name: Snøkuten Glestadrunden
description: Snøkuten Glestadrunden is a trail race held in Innlandet on February 10. The race offers distances of 7.4 km and 9.5 km and is designed to provide an exciting and challenging experience for participants of all levels. Participants will have the opportunity to experience beautiful scenery and challenging terrain.

images.alt_text: Spektakulært fjellandskap med innsjø og person på en klippe.

name: Hamarkarusellen Vinter Løp 2
description: Hamarkarusellen Vinter is the winter edition of Hamarkarusellen. Unlike the summer version, all races follow the same 5-kilometre course on lit pedestrian and cycle paths in the Prestrud area of Hamar. We keep the same officially measured 5-kilometre course for every race, making it an excellent opportunity to use as a test race. Everyone is welcome, whatever their ambitions: walkers (untimed or timed), runners (untimed or timed), those who want to compete with themselves or beat the neighbour, and active super-runners.

name: Kaarinan Syysmaraton
description: Kaarina Autumn Marathon is run on an approximately 10.5-kilometre loop through the beautiful, flat terrain of Kaarina and Piikkiö. All distances—10 km, half marathon and marathon—are officially measured. Race headquarters are located at Valkeavuori School, and the event takes place on 18 October 2025. Everyone who finishes their fifth marathon receives a silver medal, and those who finish their tenth receive a gold medal.

name: Kankaanpää Maraton
description: Kankaanpää Marathon is a versatile running event offering participants several different distances. The event includes a marathon (42.195 km), a half marathon (21.1 km), and a 10 km run. The course is designed to offer beautiful scenery and varied terrain, making the run both enjoyable and challenging. The marathon course is officially measured and meets international standards, making it possible for competitors to set personal records.

name: Poznań Malta #72
description: KIPRUN Poznań Malta is a free running and Nordic walking event held by Poznań’s Malta Lake. The event takes place in a friendly atmosphere, with precise timekeeping and no race bib required. The route offers 5 km and 10 km distances, with the finish on the lower pedestrian path by Malta Ski. It’s a great opportunity to start running or train with a group, and participants can enjoy sweets and water at the finish.
course_highlights: The 5 km starts level with the HP Park Hotel, near the beach volleyball court and GIGAPARK
The 10 km route consists of two 5 km loops, passing the finish line on the way
The finish is on the lower pedestrian path by Malta Ski, close to the lake shore
additional: Times are recorded using a token handed out at the finish and marked with the participant’s finishing place. The organizer provides blue storage boxes at the 5 km start, which are transported to the finish. Participants can also leave their belongings at the finish, but the organizer is not responsible for items left there. Instructional videos showing how to complete the route correctly are available. The event takes place from 19:00 to 21:00. Register via Decathlon GO; no race bib is required. Water and something sweet are available at the finish.

name: Begbyjoggen
description: Begbyjoggen is a weekly recreational run in Fredrikstad, offering an accessible event for everyone. The run takes place on gravel paths in the lit trail and features a main 6.8 km route starting at the Begbyporten clubhouse and passing Bjørneklova, heading down Alleen, going around the golf course, and returning via Bjørneklova. There is also a separate 4.6 km route for those who want to walk or jog. The event takes place every Wednesday at 18:00, and tickets are sold via Strava.com.
course_highlights: 6.8 km route on gravel paths in the lit trail
Start and finish at the Begbyporten clubhouse
Separate 4.6 km route for walkers and joggers
additional: Weekly recreational run every Wednesday at 18:00. An accessible event for everyone. The route follows a gravel path in the lit trail. Start and finish at the Begbyporten clubhouse. The weekly meetup is listed as Wednesdays at 18:00 at Begbyporten (the “clubhouse”).

name: GIF Joggen
description: GIF Joggen is a challenging but friendly competition against yourself or others, an accessible race for everyone, or a wonderful walk in the Gressvik forest. This event is for everyone, from children in strollers to seniors nearing 100 years old. That’s how we can make the most of the day.

name: Pukinmaki Run 1/2 Maraton 10k 5k
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki. The officially measured distances are 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 1 km children's race. The course loops around the boundaries of Pukinmäki on flat roads and paths, approximately 85% of which are paved. It is a fast course with only 4.9 metres of elevation gain, making it ideal for all runners.

name: Apkaimju brīvības skrējiens
description: The Neighborhood Freedom Run is a friendly, community-building run held in Atgāzene, Riga’s smallest neighborhood. The run covers Atgāzene, Torņakalns, and Ziepniekkalns. Its aim is not competition, but a sense of community and support for Latvia’s freedom. The route is approximately 10.2 km long, and the pace is moderate, accommodating all participants. The event takes place on November 18, starting at 11:00, and includes several breaks for rest and water.
course_highlights: The route covers Atgāzene, Torņakalns, and Ziepniekkalns
Three five-minute breaks with water and first aid available
Start and finish at the intersection of Atgāzenes iela and Vienības gatve
additional: The first 40 people to register and run will receive a commemorative gift from the organizers. Participants can leave warm clothing and bags in the organizers’ car at the start/finish area. The run aims to foster a sense of community and support for Latvia, not to compete for results. During the run, the organizers avoid having groups gather and adapt the pace to the slower participants.

name: Rembates aplis
description: “Rembates Circuit” is a running event in Rembate that brings together running enthusiasts for a shared competition. Participants can compete in various distances and age groups. The event offers an opportunity to test their abilities and enjoy the running atmosphere in Rembate.

name: Latvijas kontūras skrējiens
location: Valmiera Town Hall Square (Valmieras rātslaukums), Valmiera, Latvia
description: The Latvian Contour Run in Valmiera is a traditional festive run held on 18 November at Valmiera Town Hall Square. Participants can complete a 12.3 km route along streets named after notable figures and past popular sights in Valmiera. The event also includes a festive quiz with 12 checkpoints, where participants use the Qrenteerings mobile app to check in and enter a prize draw. The run is friendly to everyone, and finish times are not important, so participants can complete the route at their convenience throughout the day.
course_highlights: A 12.3 km route along Valmiera streets named after notable figures
The route passes Valmiera Castle ruins, Vecpuišu Park, Valmiera Olympic Centre and the Music School
12 checkpoints with QR codes for quiz participants
additional: To take part in the quiz, download the Qrenteerings app and use course code valmiera22. There are no traffic restrictions during the event; participants must follow traffic regulations. Participants are encouraged to attach a ribbon in the colours of the Latvian flag or another Latvian-themed decoration to their clothing. The route has 12 QR checkpoints, and the quiz in the Qrenteerings app is available from 9:00 to 21:00. Part of the route runs along minor roads and trails that may be harder to navigate by bicycle or with a stroller.

name: Østmarka Trail Challenge
description: Østmarka Trail Challenge organizes tough and challenging trail races in Østmarka. This race, taking place on Saturday, August 23, 2025, is not for the faint-hearted, as it features 37 km of technically demanding terrain and nearly 1,000 metres of elevation gain. Participants will experience trails that cross rough, rocky ground, and after many hours of preparation, they will feel ready for this challenge.

images.alt_text: Kart over Østmarka Trail løp, som viser ruten gjennom skogen.

name: Hodelyktløpet Østmarka
description: Østmarka Trail Challenge – The Headlamp Race is a technically demanding trail race of approximately 12 km, running mainly on blue- and red-marked trails in Østmarka. The route will be marked all the way by the organizers, but there is definitely a chance of taking a wrong turn, so it is important to pay close attention, especially at trail junctions. A good headlamp is essential! From the start at Skullerud, we follow the Flyktningeruta up to Rundvann, before taking the technically challenging blue trail downhill.

images.alt_text: Hodelyktløpet i Østmarka: Løpere med hodelykter klare for nattløpet i regnet.
Løpere med hodelykter løper i mørket før Hodelyktløpet i Østmarka.

name: Hodelyktløpet i Østmarka
description: The Headlamp Run in Østmarka is a technically demanding trail race of approximately 12 km, mainly following blue- and red-marked trails in Østmarka. The race takes place in the evening, starting at 19:30, and a good headlamp is required to navigate in the dark. Runners face challenging terrain with 400 metres of elevation gain. The race offers a nature experience in beautiful surroundings, with demanding trails. There are no food or drink stations along the route, so runners must bring their own drinks.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km of technically demanding trail running
The course follows blue- and red-marked trails in Østmarka
400 metres of elevation gain and demanding trails, with a risk of going off course
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Skullerud park between 18:15 and 19:00 on race day. There are good parking options and public transport to the start area. Indoor changing facilities and luggage storage are available. The course is marked throughout, but runners are advised to pay close attention to avoid going off course. There are no food or drink stations during the race, so runners must bring their own drinks. Participation is at your own risk. The start and finish are by the entrance towards Østmarkaporten. Start at 19:30, with space for up to 200 participants.

name: AURA Nytårsløbene 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris : kr. 199,- uanset distance // Børn under 15 år kr. 125,-

description: AURA Nytårsløbene 2026 byder velkommen til en smuk løbetur i efterårets gyldne farver i Marselisborg Skovene. Deltagerne kan vælge mellem 5 km og 10 km distancer, som løbes på en afspærret rute, der både giver mulighed for at sætte en hurtig tid eller nyde en hyggelig oplevelse i roligt tempo med familie og venner. Start og mål er ved Aarhus Atletik- og Løbeakademi, og alle modtages i mål med kakao og godt humør. Løbet er en del af en hyggelig løbsserie arrangeret af Aarhus 1900 Atletik og Løb & AURA.
course_highlights: Løb i Marselisborg Skovene med efterårets flotte farver
Afspærret rute med mulighed for både hurtig tid og hyggeligt tempo
Start og mål ved Aarhus Atletik- og Løbeakademi
additional: Deltagerne kan vælge at løbe eller gå distancerne. Der er kakao og godt humør ved målet. Løbet er en del af en løbsserie med flere arrangementer i Aarhus, herunder Lysløbet og Adventsløbet.

name: Mustaschmilen Stockholm
description:
Mustaschmilen arrangeras inne på Solvalla, Stockholm där hästarna lämnar plats för löpare under en dag och vi ser fram emot en folkfest den 21 november. Vi kommer fylla stadion med löpare i alla åldrar och välkomnar dig oavsett om du är elitlöpare eller glad motionär. Tillsammans med publik, sponsorer och aktiviteter ser vi till att det blir en oförglömlig arenaupplevelse.

Mustaschmilen i Stockholm består av tre distanser; 5 km, 10 km samt 1 km för barnen, där de två längre loppen kommer att genomföras som en varvbana fylld av peppig musik och en påhejande speaker längs med den 1 000 meter långa banan.
additional:
10:00 – Nummerlappsutdelning öppnar
Se till att hämta din nummerlapp i god tid innan start.
11:00 – Start 5 km, oavsett tempo
12:15 – Start för barnloppet, 1 km
12:45 – Start 10km, tävling
14:00 – Start 10 km, motion

Ca. 10 minuter innan varje start kommer Runacademy hålla i gemensam uppvärmning.

name: Torsdagsløpet
description: The Thursday run in Sarpsborg was a real Easter treat on Maundy Thursday, with glorious weather and a well-deserved break from the long-forecast rain. The run, which takes place on Thursdays until mid-October, offers lovely routes through the extensive network of trails in Kalnesskogen. Although there were a few icy sections, conditions were generally excellent for both runners and organizers.

name: Bislett 24 Hour Indoor
description: Bislett 24-hour is a unique indoor race held at the famous Bislett Stadium in Oslo. Participants have 24 hours to run as far as possible around the 542-meter track. The event attracts both experienced ultrarunners and beginners who want to test their limits in a supportive and motivating environment. The race is sold out, and prizes include a large achievement medal for those who reach 150 km (men) and 130 km (women).

name: 5 Km Sport Glexe
description: 5 Km Sport Glexe is a certified course offering a fast route along new pedestrian and cycle paths on the way to Gvarv. This race is perfect for both beginners and experienced runners looking to set new personal records.

images.alt_text: Rød 3D-modell av tallet 5.

name: Klubbmesterskap 5k
description: The Club Championship 5K is a running competition that is part of Tjøme Running Club’s events. The courses are officially measured, and the race is run over a distance of 5 km. This championship gives members the opportunity to compete for club championship titles and set club records. The race takes place at the beautiful Grønneset by Ånøya on Wednesday, June 25, with the start from 18:00, and is designed to challenge both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Ryggejoggen, løp nr. 2306
description: Ryggejoggen is an informal series of fun runs organised by Rygge IL’s athletics and fitness group since 1982. The runs take place weekly on different courses adapted for winter and summer, with no entry fee and no ranking of results. During the winter season, the runs are held on Saturdays, starting from Idrettshuset. During the summer season, they are held on Thursdays from the Ryggejoggen cabin, on beautiful woodland trails. Participants are rewarded for taking part 25, 100 and 200 times, with a Ryggejoggen T-shirt as the prize.
course_highlights: Winter season: 3.4 km, 6.2 km and 8 km routes on gravel roads along the railway, including approximately 500 m of asphalt
Summer season: 2 km, 4.3 km and 7.2 km routes through beautiful woodland, using cycle/pedestrian paths and farm roads
Starts from Idrettshuset in winter and from the Ryggejoggen cabin by Rygge Church in summer
additional: Winter-season runs start at 13:30, with officials present from 13:00. Summer-season runs start at 17:30, with officials present from 17:00. Prizes are awarded after 25, 100 and 200 participations: a Ryggejoggen T-shirt. Membership in Rygge IL athletics costs NOK 250 per year, or NOK 400 for a family.

name: Bergen Cider Marathon
description: Bergen Cider Marathon is a unique race that combines running, Bergen and cider for a different kind of marathon experience. The route goes through Fyllingsdalstunnelen, the world’s longest tunnel for pedestrians and cyclists, and continues through beautiful surroundings in Bergen. Half-marathon runners complete one lap, while marathon runners complete two laps and pass through the tunnel four times. After the race, participants are invited to a cider party with tastings of different ciders and food inspired by Bergen and Hardanger.
course_highlights: The route goes through Fyllingsdalstunnelen, the world’s longest tunnel for pedestrians and cyclists
Three laps around Store Lungegårdsvannet in central Bergen
A certified course through beautiful surroundings in Bergen
additional: All participants receive a technical running shirt included in the price. There will be no medal, but participants can print a certificate after the race. Refreshments during the race will be non-alcoholic cider, water and cordial/energy drink. After the race, a separate cider party will be held at Siderbaren, featuring tastings of at least seven different ciders and food. It requires a separate ticket and has limited capacity. Registration is for the selected distance, and it is possible to transfer your entry to someone else. Start at 09:00. Aid stations will serve non-alcoholic cider, water and cordial or energy drink. The cider party at Siderbaren requires separate registration and has limited capacity. Age limit: 18.

name: Barteløpet Tønsberg
organizer: Prostatakreftforeningen i Vestfold og Revetal Halvmaraton
description: Barteløpet Tønsberg is a charity race supporting the Prostate Cancer Association in Vestfold. The event includes a 5 km race on a flat course starting from the campervan parking area at Grevestien and going around Illene National Park and Semslinna, on gravel and asphalt. A children’s race is also held, and no advance registration is required to participate. Race numbers can be collected at the race office on the day of the event.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km course
The course goes around Illene National Park
Gravel and asphalt surfaces
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:30, with no advance registration required. The 5 km Barteløpet starts at 12:00. The children’s race starts at 11:30, and the 5 km race starts at 12:00. Advance registration is not required for the children’s race.

name: i Heiane ODDERØYA OPP
description: i Heiane ODDERØYA OPP is a mountain race held in Kristiansand on November 21, 2026. The race focuses on elevation gain and terrain, and is suitable for runners who want to challenge themselves on hilly ground. Treni offers training guidance tailored specifically to the race, focusing on proper training for both uphill and downhill elevation. The event is a great opportunity for both experienced and motivated runners seeking a demanding and rewarding racing experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Mountain race focused on elevation gain
Trail race on hilly terrain on Odderøya
Held in scenic surroundings in Kristiansand
additional: Treni offers a training app with guidance for the race, including an expert guide featuring mountain runner Eirik Haugsnes. It is recommended to train uphill and downhill elevation separately and taper properly before the race.

name: Tyn_deg BARNEKARUSELL Odderøya
description: Tyn_deg BARNEKARUSELL Odderøya is a children’s fun run held on Odderøya in Kristiansand. The race focuses on giving children a safe and enjoyable running experience without injuries, in an environment adapted to them. It is part of a series that encourages running and activity among children in the local area. The event is well suited to young runners who want to take part in a social and inclusive race.
course_highlights: The race takes place on Odderøya in Kristiansand
A children’s race series focused on safety and injury prevention
A fun and inclusive running environment for children
additional: The race is part of a series that emphasizes running without injuries and builds training programs based on the runner’s actual activity. Participants are encouraged to register via affiliated timing systems, but no direct registration link is provided.

name: Nidaros Vinterkarusell: Løp 1
description: Nidaros Vinterkarusell is a winter running series organized by Strindheim IL Friidrett, with races held at Ranheimshallen. Race 1 takes place on Saturday, February 7, starting at 15:00, and offers an indoor running experience with timing by EQTiming. The event is open to all ages, with separate prices for under and over 18s, and includes a one-time license. The series continues with several races during the winter months, offering both recreational runners and competitive track and field athletes a great opportunity to compete in a social and inclusive environment.
course_highlights: Indoor race at Ranheimshallen
Timing by EQTiming
Races for all ages, with separate distances for children and adults
additional: Registration is available on the day of the event for a fee. A one-time license of NOK 20/30 may be charged in addition. Results are published after the race. Race 2 is also held at Ranheimshallen, with a 3000 m race for everyone and a 1000 m race for children. Past and upcoming events include Trønderjogg, Nidaroslekene, Nidaros løpefest and Jentebølgen. Previous races have used timing by EQTiming. The listed price information is not specific.

name: Ryggejoggen, løp nr. 2307
description: Ryggejoggen is an informal running series organized by the Rygge IL athletics and fitness group since 1982. The event is held weekly on different routes adapted to summer and winter, with no entry fee or rankings. The winter routes follow gravel roads along the railway, with some asphalt, while the summer routes pass through beautiful woodland, with sections of shared walking and cycling paths. Participants are rewarded for taking part 25, 100 and 200 times, with a Ryggejoggen T-shirt as the prize.
course_highlights: The winter routes of 3.4 km, 6.2 km and 8 km follow gravel roads along the railway, with approximately 500 m of asphalt
The summer routes of 2 km, 4.3 km and 7.2 km pass through beautiful woodland, with sections of shared walking and cycling paths
The routes include crossing Kurefjordveien and a hiking trail by Ryggejogghytta
additional: During the winter, the runs are held on Saturdays, with a mass start at 13:30 from Idrettshuset. Officials are on site from 13:00. During the summer, the runs are held on Thursdays, with a mass start at 17:30 from Ryggejogghytta. Officials are on site from 17:00. Participants are rewarded after 25, 100 and 200 runs with a Ryggejoggen T-shirt. There is no entry fee and results are not ranked.

name: Nidaros Vinterkarusell: Løp 1
description: Nidaros Winter Series is a winter running series organised by Strindheim IL Friidrett at Ranheimshallen in Trondheim. Race 1 takes place on Saturday 7 February from 15:00, with timing provided by EQTiming, but the times are not recognised for records or annual statistics. The series offers races for different age groups and distances, and is part of a wide-ranging programme focused on inclusion and creating a welcoming environment for everyone who enjoys athletics. Strindheim IL Friidrett has a long tradition and a strong community for both recreational and elite athletes.
course_highlights: Indoor race at Ranheimshallen
Races for all ages over different distances
Timing by EQTiming, but times are not recognised for records
additional: Registration is available on race day for a fee. A one-off licence may cost extra (20/30 kr). Race 2 also takes place at Ranheimshallen on Sunday 8 March from 15:00, with a 3000 m race for everyone and a 1000 m race for children. Results are published after the race.

name: Köykkyri NUTS
description: NUTS Köykkyri is a relaxed but lively trail running event where you take on Köykkyrin Hill and enjoy good company. Expect hill training, sweat, and a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere, elf-runner style! Experience the thrill of Kempele’s “high altitude” and the true excitement of hill running, with 25 meters of elevation gain. Get ready to dash across the “summit” of Kempele, where every climb is a celebration and every descent deserves applause.

name: 24H Online Running
description: 24H Online Running is a unique race that takes place over 24 hours, where participants can choose to run, walk, or cycle. This event offers the possibi

name: 13. Schloss Marienburg Marathon
description: The 13th Schloss Marienburg Marathon takes place on November 21, 2026, in Nordstemmen-Adensen. This varied scenic marathon is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The course follows village streets, paved and unpaved country lanes, woodland paths, and trails, with about 560 metres of elevation gain. A special highlight is the refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg, where runners can take a break. The 21.1 km course is shaped like a figure eight, with three refreshment stations in Adensen, and offers beautiful views of the Calenberger Land and the Leinebergland in good weather.
course_highlights: Varied course featuring village streets, country lanes, woodland paths, and trails
Refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg
Figure-eight course with about 560 metres of elevation gain and views of the Calenberger Land and Leinebergland
additional: Early marathon start at 9:00 a.m. for runners who need more than 6 hours. Official electronic timekeeping. Refreshments approximately every 5 km, including water, tea, isotonic drinks, cola, fruit, and gingerbread. Changing rooms, showers, toilets, and baggage storage in the start/finish area. German Red Cross medical service in the start/finish area and along the course. Participant limit: 550 runners, including a maximum of 300 half-marathon runners. Hilly course with trails, 560 metres of elevation gain, scenic views, aid stations every 5 km.

name: 50. See-Park-Lauf
description: The 50th Bad Gandersheim See-Park-Lauf is a traditional road race held in late November in the Seepark in Bad Gandersheim. Organized by SVG GW Bad Gandersheim, the race offers categories for various age and performance groups, including boys, girls, men, women, juniors, open runners, and masters up to 95+. The event is closely connected to Oberschule Bad Gandersheim, whose students and teachers take part and support the organizing team. After the race, results, personalized certificates, and a photo gallery are made available online.
course_highlights: Road race in the grounds of Seepark Bad Gandersheim
Separate categories for a range of age and performance groups
Strong connection to Oberschule Bad Gandersheim, with active participation
additional: There are two distances: 400 m and 10 km. Typical November weather is expected, with daytime highs of around 7 °C and rainy days. The organizing team consists of about 50 people, supported by around 80 students and teachers. Road race in Seepark, distances of 400 m and 10 km, organized by the school, with rain expected due to November weather.

name: Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser
description: The Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser is a traditional race held at the end of the running season, taking participants through the Braunsteich nature reserve. A particular highlight is crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, which offers a picturesque view across the water. The event is for all ages, from children to seniors, who enjoy running and walking. The race is part of the Dresden District Rankings and the Niederlausitz Cup, and is officially recognized by the German Athletics Association in the walking category.
course_highlights: Crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, with views across the water
The route mainly follows public forest paths, with three short sections on quiet residential cul-de-sacs
Autumnal November atmosphere in the Braunsteich nature reserve
additional: The 5 km and 10 km routes have three short sections on public roads, which have little traffic as they are residential cul-de-sacs. The rest of the route follows moderate forest paths, some of which are cross-country style. The race is open to all age groups, and walking is also officially recognized. Participant limit of 300–500; medals for finishers; registration on site or online; free showers and changing rooms available; integrated into regional athletics.

name: Crossmeisterschaft SC Magdeburg
description: The SC Magdeburg Cross Country Championships is a traditional cross-country running competition organized by SC Magdeburg and the City of Magdeburg in Saxony-Anhalt. As a championship cross-country race in the German athletics calendar, it offers a challenging off-road course that differs from classic track races. The event is part of the DLV system, with official entries, rules, and timing, and is supported by the volunteer club and federation culture. The races take place in November, typically in cool and rainy weather, offering an authentic cross-country experience for club and federation runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country course, not on a track
Distances: 700 m and 1.4 km
Event held as part of the German athletics calendar
additional: The event is officially listed in the DLV system, with entries, rules, and timing. Typical November weather is cool (7 °C, low of 2 °C) and rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The start location is in Magdeburg; detailed directions are available. Cross-country course, distances of 700 m and 1.4 km, held in November in rainy weather

name: Lipperland Marathon
description: The Lipperland Marathon in Dörentrup offers a friendly, family atmosphere without crowds along the roads. The event is known for its straightforward organization and takes place in the beautiful Lipperland region in autumn. Runners can look forward to great views and a pleasant atmosphere in Humfeld. The event is organized by TuS Humfeld 1911 e.V. and is aimed at all participants looking for a personal running experience.
course_highlights: Marathon in a family-friendly setting
Beautiful Lipperland region in autumn with great views
No crowds along the roads
additional: The course runs through hilly terrain; start at the Humfeld sports hall; family-friendly; includes half-marathon and loop-course options; registration by bank transfer

name: Winterserie PSV Rot-Gold Lehrte 26/27
description: Die Winterserie des PSV Rot-Gold Lehrte bietet in der wettkampfarmen Zeit eine lockere Laufgelegenheit für Einsteiger, Fortgeschrittene und erfahrene Läufer sowie Walker. Die Läufe finden samstags statt und fördern das gemeinsame Laufen in Gruppen auf verschiedenen Streckenlängen. Die Veranstaltung findet bei jedem Wetter auf öffentlichen Straßen sowie befestigten und unbefestigten Wald- und Feldwegen statt. Nach dem Lauf gibt es die Möglichkeit zum Austausch bei kostenfreier Verpflegung im Vereinsheim.
course_highlights: Laufen auf öffentlichen Straßen sowie befestigten und unbefestigten Wald- und Feldwegen
Verschiedene Streckenlängen: 5 km, 10 km, 15 km und längere Strecken sowie 5 km Walking
Gemeinsames Laufen in Gruppen mit Begleitung durch Mitglieder des PSV Rot-Gold Lehrte
additional: Treffen ab 13:45 Uhr am Vereinsheim des PSV Rot-Gold Lehrte e.V., Hohnhorstweg 3, 31275 Lehrte. Umkleide- und Duschmöglichkeiten sowie Parkplätze sind am Startort vorhanden. Kostenfreie Verpflegung mit Tee, Kaffee und Kuchen solange der Vorrat reicht. Keine Zeiterfassung, da kein Wettkampf. Abschlussveranstaltung im Vereinsheim mit Speisen und Getränken.

name: Berliner Mannschaftslauf - einzeln oder als Team
location: Stadion An der Windmühle, Buckower Damm 150, 12349 Berlin, Germany
description: Der Berliner Mannschaftslauf am 21. November 2026 ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf rund um den Britzer Garten mit Strecken für Halbmarathon, Viertelmarathon und 3,7 km. Das besondere Format mit Teamstart im 20-Sekunden-Takt sorgt für Spannung und Teamgeist. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Jugendliche und Erwachsene mit verschiedenen Wertungen, darunter Jugendpokal und Läufercup. Die abwechslungsreiche Strecke führt durch Grünanlagen und bietet ein Naturgefühl mitten in der Stadt. Fotos der Läufer werden kostenlos bereitgestellt.
course_highlights: Abwechslungsreiche Strecke durch Grünanlagen und vorbei am Britzer Garten
Teamstart im 20-Sekunden-Takt für besondere Spannung
Wertungen für Jugendliche und Erwachsene inklusive Jugendpokal und Läufercup
additional: Start und Ziel sind am Stadion „An der Windmühle“, Buckower Damm 150, 12349 Berlin. Teamnamen können am Veranstaltungstag ergänzt werden. Die Teilnahme ist sowohl einzeln als auch als Team möglich. Fotos der Läufer werden kostenlos zur Verfügung gestellt, wenn sie vor der Kamera erfasst werden. Vorgesehen sind Wertungen für Jugend, Aktive, Masters und den Volkslauf.

name: FLVW Crossmeisterschaften
location: Schloß Neuhaus, Paderborn, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

name: Kreismeisterschaften Crosslauf
location: Ofen, Bad Zwischenahn, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: II Mazowiecki Bieg Jesieni
description: The 2nd Mazovian Autumn Run is an annual race held in Staroźreby, taking place on November 21, 2026. Participants can compete in the 10 km race, and a 400-meter race is prepared for the youngest runners. The event is open to everyone, offering attractive prizes, medals, and the opportunity to take part in both the main race and children’s races. The race takes place in urban and park areas, providing a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 10 km route on asphalt and through park areas
400-meter race for children
Medals and prizes for participants
additional: Online and on-site registration; the event also includes a program for children and adults, with the schedule and details available on the organizer’s website.

name: Botaniczna Piątka – Gdynia, edycja jesienna
location: Botaniczny Ogród w Gdyni, Gdynia, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Autumn Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event places special emphasis on the scenic appeal of its courses, offering picturesque and attractive surroundings for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors and join a close-knit running community. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take part in the autumn edition of the event in Gdynia.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque courses in Gdynia
Courses with scenic appeal and a natural character
Organized with passion and experience since 2014

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and environmental protection. Events offer a range of distances: 5 km and 10 km races, Nordic walking, and shorter races for children and young people. The course runs through forest terrain and climbs twice to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the park’s highest point, providing challenging, mountainous conditions. The event brings runners and sports enthusiasts together in a family-friendly atmosphere, with a participant limit of 500.
course_highlights: The course is entirely on forest trails and follows a 5.15 km loop
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The race centre and spectator support are located after approximately 3.7 km
additional: Children's races start between 9:00 and 9:45, over distances of 200m, 500m, 1000m and 1500m. The 5 km race starts at 10:50, the 10 km race at 11:00, and Nordic walking at 11:02. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30 in the Łopuchówko Forest District Educational Centre building. Runners in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. After leaving the forest, the finish-area layout separates runners finishing the race from those continuing for a second lap. This is the second stage of the series. Online registration closes on Thursday at 20:00.

name: Borecka Lekuk Trail
description: Borecka Łękuk Trail is an ultramarathon held in the Masurian region, in the scenic Borecka Forest, with its base at Folwark Łękuk. Participants can choose from four distances: 10 km, 21 km, 30 km and 45 km, which run through varied forest and natural terrain with moderate elevation gain. The event combines sporting competition with immersion in nature and promotes physical activity and running tourism outside the peak season. The organizers prioritize safety and ecology and offer a varied program of accompanying activities, including conferences, an after-party and recovery sessions.
course_highlights: The routes run through the Borecka Forest on natural forest surfaces
Distances have varying elevation gains, from +64 m to +284 m
Start and finish at the Folwark Łękuk hotel, with a transfer to the start of the longest distance
additional: Mandatory equipment for the 30 km and 45 km distances includes a charged phone, drink containers, at least three energy bars or gels, a headlamp or flashlight, an emergency blanket, a head covering and a waterproof jacket. The distances start on Saturday, November 21, 2026, with a transfer to the 30 km start. After the race, an after-party will be held at the Ogień i Woda Restaurant. Separate races for children are scheduled for Friday, November 20. Participants must follow safety and environmental rules, including the ban on leaving litter on the course. The race office and race-pack collection will be open on November 20 at Folwark Łękuk. The organizer provides a transfer to the 30 km start near the Czerwony Dwór Forest District Office; getting to this start independently is prohibited. The 10 km distance can be completed by running or walking.

name: Kristianstad Trail
description: Kristianstad Trail arrangeras av Härlövs IF i Bockeboda-området utanför Kristianstad och marknadsförs som en höstlig höjdpunkt för traillöpare. Loppet erbjuds i flera distanser vilket gör det tillgängligt både för erfarna traillöpare och motionslöpare. På webbplatsen finns preliminär tävlingsinformation och banor publicerade samt information om provlöpning inför evenemanget. Arrangörssidor och anmälningslänk finns samlade på tävlingens hemsida.
course_highlights: Löpning i Bockebodaskogen - skogsterräng nära Kristianstad
Flera distanser: ca 25 km (25 - 26,4 km), 12 km (12 - 12,9 km) och 5 km (5,3 - 5,7 km) beroende på mätmetod
Banlängder anges med variation beroende på olika mätmetoder
additional: Anmälan: enskild anmälan och anmälan av grupper nämns på sidan. Webbplatsen nämner försäkring och har en länk till anmälan för tidigare års upplaga (Anmälan till Kristianstad Trail 2025). Det har också förekommit provlöpning inför loppet och tidigare kommunicerats att efteranmälan varit möjlig via Racezoo. Loppet har en lång tradition i Kristianstad och information om årets upplaga finns i nyhetsartiklar och tävlingsinformation på Härlövs IF:s sida samt RaceID-sidan.

name: Karmøy Marathon
description: Karmøy Marathon wraps up the running season in the fresh West Norwegian air. The marathon course takes you through three towns, along the coastline on both the east and west sides of Karmøy, with the North Sea as your closest neighbour. This year, IL Trio is strongly represented, with participants in both the full and half marathon, including Emil Solli Stafsnes, who is taking part in his first full marathon. Results will be posted on Trio’s Facebook page as they become available.

name: Speira Karmøy Maraton 2026
description: Speira Karmøy Marathon 2026 is a season-ending race in the fresh West Norwegian air, taking you through three towns on Karmøy, along the coastline on both the east and west sides, with the North Sea as your nearest neighbour. The courses are nationally measured and certified in cooperation with AIMS & WA, and the start and finish are at Åkrahallen in Åkrehamn. The event offers marathon, half marathon and 10 km distances, with several aid stations and pace groups. There are also activities for children and a social running day ahead of the main event.
course_highlights: The marathon course passes through three towns and along the coastline on both the east and west sides of Karmøy
Courses nationally measured and certified in cooperation with AIMS & WA
Several aid stations with water, sports drink and cola, plus bananas in the finish area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Åkrahallen on Saturday 21 November from 12:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 07:45. Several changing rooms are available at Åkrahallen. Parking attendants will help ensure smooth traffic flow in the parking areas. Bag storage is available in a designated area at Åkrahallen. The kiosk and barbecue are run by Åkra Idrettslag. Free 700 m children's race with a warm-up and medal. Prize ceremonies for all distances take place after runners finish. Social Run takes place on 31 October, with 10 km and half marathon groups. Race day features a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and children's race. The start and finish for all distances are at Åkrahallen in Åkrehamn. The race website has a course video, GPX files, course certificate and course descriptions.

description: Noskrien Ziemu is a winter running, hiking, and Nordic walking series held in various locations across Latvia, including Ropaži Municipality. The event takes place whatever the weather, offering participants the chance to run or hike through urban areas, forests, meadows, and along gravel roads. The aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle and popularize running in winter, as well as support Latvia’s trail running team. Participants can expect high standards of quality and safety, and the opportunity to compete in the season standings and receive commemorative medals.
course_highlights: Routes run through urban areas, forests, meadows, and along gravel roads
The event takes place whatever the weather—ice, snow, rain, or frost
Start and finish are at the Ropaži Sports and Culture Centre
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 09:30 to 10:50. The start and finish are at the Ropaži Sports and Culture Centre (Sporta iela 2-k-1, Ropaži). After the event, participants receive a 10% discount at Ozolgravas café (Rīgas iela 4, Ropaži) upon showing their race number. Participant limit: 800. Departure from Riga at 8:30, arrival in Ropaži at around 9:30, return trip at 15:30 after the awards ceremony. It is strictly forbidden to enter the event centre indoors wearing shoes with spikes or dirty shoes.

name: Winterlaufserie
description: The Nuremberg Winter Running Series is a long-established running event held in several stages around Dutzendteich and Silbersee in Nuremberg. The races follow gravel and partly paved paths, where snow and ice may be present, underscoring the winter character of the event. The series offers distances from 5 km to 20 km and is open to recreational runners of all age groups. All runners are welcome; club membership is not required. Times are measured electronically, and there is a cup competition for participants who take part in all three races.
course_highlights: Course around Dutzendteich and Silbersee
Gravel and partly paved paths
Possible icy and snowy conditions on the course
additional: The winter running series consists of three races, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 20 km spread across three dates. To enter the cup competition, you must register for all three races. Bib numbers are non-transferable and must be worn visibly. Refreshments are available in the start/finish area. The course may change due to official requirements. Routes around Dutzendteich and Silbersee; snow and ice possible; accompanying people on sports equipment are not permitted; aids such as inline skates are not permitted.

name: Wilscher Geburtstags-Etappen-Marathon
description: The VfR Wilsche-Neubokel Birthday Stage Marathon is a special group run that annually honors all runners celebrating a milestone birthday that year. Participants run together at a moderate pace of 6:00 to 6:15 minutes per kilometer and can join at various refreshment stops. At these stage points, the birthday celebrants treat the runners to culinary delights, making the run a unique and enjoyable experience. The event combines sporting camaraderie with a festive atmosphere and is a cherished club tradition.
course_highlights: Group run at a pace of 6:00–6:15 min/km
Refreshment stops approximately every 5–10 km, with a 10-minute break
You can join at any refreshment stop
additional: The run honors all fellow runners celebrating a milestone birthday that year. The birthday celebrants lovingly prepare the refreshments at the stage points. Recent photos from the run are available via an external Flickr link. Group run, approx. 6:00–6:15 min/km; registration via an external link

name: Winterlauf-/Wanderserie TuS Jaderberg 1.Teil
description: The TuS Jaderberg Winter Running and Walking Series is a popular event held annually in Jaderberg. The first part of the series takes place in November and gives runners and walkers the opportunity to enjoy some friendly sporting competition. The event is known for its winter atmosphere and the support of TuS Jaderberg, which organizes the series. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Winter running and walking routes
A shared community experience
Part of a popular series in Jaderberg
additional: The first part of the series takes place on November 22, 2026. The event promotes sporting activities in the community.

name: 2 Bieg dla Jaj
description: The 2nd Bieg dla Jaj is a 5 km race in Poznań, scheduled for November 22, 2026. The event will take place by Lake Malta and encourages people to promote preventive health screenings for men together. Join the race and support an important health cause in a sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: 5 km race
Route in the area around Poznań’s Lake Malta
The event combines running with promoting preventive health screenings for men
additional: Registration is available through DoStartu.

name: Biegi im. ppłk. Maksymiliana Ciężkiego
location: Pomnik Maksymiliana Ciężkiego, ul. Dworcowa, Szamotuły, Poland
description: Dycha Ciężkiego is a race commemorating Lt. Col. Maksymilian Ciężki, taking place on November 22, 2026, in Szamotuły. The start and finish are located on Dworcowa Street, respectively by the Halszka Cinema and the Maksymilian Ciężki Monument. The race starts at 11:00, and the time limit for completing the course is 1.5 hours. The event is small-scale and is not a mass sporting event.
course_highlights: Start by the Halszka Cinema on Dworcowa Street
Finish by the Maksymilian Ciężki Monument
Course time limit: until 12:30
additional: The race is not a mass event within the meaning of the Act on the Safety of Mass Events. Timing is provided by STS-Timing using highly reliable Chronotrack active chips (99.8%). The time limit for completing the race is 1.5 hours from the start. The 10 km race starts at 11:00, and the time limit is 90 minutes. The start is planned by the Halszka Cinema, and the finish is by the Maksymilian Ciężki Monument.

name: Borecka Łękuk Trail
description: Borecka Łękuk Trail is an ultramarathon held in the Masurian region, in the picturesque Borecka Forest, with the start and finish at Folwark Łękuk hotel. Runners can choose from four distances: 10 km, 21 km, 30 km and 45 km, on routes through varied forest and natural terrain. The event focuses on safety, ecology and bringing runners together, and also offers additional activities such as Borecka Offline and Borecka Kids. It is a great opportunity to end the running season in a unique atmosphere amid the wild nature of Masuria.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Borecka Forest, with varied terrain and up to 284 m of elevation gain
The start and finish are at Folwark Łękuk hotel, providing a comfortable event base
Mandatory kit for the longer distances includes a headlamp and an NRC emergency blanket, underscoring the ultramarathon’s mountain-running character
additional: The 45 km, 21 km and 10 km races start at Folwark Łękuk, while the 30 km race starts at the Czerwony Dwór Forest District office, with a transfer provided. Mandatory kit for the 30 km and 45 km distances includes, among other items, a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, headwear and a rain jacket. The time limit for reaching the finish ranges from 4 to 7 hours, depending on the distance. An after-party is held after the race at the Ogień i Woda restaurant. Race packs can be collected at the race office, where last-minute registration is also available if places remain. The event is scheduled for 20–22 November 2026; the main races will take place on 21 November, and a free 5–7 km Coffee Run is planned for 22 November. The race pack is expected to include, among other items, a bib with a chip, a medal and a tree at the finish; accommodation is not included.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide cross-country running series over a distance of 5 km, held in beautiful woodland settings in city parks and forests. In Poznań, the route runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located on Św. Wawrzyńca Street. The event is open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compare their results on the same route over many years. Races take place regularly during the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start and finish by the municipal beach on Lake Rusałka, Św. Wawrzyńca Street
The route is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners, and is open to participants of all abilities
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the main race at 11:00. The event also includes races for children in different age categories. The route remains unchanged, allowing participants to compare their results over the years. The series also features races for children and young people.

description: The Długa Góra Mountain Half Marathon is an autumn running event held in Gdynia, in the Tricity Landscape Park. The 21.1 km course runs through picturesque moraine hills, with approximately 650 metres of elevation gain, offering challenging climbs and descents. The start and finish are located at Primary School No. 16 in Pustki Cisowskie-Demptowo. Participants can expect two aid stations along the course, a substantial finisher’s medal and prizes for the top competitors. It is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness amid beautiful forest scenery.
course_highlights: A 21.1 km course with approximately 650 m of elevation gain
Two aid stations along the course with water, isotonic drinks and snacks
Start and finish at Primary School No. 16 in Gdynia, Pustki Cisowskie-Demptowo
additional: Participant limit: 450. Time limit to finish the race: 4 hours. Race packs include a returnable chip and a race number. The course is marked with ribbons and signs every 5 km. After the race, there will be hot tea, cake and a macaroon from the sponsor. Awards will be presented to the top 3 competitors in the OPEN and age-group categories. Start at 10:30. The organizer notes that registering early is cheaper. Registration is also available at the race office on the day of the event.

description: The Radwanice Elephant Half Marathon is a running event for everyone—from experienced half-marathoners and 5 km debutants to the youngest participants in the children’s races. The start and finish are at the ROSZARNIA Social Services Centre in Radwanice. The half-marathon and 5 km routes are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). Runners can expect electronic timing, medical support, and a commemorative medal featuring a unique elephant design. Organizers also offer the option to purchase a technical event T-shirt and ensure the course is safely closed to traffic.
course_highlights: The half-marathon and 5 km routes are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Start and finish at the ROSZARNIA Social Services Centre in Radwanice
Electronic timing and medical support along the course
additional: A technical event T-shirt can be purchased during registration for PLN 39.99. The course is secured and closed to traffic. Electronic chip timing with online results. A commemorative medal for everyone who completes a race. The program also includes children’s and youth races. Registration is online; online payment and bank transfer are available. Participants receive electronic timing, medical support, and a commemorative medal.

name: sprawmy sobie ŁOMOT
location: Nadleśnictwo Łąck, ul. Lipowa 4, Łąck, Poland
description: Sprawmy sobie ŁOMOT is a cross-country trail race held in the Łąck Forest District, for runners who enjoy natural, forest surroundings. The course is over 21 kilometres long and challenging, with numerous elevation changes and difficult sections that will test participants’ endurance. The event is an amateur trail race promoting physical activity, hiking, and the region’s natural and recreational attractions. The start and finish are in Łąck, and the event is organised by the Rykowisko Foundation and the Łąck Forest District. Held in late November, it rounds off the running season with a substantial challenge for participants.
course_highlights: A course of over 21 km with numerous elevation changes
A race in the forest surroundings of the Łąck Forest District
Difficult, demanding trail sections
additional: The race office is located at the Łąck Forest District at 4 Lipowa Street. Race packs can be collected on race day from 8:00 to 10:45. The awards ceremony will take place no earlier than 30 minutes after the third finisher in each category crosses the finish line. The event promotes sustainable forest management conducted by the State Forests and brings the running community together. The race will take place on 22 November 2026. The race office is at the Łąck Forest District, 4 Lipowa Street; race packs are collected there during the hours listed in the event programme.

name: Geiteryggen-løpet
description: Join us for a magical evening run at Geiteryggen Airport on Tuesday, November 28, from 18:00. Maximum 1,000 places! Secure your spot and sign up now. Dress for lovely autumn weather, put on your headlamp, and join us. You’ll run among torches lighting the way through the dark forest and the runway’s colorful spotlights. Geiteryggen Run 2022 was a success, with as many as 700 people registered, and we’re really looking forward to this year’s race.

name: Vinterkarusellen 3. løp
description: The 3rd race in Vinterkarusellen takes place in Ålesund, with 5 km and 10 km distances measured by Kondis. Registration is online only, and race numbers can be picked up from 14:00 at Dekkmann in Fremmerholen. The start is at exactly 15:00. Runners must wear reflective gear and are encouraged to run on the left side of the road. There will be timing stations and a chance to win gift prizes after the race.

Several distances are available, including 5.6 km and 10.8 km, suitable for both beginners and more experienced runners.

The event offers several races, including a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, as well as a 1.6 km children’s course. The marathon consists of two laps of an officially measured half-marathon course. Parking is at the Loviisa Ice Hall, with signs directing participants to the start in the park, about 400 metres away.

The new route winds through Kalasatama’s urban surroundings and consists of a 5 km loop, run once for the 5 km race and twice for the 10 km race. You can take part competitively against the clock or dress up in your most outrageous Halloween costume.

Despite the cold weather and icy patches, it was an evening of strong performances and good spirits, with 106 participants completing the race.

description: Frikarusellen Race 3 takes place at Espeland sports ground in Arna on 26 November 2025. Bib collection and changing rooms open at 18:00, and the race starts at 19:00. The distance is 5 km, on a course that runs from north of the Londalskrysset junction to Gamle Haukeland station and back. Please note that roadworks are taking place about 400 m from the start, so everyone must run on the pavement, outside the barriers.

name: Frikarusellen - 3. løp
description: Frikarusellen - Race 3 is a road race held in Espeland, Bergen, as part of a series of races throughout the season. The race is suitable for anyone looking to take part in a social and inclusive running environment, whether they are a beginner or an experienced runner. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness and train for upcoming races in the series. Registration is via EQ Timing, and the organizer also offers training guidance through the Treni app to help participants train properly for the race.

name: Tuusula Trailrun
description: Tuusula Trailrun 2024 is a trail running race held on Sunday, 27 October 2024 at 11:00 at the biathlon stadium of Tuusula Sports Centre. The race course winds along the trails of Tuusula Korpikylä and Sammaloja and is marked with blue-and-yellow tape and signs. The entry fee includes the trail race, chip timing, a hot soup and a drink, and access to shower facilities at the ice rink.

The Hiidenhölkkä routes—the 10 km and 20 km (2 × 10 km) runs—loop around Nummelanharju and Nummela Airport. Hiidenhölkkä starts at 12:00 and the running event ends at 14:00.

name: Esbjerg Night Trail 2026/2027
description: Esbjerg Night Trail er en serie af natløb arrangeret af Orienteringsklubben Esbjerg i samarbejde med lokale partnere. Løbene foregår i mørke skove omkring Esbjerg og Fanø, hvor deltagerne løber med pandelampe på enten ca. 5 km eller 10 km ruter. Serien består af 8 løb fordelt over efterår og vinter, og løbene byder på udfordrende trailterræn med mulighed for mudder og snavs. Efter løbene er der hyggeligt samvær med lidt at drikke og mulighed for at vinde sponsorgaver fra Eventyrsport.
course_highlights: Løb i mørke skove omkring Esbjerg og Fanø
Trailruter på ca. 5 km eller 10 km med udfordrende terræn
Løb med pandelampe i efterår og vintermørke
additional: Løbene afholdes typisk kl. 19.00 med startsteder annonceret på Facebook kort før løbet. Deltagere under 15 år skal følges med en voksen. Der løbes 1 eller 2 omgange af ca. 5 km, og en god pandelampe samt trailsko der kan tåle mudder anbefales. Efter løbet serveres der lidt at drikke, evt. varmt, og der er mulighed for at vinde sponsorgaver. Pandelampe er nødvendig; trailsko med godt greb anbefales, da underlaget kan være mudret. Startstederne varierer mellem løbene.

description: Night TRAIL er en udfordrende trailløbssæson i Marselisborgskovene nær Aarhus, der strækker sig over seks afdelinger i efteråret og vinteren. Løbene foregår på 5 km og 10 km ruter med start efter mørkets frembrud, hvor deltagerne møder bakker, mudder, vand og sand på velafmærkede stier. Der er både konkurrenceklasser for herrer og damer med præmier samt lodtrækningspræmier, og der samles point til en samlet vinder efter alle afdelinger. Efter løbet er der suppe, sauna og hyggeligt samvær i klubhuset Silistria, som også tilbyder omklædning og bad. Start og mål er centralt placeret kun 4 km fra Aarhus centrum.
course_highlights: 5 km og 10 km trailruter i Marselisborgskovene

Løb efter mørkets frembrud med velafmærkede stier

Anbefalet transport er cykel eller gående pga. begrænset parkering og klima-karma. Bus 18 stopper tæt på ved Grumstolsvej/Bekkasinvej. Der kåres en samlet vinder efter alle 6 afdelinger i sæsonen. Start, mål og parkering ved klubhuset Silistria, Ørneredevej 15. Toilet, bad, omklædning og sauna er til rådighed.

name: Temple x Nike Winterized Challenge
description: The “Nike Winterized Challenge” with Temple Social is your motivation boost for the cold season. Keep running when the days get shorter and the weather gets colder. Join the Nike and Temple Social running community—we’ll run for 4 weeks, twice a week. Every step counts—earn points, and Nike will reward you with discounts and gifts. Four of you will have the chance to win the new VOMERO GORE-TEX!

description: Rambo Mosse Night Trail är ett unikt traillopp som går i den fascinerande naturen vid Rambo mosse naturreservat i Mölndal. Loppet, som är drygt 11 km långt, genomförs i skymningen med pannlampa och reflexmarkerad bana, vilket ger en speciell och utmanande löpupplevelse på skogsstigar. Start och mål är vid Herkulesgården, där deltagarna efter loppet kan njuta av bastu, dusch och värmande soppa i klubbstugan. Loppet är begränsat till 400 deltagare och erbjuder medalj och prisutdelning till de främsta i dam- och herrklassen.
course_highlights: Drygt 11 km på skogsstigar med reflexmarkeringar
Banan är småkuperad med en mix av skog, mossar och berghällar
Löpning i pannlampans sken med start och mål vid Herkulesgården
additional: Max 400 deltagare. Alla deltagare får en träningsmössa från Ullmax (värde 149 kr). Vätskestationer med vatten och Umara sportdryck vid cirka 4 km och 8 km samt efter målgång. Elektronisk tidtagning med mellantid. Efter loppet erbjuds dusch, bastu och värmande soppa med bröd och dryck i klubbstugan. Nummerlappar hämtas dagen innan eller på tävlingsdagen. Rekommenderad utrustning inkluderar pannlampa med tillräcklig batteritid och trailskor med bra grepp. Parkering finns i begränsad omfattning, kollektivtrafik rekommenderas. Anmälan sker via RaceID från 1 september och är öppen till 25 november eller tills de 400 startplatserna är fyllda. I startavgiften ingår vätska, soppa efter målgång, träningsmössa, medalj till fullföljande deltagare samt tillgång till omklädning, dusch och bastu.

description: Black Friday Trailrun är ett nattligt traillopp i Tuve, Göteborg, som erbjuder en gemenskap och glädje utan resultathysteri. Loppet arrangeras i november och bjuder på en utmanande bana i kolmörker med pannlampa, där deltagarna kan njuta av kuperad terräng och vackra vyer över Göteborg. Det finns en lång bana på cirka 9 km och en kortare barnbana på 2,5 km, båda med reflexmarkeringar. Efter loppet serveras grillad hamburgare och dryck för deltagarna.
course_highlights: Banan är cirka 9 km lång med små stigar och utmanande kupering
Fantastisk utsikt från Norra Toppen över Göteborg
Banan går till stor del över oupplysta stigar i kolmörker, pannlampa krävs
additional: Loppet har tre startgrupper: barngruppen (rekommenderad upp till 13 år) för 2,5 km, samt två startgrupper för långa banan: snabba gruppen (start 19:00) och lagomgruppen (start 19:10). Grupper med fem eller fler får 10% rabatt vid anmälan före sista oktober. Start och mål är vid Tolereds AIK:s klubbstuga vid Tuvevallen med närliggande kommunala parkeringsplatser och bussförbindelser. Banan är markerad med reflexer och flaggvakter finns vid vissa korsningar. Pannlampa och skor som passar blöta skogsstigar rekommenderas.

name: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp
location: Gummiverkstaden, Bankekind, Linköping Municipality, Östergötland, Sverige
description: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp är ett trivsamt, lokalt terränglopp arrangerat av Team Fillinge Ultra. Loppet är cirka 10 km långt och består till största delen av vackra grusvägar och fina stigar strax utanför Fillinge, söder om Bankekind/Linköping. Evenemanget arrangeras för andra året och har en avslappnad, välkomnande karaktär för traillöpare som vill njuta av naturen. Samling sker vid Gummiverkstaden (samling 10:40) och starten går kl. 11:00.
course_highlights: Cirka 10 km
Främst vackra grusvägar och fina skogsstigar
Samling och start vid Gummiverkstaden söder om Bankekind (nära Fillinge/Linköping)
additional: Samling för information kl. 10:40 vid Gummiverkstaden; start kl. 11:00. Loppet är organiserat av Team Fillinge Ultra (kontakt: marcuslundin@gmail.com). Webbplatsoperatör/arrangörspartner: Trailrunning Sweden AB (info@trailrunningsweden.se). Ny bansträckning inför 2025 och fullbokade 100 startplatser en vecka före loppet; ny vandringspris “The Golden Toaster”; information om logistik inkluderar buss från Linköping mot Åtvidaberg (avstigning vid Sandtorp) och parkering vid Gummiverkstaden (begränsad yta, samåkning uppmuntras).

name: Hammarby Alpin Marathon
location: Vindskyddet i Barnbacken, Hammarbybacken, Stockholm, Sverige
description: Hammarby Alpin Marathon är ett unikt alpint marathonlopp mitt i Stockholm, som går upp, över och runt Hammarbybacken. Loppet består av 22 varv och är något längre än ett vanligt marathon - en microultra som i arrangörens ordalag också kan kallas Sveriges sannolikt långsammaste marathon. Banan är teknisk och publikvänlig med varvning och mål vid vindskyddet i barnbacken. Evenemanget är ett festligt adventsfirande arrangerat av Stockholm Multisportklubb.
course_highlights: 22 varv runt Hammarbybacken (start/varvning/mål vid vindskyddet i barnbacken)
Start vid botten av backen (till vänster om liften när man tittar mot toppen) och upp över "Trysil"-delen vid bryggan
Tekniska partier: ner längs maskinvägen, runt skorstenen, genom Indianparken, innanför kolonilotterna och längs cykelbanan
additional: Arrangör: Stockholm Multisportklubb. Registrering sker vid varvning/mål (vindskyddet i barnbacken). Närmaste tunnelbana: Hammarbyhöjden. Startsituationen: start vid botten av backen till vänster om liften. Anmälan används via RaceID enligt anmälningssidan. Registrering och mål vid vindskyddet i barnbacken; väskor lämnas vid foten av backen; pressening vid regn; toaletter bakom parkeringen; allemansrätten gäller; resultat publiceras efter tävlingen (top 10 snabbare).

name: Arborettrimmen 1
description: Arborettrimmen is a wonderful tradition that has been held since Einar Søndeland started it in 1978. It set a participation record in 1983 with 587 participants, including Grete Waitz. The race offers distances for everyone in the beautiful surroundings of the Arboretum, where you can choose to run one (2.7 km), two (5.4 km) or three (8.1 km) laps. A 600 m Mini Run for children starts at 14:00.

description: Ålesund Winter Series consists of 5 races throughout the winter, with a shared start at 14:00 from BestDrive in Fremmerholen on the second Saturday of November, December, January, February and March. The next race in the 2025/2026 Winter Series is on Saturday, 8 November 2025. The race offers two distances, 5 and 10 km, on officially measured courses heading into Brusdalen, with turnarounds after 2.5 and 5 km. The 5 km distance includes a non-timed recreational class, and there is usually little traffic on Gamle Brusdals veg.

description: Join a short, technical indoor obstacle course at Trolljeger training center in Sandnes! Your grip, balance, strength, agility, and endurance will all be put to the test. The course is suitable for anyone who enjoys a good challenge. You have 15 minutes to complete it, with 3 attempts per obstacle before moving on. The person with the fewest mistakes and the fastest time wins.

name: Fedrelandet Backyard
description: Fedrelandet Backyard is this year's running event in Fetsund, and its inaugural edition takes place on November 29. The race starts at Fethallen at 08:00, and participants must complete a 6.7 km loop every hour to continue. The course is flat and runs along the picturesque Glomma, mostly on a gravel footpath with some asphalt sections. Anyone who fails to meet the time limit is eliminated from the race.

name: Forusløpet Vinter
description: Forusløpet Vinter is a social and inclusive test race organized by Spirit Friidrett, starting and finishing at the indoor parking area at Kanalsletta 4, Forus, Stavanger. The race serves as a preparation run for the Valencia Marathon and is open to runners of all levels, whether they are planning to run a marathon or want to check their fitness. The distances are 5 km and 10 km, run on a 2.5 km loop. The event has a welcoming atmosphere, with an opportunity to socialize after the race.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the indoor parking area at Kanalsletta 4, Forus
A 2.5 km loop, run twice for 5 km and four times for 10 km
A test race for the Valencia Marathon, with participants of all levels
additional: Race numbers are sent by SMS during the 24 hours before the start. Race numbers and safety pins can be collected at reception at Kanalsletta 4. An automatic SMS with the official finish time is sent if a mobile number is registered. Awards ceremony for the 5 km and 10 km after the finish. Registration via EQ Timing: https://live.eqtiming.com/84803#dashboard

name: Team Macody Kvalømilen - 4. løp
description: Team Macody Kvalømilen Winter Run 2026 is a winter race that is part of the Team Macody Series, a 10 km race series starting and finishing at AdO arena in Bergen. The course is officially measured and offers runners of all ages a great opportunity to compete in a wintry setting. The event has a long tradition and welcomes everyone to take part in a well-organised race with good facilities.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km course
Start and finish at AdO arena
Winter race in Bergen
additional: The course is officially measured and available under the “Map” tab. The course map can be found under the “Map” tab.

Freiberger Adventslauf
description: The Freiberg Advent Run takes place on November 28, 2026, in Freiberg’s festively decorated city center, combining physical activity with the special atmosphere of the pre-Christmas season. The event is a regional highlight, featuring several competitions for different age groups and distances. It attracts many runners each year and offers a festive setting with musical accompaniment, including the barrel drummers “Blechlawine” at Schlossplatz. Registration opens in June and is in high demand due to the limit of 1,000 advance registrations.
course_highlights: Freiberg’s festively decorated city center
Musical accompaniment by the barrel drummers “Blechlawine” at Schlossplatz
Various race distances from 1 km to 12 km, including a relay

Start times: Bambini Run 15:00, 1 km Children’s Run 15:15, 3 km Teen Run 15:30, 6 km Fun Run 15:45, 12 km Main Run and relay 16:30. Limit of 1,000 advance registrations.

name: Lauf gegen Gewalt an Frauen und Mädchen
Adventsjoggen
description:
Upplev en magisk start på julmyset med Adventsjoggen på Stora Hjortstorps Gård i Örebro den 29 november! Ta med vännerna, familjen eller kollegorna för en dag fylld av rörelse, gemenskap och smakupplevelser. Adventsjoggen är antingen fina 7,2 km eller utmanande 15 km. Vi har även 600 m Kidsrun för de allra yngsta. 

Efter loppet väntar en värmande belöning – en mustig gulasch och nybakat bröd, allt inkluderat i startavgiften! Banan bjuder på vackra omgivningar med start och mål vid gården, där ni springer genom idylliska landskap förbi Rävgången och Naturens Hus.

name: Skriešanas seriāls “Ugāle”, III posms
description: The “Ugāle” running series is a running event organized by the Ventspils Municipality Sports School, bringing together runners of different ages and ability levels. The series’ third stage will take place in Ugāle, giving participants the opportunity to compete and improve their results. The event is part of the Latvian Athletics Association calendar and is organized to a high professional standard, providing a quality competition environment.

name: Christmas Run To Tree
description: The Christmas Run To Tree is an atmospheric forest run in Klövensteen Forest near Hamburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: 6 km or 12 km. The run combines sporting activity with the special experience of buying a Christmas tree. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Forest run through scenic Klövensteen Forest
Choice of 6 km or 12 km distance
Race bib in the shape of a Christmas tree
additional: Race packet pickup on event day from 09:00 to 11:15. The race bib is in the shape of a Christmas tree and must be worn visibly on the chest. Bag drop-off is available with the coupon on the race bib. Late entries are not possible. Participant transfers are possible for a fee until November 25. Awards ceremony for the 6 km at 11:15 and for the 12 km at 13:00. The event includes race bib pickup, certificates, Christmas activities, and a festive atmosphere.

name: Friedeholz Cross
description: The Friedeholz Cross is a traditional forest cross-country race in Syke, Lower Saxony, and part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series. On November 29, 2026, races will be held over various distances, from a 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race to the 10.3 km main race, for children, young people, and adults. The course runs mostly on forest trails, with a short asphalt section before the finish at Waldstadion Syke. The event offers a varied cross-country running experience in an autumn setting and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Mostly forest trails with only approx. 100 m of asphalt
Start and finish at Waldstadion Syke
Part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series, with several distances
additional: Four distances on race day: 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race, 3.6 km middle distance for U16 and older, and 10.3 km main race for U20 and older. The event is part of a series of three races, with series scoring for those who register before the first race. Switching between the middle and long distances is possible, but does not count as a series switch. Forest trails, cross-country running, series scoring, registration required for series scoring, limited shower and changing facilities at Waldstadion Syke

name: Ratzeburger Adventslauf
description: The Ratzeburg Advent Run is a traditional race around Lake Ratzeburg, taking place on 29 November 2026. The main course is 26 km long and runs mostly along hiking trails, with scenic sections and historic points of interest. There is also a 7.5 km run around Küchensee and a 1.5 km children’s run, offering an accessible introduction to running. The event combines a sporting challenge with a nature experience and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 26 km around Lake Ratzeburg, with approximately 80% hiking trails and 20% asphalt
5 refreshment stations along the course at km 5, 10, 15, 20 and 22.5
A scenic, hilly 7.5 km route around Küchensee, plus a 1.5 km children’s run with crowd support
additional: New since 2022, intermediate timing on the 26 km course allows spectators and athletes to follow split times. The races start simultaneously, with runners arranged at the start on the right-hand side of Königsdamm. The children’s run is supported by Dein-Holzpferd.de.

name: Uplengener Adventslauf
description: The Uplengen Advent Run is a traditional cross-country race taking place for the 54th time. The races run through the Hollsand Nature Reserve and offer challenging courses depending on the weather. The event is one of the oldest running events in the region and is often used to prepare for cross-country championships. Various course distances give young people and adults the opportunity to achieve personal bests or improve their endurance. The Remels Primary School Friends’ Association will provide coffee and cake.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Hollsand Nature Reserve
Challenging courses depending on the weather
Various course distances for different age groups
additional: U14 runners can choose between 1450 m and 3100 m; U16 runners can take part in the 4450 m middle-distance race. The red loop is approximately 3000 m plus a 100 m start chute. The course uses a checkpoint system for route guidance. Cross-country race in the Hollsand Nature Reserve; course distances vary; registration and results online; coffee and cake from the Remels Primary School Friends’ Association.

name: VI Biegowe Grand Prix Krainy Dobrej Energii
Järvenpään Maraton
description: The Järvenpää Marathon has been held since 1994. The half marathon and marathon courses are officially measured and run mainly on a paved shared-use path around Lake Tuusula. For the first time, the route follows Tuusula’s Rantatie, offering cultural experiences for both runners and spectators. The area has excellent transport connections, and there is plenty of parking nearby. Welcome to Tuusula and Järvenpää!

name: Bjørgene Løpskarusell 3. Løp
description: The athletics group welcomes you to a new running series in Bjørgene on 4 February! The snow is gone and the trails in Bjørgene are in great condition. We hope to see you at the starting line!
