name: Advento bėgimo iššūkis 2026
description: The Advent Running Challenge 2026 is a virtual event taking place from December 1 to 24. Participants receive a new task each day, involving running, physical, accuracy, and creative challenges. The challenge encourages not only speed, but also perseverance, creativity, and engagement throughout all 24 days. Participants compete for the title of Advent Champion and receive a participant kit, with the chance to win prizes from the prize fund.
course_highlights: 24 days with 24 different tasks
Physical, accuracy, and creative challenges
A virtual running challenge with the opportunity to earn points and compete
additional: A participant kit for every participant. Prize fund: €175 (may increase depending on the number of participants). A 24-day challenge with tasks, prizes, and registration via a Google Form.

name: Adventsløpet
description: The Corporate Sports Association in Nordland, together with Flygt Bil, is organizing the Advent Run! On Wednesday, December 3, we’ll run to meet Advent in a fun, family-friendly race! It’s truly for everyone, as you can choose whether to walk, jog, or run. Distance: Choose between 5 and 10 kilometers, corresponding to one or two laps of the Tokleløypa trail. The race starts at 18:00 at Flygt Bil.

images.alt_text: Løper med startnummer 489, klar for løp.

name: Track & Glow 2026
description: Track & Glow 10K takes place at Gjesdal Idrettspark, one of Norway’s few running tracks with Wavelight technology. The race offers a separate elite field and several recreational fields, with automatic lap counting displayed on a big screen. All participants receive a finisher’s medal, and prizes are awarded to the winners of each wave in the women’s and men’s categories. The event is open to the public with free admission, and facilities such as kiosks and toilets are available on site.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a running track with Wavelight technology
Automatic lap counting displayed on a big screen
Warm-up options on walking and cycling paths, as well as a gravel road to Flassavatnet
additional: Bib distribution starts at 16:00 inside the Gjesdal IL Clubhouse. Runners in the elite heat must follow World Athletics shoe rules (maximum 20 mm sole thickness). There are 6 toilets in the clubhouse and more beneath the grandstand. The winner of each wave receives a prize. Photos from the race will be posted on social media. The kiosk is open in the clubhouse. Listed as cancelled.

name: Kolding Light Run 2026 powered by Andelskassen
Night Shift Trail - Växjö
location: Shooting range parking area, Notteryd, Växjö, Sverige
description: Night.Shift Trailrun Växjö är ett trailrunninglopp som arrangeras i natursköna omgivningar vid skjutfältets parkeringsplats i Notteryd, Växjö. Loppet fokuserar på en unik upplevelse i teknisk och utmanande terräng snarare än tävling och priser. Arrangörerna lägger stor vikt vid gemenskap och meningsfullhet, där en stor del av anmälningsavgiften går till välgörenhet. Loppet är en del av Mossarun-evenemangen som drivs av en grupp vänner med passion för trail och natur.
course_highlights: Teknisk och utmanande trail i naturskön miljö
Löpning i varierad terräng med inslag av skog och kuperade partier
Fokus på upplevelse och gemenskap snarare än tävling
additional: Arrangemanget är ideellt och en stor del av intäkterna går till Sangter Foundation som hjälper i Sikkim, Indien. Fokus ligger på små evenemang med få deltagare för att skapa en personlig och meningsfull upplevelse. Tidigare Mossarun-evenemang har inkluderat olika distanser och format, inklusive ultra och Backyard Ultra. Arrangörerna är öppna för samarbete och innovativa eventidéer. Start och mål ligger nära parkeringen vid skjutbanan i Notteryd. Startvågor anges som 17.30 - 18.00 och 19.00 - 19.30. Deltagarna får startchip och stämplar ut och in för att registrera varvtiden. Efter loppet bjuds det på mat och alkoholfri öl.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 2. løp
description: Samnanger Winter Series is an inclusive running series organised by the Samnanger IL Running Group. It takes place approximately every other Friday during winter at Nesodden. Participants can choose between 2 km and 5 km routes, with the 5 km route officially measured by NFIF. The races suit all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and focus on competition, training and socialising. Wearing a reflective vest is important during the dark winter months. The running group is informal, free and open to everyone.
course_highlights: The races take place at Nesodden, with the start and finish in the same place
Choose between 2 km and 5 km routes; the 5 km route is officially measured by NFIF
The races take place in winter darkness, so a reflective vest is required
additional: The races are held approximately every other Friday at 18:30. The running group also offers group training every Monday at 18:10 in Hagabotnane. The event is informal and free, with a focus on the joy of running and community. Wearing a reflective vest is recommended because of the darkness. The races take place approximately every other Friday from November to March at 19:00. Wear a reflective vest.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is an exceptional trail race taking place on 5 December 2026 in the picturesque Tricity Landscape Park. The course combines a seaside atmosphere with varied, mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging climbs, valleys, ravines and gorges. It is a great opportunity to end the season amid sporting competition and close contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Tricity Landscape Park, close to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, ravines and gorges
Challenging elevation gains and natural climbs characteristic of trail running
additional: Race packs can be collected on 4–5 December 2026 at the race office. Starts are held in waves: the 6 km night race starts at 19:00 on 4 December; on 5 December, the 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30) and 12 km (13:30) races start, along with Garmin Junior races for children. Time limits for completing the distances range from 2 to 15 hours, depending on course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The participant card is available 5 days before the race after logging in to startlist.pl. Distances from 12 km to 86 km, time limits, qualifying points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and young people.

name: Vinterkarusellen 3. løp
description: Vinterkarusellen 3rd race takes place in Fana, and all times achieved in this year’s series will be recognized in the statistics for both 5 km and 10 km. This means that a personal record set in Vinterkarusellen will always be recognized. Ålesund Vinterkarusell has a long history dating back to the mid-1980s, and since winter 2023, Ålesundløpene has been the organizer.

name: Grimstadvatnet Rundt
description: Grimstadvatnet Rundt is part of the Hareid Winter Series, with races held on the first Saturday of November, December, January and February, for a total of four races. The race is a 7.8 km road race that runs mostly on asphalt, and the course is relatively flat. The first race in the series was held on 5 December 1981, and the 110th race took place in November 2008. Everyone can take part, regardless of their fitness level.

images.alt_text: Løpere klare før start i Grimstadvatnet rundt.

name: Bergen Advents Maraton
description: Join the Bergen Advent Marathon on Saturday, December 6, where you can choose between the half marathon (21,097 meters) or the marathon (42,195 meters). The course is an out-and-back route on paved roads that are completely traffic-free or have very little traffic, and a large part of the route follows a disused railway line through idyllic rural surroundings. Marathon runners complete the same loop twice. The course is gently undulating, except for a hilltop at Fana Stadium that runners must go up and down from both sides.

images.alt_text: Løpere i maraton, iført røde løpeskjorter.

name: Vinterkarusellen (Romerike) – 3. løp, Løvenstad
description: Vinterkarusellen Romerike - 3rd race takes place on Saturday, December 5, 2026, on Løvenstadvegen in Løvenstad, Rælingen, Akershus. This race is part of Vinterkarusellen, a popular race series that attracts runners of all ages and abilities. The event offers a great opportunity to test your fitness during the winter months in a scenic area. Registration is easy through the WODira platform, and everyone can choose their category and register directly on the website.
course_highlights: The race takes place on Løvenstadvegen in Løvenstad, Rælingen
Held during the winter months, with fresh, crisp air
Part of an established race series in the Romerike region
additional: Registration is through the WODira event page.

name: Borredalen Rundt – Juleløpet
description: Borredalen Rundt is the Fredrikstad district’s most longstanding recreational race, held since 1962. The race takes place on Tuesday evenings during the April-to-October season. Its approximately 5.5 km course winds around Borredalsdammen through scenic surroundings, along forest trails, rocky terrain and sandy paths. This is an informal weekly event with no entry fee, built on volunteer effort and a sense of community among women and men who enjoy running. Participants register at the start and set off together, keeping their own time.
course_highlights: The course follows forest trails, rocky terrain and sandy paths around Borredalsdammen
An approximately 5.5 km route with varied terrain: trails, rocky terrain, forest paths and gravel roads
Scenic surroundings in the Fredrikstad forest
additional: The race is held every Tuesday during the summer season, with a mass start. Participants register their names at the start and must keep track of their own time and report it to the official recording the times. Volunteers run the event, with a six-week rotation in the race office. The Borredalen Rundt tradition began in 1962.

name: Mispo talvemaraton
location: Vändra Stadium, Vändra, Pärnu County, Estonia
description: Mispo Talvemaraton on traditsiooniline talvine jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Vändra staadionil. Võistlusel on neli distantsi: maraton (42,195 km), poolmaraton (21,097 km), ning kaks tervisekõnni/jooksu distantsi (14 km ja 7 km). Start antakse kell 11.00 ning finišis ootavad kõiki osalejaid joogid, toit, saun, diplom ja medal. Võistlus on mõeldud nii kogenud jooksjatele kui ka harrastajatele, pakkudes talvist väljakutset ja sõbralikku atmosfääri.
course_highlights: Talvine maastikuvõistlus Vändra staadionilt
Neli distantsi: maraton, poolmaraton, 14 km ja 7 km jooks/kõnd
Finišis ootavad saun, toit, jook, diplom ja medal
additional: Sekretariaat avatakse kell 9.00 stardi päeval. Stardi päeval on osalustasu 5 € kallim. Osalejatele on finišis saun, toit, jook, diplom ja medal. Osalustasu saab kanda pangas Terviseklubi MISPO kontole. Võistluspäeval registreerudes lisandub osalustasule 5 €. Kõigile lõpetajatele on ette nähtud söök, jook, saun, diplom ja medal.

name: Berliner Nikolauslauf 2026
price_range: 5,00 Euro bis 30,00 Euro (je nach Kategorie und Anmeldungstermin)
description: The 2026 Berlin St. Nicholas Run is a traditional race around the picturesque Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke lakes in Berlin’s Grunewald forest. The course follows a measured 5.3-kilometre lakeside path that is popular with both recreational visitors and competitive athletes. The event offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the Bambini Marathon to the Big 5 Marathon, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings. It takes place on December 6, 2026, and is organised by DIE LAUFPARTNER e.V.
course_highlights: A loop around Schlachtensee, 5.3 km per lap
A nature-rich route through Berlin’s Grunewald forest
A popular training route with top athletes and recreational visitors
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:00 a.m. at Fischerhüttenstraße 137, 14163 Berlin, near the turning circle between Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke. Race-day late entries are available online, subject to an additional fee. The event offers a range of distances for runners and Nordic walkers, as well as relay races. Distances range from 330 m to 26.8 km. Registration is available online or in writing; race-day late entries are online only and subject to a fee. Race bibs can be collected in Berlin.

name: Glücksburger Nikolaus-Crosslauf
location: Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2, 24960 Glücksburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Glücksburg St Nicholas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country event held in December in Glücksburg on the Baltic Sea, organised by TSV Glücksburg 09. The races start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2. Adults and older teenagers can choose between a medium 4.1 km cross-country run and a long 8.2 km run, while younger children take part in shorter, fun runs. The event has a St Nicholas theme, with a piggyback run for parents carrying babies and various races for toddlers and young people. Every participant receives a chocolate Santa Claus as a gift.
course_highlights: Cross-country running on varied terrain by the Baltic Sea
Start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2
A range of distances from 100 m to 8.2 km for all age groups
additional: The youngest participants’ races are not timed, to preserve their fun, playful character. The event takes place in typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. It also includes volunteer duties at the start, finish and along the course, as well as refreshments including coffee, tea and cake. Registration is online, and the event takes place at Schwennau Arena in Glücksburg.

name: XII Półmaraton Mikołajkowy w Mikołajkach
description: The 12th Mikołajki St. Nicholas Half Marathon is an annual running event taking place on 5 December 2026. Participants can compete over 21 km and 10 km, as well as in children’s and youth races. The event starts and race-pack pickup take place in the morning. After the races, trophies, prizes, and certificates are presented in a formal ceremony. The participant limit is 450, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: 21 km and 10 km routes through the streets of Mikołajki
Children’s and youth races with a separate schedule
Participant limit of 450
additional: Registration and race-pack pickup take place from 8:00 to 11:00. The children’s and youth races start at 10:30, with results and prize-giving immediately afterwards. Results and awards for the 10 km and half marathon take place at 14:15. Participation is free for people over 70, people with disabilities, and residents of the Mikołajki Municipality in both distances. The event is scheduled to start at 11:45. Online registration runs from 16 September to 1 December 2026; payment on the day is also available. The limit is 450 runners.

name: Trail!ON Stawiguda 2026/2027 #1
location: Ruś, Gmina Stawiguda, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn forest parking, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE is a winter running series consisting of four events held over half-marathon and marathon distances, as well as Nordic Walking events. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River area near Biedrusko, offering an intimate atmosphere for both recreational and professional runners. The course passes through picturesque areas along the Warta River, with varied surfaces and terrain. The start and race office are located at the Łysy Młyn forest car park by Lake Łyse, and the gun start is scheduled for 10:00.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop; the marathon is two loops.
The course follows mainly the blue cycling trail along the Warta River, as well as forest tracks and trails.
The course surface is slippery and uneven, with leaves, puddles, and mud, requiring care and preparation.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. During the 2026/2027 winter season, 5 km and 10 km races and Nordic Walking events are also held. Each race in the series has a theme and encourages participants to wear themed outfits. The course is not certified; it is measured using bike computers and a Garmin device. The race headquarters are at the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko, by Lake Łyse. The venue can be reached by car or by local and suburban buses; free parking is available. The start is scheduled for 10:00. Nordic Walking takes place over the half-marathon distance.

name: Advent Pop up Run Halleberg
location: Parking near Kungens kök, Halleberg, Vänersborg Municipality, Sverige

price_tiers.distance: Advent Pop up Run Halleberg 12-15 km

description: Fira andra advent med en unik löpupplevelse på Halleberg, ett av Västsveriges mest storslagna platåberg. Löpningen bjuder på en omväxlande och naturnära bana genom trolska skogar, förbi sjöar och längs fina stigar med varierande underlag från mjuka skogsstigar till tekniska partier och öppnare platåvägar. Under rundan får du njuta av mäktiga vyer över Vänern och en fascinerande geologi som berättar en historia från hundratals miljoner år tillbaka. Efter löpningen samlas deltagarna för ett juligt adventsfika, en mysig och välförtjänt avslutning på andra advent.
course_highlights: Mäktiga vyer över Vänern
Löpning genom trolska skogar och förbi sjöar
Varierande underlag med mjuka skogsstigar och tekniska partier
additional: Löpeturen delas in i 2-3 fartgrupper. Efter löpningen serveras ett juligt adventsfika. Samling sker vid parkeringen nära Kungens kök. Start kl. 10.00. Adventsfika ingår.

name: Lierløpet 13
description: Lierløpet is an exciting race series offering different distances for both men and women of all ages. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21.1 km, with age categories for everyone aged 11 and up. The race takes place in scenic surroundings and follows the well-known Linnesrunden, an easy-to-run route suitable for everyone. Prizes are awarded to the top runners, and there are opportunities to set personal records.

name: Itsenäisyysmaraton
description: In 2025, Itsenäisyysmaraton celebrates its 44th year and will be held on Saturday, 06.12, in Kuopio at Väinölänniemi. Several distances are offered, including the marathon, half marathon, minimarathon, and the Kultajousi Running 10 km and 5 km races. The route is 5.27 km long, flat, and runs on sand and asphalt. A refreshment station provides runners with water and juice. Participants can register in advance or on race day.

description: Langgarverne welcomes the whole family to the Julestjerneløbet, which, continuing a tradition dating back to 1980, is held on the first Sunday in December. The race fin

name: Omega kiirus
description: Omega kiirus on siseruumides toimuv sprint- ja keskmise distantsi võistlus, mis ühendab erinevas vanuses osalejad põnevas põlvkondade vastasseisus. Võistlus toimub Lasnamäe Kergejõustikuhallis Tallinnas ning pakub dünaamilist ja kaasahaaravat kogemust kõigile vanusegruppidele. Registreerimine on avatud kuni 1. detsembrini 2026.
course_highlights: Siseruumides toimuv sprint- ja keskmise distantsi võistlus
Vanusepõhine põlvkondade vastasseis
Toimumiskoht Lasnamäe Kergejõustikuhall Tallinnas

name: 47. Mühlenberger Nikolauslauf
location: Bezirkssportanlage am Ossietzkyring, Ossietzkyring, Hannover, Germany
description: Der 47. Mühlenberger Nikolauslauf ist ein familienfreundliches Laufevent in Hannover am 6. Dezember 2026. Es bietet Strecken über 2,5 km, 5 km und 10 km auf einer flachen, schnellen Strecke, ideal für Läufer aller Altersklassen und Erfahrungsstufen. Das Event findet auf der Bezirkssportanlage am Ossietzkyring statt und zeichnet sich durch eine angenehme, gemeinschaftliche Atmosphäre aus. Für Kinder und Jugendliche gibt es spezielle Läufe, bei denen alle Schüler eine Nikolaus-Überraschung erhalten, und die besten in den jeweiligen Altersklassen werden mit Urkunden und Ehrenpreisen belohnt. Das Rennen ist Teil der Lauf(s)pass-Serie der Region Hannover und lädt alle Laufbegeisterten ein, die festliche Jahreszeit sportlich zu feiern.
course_highlights: Flache, schnelle Strecke auf der Bezirkssportanlage
Familien- und kinderfreundliche Veranstaltung mit speziellen Läufen für Jugendliche
Teilnahme an der Lauf(s)pass-Serie der Region Hannover
additional: Online-Anmeldung möglich; Rennen in Mühlenberg, Hannover; Teilnahme für alle Altersgruppen; Ehrungen für Sieger und Altersklassen

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Lage is a traditional running event organized by the running division of TG Lage. The course runs through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park and features well-maintained forest trails, partly along the famous Hermann Trail. The run is suitable for runners of all ability levels and takes place annually in December. The event is part of TG Lage’s varied running and walking program, which also offers beginner courses and training opportunities.
course_highlights: Course through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park
Well-maintained, easy-to-run forest trails
Sections along the famous Hermann Trail
additional: TG Lage’s running division also offers a Nordic walking beginner course that covers the basics in 4 sessions of 60 minutes each. Walking poles are available to borrow. There is also a 10-session pass for time-limited training participation, valid for 6 months and 10 training sessions. The office is open on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Run on forest and field paths in the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park, on the 2nd Sunday of Advent; easy to reach, with a festive atmosphere in the gym.

name: Fischteiche Cross
description: The Fischteiche Cross is a traditional cross-country race in the Langenberger Forst near Leck, organised by SV Enge-Sande. It marks the end of the Cross-Cup series and offers races for different age groups and distances, from 0.8 km for the youngest children to 9.6 km for adults and seniors. The event features a varied woodland course and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments on site.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Langenberger Forst
Distances from 0.8 km to 9.6 km, depending on age group
Varied woodland course with typical December weather
additional: Starts are organised by age group and suitable distance; registration and results via myraceresult; coffee, cake and other refreshments available on site; awards ceremony after the race. Cross-country race in the Langenberger Forst, with distances for all age groups and registration via myraceresult. Weather-dependent, with possible winter conditions, and refreshments including coffee and cake.

name: Heeslinger Nikolauscross
description: The Heeslingen Nikolaus Cross-Country Run is a popular cross-country race held annually in Heeslingen, Lower Saxony. The event attracts athletes and families from the region and is known for its high-level sporting challenges. The races also determine the district champions of Rotenburg/W. The organizer, Heeslinger SC, is an established point of contact for sports enthusiasts and volunteers from the surrounding communities.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through varied terrain
Determination of the district champions of Rotenburg/W.
Event in the Heeslingen region with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Courses and participation conditions are available in the relevant event announcement; no entry fee is required. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children, young people, adults and masters.

name: Klausdorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Klausdorf St. Nicholas Run is a longstanding running event on the eastern shore of Kiel Fjord, taking place on December 6, 2026, in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district. This will be the 41st edition of the event, attracting runners from the region. The event offers a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere and is a sporting highlight for all age groups. Official registration is expected to open after the 2026 summer holidays.
course_highlights: Run along the eastern shore of Kiel Fjord
Traditional running event with a festive atmosphere
Event in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district
additional: The official registration page is expected to open after the 2026 summer holidays. Course maps are available as images on the website. Registration is expected to be available on the official website after the 2026 summer holidays; the event is known for its good value for money and family-friendly atmosphere.

name: ELM-Advents-HALBMARATHON
location: Königslutter am Elm, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: Festiwal Biegów Świętych Mikołajów – XXIV Półmaraton Świętych Mikołajów
description: The Festival of St. Nicholas Runs in Toruń is Poland’s largest St. Nicholas-themed running event, attracting more than 2,000 participants each year. The event takes place in a festive atmosphere on Toruń’s charming streets, offering a range of distances from a half marathon to a Nordic walking event. The start and finish of the main races are at the Old Town Market Square and the Municipal Stadium, respectively. Participants can expect a generous race package and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route runs through the streets of Toruń, starting at the Old Town Market Square and finishing at the Municipal Stadium
Available distances: half marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 5 km Nordic walking
Festive atmosphere and more than 2,000 runners dressed as Santa Clauses
additional: The Race Office is located at the MOSiR Tennis Courts in Toruń and is open on December 5 (15:00–20:30) and December 6 (8:00–11:00). The race package includes a long-sleeved technical shirt, a Santa hat, a sports bag, a race bib with a chip, energy bars, gifts from sponsors, a commemorative medal, and a hot recovery meal. Participants receive an SMS with their race bib number before the race. The Polish Santa Claus Half Marathon Team Championships are also held, with at least one woman required on each team. The race package includes, among other items, a long-sleeved technical shirt, a bag, and a Santa hat; at the finish, participants receive a medal, soup, and drinks. The event is accompanied by the “Santa Clauses for Children” charity campaign.

name: XIV Bieg Mikołajkowy
location: Stadion OSiR, ul. Piaskowa 97, Police, Poland
price_range: 85–110 zł (do 1 października; wpisowe będzie później stopniowo rosło)
description: The 14th St. Nicholas Run in Police is an annual running event held on December 6 at the OSiR stadium at 97 Piaskowa Street. Participants can choose between two distances—5 and 10 kilometers—on paved city roads. The event has a festive character, and participants traditionally start wearing Santa hats, with a special costume category also available. The program also includes children’s races, Nordic Walking, and the spectacular Dream Relay with Christmas trees. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and the winners’ awards ceremony will take place at 13:30.
course_highlights: A paved 5- or 10-kilometer route through the streets of Police
A festive atmosphere, with participants wearing Santa hats
The spectacular Dream Relay—a run with Christmas trees
additional: The race office opens at 8:00. Children’s and youth races start at 10:00. Nordic Walking starts at 12:10. The winners’ awards ceremony is at 13:30. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and Nordic Walking at 12:10. The main race is limited to 800 participants. Online registration is open until November 30 or until all places are filled.

name: Mikołajkowy Charytatywny Bieg i Marsz NW
Vinterkarusellen Løp 3
description: Vinterkarusellen Race 3 takes place in Fana and is part of a race series that has been held since the mid-1980s. This year, the course is certified by an authorized course measurer, which means all times achieved will be eligible for statistics for both 5 km and 10 km. Participants can expect a varied and exciting race experience in an active and social setting.

images.alt_text: Løpere under Necon Vinterkarusellen.
Løpere i vinterløp. Snø, skog, og løper i neon gult.
Løpere i aksjon under Necon Vinterkarusellen.
Fana Stadion løpebane, snø. Adventløpet.

name: Advenstløp - gled en som gruer seg til jul
description: Advent Run in central Drammen is an inclusive run of approximately 4 km, held on 8 December. Everyone can take part at their own pace, whether running, jogging or walking; the aim is not to be the fastest. The event combines activity, community and Christmas spirit, and 25% of the proceeds go to the Church City Mission’s project “Bring joy to someone who dreads Christmas.” After the run, hot drinks and something to eat will be served, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere around the event.
course_highlights: Run in central Drammen, approximately 4 km
Mass start at 18:00
Optional timing—you decide whether you want your time recorded
additional: The meeting point is by Øvre Sund Bridge on the Bragernes side, just opposite Rema 1000. Participants can collect their race numbers well ahead of the start. Members of Bedriftsidretten Buskerud og Vestfold can use the discount code Advent26.

name: Adventsløp - Gled en som gruer seg til jul
description: Advent Run in Tønsbergmarka is an inclusive and enjoyable event held to spread joy during the run-up to Christmas and support the Church City Mission’s project “Brighten Christmas for Someone Who Dreads It.” The event is suitable for everyone, regardless of age or pace, and focuses on community and activity rather than competition. Participants can run, jog, or walk at their own pace on a course of approximately 2.8 km, which can be completed once or twice. After the run, hot drinks and something tasty to eat will be served, and 25% of the proceeds will go to a good cause.
course_highlights: Approximately 2.8 km course in Tønsbergmarka
Option to complete the course once or twice
A non-competitive event where everyone can take part at their own pace
additional: Timing is optional; participants can decide whether they want their time recorded. 25% of the proceeds go to the Church City Mission’s project “Brighten Christmas for Someone Who Dreads It.” The course can be completed once or twice. The course is available on Strava. Member prices are NOK 150 without a medal or NOK 200 with a medal; non-members pay NOK 250 without a medal or NOK 300 with a medal. Bring a headlamp and reflective gear, as some sections may be dark.

name: Adventsløpet med Kirkens Bymisjon
description: Adventsløpet 2026 in Kristiansand is a pre-Christmas race organised in partnership with Kirkens Bymisjon, offering an enjoyable and meaningful activity for everyone. The race offers two distances: a short 3.8 km and a long 6.7 km, both with the option of running with or without timing. The start and finish are at Tresse by the Fortress, and the course passes through the beautiful surroundings of Tangen, Otra and Lund. Half of the entry fee goes directly to Kirkens Bymisjon’s work to bring joy to those who dread Christmas. After the race, hot drinks and a little something to eat will be served, and prizes will be drawn among the participants instead of awarding medals.
course_highlights: The course passes through the beautiful surroundings of Tangen, Otra and Lund
Start and finish at Tresse by the Fortress in Kristiansand
The long course consists of two laps
additional: Both courses can be run with or without timing. Age limits: with timing, from age 15; without timing, from age 11, or from age 8 when accompanied by an adult. No medals are awarded, but prizes will be drawn among all participants. Everyone receives a loaned race bib, which must be returned after the race. The EQ Timing registration fee is additional. Businesses can request a registration code and a consolidated invoice. Organised in partnership with Kirkens Bymisjon Kristiansand.

name: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night
description: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night är en unik traillöpningstävling som går av stapeln i Dalby den 12 december. Loppet erbjuder en 1 km lång light trail-bana med en rejäl backe i början, där deltagarna springer så många varv de orkar inom tidsgränser som successivt minskar. Det är en utmaning som kombinerar snabbhet och löpstrategi i en mörk och kall miljö, med möjlighet att springa upp till 20 km. Vid varvningen erbjuds vatten, cola och lite mat, och det finns priser till många deltagare. Tävlingen är öppen för alla nivåer och ambitioner och arrangeras med fokus på att njuta av skogen.
course_highlights: 1 km light trail-bana med 24 m höjdskillnad per varv
Rejäl backe i början av banan
Löpning i mörker och kallt väder
additional: Första varvet har deltagarna 10 minuter på sig, andra varvet 9 minuter och 40 sekunder, tredje varvet 9 minuter och 20 sekunder, och så vidare. Det finns vatten, cola och lite mat vid varvningen samt eventuellt buljong. Priser delas ut till många deltagare. Antalet platser är begränsat. Start vid Dalbybadets parkering kl. 15.30. Varvtiden kortas successivt: 10 minuter för första varvet, därefter 9 minuter och 40 sekunder och sedan 9 minuter och 20 sekunder. Begränsat antal platser; ta med pannlampa.

name: Magni Maraton 95
description: Magni Marathon 95 is an exciting running event held in Trøndelag. The course is designed to give participants a challenging and scenic experience, allowing them to enjoy beautiful landscapes while competing. The race attracts both experienced runners and beginners, and offers a great opportunity to test their skills on a varied and inspiring route.

name: Heim 6-timers Ultra
description: Set aside the day and try our new ultrarunning concept, Heim 6-hour Ultra Indoor! Saturday, May 24, 2025, at 10:00 in Kyrksæterøra. This race is an exciting challenge where a combination of speed and endurance is essential. The course is 3 km long, and you have 30 minutes to complete the first lap; the time limit then decreases with each lap. Informal and social, with prizes for the winners in both genders.

name: Eikanger Vintarkarusell 3
description: The second race in the 2025–26 winter series takes place on Saturday 15 November at Eikanger. There will be seven races this season, three before Christmas and four after New Year. The course follows the usual route around Eikangervågen. Registration opens at 14:20.

images.alt_text: Løpekonkurranse med mange løpere og tilskuere, norske flagg.

name: Bunkersen jule-3km
description: Bunkersen Christmas 3 km is a race held at Bislett Stadium in Oslo on Saturday, December 12, 2026. This event offers a fast and atmospheric 3-kilometer distance in mid-December, perfect for runners looking for a challenge in the winter darkness. The event is open to everyone and provides a great opportunity to test your fitness before Christmas at a classic running venue.
course_highlights: 3 km distance at Bislett Stadium
Fast and atmospheric winter course
Central location in Oslo
additional: Tickets are sold via EQ Timing through the Aett platform. The event runs from December 12 to 13, 2026. The start time is early Saturday morning at 01:00.

name: Andersens Adventløp
description: Andersens Adventløp is a traditional pre-Christmas race in Bergen, offering a scenic loop starting and finishing by the Fløibanen station on Fjellveien. The race follows Fjellveien, climbs Ole Irgens vei, descends Skansemyrsveien and returns to Mulesvingen. It is known for its great atmosphere and challenging course, which has given runners the chance to set course records in previous editions. The event brings together a great group of runners and makes for a refreshing, invigorating pre-Christmas experience.
course_highlights: Loop via Fjellveien, Ole Irgens vei and Skansemyrsveien
Start and finish by the Fløibanen station on Fjellveien
Varied terrain with flat sections and hills
additional: The race has previously faced challenging weather conditions, including hail showers. Results from previous years are available via links on the website. Contributions from organizers Arvid Berge and Rolf Hansen have been highlighted for their thoroughness and experience. The race has been held for several years. Previous reviews describe firm footing and a course marshal by the Fløibanen station.

name: Backyardish Ultra
description: Backyardish Ultra Kuopio follows the traditional backyard ultra format, but it is not an official backyard ultra. The route is a marked loop of approximately 6.7 kilometres through the forest. The event takes place in Neulamäki on Saturday, 16 November 2024, from 9:00 to 21:00. All participants start their first lap at 9:00, and subsequent laps start on the hour. The winner is the first person to finish the final lap. There is no winner if nobody completes the final lap.

name: Kauno SK Nemunas 1000 m
description: The Kaunas SK „Nemunas” 1000 m Race Cup will take place on December 14, 2024, in Kaunas. On Saturday, 127 runners competed in the 1000 m event. The top places went to the Youth category: Simas Gedeikis (Kaunas) with a time of 2:38.62 and Viltė Bubinaitė (Vilnius) with 3:04.08. Juniors, younger juniors, and children also took part and achieved excellent results.

name: Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė is a Backyard Ultra race designed to help runners cover the 100-mile distance as easily as possible. If you’ve never received a DNF in your life, here’s your chance to earn one with honor. There will be only one winner, so get ready for a challenge in Alytus.

name: Adventscrosslauf
description: The Wilscher Advent Cross-Country Run Gifhorn is a traditional cross-country race held during Advent in Gifhorn, Lower Saxony. The main distance is 7.5 km and runs through the winter landscape of the Wilsche district. The race starts at 14:00 at the meeting point at An der Masch 4. The event is organised by VfR Wilsche/Neubokel, and the entry fee is 7 euros.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the winter landscape of Gifhorn-Wilsche
Main distance: 7.5 km
Start and meeting point at An der Masch 4
additional: The meeting point and start are at An der Masch 4 in the Wilsche district of Gifhorn. Typical December weather includes temperatures around 3 °C and snow cover on most days. The race starts at 14:00, with the meeting point at An der Masch 4 in Gifhorn. Registration is via the club website. The event is a lovely opportunity to enjoy the Advent season in an active and sociable way.

name: 6 Wigilijny Bieg Charytatywny
price_range: 45–90 zł, zależnie od konkurencji i terminu zapisów
description: The 6th Christmas Eve Charity Run is a cross-country race on a forest course in Lasek Majoński in Luboń, taking place on December 12, 2026. Participants can choose between a 5 km run and a Nordic Walking event on the same course. The event is charitable and supports the Dobro się niesie Foundation, which helps people experiencing homelessness. Shorter distances are available for children, with separate categories for girls and boys. The organizers provide a race pack, a commemorative wooden medal, a meal, and gifts from sponsors.
course_highlights: 5 km run and Nordic Walking on a 100% forest trail course
Babki Forest District grounds — Lasek Majoński in Luboń
Cross-country race with a 50-minute time limit
additional: The race office opens at 9:45 near the cemetery in Luboń, ul. Armii Poznań 51B. The race pack includes a race bib, a wooden medal, a meal (sweet yeast bun and tea), and gifts from sponsors. Timing is provided by reusable chips attached to shoes. Age categories and OPEN, Luboń residents, ZSM Poznań, and four-person team classifications are available. The limit for children's races is 100 participants. An additional race-pack pickup is available on December 10, 2026, in the afternoon (location to be announced by the organizer). The 5 km run and Nordic Walking start at 12:30. The time limit is 50 minutes, and the combined participant limit for these events is 200. The entry fee includes a charitable contribution of 10 or 20 zł.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
location: Sątopy, Nowy Tomyśl County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Dwumaraton Olęderski is a series of races organized by the Nowy Tomyśl Chyży Running Club, held off-road in autumn and winter. The event has a social and sporting character and is intended for both experienced and beginner runners. The minimum distance is 10.5 km, while the full marathon distance is 42.2 km, which can be completed by running multiple 10.5 km loops. The event takes place in Sątopy and aims to help participants stay active outdoors during the challenging autumn and winter months.
course_highlights: Off-road course with a 10.5 km loop
Option to complete a full marathon or multiple loops
Races take place in autumn and winter conditions
additional: Dwumaraton Olęderski is a series of races held one weekend per month from October to March, each in a different town. The race office opens at 09:00, and the first race starts at 10:00. The time limit for the first race is 16:00. The second race starts at 09:00 the following day, with a time limit of 15:00. The event is co-funded by Nowy Tomyśl County and is held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. Information for the 2026/2027 edition gives the date as December 12, 2026; the December 13 date provided by the user may refer to another event day or to the weekend.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: The Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Bydgoszcz. The race is recreational and competitive, aimed at people aged 16 and over, and promotes outdoor physical activity. The course runs through the forested areas of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District, offering beautiful natural surroundings. Races take place regularly, giving participants the opportunity to test themselves on the same course throughout the season.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the forests of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
A cross-country route through forests and urban parks
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:45 before the race. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; participants are advised to use parking areas approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The event schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Register via the participant portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day.

name: Sørlandstesten
description: Sørlandstesten is an accessible fun run for anyone looking for a positive running experience, whatever their ambitions. Whether you’re training for a bigger goal, want to experience the thrill of competition, or simply want a social and active day, this is the race for you! There’s room for both beginners and experienced runners, and the most important thing is that you show up in good spirits and ready to run. We cheer just as loudly for the first person across the finish line as we do for someone completing their very first race.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 2/5
description: Finland’s largest road running series, Vantaa Road Running Cup, starts again on Saturday at Sotunki School, which returns as the event centre after a few years’ break. The event has a 32-year history, and this year’s new main sponsor is MK FACADE OY. On Saturday, runners will compete over 5 km and 10 km, with starts at 13:00 and 13:10. The route is designed to provide runners with a pleasant and safe environment, and enhanced supervision will ensure safety during the race.

name: Talvisarjajuoksu Rovaniemi
description: The traditional RDS Winter Series Run is back! The first race will take place on Saturday, 4 October at 11:00 on the familiar and safe Koskenkylä route. The third race in the Winter Series will be run on Saturday, 13 December 2025 at 11:00 on the Koskenkylä route. New this year: a 2 km fitness race open to everyone.

Talvinen juoksukilpailu, juoksijoita lumisella tiellä.

Talvinen juoksutapahtuma, juoksijoita lähtöviivalla.

name: Teivocup II
description: Teivocup is a winter-season series of test runs, offering the opportunity to take part in running races at all levels, from recreational runners to competitive athletes. The event is held in Ylöjärvi, near the Teivo Race Centre, and is aimed at everyone who enjoys endurance sports. Each race is 5 km, and runners can register on site. The entry fee is €10 per race (€7 for club members). The second race will take place on Saturday, 13 December 2025, followed by a Christmas party for members at Lamminpää Lodge.

name: AURA Nytårsløbene 2026
location: Banken FoodHall, Kannikegade 4, Aarhus C, Aarhus, Denmark
description: AURA Nytårsløbene 2026 byder på en smuk løbetur i de gyldne efterårsfarver i Aarhus. Deltagerne kan vælge mellem 5 km og 10 km distancer, som løbes på en afspærret rute i Marselisborg Skovene. Løbet er velegnet til både hurtige tider og hyggelige oplevelser med familie, kolleger og venner. Efter løbet modtages deltagerne med kakao og godt humør ved målområdet.
course_highlights: Løb i Marselisborg Skovene med smukke efterårsfarver
Afspærret rute for sikkerhed og gode løbebetingelser
Mulighed for at løbe 5 km eller 10 km (én eller to omgange på samme rute)
additional: Start og mål ved Aarhus Atletik- og Løbeakademi, Havreballe Skovvej 11, Aarhus C. Efter løbet serveres kakao til deltagerne. Start og mål er ved Banken FoodHall, Kannikegade 4, Aarhus C. Der er ingen tidtagning. Børn under 4 år deltager gratis, og grupper på mindst 10 deltagere får 15 % rabat ved samlet tilmelding.

name: TreeningPluss Muraste jooks-matk
location: Muraste, Harku Parish, Harju County, Estonia

name: Santa Fun Run Šiauliai
description: The Santa Fun Run is a lovely tradition for Šiauliai residents and visitors, with nearly 500 participants dressed as Santa Claus running through the city streets. The run has a noble purpose: all funds raised go to charity. There are no age restrictions, and everyone can easily complete the symbolic 1.3 km distance. At the finish, participants will be in for a surprise: one of Lithuania’s best-known performers, Jovani, will greet the running Santas.

name: Noskrien Ziemu 2. posms Koknesē
description: Noskrien Ziemu Stage 2 in Koknese is a winter running event offering the opportunity to take part in various distances and sports. The event is part of the Noskrien Ziemu series, which brings together athletes and active people who want to test their abilities in winter conditions. The race takes place in Koknese, offering a challenge and enjoyment for both individual runners and teams. Registration is open, but participant numbers are limited, so it is also possible to join the waiting list.
additional: Participant numbers are limited, and once the limit is reached, applications are placed on the waiting list. Registration is available only for one current Noskrien Ziemu stage at a time. Participants must provide the required details, including date of birth, gender, club, and place of residence for statistics.

name: Flensburger Adventslauf
description: Der Flensburger Adventslauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die jährlich im Dezember in Flensburg stattfindet. Der Lauf wird vom 1. Flensburger Lauftreff organisiert, einem Verein mit ausgezeichneter Anerkennung durch den Deutschen Leichtathletikverband. Die Veranstaltung fördert Gemeinschaft und Laufbegeisterung in der Region und bietet Läufern aller Leistungsstufen eine attraktive Gelegenheit, sich sportlich zu betätigen. Die Strecke führt durch die winterliche Stadt und bietet eine festliche Atmosphäre kurz vor Weihnachten.
course_highlights: Verschiedene Laufdistanzen (1,8 km bis 14 km)
Hügeliges Streckenprofil
Geeignet für alle Altersgruppen und Nordic-Walking
additional: Laufveranstaltung im Dezember mit winterlichem Wetter, Streckenverlauf und Altersklassen, Chip-Zeitnahme, Sicherheitsregeln, keine Rückerstattung bei Nichtteilnahme

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series associated with the traditional Rund um Wellen. The event is organized by the local running community, which also organizes the Wellen Marathon, and offers a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere away from large city events. The course includes several distances and runs through the rural surroundings, supported by local volunteers, sponsors, and the fire brigade. The series preserves its traditional character and offers runners a challenging, authentic winter running experience.
course_highlights: Rural course with a traditional character
Event with a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere
Support from local volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather conditions: around 7 °C, mostly rainy; start location: Beverstedt-Wellen; the event is part of a series with several distances (3 km and 11 km). Distances: 3 km, 11 km; traditional, community-oriented; December weather is usually cool and rainy.

name: Sparkassen Advents-Cross der LG Nordheide
location: Jahnplatz, Schützengehölz, Winsen (Luhe), Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: U10-U16 2,50 Euro, U18-U20 3,00 Euro, Erwachsene 5,00 Euro
description: The Sparkassen Advent Cross-Country Run hosted by LG Nordheide takes place on December 13, 2026, in Winsen (Luhe), at Schützengehölz by Jahnplatz. The event is open to participants from across the state and offers races for all age groups from U10 to seniors, including age groups up to M/W 95. The races cover various distances of approximately 1,400 meters to 9 kilometers. Team rankings are held separately for male and female participants. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available, as well as signposted parking nearby.
course_highlights: Various distances from approx. 1,400 m to 9 km
Races from U10 through senior age groups, including M/W 95
Venue in Schützengehölz, with a signposted walking route
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a 50% surcharge. Entries submitted by email incur a surcharge of EUR 1.00 per start. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available. Parking is available behind the Stadthalle and at the Stadthalle car park; the venue is about a 300-meter walk through Schützengehölz along a signposted route. Registration constitutes consent to the publication of the participant’s name, year of birth, club, and photo and video material in results lists and the media. Distances range from approximately 1,400 m to longer distances; registration is open until December 6, 2026. Late entries are possible for an additional fee. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available; parking is behind the Stadthalle.

name: Int. Weihnachts-Crosslauf
description: The Int. Christmas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country race held shortly before Christmas at Ravensberger Stadium in Borgholzhausen. The event is organized by LCS Olbä and offers several distances, including 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a 7.5 km walking/Nordic walking course. The 16 km course consists of two laps over partly hilly terrain around Borgholzhausen and a loop around Barenberg, which is run twice. It is a true cross-country challenge with climbs and descents. The start and finish sections are on paved paths, where spikes are not allowed. The race attracts a diverse field, from top runners to recreational and older runners, as well as walkers.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: ul. Spokojna, Mały Kack, Gdynia, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including the Tricity area in the Gdańsk Forest District and around Mały Kack in Gdynia. The races take place in natural settings among forests and urban parks, promoting outdoor physical activity. The series consists of four races in each location, and participants can compete in both local and overall rankings. The races are open to people aged 16 and over; younger participants may take part with a guardian’s consent. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through forests and urban parks
The Tricity location includes the Gdańsk Forest District and the area around Mały Kack in Gdynia
The race takes place in a natural setting and promotes outdoor activity
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race numbers and timing chips are collected on race day. The schedule is the same at all locations. Participants can buy a pass for the entire series or enter individual races. The entry fee is higher on race day. There is no participant limit. Participants under 16 may take part with a guardian’s consent. Pass holders can race for free in another city by registering in advance. Online registration is available through the Participant Portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. A pass for four races at one location is available.

description: The 7th Santa Run is an annual charity race held in Olsztyn as part of the Warmia Christmas Market. The 5 km route passes through the picturesque Old Town, Central Park, and Łynostrada. The event is open to adults and young people aged 12 and over. Its aim is to have fun and support the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Ward in Olsztyn. Participants receive commemorative Santa hats, and the limit is 420 participants.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through Olsztyn’s Old Town
Scenic paths in Central Park
A run along Łynostrada
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 11:00 at the Czesław Niemen Amphitheatre, ul. Zamkowa 1. Participants receive commemorative Santa hats. Timing is provided by chips, which must be returned at the finish. All entry fees support the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Ward in Olsztyn. Participants must be at least 12 years old (born in 2014 or earlier). Online registration is open until December 9, 2026, or until the participant limit is reached. The race office is located at the Czesław Niemen Amphitheatre, ul. Zamkowa 1. Entry fees support the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Ward in Olsztyn.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run is an event that gets the whole city moving and has been bringing runners together for 30 years. Held once a month, it typically attracts 100–200 runners of all ages. The beautiful route winds through the scenery along the Loimijoki River. Runners can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km course, which passes near Forssa city centre through the park of the old cotton mill. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of the more than 100-year-old Elävien Kuvien cinema.

description: Hamarkarusellen Vinter is the winter edition of Hamarkarusellen, with all races taking place on the same 5-kilometre course along illuminated walking and cycling paths in the Prestrud area of Hamar. All ambitions are welcome, whether you walk or run, timed or untimed, and it’s an excellent opportunity for a test run. There are 6 races in total over the winter, so bring your running shoes and join in the fun!

name: Adventsmila Kjølnes
description: In collaboration with Kirkens Bymisjon in Grenland, we invite you to Adventsmila at Kjølnes. Join us for an atmospheric race on 17 December at 18:00, with each lap measuring 3.3 km. Participants in the timed 10 km race will run 3 laps, while those in the untimed fitness class can complete 1, 2, or 3 laps. Support Kirkens Bymisjon and bring joy to someone who is dreading Christmas!

name: Snøkuten - Kaashagarunden
description: Snøkuten Kaashagarunden is a 6.9-kilometer cross-country race organized by Veldre Friidrett in Ringsaker, Hedmark. The race marks the start of the 42nd season of the Winter Series Snøkuten and attracts around 100 participants despite varying weather conditions. It is an important event at a time when many recreational and competitive opportunities have been canceled. Participants must wear a reflective vest and exercise caution in traffic. Both timed and recreational classes are available.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Ringsaker, Hedmark
Distance of 6.9 kilometers
Reflective vest required; participants must exercise caution in traffic
additional: The race attracts around 100 participants each time. Timed and recreational classes are available. A reflective vest is required. Both timed and recreational classes are offered.

name: Vinterkarusellen (Romerike) 4. løp Jessheim
description: Vinterkarusellen på Romerike is a running series organized by Lørenskog Friidrettslag, offering races for all age groups, from children to veterans. The races take place at Jessheim Athletics Stadium and are part of a traditional winter series that promotes versatility and the joy of running. Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics licence, which provides insurance coverage. The event is well suited to both recreational and competitive runners looking to race in an inclusive environment.
course_highlights: Race at the athletics stadium in Jessheim
Suitable for all age groups from 6 years and up
Part of a long-standing winter series in Romerike
additional: Participants aged 13 to 80 must purchase an athletics licence separately. Children under 13 are covered by the child sports insurance scheme and do not need their own licence. The Jessheim race has previously been organized by Ull/Kisa IL.

name: Team Mormor løbet, Ib's Marathon nr. 200
2026 Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev
location: Rocca al Mare kool, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev is a traditional winter running event taking place on 19 December 2026 in front of Rocca al Mare School in Tallinn. The event centre and start/finish are conveniently located at the school, and the programme includes three distances: a marathon, a relay marathon and an 8.4 km run. The courses run mainly along shared-use paths and are well marked and safe, offering a sporting way to end the year. Participants are provided with medical assistance, timing, medals, and hot tea at the refreshment stations and finish.
course_highlights: The 8.4 km run follows shared-use paths and is marked with signs and course marshals.
The marathon consists of 5 laps, each a 8.44 km paved shared-use path.
The relay marathon consists of 5 legs, each a lap of 8.44 km.
additional: The marathon and relay marathon have participant limits of 100 marathon runners and 150 teams, respectively. The 8.4 km run is limited to 150 runners. Race numbers are distributed on race day at Rocca al Mare School. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish area. Awards are presented after the run or marathon, as applicable. Running on the road is prohibited and may result in disqualification. The course is in an urban setting. Registration and entry fees are listed in detail. The event is held annually and is part of the Estonian running calendar.

name: Kauno „Kalėdinis bėgimas - 2026“
description: The Kaunas Christmas Run is a traditional running event held in Kaunas in December. The event is open to runners of all ages and aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and the popularity of running. The race takes place in Panemunė Forest, and the courses are paved and suitable for both recreational and professional runners. After the run, participants are treated to kūčiukai and tea, and can also use the swimming pool.
course_highlights: Course in Panemunė Forest, Kaunas
Paved surface; snow and ice are possible depending on weather conditions
Choose to run 1.7 km, 5 km (one lap) or 10 km (two laps)
additional: Race bibs will be distributed on race day from 10:00 to 11:40. The entry fee must be paid to the account of the Kaunas Running Club. After the run, participants will be treated to kūčiukai and tea. From 14:30 to 15:30, participants can swim at Žalgiris Swimming Pool (Karaliaus Mindaugo Ave. 50, Kaunas). Registration is permitted only in your own name; bib transfers are prohibited. Registration is open until October 31. Participants will receive personalized bibs. Event date: 2026-12-19

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The races take place on forest trails, on a 5.15 km loop that climbs twice to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the park’s highest peak. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic Walking event, and shorter races for children and young people. It brings together runners and sports enthusiasts of all ages in a friendly atmosphere with a spirit of competition.
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop entirely on forest trails
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The route passes through the event center, allowing spectators to cheer on participants
additional: Children’s races are held over distances of 200m, 500m, 1000m, and 1500m, with a separate start schedule from 9:00 to 9:45. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Registration for the adult race and Nordic Walking event is also available on race day until 10:00 (at a higher fee). Participants in the 10 km race complete two laps. After leaving the forest, the finish-area setup separates runners finishing the race from those continuing onto the second lap. The season comprises six races; routes are marked with orange ribbons, and times are recorded electronically.

name: XIX Nocny Bieg Wigilijny Od zmierzchu do...
Weihnachtslauf Lipperreihe
description: The Weihnachtslauf Lipperreihe is a traditional running event held annually on the fourth Sunday of Advent in Lipperreihe, a district of Oerlinghausen. The loop course starts and finishes at Lipperreihe Primary School and is precisely measured, with a hilly, moderately challenging profile. The scenic route is timed using the professional race|result timing system. The event is for adults and young people and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Precisely measured course with a hilly profile
Moderately challenging route through scenic surroundings
Start and finish at Lipperreihe Primary School
additional: Online registration is available until 7 a.m. on the day of the event. Late entries are possible until 30 minutes before the start, with a late-entry fee of 5 EUR payable in cash only. Animals are not permitted. An event shirt in French navy can be ordered as an option. Timing uses the race|result system, with a dual transponder in the race number since 2019. Residents are provided with information about traffic restrictions and road closures. Precisely measured; race|result timing; online registration until 7 a.m. on the day of the event; cash payment only; no animals permitted.

name: Nisseløpet Lommedalen
description: Nisseløpet Lommedalen is an exciting race held in Viken. It was started by neighbors Harald Krogh and Anders Lindell to spread joy on Christmas Eve. Participants can choose between distances of 6 km and 10 km, and the race is known for its scenic route through beautiful surroundings. It attracts both recreational and experienced runners and has become a tradition in Lommedalen.

name: Panevėžio Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: On the first Saturday of winter, the annual Eurovaistinė Christmas Run will take place, celebrating its 50th anniversary this year. This running festival will welcome thousands of participants, standing out for its festive atmosphere and distinctive participants dressed in Christmas costumes. The event schedule has been shifted so participants can run after dark, when the magical Christmas spirit comes alive on the streets of Panevėžys. This year, we invite you not only to prepare Christmas costumes but also to add illuminated details that will turn the crowd of runners into a glowing Christmas spectacle.

name: Søndagsløpet, Sarpsborg - juleløp - Gul løype
description: The Sunday Run in Sarpsborg is a long-standing race held at Kalnes Athletics Stadium. It offers several routes, including the popular 7.05 km Yellow Route, which features a varied and challenging course. The event brings together runners of all ages and abilities in a friendly, inclusive atmosphere. It also includes competitions such as the Triple and Super Triple for those looking for an extra challenge.
course_highlights: 7.05 km Yellow Route
Varied terrain with challenging sections
Held at Kalnes Athletics Stadium in Sarpsborg
additional: The race offers several routes (yellow, green, red) and competitions such as the Triple and Super Triple. Results and statistics from previous years are available on the website. The Christmas race (Yellow Route) starts at 11:00 on 24 December. Meet at Kalnes Athletics Stadium. To register, add your name to the participant list before the start.

name: Valestrandsmarka Rundt
description: Valestrandsmarka Rundt is a fun run organized by Osterøy IL, taking place on 24 May 2024. Participants can look forward to a scenic 4.4 km course, with a start time of 18:45. There is a great atmosphere in the svele area, bringing together both experienced and new participants, and awards are given to participants who have completed multiple races.

name: Dalborgløpet
description: Dalborgløpet takes place on December 27, the third day of Christmas, and offers a refreshing running experience during the holiday period! The course is 5 km long, starts at the sports ground at Vind, and follows Dalborgvegen along the top of Gjøvik over gently rolling terrain. It turns around after 2.5 km and follows the same route back. The race has an informal atmosphere, and runners of all abilities are warmly welcome to join in the Christmas exercise!

description: Mandal’s Boxing Day Run takes place on December 26 and offers distances of 3 km and 10 km. The race is part of the running calendar in Agder and gives participants the opportunity to experience a festive atmosphere during the Christmas holidays. It attracts both experienced and new runners and features a traditional celebration that makes it a popular activity after Christmas.

name: Ribbemaraton
description: Löplabbets Ribbemaraton is an annual race between the Löplabbet store in Sandvika and Ski Storsenter. The race is an official marathon and counts toward all kinds of Kondis awards, but it lacks the pursuit of personal records. The most important thing is to enjoy a nice run, take as much time as you need, and meet new runners. Keeping the conversation going is more important than keeping your heart rate up!

name: Vinterkarusellen 4. løp
description: The results from the 4th race in this year’s Necon Winter Series are now available. A data outage at the timing provider meant that data was not transferred correctly, but most participants have now received their correct times. Conditions were good, with no ice or snow, contributing to an enjoyable race for the more than 1,025 finishers. Bjørnar Gangsøy won the 10 km in 36:58, while Sondre Gangsøy and Emil also put in strong performances, recording 43:40 and 25:04 respectively in the 5 km.

description: Taranger’s Boxing Day Half Marathon is a half marathon in Bergen on Boxing Day, starting from Fana Stadium. The race offers a social, festive opportunity to get out after the Christmas celebrations. In the 2025 edition, the race started at 11:00, and finishers received a medal and warm mulled wine.
course_highlights: Half marathon distance
Starts from Fana Stadium in Bergen
Christmas race on Boxing Day
additional: Santa hats were mandatory in 2025. Information about the start time, medal, mulled wine, and payment applies to the 2025 edition.

name: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt Juleløp
description: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt Christmas Run is a traditional recreational race organized by Osterøy IL Friidrett. The race follows a 4.4 km course around Valestrandsmarka, starting and finishing at Furubakken sports ground. The event takes place on 26 December at 12:00 and offers a friendly atmosphere, with prizes, sveler and cordial for participants. There is a separate walking group with recorded times for those who take 30 minutes or more. The race is part of a larger race series that also includes a New Year’s race and several races throughout the year.
course_highlights: 4.4 km course around Valestrandsmarka
Start and finish at Furubakken sports ground
Separate walking group with timed results for those taking 30 minutes or more
additional: Christmas race start time: 12:00. Sveler from Toro, cordial from Saftsuse and prizes from Extra Valestrand will be served. Course records in regular races are awarded 3,000 kr by HTB. There is a separate walking group with timed results for those taking 30 minutes or more. The race starts at 12:00. No licence is required for the race. The entry fee is listed as 30 kr.

name: 21. Wolfshäger Gänsebraten Fettverbrennungslauf
location: Wolfshagen im Harz, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wolfshäger Gänsebraten Fettverbrennungslauf is a traditional race held annually on December 26 in Wolfshagen im Harz. The event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels and offers a sporting way to round off the Christmas season. It is organized by Laufteam Wolfshagen im Harz e.V., a nonprofit club that promotes running in the region. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the strong sense of community among its runners.
course_highlights: A run through the picturesque Harz countryside
A family-friendly course for all ages
A traditional end-of-year race on December 26
additional: The race is organized by Laufteam Wolfshagen im Harz e.V., a club that also holds charity runs. The event is open to recreational and competitive runners, as well as children and teenagers. No prices or start times are published on the website. The organizer can be contacted by email with questions. Information about distances and registration is available on the website; the event promotes health and community spirit.

name: Schokocross
description: Schokocross is a cross-country running event organized by ATS Buntentor Bremen at the Sportanlage Kuhhirten in Stadtwerder, Bremen. The event features short off-road races for adults over distances of approximately 2.2 km, 4.2 km and 8.2 km, as well as 400 m races for children under 10 and 800 m races for children under 14. This local club race offers competitions for children, young people, women and men, and is particularly family-friendly, with appealing race options for both young and adult runners. It traditionally takes place on December 26 and is known for its winter conditions.
course_highlights: Cross-country course at the Sportanlage Kuhhirten in Stadtwerder
Distances ranging from 400 m to 8.2 km
Competitions for children, young people and adults
additional: Typical December weather: approx. 3 °C, with nighttime temperatures down to -2 °C, an average of 40 mm of precipitation, and usually snow-covered conditions. This local club race has competitions for various age groups, including U8 and U10. Cross-country running in winter weather, with categories for children, young people and adults. Registration deadline: December 22, 2026.

name: Nyttårsmaraton Ålesund
location: Moa i Spjelkavika ved Moa Bussstasjon og Spjelkavik Omsorgsenter
description: Nyttårsmaraton Ålesund takes advantage of Western Norway’s mild, snow-light winter climate to offer an event for keen runners during the Christmas holiday period. In 2025, the race takes place on Sunday, December 28, and is normally the last marathon event of the year in Norway. The race starts at Moa in Spjelkavika, and the course follows Gamle Brusdalsvei. Marathon runners complete two laps, while half-marathon runners complete one.

name: Samnanger Romjulshalvmaraton
description: Samnanger Romjulshalvmaraton is held on 27 December 2026, starting at Ådland Church in Samnanger. The race is part of Samnanger IL’s athletics events and welcomes runners of all ages to a traditional activity during the Christmas holidays. The race starts at 11:00 and gives participants a great opportunity to stay in shape during the winter break. Samnanger IL offers a wide range of sporting activities and welcomes everyone to take part.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Ådland Church
A Christmas holiday event in scenic surroundings
Part of Samnanger IL’s athletics programme
additional: The race is part of a wide range of sporting activities at Samnanger IL. Winter series races are also held in Nesodden before and after the Christmas holiday half marathon. The Samnanger IL running group offers group training for all levels, with an accessible option for recreational and experienced runners. The start time is listed as 11:00.

name: XII Sylwestrowy Bieg i Nordic Walking
Romjulsløpet Jaktstart
description: The Romjulsløpet Pursuit Race has a flexible start in Fjellveien by “Damen” on Tuesday, December 31, between 10:30 and 11:00. The start and finish are in Fjellveien above Varegg’s clubhouse, where you must pick up your timing chip before the start. The course goes from Fjellveien, past BKK’s station, across the field to Permisjonsstien, and down to the water at the top of Munkebotn, with the option of an extra loop up to Stoltzen before returning to the start.
