name: Sylvesterloppet Kalmar
description: Sylvesterloppet i Kalmar är en lokal löparklassiker som arrangeras av Högby IF Friidrott och körs 31 december 2026. På klubbens webbplats finns grundläggande information om loppet. För funktionärer och volontärer används klubbens inloggningssystem för anmälan.
course_highlights: Distanserna 5 km och 10 km runt Fredriksskans och Lindöfjärden
Medalj och en specialdesignad mössa till alla anmälda
Promenadklass 5 km utan tidtagning samt olika klassindelningar
additional: Kalmar Sylvesterlopp beskrivs som en löparklassiker. Anmälan som funktionär/volontär sker via webbplatsens registreringsformulär (WordPress) och kräver inloggning: https://friidrott.hogbyif.se/wp-login.php?action=register Starttider för olika klasser inkluderar P/F 5 - 13, 0.4 - 2.0 km, M/K 5 och 10 km samt Promenadklass 5 km utan tidtagning; efteranmälan och betalningsalternativ inkluderar kort, Swish eller bankgiro.

name: Sylvesterloppet Olofström
description: Sylvesterloppet i Olofström är en traditionell avslutningstävling som arrangeras av UF Contact sedan 1971. Huvuddistansen är en kvartsmara (10,549 m) som i nuvarande bansträckning löps i två varv sedan 2018, och det finns även en kortare bana på cirka 5,3 km. Evenemanget har länge haft mål, omklädning, servering och prisutdelning i Idrottshallen, vilket ger en trivsam ram för löpare och publik. Historiken och klubbanknytningen gör loppet till en folkfest för både tävlingslöpare och motionslöpare.
course_highlights: Kvartsmara 10,549 m (löps som två varv i nuvarande bansträckning sedan 2018)
Kortare bana cirka 5,3 km finns kvar som alternativ
Mål, omklädning, servering och prisutdelning i Idrottshallen
additional: Anmälan sker via EasyRecord (anges i inbjudan). PM och bankartor finns upplagda som PDF-filer på arrangörens sidor (inbjudan, PM, bana). Startlista publiceras separat på arrangörens webbplats. Historik och banprofil, inklusive start- och målpunkter runt Idrottshallen och Nya torget.

name: Nyårsmilen Halmstad
description: Nyårsmilen i Halmstad är ett festligt nyårslopp där du kan välja mellan 5 eller 10 km på en snabb och lättlöpt bana som går på cykelbanor i Halmstad. Start och mål är vid Halmstad Arena friidrottsarena, och loppet erbjuder tidtagning med chip i nummerlappen. Efter målgång bjuds det på medalj, bubblig dryck, snacks, musik och en härlig stämning för alla deltagare, oavsett om du springer snabbt eller tar det lugnt. Loppet är öppet för alla och en perfekt start på det nya löparåret.
course_highlights: Snabb och lättlöpt bana på cykelbanor
10 km-loppet består av två varv
Start och mål vid Halmstad Arena friidrottsarena
additional: Nummerlapp hämtas 9:00-10:10 på Halmstad Arena. Tidtagning sker med chip i nummerlappen och resultat visas direkt efter målgång. Toalett och omklädning finns på området. Värdesaker kan lämnas på läktaren under tak (obevakat). Parkering finns ca 200 meter från start. Vatten och sportdryck från Umara erbjuds efter 5 km för 10 km-löpare. Medalj delas ut till alla löpare, och avstår man medaljen skänks 15 kr till organisationen Aldrig Ensam. Priser till de tre snabbaste damerna och herrarna i respektive klass. Möjlighet till farthållning för milen finns vid förfrågan via mejl. Loppet går den 31 december 2026 med start och mål vid Halmstad Arena. Preliminära starttider är 10.30 för 10 km och 10.35 för 5 km. Nummerlapp hämtas vid arenan mellan kl. 9.00 och 10.10. Chip-tidtagning; toalett, omklädning och parkering finns vid arenan.

name: Nyttårsløpet, Trondheim
description: The New Year’s Eve Run is an annual race held on New Year’s Eve, starting and finishing at Øya Stadium in Trondheim. You can choose between 5 and 10 km and participate in either the recreational class or the timed race. The event welcomes participants of different levels—an active way to end the year.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Øya Stadium
Choice of 5 km or 10 km
The course passes through several districts of Trondheim, including Kalvskinnet, Ila and Tempe
additional: Both a recreational class and a timed race are offered.

name: The Lost Highway
description: Lost Highway is organized by Luke The Drifter's Running Team on the last day of the year, starting from Veienmarka ungdomsskole in Ringerike. The race has a friendly, informal atmosphere and a tradition of bringing together both women and men for a winter running experience. The start is at 12:00, and after the finish there is usually a prize-giving, squash, coffee and biscuits. The race has been held for many years and has a loyal group of participants.
course_highlights: The race starts from Veienmarka ungdomsskole in Ringerike
Held on the last day of the year, in winter conditions, often with snow and ice
A traditional post-race gathering with a prize-giving, coffee and Christmas biscuits
additional: The race traditionally takes place in winter conditions, with the possibility of slippery surfaces and snow. Spiked shoes are recommended. Coffee, squash and biscuits are served after the race. In recent years, around 50–60 runners have taken part, with almost as many women as men.

name: Nyttårsløpet i Egersund
description: The New Year's Eve Run in Egersund takes place on 31 December 2026 at Vannbasengene in Egersund. The race offers 1 or 3 laps in a figure-eight, with each lap measuring 1.7 km. There is also a separate children's race, making the event family-friendly and inclusive. The start is at 12:00, and the event runs until approximately 15:00.
course_highlights: The course follows a figure-eight around Vannbasengene
Each lap is 1.7 km long
Choose between 1 or 3 laps
additional: The event runs from 12:00 to 15:00. A separate children's race is also held. The race is organized by Egersunds IK - friidrett. The start time is listed as 12:00 on New Year's Eve.

name: Nyttårsløpet, Fredrikstad
description: The New Year’s Run in Fredrikstad takes place on 31 December 2026, starting and finishing at Stortorvet. The race is suitable for elite athletes, recreational runners, old and young, and offers a fun, inclusive experience for everyone. The course consists of two laps through central Fredrikstad, each 1,600 metres long. There is no entry fee or registration, and the event runs from 12:00 to 15:00.
course_highlights: Two laps through central Fredrikstad, each 1,600 metres long
Start and finish at Stortorvet
The race is suitable for all ages and levels
additional: No entry fee or registration is required. Tickets are sold via f-b.no. The 2026 edition starts at 12:00 on 31 December. No registration is listed.

name: Nyttårsløpet Tønsberg
description: The New Year’s Race Tønsberg has been held for many years and is a fun run for absolutely everyone. The atmosphere is relaxed, and the race is a great way to start a new year. Whether you’re in peak shape or looking for a leisurely run on the last day of the year, you’re very welcome.

images.alt_text: Barn feirer etter Nyttårsløpet i Tønsberg.
Løpere i Nyttårsløpet Tønsberg, 2024. Snø. Start.
Løper nærmer seg målstreken i Nyttårsløpet Tønsberg. Snø på bakken.
Løper i Nyttårsløpet Tønsberg.  Snø og vinterlig stemning.

name: Nyttårstrimmen
description: Nyttårstrimmen is a 10 km recreational race suitable for runners of all abilities. The race has a long tradition and is Norway’s oldest continuously held recreational race, taking place every New Year’s Eve since 1975. This year, we are celebrating Nyttårstrimmen’s 50th anniversary, with hundreds of participants expected in Grenland. Participants can look forward to a varied and enjoyable experience, despite challenges such as snow and weather conditions.

images.alt_text: Deltakere i Nyttårstrimmen løper gjennom byen.
Deltakere på Nyttårstrimmen varmer opp før løpet.
Nyttårstrimmen logo: Løpere og løpsnavn.

name: Buugin Pamaus Juoksu
description: Welcome to the first-ever feel-good New Year’s run at Buugi Sports Centre on 31 December 2024 at 18:00! The event is organised jointly by Buugi Sports Centre and Hippoksen Marathon Club, with the aim of offering the best way in Central Finland to start celebrating the New Year in good company with a run and a buffet meal. Participants can choose the 10 km distance, with competitive and recreational categories for women and men.

images.alt_text: Juoksijoita maantiellä talvisessa maisemassa.  #BuugiPamaus
Juoksija punaisella juoksuradalla. Hyvän mielen uuden vuoden juoksu.

name: Uudenvuodenjuoksu
location: Tanelinrannan nuoriso- ja urheilukeskus, Lampitie 10, Seinäjoki
description: The New Year’s Run is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy exercise on New Year’s Eve. The event takes place on 31 December 2024 at various locations, including Seinäjoki, Liminka, Lieto and Imatra, and offers participants a range of distances for runners of different ages and abilities. The courses are officially measured and safe, with traffic marshals. The event brings together running enthusiasts and also offers the chance to enjoy coffee and refreshments from kiosks in the area.

images.alt_text: Eurajoen Uudenvuodenjuoksu -juoksija numerolla 323.
Eurajoen Uudenvuodenjuoksu - juoksijat lähtöviivalla.
Eurajoen Uudenvuodenjuoksun lähtö, lumisessa säässä.
Eurajoen Uudenvuodenjuoksu - juoksijoita lumisessa maastossa.

name: AURA Nytårsløbene 2026
location: Aarhus Atletik- og Løbeakademi, Havreballe Skovvej, Aarhus C, Aarhus, Denmark
description: AURA Nytårsløbene 2026 byder velkommen til en smuk og hyggelig løbetur i Aarhus, hvor du kan vælge mellem 5 km og 10 km distancer. Ruten går gennem Marselisborg Skovene og Aarhus C, og løbet er perfekt til både hurtige tider på en afspærret rute og hyggelige oplevelser med familie og venner. Start og mål er ved Aarhus Atletik- og Løbeakademi, og alle deltagere modtages med kakao og godt humør. Løbet er en oplagt måde at starte årets sidste dag på med motion og socialt samvær.
course_highlights: Ruten går gennem Marselisborg Skovene med smukke efterårsfarver
Afspærret rute med mulighed for hurtige tider
Start og mål ved Aarhus Atletik- og Løbeakademi, Havreballe Skovvej 11
additional: Deltagerne kan vælge at løbe eller gå distancerne. Efter løbet modtages deltagerne med kakao. Løbet er velegnet til både hurtige løbere og dem, der ønsker en hyggelig oplevelse i roligt tempo. Børn under 4 år kan deltage gratis i løbevogn.

name: Nytårsløb i Holbæk 2026
distance_verbose: 45 km, 25 km, Halvmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter

name: Pažadų Bėgimas
description: PROMISE RUN. We continue the tradition started in 2018. On the morning of 2026-01-01, while the sound of fireworks still echoes in your ears, confirm to yourself during the run that your New Year’s resolutions will really come true. No competition, registration, medals or prizes—just you and your New Year’s “PROMISES.” Run 10 km and write down your goals so you can check on 2027-01-01 whether they came true. The start will take place on 2026-01-01 at 14:00 at Kaunas Santaka Stadium.

images.alt_text: Bėgimas per miestą Naujųjų metų proga, daug bėgikų.
Kauno santakos stadionas.
Naktinis Kauno santakos stadiono vaizdas.
Bėgimo lenktynės, bėgikai.

name: Naujametinis ruonių maratonas
description: 2026-01-01 Pasvaliečiai invites all club members and friends to the 1st New Year’s SEALS MARATHON, which will take place in Pasvalys. This marathon is part of the traditional 18th ice-swimming event organized in Pasvalys District. After the marathon, a club members’ meeting will be held, during which the club’s most active members will be awarded.

name: Silvesterlauf Bremen
description: The Silvesterlauf Bremen is a popular running event on December 31 that welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers various distances, from 400 m for Bambinis to 10 km for experienced runners, through the beautiful surroundings of Werdersee. Alongside a sporting end to the year, festive music and a New Year’s Eve atmosphere make for a special experience. Participants in costumes are warmly invited to add their own creative touch to the event and run together into the New Year.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Werdersee
More accessible 2.5 km route for beginners and people with special needs
Festive New Year’s Eve atmosphere with music and medals for all finishers
additional: Start times vary by distance: 5 km run at 12:00, 2.5 km walk at 12:30, 5 km and 10 km walks at 12:50, 400 m Bambini run at 12:55, 1,000 m kids’ run at 13:00, 10 km run at 13:15. Race materials can be shipped for a fee. More accessible 2.5 km route suitable for everyone. Costumes are expressly encouraged for a special New Year’s Eve feeling. Various distances, including children’s and walking options, festive atmosphere, medals for everyone, creative costumes welcome.

name: Silvesterlauf Hannover
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hanover is a traditional year-end race held on December 31. The event features a 7.7 km loop, mostly on paved paths through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and along the Stichkanal to the Ihme. The race starts at 13:00 at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer. After the race, participants can refuel with mulled wine and bratwurst and receive a finisher wheat beer glass as a keepsake. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and mass start.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course goes through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the Stichkanal
Start and finish at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer
additional: Mass start; mulled wine and bratwurst at low prices after the race; every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass in the event design. On-the-day registration is possible on site from 12:00 (cash or PayPal). The race takes place on December 31, with online registration open until 31.12.25 at 10:00. There is a mass start and festivities that make the race a sociable way to end the year.

name: Silvesterlauf Wernigerode
description: The 49th Wernigerode New Year's Eve Run is the perfect end to the year in the Harz district for running enthusiasts. The race takes place on December 31, 2026, at Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode and offers a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V., this popular event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode
Run through Wernigerode's picturesque old town
Festive end-of-year atmosphere in the Harz district
additional: The course goes around Wernigerode Castle; start and finish at Marstall; no shower facilities; several events, including youth races and training sessions.

name: Silvesterlauf Burgwedel
description: The Burgwedel New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Burgwedel. The races cover several distances, including 10.6 km, 5.3 km and 2 km for children, and follow a scenic course with the start and finish at the modernised stadium on Ramhorst. The event attracts numerous runners and spectators and is organised by Schwimmverein Burgwedel. It is a popular sporting way to round off the year, with a family-friendly atmosphere and a diverse range of participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the recently modernised stadium on Ramhorst
Distances: 10.6 km, 5.3 km and a 2 km children’s race
Beautiful blue running track in the stadium
additional: The starting signal is given promptly at 12:00 by the local mayor. The event traditionally takes place on Ramhorst, where the series began in 1984. There is an award for the largest group, and the event is supported by numerous volunteers, sponsors and spectators. Distances: 2 km, 5.3 km, 10 km; December weather is usually cold and snowy; the event involves local clubs, fire brigades and families; course records have been set.

name: Silvesterlauf Salzgitter
organizer: Move SZ - Wir fördern Sport e.V.
description: The New Year’s Eve Run at Salzgittersee is a long-standing running event held on the last day of the year. The event offers various running and walking distances for different age groups and ability levels. The run is a sporting highlight and a meeting place for runners and spectators who want to end the year on an active note together. Alongside the sporting competition, there is a team classification and an awards ceremony that gives special recognition to the children’s races.
course_highlights: Running routes at Salzgittersee of 5.7 km and 11.4 km
1.2 km children’s race for participants born from 2013 to 2019
Team classification based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners
additional: Race number collection and late registration (plus transfers and late registrations) are available on 30.12. (15:00–17:00) and 31.12. (11:00–13:00) in the Stadtbad foyer. Online registration is open until 31.12.25 at 10:00 with no extra fee, unless the event is fully booked. Team classification is based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners. Race materials do not need to be collected in person. Register online by 31.12.25; race number collection at Stadtbad Salzgitter; refreshments in the finish area; parking available at Salzgittersee; dogs and running buggies allowed.

name: Silvesterlauf Magdeburg
description: The Magdeburg New Year's Eve Run is a traditional popular sporting event that has been held on the last day of the year for over 50 years. It brings together runners of all ages and ability levels in the city of Magdeburg. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and its sporting end to the year, with over 900 participants crossing the finish line. The run is part of the Magdeburg City Rankings and is very popular in the region.
course_highlights: 5 km loop, run twice
10 km main race
1.5 km children's run for the youngest participants
additional: The New Year's Eve Run is the eighth and final event in the Magdeburg City Rankings. More than 950 runners of all ages take part. The event is organized by the Magdeburger LaufKultur 08 e.V. club. Courses, registration, results, photos, press reports; the weather in December is usually cold and snowy.

name: Silvesterlauf Berlin
description: The Berlin New Year’s Eve Run on December 31 gives runners the chance to end the year on an active note. The event offers three different distances (4 km, 6 km and 10 km) through the scenic Grunewald, with challenging sections such as Drachenberg and Teufelsberg rewarded with great views over Berlin. Alongside the sporting experience, fun takes centre stage, particularly with the option to run in costume and prizes for the best costumes. At the finish, all finishers receive a delicious Pfannkuchen as a sweet keepsake to hang around their neck.
course_highlights: Route through the Grunewald, including Drachenberg and Teufelsberg
Fantastic views across Berlin before the turn of the year
A choice of distances: 4 km, 6 km and 10 km
additional: The start and finish are near Mommsenstadion (Waldschulallee 34, 14055 Berlin). The race pass and race number will be sent by email in advance. Race materials can be collected on site from 10:00 a.m. on the event day. Timing is provided by a disposable transponder attached to the race number. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes. Water, tea and Pfannkuchen are available at the finish. Only reusable cups are used. Changing facilities are available at Mommsenstadion, but there is no bag drop. Results and certificates are available online that evening. Distances vary between 2, 4, 6 and 10 km; a run for all age groups; start and finish at Mommsenstadion; refreshments include Pfannkuchen, with awards for the top finishers and the most original costumes.

name: Silvesterlauf Gütersloh
description: Der Silvesterlauf Gütersloh ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die am 31. Dezember 2026 zum 42. Mal stattfindet. Die Strecke führt entlang der Dalke und durch den schönen Rhedaer Forst, was den Lauf landschaftlich reizvoll macht. Der Lauf ist ein beliebter Treffpunkt für Freunde, Familien und Laufbegeisterte, die das Jahr sportlich ausklingen lassen möchten. Egal ob ambitionierte Läufer oder Freizeitsportler, alle sind herzlich willkommen, gemeinsam das alte Jahr zu verabschieden und das neue zu begrüßen.
course_highlights: Strecke entlang der Dalke
Lauf durch den Rhedaer Forst
Landschaftlich reizvolle und abwechslungsreiche Strecke
additional: Eventuelle kurzfristige Streckenänderungen im Bereich Hermann-Simon-Str./Dalke-Promenade möglich. Online-Anmeldung über RaceResult empfohlen.

name: Silvesterlauf Zossen-Ludwigsfelde
description: The 46th Zossen-Ludwigsfelde New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional race covering approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde. The race starts at Zossen Town Hall Square, with an honorary start at 9:00 a.m. and the official start at 9:15 a.m. at the outskirts of Zossen. The route follows firmly frozen paths that are good to run on in favorable weather. At the finish in Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, participants receive a commemorative medal and Prosecco as a reward.
course_highlights: Approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde
Start at the outskirts of Zossen, beyond the railway crossing on the old B246
Finish at Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, with a medal and Prosecco
additional: In freezing conditions, the route is firmly frozen and good to run on.

name: Silvesterlauf Winsen (Aller)
description: The MTV "Fichte" Winsen (Aller) New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional year-end running event that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 1,600 m for children to 10,300 m for adults, as well as a 6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure. The run starts and finishes at the Allertalsporthalle, where changing rooms and showers are also available. The event is officially sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and features a celebratory awards ceremony for the fastest participants in each distance.
course_highlights: Distances from 1,600 m to 10,300 m for all age groups
6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure
Start and finish at the Allertalsporthalle, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Race bib distribution from 2 December 2024 at the business office (Mon–Fri, 8:00–12:30). Late registration is possible on the event day from 12:00 to 13:45 for an additional fee. Plenty of parking is available at the Allertalsporthalle. Awards ceremony at approximately 15:30. Distances: 3 km, 5 km, 10.3 km, children’s race 1.6 km; walkers welcome. Start at 14:30. Register online or on site.

name: 12. Silvesterlauf an der Leine
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hannover is a popular year-end race that traditionally starts on December 31 at 13:00. The event features a 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths along the Leine, through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and back along the Ihme. It is organized by Hannoverscher Radsportclub (HRC), Bladerunner and Trimindous UG, and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, with mulled wine and bratwurst after the race. Every finisher receives a wheat beer glass featuring the event design as a keepsake. There is also a walking category, making the event appealing to a range of participants.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course goes through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the canal
Return route along the Ihme
additional: Mass start at 13:00; on-the-day registration is available on site from 12:00 for payment by cash or PayPal. Every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass featuring the event design. The event venue is the clubhouse of Hannoverscher Radsportclub (HRC) at Weddigenufer 23, near Unisport. The race offers a relaxed atmosphere with mulled wine, bratwurst and a wheat beer glass for finishers. There is also a walking category, and the course is ideal for anyone who wants to wrap up the running year in good company.

name: 25. VR-Bank Mitte Silvesterlauf
location: Seeburger See, Bernshausen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The VR-Bank Mitte New Year's Eve Run is a sporting way to round off the year, held around Lake Seeburg in Bernshausen. The flat circuit on paved paths offers runners an attractive course with one or two laps around the lake, depending on the distance. The event traditionally takes place on 31 December and welcomes runners of all ability levels for an atmospheric end to the year. The start and finish areas are on Kreisstraße 106 near the Bernshausen multipurpose hall.
course_highlights: Flat circuit around Lake Seeburg
Paved paths
5 km loop (1 lap around the lake) and 10 km loop (2 laps around the lake)
additional: Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 10:30 at the Bernshausen multipurpose hall, until 30 minutes before each start. Race bibs are not available for collection at Laufline Göttingen. No refund of the entry fee is available if a participant does not take part or if the event is cancelled.

name: 38. Silvesterlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The SC Altenrheine New Year’s Eve Run is the region’s sporting end to the year. With up to 800 participants, from young to old, it is one of the largest running events in the area. The event offers various distances through Altenrheine, each finishing with a lap of the stadium. The varied routes include out-and-back sections and circuits through the town. The run is a popular opportunity to end the year on a sporty note and enjoy a sense of community.
course_highlights: 600-metre out-and-back route along Schürweg towards the car park, plus 1 lap of the stadium
2,000-metre out-and-back route along Schürweg towards Außenhook, plus 1 lap of the stadium
10,000 metres: 3 laps through Altenrheine, plus 1 lap of the stadium
additional: The event is designed for up to 800 athletes, from young to old. Distances range from 600 m to 10,000 m. Registration is online; registration details and prices are not explicitly listed on the website. The run offers a festive end-of-year atmosphere, with routes in the region and a broad range of participants.

name: 44. Bad Harzburger Silvesterlauf
location: Sportpark an der Rennbahn, Bad Harzburg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Bad Harzburg New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event organized by MTK Bad Harzburg since 1981. The race takes place every year on December 31 in the Sportpark an der Rennbahn and is the oldest New Year’s Eve run in the region. The event offers several distances, including 2,500, 5,000 and 10,000 meters, run on a 2,500-meter loop. Participants can record and follow their lap times electronically, making the race especially appealing.
course_highlights: 2,500-meter loop in the Sportpark an der Rennbahn
Electronic chip timing with split times after each lap
Traditional New Year’s Eve run since 1981, with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: The race office opens at 11 a.m. on race day. Live results are available online for the first time at https://oresults.eu/events/2639. Timing is provided by a SportIdent chip, which is scanned after each lap on the 5,000- and 10,000-meter courses. Certificates and trophies are presented at 3:30 p.m. Distances: 2,500 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m; registration by post or on race day; electronic timing; awards ceremonies for top finishers; start at 1:30 p.m.

name: 47. Silvesterlauf rund um die Thülsfelder Talsperre
description: The 47th International New Year’s Eve Run around the Thülsfelder Talsperre is a traditional race held on New Year’s Eve in Molbergen, Lower Saxony. The course runs around the Thülsfelder Talsperre and offers two distances: 0.8 km and 16.1 km. Organized by SV Molbergen since 1975, the race is the final competition of the year for many runners and officially counts toward rankings. After the finish, traditional pea soup provides a sociable end to the event.
course_highlights: Loop course around the Thülsfelder Talsperre
Scenic route in Lower Saxony
Traditional start with a cannon shot
additional: The race starts with a cannon shot fired by a local fireworks club; traditional pea soup is served after the race; the event attracts many local runners and club runners; December weather is typically cold, with possible snowfall. Distances: 0.8 km and 16.1 km; held on December 31, 2026; traditional communal meal after the race; large fields of participants can cause bottlenecks at the start.

name: Dübener Silvesterlauf
description: The 47th Dübener New Year's Eve Run takes place in Bad Düben and is organized by SV Bad Düben, Athletics Department. The event offers runners of all ages the opportunity to end the year on an active note. The route runs through the scenic surroundings of Bad Düben and promises a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Registration is online through SV Bad Düben.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic surroundings of Bad Düben
Traditional New Year's Eve run to close out the year
Event for children, teenagers, and adult runners
additional: The event is aimed at children, teenagers, and adult runners. The venue is the Obermühle sports facility, Parkstraße 1, Bad Düben. Cross-country run through heathland and woodland, children's and walkers' races, compact club event

name: Emmerthaler Silvesterlauf
description: The Emmerthal New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing race held on New Year’s Eve in Emmerthal, celebrating its 51st edition in 2026. Organized by TSG Emmerthal, the event gives runners the opportunity to track their performance with detailed lap times. It is supported by local sponsors and volunteer helpers from the fire brigade, police, the German Red Cross (DRK), and the club. The race is known for its friendly, community spirit and warmly welcomes all participants.
course_highlights: Distances: 300 m and 7 km
Results published with lap times
Race held on New Year’s Eve in Emmerthal
additional: Supported by local sponsors and helpers from the fire brigade, police, the German Red Cross (DRK), and TSG Emmerthal. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with frequent snowfall. The venue is in Emmerthal, with directions provided. December weather is typically cold and snowy; results are published with lap times; the event is very popular with runners and families.

name: Haseder Silvesterlauf
location: Dorfgemeinschaftshaus Giesen, Giesen, Hildesheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Hasede New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Giesen. With courses for children and adults, the run offers a sporting and sociable way to see out the year with friends and family. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, professional timing and dedicated team of volunteers. The courses run through the residential area around the sports hall and offer both short and longer distances for different ability levels.
course_highlights: The 600 m course loops once around the sports hall, through the residential area and back
5 km and 10 km courses for ambitious runners
Family-friendly atmosphere with children’s races over 0.6 km and 1.2 km
additional: Professional timing is provided by Eichels-Event from Hanover. The event is supported by a large team of volunteers. Bambini races are offered for children over 0.6 km and 1.2 km. The awards ceremony takes place in the sports hall, which also serves as a meeting point. Courses for children and adults, results, photo gallery, timing by Eichels-Event, refreshments on site

name: Kieler Silvesterlauf
description: The Kiel New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event held on December 31 in Kiel-Ellerbek at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz. The event is organized by LTV Kiel-Ost e.V. and is limited to 250 runners. In addition to the sporting competition, there is a costume contest for individuals and teams, as well as a draw for prizes. The awards ceremony takes place in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School, and every participant receives a memento and has the option to order a certificate.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz
Limited to 250 runners
Costume contest for individuals and teams, with prizes
additional: Race materials can be collected at the sports hall on 30.12.2026 from 15:00 to 16:30 and on 31.12.2026 from 11:00 to 12:30. Late entrants must pay a fee and may receive a place if any are still available. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 14:30 in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School. There are no age-group rankings, but men and women are ranked separately. Participants who hand in their race number after the run are entered into a draw for prizes; attendance is required. Participant limit: 250; start times on 30.12.2026 and 31.12.2026; late registration possible; awards ceremony at approximately 14:30; certificates and prizes

name: Lüchower Silvesterlauf
description: Der Lüchower Silvesterlauf ist eine traditionelle Laufveranstaltung, die jährlich am 31. Dezember in Lüchow stattfindet. Ausgerichtet vom SC Lüchow, bietet der Lauf eine sportliche Möglichkeit, das Jahr aktiv ausklingen zu lassen. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an verschiedene Altersklassen von Kindern bis zu Masters und ist eine beliebte Gelegenheit für Läufer aller Leistungsstufen.
course_highlights: Verschiedene Laufdistanzen (5 km, 10 km)
Traditionelles Silvester-Event in Lüchow
Familien- und Gemeinschaftsatmosphäre
additional: Teilnehmer können in Kategorien für Kinder, Jugendliche, Aktive und Masters starten.

name: Nellschützer Silvesterlauf
description: The Nellschütz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional 10 km road race in Lützen, Saxony-Anhalt, held on the morning of December 31. Since 2000, it has been a regular fixture in the local running calendar and offers runners in the Burgenlandkreis a chance to end the year together. The race starts near the church in Nellschütz and is officially organized within the German athletics framework, including insurance and coordination of the event date. Its characteristic relaxed style means runners usually run and chat in small groups rather than aiming for a personal best. After the race, participants are traditionally treated to hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family.
course_highlights: 10 km road race through Lützen and the surrounding area
Dedicated aid station on the course
Finish area with hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family
additional: Typical December weather: around 3 °C, a low of -2 °C, usually snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The race is designed as a communal year-end event, with runners taking part in small groups. The start is near the church in Nellschütz. The race starts in Nellschütz near the church, with a dedicated aid station on the course. The event is known as a year-end race with a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Oberlichtenauer Silvesterlauf
description: The Oberlichtenau New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional end-of-year race in Pulsnitz, Saxony. With a 1.2 km children’s run, a 4.8 km fun run, and a 9.2 km long-distance run, it offers a sporting menu for all ages and ability levels. The race is a popular event for runners and spectators and always takes place on New Year’s Eve, giving participants a sporting way to see out the year. The event is distinguished by its family-friendly atmosphere and dedicated organizers.
course_highlights: 1.2 km children’s run
4.8 km fun run
9.2 km long-distance run
additional: The race traditionally takes place on December 31 and includes three distances for different age groups. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and as a sporting way to end the year. The website provides no information about start times or pricing tiers. The organizers provide a pleasant race environment, with mulled wine and a gymnasium as a meeting point. On-site registration is possible; race distances: 1.2 km children’s run, 4.8 km fun run, 9.2 km long-distance run; refreshments are provided by club members.

name: OTB Silvesterlauf
description: The OTB New Year’s Eve Run in Osnabrück is a traditional year-end race that welcomes recreational runners, walkers and competitive athletes alike. On the last day of the year, participants can choose from several distances, including a 10 km main race, walking routes, a 5.6 km short race, an accessible fun run and a Bambini run. The event offers a lively atmosphere and modern timing with a disposable chip. The route passes through scenic areas such as Rubbenbruchsee and Natruper Holz, and the race has been a fixture on Osnabrück’s running calendar since 1980.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race goes to Rubbenbruchsee, through Natruper Holz and over Finkenhügel before returning to Illoshöhe
Walking route along Rubbenbruchsee (approx. 8 km), not timed
Accessible fun run on the Illoshöhe track, with up to 5 laps of 400 m each
additional: Timing uses a disposable chip attached to the race number (walking is not timed). From 2025, the Bambini route goes through the “big finish.” The accessible fun run is new from 2025. Start times vary by distance: walkers at 11:20, Bambini at 11:30, fun run at 11:50, 5.6 km short race at 12:10, and 10 km main race at 12:20. Spikes are not allowed on the 10 km and 5.6 km routes. Several race options are available, including an accessible run, a children’s race and walking; spikes are not allowed; online registration is available; field limited to 3,000 runners.

name: Pönitzer Silvesterlauf
description: The Pönitz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional road race held in Pönitz, a district of Scharbeutz in Schleswig-Holstein. On December 31, 2026, runners set off at 9:00 a.m. to choose between 7.5 km and 15 km on a flat course that finishes at Lindenstraße 34. The event is organized by SVG Pönitz and features electronic timing. After the race, participants receive a hot drink, a Berliner doughnut and a commemorative medal, as well as a personalized certificate on request.
course_highlights: Flat course in Pönitz, finishing at Lindenstraße 34
Electronic timing
Traditional New Year’s Eve event with refreshments and a medal
additional: Registration is easy and available on race day. The event has a long tradition, with more than 40 editions, and attracts numerous runners and walkers even in adverse weather conditions. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with occasional snowfall. A traditional New Year’s Eve run with a sense of community, electronic timing and small celebrations to round off the year.

name: XVII Koszaliński Bieg Sylwestrowy
location: Hala Widowiskowo-Sportowa, ul. Śniadeckich 4, Koszalin, Poland
description: The 17th Koszalin New Year’s Eve Run is a sporting way to say goodbye to the year in Koszalin, scheduled for December 31, 2026. The program includes a 5 km run, a 3.4 km Nordic walking event, and races for children and youth. The start and race office are located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at 4 Śniadeckich Street. It’s an event for runners and anyone who enjoys staying active at the end of the year.
course_highlights: 5 km main run
3.4 km Nordic walking event
Children’s races over 200 m, 400 m, and 800 m
additional: Online registration. The race office is open from 9:00 to 11:00 at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at 4 Śniadeckich Street. The Nordic walking event starts at 11:30.

name: 27 Szczeciński Bieg Noworoczny
location: Teatr Letni im. Heleny Majdaniec, Szczecin, Poland
description: Szczecin New Year’s Run 2027 is an annual running event held on January 1 by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre in Szczecin. The program includes a 5 km Main Run, Nordic Walking, and children’s races for different age groups. The Main Run route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, passes by Psia Polana and goes around Jasne Błonia. The start and finish are by the Summer Theatre. The event is a great opportunity to start the new year actively in a family-friendly, sporty atmosphere.
course_highlights: The 5 km route consists of two 2.5 km loops
The route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, passes by Psia Polana and goes around Jasne Błonia
Start and finish by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre
additional: Children’s races take place before the Main Run at 13:20, 13:30, and 13:40 for different age groups. Capacity: 470 places combined for the Main Run and Nordic Walking, and 115 for the children’s races. Race bibs can be collected on December 29 and 30, 2026, from 17:00 to 19:30. A bag drop is available by the race office. Changing rooms are available in the start area. The program also includes Nordic Walking over two 2.5 km loops and children’s races of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m, depending on age group. Places are limited.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz Orienteering is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz Orienteering Foundation, held in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. It is an activity for everyone, regardless of age or experience, combining sport with adventure and exploring nature using a map and compass. The Foundation promotes accessibility by also creating courses for blind and visually impaired participants. The series includes a variety of courses at different difficulty levels, and participants can earn badges for completing individual rounds.
course_highlights: A variety of forest terrain around Bydgoszcz, changing with each round
Courses for beginners and advanced participants, including courses for blind and visually impaired participants
The opportunity to earn digital badges and collectible stickers for completing rounds
additional: The series consists of six rounds held from November to January in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. For each completed round, participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collector card. A special final badge is available after completing the entire series. Courses cater to different ability levels, and the final round features a mass start on the semi-open grounds of a former farmstead.

name: Lekkoatletyczne Halowe Mistrzostwa Europ... Bieg Uliczny 5 km
description: The 15th European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships will be held in Toruń. As part of the event, a 5 km road race is being organised, offering masters runners an excellent opportunity to compete on the city’s scenic routes. The competition combines sporting rivalry with a spirit of camaraderie among masters athletes.
course_highlights: A 5 km road race in the centre of Toruń
Scenic urban routes with historic views
An accompanying event to the indoor athletics championships
additional: The 5 km road race is part of the programme of the 15th European Masters Athletics Championships Indoor in Toruń. Programme details are available in a PDF on the main website. No information is available about entry fees or online registration. The 5 km road race was also one of the championship events in 2026.

name: Wbiegnij z Nami w Nowy Rok
price_range: Od 20 zł do puszki na cel charytatywny
description: “Run” into the New Year with us is an annual running meet-up held in Szczecin by Lake Głębokie. Participants cover around 5 km together. The event is social and charitable, combining sport with an opportunity to support those in need. There is an option to take an ice bath after the run, and the whole event takes place in a friendly atmosphere that encourages people to exchange New Year’s wishes. This informal running event invites everyone to start the new year actively.
course_highlights: An approximately 5 km route by Lake Głębokie
Option to take an ice bath after the run
A social meet-up with New Year’s wishes
additional: The event takes place on 1 January at 12:00 by Lake Głębokie in Szczecin. There is an option to take an ice bath after the run. The event is charitable, with a minimum donation of 20 zł to the collection tin. It is not a traditional running event, but a social running meet-up. The start is at 12:00 from a forest clearing or car park, approximately 400 m from the roundabout at Głębokie, in the direction of Wołczkowo. Participation is non-competitive and at your own risk. Anyone planning to take an ice bath should bring suitable equipment.

name: XIV Jonavos Naujametinis bėgimas
location: Žemaitės ir P. Vaičiūno gatvių sankryža, Jonava, Lithuania
description: The 14th traditional Jonava New Year’s Run will take place on January 1, 2027. The start is at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets. The traditional 20 km course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala, and the finish is on Kauno Street near the treatment facilities. The event features a hilly course and winter conditions. After the run, participants are invited to enjoy tea and snacks and collect commemorative medals.
course_highlights: Traditional 20 km running course
Start at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets
The course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala, with the finish on Kauno Street
additional: After the run, participants receive trophies and prizes, commemorative medals, and can enjoy tea and snacks. The course is hilly, and in winter it may be slippery and windy. The course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala; the weather is often wintry, and the event is popular with local runners as a way to start the new year.

name: Grimstadvatnet Rundt
description: Grimstadvatnet Rundt is part of the Hareid winter series, with race 1 held on a Saturday in November, December, January and February, making 4 races in total. This is a 7.8 km road race, mostly on asphalt, and the course is relatively flat. The first race in the series was held on 5 December 1981, and the 110th race took place in November 2008.

images.alt_text: Løper i vinterløp med snø på veien.
Løpere klare for start i et landevegsløp.
Løper i Grimstadvatnet Rundt-løpet.
Løpere samlet før Grimstadvatnet rundt løpet.

name: Resolution Run
description: Resolution Run 2026 is a fast, flat 5K taking place on New Year’s Day, January 1, 2026, at 10:15 a.m. in Galway city centre. The route passes through the city centre, starting at the Claddagh, crossing Wolfe Tone Bridge, and continuing along Merchants Road and through the Docks before returning via Grattan Road and the Prom, with a fast finish in South Park, beside Nimmo’s Pier. The route passes many of the city’s most iconic attractions. The race is AAI-certified.

name: Resolution Run 2026
description: Resolution Run 2027 invites you to start the new year with energy and activity. It’s a great opportunity to keep your New Year’s resolutions by running alongside a crowd of enthusiastic runners. The event promises good spirits, smiles, and a fun start to the year in Kaunas.
course_highlights: Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Warm-up for participants in all distances
Run on routes through Kaunas
additional: Distribution of participants’ race packs and awards are scheduled in the event programme. The event will include an official opening and a warm-up for participants in all distances. The event takes place in Kaunas and is organised by VšĮ Kauno maratono klubas. Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km; the event takes place in Kaunas; the organiser offers a festive start and a sense of community.

name: Winterserie PSV Rot-Gold Lehrte 26/27
description: Die Winterserie des PSV Rot-Gold Lehrte bietet in der wettkampfarmen Zeit eine lockere Laufgelegenheit für Einsteiger, Fortgeschrittene und erfahrene Läufer sowie Walker. Die Läufe finden samstags in Gruppen auf öffentlichen Straßen, befestigten und unbefestigten Wald- und Feldwegen statt. Der Fokus liegt auf dem gemeinsamen Laufen und dem Austausch in einer freundlichen Atmosphäre. Die Veranstaltung umfasst verschiedene Streckenlängen und endet mit einer Abschlussveranstaltung im Vereinsheim.
course_highlights: Laufen auf öffentlichen Straßen sowie befestigten und unbefestigten Wald- und Feldwegen
Gemeinsames Laufen in Gruppen mit Begleitung durch Vereinsläufer
Verpflegung mit kostenlosem Tee, Kaffee und Kuchen am Startort
additional: Treffen ab 13:45 Uhr, Zielschluss um 16:30 Uhr. Umkleide- und Duschmöglichkeiten sowie Parkplätze sind am Startort vorhanden. Zeiterfassung wird nicht durchgeführt, Laufstreckenerfassung erfolgt. Abschlussveranstaltung mit Speisen und Getränken im Vereinsheim.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn forest parking, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic Walking events, held on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests. The events offer half-marathon (21.3 km) and marathon (42.2 km) distances, as well as shorter 5 km and 10 km runs and walks. The event has an intimate atmosphere and is intended for both amateur and professional athletes, with themed races and special touches. The start and race office are located by the Łysy Młyn forest car park in Biedrusko, and the race starts at 10:00. The course follows forest trails and tracks, with some paved sections and natural obstacles such as leaves, mud, and puddles.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop; the marathon consists of two loops.
The course mainly follows the blue cycling trail along the Warta River and the Łysy Młyn running trail.
The forest surface is slippery and uneven, with leaves, mud, and puddles; total elevation gain is 110 m for the half-marathon.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and touches are encouraged for the individual races. The course is not officially certified and is measured using bicycle odometers and a Garmin device. Nordic Walking events are also held over 21.3 km, as well as runs and walks over 5 km and 10 km. The New Year's Run is event no. 2 in the series. The event centre and race office are by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. Race-pack collection on race day is scheduled for 7:45–9:30, and the start is at 10:00. Free parking is available by the event centre.

name: Ełcka Zmarzlina

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: W terminie do 11 grudnia 2026 r., dla dystansu TP 50 km, TP 25 km – 120 zł

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: W terminie do 9 stycznia 2027 r., dla dystansu TP 50 km, TP 25 km – 150 zł

description: Ełcka Zmarzlina 2027 is a walking orienteering marathon held in Ełk, offering two routes of 50 km and 25 km. The event takes place on January 9, 2027, and is funded from the budget of the City of Ełk. Participants can expect professional organization, registration at the marathon office, and a celebratory closing with a feast. It is a unique opportunity to spend an active winter day on routes of varying difficulty.
course_highlights: 50 km walking orienteering route
Alternative 25 km route
Time limits: 12 hours for 50 km and 9 hours for 25 km
additional: Participant registration takes place on January 8, 2027, from 16:00 to 20:00, and on January 9 from 6:00 to 9:30 at the race office. The time limit is 12 hours for the 50 km route and 9 hours for the 25 km route. A celebratory closing and a feast for participants are planned for 21:00 after the event. Registration is conducted through Timekeeper. According to the 2027 event page, TP 50 km starts at 08:00, and TP 25 km at 10:00. The event is funded from the budget of the City of Ełk, and KOMA EŁK is a partner.

name: SpriT Frontyard Frozen - Torna Hällestad
location: Kaninlandet, Torna Hällestad, Lund Municipality, Sverige
description: SpriT Frontyard Frozen i Torna Hällestad är en unik traillöpningstävling som erbjuder en 1 km lång light trail-bana vid Kaninlandet. Banan har en mjuk start, en utmanande 100 meter lång backe med 15 meters höjdskillnad och avslutas med en lugn 300 meters sprint på en fin stig utan asfalt eller grusväg. Tävlingen går ut på att springa så många varv som möjligt inom givna tidsgränser som successivt minskar, vilket utmanar både snabbhet och löpstrategi. Det är en tävling för alla nivåer och ambitioner med en härlig skogsmiljö och en gemytlig atmosfär med vätska och lite mat vid varvningen.
course_highlights: 1 km light trail-bana utan asfalt eller grusväg
En 100 meter lång backe med 15 meters höjdskillnad
Avslutande 300 meters sprint på fin stig
additional: Vid varvningen erbjuds vatten, cola och lite mat samt eventuellt buljong. Tävlingen har begränsat antal platser och anmälan är bindande efter betalning. Bansträckning finns tillgänglig via Strava. Vatten, cola och enklare mat finns vid varvningen. Starten går klockan 09.00.

name: Lierløpet
description: Lierløpet is one of Norway’s fastest courses, running along a wide footpath that is popular with runners and recreational exercisers in the Drammen area. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21 km), and is open to those who want to jog or walk as well as to fit, fast runners. There is also a children’s race, where all participants receive ice cream. Race numbers can be purchased at Lier Station, and the race starts at 12:00.

Løpere deltar i Lierløpet, et landeveisløp.
Togstasjon i Lier.

location: Torna Hällestad, Lund Municipality, Skåne County, Sverige

name: LBT Kėdainiai
location: Kėdainių miesto centrinis stadionas (J. Basanavičiaus g. 1.)
description: Kėdainiai Sports Centre is organizing LBT 1 – the New Year’s Run “KĖDAINIAI 2025,” which will take place on January 5 at 12:00 at the Kėdainiai Central Stadium grounds (J. Basanavičiaus St. 1). The running distances include a 400 m children’s run and 4 km and 8.5 km courses.

name: Bieg Noworoczny
organizer: Fundacja Duet – Rozwój z Pasją; Stowarzyszenie Wroniecki Klub Biegacza
description: The New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Wronki Runners Club, held on scenic routes in the Wronki municipality. Participants can choose distances of approximately 5 km or 10 km for runners, or approximately 5 km for walkers. The start and finish are on Rzecińska Street in Wronki, and times are recorded using a chip timing system. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle and brings together local residents and running enthusiasts in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5.5 km for runners and Nordic walking participants
Scenic forests and landscapes of the Wronki municipality
Start and finish on Rzecińska Street in Wronki
additional: The race office is open on race day from 9:45 to 10:45 by the start line on Rzecińska Street. Chip timing is provided by PLUS TIMING. Participants under 18 must submit written consent from a parent or guardian. The organizer does not allow participants under 15 to take part. Hot tea and coffee will be available in the catering area after the race. The winners’ awards ceremony will take place at the Zamość estate community center on Topolowa Street. The start is at 11:00. Participation is open from age 15; minors need written consent from a parent or guardian. Paying the entry fee on race day does not guarantee a medal.

name: Noworoczny Bydgoszcz FAN Maraton od 2014...
description: Bydgoszcz Fan Marathon is a unique long-distance event held in Bydgoszcz since 2014, mainly at the KS Gwiazda stadium and along the Old Bydgoszcz Canal. The course consists of multiple loops of approximately 4.22 km, following park paths with a gravel-and-asphalt surface and little elevation change. The event is small-scale and friendly, promoting recreational exercise and active leisure while continuing the tradition of similar races in other European cities. Participants time themselves and report their times to the organizers. Both runners and Nordic walkers are welcome. The start is usually in the morning, and the atmosphere is informal and friendly.
course_highlights: The course follows park paths around the Old Bydgoszcz Canal, with 4.22 km loops
Gravel-and-asphalt surface, mostly gravel
Start and finish at the KS Gwiazda stadium; little elevation change (approximately 53 m above sea level at the start and 45.95 m above sea level at the turnaround)
additional: There is no time limit; participants time themselves and report their times by email. People over 18 may take part, including Nordic walkers and walkers. The race office is located on the park path by the KS Gwiazda stadium. No entry fee is planned, except in special circumstances. Participants provide their own drinks and nutrition. The start is usually at 8:00 or 9:00. The course requires completing a multiple of the loop, up to a maximum of 10 loops. Participants arriving after the scheduled start time start together with the first participant. The event has no entry fee and no medals.

name: Bjørgene Løpskarusell 4. Løp
description: The athletics group welcomes you to a new running series in Bjørgene on February 4! The snow is gone and the trails in Bjørgene are in good condition. We hope to see you at the starting line!

images.alt_text: Løpere samlet før eller etter løp.
Løpere som løper i et løp, sett fra en lav vinkel.
Løpere på podiet med pokaler.

name: Vinterkarusellen 5. løp
description: The 5th race of Vinterkarusellen was held at Fana Stadium, where the venue was crowded and 515 runners finished the 5 km, while 247 finished the 10 km. Participation increased considerably after the previous winter race, and conditions were good despite brisk winds in some places. Markus Galleberg and Eli Anne Dvergsdal were the fastest in the 5 km, while Andre Lenningsvik and Renate Galleberg won the 10 km. This race is part of Ålesund Vinterkarusell, which consists of 5 races suited to both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Grand Prix Trójmiasta 1/3
location: Brzeźno Pier (Molo w Gdańsku-Brzeźnie), Gdańsk, Poland
description: The 3 Kings Run is the first event in the 2027 Grand Prix of the Tri-City series, held on a 100% sandy beach course in Gdańsk-Brzeźno. The event includes a 6 km cross-country run and 6 km Nordic walking, with age categories and three-person team competitions requiring at least one woman. The event is small-scale, with a participant limit of 500, offering an intimate atmosphere and sporting competition on the scenic coast. The run starts at 9:00, and the winners’ awards ceremony will take place at around 11:30.
course_highlights: 100% beach course
6 km cross-country run
6 km Nordic walking
additional: The event office opens at 07:30. Three-person teams (for both the run and Nordic walking), with at least one woman, must register at the event office. Participant limit: 500. Participants can choose the 6 km cross-country run or Nordic walking. Three-person team competition is also available, with at least one woman on each team.

name: Sylvesterloppet Göteborg
description: Sylvesterloppet i Göteborg är ett publikvänligt 10 km-lopp som arrangeras på nyårsafton med start och mål på Heden. Banan är flack och går i två varv genom centrala Göteborg, inklusive Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda och runt Svenska Mässan. Loppet passar alla löpare som vill avsluta året med en snabb och festlig löpupplevelse. Alla deltagare som fullföljer loppet får medalj och har chans att vinna utlottade priser.
course_highlights: Flack tvåvarvsbana på 10 km genom centrala Göteborg
Passerar Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda och Svenska Mässan
Publikvänlig och festlig miljö med påhejande brandmän vid Gårda brandstation
additional: Startgrupper delas in efter förväntad sluttid med elit, startgrupp 1 och startgrupp 2. Uppvärmning börjar 15 minuter före start. Nummerlappar kan hämtas 29-30 december och på tävlingsdagen 09:00-11:30 i Excersishuset på Heden. Elektronisk tidtagning med chip på nummerlappen används, och nettotid redovisas i resultatlistan. Starten går klockan 12.00 den 31 december. Anmälan via MittLopp kan göras fram till en timme före start, om loppet inte är fulltecknat.

name: Esbjerg Night Trail 2026/2027
description: Esbjerg Night Trail er en serie af natløb arrangeret af Orienteringsklubben Esbjerg i samarbejde med lokale partnere. Løbene foregår i skovområder omkring Esbjerg og Fanø, hvor deltagerne løber med pandelampe i efterårs- og vintersæsonen. Serien består af otte løb, hvor man kan vælge mellem ca. 5 km eller 10 km, fordelt på en eller to omgange. Løbet byder på udfordrende trailterræn med mulighed for mudder og vådt underlag, og der er fokus på godt samvær og løbeoplevelser i mørket. Efter løbet er der forfriskninger og mulighed for at vinde sponsorgaver.
course_highlights: Løb i mørke skove med pandelampe
Trailterræn med mudder og vådt underlag
Løb på ca. 5 km eller 10 km ruter i skovområder omkring Esbjerg og Fanø
additional: Løbene afholdes typisk kl. 19.00 med startsteder annonceret på Facebook kort før løbet. Deltagere under 15 år skal følges med en voksen. Efter løbet serveres der lidt at drikke, evt. varmt, og der er mulighed for at vinde sponsorgaver fra Eventyrsport. Serien består af 8 løb fordelt over efterår og vinter, med startsteder i Esbjerg, Fanø og skovområder nær Varde/Ribe. Pandelampe er nødvendig, og trailsko, der kan tåle mudder, anbefales. Løbere under 15 år skal følges med en voksen. Tilmelding foregår via Sportstiming.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 3. løp
description: Samnanger Winter Race Series is a social and inclusive running series organised by Samnanger IL Athletics. The races take place at Nesodden, with the start and finish in the same place, and participants can choose between 2 km and 5 km distances. The Winter Race Series is suitable for all levels, whether you want to compete, set a new personal best, stay in shape or simply enjoy a pleasant run with others. The races are held approximately every other Friday throughout the winter, and runners are encouraged to wear reflective gear because of the darkness.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Nesodden
Choice of 2 km and 5 km distances
The 5 km course is officially measured by the Norwegian Athletics Federation (NFIF)
additional: The running group is informal, free and open to all levels. Wearing a reflective vest is recommended because of the darkness. Samnanger IL Running Group also offers group training every Monday at 18:10 at Hagabotnane. The event calendar lists the start time as 18:30. The Winter Race Series is free; remember your reflective vest.

name: Vinterkarusellen 5. løp
description: The 5th race in Vinterkarusellen was held at Fana Stadium, where it was crowded, and a total of 515 participants completed the 5 km, while 247 took part in the double distance. Participation has increased sharply since the winter race 3 weeks ago, and the running conditions were good despite brisk winds in exposed areas. Markus Galleberg and Eli Anne Dvergsdal were fastest in the 5 km, while Andre Lenningsvik and Renate Galleberg won the 10 km.

name: Polar Night Marathon
description: The Polar Night Marathon is a spectacular race during the blue hour north of the Arctic Circle. Choose from several distances, from 5 km to a full marathon (42.195 km), and experience the magic of the magnificent Arctic landscape. The race takes place in early January, during the polar night, when the sun does not rise above the horizon.

Løpere i Mørketidsløpet i Tromsø. Snø, mørke, og festlige lys.
Løpere ved starten av Mørketidsløpet i Tromsø.

name: Magni Maraton 106
description: Magni Marathon is a popular marathon that attracts participants from various places. The course is known for its beautiful scenery and varied terrain, offering runners a unique experience. Participants can enjoy both challenging hills and flat stretches, making the race exciting for beginners and experienced runners alike.

name: Eikanger Vintarkarusell 4
description: The second race in the 2025–26 winter series takes place on Saturday 15 November at Eikanger. There will be seven races in total this season, with three before Christmas and four after New Year. The course follows the usual route around Eikangervågen, and registration opens from 14:20.

name: Askløpet
description: Askløpet is a long-standing race organized by Ask Friidrett in beautiful surroundings on Askøy in Vestland. The race brings together both local and visiting runners for a friendly and inclusive competition. It is a great opportunity for both recreational runners and competitive athletes to test their fitness early in the year. The event has a long history, and past results are available for those who want to follow previous performances.

name: Nidaros Vinterkarusell: Løp 2
description: Nidaros Winter Series is a winter running series organized by Strindheim IL Athletics at Ranheimshallen. The races take place indoors, with distances including 3,000 metres for everyone and 1,000 metres for children. The event is open to both young people and adults, and timing is provided by EQTiming, but the times are not eligible for records or annual statistics. The series is part of Strindheim’s tradition of offering inclusive athletics events that bring the community together in Trondheim.
course_highlights: Indoor races at Ranheimshallen
3,000 metres for all participants
1,000 metres for children
additional: Registration on the day of the event incurs a fee. The event is part of a series of races in the winter running series.

name: SOUL TRAIL CUP 2027 - Tilmeld ALLE 5 afdelinger
SOUL TRAIL CUP 2027 - Tilmeld ALLE 5 afdelinger
Noskrien Ziemu 3. tumsas posms Smiltenē
description: Noskrien Ziemu 3rd Night Stage in Smiltene is a winter running race that gives participants the opportunity to test their abilities in wintry and challenging conditions. The race takes place in Smiltene and is part of the Noskrien Ziemu series, which brings together athletes from different places. The event is welcoming to both experienced runners and amateurs, offering various distances and the opportunity to take part in a hike. The organizers provide a convenient registration process and support for participants.
additional: Registration is available only for the current Noskrien Ziemu stage. The number of participants is limited, and once the limit is reached, applications are placed on a waiting list.

description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route near the forests and the Łyna River, close to Ruś. The winter scenery, forest trails and changing terrain create unique running conditions, giving runners a chance to test their fitness and enjoy the excitement of competition throughout the season. The event is for everyone who wants to spend their winter Saturdays actively, regardless of experience level. The organizers help make the event comfortable for participants by offering passes for the full series as well as the option to enter a single race.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish by the beach at the bend of the Łyna River in Stawiguda Municipality
Winter forest scenery with natural, changing terrain
additional: Mini Trail!ON children’s races are held over distances from 300 m to 1,000 m, with age-group divisions. Children’s races take place from 9:45 to 10:15. The race office closes at 10:30. An awards ceremony for the series winners and a bonfire with the Mayor are planned for the final race. Single-race entry can be purchased at the race office on race day. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. The program also includes children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m and 1,000 m, as well as winter swimming. Online registration is open until January 6, 2027, at 23:59.

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic course in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The route follows a 5.15 km loop through forest, climbing the highest hill, Dziewicza Góra, twice. The races bring together runners of different ages and abilities across various distances, and also offer Nordic walking and races for children and young people. The organizers provide professional timing and a welcoming atmosphere, creating a unique “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The course passes through the event centre, where spectators can cheer on participants
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted chip band. Race office open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The races are held as a series of six stages. Children’s and youth races over 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m and 1,500 m. The course is marked with orange ribbons and directional arrows. Participants in the 10 km race complete two loops; after the first loop, they cross the finish line and continue onto the second loop. The 2026–2027 season consists of six stages; passes for the whole series were also available.

name: Zimowa Strzyżewska Piątka
organizer: Powiatowe Centrum Sportu w Nowym Tomyślu; Zbąszyńskie Centrum Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji; ATE Wicher Strzyżewo; Sołectwo Strzyżewo; OSP Strzyżewo; Klub Biegacza TKKF „Łabędź” Zbąszyń
description: Zimowa Strzyżewska Piątka is a 10 km race held on the football pitch in Strzyżewo. The event takes place in a winter setting, adding a unique character to the competition. The start is scheduled for 8:00, and the event is organized by local sports and community institutions. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and sporting excitement.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Start and finish at the football pitch, Strzyżewo 46A
Scenic winter setting in Strzyżewo
additional: The start and registration take place at the football pitch, Strzyżewo 46A. Registration and start hours are 8:00–8:45. The organizers are Powiatowe Centrum Sportu w Nowym Tomyślu, Zbąszyńskie Centrum Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji, and local community and sports organizations. The race office and start are at the football pitch in Strzyżewo 46A. On race day, participant registration runs from 8:00 to 8:45.

name: Vinterkarusellen 3. løp
description: The 3rd Vinterkarusellen race offers two distances, 5 and 10 km, on accurately measured courses through Brusdalen. The course turns around after 2.5 km and 5 km, then returns to the start/finish. The 5 km distance has a recreational class without timing. There is usually little car traffic on Gamle Brusdals veg on Sundays, but be aware that cars may be in the area.

name: Talvijuoksusarja 3/6
description: The 3rd event in the Winter Running Series will take place on 30.12.2023 in Mikkeli, offering runners the opportunity to participate in different distances, including 10 km and 6 km. The event is designed especially for winter conditions and attracts both competitive and recreational runners. Previous races have seen excellent performances, and participants can enjoy the winter running atmosphere.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run has been promoting the city’s fitness for 30 years. Each month, 100–200 runners of different ages take part. The beautiful route runs through the scenery along the Loimijoki River, with a choice of distances: 5.8 km or 11.2 km. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of the over-100-year-old Elävien kuvien cinema.

name: Winterlaufserie
description: The Stadthagen Winter Running Series is a relaxed running and Nordic walking event consisting of 10 individual events. Participants can choose from four signposted loop courses of varying difficulty in the scenic Bückeberge hills. There is no mass start or timing, making it a stress-free way to assess your own performance. All participants receive a warm tea at the finish in the sports center.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The Szczecin course runs through beautiful woodland around Emerald Lake, with the start and finish behind the Szmaragd Inn. The race is open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The event aims to promote running and outdoor physical activity, and to offer the opportunity to compete on a permanent course.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Emerald Lake
Start and finish behind the Szmaragd Inn at ul. Kopalniana
Varied course profile with uphill and downhill sections
additional: The race office opens at 8:30; race bibs and chips can be collected on race day. Participants can purchase a pass for the entire series or enter a single race. The pass allows one free start in another city, provided the participant registers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. The main race starts at 11:00, with a group warm-up at 10:45. The race-day entry fee is higher (60 zł). The start is at 11:00. Registration is available online through the CITY TRAIL website or at the race office on race day.

description: The 13th Winter Run as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP) will take place on January 10, 2027, in Krajkowo at the Riding Center IDMAR. The main race, covering approximately 10 km, starts at 12:00. Races for children and young people are also held over several shorter distances. The start, finish, and race village are inside the arena, providing comfortable conditions regardless of the weather. A public collection will be held in support of WOŚP, along with challenges and competitions for spectators, so there will be something for everyone.
course_highlights: Main race distance: approximately 10 km
Start and finish inside the Riding Center IDMAR arena in Krajkowo
Children’s and youth races over distances from 150 m to 1,000 m
additional: Race Office opening hours: January 8, 2027, in Mosina (17:00–20:00), and January 10, 2027, in Krajkowo (09:30–11:55). Participants can support WOŚP with voluntary donations when collecting their race packs. Challenges and competitions for spectators, as well as the HARPAGAN challenge, will also be held. The main race starts at 12:00. Registration is open until January 3, 2027; voluntary donations to WOŚP will be collected during race-pack collection.

name: VII Żniński Bieg Powstańczy
description: The VII Żnin Uprising Run is a 5 km race taking place in Żnin. The course is flat and paved, with one small hill and a turnaround halfway through. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street, near the tennis courts. The race is organized by the Jedynka Association and is limited to 200 participants.
course_highlights: 5 km course measured by GPS
Flat paved course with one small hill
Turnaround 2.5 km from the start
additional: The race is limited to 200 participants. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street in Żnin, near the tennis courts (property number 14). The payment title must include the participant’s first name, surname, and year of birth.

name: Zimowa Piątka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Zimowa Piątka is an annual race organized by the Suwałki Sports and Recreation Centre, held by Arkadia Reservoir. It is a unique opportunity to kick off the winter season with an active outing in the picturesque surroundings of Suwałki, known for its harsh climate and beautiful landscapes. The event attracts both recreational and experienced runners, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting competition among residents and visitors. For years, OSiR Suwałki has ensured the professional organization of sporting events, providing participants with comfort and safety.
course_highlights: The race route follows a picturesque course around Arkadia Reservoir
The winter scenery of Suwałki, with its characteristic cold climate
A well-prepared and marked route suited to runners of different abilities
additional: In previous editions, the race was part of Stacja Pogodne Suwałki, whose program also included a Nordic walking event and a children's race. Participants in Zimowa Piątka could take part in carnival costumes.

name: Zimowy Bieg Niedzwiedzia
location: Nowy Dębiec, Kościan County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Kościanie
description: The Winter Bear Run in Nowy Dębiec is an annual running event organized by the Kościan Municipality Sports and Recreation Center. The race takes place at the holiday resort in Nowy Dębiec, giving participants the chance to compete in scenic surroundings. The event is part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix, promoting active recreation and community integration.
course_highlights: The course runs through the holiday resort in Nowy Dębiec
Scenic areas by the lake
Organized as part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix
additional: The event is organized by the Kościan Municipality Sports and Recreation Center. The race is part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix series. The resort has a swimming area, beach, and sports fields in Nowy Dębiec. Cash prizes were awarded in previous editions.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 4 (11. jan)
description: Necon Winter Series is a running series in Bergen with several races throughout the winter. The races start and finish at Fana Stadium, and participants can choose between 5 and 10 kilometers. The course is an out-and-back route, with turnarounds after 2.5 kilometers for the 5 km and after 5 kilometers for the 10 km.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Out-and-back course with 5 km and 10 km options
Turnaround after 2.5 km for the 5 km and after 5 km for the 10 km

name: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti
description: The XXV Run Commemorating Freedom Defenders’ Day in Klaipėda is a traditional running event held to honour those who died and fought for Lithuania’s freedom. The event brings together the city’s community and visitors and takes place in Klaipėda on January 18. Participants can choose between two distances: the main 8 km course and a shorter 3 km course for schoolchildren, seniors and anyone who finds the longer course too challenging. The event starts in the evening, and the routes pass through scenic parts of the city, including a cycle path and the Summer Amphitheatre.
course_highlights: The 8 km course follows a cycle path past Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre, Liepojos Street and H. Manto Street
Finish near Klaipėda City Municipality (Liepų St. 11)
The 3 km course starts near Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre and is intended for schoolchildren and seniors
additional: Race bibs have an external timing chip. Picking up race bibs in advance is recommended to avoid queues on event day. Bib pickup for 8 km runners is on a bus near the Rotušė, and for 3 km runners it is near the Summer Amphitheatre. Buses depart for the start locations at 19:00. Individual warm-up: 19:45–19:55. The course closes at 21:20. Medals are awarded to the first 900 finishers. The event is organised with buses and community participation; the start is at the Klaipėda Giruliai Radio and TV Tower.

name: Snøkuten Nordhagarunden
description: Snøkuten Nordhagarunden takes place on October 17, 2023, and covers a distance of 9.5 km. The race is part of the Snøkuten series and gives participants the opportunity to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings. The course is quite demanding, but takes you through beautiful scenery, and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. This is a popular event on Veldre Friidrett’s calendar.
