name: Åsane løpskarusell 2027
description: Åsane Running Series is a recreational running series with weekly 5 km races starting and finishing at IKEA in Åsane. The courses are nationally measured and suitable for all levels, led by experienced coaches. The series has a friendly, inclusive atmosphere and also offers training sessions for those who would like to join the running group. Race bibs are collected in IKEA’s garage before the races, and family and individual registration are available.
course_highlights: 5 km course measured and certified by NFIF
Start and finish inside IKEA, at the back facing south
Evening races starting at 19:00
additional: Race bibs are collected in IKEA’s garage between 18:00 and 18:45. Race bibs must be worn visibly, and the tags must not be folded or damaged. A replacement race bib costs 100 kr. The races are held in the evening on selected Thursdays throughout the year.

name: Vinterkarusellen 6.løp
description: The 6th race of the season in the NECON Winter Series took place on January 20, with 721 participants finishing despite torrential rain. A total of 382 runners completed the 5 km, while 169 finished the double distance. Hector Breivik from Ask was the fastest over 5 km with a time of 18:13, while Miriam Emilie Stensland Donovan from Lerøy won the women’s race in 21:31. The 10 km winners were Magne Knudsen (35:48) and Vanja Flatberg (40:26).

name: 5 Km Sport Glexe
description: Sport 1 Glexe is organizing a 10 km race on October 12 at 11:00! The race starts at MSG car wash, heading toward Gvarv from Bø. The course has been officially measured and is a fast route on new walking and cycling paths. It is easy to run, with an unattended drink station after approximately 3.4 km, 6.6 km, and at the finish. Toilets are available at Circle K, but there are no shower facilities.

name: Bislett Spring 5k
description: Bislett Spring 5K takes place at Bislett Stadium and offers a great opportunity to set a personal best over 5 km. The starting groups are divided by target finish time, and each group has a pacer to help you reach your goal. But remember, you still have to do the running!

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Hagemanns Hill Mile 2027 er et unikt last man standing-løp i Drammen hvor deltakerne løper runder på en engelsk mil (1609 meter) på under 20 minutter. Løpet starter klokken 10:00 den 16. januar og fortsetter med nye starter hvert 20. minutt. Det er ca 80 høydemeter per runde, og det deles ut medaljer til alle som fullfører minst én runde. Start og mål er ved Svelvik idrettsforening sitt klubbhus/fotballbane Solbakken, med muligheter for å hvile inne i garderober mellom rundene.
course_highlights: Løp runder på 1609 meter med ca 80 høydemeter per runde
Last man standing-format med start hvert 20. minutt
Start og mål ved Svelvik idrettsforening sitt klubbhus/fotballbane Solbakken
additional: Løpet krever refleksvest når det er mørkt, men det er lys i gata slik at hodelykt ikke er påbudt. Det er mulighet for å varme mat og drikke, og det blir solbærsaft tilgjengelig. Det er også anledning til kjøp og salg av startnummer. Påmelding omtales via arrangementssiden.

name: Bergen 3000 Indoor
description: Gneist 3000 Indoor is an indoor 3 km track race held at Gneist Arena in Bergen. The race consists of 15 laps on a soft, smooth blue athletics track. Participants may run in running shoes or in spikes with blunt pins no longer than 6 mm. To ensure evenly matched heats and a smooth flow, start times are set according to expected finish times, and pacers are planned for several heats. The event also includes a separate 400-metre children’s race, Gneist 400 kids, for children aged 6 to 12. A café with seating in the stands will be open during the meet, and race numbers must be collected no later than one hour before the start.
course_highlights: Indoor 3 km track race on a blue athletics surface
15 laps at Gneist Arena on a soft surface
Run in running shoes or spikes with blunt pins (max. 6 mm)
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Gneist Arena no later than 1 hour before the start. Runners must report to the Callroom 10–15 minutes before each heat, where their shoes will be checked. Runners will be released into the hall when it is ready for the next heat. Warm-ups must take place outdoors, as there is no space to warm up inside the hall. A café with seating in the stands will be open during the event. No access to the competition area is permitted without a race number. Warm-ups take place outdoors. Participants report to the Callroom 10–15 minutes before their heat. A café and seating in the stands are available.

name: HOKA Solastranden Halvmaraton
description: HOKA Solastranden Half Marathon offers a unique running experience, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. Half-marathon runners should note that course marshals go home after a target time of 2:40, but timing remains open for up to 3 hours. Pacers are also available for all distances, and aid stations serve both water and sports drinks. The race takes place in a scenic area, with alternative parking options nearby.

name: Bislett Distanseserie s3r1 - 5000m 2027
description: Bislett Distance Series is a low-threshold running series that holds monthly races at Bislett Stadium in Oslo. The races offer excellent conditions and a great atmosphere, and are suitable for runners of all levels. Participants enjoy a great indoor running experience at the historic Bislett Stadium, with nuts, bars and sports drink provided for everyone who registers. You can also run alongside others at your level, and pace runners are available to help you reach your goals.
course_highlights: Indoor races at the historic Bislett Stadium
A low-threshold, inclusive running series
Pace runners available for various target times
additional: Everyone who registers receives nuts, bars and sports drink from Maxim. The races are organised with a focus on community and quality.

name: Teivocup III 2027
description: Teivocup III 2027 is a six-part training competition and test-run series held once a month from November to April. The event offers running opportunities for different age and competition categories, with distances of 5 km and 2 km. The course follows a pedestrian and cycling path, with the start and finish at the intersection by Teivo Trotting Centre. Registration takes place at Lamminpää Outdoor Centre, and the race starts at 12:00. The best runners are awarded.
course_highlights: The course follows a pedestrian and cycling path
Start and finish at the intersection by Teivo Trotting Centre
Distances of 5 km and 2 km for different categories
additional: Register at Lamminpää Outdoor Centre by 11:30; arriving early is recommended to avoid queues. Categories: 5 km M/M40/M50/N/N40/N50; 2 km P/T 09/11/13. The best runners are awarded. A six-part running series; registration opens at 11:30 and the race starts at 12:00.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich

price_tiers.distance: Bieg dorosłych 5 km i 10 km oraz Nordic Walking

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 74 zł – w przypadku rejestracji do ostatniego poniedziałku poprzedzającego zawody.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 84zł – w przypadku rejestracji w ostatni wtorek, środę i czwartek przed zawodami.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 25zł – w przypadku rejestracji do ostatniego poniedziałku poprzedzającego zawody.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 35zł – w przypadku rejestracji po tym terminie.

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series consists of six races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park near Czerwonak. The event offers a variety of distances: 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic Walking event, and shorter races for children and young people. The course follows forest paths and climbs twice to the park’s highest peak, Dziewicza Góra. The event promotes physical activity, community integration, and nature conservation in the region.
course_highlights: A fully forested 5.15 km loop course
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the highest point in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park
The course passes through the event centre about 3.7 km after the start, allowing spectators to cheer on participants
additional: Children’s and youth races are held over distances of 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m, and 1,500 m, with separate starts from 9:00 to 9:45. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Race-day registration is available only until 10:00 and only for the adult races and walk. Participants in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. After the course exits the forest, the finish-area layout separates participants finishing the race from those continuing on to their second lap. The series programme also includes a Nordic Walking event and races for children and young people. Online registration is available through the form on the organiser’s website.

name: Gdynia ULTRA WAY - Winter Race Stary Wilk
description: Gdynia ULTRA WAY - Winter Race is a winter running festival taking place on January 16, 2027, in Gdynia. The event offers six distances of varying difficulty, from 5 km to over 76 km, with significant elevation gains and challenging courses. The race combines sporting competition with the beauty of the Kashubian landscape, offering participants unforgettable views and excitement. The organizers provide professional timing, checkpoints, and course support, as well as transport to the start for selected distances.
course_highlights: Courses with significant elevation gains: Nocny Jeleń +2309 m, Tropem Rysia +1501 m
Start and finish at the Gdynia Sports Centre - National Rugby Stadium
Refreshment and hydration points on courses longer than 10 km
additional: Participants are transported to the start by buses from the Gdynia Sports Centre - National Rugby Stadium (paid transport; registration required). Cutoff times: Nocny Jeleń 15 hours, Tropem Rysia 11 hours. Electronic chip timing and mandatory checkpoints. Refreshment and hydration points on courses longer than 10 km. DZIKI DUET is run in pairs.

name: 17 Chrustowski Bieg Zimowy
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. Bronisława Malinowskiego, Chrustowo, Gmina Oborniki, Poland
description: The Chrustowo Winter Run is the oldest running event in the Oborniki municipality, held since 2007. The 12 km main race passes through the picturesque villages of Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka and Ślepuchowo, while accompanying races for primary school pupils take place on courses suited to their age. The event promotes physical activity and brings the local community together. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and a recovery meal. Prizes are also awarded to the top finishers in the OPEN and age categories.
course_highlights: The 12 km main race passes through Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka and Ślepuchowo
Accompanying races for children and young people on courses suited to their age categories
Picturesque surroundings and a wintry atmosphere make for an active start to the year
additional: The main race is limited to 200 participants. The race package includes a commemorative medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut and water. The top finishers receive statuettes or trophies. The children’s accompanying races start at 11:05, immediately after the main race begins. In the 2026 edition, the main race was scheduled to start at the Bronisław Malinowski Primary School in Chrustowo; the limit was 200 participants. This information refers to the previous edition.

name: Dziki w Ogniu & Sztafety Ogniomistrza
location: OSP fire station, Spręcowo, Dywity, Poland
organizer: Gmina Dywity, OSP z terenu gminy Dywity i Gminne Dywickie Zrzeszenie LZS
price_range: 30-40 zł za bieg indywidualny; sztafeta bezpłatnie
description: Dziki w Ogniu & Sztafety Ogniomistrza is a winter cross-country race held in Spręcowo, Dywity municipality. The approximately 6 km course runs entirely along forest roads and tracks. It is very challenging, with numerous climbs and natural terrain obstacles. The event includes an individual race and relays for members of volunteer and state fire services (OSP/PSP). The start and finish are at the OSP fire station in Spręcowo. The race takes place in January and is a sporting and recreational event, with manual timekeeping and a commemorative medal for participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 6 km, entirely along forest roads and tracks
Challenging cross-country course with numerous climbs and natural obstacles
Start and finish at the OSP fire station in Spręcowo
additional: Race office hours are 9:00–10:30 at the OSP fire station in Spręcowo. The individual race is limited to 100 participants, with additional on-site registration available for 20 runners. Timekeeping is manual; start chips must be returned at the finish. Proceeds from additional registrations support the 34th WOŚP Grand Finale. In previous editions, the relay was for teams of six firefighters.

name: Run in Sopot - 1 etap
location: Sopot Beach, Entrance No. 23 by Sopot Pier, Sopot, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie
description: Run in Sopot is a series of running events held on Sopot’s beach and around the Forest Opera. The first stage is a unique opportunity to test yourself on sandy coastal terrain. The race is open to runners of different ages and ability levels, and participants also compete in the overall standings for cash prizes. This sporting event combines physical activity with the beauty of Sopot’s coastline, creating a welcoming atmosphere for families and running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Beach run at entrance no. 23 by the Sopot Pier
Coastal route with views of the Baltic Sea
Sandy terrain and seaside atmosphere
additional: The #RUNinSOPOT 2026 series includes three beach-running events and an additional round around the Forest Opera. Participants can use the Sopot Card, which reduces the entry fee. The event is open to all and family-friendly, with cash prizes in the overall standings. The limit was 250 participants. Sopot Card holders paid 40 zł, the standard fee was 49 zł, and participants aged 65+ were exempt from the fee. A medal, hot drinks, and a hot meal were provided at the finish.

name: WOŚPowa 5
description: WOŚPowa 5 is a 5 km race held in the picturesque town of Dąbki during the Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The start and finish are located at the Water Sports Centre. The event combines sporting competition with a worthy cause, encouraging participants to support WOŚP with voluntary donations. Shorter races of 200, 400 and 800 metres are also planned for children, making the event appealing to the whole family. Join us to celebrate sport and helping others together.
course_highlights: The main 5 km race starts and finishes at the Water Sports Centre
Children’s races over 200 m, 400 m and 800 m
A scenic route in the spa town of Dąbki
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary donation to the WOŚP collection box. The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale, combining sport with charitable support. The start and finish are located at the Water Sports Centre in Dąbki. Donations collected at the previous edition were given to the 33rd WOŚP Grand Finale.

name: Sørlandstesten 5
description: Sørlandstesten is an accessible fun run for everyone looking for a positive running experience, whatever their level of ambition. Whether you’re training for a bigger goal, want to experience the excitement of competition, or simply want a social and active day, this is the race for you! There’s room for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are on the opposite side of the road from Gumpens Auto, along Setesdalsveien in Kristiansand. Participants follow a flat, fast route up Setesdalsveien to Strai, then turn around and run back.

name: Gneist 3000 Indoor
description: Gneist 3000 Indoor is an indoor 3 km road race held at Gneist Arena in Bergen. The race consists of 15 laps on a soft, high-quality blue athletics track, and participants may wear running shoes or spikes with blunt tips no longer than 6 mm. The event emphasizes evenly matched heats based on estimated finish times to ensure good competition, with pacers in several heats. A separate 400-meter race for children aged 6–12 is also held alongside the main race. Race numbers must be collected at Gneist Arena at least one hour before the start. There will be an open café and spectator seating in the stands during the event.
course_highlights: Indoor 3 km race on a blue athletics track
15 laps at Gneist Arena
Choice of running shoes or spikes with blunt tips (maximum 6 mm)
additional: The race uses eq-timing’s timing system with lap times. Warm-ups are not permitted inside the arena and must take place outdoors. Race numbers must be collected at least one hour before the start. There will be a call in the Call Room 10–15 minutes before each heat, where shoes will be checked. Participants will be allowed into the arena when it is ready for the next heat. Each heat has approximately 15–20 participants, with those whose estimated times are longest starting first. Warm-ups take place outdoors. Race numbers must be collected at Gneist Arena at least one hour before the start, and the call in the call room is 10–15 minutes before the heat starts. Gneist 400 Kids is held alongside the main race for children aged 6–12.

name: Vinterkarusellen Løp 4
description: Vinterkarusellen is an annual running series featuring several distances, with courses officially measured and certified. This means that times achieved in the races will be recognized in statistics for both 5 km and 10 km. Participants have the opportunity to set personal records that will be recognized forever. The series has a rich history dating back to the mid-1980s, and since winter 2023, Ålesundløpene has once again been the organizer.

Løpere krysser målstreken under Necon Vinterkarusellen.

name: Hamarkarusellen Vinter Løp 4
description: Hamarkarusellen Winter is the winter edition of the new Hamarkarusellen. All races follow the same 5-kilometer course along illuminated walking and cycling paths in the Prestrud area of Hamar. Everyone is welcome, whatever their ambitions—whether you walk or run, with or without a time. There is no registration at the start, and the race offers an excellent opportunity to test your fitness, with 6 races during the winter.

images.alt_text: Løpere i Hamarkarusellen vinterløp.  Snø og kaldt vær.
Løpere klare for Hamarkarusellen vinterløp 4.

name: Sandsjöbacka Trail 180
description: Sandsjöbacka Trail är ett av Västsveriges mest spännande och utmanande traillopp under vinterperioden, som erbjuder distanser på 30k, 60k, 90k och 180k. Loppen bjuder på en varierad terräng med allt från lättlöpt mark till teknisk traillöpning i en magisk miljö. Oavsett om du är ultralöpare eller glad motionär finns en utmaning som passar dig. Välkommen att uppleva gemenskap, utmaning och glädje i Sandsjöbacka!
course_highlights: Terräng med både lättlöpt mark och teknisk traillöpning
Höjdmeter från ca 1000 hm (30k) upp till ca 5000 hm (180k)
Magisk vintermiljö i Göteborgsområdet
additional: 180k-loppet är ett out and back-lopp med start i Skatås och vändpunkt i Tjolöholm. Starttiden på fredagen kan väljas fritt mellan 11:00 och 20:00, men alla 90k och 180k löpare måste gemensamt starta kl. 06:00 på lördagsmorgonen. Det finns dropbags och viloplats i Tjolöholm. Självsupport gäller för sträckan Skatås - Tjolöholm enligt Fastest Known Time-regler. Pannlampa rekommenderas för mörkersträckor. Det finns maxtider och flera depåer med stängningstider längs banorna. Evenemanget är känt för sin natursköna bana och utmanande terräng, vilket gör det till ett populärt val för traillöpare i regionen.

name: Becksvart
description: Becksvart är ett unikt mörkerlopp som går i totalt mörker med pannlampa och reflexer som enda vägvisare. Du kan välja mellan två utmanande och varierande banor på 6 km eller 12 km som tar dig över stock och sten, längs smala stigar och upp på bergshällar runt Gunnebo Slott, Kallebäck och Lackarebäcksfjället. Loppen är en perfekt fredagsaktivitet med fokus på äventyr och upplevelse, där AfterRun med mat, dryck och musik väntar i målområdet. Det finns även en hemlig tävling i tävlingen för den som vill ha en extra utmaning.
course_highlights: Mörkerlöpning med pannlampa och reflexer som enda vägvisare
Banan går längs unika stigar runt Norra Långevattnet, Lackarebäcksfjället och Kallebäck
Göteborgs mest mytomspunna backe - Hobo Hill med 80 höjdmeter på ca 200 meter (12 km-banan)
additional: Start och mål vid Gunnebo Slott & Trädgårdar. Banorna är reflexmarkerade med klädnypor och snitslar. Nummerlappar och chip kan hämtas på Nordic Wellness Krokslätt dagen innan och på tävlingsdagen. Väskinlämning finns men är obevakad. En vätskestation finns halvvägs på banan och energi erbjuds efter målgång. Sjukvårdspersonal finns på plats. Buss 754 går till Gunnebo Park. Parkering finns nedanför slottet, ej vid start/mål. Trailskor med kraftig sula rekommenderas, pannlampa är obligatoriskt. Pannlampa rekommenderas starkt och beskrivs som obligatorisk på tävlingsinformationssidan; trailskor rekommenderas. Vätskestation finns ungefär halvvägs. AfterRun med musik, mat och dryck väntar efter målgång.

name: Vinterkarusellen Sørlandet
description: Vinterkarusellen Sørlandet is an exciting running race held in Kristiansand. The race covers a distance of 10 kilometres and gives participants the opportunity to experience the beautiful winter landscape of Sørlandet. It is perfect for both recreational and experienced runners who want to challenge themselves in a wintry setting.

images.alt_text: Løper i vinterløp på snø, publikum og bil i bakgrunnen.
Løpere i et løp, som deltar i et landeveisløp.
Vinterkarusellen Sørlandet. Albumkunst eller plakat med trær og bygning, i svart/hvitt.

name: Bergen Vintermaraton
description: Bergen Winter Marathon will be held for the 5th time on Saturday, January 18, 2025. The start and finish area will be at Fana Stadium. The course is an out-and-back route on paved roads that are either completely free of cars or have very little traffic, and a large part of the route follows a disused railway line through idyllic rural surroundings. Each loop is exactly one half marathon, and the same loop is run twice for the full marathon. The half marathon is one loop, while the marathon is two loops.

name: Sydvest Crossløb 2026/27 - afd. 6 - Nysø ved Varde
Botaniczna Piątka
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Winter Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event places particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of its routes, offering picturesque and attractive terrain for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during the winter edition of the race. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy some sporting fun together.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque routes
Scenic locations
Route available on Garmin Connect
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. The organizers particularly promote cross-country running and the scenic appeal of their routes. In summer 2026, they celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: Dwumaraton Olęderski is a series of running events organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Running Club and held in a friendly, social-sporting spirit. The event is aimed at both experienced runners and beginners who want to stay active on trails during the challenging autumn and winter months. Participants run a marathon or a multiple of the 10.5 km loop. Races take place in different towns from October to March. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and invite all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: The course consists of a 10.5 km loop
Trail running in autumn and winter conditions
Choose to run a marathon or a multiple of the loop
additional: Dwumaraton Olęderski takes place over a series of weekends from October to March, each in a different town. Races start at 10:00, and the race office opens an hour earlier. The time limit for the first race is 16:00 and for the second race, 15:00. The minimum distance is 10.5 km. The events are co-funded by Nowy Tomyśl County and held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. The date of January 17, 2027, is taken from the running calendar.

name: 10 Bieg Pobiegnij z WOŚP
description: The 10th Run with WOŚP in Ostrów Wielkopolski is an annual running event held under the patronage of the WOŚP Ostrów Wielkopolski Branch. The race covers 10 km and is charitable in nature, combining sporting competition with a community initiative. It takes place in January, and participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to train and compete together. On race day, the organizer provides an information point at Plażowa Restaurant.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer road race
Charitable event supporting WOŚP
Race in Ostrów Wielkopolski
additional: Training sessions count from the time of registration until race day. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, or additional equipment. The race calendar gives January 25, 2027, as an approximate date.

name: 16 Postomiński Bieg Policz się z cukrzycą
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Postominie
description: The Postomino Run “Count Yourself in the Fight Against Diabetes” is an annual running event organized by the Culture and Sports Center in Postomino. The race is charitable and is part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity, promoting awareness and support for people with diabetes. The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino, bringing together the local community and runners from various regions. The event combines sporting competition with an important health and social message.
course_highlights: The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino
A charity event supporting people with diabetes
Organized as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity
additional: The race is organized by the Culture and Sports Center in Postomino and takes place as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The event involves local running clubs and the community. The available websites provide no details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. The race takes place as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity.

name: 18 Bieg Policz się z cukrzycą
organizer: Szczecińska Agencja Artystyczna; Klub Biegacza Maratończyk Team Szczecin
description: The 18th Run for Diabetes is an annual running event organized by Maratończyk Team in Szczecin. The race takes place on Łasztownia near the Old Slaughterhouse, giving participants a chance to spend time actively and support the fight against diabetes. The event brings people together and promotes a healthy lifestyle among runners and city residents.
course_highlights: The route runs through scenic Szczecin Łasztownia
The start and finish are located near the Old Slaughterhouse
The race takes place in the afternoon, helping create a great atmosphere
additional: Newsletter sign-up is available. No details are provided about distances, fees, or start waves. Information about the route, fees, and location comes from the regulations for the 18th edition in 2026.

name: Gramy dla WOSP
description: Gramy dla WOŚP is a running event and walking rally held in the forested areas of the Bydgoszcz Forest, with marked routes that partly follow the Blessed Czesław Jóźwiak Trail. Participants can choose from several walking distances or an 11 km run, finishing in Nowa Wieś Wielka. The organizer provides return transport from the finish to the starting points and a generous race package including a medal, refreshments, and a hot meal. The event is charitable in nature, supporting the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the forested areas of the Bydgoszcz Forest
Part of the route follows the Blessed Czesław Jóźwiak Trail
Marked routes include a section on a public road during the final 3 km to the finish
additional: Race packages are distributed one hour before the start in the starting area. The organizer provides return bus transport from the finish in Nowa Wieś Wielka to the car parks by the beach in Piecki and to Solec Kujawski. Refreshments are available on the route, with a hot meal and commemorative medal at the finish. A mobile baggage drop is available for participants’ personal belongings. The combined participant limit for the run and walking rally is 250. The time limit is 2.5 hours for the run and 4.5 hours for Nordic walking. Available information concerns previous editions. In the edition described by the organizer, the run started at 11:00, and participants made their own way to the starting point.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Szczecin by Lake Szmaragdowe. The races take place from October to April, promoting physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. Each location has its own final standings, and participants can test their abilities in sporting competition. The race is open to people aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The event follows a regular schedule and offers a friendly atmosphere, encouraging both adults and children to take part.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through forests and city parks
Szczecin: the race takes place by Lake Szmaragdowe
The races take place in natural surroundings, bringing together the city and nature
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. The main race starts at 11:00. The program also includes CITY TRAIL Junior races for children over distances from 200 m to 1 km. In Szczecin, a joint warm-up is held with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The races follow a regular schedule, and the race office remains at the same location throughout the season.

name: III Urodzinowy Maraton Grzegorza Pawła N...
XI Bieg z Puszką dla WOŚP
description: The 11th Run with a Can for WOŚP is an annual charity running event held in the Kleszczewo municipality. Participants start in Komorniki and run through several localities, finishing in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce. The run brings people together and supports the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP), while the route offers a chance to explore nearby towns and villages. The event also features children’s races and a play zone, where children receive medals and gifts. The main race is scheduled to start at 14:30.
course_highlights: The route passes through Komorniki, Nagradowice, Kleszczewo, Gowarzewo and Tulce
The finish is in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce
The run is a charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Children’s races and a play zone are available, with age categories and distances ranging from 200 m to 2,000 m. In the youngest children’s category, a parent or guardian may accompany the child during the race. Every child who finishes receives a commemorative medal and gifts from the organizers and sponsors. The date in the source calendar is approximate and indicates 25 January 2027; the event date provided is 24 January 2027.

name: XII Biegu Pobij Dystans z Sercem!
description: The 12th Run Beat the Distance with Heart is an annual race held in Piła as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale and combines sporting competition with a charitable purpose, supporting children and seniors by raising funds for medical equipment. The race attracts people from the city and surrounding areas, bringing together a community of kind-hearted people who join forces to help those in need. It is a special opportunity to take an active part in Poland’s largest charitable campaign.
course_highlights: The race will take place in Piła, in the Greater Poland Voivodeship.
The running calendar lists the distance as 10 km, although route details are unavailable.
The event takes place on the day of the WOŚP Grand Finale.

name: Frikarusellen - 4. løp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 15 år og eldre: 450 kr for alle løpene

tiers.label: tier_5
tiers.description: IL Fri-medlemmer: 100 kr for alle løpene (bruk rabattkode)

description: Frikarusellen is a race organized by Idrettslaget Fri at Espeland sports ground in Arna, Bergen. The race features a certified 5 km course that starts north of Londalskrysset, runs to Gamle Haukeland station and returns along the same route, with the finish inside the sports ground. The event is part of a race series with several dates throughout the winter and early spring. It is a popular recreational race with a friendly atmosphere and enthusiastic participants of all ages.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Start north of Londalskrysset – Gamle Haukeland station – return along the same route
Finish inside Espeland sports ground
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A license fee is additional for participants over 13 who do not have an annual license. There is a fee of 50 kr for a forgotten race bib for those registered for all the races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no. The race takes place at Espeland sports ground in Arna. Registration is stated to be via EQ Timing.

name: Søknad Frikarusellen løp nr.4 2027
description: The Frikarusellen is a winter running series organized by Idrettslaget Fri in Arna, with six races throughout the winter and spring. The course is certified as 5 km and runs mainly along a pedestrian and cycle path between Espeland and Gamle Haukeland station, with the start and finish at Espeland sports grounds. The race is suitable for both young people and adults, with separate prices for members and age groups. It is a social and inclusive running series that encourages people to enjoy running together through the winter months.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course between Espeland and Gamle Haukeland station
The course runs mostly along a pedestrian and cycle path or a lightly trafficked road
Start and finish at Espeland sports grounds
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A license fee is added for participants over 13 years old who do not have an annual license. A fee of 50 kr applies if participants who registered for all the races forget their race number. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no.

name: Götas ungdomsspel
location: Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, Karlstad, Sverige
price_range: 110–120 kr per gren; efteranmälan i mån av plats mot dubbel avgift
description: Götas ungdomsspel inomhus är en friidrottstävling för ungdomar som arrangeras i den moderna Eva Lisa Holtz Arena i Karlstad. Tävlingen erbjuder en välkomnande och utvecklande miljö för unga friidrottare att tävla och utvecklas inom olika friidrottsgrenar. Arenan är en multifunktionell inomhusanläggning med plats för 1 700 åskådare, vilket skapar en fin atmosfär för både deltagare och publik. IF Göta Karlstad, en av Sveriges mest framgångsrika friidrottsföreningar, står bakom arrangemanget och erbjuder en trygg och inspirerande tävlingsmiljö.
course_highlights: Tävlingen hålls inomhus i Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, en modern arena med plats för 1 700 åskådare
Multifunktionell anläggning för både tävling och träning
Arrangeras av IF Göta Karlstad, en förening med lång tradition och framgång inom friidrott
additional: Tävlingen arrangeras i Eva Lisa Holtz Arena som invigdes 2022 och är en modern inomhusarena för friidrott och fysträning. Arenan är multifunktionell och används även för möten och utbildningar. IF Göta Karlstad ansvarar för anmälningsavgifter för max tre grenar per tävling för sina medlemmar. Anmälningar för barn och ungdomar under 14 år ska skickas till respektive gruppmail eller till tavlingsanmalan@ifgota.se om gruppmail saknas. Anmälan senast 24 januari via EasyRecord eller gus@ifgota.se. Deltagare tävlar i sin åldersklass eller seniorklass.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sverige
description: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter är ett vinteräventyr för löpare som älskar naturen även när temperaturen sjunker. Loppet går i vackra Norra Djurgården med start och mål vid Stora Skuggan. Här kan du välja mellan tre distanser på snöiga stigar och njuta av en unik vintermedalj vid målgång. Efter loppet väntar en värmande afterrun med varm dryck och tilltugg tillsammans med andra löpare.
course_highlights: Böljande snöiga stigar i Norra Djurgården
Vätskekontroller på 6 km och 12 km vid 4 km
Start och mål vid Stora Skuggan, lättillgängligt med tunnelbana och buss
additional: Alla som tar sig i mål får en unik vintermedalj. Vätskekontroller finns på 6 km och 12 km vid 4 km. Start och mål är vid Stora Skuggan, nära tunnelbana och buss. Anmälan sker via partnern EQ Timing och är bindande utan återbetalning. Möjlighet att köpa återbetalningsskydd via Startklar finns som tillägg. Anmälan är öppen till 29 januari 2027.

description: Winterrun Oslo 2027 is the big winter running festival, taking place on Saturday, 30 January at Rådhusplassen in Oslo. The race offers a unique atmosphere, with fire baskets, torches and music along the course, as thousands of participants gather for a magical running experience through Oslo’s streets. All participants receive a medal and Vitamin Well at the finish, and great prizes are drawn after the race. This is a feel-good race for anyone who wants to test their fitness or simply have fun in the winter cold.
course_highlights: Run through Oslo’s streets with atmospheric lighting from fire baskets and torches
Start and finish at the beautiful Rådhusplassen
A unique atmosphere with music and marshals providing an extra boost
additional: Race bibs are distributed a few days before the race in the city, but can also be collected in the start area on race day. Bag storage is outdoors and requires a luggage tag. There is a dedicated women’s tent for warming up and changing. Public transport to the start area is recommended due to limited parking. Race bibs can be transferred for a fee of NOK 150 via My Page. The race takes place on winter surfaces. Costumes are encouraged, and prizes are awarded for eye-catching outfits. All participants receive a medal and Vitamin Well at the finish.

name: Kondimootor 30/50/70: Lahemaa Lumine
description: Kondimootor 30/50/70: Lahemaa Lumine on kestvusmatkade ja ultramaratonide sari, mis toimub Eestimaa kaunis looduses Lahemaa Rahvuspargis. See pakub võimalust läbida erinevaid matkaradu, nautida orienteerumist ja jalatööd ning kogeda eneseületust. Matkad sobivad kõigile, kes soovivad vabas õhkkonnas liikuda, kohtuda uute inimestega ja nautida väikest võistlusmoment. Tule pane ennast proovile ja naudi liikumist Eesti looduses!
course_highlights: Suur kilometraaž ja kestvusmatkad
Orienteerumine ja jalatöö Lahemaa Rahvuspargi radadel
Vabas õhkkonnas liikumine ja sotsiaalne kogemus
additional: Spordialad: jooksmine, käimine, kepikõnd, matkamine, seiklemine. Üritus on osa Kondimootori sarjast, mis rõhutab eneseületust ja liikumise positiivset mõju vaimsele tervisele. Algus on kell 08.00. Rajal on joogi- ja snäkipunktid ning suurem toidupunkt.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of urban parks. In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located by the city beach. The races are open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly track their results on the same course. Races are held throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start on Św. Wawrzyńca Street; finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event also includes races for children in various age groups. The event is co-funded by the City of Poznań budget. The race on 17 January 2027 is one of four Poznań dates in the 2026/2027 season; the others are scheduled for 11 October and 22 November 2026, and 21 March 2027. The CITY TRAIL program also includes races for children.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz
location: Ogród Botaniczny, Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of the Botanical Garden in Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation, adding to the scenic appeal of the course. The race is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, which is popular and combines sport with the beauty of nature. The organizers place particular emphasis on attractive courses and the event atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Botanical Garden and Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation
Picturesque, scenic surroundings ideal for running
Races organized since 2014, with a focus on natural scenery
additional: The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las from Poznań. In summer 2026, the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka was celebrated. The event is part of a cross-country race series held in various locations across Wielkopolska and the surrounding area. The organizers encourage people to sign up for the newsletter to stay up to date with events.

name: Przybij Piątkę
description: Przybij Piątkę is a winter 5 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Klub Biegacza Chyży in the Municipal Park in Nowy Tomyśl. The course is 90% on unpaved surfaces and is not officially certified. The race is free, and every participant who finishes will receive a commemorative medal. Trophies will be awarded to the top finishers. The participant limit is 200.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
90% unpaved surface
Start and finish in the Municipal Park in Nowy Tomyśl
additional: The results are scheduled to be announced at 10:00 on the same day. The race is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Nowy Tomyśl County. The race is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Nowy Tomyśl County.

description: Winter Run Stockholm är ett stämningsfullt vinterlopp som äger rum på Skansen och Djurgården den 31 januari 2027. Deltagarna kan välja mellan 5 km och 10 km på en bana som kombinerar historiska miljöer och vacker vinternatur, upplyst av eldkonstnärer, facklor och marschaller. Loppet inkluderar även en barnklass för 7-11 åringar, vilket gör det till en upplevelse för hela familjen. Evenemanget arrangeras av Marathongruppen tillsammans med friidrottsklubbarna Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK, och överskottet går tillbaka till idrotten.
course_highlights: Bana på 5 km med 57% asfalt och 43% grus
Drygt 1 km genom Skansens historiska miljöer, resten runt Djurgården
Banan är upplyst med marschaller, eldkorgar och eldshow
additional: Barnklass 1,3 km för 7-11 år. Minimiålder 13 år för 5 km (11 år i målsmans sällskap) och 15 år för 10 km (13 år i målsmans sällskap). Skansen är hundfri zon. Banan är sanktionerad av Svenska friidrottsförbundet och kontrollmätt av godkänd banmätare. Risk för is på banan, rekommenderas att ha skor anpassade för vinterunderlag. Skansen öppnar för löpare kl. 14:30. Starttider: Barnklass 16:30, 5 km 17:00, 10 km 18:00. Det finns även en barnklass för 7 - 11-åringar. Eventuellt överskott går tillbaka till idrotten.

name: Bieg 3 Jezior
description: Bieg 3 Jezior is a series of races held in Chodzież, comprising three events over 5 km and 10 km distances, taking place by three lakes: Karczewnik, Miejskie and Strzeleckie. The event has an intimate feel, with a limit of 130 participants. Participants can purchase a pass for the entire series, which includes all three races and a commemorative T-shirt. A permanent race number with a timing chip makes participation convenient, without needing to collect a number separately for each event. The race takes place on Sundays at 10:00, making it a great way to spend an active weekend in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Race routes by three lakes: Karczewnik, Miejskie and Strzeleckie
5 km and 10 km distances
Scenic areas of Chodzież
additional: The participant limit is 130. Pass holders receive a permanent race number with a timing chip, used for all three races, so they only need to visit the race office once. In the 2026 edition, the limit was 130 participants; the pass included a commemorative T-shirt and a permanent race number with a chip.

name: IV Cross Smolarza
description: The 4th Cross Smolarza is a cross-country race held in the scenic area around Krzyżowiec. The event takes place on natural forest and off-road trails, offering a challenge for runners who enjoy being close to nature. The participant limit is 170, divided among three categories: two running distances and Nordic walking. Entries are accepted online only until January 23, helping ensure the event is well organized.
course_highlights: Forest and off-road trails in the area around Krzyżowiec
Natural terrain suited to cross-country running
Limit of 70 participants for each running distance and 30 for Nordic walking
additional: The participant limit is 170: 70 for each running distance and 30 for Nordic walking. Entries are accepted online only. The event runs from 11:00 to 16:00. Participants are offered grilled sausage, bread, and tea.

name: IX Cross wokół Małego Giewontu
description: Cross around Mały Giewont is one of the toughest and most beautiful cross-country races in Poland, held in the scenic area of Olsztyn. The route takes runners through challenging terrain, offering them a unique running experience and a chance to connect with nature. The event attracts runners who appreciate tough conditions and beautiful views.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country terrain
Scenic views around Mały Giewont
Natural trails and forest sections

name: Marceliński Bieg Zimowy
description: The Marcelin Winter Run is a trail race in Poznań’s Marcelin Forest, opening a year-round series of runs in the area. Participants can choose a 5 km or 10 km route and run along forest paths. It’s an option for both experienced runners and anyone looking to start the season actively over a shorter distance.
course_highlights: Forest route in Marcelin Forest
Choose between a 5 km or 10 km distance
The race opens a series of events held in the area
additional: In the edition described by the city, the start was at 100 Ptasia Street. The series includes four races, and the medals from the individual events fit together like a puzzle.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdrojska Running League is an annual, friendly, family-oriented running and Nordic walking league held on the scenic routes of the Międzyzdroje Municipality. In the 2026/2027 season, participants compete over distances of approximately 5 and 10 km running, and 5 and 7 km Nordic walking. The league is known for healthy competition and fun, welcoming both regular participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. Participation is free, and the overall standings require taking part in at least four races or walks over the specified distances.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors may take part with written permission from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be included in the league standings, participants must finish at least four events over the required distances. This is a series of events for the 2026/2027 season. Participants must be at least 14; minors need written permission from a parent or guardian and must compete under their supervision. Participation in at least four events is required for the overall standings.

name: Necon Vinterkarusellen Bergen - løp 5
description: Necon Vinterkarusellen in Bergen is a winter running series with eight races, where participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The races start and finish at Fana Stadium, with a start time of 18:45. The series takes place on several Mondays from October to April and offers discounts for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, and free participation is available for members of the athletics groups who pay a training fee.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km race distances
Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Evening races with a start time of 18:45
additional: Discounts are available for IL Gneist members, with different codes for free or reduced entry fees. An annual licence is required for participants over 13 and can be selected during registration. Registration is via individual sign-up in EQ-timing. Participants are responsible for using the correct discount code and paying the correct fee. The series takes place on several Mondays during the winter months. A licence fee of NOK 50 may apply if you do not have an annual licence.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 5 (1. jan)
description: Necon Winter Series is a winter running series comprising 8 races, held on Mondays throughout the winter, with the start and finish at Fana Stadium in Bergen. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances. The races start at 18:45, and discounts are available for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, with options for both annual licence holders and those without a licence.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Choice of 5 km or 10 km distances
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts for IL Gneist members: free for athletics members who pay the main club membership fee and training fee (code Gneist00), 50% off for Gneist trim members (code Gneist50), and 25% off for other Gneist members (code Gneist25). The annual licence must be selected during registration, and a licence fee of NOK 50 applies to those without a licence. Registration is individual via EQ-timing. The annual licence costs NOK 50 if it has not already been paid.

name: Bjørgene løpskarusell - 5. løp
description: Bjørgene Running Series is a long-standing series of races organized by the Athletics Group of Torvastad Sports Club. The 2026/2027 season will be the 19th in the series, with races held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of Bjørgene, Karmøy, and attract many local runners of all ages. The start is usually at 19:00, and the atmosphere is social and inclusive, with biscuits, squash and fruit served after the race.
course_highlights: Races in the scenic surroundings of Bjørgene, Karmøy
Held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March
Race numbers can be collected from 18:00, with the start at 19:00
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 18:00. Biscuits, squash and fruit are served to participants after the race. The running series relies on voluntary efforts by coaches, team leaders and parents to take place.

name: Dalgårdstafetten
description: Dalgårdstafetten is a traditional relay race organised by Byåsen Idrettslag - Ski, held at Nilsbyen Mountain Bike Park in Trondheim. The race takes place on 3 February 2027 and brings runners together on exciting terrain in beautiful surroundings. This relay race offers a challenging and social experience for both participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Trail race in Nilsbyen Mountain Bike Park
Beautiful natural surroundings in Trondheim
Traditional relay race organised by Byåsen IL
additional: The 2027 edition is listed for 3 February at Nilsbyen Mountain Bike Park.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 4. løp
description: Samnanger Winter Series is an inclusive running series organized by Samnanger IL Running Group, held approximately every other Friday at Nesodden. Participants can choose between 2 km and 5 km courses, with the 5 km course officially measured by NFIF. The races are suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and focus on competition, training, and socializing. The event takes place in the evening during the winter darkness, and participants are encouraged to wear reflective vests for safety. Samnanger IL Running Group also offers group training sessions and other running events throughout the year.
course_highlights: Run at Nesodden, with the start and finish in the same place
Choose between 2 km and 5 km courses; the 5 km course is officially measured by NFIF
Races are held approximately every other Friday in the evening during the winter darkness
additional: The running group is informal, free, and open to all levels. Group training sessions are held every Monday at 18:10 in Hagabotnane. Participants are encouraged to wear reflective vests because of the darkness. The races are social and inclusive, with a focus on the joy of running and community. Reflective vests are recommended.

name: BTR Winter 12 km
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sverige
description: Bocksten TrailRun Winter är ett vintertrail som erbjuder löpare en unik möjlighet att uppleva Åkulla bokskogar i vinterskrud. Med distanser på 5, 12 och 24 km bjuder loppet på magiska stigar och en härlig atmosfär i en vacker naturmiljö. Start och mål är vid Öströö Fårfarm, och loppet präglas av gemenskap, engagemang och respekt för naturen. Endast 600 exklusiva startplatser finns tillgängliga, vilket gör evenemanget till en intim och speciell upplevelse för trailentusiaster.
course_highlights: Vintertrail i Åkulla bokskogar
Start och mål vid Öströö Fårfarm
Magisk naturupplevelse med vinterskrud
additional: Totalt 600 startplatser fördelade på 5 km (150 platser), 12 km (300 platser) och 24 km (150 platser). Obligatoriskt att hjälpa andra löpare vid behov. Startlistan finns tillgänglig online. Försäkring Startklar och Startklar Plus erbjuds för återbetalning vid sjukdom eller skada. Trafikregler gäller vid vägkorsningar. Skräpning leder till diskvalificering. Vid akut hjälp ring 076-8159678 eller 112. Starten går kl. 10.00 från Öströö Fårfarm. En vätskestation med energi finns längs banan. Sista anmälningsdag är 2 februari 2027.

name: Vintermossa (Mossaloppet)
description: Vintermossa är en vinterupplaga av Mossarun, ett terränglopp som bjuder på en utmanande och teknisk 21 km lång slinga med över 600 höjdmeter. Loppet är självstyrt och obemannat, vilket innebär att deltagarna navigerar med hjälp av en GPX-fil utan märkning på stigen. Under loppet finns en stor brasa som är tänd hela tiden för att värma kalla löpare, och möjlighet att grilla egen mat. Skidor är tillåtna vid tillräckligt med snö, vilket gör det möjligt att kombinera löpning och skidåkning på slingan.
course_highlights: 21 km lång slinga med 600+ höjdmeter
Teknisk och kuperad terräng med högkvalitativa stigar
Obemannat lopp med själv-navigation via GPX-fil
additional: Loppet är ett unsupported race utan tidtagning eller kontrollstationer. Ingen maxtid finns. Obligatorisk utrustning är nödfilt och pannlampa. Det finns en stor brasa som är tänd hela tiden för att värma sig mellan varven. Deltagare kan välja att springa en eller flera varv. Deltagarna uppmanas att swisha valfri summa till War Child eller annan valfri organisation som stöd. uppgiften är inte bekräftad på Mossaruns resultatsida.

name: Sormlands Winter Trail
location: Nävekvarns IP, Nävekvarn, Nyköping Municipality, Sverige
description: Sörmlands Winter Trail är ett vinterlopp som erbjuder tre distanser: 43 km, 22 km och 10 km, alla med start och mål vid Nävekvarns IP i Nävekvarn. Loppen går genom varierad terräng med skogsstigar, kuperade landskap och vackra kustnära partier, vilket ger en utmanande och naturskön upplevelse. Loppet är utrustat med elektronisk tidtagning och flera vätskestationer med mat och dryck längs banan. Efter målgång serveras varm mat och alkoholfri återhämtningsöl till alla deltagare. Säkerheten prioriteras med obligatorisk utrustning och tillgång till dusch och omklädningsrum vid starten.
course_highlights: Varierad terräng med skogsstigar, kuperade backar och kustnära stigar
Flera vätskestationer med mat, varma drycker och Umara Energy
Elektronisk chip-tidtagning och tydliga cut-off tider för varje distans
additional: Starttider: 43 km kl 09:00, 22 km kl 10:00, 10 km kl 11:00. Max cut-off tider: 8 timmar för 43 km, 5 timmar för 22 km, 2 timmar för 10 km. Obligatorisk utrustning inkluderar bland annat mobiltelefon, vindtät jacka, termisk underställ, mössa, handskar, vattenflaska (minst 500 ml), visselpipa, överlevnadsfilt och pannlampa vid mörkerkörning. Duschar, omklädningsrum och toaletter finns vid Nävekvarns IP. Parkering finns mot avgift vid start/mål-området. Efter loppet serveras varm mat och alkoholfri Mineral Brewing Recovery Lager till löparna. Distanserna är 10, 22 och 43 km. Nummerlappar hämtas vid startområdet på Nävekvarns IP. Vätskestationer erbjuder mat och varma drycker, och varm mat serveras vid målgång. Obligatorisk utrustning omfattar bland annat laddad telefon, vindjacka, vatten och trailskor med bra grepp. Parkering finns mot en mindre avgift.

description: Grimstadvatnet Rundt is a 7.8 km road race that is part of the Hareid Winter Series, which consists of four races held on the first Saturday in November, December, January and February. The course is mostly on asphalt and relatively flat, making the race accessible to many runners. The first race in the series was held in 1981, and prizes are awarded after the final race in February to participants who have taken part in at least three of the four races. The event is a cherished tradition and brings together runners of all ages at the Hareid clubhouse.
course_highlights: 7.8 km road race
The course is mostly on asphalt
Relatively flat course
additional: Registration takes place at the Hareid clubhouse from 13:00 on race day. Changing facilities are available at the clubhouse. A one-time licence from the Norwegian Athletics Federation is required for races outside a track if you do not have an annual licence. Prizes are awarded after the four-race series, using a points system based on the three best races, with bonus points for participating in all four. The race starts at 14:00, with registration from 13:00 at the Hareid clubhouse. Changing rooms are available at the clubhouse. Overall prizes are awarded after the fourth race; participants must complete at least three of the four races to qualify for a prize.

description: Winterrun Bergen is the big winter running festival in Bergen city centre, taking place on Saturday, 6 February 2027. The race offers a unique atmosphere with fire baskets, torches and music along the course, and participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances. All participants receive a medal and a drink at the finish, and the race is known for its great atmosphere and fantastic prizes. Race numbers can be collected in advance at Løplabbet Bergen or in the start area on race day.
course_highlights: Run in Bergen city centre in an atmospheric winter setting
Fire baskets, torches and music along the course
Everyone receives a medal and Vitamin Well at the finish
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Løplabbet Bergen, Strandkaien 6, from 4 to 6 February, 10:00–19:00, or in the start area from 2 hours before the start. Start waves are approximately 45 seconds apart, with pacers from 4:00 to 6:30 min/km. Outdoor baggage storage is available; bring your own baggage tag. There are no shower or changing facilities in the start and finish area. Public transport is recommended due to limited parking. Start time: 18:00. Participants are encouraged to wear luminous costumes.

name: Teivocup IV 2027
description: Teivocup IV 2027 is a six-part series of training races and test runs held once a month from November to April. The event’s fourth race takes place on February 6 at Lamminpää Outdoor Recreation Lodge in Ylöjärvi. The series offers several distances for different age groups and divisions, and the route follows a pedestrian and cycle path near the Teivo Race Centre junction. Registration is on site by 11:30, and the start is at 12:00. The top runners will be awarded prizes.
course_highlights: The route follows a pedestrian and cycle path
Start and finish at the Teivo Race Centre junction
Several distances for different age groups and divisions (5 km and 2 km)
additional: Registration is on site at Lamminpää Outdoor Recreation Lodge by 11:30. The distances are 5 km (M/M40/M50/N/N40/N50) and 2 km (P/T 09/11/13). With several competition classes, the event offers an opportunity to take part in winter running in Finnish nature.

Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Gór...

description: The Grand Prix of Dziewicza Góra Mountain Running is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and environmental protection. The course follows forest paths around Dziewicza Góra, the park’s highest hill, offering challenging climbs and scenic views. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic walking event, and children’s races over shorter distances. The organizers foster a welcoming sporting atmosphere that brings participants and families together.
course_highlights: A fully forested 5.15 km loop
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The course passes through the event center, where spectators can cheer on runners
additional: Children’s races are held over 200m, 500m, 1000m, and 1500m. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participants in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. After emerging from the forest at the finish, runners head to the left or right side of the balloon marked “Finish,” depending on their race distance. The participant limit is 500. People who have purchased a pass for the entire series are automatically added to the start list.

name: Trail!ON Stawiguda #3
