name: Backyard Ultra Ålesund
description: Backyard Ultra Ålesund is a unique ultrarunning event organized in collaboration with SIF/Hessa IL, where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour. The race challenges endurance and willpower, continuing for as long as runners can complete a loop within 60 minutes. The start and finish are at Skarbøvik Stadium, and the course offers beautiful views around Sukkertoppen. Participants have access to base areas for resting and refueling between loops, with facilities including tent pitches, toilets and basic refreshments.
course_highlights: The 6.7 km course runs around Sukkertoppen, starting and finishing at Skarbøvik Stadium
Each loop starts on the hour and must be completed within 60 minutes
The base area offers places to rest, eat, drink and warm up at SIF-huset
additional: The maximum number of loops is 12, with a maximum distance of 80.5 km. Details about race number distribution and parking times will be announced later. Toilets and changing rooms with showers are available in the changing-room building, as well as five toilets in SIF-huset. Basic refreshments including cordial, cola, bananas, chips and sweets will be available from 10:30. Participants are encouraged to bring their own food and drinks. Parking opens at 08:45, and participants can set up a tent or use a car or motorhome as a base in the area around the start/finish.

name: Bergen 5000 Challenge
price_range: 5000 meter: 250 kr; 1000 meter kids: 100 kr; 300 meter mini: gratis
description: Bergen 5000 Challenge is a fast and social 5,000-metre race held at Fana Stadium in Bergen. The race consists of 12.5 laps on a track with no uphill sections, and is suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. There are several heats with pacers for different finish times, as well as children’s races for the youngest participants. Admission is free for spectators, and all participants receive a medal.
course_highlights: 12.5 laps at Fana Stadium with no uphill sections
Pacers in several heats for different finish times
Approved road race results with EQ timing
additional: Race bibs can be collected in the gym at Fana Stadium on race day. The recreational race is classified as a road race with approved results. Children’s races for ages 3–6 and 6–12.

name: Haugesund Backyard Ultra
description: Welcome to Haugesund Backyard Ultra 2027, a unique and social ultrarunning event held at Haraldsvang Arena in Haugesund. The race is not about running the fastest, but about lasting as long as possible, with a new lap of approximately 6.7 km starting every hour on the hour. Participants can rest between laps if they finish within the hour, and the winner is decided after the final lap. With new, modern facilities at Haraldsvang Arena, the experience will be even better for both runners and supporters.
course_highlights: The course is easy to run and gently rolling, with a mix of asphalt and gravel
Start and finish outside the new Haraldsvang Arena
Each lap is approximately 6.7 km and starts every hour on the hour
additional: All participants start at the same time. You must be ready at the starting line for each new start. There are improved facilities and more social gathering areas around the arena compared with previous years. The race sold out in 2026, so early registration is recommended. Participants can stop whenever they wish. Registering early gives you a lower price.

name: Bislett Distanseserie s3r4 - 3000m 2027
description: Bislett Distance Series is an accessible monthly running series held at the historic Bislett Stadium in Oslo. The races offer excellent conditions and a great atmosphere, with the opportunity to run alongside others at your level. Participants receive nuts, bars and sports drink, and pacers are often available to help you reach your goals. It’s a great way to kick-start the indoor running season.
course_highlights: Run at Bislett Stadium, a classic venue in Oslo
An accessible and inclusive running series
The opportunity to run with pacers at different times
additional: Registered participants receive nuts, bars and sports drink from Maxim. The races are held indoors at Bislett Stadium, with entrance at 1 Louises gate, 0168 Oslo.

name: Nidaros Vinterkarusell: Løp 4 / Trønderjogg
description: Nidaros Vinterkarusell and Trønderjogg are long-standing running events in Trondheim, organized by Strindheim IL Friidrett. The races offer distances for all levels, from children’s races to a 10 km road race, creating an inclusive and social running experience. Trønderjogg marks the start of the running season with a great atmosphere at Trondheim Stadium, while the winter series provides regular running goals throughout the winter. The club has a long history and a strong community for both recreational and elite runners.
course_highlights: Trønderjogg: 5 km and 10 km road races at Trondheim Stadium
Nidaros Vinterkarusell: Races at Ranheimshallen, including a 3,000 m race and children’s races
Obstacle course for children aged 6 and under during Trønderjogg
additional: Trønderjogg starts at 18:00 at Trondheim Stadium. There is an obstacle course for children aged 6 and under, with a prize for everyone. Registration before the start is from 17:30. Nidaros Vinterkarusell races are held at Ranheimshallen, with timing via EQTiming, but times are not approved for records or annual statistics. Prizes go to the 3 fastest women and men in the 5 km and 10 km races at Trønderjogg. There are many prize draws among all participants.

name: Trønderjogg / Nidaros Vinterkarusell: Løp 4
description: Nidaros Vinterkarusell is a winter running series in Trondheim for all ages, from children to adults. The series consists of four races throughout the winter, with the option to enter individual races or the entire series. Trønderjogg, the fourth race in the series, is held at Trondheim Stadium and features road races over 5 and 10 km. Taking part in the entire series gives runners the chance to win draw prizes at the season finale, providing extra motivation and a sense of community.
course_highlights: 5 and 10 km road races at Trondheim Stadium
Obstacle course for little ones aged 6 and under, with a prize for everyone
Races for all ages and abilities, from children to adults
additional: Registration for individual races is through EQ Timing. Obstacle course for children aged 6 and under, with a prize for everyone. Registration for the obstacle course takes place before the start, from 17:30. Timing is provided by EQTiming, but times are not approved for records or annual statistics. WODira lists Klostergata 86, 7030 Trondheim, as the address and has a registration button.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 5/5
description: The Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland’s largest and fastest winter running series, consisting of five events in Hakunila and Tikkurila, Vantaa. The races offer accessible road-running competitions, with the option to enter using a series pass or by paying for a single race. The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School, which also serves as the event centre. At the final event, the top runners in each category are awarded prizes based on points, and runners are also encouraged with bonuses for course records. The event is open to runners of all levels and also includes a running school with coaching.
course_highlights: The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School in Vantaa
Sotunki Upper Secondary School serves as the event centre, with changing rooms and showers
Sports drinks are available at the finish area, along with a café
additional: A series pass lets you take part in all five events without registering separately. Race numbers are collected from the race office and returned after each race. Prizes are awarded based on points after the final event, and runners must take part in at least two events to qualify for overall prizes. The running school offers coaching and training sessions, and members can participate in the road-running cup for free by claiming a pass in advance. The event is held in Tikkurila, Vantaa, and includes several races, such as the 5K and 10K. These popular local events offer accessible road-running races.

name: BYU Lūša pēdās Jēkabpilī
description: BYU In the Footsteps of the Lynx in Jēkabpils is a unique running event where participants compete by running a set distance every hour until only one finisher remains. The race is physically and mentally challenging, attracting both local and international runners. The event is well organized, with precise timing and a friendly atmosphere that fosters sportsmanship and a sense of community. The participant list reflects a broad range of runners from Latvia and neighboring countries.
course_highlights: Run a set distance every hour until only one finisher remains
The race takes place in Jēkabpils, with precise timing using RFID equipment
The event attracts both local and international participants
additional: Timing with RFID equipment ensures accurate recording of results. The participant list is available online, and registration takes place online. The race is part of a wider range of events organized by RaceTiming.LV.

name: Aizkraukles novada 12. pusmaratons
description: The 12th Aizkraukle Municipality Half Marathon is a traditional running event offering a half-marathon distance and a popular run. The race takes place in Aizkraukle and brings together runners of all levels, with children’s races also on offer. The event is suitable for athletes and families looking to spend time actively outdoors and enjoy running.
course_highlights: Half-marathon distance: 21.097 km
Popular run: 5.3 km with a slight elevation gain (300 m)
Children’s races: 500 m and 1,000 m
additional: The event offers a variety of races, including children’s distances, making it suitable for families. Registration takes place online at sportlat.lv, where participants can create a profile and access personalized options.

name: Rudes Maratons un Kultūras festivāls
location: Rude, Rojas pagasts, Talsi Municipality, Latvia
description: The Rudes Marathon and Culture Festival offers a running route around Rude that is relatively flat and approximately 1.8 km long. This loop follows roads, providing an easy and accessible distance for both beginners and experienced runners. The event combines sporting activities with the atmosphere of a cultural festival, creating a friendly, community-focused environment.
course_highlights: Relatively flat loop
The route follows roads
Approximately 1.8 km long
additional: The route profile and elevation data are available for download. The route is also suitable for hiking and is easy to access using various route-planning and navigation options with plotaroute.com tools.

name: II Półmaraton Karolewo - Pruszcz
description: The 2nd Karolewo–Pruszcz Half Marathon is a certified 21.0975 km race taking place on 17 April 2027. The course is entirely paved, flat and marked every kilometre, making it conducive to good results. The race office is open on race day, and participants receive race packs containing, among other things, a bib, a timing chip, a T-shirt and a voucher for a recovery meal. The event is organised by the Agro-Economic School Complex in Karolewo, and timing is provided by STS-Timing.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course
Entirely paved and flat
Course marked every 1 kilometre
additional: The race office is open on race day from 8:30 to 16:00. Race packs contain a bib, a timing chip, safety pins, a voucher for a recovery meal, running memorabilia and a T-shirt. Participants should indicate their T-shirt size in the registration form. Unclaimed race packs will not be mailed or made available at a later date.

name: III Mistrzostwa Polski Masters
organizer: Koszalińskie Towarzystwo Krzewienia Kultury Fizycznej i Polski Związek Lekkiej Atletyki Masters
description: The 3rd Polish Masters Championships is a race organized by the Koszalin Society for the Promotion of Physical Culture, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place on Góra Chełmska in Koszalin and is aimed at masters-category runners. It has a recreational and sporting character, with chip timing and overall classifications for women and men. The organizer provides third-party liability insurance, and participants can expect official award ceremonies.
course_highlights: A race on the natural terrain of Góra Chełmska
Chip timing using returnable chips attached to footwear
Overall classifications for women and men, with trophies for places 1–3
additional: No license was required for the 2026 edition.

name: Nocna Piątka po Głogowskiej Starówce
description: Nocna Piątka po Głogowskiej Starówce is an annual road race held in the picturesque Old Town of Głogów. The 5 km course winds through the charming streets of the Old Town, offering participants a unique nighttime running atmosphere. The event is organized by Klub Sportowy ZG RUN and attracts many local runners. It is a great opportunity for sporting competition and an active day out in the heart of the city.
course_highlights: The course passes through the historic Old Town of Głogów
The race takes place in the evening, creating a unique atmosphere
The course is 5 km long, ideal for runners of different ability levels
additional: Participants can purchase a race pack from another runner through the race-pack exchange. Organizer: Klub Sportowy ZG RUN. Start and finish location: Bulwar Nadodrzański/Zespół Szkół Ekonomicznych w Głogowie. The program also includes children's races.

name: Pobiegnij z Siódemką
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Siódemka, Niepubliczna Szkoła Podstawowa nr 7 im. Marii Skłodowskiej-Curie w Słupsku i Słupski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji
description: Pobiegnij z Siódemką is a charity cross-country run organized by the Maria Skłodowska-Curie Non-Public Primary School No. 7 in Słupsk. The event is held to support the treatment and rehabilitation of a child with a cleft palate, and taking part in the run is a real way to help Mateusz and his family. The run is community-focused and inclusive, combining sport with charitable activities. This is the fourth edition of the event, which enjoys strong support from the local community and sponsors.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in Słupsk
Charity event supporting a child’s treatment
Organized by a local primary school
additional: The run is a charity event supporting Mateusz, who has a cleft palate. In previous editions, funds were raised and transferred to the Siepomaga foundation’s account. The event is supported by local sponsors and donors. The organizers thank everyone for their support and emphasize the importance of every step in the run. Proceeds from an earlier edition were donated to support Mateusz; one edition raised PLN 7,014.

name: Pop up Run Kinnekulle

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 300 kr, picknick på Öströö Fårfarm Café ingår

description: Pop up Run Kinnekulle är ett trailrunningäventyr som tar dig ut i spännande natur och nya upplevelser. Loppet bjuder på en sagolik löptur genom bokskogar, förbi små sjöar och historiska platser som Bexells talande stenar. Efter löpningen väntar en lokalproducerad picknick som avrundning. Evenemanget är öppet för olika fartgrupper och rekommenderar samåkning för deltagarna.
course_highlights: Löpning genom bokskogar i Kinnekulle
Passerar små mysiga sjöar och Bexells talande stenar
Avslutas med picknick på lokalproducerad gård
additional: Samling sker kl 10:00 vid Öströö Fårfarm. Distansen är cirka 15-17 km med 2-3 olika fartgrupper. Picknick på Öströö Fårfarm Café ingår i priset. Rekommenderad samåkning och hjälp med samordning erbjuds. Evenemanget är utformat för att erbjuda en gemenskaplig och naturnära löpupplevelse med fokus på natur, utsikt och lokal mat.

name: Vårruset (Stockholm)
description: Vårruset i Stockholm är ett motionslopp för kvinnor som erbjuder distanserna 2,5 km och 5 km i Norra Djurgården. Loppet präglas av rörelseglädje och gemenskap och välkomnar alla oavsett träningsbakgrund eller ambitionsnivå. Det är möjligt att anmäla sig individuellt eller i lag, där lag anmälda får en picknick efter målgång. Evenemanget är en del av en lång tradition sedan 1989 och syftar till att främja kvinnors hälsa och skapa en inkluderande miljö för alla deltagare.
course_highlights: Kontrollmätt 5 km-bana i Norra Djurgården
Start och mål vid Frescatiängen nära Stockholms universitet
Loppet går på grus- och skogsstigar i naturskön miljö
additional: Nummerlappar skickas ut per post vid anmälan före 17 april, annars hämtas de på plats. Lag om fem personer får picknick efter målgång. Omklädningsrum och dusch finns mot självkostnad. Rekommenderad ålder är 13 år för 5 km och 11 år för 2,5 km, yngre i vuxens sällskap. Det går att välja bort tidtagning i anmälan. Evenemangsområdet nås lättast till fots, med cykel eller kollektivtrafik. Parkering är begränsad och rekommenderas ej. Evenemanget är en del av Sveriges största motionsturné för tjejer och fokuserar på gemenskap och hälsa.

name: Baksjøløpet
description: Baksjøløpet is a traditional race that has been held since 1981 in Åbogen, Eidskog. The main course is 11.3 km and runs partly on gravel and asphalt, starting and finishing in Åbogen. There is also an alternative shorter route of approximately 6.5 km for those walking without timekeeping. The race attracts both competitive runners and recreational participants, and it is a social event with shower and changing facilities available.
course_highlights: Main course of 11.3 km on gravel and asphalt roads
Alternative route of approximately 6.5 km for recreational walkers without timekeeping
Refreshment stations along the route at approximately 4 km and 6 km
additional: Registration is available until 10 minutes before the start on race day, with an increased entry fee. Race bibs can be collected at the stand the day before the race. Everyone who finishes and pays the regular fee receives an annual prize. Gift prizes are drawn by race bib number, and trophies are awarded to the best woman and man, as well as a prize to the team with the most participants. The race is a member of Norges Turmarsjforbund and offers IVV stamping for a small fee.

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, 5'ern vår!

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dagsbillett SOLO Deltakere kr 475,00 kr 332,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

description: Our 5K! is the first race in Oslo Running Festival and offers a fast, flat 5-kilometer course along the beautiful Oslofjord, from Frognerkilen to Bygdøylokket. You can complete the race at any time between April 9 and 18, or join the group start on Sunday, April 18 at 11:00, with pacers, music, and a great atmosphere. This race is a great way to kick off the running season in Oslo and is suitable for anyone looking to test their fitness on a fast, enjoyable course.
course_highlights: Fast, flat 5 km course along the Oslofjord
The course runs from Frognerkilen to Bygdøylokket
Option to join the group start with pacers and music
additional: Race bibs can be collected from Löplabbet Oslo sentrum from April 7. The same bib is used throughout the series. A new bib can be purchased for 75 kr. The courses are marked only for the group start. GPX files and course maps are available to download. The race can be completed at any time between April 9 and 18, 2027. Registration is offered as SOLO, DUO, and TRIO tickets; listed prices vary by ticket type and purchase date.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a race in Eidsvoll starting at Ås school, Hammerås, offering a simple and efficient race format for achieving fast times. The race takes place on a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop, where runners can leave their own bottles and gels on their personal nutrition table, which they pass each lap. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. The race is known for producing many personal records and has a friendly atmosphere, with the option to ring the bell when setting a personal record.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Your own nutrition table, passed each lap
Free parking, changing rooms and toilets at the venue
additional: Race bibs are collected via self-service at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available inside the school. At selected races, ninth-grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan split times. The weather forecast is updated four times daily using satellite data for the area around Ås school. Race bibs can be collected via self-service at the school from approximately two hours before the start. Changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Registration is via RaceDays.

name: Baroniløpet
description: Baroniløpet is organized annually by Rosendal Turnlag and takes place in beautiful surroundings at Baroniet Rosendal in Kvinnherad. The race is part of the Kvinnherad cross-country running series and attracts both local and visiting runners looking for a challenging race in scenic surroundings. The terrain offers varied surfaces and beautiful nature, making the race a popular event for both recreational and competitive runners. The event has a long tradition and is well integrated into the local community.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in scenic surroundings at Baroniet Rosendal
Varied surfaces, including trails and wooded sections
Part of the Kvinnherad cross-country running series

name: Neskollen Backyard Ultra
description: Neskollen Backyard is a unique ultrarunning event held at Nes Arena in Neskollen. The race follows the classic backyard format, with a new start every hour on the hour. Participants must complete a 6.706 km loop within 60 minutes to continue. They can run up to 12 loops in total, equivalent to approximately 80.5 km. The race is a demanding test of both mental and physical strength, suitable for experienced ultrarunners and those looking to push their limits. Food and drink are provided during the event, and prizes are awarded to participants.
course_highlights: Relatively flat course around Nes Arena
Start and finish inside Nes Arena, with a short break between loops
A total of 12 loops of 6.706 km each, approximately 80.5 km for those who complete them
additional: A new start takes place every hour on the hour, with a maximum of 12 loops. Participants can take a break inside Nes Arena between loops to eat, rest and prepare. Pizza, cakes, drinks and potato chips are served during the event. Prizes are awarded. The maximum is 12 loops, equivalent to approximately 80.5 kilometres.

name: Skjold på tvers
description: Skjold på Tvers is a mountain marathon and the most beautiful spring adventure in Vindafjord, Rogaland. The race offers several route options, including the full Skjold på Tvers, with 7 peaks over approximately 21.2 km, as well as shorter options such as HalvTversen and a family route. Participants are transported from Skjold Arena to the start, and chip timing and prize money are offered in the elite class. The event combines challenging terrain with beautiful scenery and is suitable for both fit runners and families.
course_highlights: The full Skjold på Tvers, with 7 peaks, approximately 21.2 km
HalvTversen, with 4 peaks (11.4 km) or 3 peaks (9.6 km)
Family route at Vikaneset, with a trail and an alternative for strollers/wheelchairs
additional: You can also register on the day via EQ Timing at Skjold Arena, but advance registration is recommended. Bus transport from Skjold Arena to the start at Hodnafjellet is included in the price. It is possible to walk half the route, with a bus to or from Dalavik. Participants receive a T-shirt, fruit and drinks at designated stations. The elite class has a mass start at 13:00, with timing and prize money. The route page has a UT.no map and GPX file. The main route runs from Hodnafjellet to Skjold Arena.

name: Perseløpet
description: Perseløpet is a simple and effective running event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, designed to help runners achieve fast times. The race takes place on a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop, with the option to set up your own nutrition table, passed on every lap. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, and the event has a friendly atmosphere where runners can celebrate personal records by ringing the bell at the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Option to set up your own nutrition table along the course
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km
additional: Race bibs are collected self-service at Ås school from around two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Runners can set out their own bottles and gels on the nutrition table before the start. An official aid station staffed by 9th grade students from Feiring school is available at selected races. Timing and a lap-time calculator are available for planning. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area. Race bibs are collected self-service at the school from around two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Registration and current prices are available via RaceDays.

name: 8. Gdańsk Maraton
description: Energa Gdańsk Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The marathon route passes some of the city’s most distinctive landmarks, including the European Solidarity Centre, the retractable footbridge to Ołowianka Island, the Baltic Philharmonic, the Neptune’s Fountain, the Gdańsk Shakespeare Theatre, and ERGO Arena. The start and finish are at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The event uses staggered start waves, and participants can expect a full race pack and extensive support along the course.
course_highlights: The route passes the European Solidarity Centre and the retractable footbridge to Ołowianka Island
Views of the Baltic Philharmonic, Neptune’s Fountain, and the Gdańsk Shakespeare Theatre
The start and finish are at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, with a visit to ERGO Arena
additional: The marathon starts in waves. The start line will close 5 minutes after the final starting signal. Holders of a Gdańsk resident card receive a 10% discount on the entry fee. The race pack includes a bib with a chip, a medal, medical support, course refreshment stations, a hot meal at the finish, and gifts from sponsors. The official marathon T-shirt and backpack are available for purchase. The event is scheduled for 24–25 April 2027; the website lists the marathon, a 5 km race, a relay, and the Junior Marathon. Entry fee details are not provided in the available sources.

name: Bydgoski Bieg Urodzinowy
description: The Bydgoszcz Birthday Run is an annual running event held in Bydgoszcz, taking place on April 18, 2027. The race starts at 11:00. The participant limit is 1,500, and the first 1,300 people to register will receive a T-shirt. The route will be announced soon, and the event attracts runners of different age groups and experience levels.
additional: A T-shirt is available to the first 1,300 people to register. A T-shirt is provided for the first 1,300 registered participants.

name: Poznań Półmaraton
location: ul. Roosevelta near Międzynarodowe Targi Poznańskie, Poznań, Poland
description: The PKO Poznań Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Poznań, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half-marathon course runs through the city streets, offering a unique sporting experience and an opportunity to test your fitness. The organizers ensure the event has a family-friendly atmosphere, also offering an activity zone and races for children and young people. The event is well organized and enjoys considerable prestige in the running community.
course_highlights: Start on Roosevelta Street, near the Poznań International Fair
Course through the streets of Łazarz and Grunwald
The race also passes through Junikowo and Ławica
additional: Registration for the 19th PKO Poznań Half Marathon will open in December. The regulations and price list are being finalized and will be announced soon. The organizers are providing an activity zone and races for children and young people as accompanying events. The course and program are in preparation, and participants are encouraged to follow the official information channels. Registration for the 2027 edition is expected to open in December; the entry form is being prepared.

name: XVIII Bieg Piaśnicki
organizer: Gmina Wejherowo i The North Event
description: The Piaśnica Run commemorates the victims of the German occupation of Poland during World War II. The running and Nordic walking routes pass through places where thousands of innocent people were murdered. The event aims to honor the victims, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring the local community together. It also features cultural events, such as exhibitions, lectures, and concerts, that introduce the history of Gdańsk Pomerania.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking routes through historic sites of wartime atrocities
Commemoration of the victims of the German occupation of Poland
Cultural events: exhibitions, lectures, concerts, and meetings with historians
additional: The event includes running races and Nordic walking. It promotes a healthy lifestyle and community integration. The event is commemorative and educational. Previous editions have also included races for children and young people.

name: Bronek Run Forest Edition
description: Bronek Run - Forest Edition is the fifth-anniversary edition of the race, held in the picturesque Grudziądz Municipal Forest. It’s an event for running enthusiasts who enjoy being surrounded by nature, with soft forest trails, natural climbs, and the peaceful atmosphere of the woods. The 10 km race is part of the Grand Prix of the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, and special Bronek Run Kids - Forest Edition races have been prepared for the youngest participants. Participants can look forward to a special forest-themed medal and forest-themed socks in the race pack, as well as an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: Picturesque routes through the Grudziądz Municipal Forest
Natural climbs and the peaceful atmosphere of the woods
Soft forest trails
additional: A race for children and adults. The race pack includes forest-themed socks, and participants receive a medal inspired by the race’s forest setting.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten är en stafett med start, växling och mål i Folkparken i Norrköping där lag om fyra deltagare springer en fartfylld fyrakilometerssträcka var. Loppet erbjuder en härlig lagkänsla med herr-, dam- och mixedlag, med eller utan tidtagning. Bansträckningen är nära tävlingscentrum med peppmusik längs banan och publikstöd vid växlingar och mål. Det är en kväll fylld av motion, gemenskap och glädje, där barn och ungdomar kan delta gratis tack vare HSB.
course_highlights: Start, växling och mål i Folkparken i Norrköping
Varje lagmedlem springer 4 km på en fartfylld bana nära tävlingscentrum
Peppmusik längs banan och publikstöd vid växlingar och mål
additional: Benmassage erbjuds av Helhetshälsan både innan start och efter målgång. Alla deltagare får medalj sponsrad av Azets. Prestationspris till första lag i varje klass och fina priser lottas ut bland alla deltagande lag. ICA Smedby bjuder deltagarna på energifyllda produkter efter målgång. Loppet är i Folkparken, med möjlighet till efteranmälan på plats, och deltagare kan anmäla sig via hemsidan eller på tävlingsdagen. Deltagare får energifyllda produkter efter loppet.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset i Västerås är ett motionslopp för kvinnor som erbjuder distanserna 2,5 km och 5 km genom centrala Västerås med start och mål vid Lögastrand. Loppet präglas av rörelseglädje och gemenskap och välkomnar alla oavsett träningsbakgrund eller ambitionsnivå. Anmälan kan göras individuellt eller som lag, där lag anmälda får en picknick efter målgång. Evenemanget är en del av en lång tradition sedan 1989 och syftar till att främja kvinnors hälsa och skapa en inkluderande miljö för motion och samvaro.
course_highlights: Kontrollmätt 5 km-bana genom centrala Västerås
Start och mål vid Lögastrand
Picknick efter målgång för lag om 5 personer
additional: Nummerlappsutdelning sker på Intersport i Livli shoppingcenter Erikslund dagarna före loppet. Det finns övervakad väskinlämning, vattenstation och toaletter på evenemangsområdet. Picknickuthämtning sker med lagledarens nummerlapp. Rekommenderad ålder är 13 år för 5 km och 11 år för 2,5 km, yngre i vuxens sällskap. Det går att välja bort tidtagning i anmälan. Träningsträffar anordnas i flera orter inför loppet. Deltagarna får nummerlapp, målpåse och medalj; lag om 5 personer; öppet för löpare, joggare och promenad; anmälan via webben; evenemanget är en del av den nationella Vårruset-serien.

name: Stallbackamilen 2026
organizer: Trollhättans IF Friidrott och Vänersborgs AIK
description: Stallbackamilen i Trollhättan är ett snabbt 10 km-lopp som hade premiär. Banan är kontrollmätt och går på snabba cykelbanor runt Stallbacka, med en slinga på 3,3 km som springes tre varv. Start och mål är placerade bredvid tennishallen. Loppet arrangeras av Vänersborgs AIK och Trollhättans IF Friidrott och erbjuder farthållare från 35 till 60 minuter för att hjälpa löpare i olika tempo.
course_highlights: Kontrollmätt 10 km bana på snabba cykelbanor
Slinga på 3,3 km som springes tre varv
Start och mål vid tennishallen i Trollhättan
additional: Farthållare erbjuds från 35 till 60 minuter efter behov. Möjlighet att samtidigt anmäla sig till Digitala Varvetmilen för seedning till Göteborgsvarvet. Start och mål är bredvid tennishallen i Trollhättan. Farthållare erbjuds för sluttider från 35 till 60 minuter.

name: Stomperudkarusellen - løp nr 1
price_range: Enkeltløp i 2026: 110–220 kr, med lisens på 20–30 kr i tillegg
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a long-running race series organized by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races with varying distances from 800 meters to 9 kilometers, including shorter options for the youngest participants. The races take place in scenic surroundings around Sørum school and Stomperud Stadium, and the same race number is used throughout the series. This makes it easy and enjoyable for children, young people, and adults to take part in several races during the season.
course_highlights: Bingenrunden 5 km with a shorter option
Aasgaardsrunden 9 km with a shorter option
Lysløypa 6 km with a shorter option
additional: Participants use the same race number in all races in the series. Children who are members of Sørum IL can participate for free if they register at least one week before race day. The races are held in the evening and start at 19:00. Shorter options are available for the youngest participants at every race. The prices are listed for 2026 and may change before the 2027 edition. The same race number is used in all races in the series.

name: Stomperudkarusellen 2027. Bare løp 1 (Bingenrunden)
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a long-standing running series organized by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races over varying distances. The first race, Bingenrunden, is 5 km, with a shorter option for the youngest participants. The races take place on varied surfaces and offer a nice combination of road and trail, with the start and finish at Sørum School and Stomperud Stadium. Participants use the same bib number throughout the series, and the event is open to both adults and children. Children who are members of Sørum IL can participate for free when they register.
course_highlights: Bingenrunden: 5 km, with a shorter option for children
The races take place on roads and trails in the Sørum area
Start and finish at Sørum School and Stomperud Stadium
additional: Participants use the same bib number for all races in the series. Children who are members of Sørum IL can participate for free if they register no later than one week before race day. Shorter options are available for the youngest participants in all races.

name: Kolmården Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical är ett utmanande trail-lopp på 5 km med 300 höjdmeter i vacker och teknisk terräng vid Hults Bruk i Kolmården. Banan bjuder på fina stigar och tekniska partier där starka ben och snabba fötter är en fördel. Starten sker vid den gamla fotbollsplanen och loppet innehåller bland annat branta backar, singeltrack och natursköna vyer över Ågelsjön. Välkommen att delta i detta smått klassiska lopp som erbjuder en rejäl utmaning för trailentusiaster.
course_highlights: 5 km med 300 höjdmeter i utmanande terräng
Tekniska partier med singeltrack och branta backar
Vacker utsikt över Ågelsjön och passage förbi eremitens Jakobs grotta
additional: Starten går vid den gamla fotbollsplanen vid Hults Bruk. Priser delas ut till de tre främsta i varje klass samt utlottade priser. Bollplan finns 200 meter från parkeringen. Avbeställnings- och olycksfallsförsäkring erbjuds som tillägg. Banans tekniska partier inkluderar "Koklämman" med rep för hjälp uppför, och loppet passerar en mysig grillplats under ett stort klippöverhäng. Terränglöpning, tekniska partier, start vid Hults Bruk, banbeskrivning inkluderar backar och stigpartier.

name: Ørsta Gateløp
location: Ripateigane, Ørsta, Møre og Romsdal, Norway
description: Ørsta Street Race is a relaxed and fun street race held in Ripateigane, between Ørsta ungdomsskule and Øyehaug AS. The race marks the start of the athletics season for children and young people in Ørsta IL’s athletics group, and is suitable for anyone interested in athletics. The event is a great opportunity to try running in a friendly and inclusive environment, with check-in and registration just before the start.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Ripateigane, an area between Ørsta ungdomsskule and Øyehaug AS
Suitable for children and young people in the athletics group
Held outdoors, with check-in and registration at 17:15 and the race starting at 18:00
additional: Check-in and registration take place at 17:15 on the day of the race. The race is part of the start of training for children aged 4–9 in the athletics group. The first regular training session after the race starts on Tuesday 28 April at 18:00 at Ørsta stadion. In 2026, check-in and registration were at 17:15, with the race starting at 18:00. The schedule and practical details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Terrengløp i Smidalen
organizer: Nidelv IL Friidrett og Nidelv IL Ski
description: The cross-country race in Smidalen is an accessible event for children and young people in grades 1 to 7, organised by Nidelv IL Athletics and Ski in collaboration with Kjeldsberg Eiendom AS. The races take place on a circular course of approximately 1,000 metres in the scenic surroundings of Smidalen, Trondheim. Participants run 1 to 3 laps depending on their grade, with a mass start for everyone. The event promotes all-round training and the joy of competition among children in the local community.
course_highlights: Circular cross-country course of approximately 1,000 metres
Distance adapted to age: 1–3 laps
Mass start for all participants
additional: The races are held several times a year, with a focus on children and young people. Coaches and team leaders are encouraged to prioritise participation over their own training. The event is part of a sponsorship agreement with Kjeldsberg Eiendom. Previous race formats have been 1 lap for grades 1–3, 2 laps for grades 4–5, and 3 laps for grades 6–7.

name: Fjellhamarstafetten
description: The Fjellhamarstafetten is a relay organized by Lørenskog Friidrettslag, which has a long tradition in athletics and running events. The relay brings together runners of different ages and abilities, from children to veterans, and promotes both competition and community. Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics licence, which includes insurance coverage. Lørenskog Friidrettslag offers a wide range of training groups and is known for its involvement in local running series and relays.
additional: Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics licence, which is an insurance arrangement. Children under 13 are covered by the children's sports insurance and do not need their own licence. Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics licence. Children under 13 are covered by the children's sports insurance.

name: Ungdomsstafetten
description: King Harald’s Youth Relay is an annual mixed relay for 15- and 16-year-olds, organised by the Norwegian Ski Association and Holmenkollen Skifestival. The relay takes place in Holmenkollen and is held on the same weekend as the FIS Nordic World Cup. This traditional event brings together young people from all over Norway for an exciting and social ski relay.
course_highlights: Mixed relay for 15- and 16-year-olds
Held in Holmenkollen
Takes place alongside the FIS Nordic World Cup
additional: The relay was given to King Harald as a gift for his 80th birthday. Previous editions have been mixed relays for 15- and 16-year-olds.

name: ÜLEMISTE Grit 2027
organizer: Eesti Ööjooks - Night Run Estonia ja Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskus

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Virtuaalne osalemine: 24€ (sisaldab medalit, tulemuse haldamise tasu ja saatmiskulu)

description: Ülemiste Grit is an immersive endurance running event held inside Ülemiste Centre in Tallinn. Participants can choose a 1-, 2- or 3-hour challenge, running a 552-metre loop. The event is not a race, but an opportunity to enjoy moving and challenge yourself: you can run, walk or power-walk. There is an aid station on the course offering water, juice and solid food, and a medal and gift bag await at the finish. The event has a limited number of participants and offers a unique indoor running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs on the second floor of Ülemiste Centre; each loop is 552 m long.
The indoor course has tiled floors and extensive glass surfaces, so take care.
The aid station offers water, juice, Coca-Cola and solid food (banana, pickles, bread, meat product, chocolate and orange).
additional: Race pack collection takes place from 19:00 to 21:30 on the third floor of the Ülemiste Centre parking garage. Bag storage at the event centre costs €2. Medals and gift bags are handed out at the event centre after finishing. After finishing, participants are asked to stay in the finish area briefly for a group photo. Participants in the 2-hour distance are asked to enter the start area via the first floor (take the escalator near Rimi). The event is sold out; on-site registration is not available. The virtual run option ends on 22.04.2027. Participants can leave their own drinks bottles along the course, labelled with their names. The event is non-competitive and emphasises cooperation and safety. Participants receive gift bags; the course is designed to be an experience, not for chasing records.

name: Skrylleloppet
description: Skrylleloppet är ett terränglopp som arrangeras av Björnstorps IF vid Skryllegården i Södra Sandby. Loppen erbjuds i distanserna 3 km, 5 km och 10 km, där 3 km även har en motionsklass för herrar och damer. Banorna går på Skryllegårdens motionsslingor i varierande skogsterräng med grusunderlag. Skrylleloppet är ett välkomnande lopp med professionell tidtagning och resultatrapportering, och fungerar även som seedning till TCS Lidingöloppet.
course_highlights: Terränglopp på varierande skogsstigar
Underlag av grus på motionsslingor
Möjlighet att seeda till TCS Lidingöloppet via 10 km-loppet
additional: Anmälan kan göras online fram till 30 minuter innan start. På tävlingsdagen kan man även anmäla sig på plats och göra namn- eller klassbyte mot en administrativ avgift på 100 kr, betalning sker endast med Swish. Startnummer skickas ut via mejl under tävlingsveckan och kan även hämtas ut hos Löplabbet i Lund fredagen innan loppet. Deltagare som cyklar till loppet kan delta i utlottning av pris vid prisutdelningen kl. 11:30. Parkering är begränsad, samåkning rekommenderas.

name: Skälbyloppet
description: Skälbyloppet är ett familjevänligt lopp som går genom den natursköna miljön på Skälby Gård i Kalmar. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser, från korta ungdomsklasser på 600 meter upp till 8 km för vuxna, med banor som går på fina parkvägar, grus, asfalt och terräng. Det är ett perfekt lopp för att starta löparsäsongen med vätska tillgänglig vid varvning och mål. Alla som fullföljer loppet får en medalj som minne.
course_highlights: Banan går på grus/parkväg, en kortare bit asfalt och terräng
Vätska finns vid varvning på långa banan och vid mål
4 km och 8 km banorna är 1 respektive 2 varv över bron
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas vid Skälby loge på tävlingsdagen från kl. 8.30. Ungdomsklasser startar från kl. 10:00, vuxna herrar/damer startar kl. 11:00. Nyhet: promenadklass 4 km utan tidtagning. Betalning kan ske med kort, kontanter eller swish. En 4 km promenadklass utan tidtagning erbjuds enligt information om tidigare upplagor. Medalj delas ut till alla som fullföljer. Publicerade uppgifter gäller 2026 års lopp och bekräftar inte datumet 24 april 2027.

name: adidas Premiärhalvan
description: adidas Premiärhalvan är ett halvmaratonlopp som går genom natursköna delar av Gärdet och Södra Djurgården i Stockholm. Start och mål är placerade på Sportgärdet vid Lindarängsvägen. Loppet är en perfekt uppladdning för adidas Stockholm Marathon men passar även alla som vill välkomna våren med en härlig halvmara i stadsmiljö. Banan är kontrollmätt och erbjuder en varierad underlagsmix av asfalt, grus och marksten med en total stigning på 183 höjdmeter.
course_highlights: Banan går på Gärdet och Södra Djurgården med start och mål på Sportgärdet vid Lindarängsvägen
Underlag av asfalt, grus och marksten
Total stigning på 183 höjdmeter och kilometerskyltar vid varje kilometer
additional: Maxtid för loppet är 3 timmar. Under loppet erbjuds sportdryck från Enervit. Nummerlappsutdelning sker på Gärdets sportfält fredag 24 april 10:00-19:00 och lördag 25 april 08:00-11:00. Deltagare som hämtar nummerlapp på fredagen får IcePower Cold Gel och Scholl fotmask. Rabatt på 25% på adidas skor och kläder i adidas pop-up butik på Löplabbet under perioden 20 - 26 april för anmälda deltagare. Tävlingsregler förbjuder bland annat barnvagnar, inlines, rullskidor och tävlingsrullstolar. Rullstolsdeltagare startar i sista startgrupp och ledsagare är kostnadsfritt. Preliminär starttid är kl. 11.00 och maxtiden är tre timmar. Åldersgräns 17 år. Anmälan på tävlingsdagen kan göras till kl. 09.00 i mån av plats.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.stockholmmarathon.se/premiarhalvan/): 2027-04-24 — "Spring adidas Premiärhalvan den 24 april 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-24)

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
location: Olshammar, Askersund Municipality, Örebro County, Sverige
description: Munkastigen Trailrun är ett ultramarathon som går genom Tivedens trollska skogar från Olshammar vid Vätterns strand till Laxå. Loppet följer en historisk stig som munkarna använde på 1400-talet och erbjuder en utmanande och naturskön terräng. För 2027 planeras en ny bansträckning med en längre distans på cirka 53 km för SM-klasserna. Loppet är välmarkerat och deltagarna får med sig en karta för att minimera risken att springa fel.
course_highlights: Historisk stig som användes av munkar på 1400-talet
Trollsk skogslandskap i Tiveden
Välmarkerad bana med två vätskekontroller
additional: Busstransport från Laxå till starten i Olshammar ingår i anmälningsavgiften för individuell start. För lag ingår transport för första löparen. Tidtagning sker med SportIdent vid varje 10 km. Deltagarna får en plakett och serveras ett varmt mål mat efter målgång. Lag kan bestå av 2-5 löpare med valfri växling längs banan. Den ordinarie tävlingen kan genomföras individuellt eller i lag om 2 - 5 löpare. Det finns två vätskekontroller, och busstransport från Laxå till starten i Olshammar ingår i anmälningsavgiften. Fullföljare får en plakett och varm mat efter målgång. Arrangörens sida innehåller kartor, höjdprofil och GPX-fil.

name: Vårmilen (Lidingöloppet Vårmilen)
organizer: Lidingöloppet (IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö Skid- och Orienteringsklubb)
description: Lidingöloppet Vårmilen är en uppskattad löputmaning som erbjuder en av Stockholms vackraste milbanor. Loppet arrangeras på natursköna och kuperade spår som går genom skog, ängsmarker och längs skärgårdskusten, med en mjuk och skonsam underlag som passar både nybörjare och erfarna löpare. Deltagarna kan välja mellan 5 km och 10 km, och loppet är seedningsgrundande för TCS Lidingöloppet, vilket ger möjlighet till bättre startgrupp vid höstens klassiska terränglopp. Under loppet finns vätskestationer med vatten och sportdryck samt underhållning längs banan. Efter loppet finns fika och lättare mat att köpa på Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Vindlande skogsvägar och kuperad terräng
Banan går till största delen på mjuka spår och grus
Vacker natur med skog, ängsmarker och skärgårdskust
additional: Start och mål på Lidingövallen. Vätskestation med vatten och sportdryck vid 5 km och i mål. Banan är markerad med vita snitslar och spraypilar, funktionärer finns vid svåra positioner. Omklädningsrum med dusch och bastu finns på Lidingövallen. Kostnadsfri väskinlämning finns, dock ej för elektronik. Värdeinlämning kostar 20 kr. Gemensam uppvärmning före start. Rekommenderas att åka kollektivt eller cykel då parkering är begränsad. Klassbyte och namnbyte möjlig mot avgift. Barnlopp (Knattarnas Vårmil) arrangeras före huvudloppen. 10 km startar kl. 11.00 och 5 km kl. 11.10 den 24 april 2027. På 10 km finns en vätskekontroll vid 5 km och vätska vid målgång. Parkeringen är begränsad; kollektivtrafik eller cykel rekommenderas.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.lidingoloppet.se/lidingoloppet-varmilen/startinformation): 2027-04-24 — "Start lördag den 24 april 2027 på Lidingövallen" (was estimated 2027-04-24)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Start lördag den 24 april 2027 på Lidingövallen

name: Retrovarvet 2026
description: Retrovarvet är en årlig löprunda som följer Göteborgsvarvets premiärbana från 1980, en 21,1 km lång träningsrunda som arrangeras sedan 2008. Det är inte ett lopp utan ett socialt träningspass i en samlad klunga med fokus på glädje, upplevelse och välgörenhet. Eventet är ideellt och syftar till att stödja barn i nöd, med årets insamling till Ågrenska och deras arbete för familjer och barn med sällsynta diagnoser. Start och mål är på Heden i Göteborg och rundan tar cirka 2 timmar och 15 minuter att genomföra i ett tempo runt 6:30 min/km.
course_highlights: 21,1 km lång bana som följer Göteborgsvarvets premiärbana från 1980
Start och mål på Heden, Göteborg
Träningspass i samlad klunga med fokus på social gemenskap och upplevelse
additional: Max 750 deltagare. Eventet är ett träningspass, inte ett lopp, och sker på egen risk. Löparna uppmanas att följa lagar och förordningar, aldrig springa före farthållaren och hålla sig på gångbanor. Anmälan sker via mail till premiarbanan1980@gmail.com med namn och mailadress. För 2026 anges samling på Heden kl. 07:45 och anmälan via premiarbanan1980@gmail.com. Webbplatsen uppger att deltagarantalet begränsas till 750; anmälningsuppgifterna gäller 2026 års arrangemang.

name: VXO Ultrafest
description: VXO Ultrafest är en ultralöpningsfest och svenskt mästerskap som arrangeras av Växjö Löparklubb i samarbete med Svenska Friidrottsförbundet. Tävlingen hålls vid Trummens södra strand i Växjö och erbjuder flera distanser med SM-status, inklusive 24-timmarslöpning och 100 km. Banan är flack och består främst av asfalt med vissa gruspartier, vilket gör den snabb och publikvänlig. Evenemanget välkomnar både löpare och gångare för en helg fylld av utmaning och gemenskap.
course_highlights: Flack varvbana på cirka 820 meter med asfalt och grus
Lopp runt sjön Trummen på cirka 3,2 km med asfalt och grus
Tävlingsområde vid öppna gräsytor vid Trummens södra strand
additional: Pre-race middag hålls fredagen den 24 april. Varvning sker vid arenan där det finns plats för arrangörens och egna tält. SM Halvmaraton gång kvinnor startar 10:00. Tävlingsbanan för VXO24h är ca 820 m och för VXO100k samt SM gång 42 km och 21 km är banan ca 3,2 km runt sjön Trummen. Arrangörens webbplats anger att VXO Ultrafest tar en paus efter fem år.

name: Lerumsloppet 2025
description: Lerumsloppet är en folkfest och löpartävling som arrangeras av den ideella föreningen Lerum Friidrott, där överskottet går tillbaka till ungdomsverksamheten. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser från 250 meter upp till 10 kilometer och är ett populärt vårmål för löpare i alla åldrar. Start och mål är vid Bagges Torg i Lerum, och arrangemanget präglas av en gemytlig atmosfär med god service och fina priser. Lerumsloppet är en tradition som lockar både motionärer och tävlingsinriktade löpare varje år.
course_highlights: Långa banan - 10 km
Korta banan - 5.1 km
Lilla Lerumsloppet - 3.3 km
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas fredag kväll 16-19 i Elgiganten gamla lokal vid Bagges Torg eller på tävlingsdagen från kl. 09:30 vid nummerlappstältet. Start sker vid Brobacken intill Bagges Torg för alla banor utom Lerum Energiloppet som startar på Bagges Torg. Vätskestationer finns vid Vattenpalatset och vid 5,5 km på 10 km-banan. Omklädning, dusch och värdeförvaring finns nära tävlingscentrum i samarbete med Actic Vattenpalatset. Rekommendation att cykla, åka kommunalt eller samåka på grund av begränsad parkering och folkfest. Totalt ca 55 banfunktionärer och vägvisare finns ute på banan. Information om starttider, parkering, omklädning, nummerlappar och resultat finns på loppets webbplats. Anmälan sker via EQ Timing; föreningsrabatt och överlåtelse av startplats nämns för 2025.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Varmt välkomna till Lerum och Lerumsloppet lördag 25 april 2026.

name: Fjordkraft Bergen City Marathon
description: Fjordkraft Bergen City Marathon is organized by Turn og Idrettsforeningen Viking and is one of Scandinavia’s largest road races. The race brings together both Bergen residents and visitors for a festival in the heart of Bergen, with five different distances suitable for all ages and levels. The main distance is a challenging marathon consisting of two 21 km laps. The event offers an inclusive and inspiring running experience focused on activity, achievement, and community.
course_highlights: The race takes place on Bergen’s streets, with beautiful views and technical sections
The main distance consists of two 21 km laps
Five different distances for all levels and ages
additional: Registration is binding and includes an administration fee of 25 kr as well as a license to the athletics federation. It is possible to resell your race bib until 17 April 2027 via a voucher code. Official participant information will be sent out on 14 April 2027. Relay teams are also available, with separate team leader administration and a joint invoice for companies. Registration is available both individually and for companies and organizations. Company teams can be managed by a team leader and receive a joint invoice.

name: Viggaløpet
description: Viggaløpet is a traditional race held every other year, with the start and finish in Gran and Brandbu. The race has been part of Hadeland’s spring traditions since 1991 and offers a wonderful running experience in scenic surroundings. The event is organized in partnership with local sports clubs and businesses, and welcomes both runners and spectators for an active day in April.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Gran and Brandbu, alternating every other year
The race passes through beautiful natural areas in Hadeland
Held since 1991, with strong local roots

name: Fevik halvmaraton og 5 km
description: Fevik Half Marathon and 5 km are organized by IL Express Friidrett at Fevik Stadium in Grimstad. The race is part of the club’s annual events and offers both recreational and experienced runners a great opportunity to take part in a well-organized race in scenic surroundings. IL Express Friidrett has an active community, with weekly group runs and several races throughout the year, making this a popular event in the local area.
course_highlights: The races start and finish at Fevik Stadium
Scenic surroundings in the Grimstad area
Both half marathon and 5 km distances are offered
additional: IL Express Friidrett also organizes three annual track meets in May, August, and October. Weekly group runs take place on Thursdays at 19:00 from Fevik Stadium.

description: ASICS Sentrumsløpet is one of Norway’s largest running events, with 10 km, 5 km and children’s races. The race is suitable for beginners, recreational runners and elite runners, and takes participants through central Oslo, starting and finishing on Karl Johan. Along the way, runners pass well-known landmarks including the Royal Palace, Frogner Park, Oslo City Hall, Akershus Fortress and the Storting. The event has an inclusive, welcoming atmosphere, with good facilities and water stations along the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Karl Johan in central Oslo
The course passes the Royal Palace, Frogner Park, Oslo City Hall, Akershus Fortress and the Storting
Water stations at Frogner Stadium, Christiania Torv and Karl Johan
additional: Pace setters for the 10 km: 40, 45, 50, 55 and 60 minutes. Water stations on Karl Johan before the start and after the finish, at Christiania Torv, and at Frogner Stadium (approx. 3.5 km). The self-service bag storage facility in Universitetsgata opens at 13:30. Kiwi serves bananas and snacks after the finish. AfterRun at Kaffistova with food and drinks. Race bibs can be transferred to other participants before collection.

name: Siddisløpet
description: Siddisløpet is an annual running festival in Stavanger, organised by Idrettslaget Skjalg. The race goes around Store Stokkavannet and covers a distance of 8.1 km, making it suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The event also includes shorter distances, such as Siddisspretten at 500 metres and Siddismarsjen at 8.1 km. It is an inclusive, social event that brings together people of all ages who love running.
course_highlights: The race goes around Store Stokkavannet
8.1 km distance for Siddisløpet and Siddismarsjen
Short 500 m distance for Siddisspretten
additional: Three start times: Siddisspretten (500 m) at 10:30, Siddismarsjen (8.1 km) at 11:30, Siddisløpet (8.1 km) at 12:00.

name: Vinstra Byløp
price_range: 200 kr for 5 km og 10 km; gratis for barneløp og bamseløp (2026-utgaven)
description: Vinstra City Run is an inclusive running event in Vinstra Park that welcomes participants of all ages, from 2 years and up. The event focuses on public health, diversity and the joy of running, offering a children’s park run, a recreational run without timing, and timed 5 km and 10 km races. The start and finish are in Vinstra Park, and participants are encouraged to take part in teams with family, friends or work colleagues. There are prizes and bib-number prize draws, and the aim is to establish an annual running event for all levels.
course_highlights: Children’s park run and teddy-bear run in the park for the youngest participants
5 km and 10 km races with electronic timing
Untimed recreational category where you can walk or run
additional: Participants are advised to arrive 1 hour before the start. Prize-giving at approximately 13:00. Group warm-up for the 5 km and 10 km at 11:30. Start of the timed 5 km and 10 km races and the recreational category at 12:00. Previous editions have offered an untimed 5 km recreational category and timed 5 km and 10 km races.

name: Molde Maraton - Vårløpet
description: Molde Marathon is an inclusive race suitable for all levels, with distances of 10 km and 21 km. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Molde, giving participants the opportunity to experience both challenging and scenic routes. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is a popular spring event in the region.
course_highlights: Run in scenic surroundings in Molde
10 km and 21 km distances available
Organized in collaboration with local partners such as Sport 1 Molde
additional: For the 2026 edition, there was a large parking area and toilets at the start and finish area, but no changing facilities. Water stations were listed for the half marathon at 5, 10 and 15 km and at the finish, and at 5 km on the 10 km course.

name: Aron Opp
description: Aron Opp is an uphill race organised by Bedriftsidretten Buskerud og Vestfold in collaboration with Skimore Drammen, Arontunet Lodge and LaSportiva. The course is 1.75 km long with 269 metres of elevation gain. It follows a winding gravel road from the bottom of the ski slope to the top, with the finish at the lift station. The race is suitable for both fast runners and those who would like to walk briskly up the hill. There is also a children’s race for the youngest participants, and activities such as face painting for children during the event.
course_highlights: The course is 1.75 km long with 269 metres of elevation gain
Follows a winding gravel road alongside the ski slope from the bottom to the top
Finish at the lift station at the top of the hill
additional: The children’s race for children up to 12 years old is free, with support from Sparebank1 stiftelsen Buskerud & Vestfold. Race numbers can be collected between 16:00 and 17:40. Face painting for children from 16:45 to 18:15. Arontunet Lodge is open for changing facilities and toilets during the event. The course is marked with red and white ribbons. Participants are encouraged to carpool or use public transport (bus no. 4 from Strømsø Torg to the mountain lift, with a stop 50 metres from the venue). Prizes for the top three in the women’s and men’s categories.

name: Glommaløpet
description: Glommaløpet is an annual race on a gravel path along the final kilometres of the Glomma, from Sarpefossen to Gamlebyen in Fredrikstad. The course starts in the square in Sarpsborg and passes through Kulåsparken, over Sannesund Bridge, along the eastern bank of the Glomma and under Fredrikstad Bridge, finishing in the historic fortress town of Gamlebyen. The event offers several distances and categories, including 10 miles, a relay, a recreational run and a children's race, and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The course is flat and easy to run, with scenic surroundings and water stations along the way.
course_highlights: Run on a gravel path along the Glomma's final kilometres, from Sarpefossen to the sea at Gamlebyen
Start in the square in Sarpsborg and finish in Gamlebyen, the best-preserved fortress town in the Nordic countries
Flat course profile with water stations at 4.5, 5, 9.5 and 14.5 km
additional: Glommaløpet has one start group per event, with no wave starts. The maximum number of participants is limited to ensure smooth flow and sufficient capacity at the water stations. Race numbers can be collected in the square in Sarpsborg on race day from 11:00 to 13:30, or earlier at selected locations in Fredrikstad and Sarpsborg. Bus transport is available for participants and must be booked by 18 April at the latest. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and prizes are awarded to category winners and relay teams. A technical running shirt with the Glommaløpet print can be purchased when registering by 24 March. The 10-mile distance is 16 km. The relay consists of ten legs ranging from 800 metres to 3 kilometres. There are three water stations, and bus transport must be booked in advance. Changing rooms and showers are available at Kongstenhallen and Sarpsborghallen.

name: Hell Backyard Ultra
description: Hell Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon in which participants run a 6,706-meter lap in under an hour. The race continues hour by hour until only one runner remains and completes a full lap alone, known as Last Man Standing. The race takes place at Trudvang community hall in Lånke and offers a challenging but social ultrarunning experience, with the option of personal support within the start and finish area. The race record is 42 laps, set in 2026.
course_highlights: The lap is 6,706 meters long and must be completed in under an hour
The course runs from Trudvang toward Hell and Hell station, along the shore and the Stjørdal River, then back to Lånke athletics track
Start and finish at Trudvang community hall, with the option to use a tent or indoor space
additional: The race starts at 09:00, with a new start every hour on the hour. Personal support is permitted within the start and finish area, but not out on the course. Basic refreshments, including drinks and snacks, are provided, and it is possible to set up a tent near the start area. Participants must remain within the course area during the race. Start at 09:00 at Trudvang community hall in Lånke. Race director: Lars Erik Gylland.

name: Sparebank1 Østlandet-mila Moelv 2027 - 10000 meter/3000 meter på bane
description: Sparebank1 Østlandet Mile is a 10,000-metre track race held at Skarpsno Arena in Moelv. In 2027, participants can also choose to run 3,000 metres on the track. Races are organized into heats based on pace, so everyone runs alongside competitors of a similar level. There will be separate heats for women and men, with approved starting procedures and shoe checks. The event offers a great day of running focused on community, with the opportunity to qualify for championships using official times. Race bibs are distributed at Limtrehallen by the stadium, just a five-minute walk from Moelv train station.
course_highlights: 10,000 metres and 3,000 metres on the track
Heats divided by pace for optimal competition
Skarpsno Arena, near Moelv train station
additional: Toilets are available in Limtrehallen and the clubhouse next to the stadium. Everyone who has registered will receive an SMS the day before the race with information about their race bib and start time. Maximum of 400 runners in the 10,000-metre race.

name: Torghatten Maraton
description: Torghatten Marathon is held annually on the last weekend of April on the Torgøy Islands in Brønnøy municipality. The race offers distances for everyone, from a full marathon to a children’s race, in scenic surroundings along the archipelago and around the legendary mountain Torghatten. The courses are generally flat to gently undulating, with the start and finish at Nordhus Stadium. It’s a great opportunity to enjoy running in spectacular scenery, whether you’re a beginner or an experienced runner.
course_highlights: Course along the archipelago on the Torgøy Islands, with views of Mount Torghatten
Paved and gravel roads in scenic surroundings
Generally flat to gently undulating course, with the highest point at approximately 32 metres above sea level
additional: All timed distances use electronic timing. There are also untimed recreational, children’s, and para races. The courses include both paved and gravel roads. The race is organized by Sport Torghatten Idrettslag. The full marathon, half marathon, and 10 km are timed; the recreational, children’s, and para races are untimed. The event was first held in 2015.

description: Valderløpet is an annual running event on Valderøya in Giske municipality, organized by IL Valder Friidrett. The race offers a great opportunity for recreational runners and competitive runners of all ages, with distances including an 8.7 km loop around the island, a 3.3 km Constitution Day route, and short children’s races. The event is known for its inclusive atmosphere, with the option to be timed or run recreationally without timing, and medals are awarded to all participants. Valderløpet combines the joy of running with scenic surroundings and strong local involvement.
course_highlights: 8.7 kilometers around Valderøya
3.3-kilometer Constitution Day route, starting and finishing at the Sports Hall
Children’s and youth races of approximately 350 meters, with age-group classes
additional: Start and finish at the Sports Hall on Valderøya. Classes for juniors, seniors, and veterans, with five-year age groups up to 75+. Medals for all participants and trophies for the fastest finishers in each running class over age 10. Extra prizes are drawn among finishers in the main race and short races. Parents may accompany the youngest children in the children’s race. Recreational runners can start between 11:00 and 11:30 without timing. A previous edition had a recreational class without timing and registration at the sports hall before the start.

name: Larviksløpet 2027
description: Larviksløpet is an annual race organized by Larvik Turn og Idrettsforening, starting at Indre Havn, Larvik. The event includes several distances, including the main race, a 5-kilometer race starting from Jordet school, a relay, and a recruitment race. It brings together both recreational and competitive runners in a friendly atmosphere, with the relay and main race starting at the same time. Registration is via EQ Timing, and information is updated regularly on the official website.
course_highlights: Start at Indre Havn, Larvik
Several distances, including a relay and recruitment race
The relay and main race start at the same time
additional: Registration for competitions is through www.isonen.no. To take part in competitions organized by the Norwegian Athletics Association, participants must purchase a license from the year they turn 13 until age 80. There are basic and extended licenses; the basic license is recommended for athletes. The relay starts at the same time as the main race.

description: Pilsēttakas Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, held on Latvia’s scenic forest trails. This event offers a range of distances for participants of different ages and fitness levels, encouraging an active lifestyle and enjoyment of nature. The race welcomes both beginners and experienced trail runners, with particular attention given to youth and children’s categories. The event is well organized and offers the option to participate individually or in teams, as well as season passes.
course_highlights: Routes with varied surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails, forest firebreaks and off-road terrain
Five different distances are available for various age groups and fitness levels
Late registration and participation in a non-timed walk are available on race day
additional: Late registration is available at the race center on race day, up to 30 minutes before the start of the relevant distance. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first; walking participants may set out on the course from 9:00 to 10:30 without timekeeping. Walkers should note that after 12:00 they may encounter fast runners on the courses. Season passes are available at a discount, but an additional fee applies if the “Vilks” distance is selected on 20 June.

name: 7 Bieg Korczaka
organizer: Specjalny Ośrodek Szkolno-Wychowawczy nr 1 dla Dzieci Niepełnosprawnych Ruchowo w Policach im. Marii Grzegorzewskiej
description: The 7th Korczak Run is an annual running event organized by Special Education Center No. 1 for Children with Physical Disabilities in Police. The event includes a 5 km main race, Nordic walking, and children’s races over various distances, including races for children in wheelchairs. The main race route consists of two loops with an additional section, making for an interesting and varied course. The event promotes inclusion and physical activity among people of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The main race route consists of 2 loops with an extra section
The event includes children’s races over distances from 200 to 600 meters
Nordic walking is available over a distance of 5 km
additional: Medals for race participants. Forms are available to download: transfer of a race entry, guardian’s statement/consent, and authorization to collect a race pack. Recommended parking areas are listed on the website. Numerous photo galleries and videos from previous editions are available. The event website provides registration, regulations, and a course map. Electronic timing by B4SPORT is available.

name: XXXVI Biegi im. Tomasza Hopfera
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janowcu Wielkopolskim
description: The 36th Tomasz Hopfer Runs is an annual running event held in Janowiec Wielkopolski. The main event is a 10 km race that attracts runners from various regions. The organizers also offer races for children, promoting physical activity among the youngest participants. The course is certified, ensuring it has been accurately measured and professionally prepared.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km race course
Children’s races tailored to different age groups
Scenic areas of Janowiec Wielkopolski
additional: The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Janowiec Wielkopolski. Phone: +48 452 469 185. The program includes races for children and the main 10 km race. The website includes regulations and results from previous years.

name: PKO Gdynia Półmaraton 35. PZLA Mistrzostwa Polski w Półmaraton
description: PKO Gdynia Half Marathon is one of the largest running events in Poland and will take place on April 24, 2027. The half-marathon course runs through the modern city of Gdynia, showcasing its unique modernist character. The race starts in the evening at 19:30, so runners finish after dark, creating a special atmosphere. The event attracts individual runners, relay teams, and participants in accompanying 5 km and children’s races.
course_highlights: A half-marathon course of over 21 km through Gdynia
Evening start at 19:30, with the finish at City Beach after dark
A PZLA-certified 5 km course, as well as children’s races and relays
additional: The half-marathon participant limit is 15,000. The time limit for completing the half-marathon is 4 hours. The entry fee can be transferred to the next edition up to 14 days before the event. Refunds are available up to 45 days before the race if registration took place within the first 30 days after entries opened. Half-marathon relays consist of teams of 3. The 5 km course is PZLA-certified. The children’s race (Kids Run) takes place on Saturday at midday, with a unique medal at the finish. The event will also include 5 km races, relays, and Kids Run. Early registrants can receive a full refund if they withdraw up to 45 days before the race; the fee can be transferred free of charge to the next edition up to 14 days before the event.

name: 43 Bieg Kujawiaka
organizer: Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy VECTRA we Włocławku
description: The 43rd Bieg Kujawiaka is the oldest sporting event in the Włocławek region, held in memory of Napoleon Dzwonkowski and Wiesław Wesołowski. The race attracts people who enjoy physical activity and runners from various places, and takes place at Przylesie Stadium. This event has a rich tradition, brings the local community together, and promotes a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course runs around Przylesie Stadium in Włocławek
An event with a long tradition and historical significance
A race in memory of local sports figures Napoleon Dzwonkowski and Wiesław Wesołowski
additional: The organizer is the Sports and Recreation Centre in Włocławek. The event takes place at Przylesie Stadium. The website does not provide details about start waves, participant limits, or race packages.

name: Backyard Ultra TRICITY
description: Backyard Ultra TriCity is a unique ultra race in a format that originated in the USA. Runners start every hour and have to complete a 6.706 km loop. After completing the loop, they can rest until the next full hour, when they begin another lap. The race continues until only one runner remains at the start and completes the final loop within the hour limit. It is a demanding and exciting race in which only one winner is crowned.
course_highlights: A 6.706 km (4.167 mile) loop
Starts every full hour
A 1-hour limit to complete each loop
additional: Runners have 15 minutes to rest after completing a loop if they finish it in less than 60 minutes. The race takes place in Gdańsk. The organizer provides downloadable rules. The race is for adults. The available registration page is for the 2026 edition.

name: Pelplin Forest Run
description: Pelplin Forest Run is a running and Nordic walking event held at Rajkowski Mill since 2024. The start, finish, and race office are located at the kayak marina, and the routes pass through the scenic Bukowiec Forest District. The event is co-organized by the Kociewie Sports and Cultural Association and the Pelplin Municipality Sprint Kulice Sports Club, offering participants a chance to enjoy nature and compete in a beautiful forest setting.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Bukowiec Forest District
Start and finish at the kayak marina in Rajkowski Mill
Running and Nordic walking in a natural forest setting
additional: The distances and location provided are from previous editions.

name: XLIV Uliczny Bieg Bartów
location: Stadion w Barcianach, ul. Sportowa 1a, Barciany, Poland
