description: The 44th Bartów Street Run in Memory of Jan Liniewski is a traditional road race held at the stadium in Barciany. The event has a rich history and is open to various age groups, from preschoolers to adults, including people with disabilities. The main race course is approximately 3,800 metres long and runs through the streets of Barciany. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping, medals and prizes, as well as a friendly atmosphere and support from spectators.
course_highlights: The main race course is approximately 3,800 m long and runs through the streets of Barciany
Age categories range from preschoolers to adults, including a race for people with disabilities
Start and finish at the stadium in Barciany, 1a Sportowa Street
additional: The race office is open from 8:30. Registration and race-pack collection are available until 45 minutes before the start of each category. Electronic timekeeping uses a returnable chip. Medical care is available on site. Prizes are drawn after the race. Race numbers must be placed on the chest or on a special belt at the front of the body. The co-organizer of the previous edition was the Warmian-Masurian LZS Association.

name: XVIII Złotowski Bieg Zawilca
description: The 18th Złotów Anemone Run is an annual running event held in Złotów, aimed at people who enjoy running, active recreation and a sporting atmosphere. The race takes place on courses suited to different groups of participants, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The event is open and welcoming to runners of varying experience levels. The organizers provide professional event management and attractive conditions for starting and competing.
additional: The event is co-organized by the Złotów Municipal Office, Granqvists Manufacturing Sp. z o.o. and the Alfred Sokołowski District Hospital in Złotów.

name: XXXV Biegi Uliczne Wiosna Cekowska
description: The XXXV Wiosna Cekowska Street Races is an annual running event held in Ceków-Kolonia. The races attract runners from various towns and offer street courses of different lengths. The event is open and welcoming to participants of different ages and ability levels. The start and finish are at the Public Preschool in Ceków-Kolonia, and the races take place in the afternoon.
course_highlights: Street running courses in Ceków-Kolonia
Start and finish at the Public Preschool
The event takes place from 12:00 to 15:00
additional: The races take place from 12:00 to 15:00. A list of confirmed and unconfirmed participants is available on the website. No information is available about entry fees or participant limits.

name: III Bieg na dychę
description: The “Fabianki Ten” is a running event held at the stadium in Chełmica Cukrownia. Its name indicates a distance of 10 km, and an earlier edition took place in April 2026. The race combines sporting competition with an active day out in the Fabianki municipality.
course_highlights: The stadium in Chełmica Cukrownia is the event venue
A 10 km race, as suggested by the name “Ten”
Located in the Fabianki municipality

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Bålsta Stadslopp är ett snabbt och trevligt vår-lopp som arrangeras i centrala Bålsta med start och mål vid Gröna Dalens IP. Loppet har vuxit stadigt sedan starten 2019 och är känt som en persbana där många löpare slår sina tidigare rekord. Banan består av en 5 km lång slinga som kan springas en eller två varv, med 99% asfalt och avslutning på en friidrottsbana. Evenemanget präglas av fart, glädje och gemenskap och välkomnar löpare i alla åldrar och klasser.
course_highlights: 5 km lång slinga i centrala Bålsta med målgång på Gröna Dalens IP
99% asfalt med avslutande friidrottsbana
Snabb bana med liten stigning borttagen för ännu bättre tider
additional: Nummerlappsutdelning startar 08:00 utanför Gröna Dalens IP. Starttider är 09:30 för 5 km och 10:45 för 10 km. Självseedning tillämpas vid starten för att minska trängsel. Efteranmälan kan ske digitalt fram till 1 timme innan start i mån av plats. Det finns klädinlämning och begränsade ombytesmöjligheter. Pendeltåg till Bålsta station med gångavstånd till start/mål. Flera parkeringsplatser finns i närheten. Badhusvägen är avstängd för trafik under tävlingsdagen. Anmälan är öppen. Sportdrycken som serveras i muggarna är Umara U Sport Lemon.

name: Landsjön runt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pojke/Flicka Vista FUN RUN ca 1 km GRATIS

description: Landsjön Runt är ett traditionsrikt landsvägslopp som arrangeras av IK Vista sedan 1982 i Kaxholmen utanför Huskvarna. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser som passar hela familjen, från barnlopp och hinderbana till 5,5 km och 12,5 km i naturskön miljö runt sjön. Start och mål sker på Vistavallen med en bana som går medsols runt sjön, där stigningarna finns i den första halvan. Under loppet bjuds deltagarna på musik och vätska för att skapa en härlig löparupplevelse. Det finns även lagtävlingar och prisutdelningar för ungdomar och fun run.
course_highlights: Banan går medsols runt Landsjön med stigningar i första halvan
Start på gräsplanen och mål på löparbanan på Vistavallen
Naturskön miljö med löpning intill Landsjöns vatten
additional: Nummerlappar kan hämtas på Vistavallen lördagen innan mellan 14-16. IK Vista-medlemmar deltar gratis vid anmälan senast 18/4. Lagtävling för lag om fyra personer finns för 5,5 km och 12,5 km, där lagets sammanlagda tid redovisas och lagen får en kasse med godsaker. Barnlopp 0-6 år ca 500 m startar 12:00, Vista FUN RUN hinderbana ca 1 km startar 12:20 med prisutdelning efteråt. Rekommenderad parkering vid Vistavallen eller Hunnerydsbadet, kollektivtrafik uppmuntras. Loppet har arrangerats årligen sedan 1982.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://landsjonrunt.se/): 2027-04-25 — "25 April 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-25)

name: Kvantumloppet (Kvantumloppet med Trail 7+17km)
description: Kvantumloppet Trail arrangeras av Huddinge AIS vid Källbrinks IP och bjuder på 7 och 17 km löpning i Gömmarskogen. Banorna går huvudsakligen på mindre skogsstigar och följer Gömmarens gula spår på 7 km respektive svartvita spår på 17 km. Här väntar bitvis teknisk terräng med stenar, rötter och branta backar, blandat med natursköna partier. Loppet passar dig som vill utmana dig på stigarna, oavsett om du springer, joggar eller tar dig fram i eget tempo.
course_highlights: 7 km följer Gömmarens gula spår, kallat Sparven.
17 km följer Gömmarens svartvita spår, kallat Skatan.
Mestadels små skogsstigar med tekniska inslag, stenar, rötter och branta backar.
additional: Start och mål vid Källbrinks IP. Banorna anges vara cirka 5 % längre eller kortare än den angivna distansen.

name: Orion Trail
description: Orion Trail är ett vackert löplopp i natursköna Ådalen i Jämjö utanför Karlskrona, där deltagarna springer på stigar längs en slingrande å. Banan bjuder på varierad terräng med stigar, obanad mark, grusväg och asfalt, inklusive ett vattenfall och ett hav av vitsippor. Loppet erbjuder distanser på 5 km och 10 km, där 10 km-loppet innebär två varv på banan. För de yngsta finns ett barnlopp på 500 eller 1000 meter. Alla deltagare får medalj, dricka och bulle, och det finns möjlighet till dusch och servering vid målet. Orion Trail är en del av Oriondagen, en familjevänlig dag med aktiviteter i naturen.
course_highlights: Banan är cirka 5000 meter med 3700 meter stigar och obanad terräng
Sträckan går längs den natursköna Ådalen med slingrande å och vattenfall
Barnloppet erbjuder 500 eller 1000 meter med möjlighet att springa ett eller två varv
additional: Start och mål vid Orionstugan i Jämjö med parkering på anvisad plats. Nummerlappar hämtas från 09:00 på tävlingsdagen. Alla som fullföljer loppet får medalj, dricka och bulle. Dusch och omklädning finns. Servering med grillad korv, hamburgare, kakor och kaffe erbjuds. Anmälan kan göras på plats senast 30 minuter före start. Oriondagen pågår 10:00-13:00 med flera familjeaktiviteter och drop-in för dessa. Starttider: 5 km och 10 km kl 10:30, barnloppet kl 12:00. Kan genomföras som löpning eller promenad.

name: Strömsnäs Trailrun
description: Strömsnäs Trailrun är ett härligt traillopp som arrangeras i skogarna runt Strömsnäsbruk och Traryd. Loppen går huvudsakligen på stigar, skogsvägar och lite obanad terräng, vilket ger en naturnära och utmanande löpupplevelse. Tävlingen är sanktionerad av Svenska Friidrottsförbundet och välkomnar löpare i olika klasser med hederspriser och medaljer till alla som fullföljer. Start och mål är vid Graalstugan i Strömsnäsbruk, och arrangören SK Graal ser fram emot att välkomna deltagare till en fin dag i löparskor.
course_highlights: Löpning på stigar, skogsvägar och obanad terräng
Natursköna skogar runt Strömsnäsbruk och Traryd
Start och mål vid Graalstugan
additional: Tidtagning sker elektroniskt med chip i nummerlappen som återlämnas vid målgång. Prisutdelning cirka 12:30 med hederspriser till 1 - 3 i varje klass och utlottade priser. Medalj till alla som fullföljer. Omklädning och dusch finns med begränsad plats. Cafeteria finns i anslutning till målområdet. Efteranmälan sker på tävlingsdagen från 09:30 till 30 minuter före start, med extra avgift på 60 kr. Klubbar kan faktureras vid anmälan av fler än tre deltagare. Tidtagning sker elektroniskt och fullföljande deltagare får medalj enligt 2026 års information.

name: STHLM Trail Run
description: STHLM Trail Run är ett terränglopp som arrangeras på Norra Djurgården i Stockholm med start och mål vid Fisksjöäng. Loppet erbjuder två distanser, 5 km och 10 km, med starttider kl. 11.00 respektive 12.00. Banan bjuder på en härlig naturupplevelse med varierad terräng och är lättillgänglig med kollektivtrafik. Evenemanget är öppet för ungdomar från 11 år i målsmans sällskap och har en familjär och inkluderande atmosfär. Alla deltagare får medalj, vätska längs banan och tidtagning med nummerlapp.
course_highlights: Terränglöpning på Norra Djurgården med varierad natur
Start och mål vid Fisksjöäng, nära Ropstens tunnelbana
Vätskestationer längs banan och tidtagning med chip
additional: Start och mål vid Fisksjöäng, 10 min promenad från Ropstens tunnelbana. Nummerlappsutdelning sker fredagen innan på Icebug store i Stockholm eller på plats på tävlingsdagen. Nummerlappen är personlig och ska bäras synligt på bröstet med chipet utvikt. Medalj, vätska längs banan, målservice och tidtagning ingår. Efteranmälan möjlig fram till 1 timme före start. Rabatt erbjuds på Icebug löparskor för deltagare. Nummerlapp med tidtagning, vätska längs banan, medalj och målservice ingår. Prisuppgifterna gäller enligt arrangörssidans angivna prisperioder och kan avse en annan upplaga än 2027.

name: Trollhättan 5k
description: Välkommen till Trollhättan 5K, ett snabbt och kontrollmätt lopp som arrangeras för femte gången. Banan är utformad för att attrahera löpare som vill springa en snabb 5 km, antingen som förberedelse inför längre lopp eller för att slå sin personliga rekordtid. Banrekordet är redan högt och det ska bli spännande att se om det kan slås i år. Loppet erbjuder en snabb bana i Trollhättan med goda möjligheter till fina tider.
course_highlights: Kontrollmätt och snabb 5 km-bana
Lämplig som förberedelse för längre tävlingar
Möjlighet att slå banrekord

name: Tveide Rundt
price_range: 200 kr for 10 km; barneløpet er gratis
description: Tveide Rundt is a recreational race starting and finishing in Birkenesparken. The course is officially measured and certified at 10 km, and the race is held on the last Sunday in April. It is a great event for everyone aged 13 and over, with exciting draw prizes and gift cards for podium finishers. Birkenesparken Rundt is also held: a free 1 km children’s race for children aged 6 to 12, with a medal for every participant.
course_highlights: Officially measured and certified 10 km course
Start and finish in scenic Birkenesparken
1 km children’s race for ages 6–12, with a medal for everyone
additional: Schedule: The kiosk opens at 11:00. Tveide Rundt 10 km starts at 12:00. Birkenesparken Rundt 1 km starts at 12:10. The children’s race is free, and every child receives a medal. Birkenesparken Rundt is a free 1 km children’s race for ages 6–12, with a medal for everyone. The stated schedule lists the kiosk opening at 11:00, the 10 km start at 12:00, and the children’s race at 12:10.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Kevadjooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Spring Run is a beautiful spring running event held amid the ancient natural landscapes of the Kõrvemaa Nature Reserve. The event centre is conveniently located near Tallinn at the Sportland Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre. The varied routes include a 16 km main distance, a 6 km run and a youth run. Free children’s runs, activities for the whole family and childcare are also available. After the run, participants can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and hot tubs, as well as an exciting treasure hunt at Anija Manor.
course_highlights: The entire route runs through a nature reserve
A range of distances: 16 km, 6 km and a youth run
Event centre conveniently located near Tallinn
additional: Free bus transport is provided for participants between Aegviidu railway station and the event centre, in both directions. The event centre has childcare, a bag drop, a Stebby wellbeing area with Fysiotikker, and a Sportland pop-up shop where you can top up on running gear. For children, Aegviidu RMK offers nature-themed activities, a low ropes course, a mini-pancake café, and horse and pony rides (bring cash). A sauna and hot tubs will be open after the run. Participants can enter a draw to win a stylish Trek city bike at the Spring Run awards ceremony at 14:00. Group discounts: 10% off when registering at least 5 participants, and 20% off when registering at least 10 participants. A 50% discount is available for seniors (60+) and young people (up to 17) when registering in advance; the minimum final price is €15. The event takes place on 25 April 2027, offering a choice of distances and the chance to enjoy outdoor exercise and time with family.

name: Kauno Akropolio maratonas 2026
description: The Kauno Akropolis Marathon is an annual international running event in Kaunas, attracting thousands of participants. The event is for everyone, regardless of age or fitness level, and aims to promote social and physical activity and healthy-lifestyle traditions in Lithuania. The marathon and half-marathon courses are certified by World Athletics (WA) and the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races (AIMS). It is a sporting celebration for both professionals and recreational runners, held in a safe environment that meets high standards.
course_highlights: The marathon and half-marathon courses are certified by WA and AIMS
The course is measured according to international standards
The event is certified with a 5-star quality label
additional: The event is certified with a 5-star quality label, ensuring the highest standards of safety and service. The marathon courses meet international standards. The event is for both professionals and recreational runners and takes place in Kaunas. It is organized by the public institution "Kauno maratono klubas". The event offers a virtual running option, group registration, various distances, and certified courses.

name: Palangos pusės maratono bėgimas „PRALENK ŽIRGĄ“
description: The Palanga Half Marathon “OUTRUN THE HORSE” is a high-quality half-marathon event held in celebration of St. George’s Day. The event aims to establish Palanga as a European City of Sport and encourage physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and visitors. The race takes place in the resorts of Palanga and Šventoji, expanding the range of mass sporting events and encouraging local community participation in sports.
course_highlights: Start in Šventoji and finish in Palanga
The course is marked and adapted for runners
Promotes a healthy lifestyle and popularizes sports
additional: Traffic restrictions and public relations campaigns are planned to ensure the event runs smoothly.

name: Wolfsburg Run powered by VfL Wolfsburg e.V.
23 Bieg Jakubowy
description: LOTTO 23rd Jakubowy Run is a road race in Olsztyn with a tradition spanning more than twenty years, organized by the HORUS Association. The 10 km course, certified by PZLA, passes through some of the city’s most beautiful and charming places, with the start and finish in Olsztyn’s Old Town by the fountain. The event is one of the most popular running events in the Warmia and Masuria region and takes place at the beginning of the running season. In addition to the main race, children’s races and a 10 km Nordic Walking event are also held.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Olsztyn’s Old Town by the fountain
The route passes through Podzamcze Park, the boulevards along the Łyna River, and the avenues by the lake
A 10 km road course certified by PZLA
additional: Side events: children’s races over 150–200 m, 300 m, and 400 m, and 10 km Nordic Walking. The start and finish are located in the Old Town by the fountain, and winners are presented with awards after each race. The race office also allows registration and payment of entry fees on race day, if race packages are still available. The 2026 program included races for children in three age groups and Nordic Walking.

name: 35 Maraton Juranda
description: The 35th Jurand Marathon is a historic race held since 1981 and one of the most important marathons in Poland. Its certified course is exceptionally flat and entirely paved, making it ideal for setting personal bests. The route passes through the picturesque Masuria region, including villages, forests, and the landscapes of the Land of a Thousand Lakes. The event combines competitive running with a picnic atmosphere and is open to all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Certified, flat marathon course measuring 42.195 km
Entirely paved route, with no uphill or downhill sections
Picturesque Masuria region, villages, forests, and the landscapes of the Land of a Thousand Lakes
additional: 6:00–8:30. All distances start together at 9:00; wheelchair participants start at 8:55. The marathon time limit is 6 hours. Side races: the Knight’s Half Marathon (21.0975 km), Jurand’s Daughter’s 10K (10 km), and races for children and young people over 800 m, 600 m, and 300 m. Start, finish, and race office: Świetlica Gminna, Lipowiec 48B.

name: 42 Memoriał Winanda Osińskiego
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Szczecinku
description: The Winand Osiński Memorial Street Run in Szczecinek is an annual running event with a long tradition, organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Szczecinek. The main 10 km street race runs through the city on roads closed to vehicle traffic. The course is marked every kilometre and has a refreshment point. The event also includes youth races over various distances to promote physical activity among children and young people. The main race is scheduled to start at 13:00, and participants can expect professional timing and a unique sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through the streets of Szczecinek, closed to vehicle traffic
Course markings every kilometre and a water refreshment point
Electronic timing using chips in race bibs
additional: The time limit for the main race is 2 hours. The start and finish are on Piłsudskiego Street (the start is near “Mała Poczta”; the finish is at the Czesław Kazimierz Lis Municipal Stadium). Race bibs must be attached to the front of the shirt and remain visible throughout the race, or the runner may be disqualified. Youth races start at 8:55, with age groups and distances ranging from 400 m to 1,000 m. The organizer also invites organizations to set up stands during the event. Registration is through the Datasport service. The time limit for the main race is 2 hours.

name: II Charytatywny Bieg
description: The 2nd St. Ursula Ledóchowska Charity Run at Góra Chełmska near Koszalin is an event bringing together runners and enthusiasts of physical activity. Organized by the Sport, Recreation and Volunteering “SFX” Association, the run is charitable and promotes sporting activity accessible to everyone, regardless of age or fitness level. The course takes participants through the scenic areas of the Chełm Hills, offering a chance to connect with nature and spend time together outdoors. The event is part of the local running calendar and aims to build Koszalin’s sporting community.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Chełm Hills
Scenic views and contact with nature
Accessible to runners of different ability levels
additional: The organizer is the Sport, Recreation and Volunteering “SFX” Association, based in Koszalin. The event is charitable and brings people together. There is no entry fee; participation is free. Organizer contact by phone: Michał Bieliński +48 696 137 257 (does not respond to SMS). Proceeds were intended to support the establishment of the Zakład Aktywności Zawodowej z Miłością in Koszalin.

name: Nasza Dycha

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 75 zł – dla zapisanych na bieg i wszystkich zawodników Nordic Walking, wpłacone na konto organizatora poprzez formularz zgłoszeniowy

description: Nasza Dycha is a certified road race held in Gostyń, offering two distances: 10 km and 5 km. The start and finish are at the stadium, and the course is marked every kilometer and certified by the PZLA. The event attracts both local runners and running enthusiasts from other towns, offering sporting excitement and an opportunity to set a personal best on a fast course.
course_highlights: Certified road course with 10 km and 5 km distances
Course marked every 1 km
Start and finish at the stadium in Gostyń
additional: Registration is available on race days (April 25 and 26) for a higher fee, with no guarantee of a race pack. The course is certified by the PZLA and marked every 1 km. The event is organized by Gostyńskie Towarzystwo Sportowe CITIUS.

name: Półmaraton Koło
description: Koło Half Marathon is the fifth edition of the race, taking place on April 25, 2027, at Park 600-lecia in Koło. The course is exceptionally flat and fast, with just 19 metres of elevation gain over the full distance, making it ideal for setting new personal bests. Alongside the half marathon, the 4 km Debutant Run is also held, for both beginners and anyone looking for a short, fast race. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal, and the organizers provide well-stocked race packs.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course with 19 metres of elevation gain
PZLA-certified course, certification valid until 2029
Start and finish at Park 600-lecia in Koło
additional: The race office is open on April 24 from 16:00 to 18:00 and on April 25 from 08:30 to 10:00 at the MOSiR Stadium in Koło, ul. Sportowa 12. The Debutant Run starts at 11:05, and the Half Marathon starts at 11:00. The winners’ awards ceremony is at 14:00. Entry limits: 700 for the half marathon and 150 for the Debutant Run. Every participant will receive a medal and a race pack. The half marathon has a 3-hour time limit; water stations are located along the course. The event is co-organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Koło. The Debutant Run has a separate entry limit of 150.

name: V ATT RUN FUN Półmaraton Polkowicki
location: Stadion Lekkoatletyczny, ul. 3 Maja 51, Polkowice, Poland
description: The V ATT RUN FUN - Polkowice Half Marathon is a race held at the Athletics Stadium in Polkowice. The event combines sport and recreation, giving participants the opportunity to compete in the half marathon, 10 km, and Nordic Walking events. It is organized by ATT Sport Krzysztof Augustyniak, and timing is provided by STS-Timing, ensuring high precision and reliability. The main start is scheduled for 11:30, and the atmosphere is welcoming to both experienced runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Athletics Stadium in Polkowice
Three events available: half marathon, 10 km race, and Nordic Walking
Professional timing using Chronotrack active chips
additional: Timing is 99.8% reliable thanks to Chronotrack active chips. The organizer also supports registration and payments. The event takes place on Sunday and runs from 11:30 to 15:00. Information about the fifth edition lists the main start at 11:30 and the location as 51 3 Maja Street, Polkowice.

name: V Półmaraton Doliny Baryczy
description: The 5th Barycz Valley Half Marathon in Żmigród features a new, certified 21.0975 km course that starts in a picturesque town park. The route runs along the town’s streets and cycle paths, offering participants views of the ruins of a historic castle, an impressive tower, lush vegetation and a beautiful pond. This special sporting event is part of Żmigród’s active calendar. The town is known for its many running and cycling events, which attract both recreational runners and experienced competitors.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Start in the town park, with views of the castle ruins and tower
Run along the streets of Żmigród and the cycle paths of the Barycz Valley
additional: The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The start and finish are in Żmigród town park. The area has numerous natural and historic attractions that create a unique atmosphere for the race. Żmigród is known for its active sporting scene, including running and cycling events.

name: VI Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 6th Charity Run in Kartuzy is a sporting event held as part of the “Fields of Hope” campaign, aimed at supporting the Kartuzy DOM NADZIEI Hospice. The run takes place on April 26 and is part of a family fair packed with attractions for participants of all ages. Proceeds from the run will go toward the hospice’s operations, underscoring the charitable nature of the event. It brings together sport, fun, and support for those in need, engaging the local community.
course_highlights: A charity run supporting the Kartuzy DOM NADZIEI Hospice
A family fair with attractions for all age groups
The event takes place on the sports field at ZSO No. 2 in Kartuzy
additional: The run is part of the larger “Fields of Hope” event, which also includes a concert by the band GIS, a raffle, activities for children, a bicycle rally, and a motorcycle gathering with a blessing. An NFZ mammobus offering mammography screenings and an NFZ educational stand will be available on site. Proceeds from the run will support the Kartuzy DOM NADZIEI Hospice. Running calendars list April 26, 2027, as an approximate date, one day later than the date in the metadata.

name: XI Bieg Papieski
organizer: Regionalne Centrum Sportowe Sp. z o.o.
description: The 11th Papal Run is an annual running event held at the RCS stadium in Lubin, attracting local runners and amateurs from across the region. The main race, approximately 5 kilometres long, follows the city streets and offers participants an appealing urban route. The event is family-friendly, with races for children and young people held earlier at the stadium. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt and a bib with a timing chip, and the atmosphere encourages community and friendly competition.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5 km through the streets of Lubin
Start and finish at the RCS stadium
Youth races at the stadium before the main race
additional: The race pack includes a T-shirt, a race bib with a chip, and safety pins. An authorised adult may collect the pack on someone else’s behalf after completing an authorisation form. Race packs cannot be transferred to another person. The youth races take place in seven heats starting at 15:00. The race office is in the lobby on level “O” at Cuprum Arena Gallery, 20 Sikorskiego Street. In the 11th edition, the race pack included a T-shirt, a medal, and a race bib. The stated fee and other details refer to the edition planned for 2026.

name: XX Wojewódzki Bieg Przełajowy
location: Stadion Gminny, ul. Sportowa 37, Linia, Poland
description: The 20th Voivodeship Cross-Country Race through the Kashubian Landscape Park in Linia is a jubilee edition of the event, held at the municipal stadium at 37 Sportowa Street. The program includes races for children and young people, a local government officials’ race, a competition for people with disabilities, and an open 10 km race. Participants can also take part in the “Na Szlaku Kaszëb” Nordic Walking march.
course_highlights: A cross-country race through the Kashubian Landscape Park
An open race over 10 km
Various distances for children and young people, from 200 m to 3,200 m
additional: The event takes place at the municipal stadium at 37 Sportowa Street in Linia.

name: Namdalskarusellen 2027 løp 2 - Namdalsmila
description: Namdalskarusellen 2027 Race 2 – Namdalsmila is organized by Namdal Running Club, with the start and finish by Coop Extra in Spillum, Namsos. The race offers officially measured distances of 5 km and 10 km; the 10 km consists of two laps of the 5 km course. The course follows local roads and loops around city blocks, offering a varied and easy-to-run route. Participants who complete at least four of the eight races in the series receive a porcelain mug as a participation prize. The event promotes the joy of running and sporting activity in the Namdal region.
course_highlights: Start and finish by Coop Extra in Spillum
Officially measured 5 km and 10 km distances (two laps of the 5 km course)
The course follows footpaths, local roads and loops around city blocks
additional: Age-group categories from age 12 and up. Participants who complete at least 4 of the 8 races in Namdalskarusellen receive a porcelain mug. The event contact is Håvard Jakobsen, mobile 976 34 695. Namdalskarusellen offers a porcelain mug as a participation prize to those who take part in at least four of the eight races.

name: Jæren Sparebank Sentrumsløp
price_range: 125 kr for barneløp; 275 kr for 5 km
description: The Jæren Sparebank Sentrumsløp is an annual race held in Kanalparken, Ålgård, Gjesdal. The race features a 5 km loop starting outside Amfi Ålgård and passing through Torgveien, along the Figgjo River and over the Liv Godin Bridge. The scenic course combines an urban setting with beautiful natural surroundings. There is also a 700-metre children’s race. Separate start times are provided for fast runners and everyone else. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women’s and men’s categories, and all participants receive a finisher’s prize.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting outside Amfi Ålgård
The course runs along the Figgjo River and over the Liv Godin Bridge
700-metre children’s race
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 16:30 at Ålgård Sentrum by Kanalparken. Schedule: 18:00 Children’s race, 700 m; 18:15 5 km SUPER (for runners under 18 minutes); 18:40 5 km for everyone else. Prizes for the top three in the women’s and men’s categories in the 5 km, and a finisher’s prize for everyone. Course records from 2025: Men 15:42.8, Women 18:54.1. Race bibs can be collected from 16:30 at Kanalparken. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women’s and men’s categories in the 5 km, and all participants receive a finisher’s prize.

name: Gateløp
location: Ripateigane, Ørsta, Møre og Romsdal, Norway

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kr 50,- betalast med Vipps ved påmelding.

description: Ørsta IL Athletics invites you to Gateløpet, a road race held in Ripateigane in Ørsta. The race has four different courses for age groups from 4 years and up, with distances ranging from approximately 200 metres to approximately 820 metres. This is the first race in the outdoor recruitment cup, and both current and new members are welcome to join for an enjoyable evening of running. Registration takes place on race day, with payment via Vipps.
course_highlights: Four different courses for age groups: 4–6 years (approx. 200 m), 7–9 years (approx. 380 m), 10–12 years (approx. 525 m), and 13 years and older (approx. 820 m)
The race takes place in Ripateigane, between Ørsta ungdomsskule and Brødr. Øyehaug AS
The youngest age groups start first, with a combined start at 18:00
additional: Registration is on race day between 17:15 and 17:30. The youngest age groups start first. Payment is made via Vipps when registering.

name: Cytadela by Night # 114
description: Cytadela by Night 2.0 is a series of free, timed 5 km runs held in Cytadela Park in Poznań. The event attracts runners who want to enjoy the outdoors and the charm of the park in the evening. The run is recreational and open to a wide range of participants, promoting a healthy lifestyle and friendly sporting competition. It is well known in the local community and popular with Poznań residents.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km distance
The route runs through scenic Cytadela Park
An evening run in a friendly atmosphere
additional: The run is free and takes place regularly. Timing is provided during the run.

name: Värmlandsstafetten

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälningsavgift fram till och med 27/4 1 500:-/lag.

late_fee.price: 2000:- plus stafettpinne 750:- vid start första gången

description: Värmlandsstafetten i Karlstad är en stafett där lag om 5-15 deltagare tävlar tillsammans på en platt varvbana runt Sundstatjärn som mäter cirka 1270 meter. Alla lag startar och går i mål samtidigt och har två timmar på sig att transportera stafettpinnen så långt som möjligt genom att växla efter varje varv. Stafetten är öppen för alla och lag kan mixas fritt, vilket skapar en rolig och social tävlingsform som främjar gemenskap och friskvård. Efter loppet sker prisutdelning och enklare servering finns på plats. Första gången man deltar köper man en personlig stafettpinne med lagets logotyp som används vid varje tävling.
course_highlights: Platt varvbana runt Sundstatjärn, cirka 1270 meter per varv
Asfaltunderlag
Växling sker med stafettpinne inom växlingszonen vid arenan
additional: Varje lag måste köpa en stafettpinne första året för 500:- med lagets logotyp. Efter tävlingen kan resultat inskrivas på pinnen mot avgift. Nummerlappar, chip och stafettpinne hämtas av lagledaren på arenan. Parkering finns vid Sundstabadet med avgift. Omklädning och dusch finns i Idrottshuset. Servering med kortbetalning öppnar från 16:30. Sjukvård och toaletter finns vid arenan. Lag kan ta med egna tält och beachflaggor för att pryda arenan. Lag består av 5 - 15 deltagare. Växling sker efter varje varv, och samma person får inte springa flera varv i följd. Stafettpinnen kostar 500 kr första året (750 kr vid efteranmälan).

name: Vestfold løpskarusell - 2. løp - Teieskogen

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 1200 kr. for ikke medlemmer frem til 31.12.26.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1200 kr. for ikke medlemmer frem til 31.12.26.

description: Vestfold Running Series is a series of eight races in the Tønsberg region, offering running enjoyment, community, and a great atmosphere for all levels. Each race has two distances, and participants can choose to enter individual races or buy a season pass for all the races at a discounted price. The races start at 18:00 and use electronic timing via EQ Timing. The courses run through beautiful surroundings in different areas, such as Teieskogen, with the start and finish at the play area by Teie School.
course_highlights: Two distances per race, with varying lengths from 2.3 km to 6.9 km in Teieskogen
Start and finish at the play area by Teie School
Electronic timing via EQ Timing
additional: Season-pass participants collect their race number at the first race, while single-race participants can collect theirs at the race office 10 minutes before the start. The season pass must be kept throughout the series. Course descriptions and profiles are available in the Facebook group. Everyone can take part, regardless of level, and participants are encouraged to bring friends, colleagues, or family.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Kringsjåløpet
description: Kringsjåløpet is a traditional race that has been held since 1984 and marks the start of Sørdalskarusellen. The race takes place in Lillehammer on a measured 3 km course featuring varied terrain through residential areas, footpaths and wooded sections. The event offers both a mass start and virtual participation, attracting recreational and competitive runners of all ages. It is a relaxed and enjoyable fitness event with a great atmosphere and many participants and spectators. The start is at the intersection of Gamle Kringsjåvei and Håkon Håkonsensveg, and the finish is at Nordre Ål school.
course_highlights: Measured 3 km course with 25 metres of elevation gain
The course passes through residential areas, footpaths and wooded sections
Start and finish at Nordre Ål school in Lillehammer
additional: Race bibs can be collected the day before at Sport1 Lillehammer, Kirkegata 55, from 12:00 to 18:00, and on race day at Nordre Ål Barneskole from 18:45. There is limited parking near the race area, so walking is recommended. Sport1 Lillehammer offers Sørdalskarusellen participants a 15% discount and will also hold a Hoka shoe demo during the event. Sport1 will provide Fuel sports drink at the finish. The prize-giving takes place after everyone has finished. The race offers both a mass start and virtual participation.

name: Bølerstafetten
description: Bølerstafetten is a traditional relay organized by the Athletics Group of Bøler IF, starting and finishing at Haraløkka sports facility in Oslo. The relay is held for various age groups, with teams of girls, boys, and mixed participants, and the legs run on park paths and asphalt. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with a cafeteria and prizes for all participants. It is a great opportunity for young people and children to take part in a social and athletic relay in their local area.
course_highlights: The legs run on park paths and asphalt
Short course for ages 6–9, with 5 legs between 200 and 350 meters
Long course for ages 10–19, with 6 legs between 210 and 630 meters
additional: Race-number pickup is in the clubhouse cafeteria from 17:00 on race day. Changing rooms are available in the clubhouse at Haraløkka. The cafeteria and kiosk sell waffles, cakes, coffee, and soft drinks; payment by Vipps. Prizes include a team award for the winning teams in the 10–13, 14–16, and 15–19 age groups, and participant medals for everyone. Team lineups must be submitted at race-number pickup or emailed by 17:00 on race day. Age rules apply to the teams’ combined ages in the youngest categories. Mixed teams must include at least two participants of each gender. In 2026, the entry fee was NOK 600 per team for ages 6–9 and NOK 850 for the older categories; late entry cost an additional NOK 200.

name: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sverige

price_tiers.distance: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar 15-17 km

description: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar är en magisk vårtrail i Åkulla där grönskan har slagit ut och naturen är full av liv. Loppet bjuder på en sagolik löptur förbi små mysiga sjöar, Bexells talande stenar och genom den vackra bokskogen. Med 15-17 km distans och flera fartgrupper passar det både vana och glada löpare som vill skapa minnen för livet. Efter loppet finns möjlighet till gemensam lunch vid Öströö fårfarm.
course_highlights: Löpning genom Åkullas bokskog
Passerar små mysiga sjöar
Förbi Bexells talande stenar
additional: Samling sker kl 10:00 vid Öströö Fårfarm. Det finns 2-3 olika fartgrupper. Rekommenderad samåkning och hjälp med samordning erbjuds. Efter loppet finns möjlighet till gemensam lunch vid Öströö fårfarm, som deltagarna själva bekostar. Lunch efteråt är valfri och betalas av deltagarna. Arrangören rekommenderar samåkning och kan hjälpa till att samordna den.

name: Risenloppet
location: Ekevallens idrottsplats, Genarp, Lund Municipality, Sverige
description: RISEN-loppet är ett årligt löplopp som arrangeras av Genarps IF med start och mål vid Ekevallens idrottsplats i Genarp. Loppet erbjuder två distanser, 5 km och 10,7 km, där 5 km-sträckan går mestadels på asfalt i byn och 10,7 km-sträckan delar sig mellan bymiljö och Risens naturreservat. Banan är utmanande med tuffa höjdskillnader och loppet ingår i Skånes VeteranCup. Deltagarna får en RISEN-loppet-mugg vid målgång och det finns vätskekontroller längs banan samt prisutdelning efter loppet.
course_highlights: 5 km-banan är 95 % asfalt och 5 % naturstig i bymiljö
10,7 km-banan går 50 % i byn och 50 % i Risens naturreservat
Tuff höjdskillnad på båda distanserna
additional: Elektronisk tidtagning med bruttotid från startskott. Nummerlappar hämtas på tävlingsdagen senast 30 minuter före start och ska bäras synligt på bröstet. Vätska och energi finns vid 3 och 8 km (vatten och saft). I mål erbjuds vatten, saft, återhämtningsdryck (Gatorade) och banan. Rådjursloppet för barn upp till 9 år är 700 m och startar kl 12:15 med medalj till alla deltagare, anmälan sker på plats utan avgift. Efteranmälan på plats är möjlig mot tillägg på 100 kr via Swish. Prisutdelning sker cirka kl 12:30 efter barnloppet. Alla deltagare får en RISEN-loppet-mugg, guldmuggar till de cirka 25 % första på varje distans och silvermuggar till övriga. Ett barnlopp på cirka 700 meter erbjuds också. Tidigare upplagor har haft start och mål vid Ekevallens idrottsplats.

name: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“
description: The 63rd traditional “Anykščiai - Puntukas Stone - Anykščiai” race invites participants to spend May 7 actively amid the beautiful landscapes of the Anykščiai region. The race distances and difficulty levels are suited to participants of different ages and fitness levels, from a fun run for children to an 11 km challenge for endurance runners. The event is the oldest in Lithuania and is renowned for its tradition and friendly atmosphere, attracting sports enthusiasts from across the country. Participants will receive commemorative medals, while the fastest runners in the 11 km distance will win cash prizes.
course_highlights: A scenic route through the Anykščiai landscape, winding through the Anykščiai Forest celebrated in the poetry of Antanas Baranauskas
Distances for all abilities: from 300 m for children to 11 km for endurance runners
Start near the Angels Museum in Anykščiai
additional: Starts by age group: 10:30 — children’s fun run “Puntukėlis”; 11:30 — 3 km distance; 11:50 — race opening ceremony; 12:00 — 6 km and 11 km distances. Registration is open only until April 28 at 12:00; registration will not be available on race day. Participants who finish will receive commemorative medals. The fastest runners in the 11 km distance will receive cash prizes. Participants are offered advance registration, the opportunity to recover after the race in a swimming pool and sauna complex, prizes and discounts, and various age groups.

name: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas
description: Klaipėda EKOMarathon is a traditional running event held on the forest trails of Giruliai in Klaipėda. Both amateur and professional runners can take part, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. Distances range from 2 km for schoolchildren to 42.2 km for Ekomarathon participants, who run 10 laps of 4.2 km each. The event is organized by the Klaipėda city running club “Maratonas” and supported by Klaipėda City Municipality.
course_highlights: Ekomarathon course: 10 laps of 4.2 km on the forest trails of Giruliai
Schoolchildren’s course: 2 km (1 km out, 1 km back)
Start in Giruliai Forest, at the beginning of the bike path beyond the Summer Stage
additional: On race day, the timing system operates until 15:00. The entry fee is paid on site when collecting the race number. The first 300 participants receive commemorative medals; all participants receive certificates. Participants must bring an identity document to collect their race number. Participants agree that event organizers may use photographs and video footage taken during the event for marketing purposes. 4.2 km and 42.2 km distances, 2 km schoolchildren’s race, start in Giruliai Forest, online registration until April 30.

name: 12 Półmaraton Grudziądz-Rulewo
organizer: Gmina Miasto Grudziądz, Miejski Ośrodek Rekreacji i Wypoczynku w Grudziądzu
description: The 12th Grudziądz-Rulewo Half Marathon in the Footsteps of Bronisław Malinowski is a race with a unique character, deeply rooted in the history of the city and the life of its namesake, Olympic champion Bronisław Malinowski. The course passes places connected with Bronisław’s life and training, starting at the Olimpia Grudziądz stadium, crossing the Bronisław Malinowski Bridge, and finishing at Hanza Pałac Hotel in Rulewo. The race combines a passion for sport with the memory of an outstanding athlete, offering participants an exciting experience and a sporting spirit that unites generations. The event takes place on the first weekend of May, and participants can look forward to a varied accompanying program and organizational support.
course_highlights: The course passes historic places connected with Bronisław Malinowski, including the Bronisław Malinowski Bridge in Grudziądz
Start at the Olimpia Grudziądz stadium; finish at Hanza Pałac Hotel in Rulewo
A course with varied surfaces, aid stations every 5 km, and markers every 1 km
additional: The race office is open on April 30 (16:00–20:00) at Marina Grudziądz and on May 1 (8:00–10:30) at the Olimpia stadium. The time limit for completing the course is 3 hours; the course closes at 14:00. There are at least 3 aid stations on the course (water, isotonic drink, fruit). After the race, participants receive a medal and diploma and can enjoy a recovery meal, massages from physiotherapists, and free MZK bus transport for runners. On race day, warm-ups are led by Fit House instructors. Children can take part in the accompanying “Be Like Bronek” races. Information for the 12th edition lists the race office at Marina Grudziądz and at the GKS Olimpia Stadium.

name: Sianowska Dyszka
organizer: Fundacja Zastopuj Sportowiec.info oraz Gmina i Miasto Sianów

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Wpisowe to wśród dorosłych 40 zł do 02.12.2026 r.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Wpisowe wśród dzieci to 20 zł do 02.12.2026 r.

description: Sianowska Dyszka is a 10-kilometre race and part of a series of five races held in Sianów. The event promotes running as a natural form of physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the scenic running routes of the Sianów municipality. The races count towards the overall RUNking of Runners standings, which are summed up at the Runners’ Gala. The event is open to adults and children, with separate children’s races over shorter distances.
course_highlights: A 10 km race as part of the Sianowska Dyszka series
Scenic running routes in the Sianów municipality
Children’s races over distances from 100 to 1,000 metres
additional: Race packs can be collected from 9:30 to 10:45. Children’s races start between 11:00 and 11:30 over distances from 100 to 1,000 metres. A total of 120 medals have been prepared for participants. Prizes will be awarded to the three fastest women and men. Participants must register and verify their identity at the Race Office by presenting an identity document, and sign a declaration confirming that they are familiar with the regulations. Results from the Sianowska race series count towards the overall standings, which are summed up at the RUNking Runners’ Gala.

name: X Półmaraton Doliną Rospudy
location: Filipów, Suwałki County, Podlaskie Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Aktywni Znad Rospudy, we współpracy z gminami Bakałarzewo i Filipów
description: The 8th Rospuda Valley Half Marathon takes place in the scenic Rospuda Valley and is organized by the Aktywni Znad Rospudy Association. The half-marathon course is 21.0975 km long and 100% paved, providing comfortable running conditions. The start and finish are at the Filipów Municipal Office. Participants can expect refreshment stations and a race package with a technical shirt and drinks. The event promotes community and a healthy lifestyle, as well as raising awareness about the fight against harmful addictions.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is 100% paved
Refreshment stations approximately every 4 km (5 stations on the course)
Start and finish at the Filipów Municipal Office, 2 Garbaska Street
additional: The time limit for completing the course is 3 hours. Participant check-in and bib distribution take place on race day from 9:00 to 11:30 at the Filipów Municipal Office. Participants receive a race package with a personalized bib, chip, technical shirt or promotional item, and drinks on the course and at the finish. The course is marked every 1 km, with checkpoints in place. Participants must be over 18. Electronic timing is used. The accompanying Filipów Jaćwing Run is 12.5 km long. Information about the course, organizer, and registration comes from previous editions.

name: XI Bieg o Strzałę Widanta
location: Park Miejski w Resku, Resko, Poland
description: The 11th Widant’s Arrow Run is an annual running event held in Resko Municipal Park. The competition includes 5 km and 10 km races, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event. The course runs through the park and nearby forests along the Rega River, on natural, gravel, and paved surfaces. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and outdoor recreation for runners and enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Course through Resko Municipal Park and nearby forests along the Rega River
Natural, gravel, and paved surfaces
Two laps for the 10 km race and one lap for the 5 km race and Nordic walking event
additional: Children’s and youth races take place from 10:00 in the Municipal Park area by Górka Borków. A professional warm-up is held by the park stage at 11:45, before the races. Participants over 70 are entitled to free entry after registering. In the previous edition, the start and finish were in Resko Municipal Park; the programme also included children’s and youth races. Wierzbicki Running Project was a co-organizer.

name: XIII Bieg Borków
location: Osieczna, Leszno County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Bieg Borków is an annual running event held in Osieczna, offering a great opportunity to enjoy an active May holiday weekend. The event includes main races over 5 km and 10 km, as well as a free 1 km children’s race held on race day. Every participant receives a race pack and a medal, and the top runners are awarded trophies. The atmosphere encourages families and the local community to enjoy sport together.
course_highlights: Main races over 5 km and 10 km
1 km children’s race with age categories ranging from preschoolers to grades 7–8
Start and finish at the Centre for Culture and Library in Osieczna
additional: The 1 km children’s race is free. Registration takes place on race day at the Centre for Culture and Library in Osieczna, from 8:00 to 9:45. The children’s race is limited to 250 participants. Every child receives a medal and a race pack; trophies and a prize draw are planned for the age categories. In 2026, participants received a race pack and a medal, and the top runners received prizes.

name: XIII Dycha po Piachu
description: Dycha po Piachu is a race held in Czołpino, in the Smołdzino municipality. The 13th edition is scheduled for April 30, 2027. The event’s name refers to the sandy nature of the course and the local landscape. It is an option for runners looking to race in a coastal area.
course_highlights: Start in Czołpino, in the Smołdzino municipality
The event’s name suggests the race has a sandy character
Course in a coastal area

name: XXII Półmaraton Chełmżyński Chełmżyńska Dziesiątka
description: The 22nd Chełmża Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Chełmża, attracting runners from various regions. The half-marathon course runs through scenic areas of the town and its surroundings, offering participants attractive views and sporting challenges. The event is open to all and promotes an active lifestyle and integration within the local community. The organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere suited to both competition and recreation.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course passes through central Chełmża and the surrounding areas
Scenic views and varied terrain
A well-marked and secured course

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: Winter Bay Backyard Ultra i Trosa är ett unikt ultralopp där deltagarna springer varv på en 6,7 km lång bana i centrala Trosa, mestadels längs Trosaån. Varje varv måste klaras inom en timme för att få fortsätta, och loppet pågår tills endast en löpare återstår. Det är en lätt och platt bana som passar både erfarna ultralöpare och entusiaster. Under loppet erbjuds sportdryck, frukt, smörgåsar och mat, och det finns även en lagtävling och ett barnlopp Mini-TUB. Loppet firar 10 år med extra fina medaljer och priser till topptrion i herr- och damklassen.
course_highlights: 6,7 km lång bana i centrala Trosa, mestadels efter Trosaån
Lätt och platt bana anpassad för ultralöpning
Mini-TUB barnlopp med egen bana och medaljer
additional: Varje deltagare i stora loppet får en gratis silikonmugg från Umara vid nummerlappsutdelningen. Sportdryck från Umara, frukt från ICA Kvantum Trossen, samt mat från Trosa Stadshotell serveras under loppet. Vid varje varvning bjuds det på smörgåsar och godis. Det finns en lagtävling där de tre främsta resultaten från varje klubb räknas, med prispengar till vinnande lag. Mini-TUB för barn startar kl 14:15 och är öppen för barn födda 2017 eller senare. Tält kan sättas upp i samråd med funktionärer utanför startfållan. Loppet är fullbokat. Det finns även en lagtävling och Mini-TUB för barn födda 2017 eller senare. Tältplats ordnas i samråd med funktionärer; ett fåtal husbilsplatser finns, men saknar el.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.trosaultrabackyard.se/): 2027-05-01 — "1 maj, kl. 10.00 2027 – Loppet är fullt!" (was estimated 2027-05-01)

name: Hallandsloppet Trail
location: Gurkbänken, Vessigebro, Falkenberg Municipality, Halland County, Sverige
description: Hallandsloppet Trail är ett naturskönt trailrunninglopp som tar dig på en unik resa genom Ätradalen med utsikt över Ätran, fågelkvitter och grönskande lövskog. Loppet arrangeras i centrala Vessigebro vid Gurkbänken och erbjuder klasser på 5 km och 10 km, både för löpare med och utan hund. Det är en perfekt tävling för dig som vill uppleva Hallands vackra natur i en gemytlig och välkomnande atmosfär.
course_highlights: Unik resa genom Ätradalen
Utsikt över Ätran och fågelkvitter
Löpturer i grönskande lövskog
additional: Loppet hålls vid Gurkbänken i centrala Vessigebro. Start och mål anges vid Gurkbänken i centrala Vessigebro.

name: Sevede Trail Run
location: Mariannelund, Eksjö Municipality, Jönköping County, Sverige
description: Sevede Trail Run arrangeras av Hässleby Skid- och Orienteringsklubb i Mariannelund och bjuder på en utmanande och naturskön terränglöpning. Loppet lockar löpare i alla åldrar och nivåer och genomförs i vacker skogsmiljö med varierande underlag. Det är en uppskattad tradition som samlar både deltagare och åskådare för en härlig dag ute i naturen.
course_highlights: Terränglöpning i skogsmiljö
Varierande underlag med stigar och skogsvägar
Natursköna vyer runt Mariannelund

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard är ett unikt ultralopp som går i centrala Trosa längs en lätt och platt bana på 6,7 km, mestadels efter Trosaån. Loppet går ut på att klara så många varv som möjligt inom en timme per varv, där deltagarna får starta om varje timme om de klarat varvet. Det är en festlig och social tävling med prispengar, lagtävling och utlottade priser under loppets gång. För barnen finns Mini-TUB med en egen bana och fina medaljer. Under loppet serveras sportdryck, frukt, smörgåsar och mat från lokala sponsorer.
course_highlights: 6,7 km lång bana i centrala Trosa, mestadels efter Trosaån
Lätt och platt bana anpassad för många varv
Mini-TUB barnbana på 700 m som följer stora banan
additional: Starttid 10:00 den 1 maj 2027. Mini-TUB för barn startar 14:15 samma dag. Sportdryck från Umara och frukt från ICA Kvantum Trossen serveras under loppet. Vid nummerlappsutdelningen får deltagarna en gratis silikonmugg från Umara. Mat från Trosa Stadshotell och smörgåsar samt godis bjuds vid varje varvning. Lagtävling där de tre främsta resultaten från varje klubb räknas. Möjlighet att sätta upp tält utanför startfållan i samråd med funktionärer. Inga plastmuggar används för miljöns skull. 2027 års lopp startar den 1 maj kl. 10.00 och är fullbokat. Det finns lagtävling där de tre främsta resultaten per klubb räknas. Mini-TUB för barn födda 2017 eller senare startar kl. 14.15.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
location: Ekoparken vid Nordens Ark, Hunnebostrand, Sverige
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun är ett naturskönt traillopp som slingrar sig genom Ekoparken vid Nordens Ark i Hunnebostrand. Loppet erbjuder en unik möjlighet att njuta av vårens ankomst i en vacker och djurrik miljö. Evenemanget är välkomnande för både barnfamiljer och vuxna som vill kombinera löpning med naturupplevelser. Nordens Ark är en ideell stiftelse som arbetar för att bevara hotade djur och deras livsmiljöer, vilket ger loppet en extra meningsfull bakgrund.
course_highlights: Banorna går genom Ekoparken med natursköna omgivningar
Löpning i en djurrik och vacker miljö vid Åbyfjorden
Traillöpning som passar både barnfamiljer och vuxna
additional: 2026 års upplaga av Nordens Ark TrailRun är inställd. Parken är kontantfri och betalning sker med kort eller Swish. Det finns café och serveringar i parken under högsäsong. Parken har öppet dagligen med varierande tider beroende på säsong.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Välkommen till Växjöloppet den första maj 2027 i Strandbjörket, Växjö. Detta är en löparfest för hela familjen med distanser på 5 km, 10 km och halvmaraton (21,1 km), samt Lilla Växjöloppet för yngre löpare. Banorna bjuder på en naturskön löpupplevelse med inslag av asfalt, skogsväg och vackra vyer runt Växjösjön och naturreservatet Bokhultet. Växjöloppet är en traditionell och gemytlig tävling där rörelseglädje och gemenskap står i fokus.
course_highlights: Start och mål vid Strandbjörket med första kilometern på asfalt
Naturskön bana genom Bokhultets naturreservat med mestadels lövträd
Sista 3,5 km på asfalt runt Växjösjön med gemensamt upplopp på Lagunvallen
additional: Vätskestationer finns på 10 km (4 stationer) och 21.1 km (8 stationer). Lilla Växjöloppet erbjuder fyra olika sträckor för yngre löpare utan tidtagning, med nummerlapp, medalj och frukt eller t-shirt och diplom beroende på distans. Upploppet sker på Lagunvallen, cirka 300-400 meter från målet i Strandbjörket. Lilla Växjöloppet saknar tidtagning. Anmälan och betalning till barnloppen sker på plats vid Lagunen i Strandbjörket.
