name: Skatås ryggar
location: IFK Göteborg Orienterings klubb-anläggning, Skatås, Göteborg, Sverige
description: Skatås ryggar är Göteborgs största trail-tävling som erbjuder en fantastisk traillöpningsupplevelse på slingrande stigar i naturreservaten kring Skatås, Delsjöområdet och Knipeflågsbergen. Loppet har flera banlängder som passar alla, från ungdomsklasser till utmanande halvmara över fem höjdryggar. Start och mål är vid IFK Göteborg Orienterings klubbanläggning, och banorna är väl markerade för att ge en säker och njutbar löpupplevelse i vildmarksnära miljöer. Alla deltagare får en trämedalj och tillgång till vätskestationer och god mat efter loppet.
course_highlights: Banan går över fem, fyra eller två höjdryggar i Skatås och Delsjöområdets naturreservat
Den längsta banan är 21,1 km och inkluderar utmanande terräng med berghällar och slingrande stigar
Vätskestationer finns på fyra platser längs den längsta banan, med sportdryck och vatten
additional: Nummerlapp hämtas på tävlingsplatsen före start. Tidtagningschip sitter på nummerlappen och måste bäras hela loppet. Det finns väskinlämning för bilnycklar och annat. Efter loppet serveras varm soppa och bröd till alla deltagare, samt hembakat fikabröd och dryck till försäljning. Sjukvårdspersonal finns på plats. Parkering finns nära tävlingsområdet och närmsta kollektivtrafik är hållplats Töpelsgatan. Banorna är markerade med fluorescerande röd snitsel och tydliga pilar vid delningar. Löparna ansvarar själva för att följa rätt bana vid delningar. Tävlingsplatsen är IFK Göteborg Orienterings klubbanläggning i Skatås. Det finns ungdomsklasser och knattetrail, vätskestationer och mat efter målgång; parkering är gratis.

name: Seskarö Trailrun 2026
location: Seskarö Havsbad & Camping, Seskarö, Haparanda Municipality, Sverige
distance_verbose: 12 km, 7 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: Seskarö Trailrun 2026 är norra Sveriges roligaste lopp som erbjuder banor för alla, oavsett erfarenhet eller ålder. Loppet är en tävling och upplevelse för hela familjen med fokus på löparglädje. Banorna går genom Seskarös fantastiska stigar och Haparanda Skärgårds vackra natur, med varierande terräng som skog, grus, rullstenar och sand. Det finns flera distanser från 500 meter för de minsta till 12 km för den som vill utmana sig mer i teknisk terräng.
course_highlights: Banan följer befintliga leder och kombinationer av leder med varierande underlag: skog, grus, rullstenar och sand
Tekniskt krävande partier med hopp över stockar och stenar samt sand- och rullstenspartier
Detaljerade bankartor för 12 km (medsols), 7 km (medsols) och 3 km (motsols) finns på plats
additional: Nummerlappsutdelning sker fredag 29/5 kl 17:00 - 20:00 och lördag 30/5 från 08:00 på Seskarö Havsbad & Camping. Startnummer ska hämtas senast 30 minuter före start. Alla deltagare får en Seskarö Trailrun deltagarmedalj. Dusch och toalett finns tillgängligt. Överskott från startavgiften går till underhåll och utveckling av Seskarö Trails friluftsområde. Loppet arrangeras vid Seskarö Havsbad & Camping.

name: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra
organizer: Highland Trail Club och Höglandskyrkan i Sävsjö
description: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra är ett välkomnande lopp i de djupaste småländska skogarna med en fin och kuperad backyard-runda på 6,7 km samt en barn- och motionärsvänlig runda på 3,7 km. Tävlingen arrangeras av Highland Trail Club och Höglandskyrkan i Sävsjö med fokus på gemenskap och välgörenhet, där allt överskott går till välgörande ändamål. Antalet varv är begränsat till 15, vilket skapar en utmanande men rolig upplevelse för alla deltagare.
course_highlights: Kuperad backyard-runda på 6,7 km i småländsk skogsmiljö
Barn- och motionärsvänlig runda på 3,7 km
Naturnära och välgörenhetsfokuserad tävling
additional: Tävlingen pågår från lördag 09:00 till söndag 00:00. Antalet varv är begränsat till 15. Allt överskott från tävlingen går till välgörande ändamål. Backyard-varven startar på hel timme. 09:00; uppgifter om 2027 års starttid saknas.

name: Blue Mountain Trail Run
price_range: 150-450 kr beroende på distans och anmälningstid

price_tiers.distance: 15 km - Alvars stig by Nordväggen AB
6 km - Östra Ånnabodasjön by ICA Glansen

description:
Blue Mountain TrailRun är ett traillopp i Kilsbergen, två mil väster om Örebro. Fyra banor på 6, 10, 15 och 21 km, alla med start och mål vid First Camp Ånnaboda.

Banorna följer Bergslagsleden och MTB-lederna runt Ånnaboda: smal stig, rötter och sten, spänger över bäckarna, mossklädd granskog och utsikt över skogssjöarna. 21 km Blankhult har 527 höjdmeter och är loppets långa varv för den som vill ha teknik och backar. 15 km Alvars stig är mellandistansen med stig hela vägen. 10 km Trolldalsvägen är den klassiska tiokilometersbanan. 6 km Östra Ånnabodasjön går runt sjön på mest lättlöpt stig och passar som första traillopp.

Dam- och herrklass på alla banor, ingen maxtid, elektronisk tidtagning och medalj till alla i mål. Den som slår banrekordet på 21 km belönas med 5 000 kronor. Femte upplagan 2027, arrangerad av Garphyttans IF Orientering sedan 2023.
course_highlights: Tekniska stigar och kuperad terräng längs Bergslagsleden etapp 9
Passage förbi flera skogssjöar såsom Norra Ånnabodasjön och Stora Dammsjön
Stigning upp till Sånnabodahöjden med vidsträckt utsikt över Närkeslätten
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas i tävlingsexpeditionen från 09.00. Anmälan öppnar 1 december 2026. Sista anmälningsdag är 22 maj 2027. Efteranmälan på loppdagen 09.00-09.15 i mån av plats. Starttider: 6 km 09.43, 21 km 10.00, 15 km 10.35 och 10 km 11.00. Vätskestationer med vatten, sportdryck och tilltugg ungefär var femte kilometer. Trailskor rekommenderas. Hamburgare, kaffe och fika i målområdet. Bad i Södra Ånnabodasjön efter loppet. Banrekord 21 km: 1:16:41 (herrar) och 1:29:16 (damer).

name: Småland Adventure Race
description: Varmt välkomna till Småland Adventure Race 2027. Efter tre fantastiska år tar vi nya tag och satsar mot en minst lika bra tävling som senast. Småland Adventure Race är en multisporttävling där lag om 2-4 personer så snabbt som möjligt, med hjälp av karta och kompass, ska ta samtliga checkpoints (CP) som oftast består av en fysisk mindre orienteringsskärm, och finns inritade med ringar på kartorna. Banan kommer att ha ett antal transition areas (TA) där byte mellan discipliner äger rum. Tävlingen kommer främst att innehålla löpning, mountainbike, paddling men det tillkommer också andra äventyr. Under de tre tidigare tävlingarna har deltagarna bland annat paddlat madrass, klättrat, kört höghöjdsbana, SUPat och sprungit labyrint-orientering. Vissa checkpoints har suttit högst upp i klätternät och andra mitt på en slackline, men de allra flera är placerade på mer lättåtkomliga platser. Vi kan utlova många timmar av härlig äventyr! Vi erbjuder en lång och en kort klass. Preliminärt kommer lagen i långa klassen vara ute mellan 22 – 26 timmar, och i den korta klassen mellan 11 – 13 timmar. 2027 erbjuder vi även en Bike and Run klass som är en motionsklass där man bara är ute i 5-7h och har lite mindre äventyr, men ack så roligt

name: Markaryds Sparbankloppet
description: Markaryds Sparbankloppet är ett välarrangerat löplopp i Markaryd som arrangeras av SK Graal. Loppet har en stark lokal förankring med Markaryds Sparbank som huvudsponsor och erbjuder en trevlig löpupplevelse för deltagare i olika åldrar och nivåer. SK Graal erbjuder även träningsmöjligheter inför loppet och stödjer löpargemenskapen i området. Evenemanget är en uppskattad tradition som samlar löpare från när och fjärran.
additional: Efteranmälan kan göras på tävlingsdagen från kl 09:00 fram till 30 minuter innan start. SK Graal erbjuder träningar på måndagar och torsdagar kl 18:00. Medlemmar i SK Graal får 15 % rabatt på löparskor hos Team Sportia i Markaryd. Arrangeras i samband med Markaryds vårmarknad.

name: Öland Lighthouse Challenge
location: Långe Erik Lighthouse, Byxelkrok, Öland, Sverige
description: Öland Lighthouse Challenge är ett ultralopp som startar vid fyren Långe Erik på Öland och erbjuder tre distanser: 100 miles, 50 miles och 50 km. Loppet bjuder på en fantastisk löpupplevelse längs Kalmarsunds kust, genom ängs- och skogsmarker samt över det unika alvaret med vyer över Östersjön. Målgång sker vid olika platser beroende på distans, med 50 km i Djupvik, 50 miles i Lindby och 100 miles vid fyren Långe Jan. Alla som fullföljer loppet får medalj och tröja som minne.
course_highlights: Start vid fyren Långe Erik och mål vid Långe Jan för 100 miles
Löpning längs Kalmarsunds kuststräcka och genom ängs- och skogsmarker
Vyer över Östersjön och det unika alvaret på Öland
additional: Gemensam start fredag eftermiddag kl 15:00 vid fyren Långe Erik. Vätskestationer eller energidepåer finns cirka var 20:e km längs banan. 15 % rabatt på boende på Böda Sand under helgen vid bokning med koden Lighthouse Challenge. Energi- och vätskestationer finns längs banan; den officiella loppsidan anger cirka 20 km mellan stationerna. Publicerade priser gäller 2026 och kan ändras inför 2027.

name: Säffle Stadslopp 2026
description: Säffle Stadslopp är en folkfest i centrala Säffle med lopp för alla åldrar och nivåer. Här erbjuds ett tufft och lagom utmanande 10-kilometerslopp, 5 km löpning eller promenad, barnklasser samt det spännande Boxen Race med hinderbana. Start och mål är vid Medborgarhuset med publikvänliga banor som slingrar sig längs Byälvens vatten och genom stadens centrala delar. Evenemanget präglas av stor publik och en härlig atmosfär för både löpare och åskådare.
course_highlights: 10K och 5K banor längs Byälvens vatten och genom centrala Säffle
Blandat underlag med asfalt och grus
Boxen Race med varierande terräng och hinder på en 2,5 km varvbana
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas ut torsdag och fredag innan loppet hos Team Sportia Säffle samt i sekretariatet på tävlingsdagen. Start och mål vid Medborgarhuset där det finns servering, toaletter och prisutdelning. Boxen Race har intervallstart i olika grupper. Parkering rekommenderas längs Billerudsgatan eller vid 45:ans köpcenter, alternativt kollektivtrafik. Klasserna omfattar 10K Team Sportia Loppet, 5K Running, Sibyllapromenaden 5K, ST Loppet 1,5K, Papricaloppet 300 m och Boxen Race. Boxen Race är cirka 2,5 km per varv och springs två varv; 15-årsgräns gäller, med undantag för yngre deltagare i sällskap med en vuxen medtävlare.

name: Kodal Ultra Trail 50K

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Påmeldingsavgiften er kr. 500,00 frem til 28. februar.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Fra 1. mars øker prisen til kr. 600,00 frem til løpsdagen.

description: Kodal Ultra Trail 50k is a challenging and beautiful trail race taking place for the very first time on Saturday, May 29, 2027, in Kodal, Sandefjord. The race consists of a gently rolling 5 km loop, with a start every hour on the hour from 09:00 to 18:00, for a total of 10 laps, or 50 km. Participants must complete each lap within the hour to be able to start the next one. The race ends at 19:00 with the winner being announced. The event is social and inclusive, with prizes for completing 25 km and 50 km, and 10% of the surplus goes to the Norwegian Association for Children with Congenital Heart Disease. There will also be activities and a children’s race at the stadium during the event.
course_highlights: Gently rolling 5 km loop through varied, technical terrain
The course runs through deep forests in the heart of Vestfold, with trails, hills, and a field
Start and finish at the sports ground, with spectators cheering runners on during the final 200 meters
additional: The race starts and finishes at the sports ground of Kodal Idrettslag. Coffee, cordial, and cold water will be served during the event, and there will be a kiosk at the stadium. Participants must have a valid license from the Norwegian Athletics Federation, either an annual license or a one-day license purchased during registration. Participants can rest and spend time on the grass between laps, but only participants may access the rest area. Support is permitted only outdoors in the start and finish area. Starts take place every hour from 09:00, with the final lap starting at 18:00. A children’s race and activities for children are planned. Ten percent of the surplus goes to the Norwegian Association for Children with Congenital Heart Disease (FFHB).

name: Energistafetten
description: Energistafetten is a festival-like relay race held in Stavanger, inspired by the atmosphere of the Holmenkollstafetten and the Tour de France. The race consists of 10 stages of varying lengths and elevation profiles, and teams can have 6–10 members, whether colleagues, friends, or neighbors. The event emphasizes togetherness, enjoyment, and team spirit, and also includes a sprint prize in collaboration with Red Bull. After the race, participants are invited to AfterRun for live music, food, and socializing.
course_highlights: 10 stages ranging from approximately 750 to 2,500 meters
Approximately 14 km total, with 112 meters of ascent and 119 meters of descent
Start and finish in the Forum area, Stavanger
additional: Teams can have 6–10 members, and some participants may run multiple stages. All participants must be at least 16 years old, and the age limit for AfterRun is 18. No license or insurance is required, but optional insurance is available. A sprint prize with a cash award is held, with the prize donated to a good cause. After the race, AfterRun features live music and food in collaboration with Fjåge i Vågen. The Red Bull sprint prize includes a gift certificate worth 10,000 kroner, which is donated to a good cause in the region. AfterRun is held in collaboration with Fjåge i Vågen.

name: Heddal 10K
description: Heddal 10K is organized by Bluesløpet, a running organization that organizes road races in Notodden. The race takes place in Heddal, starting at Tuvensenteret, and offers a great 10-kilometer distance for runners of all ages and levels. It’s a wonderful opportunity to enjoy running in the scenic surroundings of the Notodden area.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer road race in Heddal
Start and finish at Tuvensenteret
Run in scenic surroundings in Notodden
additional: A previous edition started at 11:00. Tuven Teddy’s Children’s Race has been held in connection with the race, with free participation.

name: Stomperudløpet

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Stomperudløpet is a major running festival in Sørum, starting and finishing at Stomperud Stadion in Lørenfallet. The event offers four distances suitable for everyone, on varied courses featuring gravel roads, trails and some asphalt. The shortest distances take place on the athletics track, and the race has received positive feedback for its beautiful courses. This inclusive event encourages children, young people and adults to take part and enjoy an active day in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: A mix of gravel roads, trails and some asphalt
The shortest distances take place on the athletics track
Start and finish at Stomperud Stadion in Lørenfallet
additional: Registration is open until 11:00 on race day, with a late registration fee of NOK 100 for adults and NOK 50 for children. Participants registered for the full Stomperudkarusell for women/men pay a reduced price when registering at the secretariat during race 1 or 2 of the series. Distances listed for previous editions are 15 km, 6 km, 400 m and 300 m. The prices on the organizer’s website apply to the 2026 edition and have therefore not been used as price information for 2027.

description: Bergensløpet is a traditional race that has returned after almost 30 years, originating in 1976. The race takes place in beautiful surroundings in Bergen, with the start and finish in historic Nygårdsparken. Participants can choose between two distances, 5 km and 10 km, on a fast, scenic course along Store Lungegårdsvann and Møllendal. A free children’s race is also held for the youngest participants in idyllic surroundings around the pond in the park.
course_highlights: Fast course along Store Lungegårdsvann and Møllendal
Start and finish in historic Nygårdsparken
The 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:45 at the Vitalitetssenteret by Møhlenpris sports ground. Toilets are available at bib collection and in the clubhouse buildings. The children’s race starts at 12:00, the 5 km at 13:00, and the 10 km at 14:00. The children’s race is approximately 500 metres, with no timing or rankings, and all children receive a medal. The spring edition features a 5 km, a 10 km, and a children’s race. The listed start times for previous editions are 13:00 for the 5 km, 14:00 for the 10 km, and 12:00 for the children’s race.

name: Hurdalsjøen Trail Race
location: Hurdalsjøen Hotell & Spa, Skredderbakkveien 9, 2090 Hurdal, Norway
description: Hurdalsjøen Trail Race is a trail race held at Hurdalsjøen Hotell & Spa in Hurdal, Akershus. The race offers four distances from 5 km to 23 km, across varied terrain featuring technical sections, flowing trails and spectacular viewpoints. Participants get to experience the magical natural surroundings of Hurdalsjøen, with challenges suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The event also emphasizes community, a sense of achievement and nature experiences, with the start and finish at the hotel, which offers facilities such as a spa and good food.
course_highlights: Terrain with technical sections and flowing trails
Spectacular views from Buråsen and Buråskollen (540 m above sea level)
23 km distance with 1,000 metres of elevation gain and views over Hurdal and Hurdalsjøen
additional: All participants in the same distance start at the same time. The courses are marked with colour codes that match the race bibs. Carrying a mobile phone during the race is mandatory. There are 1–3 passes by aid stations, depending on the distance, and runners may refill their own bottles. Parking is recommended at Lundbybakken or Steinerskolen. The start and finish are at Hurdalsjøen Hotell & Spa. The start and finish are at Hurdalsjøen Hotell & Spa, Skredderbakkveien 9, 2090 Hurdal. The courses are marked, and carrying a mobile phone is mandatory. Free parking is recommended at Lundbybakken or Steinerskolen.

name: Konnerudløpet
description: Konnerudløpet 2027 takes place on May 29 in the scenic surroundings of Konnerud in Drammen. The race offers distances for everyone, from a children’s race to 21 km, and is suitable both for those who want to test their speed and those looking for a pleasant run. There will be a great atmosphere, varied courses and experiences for all ages, with free childcare and prizes for all participating children. Konnerud IL looks forward to welcoming runners to a wonderful race celebration marking the club’s 100th anniversary.
course_highlights: Scenic surroundings at Konnerud
Varied courses with distances of 5 km, 10 km and 21 km
Family-friendly, with a dedicated children’s race and prizes for all children
additional: Free childcare is available for the youngest children while their parents run. Every participating child receives a prize. The organizer lists free childcare for the youngest children and a prize for every child who participates. Registration is available via the race website.

name: Trondheimstafetten
price_range: 2500-2900 kr for hovedklassene; UNG-stafetten fra 1000 kr
description: Trondheimstafetten is a traditional 10-stage relay race that runs through central Trondheim and the surrounding areas. The race brings together teams from companies, clubs, schools and groups of friends, offering a social and inclusive running experience focused on team spirit and achievement. There is also a dedicated UNG relay for children and young people, with 6 stages in Nidarø Park and Trondheim Stadion. The start and finish are in Skanseparken, and the race welcomes a wide age range, with young people able to take part in selected stages.
course_highlights: 10 stages through central Trondheim and the surrounding areas
Start and finish in Skanseparken
The UNG relay has 6 stages in Nidarø Park and Trondheim Stadion
additional: Race bibs and diplomas can be collected together at Trondheim Spektrum in the days before the race and on race day. The relay baton is handed out no later than 30 minutes before the start at Skansenparken. There are drink stations at Kristiansten Fortress and Sverresborg Museum. Toilets and showers are available at Trondheim Spektrum and at the exchange points. Runners choose a start wave based on their expected finish time to improve race flow and competition. The main relay has ten stages, while the UNG relay has six and is for children and young people aged 6 to 15. Registration involves choosing a class and start wave.

name: Kragerø Sommerløp
description: Kragerø Summer Run is a community celebration in the heart of Kragerø, with 5 km and 10 km races and a free children’s race. The race starts at Jernbanetorget and offers a fast, scenic loop through the town centre, with a lively atmosphere and entertainment along the course. This accessible road race is suitable for all levels, whether you take part alone or with family, friends or colleagues. The 700-metre children’s race is free and gives the kids a fun experience, with a medal for everyone. The event also includes activities, stands and socialising before and after the races.
course_highlights: A fast, scenic loop through the heart of Kragerø town centre
A spectator-friendly course with entertainment along the route
A 700-metre children’s race with a medal for every child
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Sport1 Kragerø on Friday 29 May from 16:00 to 18:00, or on race day from 12:00 at Jernbanetorget. Collect your race number at least 30 minutes before the start. A relaxed social run (SAYSKY Shake-Out Run) will take place on Friday 29 May at 18:00, followed by buns, coffee and cordial. No registration is required for the children’s race; just show up. Runners are advised not to run with their own music playing in their ears. Activities and entertainment for children and spectators will be available on race day. The distances are 5 km, 10 km and a free 700-metre children’s race. The children’s race requires no registration and is recommended for children aged 2 to 10. The minimum age for chip timing is 12. Prices are based on the information provided for 2026.

name: Kvennstuguløpet 2027
description: Kvennstuguløpet is an annual race organized by Vallset IL in the beautiful surroundings around Kvennstugua in Vallset. The race attracts both young and adult runners and offers a wonderful race-day celebration with strong performances from local athletes. The event has an inclusive atmosphere focused on the joy of sport and community, and it is an important tradition in the local community. Participants can look forward to a range of distances and a great day in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Run in the beautiful surroundings around Kvennstugua
A range of distances, with competitions for both women and men
Strong local involvement and a wonderful race-day celebration
additional: The race includes distances such as 2.5 km and 5 km, with separate classes for women and men. The event is supported by many volunteers and has a strong club community. It takes place in glorious summer weather and is a social, inclusive race-day celebration.

name: Vestfold Historic Ultra Trail
description: Vestfold Historic Ultra Trail (VHUT) is a challenging trail ultramarathon through the best terrain in northern Vestfold, with only 6% asphalt on the long course. The race spans two counties and five municipalities, and runners pass many places of local historical significance. The course is unmarked, so participants must navigate using a GPS track, creating an authentic trail experience with the motto “challenging but fair.” Accommodation and transport are offered to make participation easier, along with drop-bag stations and aid stations along the way. VHUT welcomes you to a challenging and scenic ultrarunning experience in a historic setting.
course_highlights: Only 6% asphalt on the long course (147 km)
The course passes through 2 counties and 5 municipalities with local historical significance
Trail race with a challenging but fair course and GPS navigation
additional: Runners use GPS trackers. Accommodation is available from Friday to Saturday, with access to a WC, shower and kitchenette. Transport from Hengsrød to the start is offered for the 50 and 87 km distances. There are drop-bag stations for the 147 km (2 stations) and 87 km (1 station), with food and drinks provided. Aid stations with light refreshments are located at Hajern and Langevann, about 20 km before the finish. Parking is limited at the start/finish and checkpoints, and private support is not permitted at Hajern or Langevann. All runners must download the updated GPX files before the race. GPS trackers are used. Accommodation before the race and transport to the start for the 50 km and 87 km distances are offered; drop-bag stations are listed for the 87 km and 147 km.

name: Ecotrail Oslo
description: EcoTrail Oslo is an environmentally conscious trail race offering five distances in the woodland areas near the city, with the finish at Huk, Bygdøy. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, with distances from 10 km to 80 km, and features scenic surroundings and varied terrain. The courses combine forest roads, technical trails and some paved sections, offering a unique opportunity to experience Oslo’s outdoor areas and cultural history. The event places strong emphasis on sustainability and the environment, and includes services such as baggage transport, timing, and food and drink stations along the way.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest roads, technical trails and approximately 9% paved sections
The course passes through Oslo’s woodland areas, including Akerselva, Maridalsvannet and Sognsvann
Panoramic views of Oslo and a stretch along the Oslofjord, with the finish at Huk, Bygdøy
additional: The entry fee includes timing, participant prizes, baggage transport from start to finish, toilet hire, marked courses, an electric bus shuttle to the 31 km start, and food and drink stations along the way. There is no drop bag, and support is only permitted at the stations. Participants receive sports drink, water and light food in the finish area. Merino wool participant shirts are also available at a reduced price. Distances offered are 10, 21, 31, 50 and 80 km, as well as a 21 km walking distance. EcoTrail Oslo is described as an environmentally conscious trail race.

name: Tromsøstafetten 2027
description: Tromsøstafetten is a new celebration of community in central Tromsø, focused on togetherness, atmosphere and enjoyment. The race consists of eight exciting and challenging legs with varying surfaces, distances and elevation. There is room for everyone, whatever your pace, and you are encouraged to take part with family, friends, a sports club or colleagues and experience the relay spirit together. The start and finish will be near central Tromsø, and the race offers a unique opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings with a great atmosphere along the course.
course_highlights: Eight varied legs with different surfaces, distances and elevation
Start and finish near central Tromsø
Several different categories to suit all levels and paces
additional: The minimum age is 13 (born in 2014). Medals will be awarded to the three best teams in each category, and prizes will also be drawn among all participating teams. Results will be published during and after the event. The course and start/finish location will be announced in early 2027. The minimum age is 13. The course and exact start and finish locations will be announced in early 2027. Medals will be awarded to the three best teams in each category, and prizes will be drawn among participating teams.

name: Lindåstiaren
description: Lindåstiaren is a long-standing race in Lindås, first organised by Lindås IL in 1984. After a break of around ten years, the sports club is working to bring the race back. The race is scheduled for 29 May 2027.

name: Sørestrandmila Vår 2027
description: Sørestrandmila Spring is a fun run in Straumgjerde in Sykkylven, with distances of 3, 5 and 10 kilometres. The event is suitable for both shorter and longer runs on foot, bringing participants together for running in the local area.
course_highlights: Three distances: 3, 5 and 10 km
The race takes place in Straumgjerde in Sykkylven
The 3 km course has 4 metres of elevation gain

name: Farsund Maraton 2027
description: Farsund Marathon is one of Norway’s most beautiful races, running through spectacular natural and cultural landscapes. The race starts in idyllic downtown Farsund and continues out towards Lista, with distances suited to both recreational and competitive runners. The courses are designed to give participants a unique running experience, with good support from course marshals and refreshment and food stations along the way. The event has a friendly atmosphere and offers prizes to age-category winners and the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Run through spectacular natural and cultural landscapes
Start and finish in idyllic downtown Farsund
Refreshment stations every 5 km on the marathon and half marathon, serving water, cordial, cola and bananas
additional: Race administration is located in the auditorium at Eilert Sundt VGS, approximately 200 m from Torvet. Bib pickup and information hours are Friday 16:00–20:00 and Saturday 08:00–18:00. All participants receive a medal at the finish, and trophies are awarded to age-category winners, with gift prizes for the three fastest times in the marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km for men and women. This year’s T-shirt is given to the first 1,000 people to register. Toilets are located at the start and finish, as well as at Lista Lighthouse and Borshavn on the marathon course. Start times may be adjusted slightly, and time recording ends at approximately 16:00. A registration fee of NOK 15 applies, and a Norwegian Athletics Federation licence is automatically added at registration for those without an annual licence. Registration for 2027 opens on 1 December 2026. A NOK 15 surcharge applies to all registrations.

name: Totenvikaløpet
description: Totenvikaløpet is a race on a flat asphalt course with great views of Lake Mjøsa, suitable for runners of all levels. The race has been awarded "World Ranking Competition 2024" status by World Athletics and is therefore included in its official race calendar. This makes Totenvikaløpet an attractive event for both local and international runners looking for a fast, scenic course. Registration is through EQ Timing and is binding, with a focus on ensuring a safe and well-organized event.
course_highlights: Flat asphalt course
Great views of Lake Mjøsa
Suitable for all levels
additional: Registration is binding, with no refunds or transfers of entry fees. If the event is canceled due to force majeure, the entry fee will not be refunded. Registration is through EQ Timing. The entry fee is binding and non-refundable, including if the event is canceled due to force majeure.

name: HengUp
description: HengUp is an uphill race from Vassmyrane in Kinsarvik to the summit of Heng, at the start of Dronningstien. The steep but varied course passes through beautiful scenery and is designed to bring together participants of different ages. Join us for a race experience with views and community spirit in Ullensvang.
course_highlights: Start at Vassmyrane in Kinsarvik and finish at the summit of Heng.
Approximately 2.5 km with around 400 metres of elevation gain.
The course follows the first section of Dronningstien and has ten hairpin bends.
additional: HengUp took over from Blømingsmila. The first edition brought together 113 participants of different ages.

name: Monolittløpet
description: Monolittløpet is a traditional cross-country race held along the Iddefjord in Halden. The race offers a challenging yet scenic 9 km route with plenty of climbing and some steep sections. The start is at the velodrome at Ystehede, and the finish is in the square in central Halden. The race is suitable for everyone, whether you want to run, jog or walk, and offers a wonderful nature experience in historic surroundings connected to the area's granite industry.
course_highlights: A challenging 9 km cross-country race along the Iddefjord
Starts at the velodrome at Ystehede and finishes in the square in central Halden
The route passes through historic areas where granite was used for Vigeland's Monolith sculpture
additional: Monolittløpet has a modified route from 2024 for increased safety, with a trail via Brattskott and beneath Ørnerøys. Participants can take part at their own pace, whether running, jogging or walking. Monolittstafetten is also held on the same day, starting at 14:00, and a bus is provided to take participants back to the square after the relay exchange. There are several places to eat and drink around the square. The route passes through areas where the raw stone for Vigeland's Monolith was quarried. The route was changed in 2024 for safety reasons.

name: Monolittstafetten
description: The Monolittstafetten is a fun and inclusive relay with ten stages, set in beautiful natural surroundings along the fjord and around Hovsfjellet in Halden. The start and finish are in the square in Halden, and the relay is suitable for all levels, with stages of varying lengths and difficulty. There will be opportunities to socialize and relax at the finish, and a bus will take participants back to the square after their relay leg. You can also combine the relay with the Monolittløpet on the same day for an extra challenge.
course_highlights: Ten stages of varying lengths, elevation gain and difficulty
The course runs along the fjord and around Hovsfjellet through beautiful natural surroundings
Start and finish in the square in central Halden
additional: A bus is available to take participants back to the square after their relay leg. There are several places to eat and drink around the square. It is possible to take part in both the Monolittløpet at 12:00 and the Monolittstafetten at 14:00 on the same day. The stages range from 250 metres to 2.6 kilometres. A bus takes participants back to the square after their relay leg along the course.

name: Kalkmineløbet 2027
distance_verbose: 52.7 km, Marathon, Halvmarathon, 10.54 km, 6 km, 2.5 km

name: Eventyrsport SkyTrail 2027 - powered by Kari Traa
Seiklus x Tartu
description: Seiklus x Tartu on seiklusvõistluste sarja viies etapp, mis toimub Tartu linnas. Tegemist on ühepäevase seiklusvõistlusega, kus kolmeliikmelised tiimid orienteeruvad maastikul, liikudes jalgsi, kanuuga ja rattaga. Võistlus sobib nii tõsiseks võistluseks kui ka aktiivseks ajaveetmiseks sõpradega kaunis Eestimaa looduses. Rajal on erineva raskusastmega distantsid, sealhulgas jõukohane lühirada kõigile.
course_highlights: Rajale tuleb liikuda jalgsi, kanuuga ja rattaga
Lühirada on tehniliselt lihtne ja jõukohane igaühele
Rajal on mitu teeninduspunkti snäkkide ja joogiga
additional: Võistluskeskus avatakse kell 9.00, kus toimub registreerimine ja võistlusmaterjalide jagamine. Rajal on snäki- ja joogipunktid ning finišis pakutakse sooja toitu ja teed. Korraldatud transporti ega ametlikku ööbimist ei ole, soovitatakse kasutada isiklikku transporti ja majutust leida ise. Rada on ringikujuline, start ja finiš samas kohas. Võistelda saab kolmeliikmelistes mees-, nais- ja segatiimides ning osaleda on võimalik ka individuaalselt. Lühirada on tehniliselt lihtne. Võistluskeskus avatakse kell 9.00 ja start antakse kell 10.00; finišis pakutakse sooja toitu ja teed.

name: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve
description: The 55th Arco Vara run around Lake Harku is a traditional 6.5 km running race held on the shore of Lake Harku. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its second event. There are water stations along the course, which is marked and secured by course marshals. Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome and start in the final group. The event centre is at the start/finish area, where race numbers are also distributed and the awards ceremony takes place.

name: Koeru kergejõustikuvõistlused
description: Koeru Athletics Competition is a traditional track and field event held at the Koeru Secondary School stadium. Men and women compete in two age groups and take part in several events, including the 100 m run, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw, and 1000 m run. The winner is determined by adding the points from their three best events. The competition is open to everyone, and participants may enter all events. Young athletes use throwing implements appropriate for their age group.

name: Maardu kevadjooks
description: Maardu Spring Run and Health Walk is a traditional sports day held in Maardu, bringing together people of all ages who enjoy being active. The event features several runs and health walks for different age groups and abilities, including children’s runs, a youth run, a walk for people with special needs, and 3 km and 5 km runs. Participation is free, and every finisher receives a medal. The event aims to offer the joy of movement, a sense of well-being, and an active day outdoors, while highlighting time spent together with family and friends.

name: „Vilties bėgimas“
description: The Run of Hope is a civic initiative dedicated to fostering a culture of solidarity and hope in support of people with cancer and their loved ones. The event takes place in Klaipėda Old Town and offers a range of distances, from 0.2 km for children to a full marathon of 42.195 km. The race follows loop courses, allowing participants to enjoy views of the city while contributing to an important social mission. This traditional event brings athletes and the community together for a shared purpose.

name: HIT-felder Volkslauf
description: The HIT-felder Volkslauf is a long-established race in Seevetal, organized by TSV Eintracht Hittfeld. It offers courses for the whole family, from short races at the Peperdieksberg sports facility to longer routes on field and forest paths. The event starts at 13:30 and is known for its friendly atmosphere and extensive supporting program. All participants receive a finisher medal, and there are team classifications as well as cash prizes for the largest groups registered in advance.
course_highlights: Routes on field and forest paths, as well as partly paved side roads
Races over 600 m, 1000 m, 2.5 km, 4.5 km and 10.6 km, with short and long loops
Electronic timing; spikes are not allowed
additional: Start and finish at Hittfeld School Center, Peperdieksberg sports facility. Changing rooms and showers are available at the school center. Late registration is possible on the day of the event, up to 30 minutes before the start, with cash payment (except for the Roland-Witt Family Run). Supporting program with coffee, cake, grilled sausages and drinks. Certificates are available online at www.stgk.de. Team classifications apply to certain races. The group with the most advance registrations receives a challenge trophy and cash prizes. The event takes place in May, with typical temperatures around 20°C (high) and 10°C (low), and offers children’s races, walking and Nordic walking in addition to the running courses.

name: Leegebrucher Straßenlauf am 30.05.2026
price_range: Kinder frei; Jugendliche 3 Euro; Erwachsene 4 Euro
description: The Leegebruch Road Race takes place as a traditional running event in Leegebruch, welcoming runners of almost every age. Participants complete laps on the sports field and streets of Leegebruch. The event promises a lively atmosphere and is open to athletes of all ability levels. Registration is online via an external platform.
course_highlights: Laps on the sports field and streets of Leegebruch
Traditional running event with a family-friendly character
Suitable for runners of almost every age
additional: Registration is online only; on-site registration is not possible. There are no age-group categories and no awards ceremony. Changing rooms and showers are not available. Cold and hot drinks and snacks are available at the kiosk. Parking is available at the festival grounds on Lindenstraße. The race takes place on roads and in the stadium; registration is online; no changing rooms or showers; parking on Lindenstraße

name: 08. Dünenfeld Marathon
description: The Dünenfeld Marathon in Augustdorf is a special race held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large loops of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is partly trail-like. The start is at the level of the viewing platform, where runners can enjoy a beautiful view of the large dune fields. This is a private race with self-support and manual timekeeping; a photo of the clock must be submitted by email as proof.

name: 34. Emder Matjeslauf
description: The 34th Emder Matjeslauf takes place in downtown Emden. This long-standing city race has been organized by Emder Laufgemeinschaft e.V. since 1991 and is well known far beyond the region. In addition to the 10 km main race, there are school class and team competitions, making it a versatile event for all age groups. The course has been adjusted due to construction work on Neutorstraße, but still offers an attractive loop through the city. Emder Laufgemeinschaft looks forward to welcoming many participants and wishes everyone the best of luck.

name: Aegidius-Lauf
description: The Aegidius Run is a charity race in Hanover that has been established for over 20 years. The event offers several race distances, including children’s races, a wheelchair race, 5 km and 10 km runs, and walking options. The start and finish are at Aegidiushaus AUF DER BULT, and all entry fees go exclusively to charity. The course is attractive, and times are recorded with a stopwatch rather than chip timing. All participants receive a certificate, and the top runners are honored with non-cash prizes.

name: Nienburger Spargellauf
description: The Nienburg Asparagus Run is a traditional race in Nienburg, offering various distances for children, teenagers, and adults. The courses are officially measured and follow flat, partly shaded loops, starting and finishing at the Wesavi parking lot. In addition to individual and children’s races, there is also a 10 km relay, as well as company and club categories. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive prizes for the top runners.

name: Turm zu Turm Lauf
description: The 21st Turm zu Turm Run in Georgsmarienhütte offers runners a varied and scenic experience. The main 24-kilometer course links the prominent viewpoints Hermannsturm and Varusturm and passes through woodland, with around 520 meters of elevation gain. There are also races for children, a fun run, a 10-kilometer scenic run, and a walking course. The event is a sporting highlight for the Osnabrück and Westphalia region, with suitable courses for all ages and ability levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Ogród Botaniczny Uniwersytetu Zielonogórskiego, Zielona Góra, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Botanical Garden of the University of Zielona Góra. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Wielkopolska and other regions since 2014. The route in Zielona Góra consists of two laps, allowing participants to enjoy the natural surroundings and a challenging yet appealing course profile. The organizers are running enthusiasts who emphasize the aesthetics and character of cross-country routes.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Botanical Garden of the University of Zielona Góra
Two laps covering a total distance of 5 km
Picturesque natural surroundings
additional: The race takes place in the Botanical Garden of the University of Zielona Góra. The organizers are a group of running enthusiasts who have organized cross-country races with an emphasis on the aesthetic qualities of the routes since 2014.

name: RockRun Jarocin
description: Rock Run Jarocin is a unique running event combining sport, music and the atmosphere of Jarocin, a city known as the heart of Polish rock. The race attracts both experienced runners and first-timers, offering a route through the most interesting parts of Jarocin Municipality. It is not only a sporting competition but also a community of enthusiasts and a great sporting adventure that will stay with you for a long time. The event is part of the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix and emphasizes good organization and enthusiastic crowd support.
course_highlights: The route passes through the most interesting parts of Jarocin Municipality
The event combines sport with the atmosphere of a music city and a rock vibe
The race is part of the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix
additional: Details of the race pack will be announced approximately 2 weeks before the race. The event offers music, spectator, photo and finisher zones. Participants will receive a medal and a T-shirt at the finish. The junior race gives children a chance to enjoy their first sporting experience and the joy of being active.

name: Bieg Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema
location: Żelkowo, Gmina Główczyce, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema Run is a 10 km race held in Żelkowo, in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to different experience levels, with support from experts. The event is a road race for runners looking to improve their 10 km times.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging asphalt course
10 km distance
Location: Żelkowo, Pomeranian Voivodeship
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, with instructions and expert support. There is also an opportunity to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.
price_range: 50 zł za pojedynczy bieg lub 150 zł za cały cykl; biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe bezpłatne

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach głównych: 150,00 zł wpłata jednorazowa za cały cykl biegowy (opcja dostępna w elektronicznym formularzu zgłoszeniowym)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach dziecięcych i młodzieżowych jest bezpłatny.

description: The Masurian Running Grand Prix is a series of races held in scenic towns across Masuria, including Sorkwity. The 5 to 10 km courses run along paved, cobbled, and forest paths, offering participants a chance to enjoy nature. The event also includes races for children and teenagers in various age categories, with separate starts for girls and boys. Every participant in the main race receives a commemorative medal, and the organizer provides water and a hot meal. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and enjoy the beautiful Masurian scenery.
course_highlights: Courses from 5 to 10 km on paved roads, cobblestones, and forest paths
Races for children and teenagers in several age categories, with separate starts for girls and boys
Scenic Masurian surroundings near Sorkwity
additional: The participant limit for all distances at each race is 400. The race office opens 1.5 hours before the start. Race packs can be collected up to 30 minutes before the race. The organizer provides water and a hot meal prepared by local Rural Housewives’ Circles. The limit for the 2026 edition was 400 participants.

name: Dolska Dycha
description: Dolska Dycha is a 10 km road race held in Dolsk, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among the local community. The course is certified by the PZLA and marked every kilometre. It runs on roads closed to traffic within the Dolsk municipality. The event also includes a 3 km race, “Kozia Trójka.” Runners can expect refreshment stations, medical care, and a post-race recovery meal. The start and finish are at the Janusz Kusociński Primary School.
course_highlights: Course certified by the PZLA
Markers every kilometre and volunteers on more challenging sections
The race takes place on roads closed to traffic
additional: Race packs can be collected at the Race Office on event day from 16:00 to 17:30. A race pack may be collected by a third party or transferred to another person. No bag drop is available for participants. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes for the 10 km and 60 minutes for the 3 km. A refreshment point with water is located at the 5 km mark.

name: XI Bieg Memoriałowy
description: The 11th Adam Lewandowski Memorial Run in Orchowo is an annual running event organized by the Orchowo Municipality. The run commemorates Adam Lewandowski and attracts runners of various age groups and skill levels. The races take place on routes around Orchowo, giving participants the opportunity to compete and connect in a sporting atmosphere. The organizers provide professional support and attractive race conditions.

name: XV Kwidzyński Bieg Papiernika
description: The Kwidzyn Paper Run is an annual running event that began in 2010, born from a passion for running and promoting physical activity for health and fun. The 10 km race runs through the center of Kwidzyn, bringing together the local community and runners from across Poland. The event accompanies Paperworker’s Day, a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees, and participants can enjoy a range of free activities. It is organized by MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. and the MM Kwidzyn Care Foundation. Join the running community and celebrate sport and a healthy lifestyle together.
course_highlights: The course is 10,000 meters long and runs through the center of Kwidzyn
There are two checkpoints and two water stations along the course
The course provides participants with comfort and safety
additional: The event accompanies Paperworker’s Day—a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees—with many free activities throughout the day. The schedule includes the opening of the race office, a group warm-up, yoga and mobility, a meeting with champion Robert Korzeniowski, the awards ceremony, and a children’s race. Photos and video footage are taken during the race for promotional purposes.

name: XV Żmigrodzki Bieg Smoka
description: The 15th Żmigród Dragon Run is an annual running event held on the streets of Żmigród. Participants run a 10-kilometre course that combines sporting competition with the unique atmosphere of a local event. The race attracts both experienced runners and people looking to spend time actively and promote a healthy lifestyle. The fifteenth edition highlights the event’s tradition and its place in the region’s sporting calendar. The organisers warmly invite everyone who enjoys exercise and a challenge to take part in this sporting celebration.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometre route through the streets of Żmigród
An event with a unique atmosphere and local character
A race combining sporting competition with the promotion of a healthy lifestyle
additional: The race is part of local sporting events and promotes a healthy lifestyle. It brings together experienced runners and amateurs alike. Registration is online. The start and finish are in the centre of Żmigród.

name: Straumemila 2027

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barnemila er gratis ved påmelding før løpsdagen

description: Straumemila Running Festival is an annual event offering challenging and scenic routes in the beautiful surroundings of Straume. The courses follow walking paths by Skogavatnet and Ebbesvikvatnet, through Sartorlunden park and Straume town centre, combining asphalt and trails. The festival emphasises community, fun and competition, with a wide range of events for children and adults. Events include the 10 km, 5 km and Barnemila, with officially measured courses approved by the Norwegian Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: The routes pass along Skogavatnet and Ebbesvikvatnet
A mix of walking paths and asphalt
The 10 km course consists of two figure-eight-shaped laps, passing through the spectator area five times
additional: Warm-up starts at 10:40. The 10 km and 5 km start together at 11:00. The prize ceremony starts at 12:15. The relay starts at 12:35. Barnemila starts at 13:40, with a group warm-up from 13:10. Barnemila is 2.3 km long and partly follows the same route as the 5 km and 10 km. A licence is required to participate; a one-day licence is available. There is an administration fee of NOK 25 per entry. Barnemila is free to enter before race day; otherwise, it costs NOK 100 plus fees. The event takes place at Idrettsvegen 50, 5353 Straume.

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, Grorudløpet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dagsbillett SOLO Deltakere kr 475,00 kr 332,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Festivalpass SOLO Deltakere kr 1475,00 kr 1032,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

description: Grorudløpet is part of the Oslo Running Festival and offers a varied 12 km course that starts and finishes in Grorudparken. The race follows the Alna River and winds through Lillomarka’s enchanting trails, combining technical trails with gravel and asphalt. In 2027, the course will run in the opposite direction for a better experience, with trail running at the start and a downhill gravel section toward the finish. This race is suited to those looking for a scenic and challenging running experience in Oslo.
course_highlights: A varied 12 km course with trails, gravel and asphalt
Follows the Alna River and runs through Lillomarka
The course is reversed in 2027 for a better trail-running experience at the start
additional: Race bibs can be picked up from Löplabbet Oslo sentrum from 7 April. The same race bib is used throughout the series. The course will only be marked for the mass start. GPX files and course maps are available to download. A replacement race bib can be purchased for NOK 75 if yours is lost or damaged. You can run on your own from 21 to 30 May. The mass start is on Sunday 30 May 2027 at 11:00. The listed day-ticket prices are early-bird prices.

name: Jessheim Halvmaraton
description: Jessheim Half Marathon is a summer race offering both half marathon and 5 km distances, as well as a free children’s race for the youngest participants. The courses are flat and fast, run on asphalt around Jessheim, and start and finish at Jessheim Athletics Stadium. They are certified according to World Athletics criteria. The event is run by volunteers and supports sports for children and young people in Ullensaker/Kisa. It aims to provide an enjoyable experience for both recreational runners and competitive runners, with water stations and pacers for several finish times.
course_highlights: Flat and fast asphalt courses around Jessheim
Certified according to World Athletics criteria
Water stations on the half marathon course at 7 km, 10.5 km, 17 km and at the finish
additional: Children’s race for ages 0–12, approximately 600 metres, with free entry. Race numbers can be collected at Jessheim Ice and Multipurpose Hall on Saturday and Sunday. The half marathon has an early start at 10:00 for runners with an estimated finish time of over 3 hours. Pacers are available for several finish times in both the 5 km and half marathon. All distances finish at Jessheim Athletics Stadium. Distances: half marathon, 5 km, and a free children’s race of approximately 600 metres for children aged 0 to 12. The courses are stated to be certified according to World Athletics criteria. Proceeds go to sports for children and young people in Ullensaker/Kisa.

name: Risørløpet 2027
description: Risørløpet 2027 is organized by Risør idrettslag and is a trail race held at Kjempesteinsmyra in Risør. The race takes place on varied terrain and offers a wonderful nature experience for participants of all ages. The event is a tradition that brings together local and visiting runners for an enjoyable day of sport and community. The race starts on Sunday, May 30 at 11:00.
course_highlights: Trail race through varied scenery
The race takes place in the Kjempesteinsmyra area
A wonderful nature experience in Risør
additional: Organized by Risør idrettslag. The race starts at 11:00. No pricing or registration details were found on the website. No information about start waves, participant capacity, or late registration. Free 400-meter track race for children, with no ranking or timing. The children's race starts at 11:10, and registration takes place on arrival.

name: Vettisløpet

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 18-39 år og deretter 10 års klasser kr 250

description: Vettisløpet is a traditional race held on the last Sunday in May in the beautiful Utladalen valley, Øvre Årdal. The race offers a challenging and scenic course that attracts both competitive runners and recreational participants. It is a wonderful opportunity to experience the most beautiful race of spring amid spectacular scenery, with a joint start for the competitive categories and a separate start time for the recreational category.
course_highlights: The race takes place in scenic Utladalen, with varied terrain
Joint start for competitive categories at 13:00
Recreational category starts from 11:00 at Skåri
additional: Registration for the recreational category is at Skåri. The latest possible registration is at 12:30 on race day. Prizes are awarded for the fastest time in each competitive category, the fastest time for women and men, and a new course record. The race has recreational and competitive categories. The official website lists this year’s race as starting at 13:00.

name: Skaubygdaløpet
location: Dalbanen, Skaubygda Idrettspark, Nordre Frogn, Norway
distance_verbose: Halvmaraton, 7.1 km, 6.4 km, 3.7 km, 0.6 km, 0.2 km
description: Skaubygdaløpet is a forest race held in Nordre Frogn, starting and finishing at Dalbanen in Skaubygda Idrettspark. The race offers challenging off-road courses over 21.1 km (half marathon) and 7.1 km, as well as an untimed open course of 3.7 or 6.4 km. There are also children’s races of 200 m and 600 m. The courses follow hiking trails with challenging elevation profiles, making the race suitable for those seeking a technical challenge in forest terrain. The start is designed to spread out the field before the narrow trails, and the course is carefully marked, with video guidance at difficult junctions.
course_highlights: Run on forest trails in Nordre Frogn
A 21.1 km half marathon with a challenging elevation profile
The start includes laps around the track to spread out the field before the narrow trails
additional: Mass start for the 21.1 km women’s and men’s races at 11:00. The 200 m children’s race starts at 11:10, and the 600 m race at 11:20. The 7.1 km race starts at 11:40. Bus options are available from Nesoddtangen and Sjøskogen, with a short walk to the start. Late registration is available on Saturday 30 May and Sunday 31 May, with different bib collection locations. The start, finish and parking are at Dalbanen in Skaubygda Idrettspark.

name: Jentebølgen - Ålesund
description: Jentebølgen Ålesund 2027 is a race for girls and women of all ages, taking place on 30 May in Ålesund. The event offers an afternoon filled with a sense of achievement, togetherness and a great atmosphere, where participants can bring friends, colleagues or family. The race bib provides entry to the race, including insurance and ticket fees, and invites participants to join a unique community full of energy and the joy of running.
course_highlights: Approximately 5–6 km
Accessible course
No timing—walk, jog or run at your own pace
additional: The race bib includes insurance and ticket fees. The event is open to girls and women of all ages and fosters an inclusive, energetic community. All participants receive a medal. Young children participate for free; student ID or other proof of enrolment must be shown when collecting a student race bib.

name: Läänemaa sörgib ühissörk
description: Läänemaa Jog Together is a fun, relaxed family event taking place on 31 May at Haapsalu Railway Station. The group jog is about 3+ kilometres at an easy pace (~7:30 min/km), welcoming everyone in Läänemaa who enjoys being active. The event is the campaign’s grand finale, bringing together the various jogs held across the county during May. Both previous participants and newcomers are welcome to enjoy being active together and strengthen the sense of community.

name: Elsterlauf
organizer: SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda e.V. und Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Elsterlauf in Bad Liebenwerda is a traditional running and walking event, taking place for the 46th time. The event offers a variety of distances, including a marathon, half marathon, several walking and hiking routes, and children’s races. The course runs through the spa town of Bad Liebenwerda, with a family-friendly atmosphere and competitions for individuals, teams, and companies. All participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate, and awards are presented by age group. The event is organized by SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda and Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
course_highlights: A variety of distances: marathon, half marathon, 11 km, 5.7 km, 2 km, walking, and hiking
Start and finish at Roßmarkt in Bad Liebenwerda, near the primary school center, which has changing rooms and showers
Guided 11 km hike and family-friendly races such as the Bambini and fun runs
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the primary school center in Bad Liebenwerda. Bag storage is available from 7:00 to 14:00. The course closes for all distances at 13:15. There are company and club competitions with teams of three participants. Cyclists and hikers start without timing or rankings. Results are published online. Running event with online registration and various categories for runners, walkers, and families, including awards ceremonies and finisher’s medals.

name: Urwaldlauf
description: The Urwaldlauf is a six-hour race in which participants can run as many laps as they like on a 1.85 km course through the forest near Saarbrücken within six hours. The start time is flexible from 10 a.m., and participants can enter individually or as part of a team. The course combines wide forest paths with idyllic singletrack trails and offers a challenging 46 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event places great emphasis on flexibility and fun, with an electronic lap counter and refreshments at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus.
course_highlights: 1.85 km lap through the forest near Saarbrücken
46 metres of elevation gain per lap; more than 1,000 metres over marathon distance
A mix of wide forest paths and idyllic singletrack trails
additional: Bib pickup is available on site from 9 a.m. Flexible start time from 10 a.m.; the finish closes at 4 p.m. Electronic lap counter and refreshment station at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus. The field is limited to 350 participants. Late registration is possible online or on site; the late-registration fee is payable on site. Team classification available; make sure the team name is spelled consistently. Six-hour race, 1.85 km lap, approximately 46 metres of elevation gain per lap, forest paths and singletrack trails, flexible start time from 10 a.m., finish at 4 p.m., online registration until the Friday before the event, participant limit of 350.

name: ADAC-Tine-Flugplatzlauf
description: The ADAC Tine Airfield Run in Husum is a unique running event held on an actual airfield. The event is for the whole family and offers a special atmosphere for runners of all ages. Experience sporting ambition and a sense of community in the beautiful surroundings of Husum on the North Sea.
course_highlights: Run on an actual airfield
Family-friendly event
Beautiful North Sea surroundings in Husum
additional: Run on the Husum airfield, distances from 500 m to 10 km, family and children’s races, charitable support

name: 10K Hamburg - Elbe
description: The 10K Hamburg - Elbe is an exciting 10-kilometer race held at attractive spots in Hamburg, the city on the Elbe. The course follows fully closed and secured out-and-back routes on paved and asphalt paths. The race is open to runners of all ability levels and is officially measured in accordance with international competition regulations. The event is part of a cup series spanning several 10K Hamburg races, with attractive prizes.

name: 16. Campuslauf Technische Universität Braunschweig
description: The 16th Campus Run of the Technical University of Braunschweig takes place on the university campus. The run gives students and staff the opportunity to get active and spend time together on the university grounds. The event is part of the university sports program and promotes a sense of community and participants’ health.

name: 32. Tangerlauf
description: The 32nd Tanger Run in Tangerhütte is a traditional race through the Tanger lowlands, organized by SV Germania Tangerhütte. The course follows the River Tanger through the scenic Altmark countryside, which is especially beautiful in spring. The race has a long history dating back to the GDR era and was revived after reunification. The organizers wish all participants good weather and an enjoyable race.

name: 40. Göttinger Frühjahrs-Volkslauf
description: The 40th Göttingen Sparkasse Volkslauf takes place at Jahnstadion Göttingen and offers a varied range of races for runners of all ability levels. The event combines tradition and community, inviting both experienced runners and recreational joggers to enjoy an active day of fun and exercise. The distances are 2 km, 5.4 km and 10.8 km; unfortunately, the half marathon is not taking place this year. The event emphasizes health, well-being and togetherness in the region.

name: 9. Hellmich Parkhauslauf
description: The HELLMICH Parking Garage Run in Lehrte is a unique running event held in the Lehrte parking garage. Participants run a course of about 1 km through the garage, with the inclines and views of the city creating a special running experience. There are three different races with varying numbers of laps, suitable for both children and adults. Each race is limited to 50 participants to ensure safety, and every finisher receives a medal as a keepsake.

name: Wandermarathon TSV Bollensen
description: The TSV Bollensen Hiking Marathon warmly invites all fans of recreational sports to enjoy a pleasant hike through the beautiful Solling Vogler forest. The routes are circuits starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports center and run exclusively along forest trails. In 2022, the region was awarded the “Wanderbares Deutschland” quality designation. Refreshment stations along the route, as well as food and drinks at the finish, are provided. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and a relaxed get-together after the hike.

name: 13. Bieg 10km Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Run is one of the most important 10 km running events in Wielkopolska, held since 2012. It attracts leading Polish athletes as well as runners from abroad, creating a unique atmosphere filled with sporting excitement and energy. The course is interesting and varied, with wooded sections and a route through the streets of Swarzędz. The event also includes a Family Run and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns, adding even more excitement to the running festival.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Szpot
description: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival is a unique running event. The festival features three races: the 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon, the 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Run, and the 6th Szpot Swarzędz Family Run. The half-marathon course follows two loops around picturesque Lake Swarzędzkie, while the 10 km race offers a dynamic route with forest sections and city streets. The event brings together sport, education, and charity. Participants can enjoy a varied food area, partner expo, post-race meal, massages, and a charity auction. The festival is open to everyone, including athletes using active wheelchairs and seniors over 70, who can take part free of charge.

name: 5. Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon is a special running event taking place in Swarzędz. The course consists of two loops, covering a total distance of 21.097 km and running scenically around Lake Swarzędzkie. The race combines sporting excitement with professional organization, a unique atmosphere, and support from spectators, creating an unforgettable celebration of running. The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival also features 10 km races and a Family Run, making the event appealing to different age groups and ability levels.

name: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN Kupienino 31.05.2026
description: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN in Kupienin is a new running event taking place for the first time. The race offers a dynamic 5-kilometre course, ideal for fans of fast-paced running and sporting competition. The organisers invite all runners to take part in this event, which is intended to become a regular fixture on the region’s running calendar.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Fast, flat course profile
Picturesque surroundings of Kupienin

name: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challange
description: The Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challenge is a virtual challenge that takes you on a 198 km route through the vibrant streets and breathtaking landscapes of Rio de Janeiro. Travel from the Santa Cruz da Barra Fortress to the famous Christ the Redeemer monument, tracking your progress with a mobile app. Every physical activity, from running to yoga, counts toward completing the distance, and participants can enjoy an interactive map and Street View. Join a community that motivates one another and earn a carnival-inspired medal.
course_highlights: A 198 km route from Santa Cruz da Barra Fortress to the Christ the Redeemer monument
An interactive map with Street View in the final stages
Track a variety of physical activities, including yoga and strength training
additional: Participants have access to a private Facebook group where they can share experiences and motivate one another. For every 20% of the challenge completed, the organizer plants a tree or helps prevent plastic pollution. You can choose your own start date and challenge duration. The app is available on iOS and Android and syncs with popular fitness trackers.

name: V Półmaraton Po Kolei
location: Lemany, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 5th Po Kolei Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Lemany, near Szczytno. The half-marathon course is approximately 21.1 km long and follows scenic routes around the village. In addition to the half marathon, the event includes children’s races over various distances and a 5 km race, making it appealing to participants of different ages and ability levels. The event combines sport and recreation and is organized by the District Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Szczytno together with local partners. The main race is scheduled to start at 9:00. Participants can collect their race packets the day before or on race day.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course of approximately 21.1 km
Children’s races over distances from 100 m to 800 m
A 5 km race as an additional event
additional: On race day, registration is available only for race packets that have been released. The race office is open from 7:00. Participants must start with a chip and race bib, which must be returned after the race. Minors must have written consent from their legal guardians. The awards ceremony is scheduled for around 12:30.

name: X Charytatywny Gminny Bieg Między Wiatra...
location: Łukaszów, Gmina Zagrodno, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 10th Municipal Charity Run Between the Windmills is an annual running event held in Łukaszów, aimed at promoting running, sport, and a healthy lifestyle. The event is charitable, and all funds raised are donated to support those in need. The route follows a scenic loop around the windmills in Łukaszów, and participants can choose from several distances, including a children’s race and 5 km and 10 km runs. The organizers provide chip timing, as well as a hot meal and drinks for participants.
course_highlights: A loop around the windmills in Łukaszów
5 km and 10 km routes with a time limit of 1 hour 30 minutes
A children’s race of approximately 500 m on the recreation grounds
additional: The total participant limit is 200 across all distances. Timing is provided by Sports Timing Poland using reusable electronic chips worn on the leg. Chips must be returned after the race; a fee of 50 zł applies for a lost chip. Participants must check in at the race office, which is open on race day from 8:30 to 10:35. The organizers provide a hot meal, cakes, water, coffee, and tea.

name: XIV Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka
description: XIV Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka w Kostrzynie to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez Gminny Ośrodek Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji w Kostrzynie. Wydarzenie promuje aktywność fizyczną i zdrowy styl życia wśród mieszkańców oraz gości. Bieg odbywa się na trasie w Kostrzynie, angażując lokalną społeczność i sprzyjając integracji. Organizatorzy dbają o komfort i bezpieczeństwo uczestników, oferując dobrze przygotowaną infrastrukturę sportową.

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
description: The 39th Stolemów Run is an annual 10 km race held in Gniewino, attracting runners from different age categories. The event takes place at the Arena Mistrzów sports stadium and also includes children’s races, a Nordic Walking march, and a recreational run-walk. Participants are timed electronically, and medals and prizes for the top finishers await them at the finish. For those unable to attend in person, a virtual race option is also available during a designated period.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km main race
5 km Nordic Walking march
Children’s races over distances from 80 m to 800 m
additional: 11:00, official warm-up at 13:10.

name: Vårruset Sundsvall
description: Vårruset Sundsvall är ett populärt vårspringlopp som arrangeras vid Hamnträdgården med start och mål i centrala Sundsvall. Loppet erbjuder två distanser, 2,5 km och 5 km, där banan går genom stadens centrum och längs Selångersån. Det är ett motionslopp med tidtagning på 5 km och en härlig gemenskap, där lag kan delta och efter målgång bjuds det på picknick. Evenemanget är öppet för alla åldrar med rekommenderad ålder från 7 år i vuxens sällskap och är en perfekt våraktivitet för både motionärer och tävlingsinriktade löpare.
course_highlights: Start och mål vid Hamnträdgården i Sundsvall
Banan går genom centrum och längs Selångersån
Två distanser: 2,5 km och 5 km med kontrollmätt 5 km-bana
additional: Nummerlappsutdelning sker på Intersport i Birsta City dagarna före loppet. Lag om 5 personer bjuds på picknick efter målgång. Det finns möjlighet att välja bort tidtagning i anmälan. Omklädningsmöjligheter finns ej på plats, men det finns möjlighet att lämna överdragskläder i ett bevakat område. Vattenstation och toaletter finns på evenemangsområdet. Rekommenderad ålder är 5 km från 13 år (11 år i vuxens sällskap) och 2,5 km från 11 år (7 år i vuxens sällskap). Deltagarna får medalj, målpåse och nummerlapp. Lag består av fem personer och får picknick efter målgång.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: Stora Tuna OK och Kvarnsvedens GOIF Friidrott

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: ANMÄLNINGSAVGIFT 1750kr Lag (3-5 deltagare, picknickkasse ingår) fr.o.m. 8 maj

description: Blodomloppet i Borlänge är ett motionslopp som uppmärksammar den livsviktiga blodgivningen och välkomnar alla att gå, jogga eller springa 5 km eller 10 km. Loppet är öppet för både individuella deltagare och lag, där lag består av 3-5 personer som kan delta i olika distanser. Evenemanget avslutas med en gemensam picknick och erbjuder en inkluderande och social atmosfär för deltagare i alla åldrar och nivåer. Lilla Blodomloppet är ett kortare lopp på cirka 800 meter för barn och går i närområdet kring evenemangsområdet. Blodomloppet är en del av Sveriges största motionslopp med fokus på hälsa och blodgivning.
course_highlights: Löparslingor på 5 km och 10 km som går norrut över Sportfältet och delar sig vid Storsvängen
Promenadslinga utan målportal som avslutas vid frukt- och medaljborden
Lilla Blodomloppet på cirka 800 meter i närområdet kring evenemangsområdet
additional: Anmälan kan göras individuellt eller i lag (3-5 deltagare). Lagdeltagare kan delta i olika distanser. Lagdeltagare får picknickkasse. Efteranmälan för lag är inte möjlig efter 21 maj, men individuella deltagare kan efteranmäla sig fram till 28 maj kl 12:00. Efteranmälan på tävlingsdagen sker mellan 15:45 - 17:45 mot swish-betalning. Ändringar av namn, klass eller distans kan göras senast 21 maj via mejl eller på nummerlappsutdelningen 26 maj kl 16:30-18:30. Enklare kiosk finns på evenemangsområdet med endast Swish-betalning. Vätskestationer finns längs banan. Lag består av 3 - 5 deltagare och kan välja olika distanser eller klasser. En picknickkasse ingår i laganmälan. Blodgivare får 40 kr rabatt per person. Anmälningspriser och information för 2027 kan uppdateras.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/borlange/): 2027-05-31 — "31 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-27)

name: Head Energy Sommerkarusellen - 1. løp
description: HEAD ENERGY Summer Series is a running series organized by IL Gneist in Bergen, with several race dates throughout the summer. The races are suitable for different age groups and ability levels, and offer a great opportunity to take part in a social and active environment. More information about the course and registration is available on the club’s website. The event is part of Gneist’s wide range of athletics and sports activities.

name: Jentebølgen - Molde
description: Jentebølgen in Molde is an inclusive public health run held on 31 May 2027 in cooperation with Mental Helse Ungdom. The race is between 5 and 6 kilometres long, and participants can walk, jog or run on accessible terrain. The event offers a colourful, lively experience with entertainment, a mini-concert before the start, and a medal for everyone who finishes. Jentebølgen is more than a race—it is a gathering place for achievement, joy and community for all ages.
course_highlights: The course is between 5 and 6 km long, with an exact course map available
An accessible course that also allows participation in a wheelchair
A colourful Color Run with costumes, laughter and a mini-concert before the start
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the venue two hours before the start, but collecting them in advance is recommended to avoid queues. Jackets and bags can be left in a tent by the event office at your own risk. Companions participate free of charge upon presentation of a companion certificate. NOK 10 from each race bib sold goes to Mental Helse Ungdom. There is no timing, and all participants receive a medal. The stands open at 17:00, and race bibs can be collected at the venue on race day.

name: Meie oma maijooks 2026
