description: The event offers various distances and age groups suitable for runners, Nordic walkers, and recreational athletes of all ages. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle, provide an opportunity to compete, and celebrate family-oriented activities in the Kolga-Jaani area. Participants can enjoy a pleasant evening run on the shared-use path and at the stadium, with recognition for the top runners and representatives of the area.

name: Virtuaaljooks suvi 2026
description: Virtual Run Summer 2026 is a flexible, remote running event that allows participants to complete their chosen distance in their local area at a time that suits them. The event offers several distance options, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21 km), as well as the option to take part in a children’s race. Participants can record and upload their results to the GoAndRun.eu portal, ensuring that results are reliable and can be compared with those of other participants around the world. The virtual run offers a convenient, environmentally friendly way to take part in sport without having to travel to an event venue.

name: Vårruset Östersund
location: Storsjön, north of Badhusparken, Östersund, Sverige
organizer: Marathongruppen i samarbete med lokala idrottsklubbar, däribland Trångsvikens IF
description: Vårruset i Östersund är ett vårigt motionslopp som erbjuder distanserna 2,5 km och 5 km längs Storsjöns strand, norr om Badhusparken. Loppet är familjevänligt med rekommenderad ålder från 7 år i vuxens sällskap och bjuder på en härlig vårkväll med picknick för lag efter målgång. Start och mål är belägna vid Storsjön, och banan är kontrollmätt för 5 km. Deltagarna får medalj, målpåse, musikquiz och priser, samt möjlighet att välja tidtagning eller ej.
course_highlights: Banan går längs Storsjöns strand med start och mål vid Storsjön
Evenemangsområdet ligger norr om Badhusparken, nära Jamtli
Kontrollmätt 5 km-bana med möjlighet att välja 2,5 km distans
additional: Nummerlappsutdelning sker på Intersport Östersund 23 och 30 maj kl 11-17. Lag består av 5 personer och lagmedlemmar måste registrera sig individuellt. Picknick efter målgång ingår för lag och hämtas ut mot picknickbevis på lagledarens nummerlapp. Evenemangsområdet är lättillgängligt till fots, cykel eller med tåg till Västra station. Det finns vattenstation, bajamajor och möjlighet att lämna in överdragskläder och värdesaker i informationsdisken. 5 km-banan är kontrollmätt. Femmannalag får picknick efter målgång.

name: Jentebølgen - Trondheim
description: Jentebølgen in Trondheim is an inclusive public health race taking place on 1 June 2027, with a focus on mental health and community. The course starts and finishes at Torvet and offers two distances: approximately 5 km and a shorter route of approximately 3 km. Both are adapted for everyone, including participants using wheelchairs. The event offers a colourful, lively experience with a Color Run, costumes, a mini-concert before the start, and medals for everyone who finishes. Jentebølgen is also a place to connect and experience a sense of achievement and joy, with participation and togetherness at its heart.
course_highlights: The course starts and finishes at Torvet in Trondheim
Two distances: approximately 5 km and approximately 3 km, clearly marked along the course
Accessible course with the option to participate in a wheelchair
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the event venue two hours before the start, or in advance to avoid queues. Stands open one hour before the race starts, and entertainment begins 30–45 minutes before the start. Jackets and bags can be left in a tent by the race office; storage is at your own risk. Support persons can participate for free by presenting a companion certificate. All participants receive a medal. Companies and sports clubs can register groups at special rates.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a traditional running series event that began in 2016 and will take place in three stages in 2026. The runs are held on the Kambja health trails, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy forest paths and some asphalt sections. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and motivate people to take up recreational running. Each stage features a 10 km race, as well as a health run and a power run, which uses body weight and elevation gain in its calculations. Runners who participate in all three stages will receive a series T-shirt, and the grand prize winners will receive a Merida Big Nine 20 bicycle.

name: Blodomloppet Stockholm
organizer: IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö SOK
description: Blodomloppet i Stockholm är ett motionslopp som uppmärksammar den livsviktiga blodgivningen och främjar en hälsosam livsstil. Deltagarna kan gå, jogga eller springa 5 km eller 10 km, antingen individuellt eller i lag tillsammans med kollegor och vänner. Loppet är en populär friskvårdsaktivitet som avslutas med en stor picknick och erbjuder en social och meningsfull upplevelse för alla åldrar och nivåer. Det finns även ett Lilla Blodomloppet för barn och Specialomloppet samt möjligheten att delta på distans.
course_highlights: 5 km och 10 km distanser i centrala Stockholm
Promenadklass där hundar är tillåtna
Lilla Blodomloppet för barn 1-12 år
additional: Hundar är tillåtna i promenadklassen 5 km. Rullstol och stavar är tillåtna endast i promenadklasserna. Inga barnvagnar är tillåtna under loppet men på evenemangsområdet. Vid laganmälan (minst 5 personer) ingår en picknickkasse, med möjlighet att köpa till extrakassar. Det finns möjlighet att hyra tält för lag eller företag på evenemangsområdet. Starttider är uppdelade i flera grupper för 5 km och 10 km, inklusive promenad och tävlingsklasser med pris till topp 3 löpare. Laganmälan görs i lag om fem personer. Promenadklasserna saknar tidtagning; blodgivare får rabatt. Uppgifter om bansträckning och starttider för 2027 meddelas senare.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - SpareBank1 Kanthaugløpet
description: SpareBank1 Kanthaugenløpet is the second-to-last race in the Sørdalskarusellen spring season, starting and finishing at Birkebeineren Ski Stadium in Lillehammer. The race has a long tradition dating back to 1984 and offers a varied route of approximately 5.75 km, including asphalt, trails, grass-covered Olympic trails, and some challenging sections in Lyshaugen. Both a mass-start race and a virtual race are held, and the event attracts a large field of participants each year. The start is usually at 19:00, with a single mass-start wave.
course_highlights: The route is 5.75 km long, with varied surfaces: asphalt, trails, and grass-covered Olympic trails
The route passes through the floodlit trail, crosses bridges, and follows the canal with views of the Mesna River
Challenging sections in Lyshaugen include some forestry work and terrain that requires caution
additional: Registration closes at 18:00 on the day of the mass start. Race numbers can be collected at the tent by the red artwork from 17:45. There is a water station in the finish area and a toilet in Skistua. Lillehammer Red Cross Search and Rescue Corps is present in the finish area. Parking is available at the ski stadium, with the Apcoa flow payment system. A virtual race is also held, starting a few days before the mass start. Listed on 2 June 2027 in the Sørdalskarusellen race calendar. The registration window is listed as 29 May–1 June. The course route may vary from year to year.

name: The Arctic Triple Lofoten Ultra-Trail®
description: Lofoten Ultra-Trail is a spectacular trail race spanning the entire island chain, from Kirkefjorden in the west to Svolvær in the east. The race offers varied natural scenery, with mountain ridges, white beaches and grey cliffs, often with the sea close by. Participants run in the light of the midnight sun, making a headlamp unnecessary. The race is part of The Arctic Triple and attracts both elite and recreational runners looking for a unique Arctic challenge.
course_highlights: The race spans the entire Lofoten island chain, from Kirkefjorden to Svolvær
Terrain featuring mountain ridges, white beaches and grey cliffs overlooking the sea
The race takes place in the light of the midnight sun, so no headlamp is needed
additional: Registration and race bib collection take place at RETUR in Svolvær from Tuesday at 12:00 during race week. The race has support stations along the route, and the organizer provides all support to reduce environmental impact. The race is open to para-athletes, who can contact the organizer about accommodations. Lofoten Ultra-Trail is a UTMB Index race and awards ITRA points.

name: 5. ETAPP - Merimets
description: Stage 5 – Merimetsa is part of the 24th Tervisejooks ja -kõnd series, which takes place in the car parks at Pelguranna and Stroomi Beach. This 3.6 km stage gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and fitness trails in a coastal area. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers who want to spend time actively and improve their health. The series stages take place in different parts of Tallinn, offering varied landscapes and views.

name: Crosslauf Offene Kreismeisterschaften 2026
location: Sportplatz Rote Wiese, Wangelnstedt, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Open District Cross-Country Championships in Braunschweig are a long-standing competition hosted by the NLV District of Braunschweig. The event takes place at the Rote Wiese sports ground and gives runners in various age groups the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. It is open to children, young people, senior athletes and Masters, and promotes regional running in a varied cross-country setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country running at the Rote Wiese sports ground in Braunschweig
A range of age groups, from children to Masters
Long-standing district championships with regional significance
additional: The event offers a great opportunity to compete with other runners and improve your performance in a sporting setting.

name: Vårruset 2025 — Luleå
location: Luleå University of Technology, Porsön, Luleå, Sverige
description: Vårruset i Luleå är en del av Sveriges största motionsturné för tjejer och erbjuder en välkomnande och inkluderande löpupplevelse. Loppet arrangeras av Marathongruppen och genomförs vid vackra Porsön vid Luleås Tekniska Universitet. Deltagarna kan välja mellan distanserna 2,5 km och 5 km på en kontrollmätt bana. Evenemanget inkluderar medalj, målpåse, musikquiz med priser samt tidtagning för 5 km-loppet, och avslutas med en picknick för lagdeltagare.
course_highlights: Kontrollmätt 5 km-bana
Start och mål vid Porsön, Luleås Tekniska Universitet
Vattenstation och sponsorby på evenemangsområdet
additional: Nummerlappsutdelning sker på Intersport Luleå dagarna före loppet samt på evenemangsområdet på tävlingsdagen. Lag som anmäler sig får picknick efter målgång, hämtas mot picknickbevis på lagledarens nummerlapp. Omklädningsmöjligheter saknas, men det finns möjlighet att lämna överdragskläder i påse märkt med namn och startnummer. Toaletter och vatten finns på plats. Evenemangsområdet öppnar kl. 16 med sponsorby och aktiviteter. Uppgifter om distanser och upplägg kommer från Vårrusets officiella webbplats.

name: Bergen Fjellmaraton
description: Bergen Fjellmaraton is a half marathon from Montana to Skansemyren in Bergen. The course starts with a challenging climb up to Ulriken, followed by rolling terrain across Vidden and on to Vareggen, where there is a drink station. From there, the course continues towards Rundemanen and down Blåmansveien, finishing via the floodlit trail past the upper Fløibanen station to the finish at Skansemyren. The race combines beautiful scenery with challenging terrain, and the route is available to download on ut.no and in Lommekjent apps.
course_highlights: A challenging climb over the first 3 km up to Ulriken
Rolling terrain across Vidden and Vareggen, with a drink station at Vikinghytten
Finish via the floodlit trail past the upper Fløibanen station to the finish at Skansemyren
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Vikinghallen on 2 and 3 June from 10:00 to 18:00, with collection also possible on race day (without the expo). Participants must follow the marked course. All participants receive a finisher's medal. Race bibs can be transferred to another participant until 28 May. The course is marked with signs, flags and course tape. Protecting the environment and the drinking water source is important during the race. Race bibs must be collected at Vikinghallen before or on race day, not at the start in Montana. The recreational class has two start waves, and the competitive class starts at 19:30. Registration for 2027 opens in early December.

name: Valgamaa lahtised MV
description: The Valgamaa Open Championships in Orienteering Sprint is an orienteering competition held in the Valga area. The competition is part of the RMK Eestimaa Orienteerumispäevakud, family events with no age restrictions. The courses are designed for participants of different skill levels, and competitors can choose a pace that suits them. Timing is used at the competition, and an SI card can be rented if needed to help with orienteering. The event is for everyone who wants to enjoy outdoor activity and orienteering in good company.

name: Berliner Wasserbetriebe 5x5 km TEAM-Staffel
description: Die Berliner Wasserbetriebe 5 x 5 km TEAM-Staffel ist ein einzigartiger Staffellauf mitten im Berliner Tiergarten, der Teamgeist und gemeinsames Erleben in den Mittelpunkt stellt. Fünf Teammitglieder laufen jeweils eine 5-km-Runde auf einer landschaftlich reizvollen Strecke zwischen Siegessäule und Bundeskanzleramt. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch eine lebendige Wechselzone, eine festliche Atmosphäre und eine besondere Medaille aus, die den Zusammenhalt symbolisiert. Neben dem sportlichen Wettkampf steht das gemeinsame Erlebnis und die Freude am Laufen im Vordergrund.
course_highlights: 5 km lange Runde durch den nördlichen Tiergarten mit Schatten auch an heißen Tagen
Start mit Blick auf den Reichstag und Zieljubel in der Zeltgasse
Wechselzone im Start-Zielbereich als zentraler, lebhafter Treffpunkt
additional: Der Start erfolgt in Wellen, um Staus zu vermeiden. Die Zeitmessung erfolgt über einen Staffelstab mit integrierter Zeitnahme. Jedes Team erhält einen umweltfreundlichen Snack-Bag statt eines Picknickkorbs, und Teilnehmer werden gebeten, eigene Trinkflaschen oder wiederverwendbare Becher mitzubringen. Die Medaille ist ein besonderes Symbol für Teamgeist und Zusammenhalt und wird nach fünf Teilnahmen zu einer großen Medaille zusammengefügt.

name: Wydminy Night Run 5K
description: Wydminy Night Run is an annual 5 km race held in the picturesque town of Wydminy. The event is organized by HERON ULTRA TRAIL and local partners, attracting runners who enjoy the atmosphere of a night race surrounded by the Masurian countryside. The course passes through forested areas and along lakes, offering participants exceptional views and challenges. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and connect with others in the spirit of sport.
course_highlights: The route runs through forests and the Masurian countryside
The race takes place at night, adding a unique atmosphere
Views of lakes and hilly terrain
additional: The organizer is HERON ULTRA TRAIL. The event is a night race covering 5 km. No information is available about entry fees or the start time. The event is promoted on Facebook, where you can find updates and contact the organizers.

name: III Ryszewkowy Bieg o Puchar Strażaka
NATTMILEN 2026 - Sundsvall
description: Nattmilen är ett populärt nattlopp i Sundsvall som firar fem år 2027. Loppet erbjuder distanserna 5 km och 10 km med masstart och tidtagning, samt en valfri distans utan tidtagning. Starten går klockan 22:00 från Stora torget och loppet präglas av en folkfeststämning med musik, energi och after-run på restaurang Bloco. Nattmilen är ett evenemang för alla, från nybörjare till erfarna löpare, och har utvecklats till en av sommarens mest efterlängtade löparkvällar i Sundsvall.
course_highlights: Löpning genom Sundsvalls vackra stenstad
Masstart med tidtagning på 5 km och 10 km
Sveriges enda målfålla med bar sedan 2023
additional: Efteranmälan är möjlig på webben fram till 30 minuter innan start på tävlingsdagen, så länge startplatser finns kvar. Nummerlapp kan hämtas på Stadium City Sundsvall under loppveckan eller på plats vid startområdet mellan 19:00-21:30 på tävlingsdagen. Vätskekontroll finns utplacerad längs banan med vatten och sportdryck. Efter loppet bjuds det på after-run på restaurang Bloco med mingel och fest. Deltagare kan välja att springa utan tidtagning på valfri distans 5 eller 10 km. Deltagare under 18 år måste ha vuxet sällskap eller vara från 14 år för att springa på egen hand. Arrangören dokumenterar tävlingen med foto och film som kan publiceras, men deltagare kan avstå från att synas genom att meddela event@morron.se. Evenemanget dokumenteras i bild och film. Den angivna tävlingsdagen är 4 juni 2027.

name: Neveresting Hafjell
description: Neveresting Hafjell is a unique endurance challenge held on the ski slope in Hafjell on 4–5 June 2027. Participants hike or run up the slope, take the gondola back down, and repeat as many times as they can within the allotted time. Each lap covers 590 metres of elevation gain and 3.5 kilometres. The goal is to climb as many metres as possible, with the number of laps offering the chance to match famous mountain heights such as Galdhøpiggen, Elbrus and Mount Everest. The event is open to all ages and levels, with both individual and team competitions that encourage a sense of achievement and team spirit. It’s a festive event with race-number pickup, food stations and a social dinner for teams.
course_highlights: Ski slope with 590 metres of elevation gain per lap
3.5 kilometres per lap, with a gondola ride back down between laps
Opportunity to complete up to 27 laps over 36 hours
additional: Race-number pickup and the athletes’ meeting take place the evening before and early in the morning on race day. The 36-hour event starts Friday at 07:00 and runs until Saturday evening. On Saturday, there is also a 6-hour team competition starting at 10:00, in which teams of 4 work together to complete as many laps as possible. Food stations are available along the way, and teams are invited to a social dinner with a perpetual trophy presentation after the race. Discounted accommodation is offered to participants. Participants decide for themselves how many laps to complete and when to take breaks. A corporate and team competition for teams of four is also mentioned.

name: Lofoten Ultra-Trail
description: Lofoten Ultra-Trail is a spectacular trail race that spans the entire Lofoten archipelago, from Kirkefjorden in the west to Svolvær in the east. The route features mountain ridges, white beaches and grey cliffs, with the sea almost always in sight or right at your feet. The race takes place in the light of the midnight sun, so you don’t need a headlamp. This race is for anyone seeking a unique experience in beautiful and challenging surroundings, with distances ranging from 12 km to 100 miles.
course_highlights: The route covers the entire Lofoten archipelago, from Kirkefjorden to Svolvær
Terrain featuring mountain ridges, white beaches and grey cliffs
The race takes place in the light of the midnight sun, with no need for a headlamp
additional: Registration and bib collection take place at RETUR in Svolvær from Tuesday at 12:00 during race week. The race has a strong environmental focus, with support from the organizers along the way; external support is permitted only at selected aid stations. The race is a UTMB Index qualifier and awards ITRA points. Para athletes are welcome and are encouraged to get in touch before registering to discuss arrangements.

name: Lammasmäe Eesti Ööjooks - Rakvere 2026
description: This is a popular sporting event that brings running enthusiasts together and offers an exciting, atmospheric night-running experience. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Rakvere, giving participants a unique opportunity to enjoy sport and the urban landscape at night.
course_highlights: Night run in the city of Rakvere and its surroundings
Beautiful and varied scenery
Atmospheric and energetic race environment
additional: The event includes various distance options and promotes healthy lifestyles and community support.

name: Heider Abend-Stadtlauf
description: The Heider Evening City Run is a long-standing race in Heide, organized by MTV von 1860 e.V. Heide. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to compete on an attractive route through the city. The race is known for its welcoming atmosphere and the support of the local sports club. The course is well marked and offers a varied running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Heide.

name: Spargellauf
description: The WERNER Asparagus Run in Deinste is a 5.5 km relay race held annually, celebrating its 20th anniversary in 2026. Teams of five run together through the asparagus fields, using an asparagus spear as the baton. The race is suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to professionals, and the focus is on fun, as the winning team is selected by drawing lots. In addition to the race, there is a food mile featuring regional specialties and a family program with a bouncy castle and other attractions. A special race shirt will be offered for the anniversary, and a big after-show party will take place.

name: Stapelmoorer Run-Fun-Loop
description: The Stapelmoorer Run Fun Loop is a 10 km DLV-measured race that starts and finishes at the Teutonia Stapelmoor sports field. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Stapelmoor, with sections along farm tracks, school routes, and village streets. The event is part of the Teutonia Stapelmoor running community and offers runners a well-organized, varied course in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Warnemünder Stapellauf
description: The Warnemünder Stapellauf is a small running event held in June in Rostock, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Germany. It offers short distances of 555 meters and 9.3 kilometers, ideal for runners looking for a straightforward race experience. The courses have local nautical names that reflect Warnemünde’s coastal identity, including the 5 Seemeilen-Lauf (9 km) and the 3 Seemeilen-Lauf (6 km). Results are managed via my.race|result, and the event is listed in the laufen.de calendar.

name: Björnfrossa Ultramarathon
location: Kungsbergets skidanläggning, Sandviken Municipality, Gävleborg County, Sverige
description: Björnfrossa ultramaraton är ett 65 km långt terränglopp som går genom natursköna Gästriklands björnmarker med start och mål vid Kungsbergets skidanläggning. Banan följer huvudsakligen Gästrikeleden och bjuder på fin och bitvis teknisk stiglöpning samt inslag av grusväg. Loppet arrangeras av Björnfrossa arrangörsförening och erbjuder en utmanande upplevelse med cirka 1200 höjdmeter och fyra vätskestationer längs vägen. Deltagarna rekommenderas att bära obligatorisk utrustning som pannlampa och mobiltelefon för säkerhet och kommunikation.
course_highlights: 65 km terränglöpning längs Gästrikeleden
Bitvis teknisk stiglöpning och inslag av grusväg
Drygt 1200 höjdmeter och fyra bemannade vätskestationer
additional: Nummerlappar delas ut vid startområdet och ska bäras synligt under hela loppet. Obligatorisk utrustning är pannlampa och mobiltelefon med tävlingsledningens nummer inlagt. Det finns ingen drop bag-service, deltagarna bär med sig all utrustning från start. Sjukvårdare finns vid start/mål, men ute på banan ansvarar deltagarna själva. Max maxtid är 12 timmar. Tidigare loppinformation anger fyra bemannade vätskestationer, maxtid på 12 timmar och obligatorisk pannlampa och mobiltelefon; loppet är inte en sanktionerad tävling.

name: Söder Runt
description: Söder Runt är ett populärt 10 km-lopp som går runt Södermalm i Stockholm, känt för sin vackra och snabba bana längs vattnet utan uppförsbackar. Loppet lockar många löpare som vill slå personbästa och erbjuder en flack och lättsprungen bana på asfalt och grus. Efter målgång väntar en uppskattad After Run-fest med musik, mingel, mat och dryck. Start och mål är vid Tantolunden respektive Hornstulls strand, och loppet är sanktionerat av Svenska friidrottsförbundet.
course_highlights: 10 km runt Södermalm längs vattnet
Flack och lättsprungen bana på asfalt och grus
Inga uppförsbackar, många slår personbästa
additional: Vätskestationer finns efter 4 km och vid målgång. Barnvagn och hund är inte tillåtna. Alla deltagare får medalj och produkter i mål. Åldersgräns 14 år för loppet och 18 år för After Run. Betalning sker via hemsidan med kort, Swish, faktura eller bankgiro/postgiro för större grupper. Starten är preliminärt planerad till kl. 19:45. Banan är kontrollmätt och loppet är sanktionerat av Svenska Friidrottsförbundet. Åldersgräns 14 år; barnvagn och hund är inte tillåtna.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.soderrunt.se/): 2027-06-05 — "Jubileumsupplagan äger rum lördagen den 5 juni 2027 kl. 19:45." (was estimated 2027-06-05)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Jubileumsupplagan äger rum lördagen den 5 juni 2027 kl. 19:45.

name: Victorialoppet 2026
description: Victorialoppet är en traditionell löparfest i Borgholm som hålls årligen den 15 juli. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser för alla åldrar och nivåer, från Mini för de yngsta till huvudloppet på 9 km. Bansträckningen är snabb och lättsprungen med vackra strandnära vyer och en entusiastisk publik. Evenemanget har en lång historia sedan starten 1981 och skänker en del av överskottet till Kronprinsessan Victorias fond.
course_highlights: Snabb och lättsprungen bansträckning
Vackra strandnära vyer
Musikunderhållning på flera platser längs banan
additional: Nummerlappsutdelning sker tävlingsdagen 10:00-18:00 vid Borgholms Sporthall. Omklädning och dusch finns för män och pojkar i Borgholms sporthall, för kvinnor och flickor i Viktoriaskolans gymnastiksal. Vatten serveras längs 9 km banan och det finns musikunderhållning på flera platser. Priser delas ut i olika klasser och deltagare får medalj eller minnesplakett beroende på lopp. Tidtagning sker med engångschip för de flesta lopp, frivillig tidtagning för Victoriajoggen och parasportklasser.

name: BUM Borås Ultramaraton
description: BUM Borås Ultramaraton är ett ultratraillopp i Borås, arrangerat av SOK Knallen. Start och mål är vid Kypegården, med distanserna 50 km, 21 km och 10 km. Välj den sträcka som passar dig och upplev löpning i och omkring Borås.
course_highlights: Start och mål vid Kypegården i Borås
Tre distanser: 50 km, 21 km och 10 km
Ultratraillöpning i och omkring Borås

name: Osterøy på tvers 2027
organizer: Osterøy IL, Mjøsdalen IL, Fotlandsvåg IL og Bruvik IL
description: Osterøy på tvers is an annual running event from Bruvik to Hosanger on Osterøy. The race is organised in collaboration between several local sports clubs and offers a great opportunity to experience the island’s varied nature and terrain. Participants can choose between the competitive and recreational classes, and the race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners. The event has a long tradition and is well established in the local community.
course_highlights: The race crosses Osterøy from Bruvik to Hosanger
Varied terrain with both asphalt and gravel
Scenic surroundings on the island
additional: The race has both a competitive class and a recreational class. Results from previous years are published on eqtiming.com. The course map is available via Strava. The event is organised in collaboration between Osterøy IL, Mjøsdalen IL, Fotlandsvåg IL and Bruvik IL. The organiser’s website has a link to the registered participants and participant overview.

name: Hagebyløpet
location: Tennisbanen i Bergsalléen, Ullevål, Oslo, Norway

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deltakeravgift: 200 kr. for voksne over 20 år

description: Hagebyløpet is an inclusive running festival in the heart of Ullevål, Oslo, with races for all ages and abilities. The event offers three distances: a 500-metre children’s race in Halsparken, the Engelskmila (English Mile), a 1609-metre race open to everyone, and a timed 5 km race for teenagers and adults. The courses run across grass, trails and quiet streets. It’s a lively event with a great atmosphere, entertainment and activities for the whole family. All participants receive a medal, and refreshments and various activities are available at Damplassen.
course_highlights: 500 m children’s race on grass in Halsparken, with some hills
Engelskmila (English Mile), 1609 m on trails and quiet streets, open to everyone
Timed 5 km race on trails and quiet streets with pavements
additional: Refreshments including sausages, cake, waffles and drinks will be available at Damplassen. Entertainment and activities include a bouncy castle, a balloon clown, face painting and a shot-speed radar. There will be stands from partners. Public transport: Metro and bus 23 to Ullevål stadion, bus 25 to Eventyrveien, trams 17 and 18 to John Colletts plass. Toilets are available by the start area and at the Seniorsenteret at Damplassen. The start and finish are by the tennis court in Bergsalléen. Food and drinks can be purchased at Damplass, where there will also be activities and stands. Teams of at least four participants can enter the 5 km race.

name: Festaløpet 2027
description: Festaløpet 2027 is a trail race in Oppdal, Trøndelag, taking place on Saturday, June 5. The event offers two distances: a challenging 17 km trail run with 650 metres of elevation gain through mountains and forests and along waterfalls, and a shorter 5 km route on forest trails. The start and finish are at the old Festa power station, where tasty, nutritious food will also be served after the race. Spectators are very welcome to cheer, and a group training run is held three weeks before the race to get familiar with the course.
course_highlights: 17 km with 650 metres of elevation gain through mountain terrain, forest and gravel roads
Start and finish inside the old power station, with a sprint prize after 1 km
Aid station with sports drink and water before Rauhovden
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 10:30 on race day. Minimum age: 16. Carpooling is recommended due to limited parking. The awards ceremony is at 15:30, with prizes for the top three women and men, a sprint prize for the first woman and man through the power station, and draw prizes for all participants. Camping is available by the power station, with toilets and showers. Storbuan Gård serves food after the race, and showers and river swimming are available. Spectators can watch the runners by the power station after 1 km and at the finish. The race starts at 12:00, and race bibs can be collected from 10:30. The minimum age is generally 16. After the race, food and a café, showers and river swimming are available; camping by the power station is also possible.

name: Bystrandløpet Bergen3000
location: Amalie Skram videregående skole, Bergen, Norway
description: Bystrandløpet Bergen3000 is a fast 3,000-metre race that takes place around Bergen’s upcoming city beach. The course follows walking and cycling paths around Store Lungegårdsvannet and is suitable for all levels, from children to elite athletes and people with reduced physical function. The event is family-friendly, with professional timing, medals for children and an awards ceremony. Organised by Sædalen IL, the race features a flat, fast course that is perfect for testing your fitness or setting personal records.
course_highlights: The course follows walking and cycling paths around Store Lungegårdsvannet
Flat, fast course, ideal for setting records and recreational running
AIMS-approved 3,000 metres off the track, with timing at several intermediate points
additional: Starts are staggered at one-minute intervals, with heats of 10–15 runners based on expected finish time. There are children’s races, para races, recreational races, a relay and elite classes, each with separate start times. Results are published on the website, and finish times are sent by SMS. The event includes entertainment, sales stalls, a kiosk and an awards ceremony. Participants are encouraged to join the Bystrandløpet X Torshov running group. The race is inclusive of everyone, including people with reduced physical function. A 300-metre children’s race, BERGEN300, is offered. Timing is provided by EQ Timing, and 3,000-metre runners start in groups based on their expected finish times. Children receive medals, and prizes are awarded for podium places.

name: The Arctic Triple - Lofoten Ultratrail - inkl. NM
description: Lofoten Ultra-Trail is a spectacular trail race that stretches across the entire island chain from Kirkefjorden to Svolvær. The race offers varied terrain with mountain ridges, white beaches and steep cliffs, with the sea almost always in sight. Participants run in the midnight sun, creating a unique experience without the need for a headlamp. The race is part of The Arctic Triple, a series of three challenging races in Lofoten that also includes ski and triathlon competitions. Lofoten Ultra-Trail is also an official Norwegian Championship venue and awards UTMB Index points.
course_highlights: The race runs along the entire island chain from Kirkefjorden to Svolvær
Terrain featuring mountain ridges, white beaches and steep cliffs
The race takes place in the midnight sun, with no need for a headlamp
additional: Registration and bib pickup take place at RETUR in Svolvær from Tuesday at 12:00 during race week. The race is open to para-athletes, who can be offered an adapted course and logistics. Lofoten Ultra-Trail is a UTMB Index race and awards ITRA points. Relay and stage races are also available, as well as a 4-day stage race with luggage transport and accommodation included. The race includes the Norwegian Championships in 2027.

name: Sommerløpet
description: Sommerløpet is Southern Norway’s largest running festival, held in Kristiansand with the start and finish at Øvre Torv. The event offers distances for everyone, from a children’s race to a half marathon, and welcomes participants of all ages and fitness levels. The courses pass through some of the city’s most attractive areas, including cultural venues, the city beach and historic Posebyen, creating a festive atmosphere with plenty of participants and spectators. Pacers are available for several distances, and there are well-stocked water stations along the way, making it an inclusive and motivating experience for everyone.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Øvre Torv in central Kristiansand
The course passes Kilden Performing Arts Centre, Kunstsilo, Kanalbyen, Odderøya and the city beach
Water stations by the pedestrian bridge over the Otra and in the finish area
additional: Pacers carrying balloons are available for various finish times in the 3 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon. Race bibs can be collected at Løplabbet and Clarion Ernst Hotel. T-shirts can be purchased during registration and collected at the hotel. Maximum of 5,000 participants in total; some distances may sell out. Companions can run for free using a code. The Red Cross provides first aid in the finish area. Distances include the Children’s Race (600 m), 3 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon (21 km).

name: Byløpet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser tom 4. april 2027 (50 kr billigere før 5. april)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alle barn 0-10 år kan delta gratis

description: Byløpet is Grenland’s largest city race and half marathon, held in central Skien, starting by Arkaden. The 5 km, 10 km and 21 km courses run through scenic surroundings around Hjellevannet and offer a varied paved route with both hills and beautiful viewpoints. The event is open to everyone, from professional runners to families and school classes, and also includes a free children’s race for children up to 10 years old. Byløpet emphasizes the joy of running and public health, and provides accessibility for para-athletes. Race numbers are collected outside Sport 1, and there is plenty of nearby parking.
course_highlights: The course runs along the shore of Hjellevannet, with views of Skien city and Bakkestranda
Paved surface with challenging hills, including after the Falkum River and up towards Klosterøya
Water stations at Herkules and in the pedestrian street, as well as refreshments at the finish
additional: Start times: Half marathon at 11:00, 5 km at 13:00, 10 km at 13:30, Ibsen’s Children’s Race at 10:30. Race numbers are collected outside Sport 1. Free parking at Bygarasjen on race day. Accessibility for para-athletes with a guide or bicycle. Photos are taken during the race and may be published with consent. Ibsen’s Children’s Race is free for children aged 0 to 10. All participants receive a medal. Registration is through EQ Timing.

name: Oppegårdmila
location: Oppegård IL Clubhouse and Stadium, Oppegård, Norway
description: Oppegårdmila is an annual race organized by Oppegård IL, with distances of 500 m, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The race follows varied routes, including the Installatørrunden and The Well course, and is suitable for children, teenagers and adults. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with a warm-up at the stadium, race-number pickup at the clubhouse and prize-giving for different age groups. After the race, participants over 18 can enter The Well for free, making for a pleasant end to the day.
course_highlights: Micromila 500 m course for the youngest participants
Minimila 2 km course
Installatørrunden 5 km and The Well 10 km course (5 km x 2)
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the clubhouse on Friday, June 5, from 19:00 to 19:30, and on race day from 09:00 to 11:30. There is a warm-up at the stadium before the start. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men, as well as to the 1st, 2nd and 3rd-place girls and boys in the 12–15 and 16–19 age groups. All participants receive a participation prize. Participants over 18 can enter The Well for free after the race, but must register for this by Thursday, June 4, at 12:00. Previous editions have offered participants the option to run or walk against the clock, with a medal at the finish.

name: Tanangerløpet
description: Tanangerløpet is an annual race organized by Havørn Friidrett, aiming to promote the joy of sport and public health. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels, whether you are experienced or a beginner. The course starts at Tananger Indre Havn and follows Tananger Ring counterclockwise, on a scenic route that includes a footpath and an underpass. The start and finish are at the same location, and the event offers a great experience focused on community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: The course starts and finishes at Tananger Indre Havn by Hummeren Hotell
Runs counterclockwise around Tananger Ring, with a footpath on the left
Underpass beneath the roundabout at Myklebust for safe crossing
additional: Please arrive approximately 30–45 minutes before the start. There will be drinks and music at the 4 km point. Timing is recorded using a chip in the race bib, and net time is used. Toilets are available at Hummeren Hotell. Changing rooms and showers are not available after the race. Bags can be left in a designated room at Hummeren Hotell, but the organizer accepts no responsibility for them. The race will go ahead in all weather unless conditions are unsafe. The race bib must be attached visibly to your chest and contains a timing chip that must not be folded or bent.

name: Skredløpet
description: Skredløpet is a trail race that started in 2007 and has grown into a popular annual event with around 370 participants. The race is 8.5 km long with 444 metres of elevation gain, and follows a scenic route from the avalanche barrier at Aga via Svartetjødn, Rogdatjødn and Rogdo, up to Kvestadstølane, Måkestadstølane and Herseter, before descending to the finish at Reisæter. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys walking or running in nature, and includes adult competition classes, a short-legged race for children and a recreational class for those who want to enjoy nature at their own pace. Activities and social events are also held during Skredløpshelga, including an activity day and dancing.
course_highlights: 8.5 km course with 444 metres of elevation gain
Starts at the avalanche barrier at Aga and passes through scenic areas such as Svartetjødn and Rogdo
Highest point at Herseter, with great views, before descending to the finish at Reisæter
additional: The Kortbeintløpet has a bus from the car park at Aga to the start area at Rogdo at 12:00, and a return bus from Reisæter after the event. The recreational class can walk the course at their own pace, with a nature trail along the way. Freshly made waffles, coffee and squash are served at Rogdo and Reisæter. A team competition is held, with a minimum of 5 and a maximum of 10 participants per team. All participants in the Kortbeintløpet receive a participation prize, and prizes are drawn among the children. Participation earns 500 extra exercise points in the Solnuttrimmen app. The Kortbeintløpet is about 5 km and is for ages 7–15. It has not been confirmed that the stated details for the 2026 edition apply to the date 5 June 2027.

name: Graabeinløpet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Påmelding koster kr. 300,- for både 10km og 5km.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Påmelding koster kr. 300,- for både 10km og 5km.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Prisen for 10km økes med 100,- til 400,- 14 dager før løpsdagen.

description: Graabeinløpet is a family-friendly race held at Sletta sports ground in Sætre. The event offers 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a free children’s race, and is suitable for children and adults of all ages. The courses are officially measured and approved by the Norwegian Athletics Association, and run on both gravel and asphalt roads through scenic surroundings. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to class winners and the fastest boys and girls under 13. The event also has a kiosk, toilets and medical personnel on site to ensure a safe and enjoyable race experience.
course_highlights: The course runs on gravel and asphalt roads through Sætre town centre and the Chemring Nobel factory area
Start and finish at Sletta sports ground, with one 5 km lap and two laps for the 10 km
The course is officially measured and approved by the Norwegian Athletics Association
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:30, the 10 km starts at 13:00 and the 5 km starts at 13:25. There is a kiosk and indoor toilets at the stadium. The Red Cross is on site with medical personnel. An announcer makes announcements before the start, and course marshals are stationed along the entire course. Parking is available about 150 metres from the start area, with space for over 100 cars. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to class winners in classes with at least 3 participants. The children’s race is free, and all participants receive a medal. The organiser states that it will be set after summer 2026.

name: The Arctic Run
description: The Arctic Run is a unique island marathon held on Hadseløya in Vesterålen, Northern Norway. The race offers a scenic and varied course with a maximum elevation of 300 meters, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Participants can choose between a full marathon, a half marathon with views of the sea and mountains, and a 10K route that combines urban and natural landscapes. The event highlights the region’s stunning natural beauty, including views of Langøya, the Lofoten Wall, and the mountains in Bø, making it a memorable experience for all runners.
course_highlights: Marathon route around Hadseløya island with 300 meters maximum elevation
Half marathon with views of the sea, Langøya, and the Lofoten Wall
10K route through the city center, residential areas, and natural landscapes, with 79 meters of elevation
additional: The event includes a free 600-meter TAR Family Run at 10:00 AM on race day, with no timekeeping. Bib pickup is available from 08:00 to 09:45 AM at Hurtigrutemuseet. Food and drink stations are located at several points along the course and offer energy drinks, juice, water, bananas, nuts, chocolate, cookies, and dried fruit. Toilets are available at the start, finish, and along the course. Camp TAR offers drop-in showers, with passes available for purchase. Photographers will capture moments from the race, which will be available to purchase after the event. Shuttle buses run from several hotels to the race. The information page also covers food and drink stations, toilets, baggage storage, and pacers. A free 600-meter family run is also held.

name: Lysefjorden Inn Ultramaraton
description: Lysefjorden Inn is a 62-kilometre ultrarun through the dramatic landscape around the Lysefjord. The race starts at Oanes quay and passes Preikestolen Basecamp, Bratteli and Bakken farm before reaching Songesand, then continues through Daladalen and Fylljesdalen. Along the way, runners face challenging terrain and significant elevation changes, accompanied by fjord and mountain scenery. Welcome to a long and memorable challenge in Rogaland.
course_highlights: 62 km from Oanes quay to Songesand quay and onwards into the mountain terrain
Passes Preikestolen Basecamp, Bratteli and Bakken farm
Challenging climbs and varied terrain through Daladalen and Fylljesdalen
additional: The 2027 race date is 5 June. The course includes, among other things, the steep climb to Nordrestølstjern.

name: Ørsta Fjellmaraton
description: Ørsta Fjellmaraton is a sociable, informal mountain marathon in the heart of the Sunnmøre Alps, with distances for all levels. The event offers a full marathon, half marathon and short course in beautiful scenery with panoramic views, as well as a children’s race. The event has a low entry fee and emphasises health and the duty to cheer, and is known for its great atmosphere and high participant satisfaction. The course is mainly on trails and forest roads, with a drinks station and a simple kiosk at the finish. Ørsta Fjellmaraton has no race numbers or prizes and encourages an inclusive, sociable running environment.
course_highlights: The course is mainly on good trails and forest roads
Panoramic views of the beautiful mountain scenery in the Sunnmøre Alps
Drinks station at Mosetra and several good water sources along the course
additional: Multiple start times for different distances and levels: early start at 08:00 for recreational full-marathon runners, 09:00 for the competitive full marathon, recreational half marathon at 10:00, competitive half marathon at 12:00, short course at 12:30, and the children’s race starts continuously from 12:45 to 13:30. Registration for the children’s race takes place at the start. The race emphasises health and the duty to cheer, and participants can change distance along the way. No race numbers or prizes; timing is informal, and participants can write down their own times.

name: Sommernattsløpet Trondheim
description: Sommernattsløpet Trondheim is the big running celebration of the summer, with fast courses and beautiful surroundings. Choose between 5 km and 10 km; the 10 km consists of two laps of the same course. The course is officially measured and among the fastest in Trondheim, with minimal elevation, offering a great chance to set a new personal best. All participants receive a drink and a beautiful medal, and prizes are awarded to the fastest women and men in both distances. The event features entertainment and music along the course and is suitable both for those who want to test their fitness and those who run for fun.
course_highlights: Fast, officially measured 5 km course in central Trondheim
The 10 km distance consists of two laps of the same course
Minimal elevation and a chance to set a new personal best
additional: Pacers are available for various times in both the 5 km and 10 km distances. The start and finish are at Skansenparken to Havna in central Trondheim. Race bibs can be collected on behalf of other participants, and participants travelling from far away can collect their bibs on race day. All participants receive a drink and a medal at the finish. Company registration is available using separate registration forms, with a VIP package for groups of over 100 participants.

name: Skurdalen Trail 2027
description: Skurdalen Trail is a trail race in scenic surroundings near Fagerli Leirskole in Skurdalen. The course offers challenging mountain terrain with spectacular views of Hallingskarvet and Hardangervidda, including the well-known Hovdetrappa. The event offers distances for the whole family, from a fun Kids Trail to a challenging 18 km course with demanding trails and mountain scenery. After the race, participants can enjoy a social gathering with a barbecue buffet, sauna and concert, making it a complete experience for runners and spectators alike.
course_highlights: The course passes via Hovdetrappa, with great views of Hallingskarvet and Hardangervidda
Trail running in challenging mountain terrain with bogs, climbs and mountain farms
Shared start and finish at Fagerli Leirskole, followed by a social get-together and After Trail
additional: Shared start and finish area at Fagerli Leirskole. Soup is served at the finish. GPS tracking of the races is available. After Trail includes a sauna at Bygdebadstua and a barbecue buffet at Fagerli, with a concert and social gathering. Mandatory equipment for the 12 km and 18 km includes a downloaded GPX course file and first-aid equipment. Participants must bring a mobile phone with the organizer’s number. Pacing and outside assistance are not permitted. Participation is at your own risk. The start and finish are at Fagerli Leirskole. Accommodation is available at Fagerli for race weekend. The race distances listed are 18 km, 12 km, 5 km and Kids Trail.

name: Lyngstadfjellet rundt
description: Lyngstadfjellet Rundt is a long-standing race organized by Hustadvika Sportsklubb that goes around Lyngstadfjellet. The race is approximately 12 km long, starting and finishing at the clubhouse in Lyngstad. It is a recreational class with timing, and all participants receive a commemorative pin. The top three women and men are awarded prizes.
course_highlights: Race around Lyngstadfjellet
Approximately 12 km
Start and finish at the clubhouse in Lyngstad
additional: A commemorative pin for all participants. Prizes for the top three women and men. The race began in 1976 and returned in 2026 after a long break.

name: Haugesunds Avis halvmaraton 2027
description: Haugesunds Avis Half Marathon and Fun Run is a traditional recreational running event held in Haugesund, starting and finishing at Haugesund Athletics Stadium. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, relay, 5 km fun run, and a children’s marathon for the youngest participants. The course runs partly along sidewalks and inside the stadium, offering both recreational and more experienced runners the chance to take part in a well-organized race in scenic surroundings. The event is inclusive, with options for all ages and levels.
course_highlights: The half marathon and relay start at Haugesund Athletics Stadium
The 5 km fun run follows a certified measured loop, starting and finishing inside the athletics track
Children’s marathon of approximately 750 metres for children aged 0 to 12, starting at the stadium
additional: The children’s marathon starts at 11:30, the 5 km fun run at 12:00, and the half marathon and relay at 13:00. The 5 km course is a loop on the same course as the half marathon, adjusted to the correct distance inside the stadium. Previous editions have also included a 5 km, relay, and children’s race.

name: Stomperudløpet 2027
description: Stomperudløpet is an annual race held at Sørum Stadium in Akershus. The race offers two distances, 6 km and 15 km. The longer course was recently adjusted from 16.5 km to 15 km following positive feedback. The route passes through varied terrain, including gravel roads, trails and sections of old routes, and offers scenic surroundings such as Flaenhytta and the lean-to shelter on Jultonåsen. The race is suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners looking for a challenging and enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: The route runs from Lørenfallet via Aasgaardveien (gravel road) to Bølerteiet
Trail up to Tømtekoia and on to Svartputtveien
Up to Flaenhytta and the lean-to shelter on Jultonåsen before returning to Lørenfallet

name: Søndre Nordstrandsløpet
description: Søndre Nordstrandsløpet is an inclusive community race held at Holmlia Square in Oslo. The race offers several distances, from 500 metres for the youngest participants in the Løveløpet to a new, challenging 16 km course. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas along the Ljanselva river and at Hvervenbukta, and suit all levels, with both timed and accessible options. All distances share the same start and finish, and the event concludes with an awards ceremony and medals for all participants.
course_highlights: The routes pass through some of Søndre Nordstrand’s most beautiful natural areas, including the Ljanselva river and Hvervenbukta
Several distances, with a shared start and finish at Holmlia Square outside MENY
New 16 km distance combining 10 km and 6 km laps, with timing
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day: Løveløpet from 08:45 to 09:30, and the other distances from 09:45 to 10:45. There is a group warm-up before all distances, led by an instructor from Lia Trening. Toilets are available on the second floor of Holmlia Shopping Centre from 09:00. Bag storage is available at the race office/OBOS tent, at your own risk. All participants receive a medal. MENY provides prizes for the fastest runners. Coloured markers along the course indicate which distance to follow: blue (500 m), yellow (3.3 km), red (6 km), green (10 km), green/red (16 km). The latest available race information is for 2026 and lists distances from 500 metres to 16 km. Holmlia station is about a five-minute walk from the start area.

name: Peura Trail
distance_verbose: 102 km, 51 km, 37 km, 23 km, 13 km, 6 km

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The Jaanikese running cross-country race is the second event in the series and takes place at the Jaanikese Motor and Leisure Centre. The course features varied terrain suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event offers the chance to enjoy a sporting competition in beautiful natural surroundings and is part of the centre’s active running and cycling trail.

name: Padise liigub
description: Padise liigub is part of the Lääne-Harju movement series and takes place at the Padise community centre of the Lääne-Harju Cultural Centre. The route passes through Padise’s beautiful landscape, offering excitement and scenic views for runners, walkers and Nordic walkers. The event is suitable for the whole family, with children’s races in addition to the main 5 km distance. It is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy being active in a historic and naturally beautiful setting.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The 2nd Jaanikese Cross-Country Run takes place at the Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Centre and is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa Running and Walking Series. The event offers several distances, including children’s races, a 2.7 km run and walk, and the main 5.4 km run. The courses follow the cross-country track, giving participants the chance to enjoy a sporting competition across different age groups. The event is organised by the Valgamaa Sports Association, which welcomes everyone interested in running to take part and enjoy an active day.

name: SunRun
description: SunRun Saaremaa 2026 is a team running experience held amid Saaremaa’s beautiful natural scenery. The run starts at sunrise in Kuressaare and finishes at sunset at Illiku laid in Orissaare, covering a total of 180 km. Any group, circle of friends, or sports club can take part by forming a team and dividing the distance among its members. The aim is not to win, but to run together with friends at a comfortable pace and enjoy the experience. Each participant receives a GPS wristband that serves as a baton, and there are refreshment and food stations along the course.

name: Samogitia Ultra 2027 - Where Dreams Go to Die
description: Samogitia Ultra is a unique endurance race held in the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai, Lithuania. Participants run a 6.7 km forest trail loop every hour on the hour, continuing until only one runner remains, known as the Last Man Standing. The race challenges runners' endurance, strategy, and grit, with a minimum of 7 loops required to earn a medal. The course features about 70 meters of elevation gain per loop and is set in a beautiful natural reserve.
course_highlights: 6.7 km forest trail loop with about 70 meters of elevation gain
Course runs through the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai
100% forest single- and double-track trails and gravel; the same loop is run day and night
additional: Runners must complete each 6.7 km loop within one hour or be eliminated. A minimum of 7 loops (46.9 km) is required to earn a medal. Runners receive warnings 3, 2, and 1 minute before each loop. Personal tents can be set up from 6 PM the day before the race near the start gate. Toilets are available about 50 meters from base camp. Water and hot water are available at base camp. There are no showers, but a clean lake is nearby. Walking during the race is allowed and recommended. Personal items can be left in tents, but are not the organizer's responsibility. The event has a tent base and aid stations, but there are restrictions on support along the course.

name: Olimpinės dienos bėgimo renginiai
description: The Olympic Day running events in Kaunas invite city residents and visitors to take part in a range of free sports activities. The event offers several running distances: a 500-metre children’s run, a 1,988-metre Lithuanian Olympic Mile, and 5- and 10-kilometre races. In addition to running, participants can try an extreme obstacle run, orienteering, and a 3×3 basketball tournament. The event aims to bring communities together and promote an active lifestyle, while also offering the chance to meet professional athletes and Olympians.
course_highlights: 500-metre children’s run
1,988-metre Lithuanian Olympic Mile
5- and 10-kilometre races
additional: More than 15,000 prizes will be handed out to participants. Visitors can also take part in educational and Olympic education events and games, and meet Olympians. The event is free and focused on mass participation and bringing communities together. More than 100 activities, runs, tournaments, educational events, a concert, and a film screening.

name: Vilkaču maratons
description: Vilkaču Marathon is a challenging 42-kilometer marathon along forest trails in Tukums Municipality, considered one of the toughest marathons. The course includes more than 2,000 meters of elevation gain on steep and very steep climbs, and participants must complete thirteen laps, passing the race center several times. During the race, a hydration and food station is available in the start/finish area, and the winner receives 25% of all participants’ entry fees. This marathon offers seven hours of racing in a forest, among hills and in a place steeped in legends, where participants compete against themselves and the clock.
course_highlights: 42 km along forest trails with more than 2,000 meters of elevation gain
Thirteen laps, passing the race center several times
Steep and very steep climbs on the slopes of Āžu Hill
additional: A hydration and food station, staffed by the marathon chef, is available in the start/finish area.

name: 19. Lauf zwischen den Meeren
description: The Lauf zwischen den Meeren is a unique relay race that takes participants as a team along a 92.2-kilometre route from Husum on the North Sea to Damp on the Baltic Sea. The route crosses Schleswig-Holstein and connects the coasts of the two seas, with up to ten athletes per team running together. The race promotes both individual performance and camaraderie, attracting up to 800 teams from recreational and elite running. The fastest relays take about 5 hours and 10 minutes and reach the finish at around 14:15.
course_highlights: 92.2-kilometre route from Husum to Damp
10 varied stages ranging from 6.9 to 11.5 kilometres
The route passes through flat North Frisia, historic towns, along the Schlei and through the terminal moraine landscape of Schwansen
additional: The entry fee is per team (5–10 runners). Teams registering for the corporate category pay an additional 19% VAT. The race starts at the harbour point in Husum and is organised by LAV Husum. The route has 10 changeover points and is temporarily closed at railway crossings.

name: 3. Abend-Kanallauf Rethmar
location: Sportgelände des MTV Rethmar, Sehnde, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: MTV Rethmar von 1900 e.V. - Sparte Laufen
description: The 3rd Evening Canal Run Rethmar 2026 is a versatile running event at the MTV Rethmar sports grounds in Sehnde. Distances range from 400 m for the Bambini to the Kalimandscharo Half Marathon over 21.1 km. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured and eligible for rankings, with a light cross-country character. The event takes place in all weather and is open to runners of all age groups, whether or not they belong to a club.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km and 10 km courses with a light cross-country character
Kalimandscharo Half Marathon course over 21.1 km
A range of distances from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon
additional: The late entry fee of EUR 3.00 is waived for the 400 m and 1,500 m races for all U18 age groups. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured and eligible for rankings. Age-group classification is in accordance with the DLO. Measured courses, cross-country character, online registration, results published after the race, event held in all weather, various age groups

name: 41. Internationaler Sollinglauf
organizer: Laufgruppe des Dasseler Sport-Clubs von 1920 e.V.
description: The 41st International Solling Run takes place in the Solling area near Dassel. The event offers various race distances, from 400 m to the Leaders Akademie Solling Marathon over 42.5 km. The routes pass through the diverse landscape of the Solling and offer suitable options for ambitious runners, recreational runners, and walkers. The event is organized by Dasseler Sport-Club von 1920 e.V. and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive prize money.

name: Below- Gedenk- und Heidelauf
description: The Below Memorial and Heath Run is a traditional race through the Wittstock Heath and forest, held annually by LC Dosse Wittstock e.V. The 8.5 km course is open to women, men and young people and offers varied natural scenery. In addition to the main race, there are classifications for young people and schoolchildren, as well as a school cup classification. The event is part of the Brandenburg Cup and is known for its friendly atmosphere, with trophies for the overall winners and certificates for all participants.

name: Finkenwerder Insellauf (mit HH-Meisterschaften 5 km)
description: The Finkenwerder Island Run takes place in Finkenwerder, Hamburg, and offers a varied range of races for all age groups. The main races follow an accurately measured, flat 5 km loop through green spaces and along the Elbe, ideal for fast times and the Hamburg 5 km Championships. In addition to the main distances, there are age-appropriate races for children and young people, as well as relay and walking events. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish right at Finkenwerder Market Square, and its sustainable approach, including reusable cups and recycled medals.

name: Oranienburger Stundenlauf
description: The Oranienburg Hour Run is a varied track running competition behind Oranienburg Palace. The event offers various races with time limits of 15, 30 and 60 minutes, as well as a 400-metre children’s race and Nordic walking. Races are divided by age group and gender, and all laps completed within the time limit count. Every finisher receives a medal, and certificates and awards ceremonies are provided for the top runners.

name: Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow LC/NLC
description: The Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow is a traditional running event held in Güstrow, Germany. The event is organized by Tri Fun Güstrow e. V. and offers various distances for different age groups. The main event is a 10 km race for runners aged U20 and above, complemented by shorter races for young people and children. The 48th edition of this local event takes place at the InselseeHeidberg beach and promises a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.

name: Usedom Beach Marathon - 6. Juni 2026
description: The Usedom Beach Marathon is Germany’s first beach marathon and takes place on the island of Usedom. The races run exclusively over sand along the Baltic Sea beach, with no asphalt or road traffic, offering a unique natural running experience right by the sea. Participants can choose from the marathon, half marathon, 10 km short-distance race, or marathon relay. The event combines a sporting challenge with a special beach atmosphere and a professional program in the finish area in Ahlbeck.

name: Volkslauf des MTV Soltau powered by Stadtwerke Soltau
description: Der Volkslauf des MTV Soltau powered by Stadtwerke Soltau ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf in Soltau, der Läufer aller Altersklassen willkommen heißt. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine sportliche Herausforderung in einer freundlichen und familiären Atmosphäre. Der Lauf fördert die Gemeinschaft und den Breitensport in der Region und wird von engagierten lokalen Partnern unterstützt.

name: Wremer Deichlauf
description: Der Wremer Deichlauf ist das traditionelle Highlight der Sportsaison des TuS Wremen 09 und lädt alle Laufsportfreund*innen herzlich ein. Angeboten werden zwei Strecken: eine kurze Runde über 5.300 Meter und eine lange Strecke über 15.900 Meter durch die grüne Marsch. Die Strecken verlaufen überwiegend auf asphaltierten Rad- und Wirtschaftswegen und führen auch außendeichs direkt an der Wasser- und Wattkante entlang. Auf der kurzen Runde gibt es zudem einen gesonderten Walkingwettbewerb.
course_highlights: Streckenführung überwiegend auf asphaltierten Rad- und Wirtschaftswegen
Lauf direkt an der Wasser- und Wattkante auf dem Treibselräumweg
Zwei Streckenlängen: 5,3 km und 15,9 km durch die grüne Marsch
additional: Walkingwettbewerb auf der 5.300 Meter Runde

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
location: Fort Poznań Event Place, Poznań, Poland
description: Poznańska Piwna Mila to cykl biegów na dystansie mili, które łączą rywalizację sportową z pasją biegania oraz propagowaniem aktywnego stylu życia. Impreza odbywa się w Fort Poznań Event Place w Poznaniu i przyciąga biegaczy chcących zmierzyć się na krótkim, dynamicznym dystansie. Atmosfera wydarzenia sprzyja zarówno sportowej rywalizacji, jak i integracji uczestników.
course_highlights: Bieg na dystansie jednej mili
Organizacja w Fort Poznań Event Place
Cykl biegów łączący sport i pasję biegania

name: MnO Jaszczur i Czerwony Most
description: Maraton na Orientację "Jaszczur i Czerwony Most" to impreza organizowana przez Zgromadzenie Wędrownicze w Koszalinie. Jest to wydarzenie dla miłośników biegania na orientację, łączące sportową rywalizację z eksploracją terenów. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na wymagające trasy i atmosferę przygody. Impreza ma charakter kameralny i odbywa się w malowniczych okolicach.
course_highlights: Trasy biegnące przez zróżnicowany teren
Elementy biegu na orientację wymagające nawigacji
Malownicze okolice Koszalina

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika is a unique street race held in the magical setting of Toruń, the city of Nicolaus Copernicus. Participants can choose between the 10 km and 5 km distances, and can also take part in Nordic Walking. The race starts in the evening, offering an unforgettable experience of the city’s nighttime atmosphere. The finish is at the Municipal Stadium, and the organizers provide a bag drop and support from volunteers.
course_highlights: The 10 km course starts at Galeria Copernicus, 15 Żółkiewskiego Street
The 5 km and Nordic Walking start at Józef Piłsudski Bridge, Camping Tramp, Dybowska Street
Finish at the Municipal Stadium, 23/29 Bema Street
additional: The time limit for the 10 km is 1 hour 20 minutes. The time limit for the 5 km is 50 minutes, and for Nordic Walking it is 60 minutes. The race office is located at Galeria Copernicus next to the Decathlon store and is open on June 6 from 15:00 to 21:00. The organizer provides a bag drop at the start and transports belongings to the finish. Volunteers hand out bag-drop bags marked with the race number; participants must tie them themselves and hand them in before the race.

name: Västerås Stadslopp
price_range: 2026: 120–400 kr beroende på lopp och anmälningstid
description: Västerås Stadslopp är en folkfest i Vasaparken som bjuder in löpare i alla åldrar att delta i olika lopp, inklusive barnlopp och laglopp. Evenemanget arrangeras av Västerås Friidrottsklubb och erbjuder en härlig atmosfär med aktiviteter för barn, maskotar och möjligheter att delta oavsett funktionsvariation. Nummerlappar hämtas på plats och det finns service som väskinlämning och vattenstationer. Lag som anmäler sig får en matkasse efter målgång, vilket gör det till en social och rolig löparupplevelse.
course_highlights: Barnlopp med tre olika sträckor att välja mellan
Aktivitetsområde för barn med hinderbana, höjdhopp och kulstötning
Start och mål i Vasaparken med tillgång till toaletter och vattenpåfyllning
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas på plats i Vasaparken den 7 juni från 09.00, med särskild tid för 2,5 km och längre efter 11.00. Lag om fyra personer får matkasse efter målgång. Toaletter och vattenpåfyllning finns vid Rådhuset nära starten. Väskinlämning erbjuds men utan tak. Barnloppen är max 400 deltagare och är fulltecknade för 2026. Maskotar och aktivitetsområde för barn finns på plats. Datum för 2027 meddelas senare. Lag om fyra personer kan få en matkasse/picknick efter loppet.

name: Eidemila 2027
location: Kvaløy kirke, Eidkjosen, Kvaløya, Tromsø, Norway
description: Eidemila is an annual 10 km race that has been held since 2008, starting at Eidkjosen and finishing at Kvaløysletta. The race is organized by Tromsø Running Club and attracts runners who want to track their progress and compete for fast times. It is a popular event in the region with a rich history and results available to participants. The race has a tradition of bringing experienced and new runners together in a great running atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km course from Eidkjosen to Kvaløysletta
Held annually since 2008
Fast course with good opportunities for personal bests
additional: Results and statistics from previous years are available to participants, including winning times, age groups and team competitions. In 2026, bib collection was outdoors at Eide Handel. There were no changing facilities, and parking was available at Eide Handel.

name: Rekordmila
description: Rekordmila is a fast, flat 10-kilometer race in beautiful Buvika, perfect for anyone looking to set a new personal record. The course starts in central Buvika, follows the old road towards Øysand and returns. It is optimized for fast running, with a small roundabout at the turnaround to minimize time loss. In addition to the main race, there is a children’s race of approximately 500 meters, suitable for children of all ages. Rekordmila is also a race with heart: participants are encouraged to do good deeds in their local community as part of the event.
course_highlights: Fast, flat 10 km course from central Buvika to Øysand and back
The start has been moved 350 meters back, with a net downhill
Children’s race of approximately 500 meters along the path towards the water
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:00, approximately 90 minutes before the main race. Race bibs for the 10 km can be collected at Skaunhallen from 09:30 on race day. There are changing facilities at Skaunhallen. Water, squash, buns and bananas are served in the finish area, but there is no water station along the course. The course is closed to car traffic during the race. Pacers are available for various finish times, and photographers on the course offer photos for purchase. Cash prizes go to the top three men and women, with bonuses for a course record and for running under 30 minutes. A children’s race is also held. Previous editions have offered the option of paying the entry fee with a good deed in the local community.

name: Steinkjermila
description: Steinkjermila is a recreational race and a festival for the whole family, held in the heart of Steinkjer city centre, with the start and finish at Steinkjer Square. The course winds through many of the city’s most beautiful places and offers a varied, scenic route. The event includes the Mila and 5`ern distances, as well as the Minimila children’s race, which is free for children aged 0–12. It is a social and inclusive event with a group warm-up, prize-giving and activities for all ages.
course_highlights: The course runs through Steinkjer city centre, starting and finishing at the square
The Mila distance consists of two laps of the same course
The Minimila children’s race crosses the bridge, goes through Holmen and returns to the square
additional: Race bibs can be collected in advance at Steinkjer Kulturhus on Friday 4 June and Saturday 5 June from 11:00 to 17:00, and on race day from 09:30. There is a group warm-up for children at 10:30 on the square. Bag storage is available in the Sparebank 1 SMN tent by the church tower. Everyone who finishes receives a medal. Gift cards are awarded to the top three men and women in the Mila and 5`ern. The Red Cross and race marshals ensure safety during the race. Water, cordial and bananas are available at the finish area and along the Mila course. Toilets and showers are available at Samfunnshuset. Minimila is approximately 700 metres long and free for children aged 0–12.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 24. Laekvere – Simuna jooks
description: The third stage of the 2026 Lääne-Virumaa running and walking series is the traditional Simuna–Laekvere Run, which has earned a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts. The run is distinctive because its direction changes every year. The event takes place at Simuna School and welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: E-Lux Peetri Jooks
description: E-LUX Peetri Run is one of Estonia’s liveliest mass-participation sporting events, bringing together running enthusiasts of different ages and abilities. The main distance is 10 km, which is timed, with prizes awarded to the top finishers. There is also a charity run, a youth run and children’s races. The event takes place in Peetri and, alongside the running, features a large expo and market area with a variety of vendors and entertainment. The charity run supports the Children’s Foundation of Tartu University Hospital and, through it, children with mobility impairments. All finishers receive a cool summer medal.

name: Simuna-Laekvere rahvajooks
description: The Simuna-Laekvere People’s Run is a traditional recreational running event held every other year, alternating between Simuna and Laekvere. The course follows paved roads, with rolling sections and a few climbs, offering participants a varied running experience. The event is friendly and well organized, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants, and also offers a sauna and hot soup after the run. The number of participants is usually around 100, creating a pleasant, relaxed atmosphere. Age-group prizes are awarded, and the first ten finishers receive a running shirt.

name: Bėgimas Tėvo dienos proga 2026
description: The Father’s Day run in Tauragė is a festive event inviting all running enthusiasts to take part with family and friends. It is a great opportunity to celebrate Father’s Day actively and have fun as part of the city festival. The event takes place during Tauragė City Festival, offering a chance to experience community spirit and sporting enthusiasm.
course_highlights: A festive run during Tauragė City Festival
A friendly atmosphere for families and friends
A chance to celebrate Father’s Day actively
additional: The event is part of Tauragė City Festival, takes place outdoors, and encourages active leisure and family participation.

name: Ventspils pusmaratons
description: Ventspils Half Marathon 2027 is an annual running event taking place on June 6 in Ventspils. The race offers various distances, including a half marathon (21.0975 km), 10 km, 5 km, and a children’s run, welcoming participants of different ages. The event is organized by the Maratona Klubs Association in cooperation with the Ventspils City Council, providing professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. The course passes through some of Ventspils’ most beautiful spots, offering both city scenery and seaside views.
course_highlights: Half-marathon distance: 21.0975 km
Distances suited to different age groups, including a children’s run
The course passes through Ventspils city and seaside scenery
additional: Participants may transfer from a longer distance to a shorter one free of charge until 01.06.2027. During race week, changing distances costs 10 EUR. Young people born in 2008 or later receive a 50% discount on the 10 km and 5 km distances until 03.06.2027. Registration on race day is available, but full services may not be provided. Runners from Russia and Belarus are not permitted to participate.

name: Harzgeröder Klippenlauf
description: The Harzgeröder Klippenlauf is a varied popular and cross-country race in the Lower Harz, suitable for runners of all ability levels. Distances range from 1 km for children to a challenging half marathon of 21.1 km with 450 metres of elevation gain. The routes run through the Selke Valley along the Selketalstieg, past the districts of Mägdesprung and Alexisbad, with rocky sections, narrow trail paths and a rock tunnel. Alongside the sporting challenge, the Klippenlauf offers fun for the whole family, including a raffle and other events. The start and finish are at the dog training ground in Harzgerode.
course_highlights: Rocky sections and challenging climbs
Narrow trail paths along the Selketalstieg
Rock tunnel on the 15 km and half-marathon courses
additional: The start and finish are at the dog training ground in Harzgerode, where the race office and race-number distribution are located. Safety pins may not be used to attach race numbers; race belts are available for 5 EUR. Separate starts are held for the taster run (1 km), schoolchildren’s race (2.5 km), everyone’s race (5 km), main race (15 km) and half marathon (21.1 km). A raffle offers great prizes for participants. The event is one of the region’s major running and sporting events. Participants can pre-order a running shirt, registration is available online, and running with dogs is prohibited. The event is limited to 600 participants.

name: Deichlauf
organizer: TSV Winsen (Luhe) von 1850 e.V. und SV Greven
