description: The Deichlauf in Hohnstorf/Elbe offers a varied running program, with races for children and teenagers, an Olympic school relay, and 5 km and 10 km races. The event is sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The scenic route follows the dike and offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, family atmosphere. Special and team categories add to the excitement of the competition.
course_highlights: Running routes along the Elbe dike
A variety of distances from 1000 m to 10 km
An Olympic school relay as a special highlight
additional: Showers are not available. Medical staff are on hand at the finish and along the route. Photos and videos will be taken by an appointed service provider and may be published. The event is a community gathering with a particular focus on families and nature lovers.

name: Europamarathon 2026
description: Der Europamarathon Görlitz-Zgorzelec ist ein grenzüberschreitender Lauf durch die Europastadt Görlitz und Zgorzelec, der seit 2004 jährlich stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Distanzen vom Marathon über Halbmarathon, Staffel, 10-km- und 5,6-km-Läufe bis hin zu Kinder- und Jugendläufen. Die Strecke führt durch historische Stadtteile und über die Neiße, verbindet zwei Länder und begeistert Läufer aller Leistungsstufen sowie Familien und Firmenteams. Die Atmosphäre wird durch zahlreiche Zuschauer und eine lebendige Stimmung an der Strecke geprägt.
course_highlights: Grenzüberschreitender Rundkurs durch Görlitz und Zgorzelec mit welligem Profil
Überquerung der Neiße auf der historischen Altstadtbrücke, dem lautesten Abschnitt der Strecke
Strecke führt vorbei an historischen Fassaden und durch die Europastadt
additional: Der Marathon besteht aus 4 Runden, der Halbmarathon aus 2 Runden. Es gibt auch Staffelwettbewerbe sowie Walking-Distanzen. Die Kinder- und Jugendstrecke umfasst 1,5 km (2 Runden). Start und Ziel liegen im Görlitzer Stadtzentrum. Die Veranstaltung wird von einem Verein mit vielen ehrenamtlichen Helfern organisiert. Neben Marathon und Halbmarathon gibt es unter anderem 5- und 10-km-Angebote, einen Kinder- und Jugendlauf sowie eine 400-m-Landskron-Brause-Sausen.

name: Lingener Citylauf
description: The Lingener City Run is a long-standing event held each year on and around Lingener Market Square. For the 35th time, the city centre will become a sporting stage full of energy and community spirit. The event offers various distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 10-kilometre relay with up to 100 teams. The course runs through the city centre and is part of the EL Cup. The event is a highlight for runners and spectators from the region and beyond.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Lingener Market Square
Route through the city centre of Lingen
Part of the EL Cup, with 5 km and 10 km runs
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the start for a fee of €3.00. Bib number distribution begins at 10:00 on race day. Changing facilities and restrooms are available in the Bäumerstraße gym, about 500 m from the market square. Timing is recorded using transponders attached to the bib numbers, which must be handed in after the race. Parking is available, among other places, in the Marktplatz underground car park and at the Alter Pferdemarkt car park. Due to road closures, access to parking in the city centre will be restricted on the event day. Start and finish on Lingener Market Square, parking in the city centre, changing facilities at the Bäumerstraße gym, no timing for the children's race

name: Neustädter Stadtlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: 14. Stadtlauf des TSV Neustadt
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: Der 14. Stadtlauf des TSV Neustadt am Rübenberge ist ein barrierearmer Volkslauf, der Gemeinschaft und soziale Verbundenheit fördert. Die Veranstaltung steht für ein inklusives Miteinander und richtet sich an Läufer aller Altersgruppen und Leistungsniveaus. Der Lauf findet in der Stadt Neustadt am Rübenberge statt und bietet eine sportliche Plattform für Jung und Alt, um gemeinsam aktiv zu sein.
course_highlights: Barrierearmer Lauf für inklusive Teilhabe
Gemeinschaftliches Miteinander und soziale Verbundenheit
Veranstaltung in Neustadt am Rübenberge

name: 21. ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf
description: The ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf in Potsdam is a unique running event that combines tradition, culture, and sporting challenge. The course passes through the historic palaces, gardens, and landmarks of the state capital of Brandenburg, offering runners an unforgettable experience in a UNESCO World Heritage Site. With more than 4,500 participants, the race is a popular event for runners of all abilities. Experience the special atmosphere and the diverse sights along the route through the city’s history.

name: Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf
organizer: Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. und Freunde des Vogelberglaufes
description: The Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf is a traditional race held in Bleicherode. The event offers four distances (2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 20 km) on road and trail courses, starting at the former Schneckenhengst youth hostel building. The race is organized by Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. and Freunde des Vogelberglaufes. Results are scored according to the age-group system of the German Athletics Association, with specific age restrictions for younger participants. Trophies and certificates are awarded to the top runners in various categories.

name: Norderstedter Stadtlauf
description: The Norderstedt City Run is a popular running event held annually by Norderstedter Sportverein e.V. Runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in various races, including the 5-kilometer race, 10-kilometer race, fun run and children’s run. The event offers a sporting atmosphere on closed, traffic-free routes and is supported by the police, the THW and volunteers. The run promotes community, fun and health and is a highlight of the regional sports calendar.

name: Everstener Brunnenlauf 2026
description: The Everstener Brunnenlauf is a long-standing running event in Oldenburg. Various races are offered, including races for schoolchildren, a 6.3 km corporate and taster run, and a 10 km fun run. The route passes through the Eversten district, starting on Wienstraße and finishing in Eversten Holz. The event is known for its large number of participants and family-friendly atmosphere, appealing to both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Haster Volkslauf
description: The Haster Volkslauf 2026 takes place on June 7 in Osnabrück-Haste and offers races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini races, an inclusive fun run, and short- and long-distance races. The course passes through the beautiful surroundings of Haste and is recognized as an officially sanctioned race by the German Athletics Association. Participants receive medals and trophies, with the awards ceremony held immediately afterward at the sports field. The entry fee also supports a fundraising campaign for “Jede Oma zählt.”

name: Hopfengarten-Pokallauf - Landescup 9
description: The Hopfengarten Cup Race is part of the Novo Nordisk State Cup Saxony-Anhalt and takes place in Magdeburg. The event is organized by the Saxony-Anhalt Athletics Association (Leichtathletik-Verband Sachsen-Anhalt e.V.) and is open to runners of all age groups. The State Cup provides a sporting platform for ambitious runners and promotes running in the region. Runners must register through the LADV registration portal, and the association’s age-group and course recommendations apply.

name: ZVO Energie-Straßen-Lauf Rund um Ratekau
description: The ZVO Energie-Straßen-Lauf Rund um Ratekau is being held for the 36th time and offers races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, as well as a 400 m Bambini run. The courses are officially measured and suitable for record attempts, with the start and finish at the TSV Ratekau sports field. There are suitable races for all ability levels, including a schoolchildren’s cup that runs throughout the calendar year. The event places great emphasis on safety, with road closures, and provides refreshments along the course and in the finish area.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
location: Aleja Tysiącletnich Dębów, Rezerwat Pustelnik, Kazimierz Biskupi, Poland
description: The Run beneath the Thousand-Year-Old Oaks is a unique sporting event held in picturesque Kazimierz Biskupi, in the heart of the Bieniszew Forest. The race brings together sport, history, and the beauty of the local natural surroundings, taking participants along an avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, beginners, and families, with races over various distances and a Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Aktywny Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Kazimierz Biskupi Municipality, and the race tradition dates back to the beginning of the 21st century.
course_highlights: The course follows a picturesque avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve
The race takes place in the heart of the Bieniszew Forest, offering a chance to connect with nature
Running courses of 10 km and 5 km are available, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event
additional: The 10 km main race starts at 13:00; the 5 km accompanying race and 5 km Nordic walking event start at 13:10. The time limit for completing the race is 14:40. The winners’ awards ceremony and the closing of the event take place at 14:45.

name: X Festiwal Biegów Polski Północnej i Akt...
location: Boisko przy ul. Leśnej, Wdzydze Kiszewskie, Poland
description: The Northern Poland Running and Physical Activity Festival in Wdzydze is the tenth anniversary edition of an event promoting running and physical activity in the picturesque landscapes of Kashubia. The event takes place June 5–7 and features five main races in the Hard Runner series, with distances ranging from 1.6 km to a half marathon. Participants compete for an overall ranking based on the total points earned across all races. The festival brings together the running community of Northern Poland while also promoting local culture and nature.
course_highlights: Routes of 1.6 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and a half marathon (21 km)
Picturesque landscapes of Kashubia and the forests of the Kościerzyna Forest District
Routes available to view on the Traseo platform
additional: Race number with a timing chip (returnable). The race office is open during the festival. The overall ranking is based on the total points earned across five races. Recognition for the top competitors from the Municipality of Kościerzyna.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
location: Opalenie, Gmina Gniew, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The XIII DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon in Memory of Barbara Karaczyńska is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie to coincide with the anniversary of the founding of the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Center. The marathon course is entirely paved, runs through the picturesque fields and forests of Kociewie, is certified by the Polish Athletics Association, and features numerous fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race is demanding due to the terrain and thermal conditions, but offers beautiful views and an unforgettable atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal, and everyone receives a commemorative medal, diploma, and T-shirt.
course_highlights: An entirely paved course through the fields and forests of Kociewie
646 m of total elevation gain with numerous steep climbs
The course is marked every 1 km, with refreshment stations every 5 km and mobile refreshment stations
additional: A recovery meal is served after the race. The 10 km “Olka” course is paved and partially follows the half-marathon course. The entry fee is donated in full to the DASZRADE Foundation, which supports people recovering from addiction.

name: III Bieg Charytatywny Dookoła Jeziora Cz...
XXX Bieg Łagowskiego Lata
location: Łagów, Świebodzin County, Lubusz Voivodeship, Poland

name: Voss Løpskarusell 3
description: Voss Running Series is a running series for everyone, with races on Mondays at 19:00 in 2027. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at the sports ground, and passes through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. You can enter individual races or all six races together, with a discount for early registration. The event welcomes recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up to an enjoyable fun run in Voss.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at the sports ground
Route through Prestegardsmoen
Race along the waterfront promenade
additional: Registration is online via EQ Timing. There is a discount for registering for all six races before the second race. The fifth race, on 20 September, starts at 18:30, earlier than the other races.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, løp 3
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is a friendly running series for everyone, with races on Mondays at 19:00. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up, and a discount is available when registering for all six races in the series. This is a great recreational race in the beautiful surroundings of Voss.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: All races start at 19:00, except the fifth race on 20 September, which starts at 18:30. Registration is online only via EQ Timing. A discount is available when registering for all six races before the second race.

name: Pärnu Aasta jooksud 4 etapp
description: Pärnu Aasta jooksud 4 etapp on osa Pärnumaa rahvaspordisarjast, mis kutsub kõiki jooksuhuvilisi osalema mitmekülgsetel jooksuvõistlustel. Võistlus toimub Pärnu rannas, pakkudes osalejatele meeldivat ja sportlikku keskkonda. Üritus on hea võimalus nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele nautida liikumist ja võistlusmomenti maakonna spordiliidu korraldusel.
course_highlights: Jooksud toimuvad Pärnu rannas
Rahvaspordisari ühendab erinevad liikumisüritused Pärnumaal
Sobib nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele

name: 37. Campuslauf Technische Universität Clausthal
description: The 37th Campus Run at Clausthal University of Technology is taking place, offering runners a sporting challenge on campus. The event includes several race distances, including one lap, three laps, and a children’s run. The run is a popular university sports event that welcomes students, staff, and guests alike. There is also a Campus Open Air, creating a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Gallaberget Trailrun
description: Gallaberget Trailrun är ett terränglopp som arrangeras av Vretstorps IF Löpning. Loppet bjuder på en tuffare bansträckning med mycket stig och skogsmiljö, vilket ger en utmanande och naturskön löpupplevelse. Efter loppet kan deltagarna njuta av gemenskap med korv med bröd och bad i kvällssolen. Evenemanget lockar löpare i olika åldrar och nivåer och är uppskattat för sin fina atmosfär och välorganiserade arrangemang.
course_highlights: Tuffare bansträckning med mycket stig
Skogsmiljö och natursköna omgivningar
Efter loppet korv med bröd och bad i kvällssol
additional: Efter loppet erbjuds korv med bröd och möjlighet till bad i kvällssolen. Tidigare lopp har haft cirka 65 anmälda löpare och inkluderat fina priser från sponsorer som Vitamin Well och Nocco. 2026 års upplaga hade en tävlingsklass på 10 km. Efter loppet bjöds det på korv med bröd och möjlighet till bad.

name: Avesta Night Sky Run Knattelopp
description: Avesta Night Sky Run är ett kvällstraillopp som arrangeras vid Dalahästens skidcenter i Avesta. Loppet erbjuder två distanser, 3,33 km och 10 km, som mestadels går på spåren på rullstensåsen omkring slalombacken. Det är en trevlig och utmanande terrängbana som passar både nybörjare och erfarna löpare. Evenemanget är en del av Dalaportens OL:s tävlingsprogram och bjuder på en unik löpupplevelse under kvällstid.
course_highlights: Traillopp på 3,33 km eller 10 km
Banan går mestadels på spåren på rullstensåsen
Löps runt slalombacken vid Dalahästens skidcenter
additional: Deltagarna får en medalj och Festis.

name: Vestfold løpskarusell - 5. løp - Tønsbergmarka

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 1200 kr. for ikke medlemmer frem til 31.12.26.

description: Vestfold Running Series 2027 is a series of 8 great races in the Tønsberg region, offering the joy of running, community and a great atmosphere for all levels. Each race has two distances, and starts at 18:00. Participants can choose to enter individual races or buy a season pass for all races at a discounted price. The races take place in varied and beautiful surroundings, with electronic timing provided by EQ Timing. Course descriptions are shared in a Facebook group.
course_highlights: Two distances per race, ranging from approximately 2.3 km to 6.9 km depending on the location
Races in beautiful natural areas such as Essoskogen, Tønsbergmarka, Vear, Teieskogen and Revetal
Start and finish at central, accessible locations such as car parks, lifebuoys and sports halls
additional: Season-pass participants collect their race number at the first race. Participants entering individual races collect theirs at race headquarters 10 minutes before the start. The season pass must be kept throughout the series. Course descriptions and profiles are shared in the Facebook group.

name: Borgenløpet
description: Borgenløpet is organized by Borgen IL and offers an inclusive running experience for all ages and ability levels. The event features a 7 km trail course called Åsmarkarunden, as well as a shorter 4 km route for those who prefer it. There is also a children’s race, held as the final event in the sports school’s running series. The event includes an open kiosk, a commentator, and a great atmosphere, and invites everyone to enjoy a fun community celebration at Borgen.
course_highlights: 7 km trail course called Åsmarkarunden
Shorter 4 km route for those who prefer it
Children’s race for the youngest participants, held as the final event
additional: The event features an open kiosk, a commentator, and plenty of activity. The race is open to everyone, from recreational runners to elite athletes. The event concludes the sports school’s running series with a children’s race.

name: Lääne-Virumaa noorte MV
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Youth Championships is an athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Rakvere. The events include several athletics disciplines, such as running, jumping and throwing, and are intended for different age groups from U-14 through to adults. The competition aims to honor the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. All age groups receive medals, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at the stadium and starts at 11:00; registration opens at 10:00.

name: 6. ETAPP - Nõmme terviserada
description: The Nõmme health trail is part of the Tradehouse health running and walking series organized by Stamina Sports Club, which encourages people to stay active by collecting health kilometres. This stage offers a chance to enjoy the Nõmme area health trail, which is suitable for both runners and walkers. As part of the series, participants can collect health kilometres at both in-person and remote stages, as well as through personal training. The event is open to everyone interested in physical activity who wants to improve their health and spend time actively.

name: Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The 19th MittSommerNachtsLauf is an open race for everyone, with a steady pace of approx. 6 min/km, or 6 km/h for walking. The race starts at 7 p.m. in the village center of Marklohe and finishes at the heated outdoor pool in Wietzen, where the swimming pool will remain open until 10 p.m. and the support association will provide refreshments. The running route is up to 18 km, with additional starting points at 13, 10 and 5 km. The walking route is up to 10 km or 5 km. The event promises a sporting evening in beautiful surroundings and is open to everyone who enjoys running or walking.

name: Liikumissari" 8.Järvamaa järvede jooksud" V etapp Paide tehisjärve jooks
location: Paide tehisjärv, Paide, Järva County, Estonia

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 3. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 3rd stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event held on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful views of the lake and varied terrain. The event is part of a series organised by the Joosu Health Sports Club, which promotes an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone is welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lake views throughout the course
Varied terrain suitable for runners of different levels

name: Vertikālais kilometrs (VK) Siguldā
description: The Vertical Kilometer in Sigulda is a challenging mountain run that offers a chance to test your strength and endurance on the trails of Sigulda’s hills. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to climb 1,000 meters in elevation. The event is part of the Sigulda Running Series, which brings together athletes and active people from all over Latvia. The run takes place in beautiful natural surroundings, with breathtaking views and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: A challenging climb with 1,000 meters of elevation gain
Run along the mountain trails in Sigulda and the surrounding area
Breathtaking views and natural scenery
additional: Race bibs and timing chips will be issued at the start venue.

name: 41. AZ-Abendvolkslauf
description: The 41st AZ Evening Fun Run takes place in Uelzen and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. From short introductory runs for children to the 5 km and 10 km main races, as well as walking, Nordic walking and recreational hiking, there is something for everyone. The course passes through Uelzen’s historic city center and along the Ilmenau meadows, among other places. The race is an established event supported by dedicated volunteers and numerous sponsors from the region.
course_highlights: The course passes through Uelzen’s historic city center
The 10 km loop is run twice
Sections along the Ilmenau meadows and over the Katzenbuckel Bridge
additional: Late registration is possible on race day until approximately 1 hour before each event; the late registration fee is €3.00 (except for the introductory run and hiking). All children’s and school-age races up to 2.0 km award medals at the finish. Certificates can be printed online after the event. The start for all events is on Albertstraße, in front of the turning area.

name: Holstenköstenlauf
organizer: SVT Neumünster in Kooperation mit BMS Die Laufgesellschaft mbH
price_range: 10 km Lauf: 23,00 Euro bis 26,00 Euro, 5 km Lauf: 13,00 Euro bis 16,00 Euro, Holstenkösten-Becher: 12,00 Euro
description: The Holstenköstenlauf in Neumünster is a traditional city race held as part of Schleswig-Holstein’s largest city festival, the Holstenköste. The event offers races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, and takes runners through various parts of Neumünster. The 10 km course is officially measured according to DLV rules and offers an attractive route through the city center, Tungendorf, and Brachenfeld. All finishers receive a coveted festival medal as a memento of the event.
course_highlights: Attractive course through the city center, Tungendorf, and Brachenfeld
10 km course officially measured according to DLV rules
Start and finish at Kleinflecken, with the same start and finish line
additional: Participation available for various age groups; registration online or on site; bib number collection in the foyer of the Stadthalle; refreshments on the course and at the finish; award ceremonies in the evening

name: Oesterweger Feuerwehrlauf
description: The Oesterweg Fun Run and Fire Brigade Run in Versmold offers a varied running program for all ages and ability levels. From short Bambini and school runs with no entry fee to an officially measured 10 km road race and a 6 km team and fire brigade run, there is something for everyone. The flat, asphalted routes pass through the town center, with spectators providing plenty of encouragement. Walkers can also enjoy a scenic 6 km tour through the rural countryside alongside the event.
course_highlights: Flat, asphalted routes through the center of Oesterweg
10 km loop course with four identical laps plus an introductory lap
6 km loops for the team and fire brigade runs, as well as walking
additional: The Bambini run (450 m) and school run (1.2 km) have no entry fee. Participants up to age 11 are eligible for the school run standings; the taster run is for participants up to age 15. The team and fire brigade run consists of teams of four participants each. Walkers start alongside the fire brigade run from the rear rows so they do not interfere with the runners. Various distances, online registration, downloadable race brochures, special categories for fire brigades and teams, results on TimeTeamJung.

name: Voxtruper Volkslauf
description: The 13th Voxtrup Fun Run in Osnabrück offers a varied selection of races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes distances from 0.4 km for Bambinis to the 9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain. The races take runners through very scenic countryside, with several refreshment stations to support participants. Late entries are possible on the day of the event, and the event prioritises a safe and smooth race experience. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed.
course_highlights: Very scenic countryside run with a range of distances
9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain
Several refreshment stations depending on the distance (up to four for 9.8 km)
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event, up to 45 minutes before the respective race. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. Certificates can be printed online, and results are available at www.laufen-os.de. Refreshment stations: 1 at 3.9 km, 2 at 5.5 km, and 4 at 9.8 km. Participants can register on site; dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. The courses are designed to take runners through scenic countryside.

name: 14. Garbsener Citylauf
description: The 14th Garbsen City Run is Garbsen’s largest sporting event and offers races for all age groups and ability levels. There are six different races, from a 500-meter parent-child run to the 10,000-meter Agon Tax Run. The courses pass through Rathausplatz, the IGS grounds, along Meyenfelder Straße, and by Berenbosteler See. The event is family-friendly and emphasizes fun and community, supported by a dedicated organizing team and numerous volunteers.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2026 Lauf 1: 36. Donoper Volkslauf
description: The first race, the 36th Donoper Volkslauf, is organized by SC Donop 1948 e.V. and offers a varied 7,777-meter route around the Donop sports field in Blomberg-Donop. The series combines a sporting challenge with nature and community, and is open to runners, walkers, and hikers.

name: Derentaler Löwenlauf
description: The Derental Lion Run is a traditional race in the Weser Uplands, designed as a family-friendly sporting event for all ages. The event offers various distances through the beautiful Derental countryside and the Steinbach Valley. It places particular emphasis on diversity, tolerance, and working together, supported by a donation to the “augen auf!” Foundation for every participant. The race is organized with great care by the Weserbergland Runners Derental and promises an unforgettable day for children, young people, adults, and seniors.

name: Kleinbahn-Lauf
description: The Kleinbahn Run in Rhauderfehn is a fun run without timekeeping, welcoming runners and walkers on 5- and 10-kilometer routes. There are also children’s races for kindergarten and primary school children, enthusiastically cheered on by parents and grandparents. The 10 km loop starts at the marketplace and runs along the Hauptfehn Canal, through the villages of Holtermoor and Rhaude, and back to the finish via the Ostfriesland hiking trail. The 5 km route also starts at the marketplace and follows the Ostfriesland hiking trail back to the finish. The race offers a lovely opportunity to experience the region along varied routes.

name: The Alpaca Race
description: The Alpaca Race är ett trail-lopp som går av stapeln i Göteborgs vackra Hisingsparken. Det är ett tekniskt krävande lopp där endast ett fåtal löpare har sprungit hela distansen. Loppet erbjuder en unik naturupplevelse och en utmaning för både motionärer och erfarna traillöpare. Förberedelser inkluderar provlöpningar och gemensamma träningar som främjar gemenskap och löparglädje.
course_highlights: Tekniskt krävande trailbana i Hisingsparken
Löpning på skogsstigar med varierande höjdskillnader
Naturskön miljö i Göteborg
additional: Prov-löpningar arrangeras normalt tre gånger per år utan föranmälan. Start och samling sker vid IF Kvilles klubbstuga med tillgång till toaletter, omklädning och dusch. Deltagarna uppmuntras att resa hållbart till arrangemanget. GPX-fil finns att ladda ned för egen träning på banan. Medalj till alla deltagare.

name: Öland Ultra Trail
description: Öland Ultra Trail är ett fantastiskt trailäventyr i den vackra naturen på norra Öland. Loppet erbjuder två distanser, 50 km och 25 km, med start från Böda Sand respektive Byxelkrok och gemensam målgång vid Böda Sand. Bansträckningen bjuder på natursköna vyer och passerar platser som Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar och Trollskogen. Alla som fullföljer loppet får medalj, och föranmälda deltagare får en T-shirt inkluderad i startavgiften.
course_highlights: Passerar Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar och Trollskogen
Start 50 km vid Böda Sand, start 25 km vid Byxelkrok
Gemensam målgång vid Böda Sand
additional: Efteranmälan möjlig till 11 juni samt vid nummerlappsuthämtning fredag 12 juni kl. 19:00-20:00 och tävlingsdagen 13 juni kl. 07:30-09:00. Betalning kan ske kontant, med kort eller swish. Energistationer finns längs banan. T-shirt ingår i startavgiften vid föranmälan senast 6 juni med angiven tröjstorlek. Medalj till alla som fullföljer. Föranmälda deltagare får en T-shirt om de anmäler sig senast 6 juni. 50 km startar kl. 09.00 och 25 km kl. 10.00.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/oland-ultra/): 2027-06-12 — "Tid & datum 12 juni 2027 50 km kl. 09:00" (was estimated 2027-06-12)

name: Urskogsloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 200 kr och anmälan stänger den 10/6.

description: Urskogsloppet är ett motionslopp som går på enkla stigar genom en fantastisk urskogsmiljö i Örnsköldsviks kommun. Loppet finns i två distanser: det långa originalloppet på 19,7 kilometer som startar i Backe/Berg och slutar i Björna på Biggevallen, samt ett kortare lopp på 6,6 kilometer med start och mål på Biggevallen. Loppet arrangeras alltid lördagen före midsommarhelgen och följer delvis vandringsleden Urskogsleden. I samband med loppet pågår Björnadagen med aktiviteter och prisutdelning. Terrängen är bitvis ojämn med stockar, sten och våta partier, vilket ger en unik och naturnära löpupplevelse.
course_highlights: Löpning på enkla stigar genom urskogsmiljö
Delvis längs vandringsleden Urskogsleden
Terrängen är ojämn med stockar, sten och våta partier
additional: Start sker i Backe/Berg med busstransport från Björna. Det finns två startgrupper beroende på antal deltagare, med start kl. 11:00 och 11:30. Tidtagning sker med chip på handleden med mellantid vid 11,5 km. Vid mål finns omklädningsrum och dusch samt möjlighet att köpa mat för de som förbeställt. Dubbade skor är inte tillåtna i omklädningslokalerna. Parkering finns vid Björna skola och samåkning rekommenderas. Loppet har fyra kontrollstationer med vätska och enklare tilltugg. Terrängen är bitvis våt och ojämn, så löpare bör vara beredda på detta. På 19,7 km-banan finns fyra kontroller. Registrering, parkering och omklädning finns vid skolan i Björna, och buss till starten i Berg ingår för anmälda deltagare.

name: Nalta Backyard Ultra
description: Nalta Backyard Ultra är ett unikt ultralopp där det inte handlar om snabbhet utan uthållighet. Loppet går ut på att springa ett varv på en cirka 6,7 kilometer lång bana varje hel timme, så länge du orkar. Start och mål är vid Ursbergets skidstuga i Piteå, och loppet fortsätter tills endast en löpare kan genomföra ytterligare ett varv. Det är en utmaning i både fysisk och mental styrka med en tekniskt krävande bana i skogsmiljö.
course_highlights: 6,7 kilometer lång rundbana med cirka 65 höjdmeter
Banan består av skogsstigar, motionsspår, grusväg och cirka 500 meter asfalt
Tekniskt krävande delar med tydlig markering av skyltar och snitslar
additional: Registrering sker 07:30 - 08:30 med tävlingsgenomgång 08:30. Start och mål vid Ursbergets skidstuga med gräsplan för deltagarnas utrustning. Det finns två mindre omklädningsrum, en dusch och två toaletter vid tävlingsområdet. Områdeskarta visar startfålla, varvning, målgång, tävlingsledning, energiområde, deltagaryta och rekommenderad parkering. Starten går klockan 09:00 och därefter varje hel timme. Registrering är angiven till 07:30 - 08:30 och tävlingsgenomgång till 08:30. Deltagandet sker på egen risk.

name: Flosjön-Edstjärn
location: Flosjön–Edstjärn, Gagnef Municipality, Dalarna County, Sverige
description: Flosjön-Edstjärn är en halvmaraton som arrangeras årligen av Edstjärns Idrottsklubb i Gagnef. Loppet är öppet för alla och går genom natursköna områden runt Flosjön och Edstjärn. Det är ett väl etablerat evenemang som främjar idrott och gemenskap, särskilt bland ungdomar. Klubben uppmuntrar deltagande i olika former av idrott och erbjuder en fin möjlighet att uppleva vacker natur under löpningen.
course_highlights: Halvmaratonlopp runt Flosjön och Edstjärn
Natursköna vyer och varierad terräng
Arrangeras av ideella Edstjärns IK med fokus på ungdomsidrott
additional: Alla anmälningar är bindande och deltagande sker på egen risk. Personuppgifter hanteras av Edstjärns IK och Mitt Lopp. Namn och resultat publiceras på www.eik.one. Arrangören kan avbryta loppet vid behov för deltagarnas hälsa och säkerhet.

name: Öllsjö Löpfest 2026
description: Öllsjö Löpfest är ett familjärt och gemytligt motionslopp som välkomnar deltagare i alla åldrar och med olika fysiska förutsättningar. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser, inklusive barnlopp och längre sträckor, och arrangeras med fokus på rörelseglädje och gemenskap. Evenemanget inkluderar musik och aktiviteter för hela familjen samt en lagtävling med chip-tidtagning. Det är en återkommande löpfest som skapar en härlig atmosfär i Öllsjö varje år i juni.
course_highlights: Barnlopp på 450 m och 1700 m
Lopp på 5 km och 7,5 km trailmix
Automatisk tidtagning med chip och lagtävling
additional: Eventområdet är öppet 10:00 - 14:00. Nummerlappsutlämning startar 10:00. Uppvärmning sker med STC Härlöv före barnloppen och de längre loppen. Godisregn för barnen kl 12:20. Prisutdelning sker kl 13:10 vid eventområdets scen. Dusch, ombyte och väskinlämning finns tillgängligt. Evenemanget har erbjudit flera olika lopp och chip-tidtagning.

name: Bèrghem Ultra Trail 2027
description: Bèrghem Ultra Trail 2027 is a demanding ultramarathon set in the scenic surroundings of Ringsaker, Innlandet. The race features a long and challenging 135-kilometre course suited to experienced ultrarunners. Starting early in the morning, participants will experience varied terrain and beautiful scenery throughout the race. It is a great opportunity for runners looking for a real challenge in a spectacular landscape.
course_highlights: 135 km ultramarathon across varied terrain
Scenic surroundings in Ringsaker, Innlandet
Early morning start at 08:00
additional: There are currently 13 places available. Participants must have been born in 2007 or earlier.

name: Birkebeinerløpet
description: Birkebeinerløpet is Norway’s largest trail race and will be held on Saturday, 12 June 2027, for the 29th time. The race starts at Birkebeineren Ski Stadium in Lillehammer and finishes at Håkons Hall, taking runners through varied forest terrain with trails, cart roads and ski tracks from the Olympics. The course is 20.2 km long, with 337 metres of ascent and 569 metres of descent, offering participants a wonderful experience of nature and the true joy of running. Anyone who is 16 or older in 2027 can participate, and the race is part of the Birkebeinertrippelen.
course_highlights: Varied terrain including trails, grass, cart roads and ski tracks from the 1994 Olympics
The course is 20.2 km with 337 metres of ascent and 569 metres of descent
Finish at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer
additional: There are intermediate timing points at Sjøsetervegen (approx. 7.7 km) and Kroken (approx. 14 km). The course may have some wet sections and steep downhill slopes; take extra care in wet conditions. Participants must be at least 16 years old by 31 December 2027. Participants must be at least 16 years old by 31 December 2027.

name: LøpeBirken 12km
description: LøpeBirken 12 km is a trail race being held for the 20th time on Saturday, 12 June 2027. The race starts at Birkebeineren Ski Stadium and finishes at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer, offering varied terrain with trails, gravel roads and ski tracks from the Winter Olympics. Participants can enjoy the authentic Birken atmosphere, challenges and wonderful nature experiences in a race that combines the joy of running with a sense of achievement. The race is open to everyone aged 16 and over with timing, and 15-year-olds may participate without timing.
course_highlights: Start at Birkebeineren Ski Stadium (525 m above sea level), with varied surfaces including grass, trails and a wide ski track
First refreshment station at 4.14 km, with water and Maxim
The course includes rolling terrain, steep hills and marsh sections, and finishes at Håkons Hall
additional: There are two refreshment stations on the course. Participants are advised to be aware of wet conditions and traffic when crossing local roads. The race finishes at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer. Participants aged 16 and over can run with timing; 15-year-olds may participate without timing. Food and drinks along the course and at the finish are included in the entry fee. A free shuttle bus runs from Håkons Hall to Birkebeineren Ski Stadium.

name: Birken fjellmaraton
description: Birken Mountain Marathon is a 42 km trail race through varied and beautiful mountain terrain from Sjusjøen to Lillehammer, finishing at Håkons Hall. The race offers an authentic experience of nature and a tough running challenge through high mountain terrain, trails, and gravel roads. It is a popular race that is part of the Birkebeiner Triple and is suited to runners looking for a demanding, scenic mountain marathon.
course_highlights: The race starts at Sjusjøen Cross-Country Arena, with 2 km of gravel road before the trail heads through high mountain terrain over Sjusjøfjellet and Lunkefjell
Varied surfaces include trails, gravel roads, and some wet and boggy sections near Nevelvannet
The final section includes steeper, rocky terrain, followed by the last 2 km on gravel road to the finish at Håkons Hall
additional: The race takes place on Saturday, 12 June 2027, for the ninth time. Anyone who is 18 years old by 31 December 2027 may take part. The race is part of the Birkebeiner Triple. There are several aid stations along the course, including the last one at Kroken, 6 km from the finish. The terrain is also suitable for runners with limited trail-running experience. It is recommended to run carefully on steep, rocky descents.

name: UltraBirken løp
description: UltraBirken Run is a 60 km ultramarathon from Sjusjøen Cross-Country Arena to the finish at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer. The race offers a tough running challenge across varied and demanding terrain, and is suited to runners who want to test their limits. It is held annually and is part of the Birkebeiner Triple, is approved as a qualifier for the UTMB 50K, and awards 2 ITRA points. The race continues to attract more participants and has a rich tradition of achievement and community.
course_highlights: Starts at Sjusjøen Cross-Country Arena, with 2 km of gravel road before the trail crosses high-mountain terrain over Sjusjøfjellet and Lunkefjell
The route crosses Krigsfjell, Hitfjell, Pellestova and Nevelfjell, the course’s highest point at 1,072 metres above sea level
The course ends with demanding, rocky and steep sections before reaching the finish on a gravel road outside Håkons Hall in Lillehammer
additional: The race awards 2 ITRA points and qualifies for the UTMB 50K. Participants must be at least 18 years old as of 31 December 2027. The race is part of the Birkebeiner Triple. The route has a total of 1,258 metres of elevation gain and 1,873 metres of descent. There may be muddy and wet sections, as well as steep and rocky sections where reducing your pace is recommended. Start time: 08:00. Participants must be 18 years old by 31 December 2027. The race awards 2 ITRA points and is approved as a UTMB 50K qualifier. Food and drinks at the stations are included in the entry fee.

name: UngdomsBirken løp
description: The UngdomsBirken Run is an approximately 5 km race for young people aged 12 to 16, starting at Stampesletta and finishing at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer. The race gives participants the chance to experience the true Birken atmosphere and cross the same finish line as thousands of other participants. It will be held for the 22nd time in 2027 and focuses on achievement, community and the joy of running, whether it is your first time or you have taken part before. The course passes through varied terrain, including gravel paths, a floodlit trail and scenic surroundings near Maihaugen.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km from Stampesletta to Håkons Hall
The course follows gravel paths, crosses Finnabrua and runs alongside the Mesna River
Finish at Håkons Hall in the true Birken atmosphere
additional: There is a drinks station with squash and water after approximately 2.5 km, as well as a food and drinks station at the finish serving water, squash and sausages from Gilde. Participants with special dietary needs are advised to bring their own packed meal. Everyone is encouraged to drink plenty of fluids before and during the race. Elevation figures for the course vary depending on GPS equipment and map data. For participants who turn 12–16 by 31 December 2027. Drinks are available at approximately 2.5 km, with food and drinks at the finish.

name: Haslummila
description: Haslummila is a road race starting and finishing at Bekkestua in Bærum, offering distances of 400 metres for children, 5 km for ambitious runners and 10 km for avid runners. The event is an inclusive, energetic running festival that focuses on time, personal achievement and the local community. The course takes in a variety of streets and paths, with several underpasses and scenic areas, and there are drink stations along the way. All participants receive a medal, and children also get ice cream as a prize. The event encourages the use of public transport and offers good nearby parking.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Bekkestua, with a 400 m children’s race on Bærumsveien
The 5 km course passes through underpasses beneath Kirkeveien and Bærumsveien, and by Haslum Klubbhus and Nadderud VGS
The 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km route
additional: Drinks will be available at the finish and at one drink station along the course (5 km runners pass it once; 10 km runners pass it twice). Participants are encouraged to use public transport, with both a bus station and a metro station within walking distance of the start/finish. Several parking garages are located nearby. Information about race numbers, clothing storage, toilets and AfterRun will be provided later. Drinks are available at the finish and at one station along the way. All participants receive a medal, and children also get ice cream.

name: Fana Backyard
price_range: 600 kr individuelt; 1000 kr per lag på to
description: Fana Backyard Ultra is organized by Gneist Friidrett and follows the classic Backyard Ultra rules, with a start every hour on the hour. The course is 6.706 km long and consists of asphalt, trails and gravel, with a total of 12 laps run within a time window from 09:00 to 21:00. The event takes place at Gneist Arena in Bergen and offers a challenging, sociable ultra-running experience with both individual and team classes. All participants have access to a base camp with facilities such as snacks, drinks, changing rooms and toilets, and finishers receive T-shirts.
course_highlights: 6.706 km course with asphalt, trails and gravel
Starts every hour on the hour, following Backyard Ultra rules
12 laps in total, covering 80.472 km
additional: Teams consist of 2 runners who take turns running every other lap throughout the competition. All 12 laps must be completed for a valid overall time. The final lap must be completed by 21:00. Everyone who completes 1 to 11 laps receives an official participant T-shirt, while everyone who completes all 12 laps receives an exclusive black T-shirt. Spectators are welcome outside and inside Gneist Arena, but do not have access to the runners’ base camp. Pedestrian crossings must be used when crossing roads, and marshals direct traffic at some points. The start and base camp are at Gneist Arena. The base camp has snacks, drinks, toilets and changing rooms. Minimum age: 15 (born in 2011 or earlier).

name: Hell Løpefestival
organizer: Hell Ultraløperklubb, med bistand fra flere idrettsklubber i Stjørdal
description: Hell Running Festival takes place on 12–13 June 2027 at Øverlands Minde in Stjørdal and offers a wide range of races for all levels. The festival includes Stjørdalsmila, with 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as ultrarunning events of 6, 12 and 24 hours and a marathon. The races are held on certified courses with asphalt and tartan surfaces, and Øverlands Minde offers good facilities, including showers and changing rooms. With the Trøndelag midnight sun as a backdrop, this is a highlight for running enthusiasts in the region.
course_highlights: Stjørdalsmila: certified 5 km and 10 km courses through central Stjørdal and along the promenade at Tangen
Ultrarunning on a 1,185.6 m loop with asphalt and tartan surfaces at Øverlands Minde
The races take place outdoors, with facilities including showers and changing rooms at Øverlands Minde
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Øverlands Minde on Friday 11 June from 18:00 to 21:00, on Saturday 12 June from 09:00, and on Sunday 13 June until 12:45. Registration for Stjørdalsmila closes at 12:00 on race day. The ultrarunning events have a support area with tables and tents, and the running direction is reversed every 6 hours. All participants must have a licence (insurance). The race takes place outdoors, with the midnight sun as a backdrop. The festival runs over two days, 12–13 June 2027.

name: Moan5ern
organizer: Sprek Treningssenter, Berg Eiendom, Intersport, Alti Magneten og Markabygda IL
description: Moan5ern is an inclusive race in Levanger, Trøndelag, offering a running festival for all ages and levels. The event is organized in collaboration with local partners such as Sprek Treningssenter and Markabygda IL, and aims to provide a wide range of recreational running opportunities. The race includes a children’s race, a untimed fun run, and competitive waves for the fastest runners. Moan5ern is a great opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners to take part in a social and active event.
course_highlights: 5 km course in Levanger
500-meter children’s race
Competitive waves based on expected finish time
additional: The children’s race starts at 12:00, with free entry and no registration required. The untimed fun run starts at 12:30. Competitive wave 1 (faster than 20 min) starts at 13:00, and wave 2 starts at 13:05. Previous editions have had wave starts for competitive runners. The children’s race has been free and has not required registration.

name: Gjesdal Backyard
location: Gjesdal IL stadion, Ålgård, Gjesdal, Norway
price_range: 800 kr; stafett fra 1500 kr per lag

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 800,- kr. Dette inkluderer bevertning og pleie gjennom hele dagen.

description: Gjesdal Backyard is a unique and different kind of race where participants run a 6.7 km loop up to twelve times, starting and finishing at Gjesdal IL Stadium in Ålgård. The course features varied terrain, including asphalt, tractor tracks and flowing trails, and includes a challenging hill and scenic valleys. Loops start on the hour, and your pace determines how long your breaks between loops will be. The event also offers a relay option, where teams of 2–6 people can share the 12 loops. Refreshments, entertainment and good facilities are available at the stadium throughout the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the tartan track at Gjesdal IL Stadium
Varied terrain with asphalt, tractor tracks and flowing trails
The course’s toughest and longest hill comes early in the loop
additional: Bib pickup from 07:30. Race briefing and general information at 08:45. A new loop starts on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00. Personal chair in the “Storsalen,” with refreshments, entertainment and surprises. Good changing-room and toilet facilities. Medical staff on site. Food and drinks included: water, fruit, squash, crisps, jelly men, cola, sandwiches, hot food after loop 6 and a Jæder burger after loop 12. Minimum age: 16. Runners must bring suitable shoes, a headlamp and clothing appropriate for the conditions. Start and finish at Gjesdal IL Stadium in Ålgård. The race is limited to 12 loops (80.4 km) and has a minimum age of 16. Relay teams can consist of 2–6 people, and each participant must run at least two loops.

name: Hovlandsnuten Opp
description: Hovlandsnuten Opp is a traditional uphill race from Risvoll School to the summit of Hovlandsnuten, 931 metres above sea level. The approximately 6.7-kilometre course offers varied terrain, with Sherpa steps, beautiful views over the fjord and a challenging climb. The race is suitable for everyone, young and old, and family entertainment is provided at Trollplassen. The event also has a dedicated Sherpa/firefighter class with additional weight to carry. After the race, there is a social gathering with music, awards and activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: The course passes through Sherpa steps built by Sherpas from Nepal
Water stations at Skreivane, Hovlandsstølen and Hovlandsnuten
Panoramic views from the summit at 931 metres above sea level
additional: The recreational walk starts at 08:30 from Risvoll School, with the option to start from the alternative parking area in Nordstøldalen. The competition starts at 12:00. Race numbers (vests) are handed out before the start. Medals are presented by Mayor Håvard Handeland. There is a race announcer and several family activities at Trollplassen, including face painting, a pirate show and music. Participants in the Sherpa/firefighter class must carry at least 20 kg of additional weight. Competition participants must bring a wind jacket and trousers, and poles are not allowed on the Sherpa steps or in the open mountain terrain. The course is marked, and there are Norwegian Red Cross stations with defibrillators along the course. Water stations are listed at Skreivane, Hovlandsstølen and Hovlandsnuten. Competition participants must bring a wind jacket and windproof trousers; poles are not allowed in the competition class. The Sherpa/firefighter class requires at least 20 kg of additional weight, and all participants must have a licence.

name: 3 toppsløpet på Jeløya (3TL)
description: 3toppsløpet on Jeløya is a trail race held annually around Midsummer, starting and finishing at Sølystranda on Jeløya in Moss. The race offers four distances: Mini 1TL (1 km), 1TL (10 km), 2TL (20 km) and 3TL (30 km). Runners alternate between forest trails and scenic beaches. The course includes the three well-known peaks Rødsåsen, Bjørnåsen and Rambergtoppen, offering a technically challenging and varied terrain experience. The event is run by volunteers and has a low entry fee. Any surplus supports children affected by war and conflict through a partnership with Right To Play.
course_highlights: Trail race on paths, forest roads, beaches and some paved sections
Includes three well-known peaks: Rødsåsen, Bjørnåsen and Rambergtoppen
The course follows much of the shoreline around Jeløya
additional: Mass start for 1TL (10 km), 2TL (20 km) and 3TL (30 km) at 10:00 from Sølystranda. Mini 1TL (1 km) starts at approximately 09:30. An early start for 3TL and the marathon is available at 09:00 for runners expecting to take longer. 3TL requires runners to check in at all three peaks; 1TL requires a check-in only at Rødsåsen. There are no aid stations for 3TL, so participants must bring their own food and drink. 1TL has an aid station at Kasekilen. Carrying a charged mobile phone is mandatory, and running with a backpack is recommended. The 2027 edition will take place on Saturday, 12 June, with the regular start from 10:00 at Sørlystranda.

name: Trolljegerprøven Sandnes
description: Trolljegerprøven Sandnes is a Norwegian trail obstacle race that combines endurance, strength and fun on a nature-based obstacle course. The race is suitable for all levels and offers an adrenaline-filled experience in the wilderness. The event takes place in Sandnes and is part of Trolljeger’s many exciting events for both adults and children. Prepare well with training at Trolljegerhallen or outdoor sessions before the race.
course_highlights: Norwegian trail obstacle course
Combines endurance and strength
Nature-based obstacles in the wilderness
additional: Trolljegerhallen at Foss-Eikeland offers training and preparation for obstacle races. Outdoor sessions focused on obstacle racing are also held to help participants get into the right mindset before the race. Tailored events are available for groups, adapted to their wishes and needs.

name: Soknaløpet
description: Soknaløpet is held in Sokna, Buskerud, and organized by Soknedalen Idrettslag. The race offers a 5 km for adults and a separate children’s race, welcoming both recreational runners and younger participants.
course_highlights: 5 km race
Separate children’s race
Held in Sokna in Soknedalen

name: Ålesund Maraton
distance_verbose: Maraton, Halvmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 0.8 km, 0.5 km
description: Ålesund Marathon is an annual celebration in the heart of Ålesund, offering races for all ages and ability levels. Participants can choose from the 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon, 5 km relay, and the Children’s Mini Marathon, which has two distances. The courses run through the city streets, starting and finishing at Skansekaia, with spectators creating a great atmosphere along the route. The event encourages both personal bests and the joy of running together, with start groups suited to different expected finish times. The Children’s Mini Marathon gives the youngest runners a fun and inclusive start to the race festivities.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Skansekaia in central Ålesund
The half marathon is run over two laps; the marathon over four laps
The 5 km relay course has three possible changeover points
additional: Start groups for the 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon are based on expected finish time. The Children’s Mini Marathon has two distances (500 m and 800 m), with the option to change distance during the event. Children can enter Bybadet for free on June 6 and 7 by showing their medal, race bib, or receipt. The relay can be run by teams of 2–6 participants; mixed teams must include at least 40% women. Traffic and parking in the city centre will be affected during the event. Public transport and parking at Aksla are recommended. Registration for the 2027 race has not yet opened.

name: Backyard Larvik Ultra
description: Backyard Larvik is a unique ultrarun where participants run a 6.7 km loop at the start of every hour, for a maximum of twelve laps. The race combines strategy and endurance, with the last runner to start a lap winning. The event has a social focus and a low barrier to entry, and offers break facilities with food and drink in a warm indoor space. Those who complete twelve laps receive a cup, and those who complete seven laps receive a wooden medal. The race takes place at Fagerli School in Larvik, with bib collection and a race briefing on the day before and on race day.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop run at the start of every hour
Maximum 12 laps, for a total of 80.4 km
Break facilities with food and drink in a warm indoor space
additional: Bib numbers and ankle chips can be collected at Fagerli School on Friday 12 June from 18:00 to 20:00 and Saturday 13 June from 07:45 to 08:30. The race briefing starts at approximately 08:30 in the gym at Fagerli School. Bringing your own cup is mandatory. The ankle chip and Velcro strap must be returned after the race; a fee applies if they are not returned. The Red Cross will be present with an ATV to provide assistance. The maximum number of participants is 350. Bib numbers can be attached with a race belt to make changing clothes during breaks easier. The organiser’s information about the race format and price reflects the published details and may change before the 2027 edition.

name: Sommernattsløpet Bergen
description: Sommernattsløpet Bergen is a summer street race held in beautiful surroundings around Bergen city centre. The course offers fast and relatively flat laps around Lungegårdsvann, with the start and finish in Nygårdsparken. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km; the 10 km consists of two laps of the same course. The race is suitable for all levels and offers a festive atmosphere with music, cheering and the chance to set a new personal best.
course_highlights: Course around beautiful Bergen city centre and Lungegårdsvann
Minimal elevation, with a fast and flat course
Start and finish in Nygårdsparken with music and cheering
additional: Pacers are available in several pace groups from 4:00 to 6:30 min/km. Race bibs can be collected at Löplabbet Bergen or on race day for participants travelling from far away. All participants receive a drink and a medal at the finish. Prizes from partners will be drawn after the race. The start time for the 5 km is listed as 19:00. The 10 km has wave starts at 20:00 for expected times under 50 minutes and at 21:30 for expected times over 50 minutes.

name: Bergsdalen Halvmaraton
description: Bergsdalen Half Marathon is held annually, starting at Bergsdalen Church, and brings runners together for a wonderful half-marathon experience in scenic surroundings. The race has a reputation for being well organized and welcomes both recreational and more experienced runners. The event is organized in collaboration with Stanghelle IL, which also offers several activities for children and adults in the local community. Bergsdalen Half Marathon 2027 is planned for June 12, and runners can look forward to a day with a great atmosphere and a challenging course.
course_highlights: Measured and well-marked courses
Reported to have around 90 meters of elevation gain
Start and finish at the church in Bergsdalen
additional: Previous editions have featured a half marathon, a 10 km race, and a relay. The 2027 edition is planned for June 12.

name: Kvammen halvmaraton 2027
description: Kvammen Half Marathon is organized by Kvammen Sports Club and takes place on Saturday, June 12, 2027. This is a challenging and exclusive half marathon that gives participants the opportunity to experience much of Kvammen. The course passes through scenic areas such as Høgda, Hegreneset, the school, Løvika and Leknes, before finishing back at Høgda. This race is suited to runners looking for a challenging distance in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The course passes through Høgda, Hegreneset, the school, Løvika and Leknes
Scenic surroundings in the Kvammen area
A challenging and exclusive half marathon with varied terrain
additional: The course information is for the 2026 edition; a detailed course map and video were announced but have not been confirmed for 2027.

name: Vanglateenistuse jooks
description: The Prison Service Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place at the Jõhvi music square. This athletics event gives participants the opportunity to enjoy a run in the beautiful surroundings of Ida-Viru County. The series includes several stages in different locations, offering a varied running experience. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and is traditionally well organized and friendly.

name: ELVA SÜDAÖÖJOOKS 2026 TARTUMAA LIIGUB ETAPP
description: Elva Midnight Run 2026 is a nighttime running and walking event held near the Elva Cultural Centre. The races start in the evening and offer several distance options, including a 10 km run and walk, as well as children’s races. The event is part of Tartu County’s exercise events and is suitable for both active runners and families. The organizers welcome everyone to take part and enjoy a sporty evening in Elva’s beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Eesti noorte KV
description: The Estonian Youth Archery Cup takes place in Pärnu, giving young athletes the opportunity to compete and develop their skills. Several archery clubs from across Estonia take part, making it an important event on the calendar for young archers. The competition is held at Tammiste Stadium, where athletes can demonstrate their accuracy and skill. The event is a tradition and supports the development of young people in archery.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Krakės - Laiko ratu“
organizer: Krakių bendruomenės centras, Krakių kultūros centras, Krakių seniūnija
description: The “Krakės – Laiko ratu” running race is a traditional national event held in the town of Krakės, Kėdainiai District. The race welcomes everyone, from professionals to beginners and recreational runners, with a range of distances for different age groups. The start and finish are in the town centre, at Laisvės Square. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and awards across various age categories. Participants are served traditional šiupinys stew, and can play outdoor wooden games by “LPA GAMES”.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Laisvės Square in the town of Krakės
Different distances for age groups: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
The 600 m “Catch the Stork” run around the Krakės honour circuit for children and families
additional: Race bibs are issued from 11:00. The opening ceremony and the 600 m “Catch the Stork” run start at 11:30. All participants are served šiupinys stew prepared by the Krakės Community Centre. Awards are presented to age-group winners, the youngest and oldest participants, and the fastest 10 km runners. Advance registration is online, and the entry fee is paid by bank transfer. There are various distances and age groups, as well as games and entertainment during the event.

name: Ezerkauliņi Salaspils pilsētas pusmaratons
description: The “Ezerkauliņi” Salaspils City Half Marathon brings together running enthusiasts, Salaspils residents and visitors for a sporting celebration in Salaspils. Participants can choose the half marathon, a 10.55 km run or Nordic walking, a 5.27 km fun run, or a 0.75 km children’s run. The course runs along Salaspils streets, and the event invites everyone to enjoy moving together and the city’s atmosphere.
course_highlights: The city course runs along the streets of Salaspils.
A 21.097 km half-marathon distance is available.
Participants can also take part in the 10.55 km distance by Nordic walking.
additional: A 0.75 km children’s run is also available.

name: Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf
location: Kurpark Bad Nenndorf, Bad Nenndorf, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf is a long-standing, DLV-approved public race and part of the Schaumburg Running Series. It takes place in the beautiful Kurpark in Bad Nenndorf and offers distances for different age and ability groups, including 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5 km, 10 km, and 5 km walking and Nordic walking. The event is family-friendly and attracts many participants, who run on paved paths through the park. In addition to the sporting competition, there is an attractive supporting program and good facilities, including changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through the Kurpark
Start and finish on Kurpromenade by the Wandelhalle
A range of distances from 1,000 m to 10 km, plus walking options
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports center, which can be reached by bus shuttle. Insurance coverage is provided through an LSB contract. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Medical support is provided. A maximum of 300 participants in the 1,000 m and 2.5 km races. The 5 km Nordic walking and walking events are timed, with no placings. First race for the Samtgemeinde Cup. Scoring race in the Schaumburg Running Series. The race takes place as part of the State Garden Show, with various distances and a family-friendly atmosphere. Early registration is possible, and the event is open to all age groups.

name: Mut-Lauf
description: The MUT-LAUF Kiel is an annual running event that promotes greater openness and courage in dealing with mental illness. Its aim is to take a stand against stigma and raise awareness of mental health. The run celebrates moving together without pressure to perform and is open to everyone, regardless of age, fitness level, or physical limitations. Alongside the run, there is a varied program featuring music, interviews, food and drink, and a marketplace with information about mental health and prevention.
course_highlights: A run open to everyone, with no pressure to perform, including wheelchair users
Event held at the Moorteichwiesen in Kiel
Program featuring music, interviews, and a marketplace
additional: Registration is available online through the Davengo portal or in person at KIELER FENSTER, Ambulantes Zentrum. The event takes place every year on the Saturday before Kiel Week begins. The program includes activities for the whole family and a marketplace featuring self-help groups and social organizations. Entry fees are €10 for adults and €5 for children. Information about self-help groups and a sociable program are provided.

name: Söltjerlauf
description: The Söltjerlauf in Bad Münder is a charity run in the beautiful Süntel hills, where every lap counts. The event welcomes all age groups and fitness levels, from children to marathon runners, and features a shaded forest loop of approximately 3.8 km with a refreshment point. Participants have four hours to run as many laps as possible, with the proceeds going to a good cause. The event promotes team spirit and health, and invites participants to stay after the run for catering and the awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Shaded forest loop of approximately 3.8 km
Refreshment point along the course
Atmosphere at the Bergschmiede restaurant, with catering
additional: A shuttle service is available from 09:30 to help participants arrive in time for the 11:00 start. Every participant receives a certificate stating the distance covered. The top individual runners and the top 10 teams receive prizes. Parking is limited, so using the overflow parking areas and bus shuttle is recommended. Dogs must be kept on a short leash and are not allowed to participate as team members. Competition open to all age groups; sponsors donate for each lap to local projects. The event takes place on the Bergschmiede grounds, with support from local sponsors such as Sparkasse Hameln-Weserbergland and Ardagh Group.

name: Volksbank Haren Citylauf
description: The 27th Volksbank Haren City Run takes place on an attractive, fast course through Haren city centre. The 5 km and 10 km races are measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings, making them ideal for competitive athletes and recreational runners. Children and young people can take part in special races over 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km. There is also a team competition in the 5 km race for teams from companies, clubs or groups.
course_highlights: Attractive, fast course through Haren city centre
The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings
Special races for children and young people over 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km
additional: All participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive finisher shirts. Entry fees are paid by direct debit. The 5 km race includes a team competition for teams of at least 3 people. Children from Haren daycare centres and schools can take part for free if their institution participates. Large trophies and certificates are awarded for school competitions.

name: 12. Heilwald Marathon
description: The 12th Heilwald Marathon takes place in Bad Lippspringe. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and runs through the unique Heilwald, whose soothing low-mountain climate and species-rich forest offer a special running experience. The event is a private, self-supported race, with times recorded by hand; a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participation is at your own risk, and a voluntary donation for tree planting is requested.

name: 13. Himmelswegelauf
description: Der Himmelswegelauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf rund um die Himmelsscheibe von Nebra, der jährlich im Juni stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Disziplinen wie Marathon, Halbmarathon, den 10 Kilometer langen Himmelsscheibenlauf, Walking, Radtour und geführte Wanderungen zum Fundort der Himmelsscheibe. Die Strecken führen durch historische und archäologische Stätten wie das Sonnenobservatorium Goseck, die Dolmengöttin von Langeneichstädt und das Besucherzentrum Arche Nebra. Start- und Zielort ist meist die Arche Nebra, unweit des Fundortes der Himmelsscheibe, die als älteste konkrete Abbildung des Kosmos gilt. Der Lauf verbindet sportliche Herausforderung mit kulturellem Erleben in einer einzigartigen Landschaft.
course_highlights: Start und Ziel an der Arche Nebra, nahe dem Fundort der Himmelsscheibe
Marathonstart am 7.000 Jahre alten Sonnenobservatorium Goseck
Streckenführung durch den Ziegelrodaer Forst und vorbei an archäologischen Kultstätten
additional: Die Veranstaltung umfasst neben den Läufen auch Walking, Radtouren und geführte Wanderungen zum Fundort der Himmelsscheibe. Alle Strecken sind vorbehaltlich behördlicher Genehmigung. Die Medaille wird in einem exklusiven Design vergeben.

name: 18. Edeka Ladage-Lauf
description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen is a long-standing community race with a variety of events for all age groups. The event takes place at the Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School sports facility and offers varied loop courses for everyone from kindergarten children to experienced runners. The longer races follow a slightly modified 2.5 km loop, with the start and finish close to the event area, creating a special atmosphere. Alongside the competition, the event also emphasizes a sense of community, supported by a prize draw and a dedicated team of volunteers.

name: 23. Sudenburg-Lauf - Der Lauf mit dem Lächeln
description: The Sudenburg Run is an event with the motto “By runners, for runners” and takes place at Heinrich Germer Stadium in Magdeburg. The event is distinguished by enthusiasm for running and for the Sudenburg district. There are various race routes for children, teenagers, and adults, which lead through the city and the stadium. The focus is on getting as many people as possible running and putting a smile on their faces.

name: Ottermeerlauf
description: The Ottermeer Run in Wiesmoor is a long-standing event. It offers a varied course and a motivating atmosphere, and is open to both individual runners and relay teams. A particular highlight is the 6-hour ultramarathon, which is part of the Nordcup and open to runners aged 18 and over. Every finisher receives a custom medal shaped like the outline of the Ottermeer, featuring the mascot Otti.

name: 24h Lauf Halberstadt
description: The 24-hour run at Friedensstadion Halberstadt starts at 18:00 and is organized by VfB Germania Halberstadt in collaboration with the Halberstadt Leisure and Sports Center. The goal is to keep runners on the tartan track continuously throughout the 24 hours. The event is part of VfB Germania’s club festival, where various sports departments introduce themselves and invite visitors to join in. In addition to the run, traditional activities include pulling a coach on the track. The event offers a sporting challenge and a sociable program for participants and spectators.

name: Fischland-Darss-Zingst-Ultramarathon (FDZU)
description: The Fischland-Darss-Zingst Ultramarathon (FDZU) is the longest nature-experience run in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and is being held for the 10th time. The route passes through the unique Baltic Sea coastal landscape from Rostock to Stralsund, offering runners a special experience of nature along the region’s peninsulas and islands. The race is defined by its tradition and distinctive atmosphere, created by the combination of nature, challenge and community.

name: Harsefelder Lauf- und Musikfestival
organizer: Lauftreff Harsefeld, LSC Harsefeld, Stadtmarketing Harsefeld
description: The 20th Running and Music Festival takes place in Harsefeld, combining sporting challenges with musical entertainment. Runners of all ages can take part in a range of distances, from children’s and Bambini runs to short and long-distance races and relays. In the evening, Marktstraße becomes a lively party strip with an open-air disco and live music. The festival is a regular fixture on Harsefeld’s event calendar and, alongside the sporting events, offers a varied children’s program and food stalls.

name: Kalimandscharolauf 2026
description: The event is organized by K+S Minerals and Agriculture GmbH, Zielitz plant. The race takes place away from the stadium and offers runners an attractive course in the Magdeburg/Börde region. Registration is open.

name: Lauf um den Senftenberger See
description: The 49th Run Around Lake Senftenberg offers runners a choice of distances around picturesque Lake Senftenberg. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, from the Bambini race to the challenging 17.7 km lake loop. Races start at 09:00 in front of the Seesporthalle Großkoschen, with a friendly atmosphere, ample refreshments, and changing and washing facilities. Register online via myRacePartner; late registration is available until race day for a small fee.

name: Luckenwalder Turmfestlauf
description: Das 35. Luckenwalder Turmfest findet vom 11. bis 13. Juni 2027 rund um den Marktturm statt. Die Innenstadt verwandelt sich mit modernen Fahrgeschäften, zahlreichen Marktständen und einem abwechslungsreichen Bühnenprogramm in eine der größten Festmeilen der Region Teltow-Fläming. Das Fest ist offen für alle Besucherinnen und Besucher, unabhängig vom Geldbeutel, da 2027 auf einen regulären Kulturbeitrag verzichtet wird. Unterstützer können freiwillig spenden oder ein Unterstützerarmband erwerben, um die Tradition des Stadtfestes zu erhalten und weiterzuentwickeln.
additional: Das Turmfest beginnt an allen drei Tagen jeweils ab 12:00 Uhr. Der Festbetrieb endet freitags und samstags um 01:00 Uhr, sonntags um 22:00 Uhr. Es gibt keine reguläre Eintrittsgebühr, stattdessen wird um freiwillige Spenden gebeten. Unterstützerarmbänder sind für 10 Euro in der Touristinformation erhältlich. Die Touristinformation hat montags bis freitags zu unterschiedlichen Zeiten geöffnet, ist aber vom 24.12.2026 bis 01.01.2027 geschlossen.

name: OSTSEE Run
description: The OSTSEE Run by ROTEC is a sporting highlight as part of the OSTSEE Sports Games in Cottbus. The race offers an attractive course for runners and walkers and is part of a varied sports and leisure program featuring numerous other competitions and activities. The event welcomes sports enthusiasts of all ages and, in addition to the sporting competition, offers a lively program of activities and a large OSTSEE party with free admission. This combination of sporting event and celebration makes the OSTSEE Run a special experience in the region.

name: OSTSEE Sparkassen Halbmarathon
description: The SPARKASSEN Half Marathon takes place in Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee. The 21-kilometer course starts at 10:00 a.m. from the Möbel Höffner grounds. Race materials can be collected from 7:00 a.m. in the start and finish area. The race is open to participants aged 18 and over and offers an attractive route along the Baltic Sea coast. On-site registration is not available; participants must register in advance.

name: Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg
description: The Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg is a challenging running event held in Altenburg. Participants can choose from various distances, including the marathon, two-person marathon relay, half marathon, 13.3 km run, fitness run, children’s and students’ races, and walking events. The course takes runners through the historic city of Altenburg, with varied sections that include climbs in the city forest and along the Großer Teich. In addition to the sporting challenge, the supporting program offers a wide range of entertainment, including music, a children’s festival, and a talk by running legend Uta Pippig.

name: Tollenseseelauf
description: The Neubrandenburg Tollensesee Run is a scenic race around Lake Tollensesee that attracts more than 2,000 runners each year. With distances for young and old, the event offers a varied running festival in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is challenging, with several climbs, which is why the race is also known as “The Toughest in the North.” More than 300 volunteers help create an unforgettable running experience, with certificates, technical T-shirts, and trophies for the top finishers.

name: Waaker Bystopen-Attacke
description: The Waaker Bystopen Attack is an obstacle race in Lower Saxony, held around the Waaker Büsteppe in the Göttingen Forest. The event offers distances of 2.5 km (family run), 5 km and 10 km, with more than 30 natural and artificial obstacles. You can participate individually or as part of a team; team scoring requires at least 4 runners. Alongside the main race, there is also a Bambini Attack for the youngest participants, which does not require registration. The event focuses on fun, team spirit and exercise in nature.

name: Bürgerlauf Visbek
description: The 1st Visbek Community Run takes place in Visbek Park (Pastors Wisk) and offers a varied program for runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, as well as intermediate and main races over 5 km and 10 km, complemented by a walking or hiking route.
