Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 15:00, and all races are professionally measured. Proceeds benefit the Visbek Community Foundation, making the run a sporting event with a charitable purpose.

name: Drebber-Marathon
description: The Drebber Run offers a wide range of competitions for all ages and ability levels. The course follows an officially measured 2.34 km loop through the Jacobidrebber district, with the start and finish at the sports field. In addition to individual and relay events ranging from a children’s run to a marathon, there is an attractive supporting program for spectators and participants. Emergency services personnel are especially invited to take part in the Blue Light Cup as a relay team and showcase their performance.

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: The 4th Skolwińska Mile is an annual road race held in Szczecin, attracting both adults and children. The event is taking place and continues the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the chance to compete over a short distance. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide an easy way to get in touch via the registration form, as well as administrative support.
course_highlights: A 1-mile distance (1,609 meters) on scenic recreational grounds
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the top finishers and medals for everyone who finishes
additional: Children’s races of approximately 200 meters are also held as part of the event. Participants can use the registration form available on the website to quickly contact the organizer and system administrator. Participants can use training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks. The event is supported by a local building supply store, and the participant limit is 60.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level and achieve officially recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime character. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by providing refreshments after the race and awards for the winners.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Night race starting at 21:55
Urban course through the streets of Szamotuły
additional: Temporary traffic changes apply on race day, with parking restrictions and designated detours. Race packet collection is available from 17:00 to 21:30. Refreshments for participants and awards for the winners are planned after the race. There are 26 free race packets available for people with disabilities in the family race, accompanied by a caregiver; apply by email.

name: Leśna ZaDyszka
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race held in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest District in the Regimin Municipality, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in forest areas. The course is a 5 km loop through forest tracks and an asphalt section, showcasing the beauty of the Masovian countryside. Participants can choose from three events: 5 km, 10 km (2 loops), and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. Children can take part in a 1,500 m run with no rankings. The start and finish are in a forest clearing by the Szulmierz–Regimin road, and times are recorded using a professional chip timing system.
course_highlights: A 5 km loop through forest tracks and asphalt (4 km through the forest, 1 km on asphalt)
Picturesque Masovian countryside
Start and finish in a forest clearing by the Szulmierz–Regimin road
additional: Times are recorded using chips attached to participants’ shoes. The race office opens at 9:00. All participants receive a commemorative medal and a recovery meal. Prizes are awarded for places in age-group and open categories. Participants can choose a standard T-shirt at no extra cost or a Premium LAS T-shirt for an additional 20 zł. Volunteers provide course support.

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: The VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka is a 10 km race in Kwidzyn, in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is scheduled for Saturday, 12 June 2027. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging paved course. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels to help participants prepare optimally for race day.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging paved course
10 km distance
Road race in scenic Kwidzyn
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to a runner’s VDOT level, with detailed instructions and expert support.

name: 200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
XVI Grand Prix Stargardu Cztery Pory Roku
location: Morzyczyn, Stargard County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Dadathlon Run and Festival (Stockholm, Hagaparken)
description: DaddyHood Dadathlon är ett sportevenemang för pappor och barn som syftar till att inspirera till rörelse och värdefull tid tillsammans. Evenemanget hålls både live i Hagaparken, Stockholm, och virtuellt för deltagare som inte kan närvara fysiskt. Det är en familjevänlig aktivitet som främjar hälsosamma vanor och gemenskap bland aktiva pappor och deras barn.
course_highlights: Familjevänlig löpning i Hagaparken, Stockholm
Evenemanget inkluderar både live och virtuell deltagandeform
Strollers välkomna under löpningen
additional: Evenemanget är en del av en global virtuell sportutmaning med tre sporter under tre månader: löpning i maj, cykling i juni och vandring. Strollers är välkomna under löpningen. Evenemanget är gratis att delta i virtuellt och syftar till att skapa oförglömliga minnen och bygga hälsosamma vanor tillsammans med barnen. Dadathlon består av tre grenar som arrangeras vid olika tillfällen under året. Aktiviteten kan registreras med app eller sportklocka.

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, Trolltrail
description: TrollTrail is a short, technical and fun trail race in beautiful surroundings by Trollvann in Oslo. The race covers 6.3 kilometres of hilly terrain, including gravel, trails, off-road sections and asphalt. The course combines fast sections with challenging trails and flowing forest paths, and is suitable both for experienced trail runners and for those looking to try something new off-road. The final race has a mass start on 13 June at 11:00, offering a tough running experience in the forest.
course_highlights: 6.3 km of hilly, technical running on gravel, trails, off-road sections and asphalt
The course runs alongside Trollvann, Svartputten, Linderudkollen ski centre and Langevann
A combination of fast sections and challenging trails, with flowing forest paths
additional: Race bibs can be collected from Löplabbet Oslo sentrum from 7 April. The same race bib is used throughout the series. A new race bib can be purchased for 75 kr. The courses will only be marked for the mass start. GPX files and course maps are available to download. When crossing an asphalt road, runners must run along the side between the road and the water.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a simple and efficient running event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, designed to help runners achieve fast times. The race takes place on a flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop, with the option to set up your own nutrition table along the way. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. Race bibs are collected at a self-service station at the venue, which also has free parking, changing rooms and toilets. Perseløpet has a friendly atmosphere, and runners who set a personal best get to ring the bell by the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop
Personal nutrition table passed on every lap
Venue at Ås school with free parking, changing rooms and toilets
additional: Race bibs are collected at a self-service station about two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Runners can place their own bottles and gels on the nutrition table before the start. At selected races, ninth-grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station and raise money for their school trip. A countdown feature and lap-time calculator are available for planning. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets at the venue. Registration is via RaceDays, and half-marathon runners can arrange their own drinks and nutrition.

name: Trollheimsløpet
description: Trollheimsløpet is a traditional race held in the centre of Rindal, starting and finishing at Trollbanen. The course is mainly on trails, with sections of grass, asphalt and gravel, and offers scenic surroundings around Igltjønna. There are several distances and categories, including a children’s race, competitive categories and a fun run, making the event accessible to all ages and abilities. The event also has a friendly atmosphere, with kiosk sales, changing facilities and awards for both children and adults.
course_highlights: The course is mainly on trails, with sections of grass, asphalt and gravel
Around the picturesque Igltjønna in the centre of Rindal
An optional extra loop in the fun run gives a distance of 8 km
additional: The children’s race (200 m) starts at 11:45, with no timing. The 1 km competitive categories for ages 11–14 start at 12:20, and the 6 km race for older categories starts at 12:45. The untimed fun run offers a choice of 1, 3 or 8 km, with start times between 10:30 and 12:00. All children’s race participants receive awards, and category winners aged 15 and over receive cash prizes. Participants celebrating a milestone receive recognition for their years of participation. The race office is at the start; changing facilities are at Rindalshuset, and toilets are available at the event venue. Previous editions have included an untimed fun run and a children’s race.

name: Utleiraløpet
description: Utleira Run is a family-friendly fun run in Utleira, Trondheim, organized by Utleira IL ski/athletics. The event offers distances ranging from 600 metres for children to a 21 km Forest Marathon through Estenstadmarka, bringing together children, recreational runners and competitive runners for a day filled with the joy of running, activity and a festive atmosphere. The event has a long tradition dating back to 2015 and has grown into an inclusive running festival with activities for the whole family. The start and finish are at Utleirahallen, with an emphasis on both competition and socializing.
course_highlights: 21 km Forest Marathon through Estenstadmarka
Children’s races of 600 metres and 2 km
Fast, spectator-friendly course around Leira for the 5 km and 10 km
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Utleirahallen on Saturday 12 June from 19:00 to 21:00 or on race day. Timing is provided for all distances except the 5 km recreational run. The award ceremony for the Forest Marathon is at approximately 11:30, and for the 5 km and 10 km at approximately 13:15–13:30. Everyone who finishes receives a medal. There are water stations on the 5 km and 10 km courses. The children’s races start at 10:00 and 10:15, with activities for the children afterwards. Course records are rewarded with a gift card worth 1,000 kroner from Hank Sport. In 2026, all finishers received a medal. Information about prices and prizes may vary from year to year.

name: Perseløpet
description: Perseløpet is a race in Eidsvoll starting at Ås school, offering a simple and efficient setup for achieving fast times. The race takes place on a flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop, with the option of having your own nutrition table along the course. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, so both beginners and experienced runners can find a suitable challenge. The event emphasizes personal-record attempts and community, with the option to celebrate personal records near the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop
Your own nutrition table, passed on every lap
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km
additional: Race bibs are collected by self-service at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms, and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, 9th-grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan split times. The weather forecast is updated four times daily using satellite data for the area around Ås school. Race bibs are collected by self-service at the school from approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms, and toilets are available at the venue. Registration and current prices are available from RaceDays.

name: EKVA lahtised kergej. võistl.
description: The EKVA Open Athletics Competitions take place in Kohila and offer veterans and recreational athletes the opportunity to compete in a variety of track and field events. The competitions are intended for active athletes of all ages who want to test themselves and enjoy the thrill of athletics. EKVA regularly organizes various championships and series that promote running and athletics in Estonia. The competitions are open to both recreational athletes and veterans, with age-group events available.

name: Viimsi maraton
description: Viimsi Marathon 2026 takes place on the Viimsi Peninsula and offers participants a course consisting of one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied terrain includes both paved roads and forest trails, with climbs and descents throughout the distance. It is a great opportunity to enjoy a summer run with a positive community.

name: Barmstedter Stadtlauf
description: The 22nd Barmstedt City Run takes place in Barmstedt. The event offers measured 5 km and 10 km circuits that are eligible for rankings. In addition to the main races, there are Nordic walking, walking, children’s and toddlers’ races. The start and finish are at the market square in Barmstedt, and the route runs through the town centre and around Lake Rantzau, on a variety of surfaces including cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km and 10 km circuits, eligible for rankings
Route through Barmstedt’s town centre and around Lake Rantzau
Varied surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths
additional: Timing is done with a loan chip worn around the ankle (except for the children’s races), which is collected at the finish. Unreturned chips will be charged at 40 euros. Jogging strollers and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. The races have different age categories and minimum ages. The route may vary slightly due to construction work; updates will be posted on the website. Routes are measured; surfaces vary; online registration is available; no late registrations; refreshments and medals are included.

name: Donatus-Lauf
location: Sportgelände SC Fortuna Liblar, Hamburg-Rissen, Hamburg, Germany
description: The Donatuslauf takes place around Lake Donatus on the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds in Hamburg-Rissen. The event offers a range of race distances, from a 400 m toddlers’ run and 1,200 m schoolchildren’s races to a half marathon and a 10 km main race. The races are designed for different age groups and offer a family-friendly atmosphere, with additional walking and family races. The course is varied and clearly marked, with the start and finish area close to Erftstadt railway station. Awards ceremonies take place shortly after the races, and certificates can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400 m to a half marathon
Start and finish area near Erftstadt railway station, with easy access
Family race and Nordic walking as additional offerings
additional: Late entries are accepted only until the participant limit is reached and incur a €3 late-entry fee. Awards ceremonies take place on the sports grounds immediately after the respective races. Parking is available only at Erftstadt railway station, just 100 m from the start and finish area. Certificates can be downloaded online as PDFs and printed. Courses around Lake Donatus, online registration, parking at Erftstadt railway station, start and finish area at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds

name: Handewitter Sommerlauf
description: Der Handewitter Sommerlauf am 27. Juni 2027 bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern aller Leistungsstufen passende Strecken mit wenigen Höhenmetern. Von Bambini über 2,5 km, 5 km, 10 km, Nordic Walking, Halbmarathon bis hin zu Staffel- und Rollstuhlrennen ist für jeden etwas dabei. Die Veranstaltung findet rund um die Wikinghalle in Handewitt statt und besticht durch eine top organisierte Atmosphäre, starke Stimmung und ein unvergessliches Zielerlebnis. Die DLV vermessenen Strecken laden sowohl Einsteiger als auch ambitionierte Läufer ein, ihren sportlichen Tag individuell zu gestalten.
course_highlights: Strecken mit wenigen Höhenmetern rund um die Wikinghalle und durch Handewitt
Vielfältige DLV vermessene Strecken von 400 m Bambini bis Halbmarathon
Versorgungsstationen mit Wasser, Äpfeln und Bananen auf den längeren Strecken
additional: Start- und Zielbereich an der Wikinghalle in Handewitt. Startnummernausgabe am Samstag von 12:00 bis 16:00 Uhr und Sonntag ab 08:30 Uhr. Medaillen aus Holz, Verzicht auf Pappbecher, Nutzung eines Mehrwegsystems. Versorgung mit Getränken und Obst im Zielbereich und auf den Strecken. Online-Urkunden zum Download nach dem Lauf. Parkmöglichkeiten fußläufig zum Veranstaltungsort und Anreise mit ÖPNV möglich. Ummeldung bis Meldeschluss gegen Gebühr möglich.

name: Drei-Länder-Lauf
description: The Three-Country Run takes place in Arenshausen and connects the regions of Thuringia, Lower Saxony and Hesse. The event offers various race distances, including 1.2 km, 2 km, 5 km and 13 km, some of which are loop courses and others out-and-back races. In addition to the main races, there is a fun run for preschool children with no timing, as well as Nordic walking as a non-competitive event. The run has a long tradition as a symbol of the region growing together after German reunification.

name: Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf
description: Der Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung in Schackensleben, etwa 25 km westlich von Magdeburg. Angeboten werden Strecken über 400 m, 1,4 km, 6,0 km und 10,8 km, die durch den Ort und die umliegende Landschaft mit bördetypischem welligem Profil führen. Die Läufe finden auf Straßen und befestigten Feldwegen statt und bieten mehrere Getränkestellen. Für die Teilnehmer gibt es gute Umkleide- und Duschmöglichkeiten sowie eine umfassende Verpflegung mit Kaffee, Kuchen, Getränken und Gegrilltem. Nach dem Zieleinlauf können sich die Läufer mit Getränken und Obst stärken, und es gibt eine traditionelle Tombola mit attraktiven Preisen.
course_highlights: Streckenführung durch den Ort Schackensleben und die umliegende Landschaft mit welligem Profil
Laufen auf Straßen und befestigten Feldwegen
Mehrere Getränkestellen entlang der Strecke
additional: Start und Ziel aller Strecken ist der Sportplatz mit Umkleide- und Duschmöglichkeiten im Vereinshaus. Die Verpflegung umfasst Kaffee, Kuchen, Schmalzstullen, Getränke und Gegrilltes. Nach dem Zieleinlauf gibt es Getränke und Obst für die Teilnehmer. Parallel zur Siegerehrung findet eine Tombola mit attraktiven Preisen statt. Der Hopfenlauf ist Teil des Novo Nordisk Landescups und des Elbe-Ohre-Cups.

name: REWE Women´s Run Hamburg
description: The REWE Women’s Run Hamburg is a road race for beginners and ambitious runners in the Elbe metropolis of Hamburg. The event offers a measured 10 km loop course starting and finishing at Ballindamm. In addition to the main race, there is also the REWE Girl’s Run for girls aged 5 to 10 over 1 kilometer. Participants receive a finisher medal and can use showers and changing facilities after the race.

name: Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund
description: Der Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf in der Stadt Kappeln, der jährlich vom TSV Kappeln veranstaltet wird. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern verschiedener Altersklassen und Leistungsniveaus die Möglichkeit, auf einer abwechslungsreichen Strecke durch die Stadt und ihre Umgebung zu laufen. Der Lauf fördert den Breitensport und das Gemeinschaftsgefühl in der Region. Teilnehmer können sich auf eine gut organisierte Veranstaltung mit familiärer Atmosphäre freuen.
course_highlights: Strecke führt durch die Innenstadt von Kappeln
Abwechslungsreiche Laufroute mit Stadt- und Naturabschnitten
Geeignet für Läufer aller Altersklassen und Leistungsniveaus
additional: Die Veranstaltung wird vom TSV Kappeln organisiert, einem Sportverein mit vielfältigem Sportangebot. Es gibt keine expliziten Angaben zu Startzeiten, Wellen, oder besonderen Ausstattungen auf der Webseite. Die Anmeldung erfolgt online über die Startgeld-Seite. Die Veranstaltung ist Teil des Vereinsprogramms und wird regelmäßig in den News des TSV Kappeln kommuniziert.

name: Alfelder Bernd Meyer Staffelmarathon
description: The Alfelder Bernd Meyer Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay marathon held in Alfeld (Leine). The event is open to runners from across the region and is organized jointly by several local running clubs and the town of Alfeld. The course is an approximately 3 km loop, run twice, with the start and finish on the market square. Each team consists of 7 runners, who must be registered by name. Timing is electronic, using disposable transponders. There is also a children’s race of approximately 700 m.

name: Barsbütteler Volkslauf
description: The Barsbüttel Fun Run is a long-standing running event held every June at the sports field in the Barsbüttel Sports Center. It offers a range of distances from 400 m to 10 km, which are mostly flat and run along paved or firm, sandy farm tracks. Most of the routes pass through the traffic-free Barsbüttel countryside and offer scenic views, particularly the longer 5 km and 10 km routes. Times are measured electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterward. Food and refreshments are also available for runners and spectators.

name: Ludwigsluster Schlossgartenlauf
description: The Ludwigslust Palace Garden Run takes place in Ludwigslust Palace Park and offers runners of all ages a varied choice of distances. The routes range from 2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, with additional walking events over 5 and 10 km. New to the program is a fun run for the youngest children, with no registration or timing, who receive an official medal at the finish. This traditional event warmly welcomes beginners and professionals alike to enjoy the beautiful park landscape.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: XVII Elbląski Bieg Piekarczyka Mini Bieg Piekarczyka
description: The Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is one of the largest and best-known running events in Elbląg, held every year in June. The two-day event combines sporting competition with numerous side attractions, including races at various distances and activities for children. The route runs through the streets of the city centre and features a flat asphalt-and-cobblestone surface with one hill, making it suitable for fast times. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, as well as many spectators cheering participants along the route.
course_highlights: Flat route with one hill on Teatralna Street
Asphalt (80%) and cobblestones (20%)
Route certified by the Polish Athletics Association
additional: The time limit for completing the race is 1 hour and 30 minutes. The Mini Piekarczyk Run takes place on loops of Teatralna Street ranging from 50 to 600 metres, adjusted to the children's ages. Race packs are distributed at two locations: Ogrody Shopping Centre (13 June) and the “Helena” MOSiR ice rink (14 June). Participants over the age of 70 are exempt from the entry fee after registering.

name: Rozbiegane Suwałki
description: Rozbiegane Suwałki is an annual citywide celebration of running held in June in Suwałki. The three-day event attracts hundreds of participants of different ages and experience levels. The programme includes races for children, the Bieg na Piątkę (5 km), the Suwalska Ćwiartka (10.5 km), and the Śniadaniowy Bieg na Wyspę (approx. 3.5 km). The courses are flat and fast, making them ideal for personal bests, and the atmosphere combines sporting competition with community spirit.
course_highlights: Flat, fast urban courses
Evening 10.5 km main race—the Suwalska Ćwiartka
A range of distances for children and adults
additional: The three-day event includes races for children and young people, a 5 km race, the 10.5 km main race in the evening, and a recreational race of approximately 3.5 km with breakfast at the finish. The organizer is the Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach, which also offers bicycle and water-sports equipment rentals, as well as sports facility rentals.

name: X Bieg o Złotą Monetę
description: The 9th Charity Run for the Golden Coin in Olsztyn is an annual running event organised by the Future for Children Foundation to support sick and disabled children from Warmia and Masuria. The 5 km main race takes place by Lake Ukiel and is open to runners of varying abilities, including beginners. The event also features a family picnic and numerous attractions, giving participants the chance to help through physical activity and fun. The run is the finale of the “GOOD GIVES BACK” campaign and supports rehabilitation and the purchase of medical equipment for children.
course_highlights: A scenic route by Lake Ukiel in Olsztyn
Welcoming and accessible to runners of all abilities, including walkers
5 km distance with a one-hour time limit
additional: The event also includes children’s fun runs over distances starting at 400 m, as well as junior and youth races over age-appropriate distances. The special guest is Krystyna Abramczyk Puzio, a multiple Polish and world champion in weightlifting. After the run, there is a family picnic with prizes and gifts for participants.

name: Rapla Selveri suurjooks, virtuaaljooks
description: Rapla Selveri Suurjooks is a traditional running race held in Rapla, offering several distance options from children’s races to a half marathon. The race centre is located in the Rapla Selver car park, and the routes run along the town’s streets and highways. They are clearly marked and measured. Participants’ safety is ensured, and the event is organised by Kehakultuur OÜ in cooperation with Jooksja magazine. Pre-registration closes on 20 May, and start groups are formed according to expected finish times to ensure a smooth and safe race day.

name: Meine Nacht - Kirche laufend erleben
description: Der Lauf "Meine Nacht - Kirche laufend erleben" findet voraussichtlich am 11. Juni 2027 in 38527 Meine statt. Es handelt sich um einen 10 km Lauf mit flachem Profil, der auch als 5er-Staffel mit Teilstrecken von jeweils 2 km angeboten wird. Der Start erfolgt um 20:00 Uhr, und es gibt zudem Wettbewerbe für Kinder und Jugendliche. Die Strecke ist flach und eignet sich für Läufer aller Leistungsstufen.
course_highlights: Flache Strecke
10 km Distanz mit 5er-Staffel (Teilstrecken je 2 km)
Startzeit am Abend um 20:00 Uhr
additional: Start und Ziel sind für alle Wettbewerbe gleich. Für die genaue Ortsanzeige wird RUNME Premium benötigt. Es werden auch Wettbewerbe für Kinder und Jugendliche angeboten.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
organizer: VIF Gute Friidrott och Blodcentralen i Visby
description: Blodomloppet i Visby är ett motionslopp som arrangeras för att uppmärksamma den livsviktiga blodgivningen och främja en hälsosam livsstil. Deltagarna kan välja att gå, jogga eller springa 5 km eller 10 km längs vackra banor som inkluderar Visbys ringmur, innerstad, strandpromenad, Almedalen och hamnen. Det finns även ett Lilla Blodomloppet för barn med kortare distanser. Loppet är öppet för både individuella deltagare och lag, och avslutas med en gemensam picknick för deltagarna.
course_highlights: 5 km-banan går längs Visbys ringmur och innerstad med kulturarv
10 km-banan inkluderar ringmuren, strandpromenaden, Almedalen och Visbys hamn
Lilla Blodomloppet går i stadsmiljö med start bakom stora scenen
additional: Efteranmälan sker på plats från kl 16.00 den 16 juni i Informationstältet. Deltagare får t-shirt, nummerlapp, medalj och gåva till blodgivare. Lagdeltagare kan hämta ut picknickkasse efter målgång eller använda picknickkort (gäller endast Blodomloppet på distans). Banorna är natursköna och går genom historiska och centrala delar av Visby. Det finns vätskestationer och sjukvård på plats. Omklädning och toaletter finns tillgängliga. Parkering och vägbeskrivning finns på hemsidan. Anmälan kan göras individuellt eller i lag med högst fem deltagare. Deltagarna får t-shirt, nummerlapp och medalj; lagdeltagare kan hämta en picknickkasse efter målgång. Lilla Blodomloppet har distanserna 300 m och 1,6 km.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/visby/): 2027-06-15 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 15 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-15)

name: Namdalskarusellen 2027 løp 5 - Hestmarka 5km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris : 80 ,- (+ lisens) for enkeltløp i karusellen.

description: Namdalskarusellen 5 km Hestmarka is a pleasant race in Namsos that is part of Namdal Running Club’s race series. The race offers a varied course that starts on Bøndernesvegen and goes via the pedestrian path over Gamle Namsbrua, through Holmenvegen and Industrivegen, before finishing at the start area. Participants in the series receive a porcelain mug as a participation prize if they take part in at least four of the eight races. The race is suitable for all age groups, with categories from age 12 and up.
course_highlights: The course starts on Bøndernesvegen and follows the pedestrian path over Gamle Namsbrua
The route goes through Holmenvegen, Industrivegen and FV17
The finish is near the start area at E-nor AS in Hestmarka
additional: Age categories start at 12 and are divided into several groups. A porcelain mug is awarded as a participation prize for taking part in at least 4 of the 8 races in Namdalskarusellen. Meeting point and start at Hestmarka by E-nor AS.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 2 etapas
description: Jonava Running Cup - 2026, Stage 2 is a running event taking place in the village of Ragožiai, Jonava District. This traditional race is intended for active sports enthusiasts and offers various distances and the opportunity to test their endurance and strength. The event is open to everyone who wants to spend time actively and enjoy running in nature. It is organized by the Lithuanian Amateur Runners Association, which ensures the smooth running of the competition and participants’ comfort.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the surroundings of the village of Ragožiai
Different distances are adapted for runners of various levels
Nature and natural trails provide an enjoyable running experience
additional: The event is open to all active and sporty people in Lithuania. Among the different distances and obstacle courses, everyone can find a suitable challenge or activity. There is no specific information about the event course or the number of participants; registration takes place through the official platform.

name: 95. Terrainkurweg Marathon
description: The 95th Terrainkurweg Marathon in Salzgitter is a challenging run on a hilly course with about 150 meters of elevation gain and loss. The route passes through Vöppstedter Forest, by the Liebenburg forester’s lodge, and along the Salzgitter golf course. The event is not an official DLV event and is intended for well-trained runners. Refreshments, including drinks and snacks, are available in a covered room.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Center for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors in a sporting atmosphere. The event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix and is held regularly, promoting a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Bolechowo, in the Czerwonak municipality.
The previous recorded edition covered a distance of 5 km.
The event is part of the Active Czerwonak at Night series.
additional: The event is free and takes place in the evening, usually between 19:30 and 22:00. This recurring sporting event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees, or required equipment.

name: Midsommarjoggen 2026
description: Midsommarjoggen är en löparfest i Rynningevikens naturreservat i Örebro som bjuder in löpare, familjer och kollegor att tillsammans kicka igång midsommarveckan. Loppet är 7,2 km långt och går på lättsprungen grusväg med vackra vyer och två träbroar över Lillån. För de yngsta finns ett fartfyllt Kidsrun på 600 meter utan tidtagning. Efter målgång fortsätter kvällen med en trevlig after run med mat, dryck och gemenskap vid Stora Hjortstorps Gård.
course_highlights: 7,2 km genom Rynningevikens naturreservat på lättsprungen grusväg
Två träbroar över Lillån
Två längre backar vid Venastugan
additional: Start för Kidsrun kl 17:45 med samling 17:40. Nummerlappar hämtas från kl 16:00 till 18:00 på tävlingsdagen. Tidtagning sker med transponder som lånas ut vid nummerlappsutdelningen och ska lämnas tillbaka efter loppet. Vatten och sportdryck finns vid 3 och 5 km. Toaletter finns nära tävlingsområdet och vid vätskestationerna. Ingen omklädning eller dusch finns på plats. After run med mat och dryck erbjuds efter loppet (ingår ej i startavgiften). Ungdomar födda 2008 eller senare får 50% rabatt på startavgiften. Medlemmar i vissa löparklubbar kan få rabatt via medlemssidor. Gruppanmälan möjlig via kontakt med info@epictrail.se.

name: Sommerkarusell Ålesund - 1. løp
description: Sommerkarusell Ålesund is a long-standing race series organized by Ålesundløpene, with races in scenic surroundings along Lillevatnet and Brusdalsvatnet in Vasstranda. The courses are relatively flat and paved, with little traffic, and are suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. The series consists of several races throughout the summer, and participants who complete multiple races receive a nice medal. The start of the first race in 2027 is at the western end of Lillevatnet in Spjelkavik.
course_highlights: The courses run along Lillevatnet and Brusdalsvatnet in Vasstranda
Relatively flat paved courses with little traffic
Distances of 5 km and 10 km officially measured by Kondis
additional: 10 km starts at 18:00 and 5 km at 18:05, from the car park by the walking path at the western end of Lillevatnet in Spjelkavik. Gift prizes are awarded after each race. Medals are awarded to those who take part in 2 or 3 races in the series. Course records have been set for the 5 km and 10 km distances. The participation record is 132 finishers in a summer race along Vasstranda.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Mesnaelva opp

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: For klassene 0-11 år, 12-15 og 16-19 år kr 80,-

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Familie koster kr 250,- pr løp pr familie

description: Mesnaelva Uphill is a challenging uphill race held in scenic surroundings along the Mesna River in Lillehammer. The course climbs 360 metres over approximately 4 km, starting at Strandtorget and finishing at Kanten kro. It is the first uphill race in the Sørdalskarusellen and has been held since 2008. In addition to the main course, there is a shorter 2.3 km course for younger participants with 241 metres of elevation gain. The event offers both virtual participation and evening mass starts in waves.
course_highlights: 4 km course with 360 metres of elevation gain, from 123 metres above sea level to 483 metres above sea level
The course follows the Mesna River through scenic areas of Lillehammer
Short course for younger participants: 2.3 km with 241 metres of elevation gain and a 10.2% gradient
additional: Mass start in waves: Wave 1 starts at 19:00 for men aged 12–39; Wave 2 starts at 19:01 for women aged 12–39 and men aged 40–49; Wave 3 starts at 19:02 for the remaining categories; and Wave 4 starts at 19:00 for the youngest participants on the short course. There is a drinks station in the finish area, clothing transport from the start to the finish, and medical services at the finish area. Results are sent to participants' mobile phones immediately after they finish. Participants can also take part virtually from 15–17 June and record their time via My Page under the self timing tab. There is also a short course for children, starting at Badedammen.

name: Filter Temposari (3. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or inline skating. The events take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring speed races with individual starts. The Tallinn event is held at Vabaduse väljak, on a short, technical course well suited to sprint enthusiasts. Series finishers are eligible for the Kullapada awards programme, which rewards consistent participation in every event.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 IV etapp 400m
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage IV (400 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is intended for all running enthusiasts. The series features various distances and age groups, with participants earning points according to their placing in each race. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners; payment is in cash at the venue. Pre-registration is recommended and closes at 16:30 on race day. Those who register later will be placed in the later races. Series winners are determined by age group, and the awards ceremony takes place at the end of the series.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Distance Running Series is a sports series in Kohila Municipality consisting of several stages and aimed at sports enthusiasts in the region. The series aims to promote sports and physical activity and give participants the opportunity to compete over various distances. Participants at each stage receive a commemorative medal, and points are tallied across the series in the competition classes. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Centre, which supports a healthy lifestyle and active movement.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is an athletics track-running series organized by Tartu Spordiselts Kalev, offering the opportunity to take part in multiple meets at stadiums in Tartu and Ülenurme. The series aims to provide competition opportunities for children and young people and promote participation in athletics in the city and county of Tartu. Competitions take place during the summer months and are open to various age groups. Registration closes at 12:00 on the day of the competition, allowing for flexible participation.

name: Rakvere lahtised MV
description: The Rakvere Open Championships are athletics championships held at Rakvere Stadium. The competition brings together the local sporting community and offers an opportunity to watch a variety of track and field events. The event is open to everyone interested and creates a sporty, supportive atmosphere.

name: Tänndalen 100 miles
location: Ski Lodge Tänndalen, Tänndalen, Härjedalen Municipality, Jämtland County, Sverige
description: Tänndalen 100 miles är ett spektakulärt ultralopp på 161 kilometer som går på lättlöpt asfalt genom svensk och norsk fjällnatur. Loppet startar vid Ski Lodge i Tänndalen och tar dig genom vidsträckta fjällvidder, längs glittrande vatten och hela vägen till världsarvsstaden Røros, för att sedan återvända till målgång vid Ski Lodge. Loppet bjuder på magiskt midsommarljus och en unik fjällupplevelse för ultralöpare.
course_highlights: 161 km lättlöpt landsväg genom svensk och norsk fjällnatur
Sträckan inkluderar en loop till Funäsdalen och världsarvsstaden Røros
Start och mål vid Ski Lodge i Tänndalen
additional: Loppet startar klockan 19.00. Arrangörens information anger att solnedgången är omkring klockan 23 och beskriver loppet som ett av få 100 miles-lopp där pannlampa inte behövs. Prispengar erbjuds till de tre främsta i dam- och herrklass.

name: Borejoggen
price_range: 300–350 kr för Borejoggen och Lagjoggen enligt 2026 års prisuppgifter; Minijoggen 150 kr
description: Borejoggen är en anrik löpartävling som arrangeras i Torsby varje midsommarafton och har en lång tradition med 42 år bakom sig. Loppet går på en 8,5 kilometer lång asfaltbana i centrala Torsby och välkomnar alla löpare oavsett nivå, från elit till motionär. För barn och ungdomar finns Minijoggen på 1,5 kilometer. Det finns även en populär lagtävling, Lagjoggen, där tre deltagare tävlar tillsammans och lagets sammanlagda tid räknas.
course_highlights: 8,5 km asfaltbana i centrala Torsby
Minijoggen för barn och ungdomar på 1,5 km
Vätskekontroller vid 2 km, 4 km, 5,8 km och i mål
additional: Gemensam start Minijoggen kl. 9.30 på Östmarksvägen. Gemensam start för Borejoggen och Lagjoggen kl. 11.00 på Östmarksvägen. Ombyte och dusch finns i Torsby Skidtunnel och Valbergsstugan. Priser delas ut för spurtpris vid 2 km, bergspris vid Kollsberg efter 5 km, samt till de tre främsta i dam- och herrklasserna och lagklassen. Trafikvakter och vägvisare finns vid trafikerade vägpassager. Sjukvård finns vid mål och beredd för utryckning på banan. Tidigare upplagor har haft start och mål vid Herrgårdsparken. Borejoggen och Lagjoggen har startat kl. 11.00 och Minijoggen kl. 9.30.

name: Orsakajtn
description: Orsakajt'n och Orsabajk'n är en MTB- och löptävling som arrangeras varje midsommarafton i Orsa. Tävlingen följer en bana i Oreälvens dalgång med skogsstigar, grusvägar och lite asfalt, med lätt till måttlig kupering över sandåsar. Startnummer skickas digitalt dagen före och hämtas på plats eller på Karl Hedin i Orsa. MTB-tävlingen kräver licens och medlemskap i förening ansluten till Svenska Cykelförbundet.
course_highlights: Banan går i Oreälvens dalgång på skogsstigar, grusvägar och asfalt
Lätt till måttlig kupering över fina sandåsar
Banan är markerad med orange enduropilar och km-skyltar
additional: Startnummer skickas digitalt till mobilen dagen före tävlingen. Nummerlapp hämtas på Karl Hedin i Orsa torsdag 16:00-20:00 eller på startplats på tävlingsdagen. Inga efteranmälningar på plats, anmälan stänger en timme före start. Inga återbetalningar vid skada eller sjukdom. Parkering finns vid Lillåvallen. Anmälan sker online och stänger en timme före start; efteranmälan på plats erbjuds inte. Nummerlappar hämtas hos Karl Hedin i Orsa eller vid respektive startplats på tävlingsdagen.

name: Vikersundbakken Trappeløp. Vegard Hjelmesæths minneløp 2027
description: Vikersundbakken Stair Run. Vegard Hjelmesæth Memorial Run 2027 takes place on Friday, June 18, 2027, in Modum. This unique race offers 6-, 12- and 24-hour events, where participants run up the stairs in the ski jump and down the road on a loop of approximately 2.3 km with 200 metres of elevation gain per lap. The goal is to complete as many laps as possible within the chosen time limit. There is also an option for a children's race and a single lap for those who wish to take part.
course_highlights: Run up the stairs at the Vikersundbakken ski jump
A loop of approximately 2.3 km with 200 metres of elevation gain per lap
Run down the road after the ski jump
additional: Tickets are sold via racetracker.one. The event includes 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, as well as a children's race and the option to run a single lap. The loop has 200 metres of elevation gain and goes both up the stairs in the ski jump and down the road. Registration via racetracker.one. There is also a single-lap competition and a children's race.

name: Skagerrakmila
description: Skagerrakmila is a summer race in Arendal that passes through the city centre and along the waterfront. The course offers varied terrain, with both flat sections and challenging climbs, including a tough hill by the kayak club. The start and finish are in Pollen, and the race is suitable for recreational runners looking for a challenging 10 km in beautiful surroundings. The event is organised by IK Grane Arendal Friidrett and has a pleasant summer atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Pollen, in central Arendal
The course runs along the waterfront with lovely views and passes several landmarks, including Barbu Church and Arendal Old Town Hall
A challenging climb up to Vollenetoppen and a steep hill by the kayak club
additional: The children's race starts in Pollen and follows a shorter route through the city centre. The start and finish have been moved approximately 100 metres to improve flow in the finish area. There is a key point on the course with crossing traffic between 5.5 and 6.5 km, where runners must keep to the right. A children's race is also held. The course information is based on the 2025 map, so the route for 2027 may be different.

name: Tallinna noorte MV
description: The Tallinn Youth Championships is an individual athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Tallinn. The competition includes several age groups, from U-14 to adults, and a range of athletics events, including running, jumping, putting, and throwing. Its aim is to honour the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. Medals are awarded in all age groups, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at a stadium and starts at 11:00 in the morning; registration opens at 10:00.

name: 21. Laatzen Leinelauf
description: The 21st Laatzen Leinelauf is taking place, offering runners routes of 3.5 km, 6.5 km, and 10 km through the idyllic Leine floodplain, with nature, water, and wide-open meadows. The event also includes a 1.2 km Bambini run and a 6.5 km walking category. The 10 km route includes a team classification for mixed teams. The traditional Laatzen Wine Festival takes place alongside the race, rounding off the evening with culinary and musical highlights.

name: 40. Braunschweiger Nachtlauf
description: The 40th Braunschweig Night Run offers a wide range of sporting events for all age groups, from Bambini races to recreational runs. The races pass through Braunschweig city center, with the start and finish on Bohlweg; the Bambini races start at Burgplatz. The event is known for its special atmosphere and for the support of the Braunschweigische Sparkassenstiftung, which makes the event possible and helps it grow. The race bib serves as a ticket for public transport in Braunschweig on the day of the event. All finishers can download certificates, and baggage drop-off is open until 23:30.

name: SportScheck RUN Hamburg
description: The SportScheck RUN Hamburg is a traditional night run around the Outer Alster, held in a lively evening atmosphere. Depending on the distance, runners can complete one or two laps of the 7.5 km route around the Alster. There are special 1 km and 1.8 km races for children. The start and finish area in Alsterpark offers a special atmosphere, with a cheering zone, photo point and a large medal wall bringing the Hanseatic flair to life at dusk.

name: Brunsbüttler Citylauf
description: The Brunsbüttel City Run is an urban running event in Brunsbüttel, Schleswig-Holstein, featuring 5 km and 10 km races, as well as a short stadium run for children. The start and finish are at the Bildungszentrum stadium on Ziegelweg. The event is open to adults, young people, school groups, corporate teams, and children—not just club athletes. The 5 km course is a loop, while the 10 km course is run twice. The youngest participants can take part in an approximately 400 m children’s run in the stadium, making it easy for families to follow all the action.

name: Jemgumer Dörploop
description: Der Jemgumer Dörploop ist ein vielseitiger Laufwettbewerb in Jemgum, der verschiedene Distanzen für alle Altersgruppen anbietet. Die Strecke besteht aus Runden von 5,3 km, die je nach Wettbewerb mehrfach gelaufen werden. Neben Einzelwettbewerben gibt es auch einen Staffelwettbewerb mit vier Läufern. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch eine elektronische Zeitmessung mit Mehrwegtranspondern aus und bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit Urkunden, Medaillen und Sachpreisen für die Teilnehmer.
course_highlights: Rundkurs von 5,3 km Länge
Staffellauf mit 4 × 5,3 km Runden
Wasserstellen auf der Strecke und Verpflegung im Ziel
additional: Nachmeldungen sind bis 60 Minuten vor dem jeweiligen Start möglich, mit einer Nachmeldegebühr von 3,00 € für alle Wettbewerbe außer Bambini und Schüler. Die Zeitmessung erfolgt elektronisch über Mehrwegtransponder am Fuß, die nach dem Lauf zurückzugeben sind (10,00 € Gebühr bei Nicht-Rückgabe). Im Ziel werden Getränke und Obst vom EDEKA Blank angeboten.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2025 Lauf 2: 34. Wöbbeler Volkslauf "Rund um den Hahnenberg"
description: The course runs around Hahnenberg and offers runners a varied challenge. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and promises a pleasant atmosphere in typical June weather, usually with sunny conditions.

name: Challenge Gdańsk 2026
description: Challenge Gdańsk is a triathlon held in a beautiful location on the Baltic Sea, in the city of freedom and Solidarity. The event includes the T100 distance, consisting of a 2 km swim in the Gulf of Gdańsk, an 80 km fast bike course through the Vistula River delta, and an 18 km run along Gdańsk’s beach and Ronald Reagan Park. The finish line is at the Gdańsk pier in Brzeźno, making for a unique finish experience. The event is an official qualifying race and attracts athletes from various categories, including Challenge Women by Brooks.
course_highlights: 2 km swim in the Gulf of Gdańsk, starting and finishing on Gdańsk Brzeźno beach
80 km fast bike course through the Vistula River delta, passing through Kiezmark, Cedry Małe, and Koszwały
18 km run over 4 laps along Gdańsk’s beach and Ronald Reagan Park, with aid stations along the course
additional: The Sprint distance starts at 8:00 from Gdańsk Brzeźno beach. The race office is open from 10:00 to 20:00. The option to purchase a start fee refund is available if withdrawing by 31 May 2027. The bike course consists of two fast laps through the Vistula River delta. The run course consists of 4 laps of 4.5 km, with aid stations on each lap. The finish line is at the pier in Gdańsk Brzeźno. Athletes must collect their race packs and attend the race briefing. The organizer reserves the right to change the course and race format in the event of adverse weather conditions.

name: Nocny Bieg Świętojański
description: The Świętojański Night Run is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the 2026 Grand Prix of Gdynia. The main 10 km race takes place amid the city’s picturesque scenery, accompanied by races for children and youth. The event attracts runners of different age groups, offering sporting competition and a chance to connect in a nighttime atmosphere. The organizers provide professional event support as well as photo and video coverage.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm
description: EcoTrail Stockholm är en naturnära löptävling som erbjuder flera distanser för alla åldrar och nivåer, från barnlopp till ultradistanser. Loppen går på vackra stigar genom skogar, skärgård, landsbygd och stadsmiljöer med hög andel naturupplevelser. Tävlingen präglas av en stark miljöprofil och gemenskap, där löpare kan utmana sig själva i en inspirerande och välorganiserad miljö. Målgången sker vid Stora Skuggans Amfiteater på Norra Djurgården, med fina medaljer och efterfest för deltagarna.
course_highlights: Hög andel natur med skogsstigar, skärgård och landsbygd
Utsiktspunkter och sevärdheter längs banan
Start och mål vid Stora Skuggans Amfiteater på Norra Djurgården
additional: Obligatorisk utrustning för 58 km inkluderar minst en liters vattenbehållare, kåsa eller mugg för dryck vid vätskestationer samt mobiltelefon med fulladdat batteri och tävlingsledningens nummer. Vätskestationerna har inte muggar, deltagarna fyller själva sin mugg/kåsa/flaska. Maxtid för 58 km är 11 timmar. För 21 km krävs kåsa, mugg eller flaska för dryck. Det finns även barnlopp och virtuella lopp i olika distanser. Medaljer i trä med unikt tema delas ut till alla som fullföljer. Start och mål vid Stora Skuggans amfiteater. Alla fullföljare får en trämedalj.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://stockholm.ecotrail.com/): 2027-06-19 — "19 juni 2027 EcoTrail Stockholm" (was estimated 2027-06-12)

name: Run Malmö
description: RUN MALMÖ är ett stadslopp som erbjuder två distanser, 21 km halvmarathon och 10 km, med gemensam start och mål i hjärtat av Malmö. Loppet bjuder på en bana som kombinerar stadens industriella charm med grönskande stråk och vackra vyer längs vattnet, vilket ger en energifylld och varierad löpupplevelse. Publikstöd och en frisk havsbris hjälper löparna hela vägen mot målet. Alla som fullföljer loppet får medalj, frukt och dryck, och det finns service med vätskestationer och sjukvård längs banan.
course_highlights: Kontrollmätt och godkänd bana på 10 km och 21,0975 km
Bana med industriell charm och inslag av grönskande stråk och lummiga stigar
Vackra vyer längs vattnet och frisk havsbris
additional: Service vid vätskestationer med vatten och sportdryck. Kontrollmätt och avstängd bana med funktionärer. Sjukvård i målområdet och på några platser längs banan. Medalj, frukt, bar och dryck till alla som fullföljer loppet. Toaletter på arrangemangsområdet och vid vätskestationerna. Möjlighet att ändra distans mot administrationsavgift. Folksams Motionsloppsförsäkring finns att köpa. Barnvagn och rullstolsdeltagande tillåtet, men banan är inte anpassad för rullstolslöpning.
