In addition to the marathon, participants can also run a shorter distance free of charge and without official timing, making it suitable for anyone who enjoys being active.

name: J. Lossmanni mälestusjooks
description: The Jüri Lossmann Memorial Run is a traditional running race held in Viljandi. The race starts at 19:00. The run is dedicated to Jüri Lossmann and offers participants the chance to enjoy a pleasant summer evening and a sporting challenge.

name: Oberlichtenauer Sommerlauf
description: The 44th Oberlichtenau Summer Run is taking place, inviting runners of all ages to a sporting event that has brought together the Saxon running community and guests from near and far for more than four decades. The day begins with children’s races over 800 metres and 2.2 kilometres for the U12 and U14 age groups. These are followed by the recreational run of approximately 5 kilometres and the challenging 13-kilometre main race, which tests stamina and agility with steep climbs and fast descents over the Keulenberg. The running group of Sportgemeinschaft Oberlichtenau looks forward to welcoming all participants.
course_highlights: Children’s race: 2 laps around the sports field (800 metres)
U12 and U14 children’s race: 2.2 km along Keulenberstraße
Main race: 13 km with challenging climbs and descents over the Keulenberg
additional: The event day starts with the children’s race at 09:45, followed by a new children’s race for U12 and U14 at 09:55. The awards ceremony takes place immediately after the children’s races. The recreational run starts at 10:25 and the main race at 10:30. The running group is led by Patrick Thomschke (department head) and Jens Schäfer (manager). The event usually takes place in summer temperatures of around 23°C. Registration and further details are available on the official website. The race is a great opportunity for runners to achieve personal bests and experience the beautiful Saxon countryside.

name: 10. Hochkippenlauf
description: The 10th Hochkippenlauf takes place at Stadion Profen and is organized by SV Eintracht Profen. Various races are offered for different age groups, from a Bambini run to distances for young people and 10 km races for adults. The event is part of a sports festival. The race is a great opportunity for sports enthusiasts of all ages to compete in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 400 m Bambini run (one lap of the stadium)
Distances of 2.1 km, 4.2 km and 5 km for young people
10 km race for U18, U20 and adults
additional: The Bambini runs take place over one lap of the stadium. The race takes place at Stadion Profen, with warm and sunny weather in July. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere and the chance to win prizes in various categories.

name: 46. Küstenkanallauf
description: The event offers 22 km, 11 km and 5.5 km races, as well as walking and hiking routes. The scenic course runs along the Küstenkanal and is suitable for runners of all ability levels. This traditional event is organized by KC Ikenbrügge von 1971 e. V.
course_highlights: Scenic route along the Küstenkanal
A choice of distances: 5.5 km, 11 km and 22 km
Walking and hiking routes available
additional: Start times: Runners in the 5.5 km, 11 km and 22 km races start at 17:00; walking and hiking start at 16:15. Register using the online form on the website or through the contact channel, providing your name, year of birth, club and town. This is a local event with a friendly atmosphere that attracts numerous runners from the region each year. Registration, results and further details are available on the official website and in the event announcement.

name: 9. Bremer Brückenlauf
price_range: ab 8,00 € bis 45,00 € je nach Kategorie und Frühbucherstatus
description: The Bremen Bridges Run invites runners to experience Bremen from a unique perspective. The course crosses bridges spanning the Weser, the Kleine Weser and the Werdersee, offering a maritime atmosphere in the heart of the city. A range of distances is available, including a half marathon, 10 km run, 5 km run, a special 5 km underwear run, and children’s races. The event promises good spirits, a summery atmosphere and breathtaking views of Bremen and the Weser.
course_highlights: Run across several bridges in Bremen
Course crosses the Weser, Kleine Weser and Werdersee
Officially measured courses eligible for record lists
additional: Optional medal engraving (10 € for adults, 7.50 € for children). Start times vary by distance, from 16:30 (underwear run) to 18:15 (5 km and 10 km walking). All main races are measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for record lists. Children’s races are privately measured. An alphabetical finish list is provided for walkers and Nordic walkers. Conditions of participation and age categories are clearly defined. Circuit course with official measurement, age categories, competition categories, medal engraving available, including Nordic walking.

name: Benkhauser Schlosslauf
location: Schloss Benkhausen, Espelkamp, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 600 m Kinderlauf kostenlos, 2 km Schülerlauf 4,00 € (bis 14.06.), 6,5 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), 10,8 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), 20,8 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), Preise steigen nach dem 14.06.
description: The Benkhausen Castle Run is a sporting event taking place for the second time in 2026, set against the unique backdrop of Benkhausen Castle. The event offers varied routes along paved side roads and footpaths in beautiful Benkhausen. The start and finish are at Benkhausen Castle Square, where race bibs are also distributed. The event is open to runners of all ages and includes several distances, including children’s and schoolchildren’s races.
course_highlights: Running routes along paved side roads and footpaths in beautiful Benkhausen
Start and finish at historic Benkhausen Castle Square
Kilometre markers along the route for guidance
additional: Late entries are possible on race day from 12:30 until 60 minutes before the start, provided the participant limit has not been reached, for an additional fee of €2. The number of participants is limited to 200 runners per main race (6.5 km, 10.8 km, 20.8 km), with a maximum of 600 registrations overall. Timing uses disposable chip technology. Shower and changing facilities are available at Benkhausen Primary School. Children’s and schoolchildren’s races award medals to all participants and have no timing or awards ceremony. The well-known announcer Heino Krüger accompanies the races. Late entries are possible on site; the participant limit for the main races is 200 per distance, with a maximum of 600 registrations overall; chip timing; event held as part of a sports festival.

name: 01. Okertalsperren Ultra-Marathon
description: The course covers 47.4 km and consists of three laps of a 15.8 km, mostly flat loop around the main arm of the Okertalsperre. The route runs along the forebay, over the dam and the main dam wall, offering a scenic course with gentle climbs. The event is suitable for experienced runners; bringing your own refreshments is recommended, and runners are responsible for their own timekeeping. After the race, participants receive certificates by email, and the results are published on the website.

name: 40. Schweriner Fünf-Seen-Lauf
description: The Schwerin Five Lakes Run is a traditional race in northern Germany, taking place for the 40th time. The event offers various race distances around Schwerin’s five lakes, including a half marathon, 15 km, 10 km and 5 km runs, as well as a one-mile lake run for children. Runners experience a scenic course with the start and finish at Bertha-Klingberg-Platz. The event is known for its excellent organization, family-friendly atmosphere and various categories, including corporate and school competitions.

name: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny
description: The Kalisz Night Amber Hellena Half Marathon is a unique nighttime half marathon held in Kalisz. The event attracts hundreds of runners from different cities, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a running challenge after dark. The half-marathon course passes through charming parts of the city, giving participants an unforgettable experience. The event has become a tradition and is popular with both amateur and professional runners.

name: Mam Marzenie 12.RAZ 25h RUN
organizer: Fundacja Mam Marzenie oraz Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia (RAZ Szczecin)
description: 25h RUN is a unique running event organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, combining sport with charity. The 10th anniversary edition takes place by Lake Arkonka in Szczecin and aims to make Marlena, one of the foundation’s beneficiaries, dream come true: a trip to the island of Zakynthos. Participants run for 25 hours, and every kilometer brings them closer to achieving this goal. It is not only a sporting challenge, but also an opportunity to work together to support children in need.

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowo ZaDyszka is an annual road race held in Janikowo, attracting runners of different ages and ability levels. The race covers 10 km, with professional timekeeping provided using Chronotrack technology. The event is organized by the Janikowo Sports and Recreation Centre, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, ensuring high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and welcoming to everyone who enjoys physical activity.

name: XI Krokowska 10
description: The 11th Krokowska 10 is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series, taking place on July 4 in Żarnowiec. The race offers a 10 km distance through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the region. Kaszuby Biegają is the largest running event in northern Poland, promoting physical activity and local culture. Participants can expect professional organization and unique medals assembled from pieces awarded at the individual stages.

name: XXVI Bieg o Kryształową Perłę Jeziora Na...
description: The 26th National Run for the Crystal Pearl of Lake Narie is the main race, covering a distance of 31.13 km. It takes place in the scenic surroundings of Lake Narie in Kretowiny. The start and finish are located at the Main Beach in Kretowiny. The event includes age categories for men and women, and participants can look forward to a formal opening and closing ceremony, with awards presented. The event is national in scope and attracts runners from various age groups.

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, Maridalsvannet rundt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dagsbillett SOLO Deltakere kr 475,00 kr 332,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Festivalpass SOLO Deltakere kr 1475,00 kr 1032,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

description: Maridalsvannet Rundt is one of eight races in the Oslo Running Festival, which follows the capital’s beautiful trails and roads. The race has a mass start on Sunday, July 4 at 11:00, with the start and finish at Frysja, a lovely area with good facilities and opportunities for swimming, barbecuing, and relaxing after the race. The course is 13.5 km long and offers scenic surroundings around Lake Maridalsvannet. The Oslo Running Festival gives you the flexibility to run alone or with others, and you can take part in several races with a festival pass or day tickets.
course_highlights: The 13.5 km course goes around Lake Maridalsvannet
Start and finish at Frysja, with good facilities such as a café and grocery store
Lovely start and finish area with opportunities for swimming and barbecuing
additional: Race bibs can be picked up at Löplabbet Oslo city centre from April 7. The same race bib is used throughout the series. The course is marked only for the mass start. Timing is recorded by a chip attached to the race bib, which must be visible on your chest. There are good public transport connections and several parking spaces near the start area. The race can be completed at a time that suits you during the period June 25–July 4, 2027. An early-bird price is listed; prices vary by ticket type.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a simple, fast race event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, featuring a flat, measured 2,633-metre loop. The race offers seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, and is suitable for anyone looking to chase a personal best. Participants can set out their own bottles and gels on their personal nutrition table, which they pass each lap, allowing them to keep their nutrition well under control during the race. The event has good facilities, including changing rooms, toilets and free parking at the venue.
course_highlights: Flat, measured 2,633-metre loop
Participants’ own nutrition table at every lap
Good facilities, including changing rooms and toilets inside Ås school
additional: Race bibs are collected using self-service at the school from around two hours before the start. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan split times. At selected races, ninth-graders from Feiring school staff an official water station and raise money for their school trip. Participants who set a personal best can ring the bell by the finish area. Race bibs are collected using self-service at the school from around two hours before the start.

name: Perseløpet ¤5- 2027
description: Perseløpet is a simple, fast running event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, featuring a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop. The event offers seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, giving runners the opportunity to set personal records in a well-equipped setting with a dedicated nutrition table. Race bibs are collected via self-service at the venue, which has free parking, changing rooms and toilets. The event is organised by Feiring IL and has a tradition of many personal records, with a friendly atmosphere where runners can celebrate their personal records by ringing the bell at the finish.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap
Flat road races offering the opportunity for fast times
additional: Race bibs are collected via self-service approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Runners can place their own bottles and gels on the nutrition table before the start. At selected events, ninth graders from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. A lap-time calculator is available to help plan split times. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area. Registration via RaceDays. Race bibs are collected via self-service at the school, and runners can place their own drinks and nutrition at the nutrition table.

name: SVE-Steinwiesenlauf
description: The Steinwiesenlauf organised by SV Eidelstedt Hamburg is a popular running event that attracts numerous participants every year. The event offers various races for all age groups, from a kids’ run and school races to the 5 km and 10 km main races. The course includes a motorway bridge and offers exciting competitions in a family-friendly atmosphere. The race traditionally takes place on a weekend and continues to attract more participants.

name: Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 05.07.2026
description: The 7th Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 2026 is an annual running event held in Wilkowo near Świebodzin. The race attracts runners from various categories and offers the chance to compete on a route combining road and off-road sections. The organizers provide professional timing and technical support, while participants can expect efficient organization and a friendly atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to get active and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: A route combining road and off-road sections
Scenic surroundings of Wilkowo near Świebodzin
Professional electronic timing
additional: The event is organized by Super Sport, a company from Zielona Góra, which provides timing, race bib printing, and technical support. No details are available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Registration will be available at super-sport.com.pl, and the event attracts local runners and sports enthusiasts.

name: Pogoń za Jednorożcem
description: The Unicorn Chase is an annual running event held in Jednorożec, taking place for the eighth time in 2026. The event includes a 5 km race and Nordic walking over the same distance, as well as children’s races over shorter distances. It is organized by the “Jednorożec robi co może” Association in cooperation with local partners and patrons, offering participants sporting competition, numerous attractions, and prizes. The start and awards ceremony take place on the same day, and participants can expect professional organization and chip timing.

name: 34 Bieg po Plaży
location: Jarosławiec, Postomino, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 34th Jarosławiec Beach Run is an annual running event organized by the Culture and Sports Centre in Postomino. The race takes place on a scenic route along the beach by the Baltic Sea, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by coastal nature. The event attracts runners from various regions, combining sporting competition with recreation and socializing. The organizers provide professional event support and attractive keepsakes for participants.
course_highlights: The race route runs along a sandy beach by the Baltic Sea
Scenic views of the sea and coastal nature
Flat, fast terrain conducive to good race times
additional: The event is organized by the Culture and Sports Centre in Postomino and takes place in Jarosławiec. The website has no detailed information about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Reports and photo galleries from previous editions are available.

name: Naktinė bėgimo šventė „Kaišiadorys 2026/10“
location: Kaišiadorių Teofiliaus Matulionio aikštė, Kaišiadorys, Lithuania
price_range: 4,- EUR iki 20,- EUR, registracijos ir dalyvio mokesčiai priklauso nuo distancijos ir registracijos laiko
description: The night running festival “Kaišiadorys 2026/10” is dedicated to commemorating Statehood Day (the Coronation of King Mindaugas of Lithuania). The event will take place in Teofilius Matulionis Square in Kaišiadorys and will include a range of age groups and distances, giving runners the opportunity to compete and enjoy running on city streets and nature trails. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take part and promote a healthy lifestyle. The event will be filmed and photographed, and participants agree that the material may be used for marketing purposes.
course_highlights: Event venue: Teofilius Matulionis Square in Kaišiadorys, city streets, the Girelė nature trail, and the Gandriukas trail
Distances from 436 m to 8 km, suitable for various age groups
Night run with the option to purchase special running T-shirts
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the event venue from 17:00 to 20:45, depending on the distance. No participation fee applies to students and employees of the Kaišiadorys Education and Sports Centre. Special running T-shirts (light or dark) are available for €15. Safety requirements must be followed during the event. The running venue is Teofilius Matulionis Square in Kaišiadorys and the surrounding areas; registration on race day; T-shirt sales; various distances.

name: Feriespretten 2027
description: Feriespretten is the summer’s most beautiful and fun trail race, organized by Hope IL in Risør, Agder. The race offers two distances over varied, hilly terrain, with the start and finish in the same place. The long course, approximately 9 km, is suitable for those looking for a challenging workout in beautiful surroundings, while the short course, approximately 5 km, is perfect for beginners, children and families, or as an untimed recreational run. Feriespretten is a family-friendly event that brings experienced runners and beginners together for an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Two distances over varied, hilly terrain
Start and finish in the same place
The course runs through beautiful scenery on the Sandnes peninsula
additional: The short course can be run untimed as a recreational run. The organizer is Hope IL. Results and statistics from previous years are available on the website. Untimed recreational categories are offered for the 5 km and 9 km distances. Timing information is provided through the organizer’s channels.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a three-stage running series inviting both recreational and experienced runners to enjoy an active time outdoors. At each stage, participants can choose between a lap of the approximately 5 km health trail and a 10 km race. There is also an exciting power run to find the best ratio of strength to speed. Series finishers are eligible for prizes and prize draws, including a bicycle as the grand prize. Participation is free, and registration is available online and on-site.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Czerwonak Physical Culture Development Center. Held in the evening, it combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It has become a long-standing tradition, attracting participants who want to spend time outdoors running or walking in a friendly atmosphere. The event takes place around Bolechowo and lasts approximately two and a half hours.
course_highlights: Evening runs and walks outdoors
Route around Bolechowo and Czerwonak
Bringing the local community together through physical activity
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. It is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees, or online registration.

name: 7. ETAPP
description: Käime Koos is a recreational sports series by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev, inviting participants to take part in various hiking and walking stages across Estonia. The 7th stage takes place on Kesselaid, offering participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment. The series aims to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle through hiking and walking together. Participants can experience varied terrain and combine exercise with good company.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment
Varied terrain suitable for walking and hiking
The series takes place in different parts of Estonia, showcasing local natural beauty
additional: Käime Koos stages take place in different locations across Estonia, where participants can enjoy nature and physical activity. The series is organised by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev. More information and contact: Sirje Soovik +372 506 2250.

name: Gütersloh Läuft - für den guten Zweck
description: Gütersloh Läuft is a diverse charity running event taking place for the 18th time in Gütersloh City Park. The event offers races for all age groups, from Bambini and school races to Nordic walking, corporate and individual races, as well as a 10 km summer evening run. All participants support the German Stroke Foundation with their entry fee, as €1 is donated for every registration. The routes run through the beautiful city park and offer a sporting, community atmosphere for recreational and ambitious runners.

name: City-Sport-Abendlauf
description: The City-Sport Evening Run in Rostock is a popular summer race held annually in Barnstorfer Wald. Hundreds of runners come together for an evening run that combines the joy of running with a good cause. Proceeds from the race are donated to charitable organizations, most recently to the Rostock hospice at Klinikum Südstadt. The race has become a fixture on Rostock’s running calendar and continues to attract growing numbers of participants.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 4. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 4th stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event around Lake Viljandi on the health and ski trail. The race is part of the traditional Joosu Series, offering participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The course has good footing and is suitable for runners of different abilities. The event is organised by the Joosu Recreational Sports Club, which welcomes all running enthusiasts to take part.

name: Vooremäe tipujooks
description: Vooremäe Tipujooks is a running competition organized by the Tartumaa Sports Association and held at Vooremäe. It is a traditional summer sporting event that invites running enthusiasts to take part and offers the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and competitive sport. The competition is part of the Tartumaa sports calendar and is suitable for runners of different ability levels.

name: Borener Meile
description: The Borener Meile is a traditional 1,609.34-meter road race, held for the 35th time as part of the Borener Dorftage in Boren. The race is organized by Borener SV, an active sports club on the Schlei with a particular commitment to running and triathlon. The event offers runners a short, fast course and is a popular competition in the region. Results and photos from previous races are available on the website.
course_highlights: Road race over exactly 1,609.34 meters (one mile)
Traditional event held as part of the Borener Dorftage
Organized by the local sports club Borener SV
additional: Road race, registration available, results and photos from previous events available

name: Böda Sandsloppet
location: Böda Sand SportCamp, Böda, Öland, Sverige
description: Böda Sandsloppet är ett familjevänligt löplopp som arrangeras vid Böda Sand SportCamp på Öland. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser för både barn och vuxna, med banor i härlig skogsterräng. Det finns möjligheter att välja mellan 6,5 km och 4 km för vuxna samt kortare sträckor för barn och ungdomar. Alla deltagare som fullföljer loppet får medalj som minne. Arrangemanget präglas av en trivsam atmosfär och är öppet för löpare i alla åldrar och nivåer.
course_highlights: Bana i härlig skogsterräng
Start och mål vid Böda Sand SportCamp
Distansval för både barn och vuxna
additional: Efteranmälan möjlig till och med 8 juli, därefter nummerlappsuthämtning på tävlingsdagen från kl 15:00. Betalning kan ske kontant, med kort eller Swish. Barn och ungdomar under 11 år har ingen tidtagning eller prisutdelning. Start och mål vid Böda Sand SportCamp. Anmälan senast 3 juli 2027; efteranmälan erbjuds mot högre avgift. För barn 11 år och yngre är det ingen tidtagning eller prisutdelning.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/bodasandsloppet/): 2027-07-10 — "Tid & datum 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-02)

name: Musköloppet
description: Musköloppet är ett uppskattat jogginglopp som går av stapeln i den storslagna skärgårdsmiljön på Muskö. Loppet har en lång tradition och firade 30 år 2022, efter att ha pausats under pandemin. Det finns flera olika banor och klasser, inklusive barnlopp, och loppet erbjuder en härlig naturupplevelse med start och mål vid Muskö Hembygdsgård. Efteranmälan är möjlig på plats senast en timme före start.
course_highlights: Loppet går i vacker skärgårdsmiljö på Muskö
Start och mål vid Muskö Hembygdsgård
Barnlopp med distanser 1,5 km och 2,5 km för olika åldersklasser
additional: Efteranmälan kan göras på plats vid start- och målområdet senast en timme före loppets start. Det finns vätskekontroller längs banan och egen vätskelangning är tillåten. Tävlingsledningen kan besluta om omstart vid behov. Det är inte tillåtet med draghjälp från icke tävlande. Starttider för barnlopp är kl 10:00 för 1,5 km (7-10 år) och kl 10:30 för 2,5 km (11-14 år). Den officiella webbplatsens nedräkning anger 10 juli 2027. Publicerade tider och distansuppgifter på webbplatsen gäller dock 2026. Stafetten kostar 150 kr per lag och knatteloppet för 4 - 6-åringar är gratis enligt publicerade uppgifter.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.muskoloppet.se/): 2027-07-10 — "Nedräkning till Musköloppet 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-10)

name: H2 Trail
distance_verbose: 80 km, 50 km, 28 km, 18 km, 11 km, 6 km
description: Umara H2 Trail 2027 arrangeras av OK Skogsvargarna och går av stapeln den 10 juli på Bergagården, Hunneberg. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser från 6 km upp till 50 km, inklusive en knattetrail för de yngsta. Banorna går genom varierad terräng på Hunneberg med inslag av stigar, grusvägar och asfalt, och bjuder på vackra utsiktsplatser, torp och badplatser. Alla deltagare på distanserna 11 km till 50 km får en egen Umara-mugg för att minska engångsmuggar vid vätskestationerna. Klubben erbjuder även dusch, bastu och omklädningsrum i sin klubbstuga vid Bergagården.
course_highlights: 50 km-distansen går över Hunneberg med sevärdheter som utsiktsplatser, torp och badplatser
Banan är markerad med pilar och snitslar, med 23% grusväg, 73% stigar och 4% asfalt
Knattetrail och minitrail för barn med medalj till alla deltagare
additional: Alla deltagare på distanserna 11 km till 50 km får en egen Umara-mugg som ska användas vid vätskestationerna för att minska engångsmuggar. Vätskekontroller finns längs banan och deltagarna uppmanas att bära egen vätska. Möjlighet till support finns vid en angiven plats på banan vid varvning på Bergagården (25 km). Knattetrail och minitrail genomförs utan tidtagning och med medalj till alla deltagare. Parkering finns cirka 300 meter från tävlingscentrum med skyltar. Mobiltelefon och powerbank rekommenderas för nödsituationer. Tidigare upplagor har haft vätskestationer längs banan; deltagare har behövt ta med egen vätska.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://okskogsvargarna.kanslietonline.se/arrangemang/umara-h2-trail-2027/): 2027-07-10 — "Lördag den 10 juli på Bergagården, Hunneberg" (was estimated 2027-06-26)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Lördag den 10 juli på Bergagården, Hunneberg

name: Gotland Run 511k (2026)
description: Gotland Run 511k är ett unikt löpäventyr och en resa för att utforska ditt inre landskap. Det är inte en traditionell tävling utan en självförsörjande löpning runt Gotlands vackra ö, inklusive en runda runt Fårö, med start och mål i Visby. Deltagarna har 10 dagar på sig att genomföra den cirka 511 km långa banan, med stöd från fyra Angel Stations längs vägen. Arrangören tillhandahåller grundläggande stöd, medan mat och boende ansvarar löparen själv för.
course_highlights: Start och mål i Visby, Gotlands medeltida huvudstad
Klockvis varv runt ön inklusive Fårö
Blandad terräng med asfalt, grusvägar och kortare stigar
additional: Deltagarna måste checka in två gånger dagligen via en online-verktyg. Boende första natten är på Visby Fängelse Hostel med delade rum. Pre-race middag och briefing hålls kvällen före start. Angel Stations erbjuder stöd, vatten, vila och ibland duschmöjligheter. Färja till Fårö går var 30:e minut, men kräver samtal mellan 22:00 och 05:30. Löpningen måste genomföras till fots inom 10 dagar, i genomsnitt cirka 51 km per dag. Bagageförvaring finns på hostelet. Parkering finns nära färjeterminalen och billigare alternativ vid Visby flygplats. Självförsörjt upplägg: deltagarna ansvarar för merparten av mat och logistik. Hela sträckan ska genomföras till fots inom tio dagar, med regelbundna positionsrapporter.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://runtrip.se/race-memo-2027/): 2027-07-10 — "SATURDAY, JULY 10 — The race starts at 10:00 am outside the main entrance of Visby Fängelse" (was estimated 2027-07-03)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: SATURDAY, JULY 10 — The race starts at 10:00 am outside the main entrance of Visby Fängelse

name: Klåveröd Backyard 2026
location: Klåveröd, Svalöv Municipality, Skåne County, Sverige
description: Klåveröd Backyard är ett trail- och backyardlopp i Klåveröd på Söderåsen, med löpning genom vacker bokskog. Loppet beskrivs som en kombination av trail och backyard och välkomnar deltagare till en naturnära löparupplevelse i Skåne. 2026 års evenemang är annonserat till lördagen den 11 juli.
course_highlights: Trail genom bokskog
Naturnära miljö i Klåveröd på Söderåsen
Kombinerar trail med backyard-format
additional: Facebook-evenemanget för 2026 anger lördagen den 11 juli. Vid 2024 års lopp sprang segraren 14 varv, över 9 mil.

name: Branäsutmaningen
description: Branäsutmaningen är ett sommaräventyr i Branäs som erbjuder en 6 kilometer lång utmanande bana. Branäs är känt för sin vackra natur och familjevänliga friluftsliv året runt. Under sommaren finns aktiviteter som mountainbike, padel och vattenaktiviteter vid Klarälven. Branäs satsar på familjevänliga cykelleder och natursköna vandringsleder, vilket gör det till en perfekt plats för en aktiv och rolig sommarupplevelse.
course_highlights: 6 kilometer lång utmanande bana
Familjevänliga downhillbanor och breda cross country-leder
Naturskönt läge vid Klarälven med vandringsleder och fiske
additional: Branäs erbjuder familjevänlig liftburen cykling med sexstolsexpressen Sjöexpressen som hjärta i cykelsatsningen. Det finns grill- och rastplatser med utsikt, mil av grus- och asfaltsvägar för träning, samt cykelbanor för barn vid Soltorget. Mat och dryck finns på Ladans restaurang i centrum. Sommarkartan inkluderar pumptrack, linbana, studsmatta med big airbag och leder i Logläntan. Start kl. 14.00 vid Soltorget. Familjedagen omfattar även Björnbuseloppet för barn, after-run och trubadurkväll. Förstapriset i loppet är en skidsemester för familjen.

name: Hestane Skyrace
organizer: Lars Øvrebø og Torstein Bolstad Blikra, med Gaular IL
description: Hestane Skyrace is a demanding skyrace over the spectacular peaks of Storehesten and Lisjehesten in Bygstad. The race features technical climbing, an exposed ridge and magnificent panoramic views in dramatic natural surroundings. There are two distances: 32 km with 1,900 metres of elevation gain and 26 km with 1,400 metres of elevation gain, both across challenging mountain terrain. The event is a celebration for the whole village, with activities for participants and spectators alike.
course_highlights: Technical climbing and an exposed ridge over Storehesten and Lisjehesten
Magnificent panoramic views and challenging mountain terrain
Two distances: 32 km (~1,900 m elevation gain) and 26 km (~1,400 m elevation gain)
additional: Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, 1 L of water, emergency ration and wind jacket. Cutoff at Skaraly at 15:30; final finish at 19:00. Parking at Langeland Ski Centre costs 50 kr. Race bibs can be collected on Friday 9 July and on race day from 07:00. There are staffed stations with water and first aid along the route. After-run gathering at Tønna in Bygstad from 20:00, with food and socialising. Start and finish at Langeland Ski Centre. Start at 09:00. Registration via Racedays.

name: Kvasshovden Opp
description: Kvasshovden Opp is a traditional uphill race in Ulvik, Hardanger, running from the centre of Ulvik to the summit of Kvasshovden at 1,030 metres above sea level. The race offers a challenging climb and beautiful views over Hardanger, attracting both local and visiting runners. It has been held since 1926 and is known for its great atmosphere and beautiful scenery. Kvasshovden Opp is a perfect race for those who enjoy demanding uphill races in spectacular surroundings.
course_highlights: Uphill race from the centre of Ulvik to the summit of Kvasshovden at 1,030 metres above sea level
Beautiful views over Hardanger during the race
Challenging climb with varied terrain
additional: The race is held annually in July, with results available online. The organiser is Ulvik Idrottslag, founded in 1926, with 337 members. Contact by phone on 95938952 or by email at post@ulvikil.no.

name: Black Lake Race
description: Black Lake Race is a challenging mountain trail race held in Vågstranda, Norway, featuring stunning views over Norwegian fjords. The main 29 km course combines runnable terrain, steep climbs, and exposed ridge running, including a demanding ascent to Trollstolen and a high mountain ridge section. There is also a faster and more accessible 20 km course that mixes gravel roads, forest trails, alpine terrain, and technical descents. The race offers a unique experience in spectacular natural surroundings with aid stations and mandatory GPX navigation for the longer course.
course_highlights: Steep climbs, including more than 850 vertical meters of ascent to Trollstolen
Exposed mountain ridge running with panoramic fjord views
Technical descents and alpine terrain
additional: The 29 km race requires mandatory GPX navigation loaded onto GPS watches. Aid stations with food and drinks are available along the course. A 5-hour cut-off applies at Checkpoint 3 on the 29 km course, with an alternative route for late participants. Running poles are permitted. Free camping is offered for participants at Hjelvik Idrettsplass, with assistance available for campervan/caravan parking upon request.

name: Rástegáisái
description: Rástegáisái 2027 is a traditional uphill race and hiking event in Tana, Finnmark, organized by Sirbmá-Sirbma IL. The recreational hike starts between 08:00 and 12:30, and the uphill race has a mass start at 13:00 for all categories. Participants must bring a backpack with full-coverage outerwear for the descent. A hydration belt is recommended, as there is only one water station along the route. All participants receive a finisher’s prize, and prizes are awarded to the top three in every category. The event offers a challenging mountain route through beautiful scenery, with the opportunity to earn fitness points and visit a Perletur checkpoint along the way.
course_highlights: Uphill race with a challenging climb
Only one water station along the route, at the camp below the mountain
Opportunity to earn fitness points and visit a Perletur checkpoint along the way
additional: All uphill-race participants must bring a backpack with full-coverage outerwear for the descent. Runners without a backpack that meets the requirements will receive a 15-minute time penalty. Runners and hikers who have not reached the summit by 16:00 will be turned back by marshals. Hikers taking the shortest route (4 km) may start as late as 15:55.

name: Dynafit Hardangerjøkulen Ultra
description: Dynafit Hardangerjøkulen Ultra is a challenging 95 km ultramarathon that starts and finishes at Liseth Pensjonat & Hyttetun near Vøringsfossen in Eidfjord. The route circles the beautiful Hardangerjøkulen glacier, crossing mountain terrain with both easy and technically demanding sections, and may be snow-covered in places. For those looking for a shorter challenge, a 34 km route follows part of the same course. Liseth Pensjonat & Hyttetun serves as the base throughout the event, with accommodation, food and opportunities to socialise around the fire pit.
course_highlights: The route circles Hardangerjøkulen, one of Norway’s most beautiful glaciers
Mountain terrain with both easy and technically demanding sections
Parts of the route may be snow-covered
additional: Start and finish at Liseth Pensjonat & Hyttetun near Vøringsfossen. Total elevation gain: 4,980 m+ on the 95 km route and 1,330 m+ on the 34 km route. The route follows the Norwegian Trekking Association’s trail network and is not marked, so GPS navigation is required. There is no or poor mobile coverage along the way. Checkpoints on the 95 km route are at Finse (38 km), Krækkja (62 km) and Kjeldebu (75 km). In bad weather, an alternative route is available, with distances of 100 km and 35 km. A pre-race briefing and tracker distribution take place early on race day. Runners can be followed on a big screen at the event base.

name: Melbuløpet
location: Melbu torg, Melbu, Hadsel, Nordland, Norway
description: Melbuløpet takes place at Melbu Square and offers three officially measured distances: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km on a very flat, fast course, offering good opportunities to achieve fast times. A children’s race of approximately 600 metres is also held for the youngest participants. The race is part of Sommer-Melbu, a long-running summer festival held since 1986 and characterised by broad local involvement and a strong volunteer spirit.
course_highlights: Very flat and fast course
Three officially measured distances: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
Children’s race of approximately 600 metres
additional: The children’s race starts at 15:30 and the competitive race categories start at 16:00. Children’s race participants register on site. The race is held as part of the Sommer-Melbu festival, which lasts ten days and is run by volunteers. The listed start location is Melbu Square. Registration for the competitive race categories is via EQ Timing, while children’s race participants register on site.

name: Hornindal Rundt
description: Hornindal Rundt is a demanding mountain ultramarathon through the spectacular scenery of Hornindal, surrounded by some of the finest mountains in the Nordic region. The race covers 75 kilometres with 5,600 metres of elevation gain and includes 20 mountain checkpoints. Participants experience a tough and varied course with views of Jostedalsbreen, the Sunnmøre Alps and the sea, and are challenged both physically and mentally in one of Norway’s most demanding trail races.
course_highlights: 75 km ultramarathon with 5,600 metres of elevation gain
20 mountain checkpoints along the route
Views of Jostedalsbreen, the Sunnmøre Alps and the sea
additional: The 75 km ultramarathon starts at 07:00 from Honndalshallen. There are cut-off times along the course to ensure safety, with the first at Horndøla Bru and the second at Holskarsætra (checkpoint 13). Participants in the 75 km race must carry mandatory equipment, including a headlamp, clothing and a mobile phone. For the 75 km race, the start is at Honndalshallen at 07:00, and mandatory equipment includes a headlamp, clothing and a mobile phone. The 38 km race starts at Horndøla Bru at 11:00 and finishes at Honndalshallen. The race information on the website applies to 2026; the date and details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: 45. jooks ümber Pühajärve
location: Pühajärve Spa & Holiday Resort, Otepää, Valga County, Estonia
description: The 45th Run Around Lake Pühajärv is a traditional running race held around Pühajärv Spa & Holiday Resort. The distance is 10.7 km, and the course is well marked and secured, offering participants beautiful views of the lake. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its third event. The start is at 12:00 on Saturday, July 11. Participants are provided with timing, refreshment stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A 10.7 km course around Lake Pühajärv
Refreshment stations at 4.4 km and 7.7 km
The course is marked and secured by course marshals
additional: Start groups are formed based on previous results; elite runners may start in the first group. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the back of the race bib. Participants receive a medal, sports drink and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance along the entire course. The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:30, with awards for the top six. Participants can register on site, and discounts are available. The course runs around Lake Pühajärv and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triatlon 2026
location: Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triathlon takes place at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre and offers an exciting grassroots triathlon experience. The main distance comprises a 250 m swim, a 20 km mountain bike ride and a 4 km run, much of which follows the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Reserve. In addition to the main event, participants can take part in the Stebby duathlon and youth duathlon, which are intended for different age groups. The event is well organised, with chip timing, medical support and water stations. After the race, participants receive a medal and can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and bike-washing facilities.
course_highlights: The swim takes place in the pond at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre, over one lap, with a maximum depth of 2.5 m
The 20 km bike course follows the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Reserve
The 4 km trail run is marked and secured
additional: Starts are in waves of five, with a 10-second interval between each wave. Competitors must wear a helmet while cycling and a timing chip around their ankle. The entry fee includes medical first aid, water-station service, a medal, hot soup, a smoothie, use of the sauna and hot tub, and bike washing. There is a bag drop at the event centre, and changing facilities are available in the sauna anteroom. The swim start number must be written on the cheek or shoulder with a waterproof marker. Drafting is permitted during the bike leg. Trail course, family events, free soup and sauna, registration information, entry fees vary, limited number of places

name: Mõisa jooks
organizer: SK Team Kehtna ja Alutaguse vallavalitsus
description: Kehtna Manor Run is a friendly, community-focused running event held in the grounds of Kehtna Manor. It offers three distances: a 5 km main race, a 2.5 km youth race, and a 500 m children’s race, welcoming participants of different ages. Alongside the races, the event features Children’s Day activities, pony rides, and trampolines, creating a pleasant family-day atmosphere. It is organized by SK Team Kehtna, which is dedicated to promoting sport and physical activity in the community.

name: 5. Pühajärve pargimiil
description: The 5th Pühajärve Park Mile is a 1.6 km running race held in the park of Pühajärve Holiday Centre. The start and finish are at the same location, and the race begins at 12:10. The race is open to all running enthusiasts and offers a pleasant opportunity to enjoy a run in beautiful park surroundings. Participants receive a medal and bib number, chip timing, sports drink and water at the finish, and medical assistance along the entire course.

name: Pajusi Mudajooks
organizer: MTÜ Sporty ja MTÜ Pajusi Küla Selts
description: Pajusi Mudajooks is a popular mass-participation sporting event in Central Estonia, offering participants an exciting and adventurous obstacle course of up to 10 km. The event takes place in Pajusi village and is suitable for both individual runners and teams. The course features natural and man-made obstacles that challenge participants’ physical and mental endurance. Separate courses are available for children, and all finishers receive a commemorative medal. Free parking and hot soup after the race are provided for participants.

name: Rojas pusmaratona festivāls
description: The Roja Half Marathon Festival is an annual running event held in Roja, offering a range of distances, including a 21.1 km half marathon, 12.3 km, 3 km, and children’s races. The competition takes place on a stadium track and a certified asphalt course suitable for timed races. The festival welcomes both professional and amateur runners and also features a 24-hour ultramarathon and other running options. It is a great opportunity to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and the Zvejnieksvētki morning activities in Roja.
course_highlights: Course lap length: 1234.7 m
Course surface: stadium track and asphalt
The course meets the requirements for timed races and has a World Athletics certificate
additional: Registration and bib collection take place from 7:00 to 8:45 (3 km) and until 9:15 (21.1 km, 12.3 km, and 400 m children’s races). The 3 km race starts at 9:00, the 12.3 km race and Nordic walking at 9:30, the half marathon at 9:30, and the children’s races at 9:45. The festival also includes 24-hour, 12-hour, and 6-hour races with separate start times. The awards ceremony takes place at around 12:00–13:00. Individual support points for the ultramarathon are available along the course.

name: Wybelsumer Polderlauf
description: The Wybelsumer Polder Run is a running event for children and adults held at the Wybelsum sports ground in Emden. Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V., the event offers a sporting opportunity for the whole family in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. It is part of Emden’s diverse events calendar and promotes the local community and sport.
course_highlights: Running event for children and adults
Venue: Wybelsum sports ground, Emden
Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V.
additional: The event includes various running distances for all age groups and is a popular regional event in the Krummhörn region.

name: Bergheide-Cross 2026
description: SCB Langendamm invites you to the 4th Bergheide Cross 2026. The course starts on the access road to the shooting house of the local small-bore rifle club and runs through the “Osterberg” local recreation and nature conservation area. The event offers three distances for different competition and age categories, as well as walking on the shorter course. There is also a 1,000-meter race for children and young people. The event is approved by the DLV and starts at 16:00.

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race held in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to take on a moderately challenging course. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, providing convenient event facilities. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.

name: VI Warmiński Bieg Uliczny
description: The 6th Warmian Street Run in Reszel is an annual sporting event that attracts both amateurs and experienced runners. The race follows the streets of Reszel, giving it a unique atmosphere and allowing participants to experience the city from a different perspective. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively, enjoy sporting competition, and meet fellow running enthusiasts. The organizers welcome everyone, regardless of experience level, emphasizing the importance of exercise and positive energy.

name: Semesterhalvmaran
location: Torps herrgård, Kumla Municipality, Örebro County, Sverige
description: Semesterhalvmaran är ett återkommande löplopp arrangerat av Löparklubben LK Gränslöst som bjuder in löpare att uppleva Närkeslättens vackra vidder. Loppet startar och går i mål vid Torps herrgård utanför Kumla och erbjuder en fin löpupplevelse på grusvägar bland böljande sädesfält. Efter två års uppehåll är loppet tillbaka den 11 juli 2027 och välkomnar löpare på alla nivåer att delta i en gemenskap fylld av löparglädje. LK Gränslöst är en inkluderande klubb som vill förena löpare från hela landet och skapa en stark gemenskap kring löpning.
course_highlights: Start och mål vid Torps herrgård utanför Kumla
Löpning på grusvägar bland böljande sädesfält på Närkeslätten
Vacker och naturnära miljö på Närkeslätten
additional: Anmälan planeras att öppna i januari. Loppet arrangeras av Löparklubben LK Gränslöst som även arrangerar andra lopp och gemensamma träningar varje onsdag kl 18:00 i Örebro. Klubben fokuserar på gemenskap och löparglädje för alla nivåer.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.lkgranslost.se/semesterhalvmaran-finish/): 2027-07-11 — "Söndagen den 11 juli 2027 är det åter dags för löpning på Närkeslätten när den är som bäst!" (was estimated 2027-07-03)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Söndagen den 11 juli 2027 är det åter dags för löpning på Närkeslätten när den är som bäst!

name: PALMS Südasuve Challenge - Võsu 2026
location: Võsu, Lääne-Nigula vald, Lääne County, Estonia
description: PALMS Midsummer Challenge - Võsu 2026 is a sporting summer event held in the town of Võsu. It is an enjoyable and active challenge for running enthusiasts, offering the chance to enjoy summer nature and community support. The event is part of the Estonian Night Run series and brings together runners from different regions. Võsu’s beautiful coastal scenery provides excellent conditions for a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Coastal scenery in the town of Võsu
A pleasant, active summer running environment
Part of the Estonian Night Run series
additional: The event includes a range of swimming distances and is open to both local and virtual participants, offering summer sea air and sport in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Vimka tõusu maraton
description: Vimka Tõusu Marathon is a summer marathon on the Viimsi Peninsula, offering participants one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied course includes both paved roads and forest trails, with several climbs and descents that make the run exciting and varied.

name: Pönitzer Volkslauf

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Mitglieder der Sportvereinigung Pönitz zahlen die Hälfte.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Mitglieder der Sportvereinigung Pönitz zahlen die Hälfte.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Mitglieder der Sportvereinigung Pönitz zahlen die Hälfte.

description: The 41st Pönitz Fun Run takes place in Pönitz and invites runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers to a sporting and social event. The course runs through the charming landscape of Holstein Switzerland, with romantic hedgerows, summer fields, and peaceful meadows. At the Pönitz Sports Park, participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, show performances, and an awards ceremony. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and attractive prizes are awarded to the winners.
course_highlights: Holstein Switzerland scenery with hedgerows, fields, and meadows
Start and finish at Pönitz Sports Park in a summery atmosphere
Refreshments and show performances at the venue
additional: The awards ceremony begins at 11:15, with medals for the overall winners (places 1–3) and trophies and certificates for age-group winners and placers. Members of SVG Pönitz pay half the entry fee. The event offers refreshments, show performances, and a friendly atmosphere for athletes, companions, and spectators. Runners can choose from the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and Nordic walking; start times from 8:30; a shared experience of community and nature.

name: 27. Gläserner Mönch Lauf
description: The Gläserner Mönch Run is a traditional trail race in the Harz foothills, returning after a seven-year hiatus. The course is known for its undulating profile, with more than 100 meters of elevation gain per lap, and the legendary climb up 222 steps to the “Gläserner Mönch.” Participants can choose from a range of distances, from the Bambini Run to the 18 km Extreme Run, and enjoy unspoiled nature among rocks and forests. The event combines a sporting challenge with local pride and takes place around the Landhotel Schäferhof in Halberstadt.

name: BTG-Sommerstaffel
description: Die BTG-Sommerstaffel ist eine traditionsreiche Staffelveranstaltung, die von der Bielefelder Turngemeinde von 1848 e.V. ausgerichtet wird. Der Verein ist der älteste Sportverein in Bielefeld und bietet eine breite Palette an Sportarten an, darunter auch Leichtathletik. Die Veranstaltung findet in Bielefeld statt und richtet sich an sportbegeisterte Läuferinnen und Läufer, die gemeinsam in Teams antreten. Die BTG legt Wert auf eine familiäre Atmosphäre und sportliche Gemeinschaft.

name: Bajoro 26
description: Bajoro 26 is a 10 km race taking place in Starogard Gdański. It’s an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to both beginners and more experienced runners. Bajoro 26 is a moderately challenging event on an asphalt surface, ideal for improving fitness and competing in a friendly atmosphere.

name: 43 Bieg o Złoty Kłos
location: Kołaczkowo, Września County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Västervik City Run
description: Västervik City Run är ett stadslopp på cirka 6,3 km som går i och kring Västerviks centrum med start och mål vid Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget. Loppet erbjuder en fin bana som följer cykelbanan längs Gamlebyviken och passerar bland annat Stegeholms slottsruin och Myntbryggan. Efter målgången får deltagarna en medalj som bevis på sitt deltagande. Loppet är en trevlig sommartradition som välkomnar löpare i alla åldrar.
course_highlights: Stadslopp på cirka 6,3 km i Västerviks centrum
Banan följer cykelbanan längs Gamlebyviken och passerar Stegeholms slottsruin
Start och mål vid Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget
additional: Knattelopp (Sparbanksloppet) på 800 m för barn upp till 10 år med gemensam avgång från Fiskaretorget kl. 18:30. Efter målgång delas medaljer ut till deltagarna. Ett separat Sparbankslopp på cirka 700 meter erbjuds för barn upp till 10 år. Anmälan till 2027 års lopp öppnar 1 maj.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.vikhockey.se/boka-bord-2/city-run/): 2027-07-12 — "Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!" (was estimated 2027-07-05)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!

name: Victorialoppet
description: Victorialoppet är en traditionell löparfest som hålls varje år i Borgholm på Öland. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser för alla åldrar och förmågor, inklusive ett huvudlopp på 9 km, Victoriajoggen på 4 km, Lilla Victorialoppet på 2 km samt Mini för de yngsta på 1,5 km. Bansträckningen är snabb och lättsprungen med vackra strandnära vyer och en entusiastisk publik som skapar en härlig atmosfär. Evenemanget är en folkfest med musikunderhållning längs banan och ett starkt engagemang för Kronprinsessan Victorias fond.
course_highlights: Snabb och lättsprungen 9 km bana med strandnära vyer
Musikunderhållning på flera platser längs banan
Banor anpassade för alla åldrar och funktionsvariationer
additional: Nummerlappsutdelning sker tävlingsdagen 10:00-18:00 vid Borgholms Sporthall. Omklädning och dusch finns för män och pojkar i Borgholms sporthall, för kvinnor och flickor i Viktoriaskolans gymnastiksal. Vatten serveras längs 9 km banan och det finns musikunderhållning på flera platser. Priser delas ut i olika klasser och deltagare får medaljer, minnesplakett, glass och dricka beroende på lopp. Tidtagning sker med engångschip för de flesta lopp, frivillig tidtagning för Victoriajoggen och parasportklasserna. Det finns även parasportklass och ungdomsklasser. Vatten finns längs 9 km-banan, och omklädning och dusch erbjuds vid Borgholms sporthall och Viktoriaskolans gymnastiksal. Avgifter varierar beroende på lopp och anmälningstid; administrativ avgift tillkommer.

name: Sommerkarusell Ålesund - 2. løp
description: The Summer Series in Ålesund is a long-running race series held in scenic surroundings along Vasstranda by Lillevatnet and Brusdalsvatnet. The courses are relatively flat and run on asphalt with little traffic, offering good conditions for both the 5 km and 10 km distances. The races start from the car park by the walking trail at the western end of Lillevatnet in Spjelkavik. The atmosphere is friendly, with prizes and medals for participants who take part in multiple races. The Summer Series has a long history in Ålesund and is now back under the organisation of Ålesundløpene.
course_highlights: The courses run along Vasstranda on the south side of Lillevatnet and Brusdalsvatnet
Relatively flat asphalt courses with little traffic
Start and finish at the car park by the walking trail at the western end of Lillevatnet in Spjelkavik
additional: The 10 km starts at 18:00 and the 5 km at 18:05. The courses have been officially measured by Kondis. Gift prizes are awarded after each race. Medals go to participants who take part in 2 or 3 races in the series. Course records for both the 5 km and 10 km distances are listed. The participation record is 132 finishers. Registration is through EQ Timing. Participants who finish at least two races in the series receive a medal at the final race of the season.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 3 etapas
description: The Jonava Running Cup is an open running tournament held in the Jonava District to promote sport and physical activity. The competition consists of five stages in different locations, where runners compete against one another and collect points toward an overall ranking. Each stage has its own course and start time, and participation is free. The tournament is organized by the Jonava Sports Centre together with the Lithuanian Amateur Runners Association and other partners.
course_highlights: Five stages in different locations across the Jonava District
Courses ranging from 6 km to 8.4 km
Evening start at 19:30; race bibs collected before the competition
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the start location on race day from 18:30 to 19:20. Registration for each stage is completed separately online. Participation is free. The courses may cross roads open to traffic, so participants must obey traffic rules. A five-stage series, online registration, open to participants from Lithuania and abroad, with starts usually at 19:30.

name: SUNSET Hamburg 2026
description: Altra Sunset Hamburg takes place in Wilhelmsburg Island Park. The event offers a scenic approx. 5 km loop course on asphalt and paths, which can be run 1 to 3 times, making distances of approx. 5 km, 10 km or 15 km possible. On the day of the event, participants can choose how many laps to run, with a checkpoint counting the laps. There is also a relay race, in which the course is run four times by teams of 2 to 4 runners. The event is open to anyone who is trained and has no medical concerns; club membership is not required.

name: Lauf um und am Gartower See
description: The run around and along Gartow Lake is a longstanding running event held on the lake’s north shore in Gartow. The course offers a natural setting with views of the lake and the surrounding Gartow pine forest, making it ideal for runners of all ages. The event is organized by the sports club SV Gartow, which has fostered sporting commitment and community in the region since 1946. The start and finish are centrally located in town, creating a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Kraftprovet
organizer: Trollhättans IF Friidrott och Trollhättans SOK
description: Kraftprovet är ett klassiskt stadslopp i Trollhättan som bjuder på en unik löparupplevelse längs kanalområdet med grönskande stråk, kuperad terräng och vackra vyer över Göta älv, slussarna och historiska kraftstationer. Loppet är en folkfest där både elitlöpare och motionärer deltar, och stämningen förstärks av publikens hejarop och musik längs banan. Med över 40 års tradition är Kraftprovet en mötesplats för stad, natur och människor under Fallens Dagar. Det finns flera lopp att välja på, från 800 meter till 11,6 kilometer, inklusive en rolig utklädnadstävling och en Fun Run-klass utan tidtagning.
course_highlights: Banan följer kanalområdet med varierad och kuperad terräng
Vackra vyer över Göta älv, slussarna och historiska kraftstationer
Publikstöd, musik och folkfeststämning längs hela banan
additional: Start och mål vid Hansenplatsen i Trollhättan. Nummerlapp med förnamn vid anmälan senast 30 juni. T-shirt kan beställas vid anmälan senast 15 maj, ingår i vissa lopp och kostar extra i andra. Silvermedalj delas ut till löpare som springer under 50 min (män) respektive 55 min (kvinnor). Farthållare finns för tiderna 50, 55, 60 och 65 minuter. Utklädnadstävling med priser före start. Dusch och ombyte finns cirka 1 km från mål i Arena Älvhögsborg. Vätskekontroller med Umara sportdryck och vatten finns längs banan.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://kraftprovet.se/deltagarinfo/): 2027-07-16 — "Datum 16 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-16)

name: Lüllemäe mägedejooks
description: Lüllemäe Mountain Run is the third event in the Valgamaa running series and takes place on the Lüllemäe health trails. The main race distance is 4.5 km, and children’s toddler and mini runs are also held at the Lüllemäe Basic School stadium. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and offers a chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting competitive atmosphere. Children’s runs are free, and the main race entry fees are reasonable, encouraging broad participation.

name: Ozolkalna VK
additional: The participation fee must be paid by bank card or bank transfer. If paying by bank transfer, registration details must be sent to latloppet@gmail.com.

name: Night Run Gdynia
description: Night Run Gdynia is a 5-kilometer night race held on the shores of the Baltic Sea as part of IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends. After dark, with city lights reflected on the asphalt and water, hundreds of runners set off on a spectacular route through the streets of Gdynia. The event has become an important and eagerly anticipated part of the city’s sporting calendar, combining athletic competition with the unique atmosphere of a night run.

name: Lidingöloppet Funäsfjällen
description: Lidingöloppet Funäsfjällen är en utmanande terränglöpning i fjällmiljö med branta stigningar, sluttande stigar och flacka ängsmarker som bjuder på fantastiska vyer över fjällen. Loppet kombinerar adrenalinfylld löpning med natursköna upplevelser och arrangeras vid Bruksvallarnas skidstadion i Bruksvallarna. Detta är den fjärde upplagan av loppet och välkomnar löpare till en unik och vacker utmaning i Sveriges fjällvärld.
course_highlights: Branta stigningar och sluttande stigar
Flacka ängsmarker med otroliga fjällvyer
Utförssträcka ner mot Bruksvallarna by efter tuff stigning
additional: Nummerlappsutdelning sker på plats i Bruksvallarna. Vid anmälan på loppdagen tillkommer en efteranmälningsavgift på 100 kr. Under veckan före loppet anordnas löparclinics, skotester, prova på fjällöpning och andra aktiviteter i Bruksvallarna. Vätskekontroller och mat- och dryckesstationer finns längs banan.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.lidingoloppet.se/lidingoloppet-funasfjallen): 2027-07-17 — "Date 17 juli" (was estimated 2027-07-10)

name: Gårvikloppet
description: Gårvikloppet är ett uppskattat löparlopp i Gårvik som startade 2016 och snabbt blev en succé med över 100 deltagare i alla åldrar. Loppet erbjuder flera klasser och banor, från utmanande värstingbanor till promenadklasser, vilket gör att alla kan delta oavsett nivå. Arrangemanget drivs av Badortsföreningen i samarbete med Dreambody gym och präglas av en gemytlig och inkluderande atmosfär.
course_highlights: Flera banor och klasser för olika nivåer
Terränglöpning i natursköna Gårvik
Banrekord för 4 km och 8 km för både damer och herrar
additional: Loppet har klasser från promenad till elitnivå och välkomnar deltagare i alla åldrar. Banrekord finns noterade för 4 km och 8 km för både damer och herrar. Tidigare resultat omfattar 4 km- och 8 km-klasser.

name: Yttersia Skyrace Senja
description: Yttersia Skyrace Senja is a rugged and accessible skyrace held on Senja’s spectacular outer coast, starting and finishing at Yttersia Base in Skaland. The course takes participants through dramatic coastal mountain terrain with long ridges, sheer slopes and fantastic views of the Berg Islands, Steinfjorden and Okshornan. The race features a continuous, runnable climb to Husfjellet, followed by narrow, exposed ridges and challenging technical terrain. It finishes with a sociable atmosphere, music and an after-run gathering at the finish area. This race is for anyone looking to experience authentic Senja terrain and a day filled with community and good vibes.
course_highlights: Dramatic coastal mountain terrain with long ridges and sheer slopes
A continuous, runnable climb to Husfjellet (632 m above sea level) with spectacular views
Technical, untouched terrain at Nonshaugen, near a historic graphite mine
additional: The race starts with a short stretch on a gravel road before continuing onto trails and uphill. There is one refreshment station at Litjebrusen. The finish area at Yttersia Base offers music, an announcer, awards, food, drinks and an after-run gathering with a sociable atmosphere lasting into the afternoon and evening. For 2026, the course is listed as running on gravel roads, trails and technical mountain terrain, with one refreshment station.

name: Lillesand Backyard Ultra
description: Lillesand Backyard Ultra is a backyard ultramarathon in Lillesand, where participants run repeated laps in a social, endurance-focused format. Previous editions have taken runners through central Lillesand, with the option to run more laps for as long as they have the strength. Join the running festival and see how long you can keep going.
course_highlights: Laps through central Lillesand
Backyard format with repeated laps
The opportunity to run for several hours and complete multiple laps
additional: Previous editions have been held in July.

name: Fiskekakeløpet
description: Fiskekakeløpet is a 12-kilometre road race in Risør, known as “the race that tastes of Risør”. The course takes participants through the town and onward towards Åmland and Viddefjell, before finishing at Holmen. It combines running with a local coastal atmosphere and the opportunity to socialise after the race.
course_highlights: 12 km on asphalt
The course passes through Solsiden, Krana, Frydendal and along Risørveien
Finish at Holmen after crossing the bridge
additional: Previous editions have started at Tollbua. After the race, participants have been able to go swimming, and a banquet has been held. Participants are responsible for buying their own fish cakes and beer.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 9. Rakvere valla Suvejooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 is a multi-stage running and walking series featuring various races in the Lääne-Virumaa region. Stage 9, Rakvere Parish Summer Run, takes place at Kooli 4 in Rakvere. The series aims to offer a sporting challenge and enjoyment to running enthusiasts and promote an active lifestyle throughout the region.

name: Väinjärve jooks , 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VI etapp
description: The Järvamaa Lake Runs is a traditional running series consisting of several stages by different lakes in Järvamaa. The Väinjärve Run is the sixth stage of the series. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and varied terrain around the lake. The series offers different distances and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: 12. skrējiens Piltene
description: Skrējiens Piltene is an annual running event in Piltene that brings together participants of different ages and fitness levels. Previous editions have included 10 km and 5 km races, as well as shorter events and Nordic walking starts. The event aims to promote an active, healthy lifestyle and popularize running.
course_highlights: The event’s main race is a 10 km road run.
Previous editions have also included a 5 km race.
Participants have also been offered a mile race and a 5 km Nordic walking start.

name: OYLER Berglauf
description: The 27th Oyler Berglauf takes place as part of the sports festival week in Marklohe. Organized by Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle, this race offers a sporting challenge on Oyler Berg. The event is part of a varied sports program and is aimed at runners who want to experience a hilly course in a friendly club atmosphere. The exact course route and further details can be found on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Race on Oyler Berg
Venue: Sportplatz Oyle
Part of Sportwerbewoche 2026
additional: The organizer is Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle von 1953 e.V. No pricing or registration details have been published on the website, nor are there any start times or wave details. The event takes place as part of Sportwerbewoche 2026 at Sportplatz Oyle; no specific registration information is available.

name: 22. Wiesenlauf
description: The 22nd Wiesenlauf in Klein Meckelsen gives runners the opportunity to compete on officially measured and DLV-approved 5 km and 10 km courses. The event includes district championships over both distances and a regional championship over 5 km, with results counted from the M/W 14 age group. The start and finish are at the Klein Meckelsen sports field. The event is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants.

name: 4. Fachberg 100
description: The Fachberg 100 is a 100 km road race in Northeim, Germany, starting at 6:00 a.m. The course consists of 15 laps and a short out-and-back section, alternating between asphalt and dirt paths. Each lap includes about 75 meters of elevation gain, for a total elevation gain of 1,125 meters. This is a small ultrarunning event with limited entries and no entry fee; runners must bring their own refreshments.

name: 12. Nocny Portowy Maraton Szczeciński oraz 7. Nocny Portowy Półmaraton Szczeciński
description: The 12th Szczecin Night Port Marathon and the 7th Szczecin Night Port Half Marathon are unique night races held in Szczecin, taking runners through the city’s central streets, the port and the shipyard. The marathon course consists of two identical 42,195 m loops, while the half marathon covers 21,097 m; both courses are certified by the PZLA. The race starts at 23:00, creating a unique atmosphere in the city at night and allowing participants to admire Szczecin’s distinctive landmarks. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle and the West Pomerania region.
course_highlights: The course passes through the city centre, the port and the Szczecin Wulkan Shipyard grounds
Scenic viewpoints at Wały Chrobrego, with music and spectator support
Two identical marathon loops and distance markers every 1 km
additional: The time limit for both races is 6 hours. The start and finish are at the Florian Krygier Municipal Football Stadium. The marathon course consists of two identical loops, while the half marathon is one loop. There are refreshment stations and distance markers every 1 km along the course. Participants must follow the instructions of the event and safety personnel.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail running event held in the picturesque landscapes of the Elbląg Upland overlooking the Vistula Lagoon. The course follows wild trails with varied elevation and peaceful natural scenery, offering runners a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series that promotes physical activity in harmony with nature, and is aimed at both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support, and a generous race pack.
course_highlights: The wild natural landscapes of the Elbląg Upland, with picturesque hills
Routes through the Elbląg Upland Landscape Park and four forest nature reserves
Views of the Vistula Lagoon and historic sites, including Old Prussian hillforts and the Imperial Stone
additional: The race pack includes a waterproof race bib with a chip, medical support, course marking, aid stations, drinks and snacks at the finish, a commemorative medal, and a GPS tracker for the 81 km distance. Starts are staggered from 5:00 (81 km) to 10:30 (14 km), with separate Garmin Junior races for children. The system applies discounts when registering for more than one event in the series. The program also includes Garmin Junior races over 200 m, 500 m, and 1,000 m.

name: 2 Chojnicka Piątka
description: 1. Chojnicka Piątka is a road race held in Chojnice, attracting runners looking for sporting excitement and fun. The event takes place on Rybacka Street and offers plenty of attractions for participants. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness over a short distance and experience the atmosphere of a local sports celebration.
course_highlights: A road race in central Chojnice on Rybacka Street
A short 5 km distance, ideal for runners of all levels
The atmosphere of a local sports celebration with numerous attractions
additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. It offers plenty of attractions for participants and spectators. The start and finish are on Rybacka Street in Chojnice.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
location: Kosewo, Mrągowo County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach głównych: 150,00 zł wpłata jednorazowa za cały cykl biegowy

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach dziecięcych i młodzieżowych jest bezpłatny

description: The Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur is a series of races held in the picturesque towns of Masuria, promoting outdoor activity and a connection with nature. The event includes main races of approximately 6.6 km, as well as races for children and young people in different age categories. The main race route runs along asphalt roads, cobblestones, and forest roads, offering participants varied surfaces and beautiful views. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the organizers provide water and a hot meal after the race. The event has a family-friendly, inclusive atmosphere, with activities for children and a concert after the winners’ awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The main race route is approximately 6.6 km long and runs along asphalt roads, cobblestones, and forest roads
Children’s and youth races over distances from 100 m to 800 m in different age categories
Picturesque Masurian landscapes around Kosewo
additional: The participant limit across all distances at each race is 400; the Race Office opens 1.5 hours before the start; race packs can be collected and registration is available until 30 minutes before the start; every participant receives a commemorative medal; the organizers provide water and a hot meal prepared by local rural homemakers’ associations; after the awards ceremony, the band Folk Banda will perform.

name: Puchar Polski Nordic Walking - II etap
XIII Półmaraton i Ćwierćmaraton
location: Chrzypsko Wielkie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: 31. Jooks-kõnd ümber Uhtjärve
description: The 31st Run-Walk Around Lake Uhtjärv is a traditional running and walking series in the Võru region, offering a range of distances for every participant. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Lake Uhtjärv, providing a sporting challenge for both runners and walkers. The series includes various distances and mini-distances suitable for beginners and experienced athletes alike. The event is part of the Võru County running and walking series, known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.

name: Sõõrikujooks
description: Sõõrikujooks on Tallinnas Õismäe tiigi juures toimuv jooksusündmus, mille korraldab Marathon100. Oodatud on jooksusõbrad nautima mõnusat liikumist ja ühist jooksupäeva.
course_highlights: Stardi- ja sündmuspaik asub Õismäe tiigi juures.

name: Jooks ümber Uhtjärve
description: The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series is a multi-stage series of running and walking events, offering a range of distances for both adults and children.
