The main distances range from approximately 5 to 8 kilometres, and the course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel roads, with some off-road sections. The series also includes mini-distances and runs for toddlers, suitable for all age groups. The event is open to everyone interested in sport and promotes healthy lifestyles and community involvement.

name: Flughafenlauf Barth
description: The Barther Airport Run takes place at Stralsund-Barth Baltic Sea Airport and offers a varied program of seven events for runners and walkers of all ages. From short distances for young runners to the half-marathon, there is something for everyone. The event promises a morning full of activity, fun, and exciting races in a unique atmosphere right at the airport. Walkers are also very welcome, and refreshments are available on site.

name: Kaszubski Festiwal Biegowy VII Kaszubski Maraton o Wschodzie Słońca
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
description: The Kashubian Running Festival is a unique running event on a scenic course through the towns of Rozewie, Swarzewo, Jastrzębia Góra, and back to Rozewie. The festival offers a range of distances: a marathon, half marathon, and 15 km, 10 km, and 5 km races, so every runner, regardless of experience, can find a suitable course. The marathon starts at 04:35, allowing participants to experience the extraordinary atmosphere of sunrise over Kashubia. After the races, the organizers provide refreshments and a prize draw, creating a festive, social atmosphere.

name: Aastajooks
organizer: Spordiklubi Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi MTÜ
description: The Pärnu Annual Runs are a traditional running series that began in 1985 and are inspired by the Eastern calendar, dedicating each year to its corresponding symbolic animal. The 2026 series is themed around the Year of the Fire Horse and consists of nine stages held in three different areas of Pärnu: Vallikäär, Pärnu Beach, and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail. Three stages take place at each location, offering participants a varied and enjoyable running experience. The series aims to provide a sporting challenge and enjoyment for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series is a competition for sports enthusiasts in Kohila Parish, offering a variety of running opportunities for different age and ability groups. The series aims to promote recreational exercise and provide participants with an enjoyable sporting experience. Participants receive a beautiful commemorative medal at each stage, and the series standings are based on points. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Centre, which provides modern facilities and a strong sporting environment.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is a running series competition organised by Tartu Spordiselts Kalev and held in the city of Tartu. The series has several stages, offering opportunities to take part in track races across different age groups. Competitions are held mainly at Tamme and Ülenurme Stadiums and are aimed at both young people and adults, providing a sporty and friendly competition environment. Registration closes at 12:00 on race day, offering flexibility for participants.

name: 34. Lippesee Marathon
location: Lippesee, Paderborn-Sande, Paderborn, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 34th Lippesee Marathon in Paderborn-Sande is a private marathon run held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, around Lippesee, a popular recreational area and water sports center. Participants must provide their own refreshments, as there are no aid stations, and record their time manually. A photo of the clock must be submitted by email as proof. The event is designed for experienced runners aged 18 and over, with a limit of 18 participants, and takes place only if at least five people register.

name: Blefjells Beste
description: Blefjells Beste is a trail race on Blefjell that passes several of the most beautiful places on Store-Ble. The race offers distances of 92, 53, 24, 10 and 5 km, and is a social, informal event for everyone who enjoys being outdoors in the forest and mountains. The start and finish are at Bestebu, a private cabin at Klengstøl. The courses are mainly on trails and mountain terrain, with the final kilometres on gravel roads. Participants must carry all their own food, drink and equipment, as there are no food or drink stations along the way.
course_highlights: Trail race with distances of 92, 53, 24, 10 and 5 km
The courses are mainly on trails and mountain terrain, with 150 to 3,150 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at the Bestebu cabin at Klengstøl, along Store-Bleveien
additional: The Storetroll course (92 km) consists of completing the other distances—53+24+10+5 km—in sequence. For the 92 km race, there are time limits for passing through the event area: after 1 lap (53 km) by Saturday at 12:00, and after 2 laps (53 + 24 km) by Saturday at 18:00. The 53 km and 24 km courses are not marked by the organiser, while the 5 km and 10 km courses are well marked. Name changes cost 150 kr for the 92, 53 and 24 km distances, and are free for the 10 and 5 km distances. The race requires participants to respect wild reindeer and leave no litter. There are no food or drink stations along the way, but clean water is normally easy to find in the mountains. Participants must carry their own food, drink and equipment; there are no food or drink stations. The event is listed for 23–24 July 2027, with registration opening on 1 December 2026.

name: Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail
description: Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail is the world’s northernmost ultra-running event, held in Utsjoki, in the Lapland wilderness. The route climbs to the summits of Kaldoaivi’s highest fells and offers spectacular, challenging scenery. The race tests runners’ endurance and skills in demanding natural terrain, but rewards them with an experience that brings many back year after year. The event also includes mountain bike races and offers a range of options for participants of different levels.
course_highlights: The route climbs to the summits of Kaldoaivi’s highest fells
Spectacular, rugged Lapland wilderness scenery
A demanding and instructive trail route
additional: Registering for two days gives a 30% discount on the price of the lower-priced category. The entry fee includes drinks and energy supplies at aid stations, washing facilities, transport of a gear bag to the finish, a race number, timing, a Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail lightweight backpack, a KUT product and a Finisher pendant. Category changes and transfers are free of charge until 7.7.2027. The event centres and start locations are in Nuorgam and Utsjoki. The race schedule includes several start times for different distances on 23.7. and 24.7.2027. Participant limits vary by distance; for example, MTB & E-MTB 57 km: 100 participants, Trailrun 168 km: 100 participants. The event offers several distances, including trail running, mountain biking and road cycling, with no amenities along the route. Participation includes a race number, timing chip, lightweight backpack and Finisher pendant. The event takes place in July 2027; detailed schedules and registration information are available on the website.

name: Bokeler Windmühlenlauf
description: The 20th Bokeler Windmühlenlauf takes place in Bokel. This traditional anniversary race is organized by ALG-VfL Bokel. Participation is limited to 300 people, and registration is through the RaceResult platform. The race offers runners a special atmosphere in the region and is a popular event for endurance and athletics enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Various race distances (5 km, 10 km, children's race)
Local club atmosphere
Limited to 300 runners
additional: Places are limited to 300 people. The organizational fee covers provision costs and is non-refundable, including in cases of force majeure.

name: Fun-Lauf "Durch den Wewerschen Wald"
description: The 33rd Fun Run “Through the Wewerschen Forest” in Paderborn is a community run with no timing and no entry fee. The event supports children in need through many thousands of steps and asks participants to make a donation instead. The runs take place on flat circuits with little elevation gain and are suitable for everyone. Competitions for children and teenagers are also offered.
course_highlights: Flat circuit (one lap)
Little elevation gain (30 to 40 metres uphill)
Distance options: 5 km and 7 km
additional: Run with no timing and no entry fee; participants are instead asked to make a donation. Competitions for children and teenagers are available. The finish location is not publicly displayed (RUNME Premium required). Runs on flat circuits, various distances, no timing, no entry fee, donations for charitable causes.

name: 13. Heilwald Marathon
description: The Heilwald Marathon in Bad Lippspringe is a special race held in the heart of the 200-hectare Heilwald, a unique therapeutic and recreational forest in Europe with a soothing low-mountain climate. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and has been carefully measured using a measuring wheel and GPS. This is a private, self-supported race. Times are recorded manually, and a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participants take part at their own risk. There is no entry fee; instead, voluntary donations for tree planting are welcome.

name: 38. Heiligenhafen Mitternachtslauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 20,- EURO in der Online-Voranmeldung für alle Teilnehmer.

description: Der Heiligenhafen Mitternachtslauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf, der jährlich in Heiligenhafen stattfindet. Die Hauptstrecke führt über 10 km durch die Stadt und rund um den Binnensee, mit Start und Ziel auf dem Sportplatz Lütjenburger Weg. Neben dem klassischen 10-km-Lauf gibt es auch kürzere Wettbewerbe für Jugendliche, Kinder und einen Binnenseelauf über ca. 5,5 km. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine besondere Atmosphäre mit viel Unterstützung an der Strecke und einem Start spät am Abend, der den Lauf zu einem besonderen Erlebnis macht.
course_highlights: 10 km Rundkurs durch Heiligenhafen mit Blick auf den Binnensee
Strecke führt an der Uferpromenade, Ferienpark und Seebrücke vorbei
Leichte Steigungen und Gefälle, Start und Ziel auf dem Sportplatz
additional: Es gibt mehrere Wettbewerbe: Mini-Mitternachtslauf (1 km) für Kinder, Mitternachtslauf-Doppelmeile (3,2 km) für Jugendliche, Binnenseelauf (ca. 5,5 km) und den klassischen 10-km-Lauf. Nachmeldungen sind am Lauftag ab 18 Uhr auf dem Sportplatz gegen eine Nachmeldegebühr möglich. Die Zeitnahme erfolgt elektronisch mit Transponder ohne Leihgebühr, bei Verlust wird eine Gebühr von 15 Euro erhoben. Die Teilnehmerzahl ist auf 1250 Läufer begrenzt.

name: Helags Fjällmara
description: Helags Fjällmara är ett klassiskt fjällmaraton som arrangeras i Ljungdalsfjällen sedan 1985. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser som passar alla nivåer, från den utmanande helmaran på 42 km till barnrundan på 800 meter. Tävlingen bjuder på en unik fjällupplevelse med vacker natur och varierande terräng, och är familjevänlig med lopp för både vuxna och barn. Start och mål är på ängen mitt i byn Ljungdalen, och arrangemanget inkluderar energi- och vätskestationer, personlig mugg, medalj till alla som fullföljer samt dusch och bastu efter målgång.
course_highlights: Terränglopp i vacker fjällnatur i Ljungdalsfjällen
Olika distanser från 800 m barnrunda till 42 km helmaran
Start och mål på ängen mitt i byn Ljungdalen
additional: Masstart för alla distanser. Nummerlappsutdelning i gymnastikhallen vid tävlingsområdet med chip för elektronisk tidtagning. Energi- och vätskestationer längs banan och efter målgång. Dusch och bastu finns efter målgång. Deltagartak per distans finns, t.ex. 100 deltagare på 42 km. Barn under viss ålder ska springa i vuxens sällskap.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://helagsfjallmara.se/): 2027-07-24 — "24 Juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-17)

name: Hornsjön Runt
description: Hornsjön Runt är ett traditionellt löplopp runt Ölands enda insjö med vacker och varierande öländsk natur. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser för både ungdomar och vuxna, inklusive en vandringsklass. Under loppet passerar deltagarna grusvägar med kalkstensunderlag, gräs, kohagar, löv- och barrskog samt sanddyner. Alla som fullföljer loppet får medalj och det finns prisutdelning för de tre främsta i varje klass.
course_highlights: Loppet går runt Ölands enda insjö
Växlande underlag med grusvägar, gräs, kohagar, löv- och barrskog samt sanddyner
Tre vätskestationer längs banan samt vid start/mål
additional: Vandringsklass finns för 5,5 km och 11 km med starttid mellan 13:00 och 16:00 utan tidtagning. Möjlighet till dusch och omklädning finns på Högby Idrottsplats. Prisutdelning sker till de tre främsta i alla klasser. Start och mål är vid Pensionat Hornsjön. Ungdomsklasser har olika starttider från 15:30 till 16:00 beroende på ålder och distans. Det finns distanser för barn och ungdomar samt en vandringsklass utan tidtagning.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/hornsjon-runt/): 2027-07-24 — "Tid & datum 24 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-17)

name: Bjäre Trail
price_range: 195–425 kr (2026 års ordinarie tidiga anmälningsavgifter; priser för 2027 ej bekräftade)
description: Bjäre Trail är ett utmanande traillopp som bjuder på varierande terräng genom beteshagar, gamla banvallar och täta bokskogar med forsande vattenfall. Löparna möts av branta backar, inklusive en gammal skidbacke, och belönas med storslagen utsikt över Laholmsbukten, Bjärehalvöns norrsida och Hallands kustlinje. Loppet arrangeras i Båstad Företagsby och välkomnar både erfarna traillöpare och naturälskare som vill uppleva en tuff och naturskön bana.
course_highlights: Väldigt varierande terräng med beteshagar och gamla banvallen
Täta bokskogar med forsande vattenfall
Branta backar med utsikt över Laholmsbukten och Bjärehalvön
additional: Max 300 startande. Efteranmälan på plats på tävlingsdagen mot förhöjd avgift 100 kr, endast jämna kontanter eller SWISH. Nummerlappar hämtas senast en timme före start vid start/mål eller på Bjäre bär’s gårdsbutik under fredagen. Toaletter finns på företagsbyn, men inga omklädningsrum eller duschar. Träsplakett till alla som fullföljer, hallon till vinnarna i varje klass sponsrade av Bjäre bär. Distanserna är 12, 17, 34 och 51 km. 34 och 51 km körs som två respektive tre varv på 17 km-slingan. Tävlingsinformationen anger ett maxantal på 300 deltagare.

name: Hamra Trail Run 2026
description: Hamra Trail Run är ett familjärt och exklusivt trailrunninglopp som arrangeras i fantastisk fjällmiljö vid Pensionat Strandgården i Fjällnäs. Loppet erbjuder tre distanser - Sprint 12 km, Distans 24 km och Ultra 48 km - med varierande höjdmeter och vätskestationer längs banan. Löparna förväntas vara självförsörjande och följa tydligt markerade orange flaggor på banan. Evenemanget har en begränsning på max 150 deltagare och är känt för sin gemenskap och natursköna upplevelse.
course_highlights: Sprint 12 km med ca 300 höjdmeter och 1 vätskestation vid 4 km
Distans 24 km med ca 630 höjdmeter och 2 vätskestationer vid 4 km och 20 km
Ultra 48 km med ca 1300 höjdmeter och 4 vätskestationer inklusive start/mål
additional: Nummerlapp hämtas vid sekretariatet på tävlingsdagen med olika tider beroende på distans. Obligatorisk pre race-genomgång hålls före start. Löparna måste ha med sig egen kåsa/mugg/flaska då engångsmuggar inte används vid vätskestationerna. Obligatorisk utrustning inkluderar förstärkningsplagg, vindjacka/vindbyxor efter väder, första förband inklusive dauerlinda samt fulladdad mobiltelefon med sparat säkerhetsnummer. Banorna är bitvis leriga och obanade, särskilt över Skenörsfjället där terrängen är snårig. Reptid för 24 km är 3,5 timmar med maxtid 8 timmar. Löparna uppmanas att stanna och hjälpa andra vid behov och att följa flaggorna noggrant. GPX-filer för alla distanser finns tillgängliga. Enligt tillgänglig loppinformation är antalet startplatser begränsat till 150. Löparmiddag efter målgång.

name: ÖTILLÖ Gothenburg
description: ÖTILLÖ Swimrun Gothenburg är ett unikt swimrunlopp som äger rum i hjärtat av sommaren i Göteborgs vackra skärgård. Tävlingen bygger på en stark lokal swimruntradition och erbjuder en spektakulär bana med många simsträckor och varierande löpterräng över öar och klippor. Loppet är lättillgängligt med färjor från fastlandet och bjuder på en fantastisk kombination av naturupplevelser och publikstöd. Det är en perfekt tävling för både erfarna swimrunlöpare och nyfikna deltagare som vill uppleva sporten i en naturskön miljö.
course_highlights: Kombination av snabba löpsträckor och intensiva simsträckor
Bana som går genom Göteborgs västkustskärgård med många öar och skär
Storslagen kust- och skärgårdsnatur med mycket publik längs banan
additional: Tävlingen erbjuder tre distanser: World Series (ca 39,7 km med 29 löpsträckor och 28 simsträckor), Sprint (ca 22,8 km med 18 löpsträckor och 17 simsträckor) och Experience. Start och mål är vid Styrsö Bratten. Färjor går regelbundet från Saltholmen och Stenpiren till tävlingsområdet. Obligatorisk utrustning finns att köpa vid start/mål-området. Det finns ett stort volontärengagemang som hjälper till längs banan och vid arrangemanget. Prisutdelning sker efter tävlingen. Check-in sker i Styrsöskolan. Evenemanget erbjuder distanserna Experience, Sprint och World Series.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://otilloswimrun.com/races/gothenburg-sweden/gothenburg-world-series/): 2027-07-24 — "saturday, July 24th, 2027 ... 08:11 Start World Series" (was estimated 2027-07-31)

name: Kil till Skutberget
description: Kil till Skutberget följer vandringsleden mellan Kil och Skutberget i Karlstad, en sträcka på cirka 22 kilometer. Leden går genom varierad värmländsk natur och passerar Sörmon, Högemon och Kilsravinerna. Ett naturnära lopp som tar deltagarna från Kil mot Vänerns strand vid Skutberget.
course_highlights: Cirka 22 kilometer mellan Kil och Skutberget i Karlstad.
Leden passerar naturområdena Sörmon och Högemon.
Sträckan går genom Kilsravinerna och avslutas nära Vänern.

name: Rondane Backyard Ultra
description: Rondane Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarun in the beautiful natural surroundings of Rondane, held at Stormoegga Ski Arena in Folldal. The race follows a scenic and varied loop through the Kroktjønna area, with pine forest, trails, gravel roads and idyllic ponds, and the Rondane mountains as a spectacular backdrop. The competition is a “Last Man Standing” race, with a new loop starting every hour, and continues until only one runner remains. In 2027, a separate night course will be introduced, offering participants a different experience in the dark. The arena’s service building offers facilities such as showers, changing rooms and a lounge for runners and supporters.
course_highlights: A varied route on forest trails, gravel paths and tractor roads in scenic surroundings
The course passes the Kroktjønna swimming area twice per lap
Night course on gravel road and asphalt between midnight and 06:00
additional: The race starts on 24 July 2027 at 09:00 and continues as long as runners complete the lap in under one hour. The service building at Stormoegga Ski Arena offers toilets, changing rooms, showers and a lounge. Participants may pitch their own tents and park caravans/campervans on site. A reflective vest is mandatory between 23:00 and 04:00, and a headlamp is recommended between 00:00 and 03:00. The race takes place on private gravel roads with some vehicle traffic, and runners must run on the left-hand side. First aid is available, and the race director can be contacted by phone on 909 56 674. Race bibs and timing chips are used. All places are sold out, but there is a waiting list to take over resold race entries. The start and finish are at Stormoegga Ski Arena, which has a lounge, kitchen, toilets, changing rooms and showers. Camping or parking a campervan/caravan at the arena is permitted.

name: Bleik Backyard Ultra - Last Man Standing
description: Bleik Backyard Ultra - Last Man Standing is an ultramarathon in Bleik, Andøy, where participants compete to keep going for as long as possible. The race has been described as a historic ultramarathon for the local community. The challenge is to show up for each new lap and see who is left standing in the end.

name: Kyststien Trail Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Preliminärt pris for løpet 2027 er 500 kr pluss eventuelt 100 kr for transport.

description: Kyststien Trail Ultra is an unforgettable 50 km ultramarathon along the Coastal Trail from Helgeroa to Gon Camping. The race offers varied terrain, including idyllic sandy beaches, technical trails along cliffs and coves, and spectacular panoramic views of the sea and lush countryside. It is a challenge that requires good preparation, with demanding climbs and descents, but also offers the joy of running and a wonderful sense of community among participants. The race celebrates nature and a passion for running, and encourages respect for the surroundings.
course_highlights: 50 km along the Coastal Trail over varied terrain: sand, grass, mountains, stairs, rocks, roots and gravel
Spectacular panoramic views of the sea, cliffs and lush countryside
Technical coastal trails with demanding climbs and descents
additional: Race bibs can be collected the evening before or on race day. The finish at Gonhytta offers water, drinks, snacks and hot soup. Prizes for the top 3 women and men, plus a race-bib raffle. All finishers receive a locally made birch medal. There is an opportunity to take a free hot shower and a cold sea swim. The race has 5 staffed aid stations with first aid, toilets, drinks and snacks. The course is marked with blue blazes and additional signs; a GPX file is recommended for navigation. Maximum 180 participants; a waiting list will be available if the race fills up. The start is at Blokkebukta camping, with the finish at Gonhytta at Gon Camping. Participants are provided with refreshments and a free hot shower, and all finishers receive a medal made from local birch.

name: Mefjellet Opp 2027
description: Mefjellet Opp is a traditional uphill race organized by Valldal Idrettslag in Fjørå, Valldal. The race features a challenging climb up Mefjellet and attracts both local and visiting runners looking for a demanding and scenic experience. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness in beautiful surroundings and experience the welcoming atmosphere of Valldal IL.
course_highlights: Steep uphill climb up Mefjellet
Scenic surroundings in Fjørå, Valldal
A traditional race with strong local roots
additional: The event is organized by Valldal Idrettslag. No specific information about the start time, price, or registration was found. Contact person for the event: leiar@valldalil.no. A village brunch is also held at the clubhouse in November, and the clubhouse is available for private use in June, but these are not directly related to the race. Previous editions have had a recreational start from Fjørå town center or Hauge, and a mass start for the competition classes. There have been two water stations along the course.

name: Mispo maastikumaraton
description: Mispo Trail Marathon is a trail race held in the Kurgja area of North Pärnumaa. The race distances are 42.195 km (marathon), 21.097 km (half marathon), 14 km and 7 km. The start is at the C. R. Jakobson Farm Museum at 11:00, and the race office opens at 9:00. All finishers receive a drink, food, access to the sauna, a diploma and a medal at the finish. The traditional event is organised by Terviseklubi Mispo, an active sports club since 1989.

name: Sakala metsajooks
description: The Sakala Forest Run is a trail race held in the Metsarada area in Kurgja municipality. The event offers several distances, including a marathon, half marathon, and shorter 7 km and 14 km runs. The race starts at 11:00 from the C. R. Jakobson Farm Museum, and participants are provided with a drink, food, sauna, certificate, and medal at the finish. The traditional event is organised by the Mispo Health Club and offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere.

name: Jelgavas nakts pusmaratons

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pusmaratona stafete sastāv no 2 dalībniekiem. Cena ir 20x2 = 40 euro €17,50 - +

description: BTA Jelgava Night Half Marathon is a night half marathon organized by the Baltic Events Association in Jelgava. Participants can compete individually in the half marathon or as a two-person relay team. The event is a popular sporting occasion that brings together runners who want to test their abilities at night in an urban setting.

name: 10. NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf
price_range: 25 EUR für Erwachsene, 20 EUR für Kids
description: The NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf is a maritime race held annually on the North Sea island of Norderney since 2016. The event offers a unique running experience surrounded by the island’s natural scenery and a special atmosphere. The routes pass through the historic Kurplatz and by landmarks such as the Napoleonschanze, the Schwanenteich and the island windmill. The race is suitable for all age groups, with distances ranging from the Bambini Run to the half marathon.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Kurplatz, with the Conversationshaus and Badehaus
Passing the Napoleonschanze, Norderney’s oldest monument
Run through the lively shopping streets, with spectators cheering
additional: The official technical shirt can be ordered during registration and is handed out with the race materials. The shirt costs 25 EUR for adults and 20 EUR for children. Timing is provided by ChampionChip; chip rental costs between 3 and 5 EUR, depending on the race. A preferred bib number is available for an additional 3 EUR. Cut-off times: 1:15h for 10 km and 2:30h for the half marathon. Island and maritime theme, sustainable technical shirt, on-site registration, online results, ferry connections for participants, test run on the day before the race, certificates and medals for children

name: 6. GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon
description: The GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon is a 50 km trail run starting in Kaltenweide, Langenhagen, Germany. The route has a modest elevation gain of about 350 meters and must be completed within 8 hours. The course passes through forest and trail sections, by Brelinger Berg with its geological nature trail, and back along Bissendorfer Moor. The event is registered with the German Ultramarathon Association and offers online results, certificates, and finisher medals.

name: FriesenCross
description: The Friesencross in Schillig is one of Germany’s most extraordinary cross-country running events. The route runs directly along the beach and offers a unique natural experience beside the Wadden Sea UNESCO World Heritage Site. Runners cross soft sandy beaches, green meadows and even the muddy seabed, combining a sporting challenge with the unmistakable atmosphere of the North Sea. Running sports presenter Heino Krüger accompanies the event and guides participants through the day with his extensive experience. The Friesenfestival takes place alongside the race, adding entertainment, music and culinary highlights.

name: Mulsumer Speckenlauf
location: Mulsum, Wurster Nordseeküste, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: Der Mulsumer Speckenlauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die vom TSV Mulsum v. 1919 e.V. organisiert wird. Die Veranstaltung findet im Rahmen der Sportwoche statt und bietet Läufe für Kinder über 450 m und 900 m sowie für Erwachsene über 5,3 km und 10 km. Die Strecke führt über Schotter, Feldwege und Asphaltstraßen und ist bekannt als „Die Hölle von Mulsum“. Für das leibliche Wohl ist gesorgt, und jeder Teilnehmer erhält eine Urkunde.
course_highlights: Streckenführung über Schotter, Feldweg und Asphaltstraße
Kinderläufe über 450 m und 900 m
Erwachsenenläufe über 5,3 km und 10 km mit geänderter 10-km-Strecke wegen Brückensperrung
additional: Start ist vom Sportplatz in Mulsum. Die Kinderläufe starten um 14:00 Uhr, die Erwachsenenläufe um 15:00 Uhr. Für Mitglieder des TSV Mulsum ist die Teilnahme kostenfrei. Nachmeldungen sind bis 45 Minuten vor dem Start vor Ort möglich. Es gibt eine Siegerehrung mit Urkunden für alle Finisher. Die Veranstaltung ist Teil der Laufsammler Aktion.

name: 26. Bieg Dookoła Morynia i Jeziora Morzycko
description: Join us for the 26th edition of the Run Around Moryń and Lake Morzycko, a unique event combining sporting competition with the beauty of Western Pomerania. The course follows a scenic route around Lake Morzycko, offering participants unforgettable views and a sense of sporting community. It’s a great opportunity for runners and fans of an active lifestyle to meet in Moryń and enjoy exercising outdoors. Whatever your experience level, there’s something here for everyone.

name: 24 Bieg Uliczny św. Jakuba
description: The 24th Energa St. James’s Run is an annual running event held in Lębork to celebrate the city’s patron saint. The certified 10 km course runs through the city streets, with appropriate safety measures provided by the services responsible for order. The ceremonial start takes place at Peace Square, and the official start is on Armii Krajowej Street. Participants must obey traffic regulations. The first 600 finishers will receive a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course
Runs through the streets of Lębork
Ceremonial start at Peace Square; official start on Armii Krajowej Street
additional: 7:00–9:00 at the Race Office in the gymnasium of the Special Educational Centre in Lębork, at Curie-Skłodowskiej Street. Participants under 18 from Lębork County are exempt from the entry fee upon presenting a valid student ID. The first 600 finishers will receive a commemorative medal. A contest for the best cheering zone will be held, with a prize of PLN 1,000.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – summer edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event places particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of its courses, offering picturesque and attractive routes for runners. It’s a great opportunity to combine sport with the beauty of nature and enjoy an active day in Gdynia.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque routes
Routes with scenic and natural appeal
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts
additional: Botaniczna Piątka has organized races and sporting events since 2014.

name: Hel - Rysy
location: Hel, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Runmaröloppen 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Mini-Lunken 1.5km 60kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och en kula glass.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lunken 5.7km: från 150kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och finisherdryck.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Halvmarathon 21km: från 350kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och finisherdryck.

description: Runmaröloppen är ett unikt löplopp i hjärtat av Stockholms skärgård på ön Runmarö. Loppen erbjuder en familjär och trivsam atmosfär med vackra banor som passar både barn, seniorer och erfarna löpare. Start och mål är vid Svängens Krog, och dagen bjuder på löpning, mat, glass, bad och härlig stämning. Halvmarathonbanan är cirka 21 km lång och anses vara en av Sveriges vackraste, medan Lunken på 5,7 km går genom grönskande fårhagar och skärgårdsbyar. Mini-Lunken och Antikrundan är kortare lopp för barn och seniorer, och det finns även en hundklass där hunden får en ätbar medalj.
course_highlights: Halvmarathon 21 km runt hela Runmarö med historiska och natursköna vyer
Lunken 5,7 km genom grönskande fårhagar och äkta skärgårdsbyar
Mini-Lunken och Antikrundan 1,5 km för barn och seniorer
additional: Mini-Lunken startar kl 11:00, Lunken och Halvmarathon startar kl 13:00. Det finns energistationer och pepp runt hela ön. Efter målgång får alla medalj och finisherdryck, Mini- och Senior Lunkare bjuds på glass. Max 200 platser för Halvmarathon och 120 för Lunken i första omgången, med ytterligare 30 platser släppta senare. Det finns en egen taxibåt mellan Stavsnäs Vinterhamn och Styrsvik samt Vaxholmsbåt linje #23. Nummerlappsutlämning sker på Svängen och Låttas Bageri. Kvällsaktivitet med middag och fest på Svängen efter loppet. 20% av överskottet skänks till Skärgårdsstiftelsen. Evenemanget erbjuder barnlopp, 5,7 km och halvmaraton på 21 km. Deltagarantalet är begränsat. Enligt befintlig evenemangsinformation går 20 procent av överskottet till Skärgårdsstiftelsen.

name: Salomon 27K
location: Ottsjö, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sverige
description: Salomon 27K är ett fjällöpningsevenemang som sträcker sig över 27 kilometer och passerar tre fjäll med en vacker målgång i Ottsjö. Loppet anses av många som ett av Sveriges vackraste och erbjuder en unik fjällupplevelse med ren naturpoesi. Under loppet finns mat- och vätskestationer med lokalt mathantverk och en säkerhetsorganisation för snabb hjälp vid behov. Deltagarna kan även ta del av busstransfer till start och tillbaka efter målgång.
course_highlights: 27 kilometer fjällöpning över tre fjäll
Vacker målgång i Ottsjö
Mat- och vätskestationer med lokalt mathantverk
additional: Busstransfer till start från Ottsjö, Trillevallen och Undersåker samt busstransfer tillbaka efter målgång. Elektronisk tidtagning med chip. Kåsa används för dryckeshantering vid mugg-fria vätskestationer. Säkerhetsorganisation finns för snabb insats vid olyckor. Startplats kan överlåtas mot en avgift på 250 kr. En stor del av anmälningsavgiften går till upprustning av Fjällmaratonlederna för hållbar utveckling. Loppet ingår i Fjällmaratonveckan.

name: KFC Südasuve Challenge - Pirita 2026
description: KFC Midsummer Challenge is a midsummer sports celebration taking place in Pirita for the third time. This community run offers beautiful views of the sea and the Old Town, with three distances to choose from. Participants can run, walk, or cover the distance with a stroller or walking poles. The start and finish are conveniently located in the same place on the beachfront, and the route follows a seaside pedestrian and cycling path without closing roads to traffic. All finishers will receive KFC gifts, and an event host and mascot will keep the spirits high.

name: Iigaste metsajooks
description: The Iigaste Forest Run is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa running and Nordic walking series, held every summer. This forest run gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting challenge on the 7.4 km main course, as well as shorter running and Nordic walking distances. The event takes place in Iigaste village and is suitable for different age groups, with medals and diplomas awarded to the top finishers. Entry is affordable, and registration is conveniently available online.

name: Pajūrio basatlonas
description: Pajūrio Basatlonas is a unique barefoot run on the seaside sand, held in Smiltynė, Klaipėda. The event takes place during the Sea Festival and gives participants an unforgettable experience of running between the sea and the dunes. The race promotes running culture in Lithuania and encourages a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose from several distances and enjoy the beautiful coastal scenery and gentle breeze.
course_highlights: Barefoot running on seaside sand
Start on the beach by the southern pier, Kopgalis, Smiltynė
Distances of 500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, with a 2-hour time limit
additional: A 2-hour time limit applies to all distances. Participants must have an identity document, a race number attached, and an electronic timing chip attached to their shirt. Participants run voluntarily and assume all risks associated with taking part. Barefoot running on seaside sand, various distances (500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km), online registration, regulations and rules, awards and commemorative medals.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The Volkswandertag in Bollensen is an annual event held on the last Sunday in July, open to hikers of all ages. A range of family-friendly routes takes participants along forest trails through the beautiful Solling region. The marathon and half-marathon hikes are circular routes starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports hall. All routes are marked and have refreshment stations. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with food and drinks in the finish area and a strong sense of community.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
location: Dąbki, Gmina Darłowo, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Seaside Spa Run is an annual running event held in Dąbki, promoting running as a simple form of exercise and a healthy lifestyle. The 10 km race is part of a larger sporting event that also includes races for children and young people and the Spa Nautical Mile. The event is family-friendly and recreational, and also aims to promote the Dąbki Spa and the Darłowo Municipality. It is organized by the Darłowo Municipality Office and the Seaside Spa Run Association, with support from numerous partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: 10 km course
The race takes place in the seaside town of Dąbki
Side events include the Spa Nautical Mile and races for children
additional: The event also includes the Spa Nautical Mile, covering 1,852 m, and races for children and young people over distances from 150 m to 1,100 m. The event is family-friendly and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland
organizer: Botaniczna Piątka; współorganizatorem edycji letniej jest Ogrody Przelewice
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque Dendrological Garden in Przelewice, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The organizers place particular emphasis on the aesthetic appeal of the proposed routes, making the race attractive to nature lovers and those who enjoy active recreation. It’s a great opportunity to combine a passion for running with a unique green setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Dendrological Garden in Przelewice
Picturesque, aesthetically pleasing natural surroundings
A race amid unique plant life and greenery
additional: The event is organized by a group of running enthusiasts that has been active since 2014, specializing in cross-country races and paying close attention to the aesthetics of the locations. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrated its 10th anniversary. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, entry fees, or additional services. In the previous summer edition, participants received a commemorative medal.

location: Jantar, Gmina Stegna, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Peak Performance Vertical K
description: Åre Vertical K är ett prestigefyllt vertikalt lopp som arrangeras årligen under tisdagskvällen i samband med Kia Fjällmaraton Årefjällen. Loppet startar med masstart på Åre Torg och målgång sker på toppen av Åreskutan, vilket innebär exakt 1000 vertikala höjdmeter. Det är ett krävande lopp där deltagarna får räkna med maxansträngning från start till mål. Banrekorden att slå är 46:24 för damer och 39:13 för herrar. Prispengar delas ut till de tre bästa i både herr- och damklassen.
course_highlights: Masstart på Åre Torg
Mål på toppen av Åreskutan
Exakt 1000 vertikala höjdmeter
additional: Mat- och vätskestationer längs banan med lokalt mathantverk. Kåsa används för dryckeshantering vid mugg-fria vätskestationer. Busstransfer till start från Ottsjö, Trillevallen och Undersåker samt busstransfer tillbaka efter målgång. Elektronisk tidtagning med chip. Säkerhetsorganisation för snabb insats vid olyckor. Startplats kan överlåtas mot avgift på 250 kr. Rekommenderad försäkring för återbetalning vid sjukdom eller skada. Priser delas ut till de tre främsta damerna och herrarna. Banrekorden är Emmie Collinges 46:24 och Kilian Jornets 39:13.

name: ATEA Kalmarmilen
description: ATEA Kalmarmilen är ett etablerat millopp i Kalmar för både motionärer och elitlöpare. Banan går genom stadsmiljöer och längs välkända platser i Kalmar, med start vid Teatervallen och målgång på Larmtorget. I anslutning till loppet arrangeras även Lilla ATEA Kalmarmilen för barn i olika åldersklasser.
course_highlights: Start vid Teatervallen och målgång på Larmtorget
Banan passerar Kalmar slott och Gamla stan
Sträckningen går även via hamnen, Fredrikskans, Lindö och Ängö
additional: Lilla ATEA Kalmarmilen erbjuder barnlopp i olika åldersklasser. Loppet har även DM/VDM-status för Östsvenska och ingår i I Run Kalmar-raceserien.

name: 10. ETAPP
description: TV 10 Olympic Start is a competition series organized by the Estonian Athletics Association for schoolchildren and young athletes. Competitions take place in different age groups and cover a range of athletics events. The 10th stage will be held at Tamme Stadium in Tartu, giving young athletes the opportunity to test their skills and gain experience. The series aims to support young people’s athletic development and provide a fun and motivating competitive environment.

name: Fjällmaraton 100k
location: Fångåmon, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sverige
description: Fjällmaraton 100K är ett klassiskt fjällmaraton som startar i gryningen i Fångåmon och följer en vacker, slingrande och lättlöpt stig till Vålådalen via Nulltjärn. Därefter ansluter loppet till den klassiska Fjällmaratonbanan över Ottfjället och fortsätter sedan över Hållfjället, Grofjället och Välliste på vägen tillbaka till Ottsjö. Loppet erbjuder en unik atmosfär med en recovery zone i målområdet där deltagarna kan koppla av i bastu och återhämta sig med alkoholfri öl. Alla deltagare måste vara självförsörjande under loppet med möjlighet att fylla på vatten vid officiella vätskestationer längs banan.
course_highlights: Start i Fångåmon i gryningen
Vacker och lättlöpt stig via Nulltjärn och Vålådalen
Passage över Ottfjället, Hållfjället, Grofjället och Välliste
additional: Mat- och vätskestationer längs banan med lokalt mathantverk. Officiell dryck är U Sport by Umara (citron). Deltagarna får en Fold-a-Cup för vätskestationerna. Busstransfer till start från Ottsjö, Trillevallen och Undersåker samt tillbaka efter målgång. Startplats kan överlåtas mot en avgift på 250 SEK. Säkerhetsorganisation finns för snabb hjälp vid allvarliga skador. Deltagarna ansvarar själva för vätska och energi mellan de officiella vätskestationerna.

name: Olavsløpet 2027
description: St. Olavsloppet is a three-day relay race from Trondheim to Östersund, finishing in Östersund. The race offers two main distances: StOlav 340, covering the entire route, and StOlav 210, a shorter option. Participants compete in teams and can choose from several categories, including open, corporate, women’s, and men’s. The race features varied terrain, with daily stages that include both urban settings and scenic areas, and places a strong emphasis on team spirit and community.
course_highlights: Three-day relay race from Trondheim to Östersund
Varied terrain featuring both urban and natural settings
Water stations approximately every four kilometers and at relay exchanges
additional: The race has start groups based on expected running pace, and teams are seeded following communication with team managers. Race bibs must be worn visibly on the chest and back and must not be folded. Timing takes place at regular exchanges, which are monitored by cameras. GPS trackers are issued daily and attached to the relay baton, which is handed from one runner to the next. Additional exchanges without timing are permitted on certain sections. Teams may distribute their own drinks, but not from moving vehicles.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 4. posms – Lucavsala
description: Izskrien Rīgu Stage 4 is part of a popular running series held in Riga’s parks and neighborhoods, designed for the whole family. This stage will take place on Lucavsala, giving participants the chance to enjoy running in a beautiful, green urban setting. The series is known for its friendly atmosphere and for welcoming both professional and amateur runners. At the end of the event, the fastest runners and the season’s overall leaders are traditionally honored.
course_highlights: Run through Lucavsala Park and the surrounding area
Green, flat terrain suitable for runners of all levels
Friendly atmosphere and the chance for the whole family to compete
additional: A concert and party are traditionally held at the end of the event, adding to the sporting experience. Participants can check in until noon on race day. The series brings together around two thousand participants at each stage.

name: 4 PolandRockowy Bieg Policz się z cukrzy...
location: Broczyno, Czaplinek, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Kvitfjell Stuttlaup
description: Kvitfjell Stuttlaup is a 13-kilometre trail race featuring technical trails and varied terrain in beautiful Kvitfjell. The race starts at Kvitfjelleggen and finishes at Tyrihanstunet, with approximately 240 metres of elevation gain. Known for its challenging and fun trails, the race is part of Lauparfestivalen, which also includes several other races and activities. Participants can look forward to a great mountain running experience, a lively atmosphere and the option to buy food in the finish area.
course_highlights: 13 km with approximately 8 km of trail and 5 km of gravel road
Technical and fun trail on the west side of Svinåa
240 metres of elevation gain over varied terrain
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 11:00 at the start. There is a drinks and food station at Svinslåvangen after 8.5 km. Parking is not available at the start. Recommended parking locations are Skitorget, by Tyrihans, along the roads towards the top (west side), or at Gudbrandsgard Hotel (east side). Carpooling is organised, with participants meeting at 10:00 in the parking area at the bottom of Vestsideløypa. Food can be purchased from Tyrihanstunet in the finish area. The race does not provide sports drinks or gels, in order to keep the event simple and affordable. The festival website lists the event as 24–25 July, which does not match the stated race date of 30 July 2027.

name: Kvitfjell Langlaup
description: Kvitfjell Running Festival offers three challenging races through varied terrain in Ringebu, Innlandet. Kvitfjell Opp is a brutal uphill race up the Olympic downhill course, climbing 838 metres over 3.2 km. Langlaupet is a 25 km long-distance race with 19 km of trail and 6.5 km of road, offering an extra challenge for those who want more after the uphill race. Stuttlaupet is a 13 km race with technical trails and gravel roads, perfect for those looking for a shorter but challenging mountain run. All races finish at Tyrihanstunet, where good food and a social atmosphere are also on offer.
course_highlights: Kvitfjell Opp: 3.2 km uphill race climbing 838 metres up the Olympic downhill course
Langlaupet: 25 km through varied terrain, with 19 km of trail and 6.5 km of gravel road; highest point approximately 1,100 metres above sea level
Stuttlaupet: 13 km with approximately 8 km of trail and 5 km of gravel road; a technical and enjoyable course
additional: Race bibs are distributed at the start of each race. Kvitfjell Opp starts by the lift at the bottom, while Langlaupet and Stuttlaupet start from Kvitfjelleggen behind the summit café. There are refreshment stations along Langlaupet and Stuttlaupet, as well as a refreshment station on Kvitfjell Opp at the mid-station. For Kvitfjell Opp, parking is recommended at the mid-station; for Langlaupet and Stuttlaupet, parking is recommended at Skitorget or Gudbrandsgard Hotel. A children’s race starts at 13:00 on Saturday during the festival, with a medal and drink at the finish. Talks and an after-run event are also part of the festival. Langlaupet is part of Kvitfjell Running Festival, which also includes Kvitfjell Opp and Stuttlaupet. Weather conditions can change in the mountains.

name: Kvitfjell Lauparfestival 2027
description: Kvitfjell Running Festival 2027 takes place in Kvitfjell from 27 to 31 July 2027. The festival offers a varied programme of sport and culture, with tickets available through EQ Timing. The event starts early in the day and continues until late in the evening, offering participants a great experience in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Kvitfjell Uphill follows the former Olympic downhill course up the mountain.
The approximately 25 km long-distance race traverses varied terrain, including trails and gravel roads.
The short race offers a shorter 13 km trail-running distance.
additional: Tickets are sold through EQ Timing. The event runs from early morning until late evening. It takes place in Kvitfjell, with a map and directions available on the website. The programme also includes an uphill race for children, talks at Tyrihanstunet, and an after-run.

name: Vormsi maraton
description: Vormsi Marathons VIII is a two-day running event on Vormsi Island, taking place on July 31 and August 1 near Sviby Harbour. Participants can choose the marathon or half-marathon distance on both days, with the courses running mainly on paved roads on Vormsi Island. The courses are marked, and timing is provided using electronic SI sticks. After the run, participants can join a social gathering and enjoy a sauna and hot soup at the finish. The event is small and friendly, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners.

name: Springe-Deister-Sommerlauf
description: The Springe-Deister Summer Run features a measured 5 km loop at the foot of the Kleiner Deister. The course is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), so results can be included in rankings. Kilometer markers are clearly signposted, and the course is gently undulating, with an elevation difference of approximately 20 meters. The race starts at 5:45 p.m. at Schulzentrum Süd (OHG) in Springe and is aimed at runners looking for an attractive, officially sanctioned running event in the region.

name: Falkenbergs Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 450 kr fram till och med 20:e juli 2027

description: Falkenbergs Stadslopp är ett 10 km långt stadslopp som går genom Falkenbergs centrala delar och sommarvackra miljöer. Loppet är en folkfest och en löparhöjdpunkt i Halland som välkomnar både nybörjare och erfarna löpare. Banan är snabb och lättsprungen med ett fantastiskt publikstöd längs vägen. Start och mål är samlade på Falkenbergs Idrottsplats, vilket skapar en smidig och trivsam helhetsupplevelse för deltagarna.
course_highlights: 10 km genom Falkenbergs centrala delar och sommarvackra miljöer
Snabb och lättsprungen bana med två vätskestationer längs banan
Start och mål vid Falkenbergs Idrottsplats med god infrastruktur och publikstöd
additional: Uppvärmning sker 11:40 vid startområdet med Nordic Wellness. Prisutdelning sker 13:00 vid målområdet. Nummerlappar hämtas på Team Sportia torsdag och fredag innan loppet samt på tävlingsdagen från kl. 9.00. Det finns omklädningsrum och möjlighet att lämna in väskor på tävlingsdagen. Massage erbjuds vid målområdet efter loppet. Falkenbergs Stadslopp är distriktsmästerskap 2027 och ingår i Tour de Falkenberg. Startgrupper markeras med flaggor efter självskattad kilometertid för säkerhet. Kiosken är öppen 10:00-14:00. Två vätskestationer finns på banan vid 3 och 8 km samt vid mål.
