name: Kivijärviloppet
location: Kivijärvi, Övertorneå Municipality, Norrbotten County, Sverige
description: Kivijärviloppet är ett traditionellt terränglopp som arrangeras av Kivijärvi IF sedan 1970. Loppet hålls i byn Kivijärvi i Tornedalen och erbjuder flera distanser med en huvudklass på 12 km som är öppen för både damer och herrar utan åldersindelning. Tävlingen är känd för sin långa historia, fina banor och ett rikligt prisbord tack vare generösa sponsorer. Många namnkunniga idrottare har deltagit genom åren, vilket ger loppet en stark lokal och nationell status.
course_highlights: Terränglopp med flera distanser: 0,5 km, 1,5 km, 5 km, 7,5 km och 12 km
Banmarkeringar i olika färger för varje distans: gul, vit, blå och röd
Loppet hålls på samma banor sedan starten 1970 med undantag för Corona
additional: Bansträckning med färgkodade markeringar för olika distanser: 0,5 km och 1,5 km (gul), 5 km (vit), 7,5 km (blå), 12 km (röd). Tävlingen har ett rikligt prisbord för barn, vuxna och motionärer tack vare frikostiga sponsorer. Kivijärvi ligger cirka 15 kilometer söder om Korpilombolo längs Övertorneåvägen. Den officiella webbplatsens information gäller 2026 och bekräftar inte datumet 7 augusti 2027.

name: Augustiloppet
description: Augustiloppet är en del av Augustifesten i Smedjebacken, en vecka fylld med roliga och spännande aktiviteter för hela familjen. Loppet arrangeras i samband med festivalen och erbjuder en trevlig motionsupplevelse i en gemytlig miljö. Det är en traditionell sommarhändelse som samlar både motionärer och tävlingsinriktade löpare. Evenemanget är välkomnande för alla åldrar och nivåer.
course_highlights: Barnlopp på cirka 700 meter
5 km motionsklass
10 km tävlingsklass
additional: Tidigare upplagor har haft start och mål på torget i Smedjebacken. I en tidigare upplaga var barnloppet gratis.

name: Storå 6 timmars och 3 timmars
description: Storå 6 timmars är ett utmanande ultralopp som arrangeras av Storådalens SK vid Hagabackens skola i Guldsmedshyttan. Loppet erbjuder två distanser, 6 timmar och 3 timmar, där deltagarna springer på en 2130 meter lång bana med cirka 50 höjdmeter per varv. Under loppet serveras sportdryck och energi vid varvning, och korv med bröd finns tillgängligt halvvägs. Alla deltagare får en T-shirt efter målgång och hederspris delas ut till de tre främsta i varje klass. Resultaten publiceras live under tävlingsdagen på hug-timing.se.
course_highlights: Varv på 2130 meter med cirka 50 höjdmeter
Vid 20 varv passeras maratondistansen med totalt 1000 höjdmeter
Sista 30 minuterna springer man ett kortare varv
additional: Start, varvning och tävlingscentrum vid Hagabackens skola med duschar, WC, service och sjukvård. Parkering för 6-timmars på grusfotbollsplan bakom skolan, för 3-timmars på Guldsmedshyttebruks parkering 500 m bort eller vid starten. Tidtagning sker med chip på fotleden som lämnas tillbaka efter loppet. Sportdryck från Umara och andra produkter serveras vid varvning. Alla löpare får T-shirt efter avslutad tävling. Hederspris till de tre främsta i respektive klass. Loppet är inställt på grund av för få deltagare. Planerade starter var kl. 11.00 för 6-timmarsloppet och kl. 14.00 för 3-timmarsloppet. Tidtagning skulle ske med chip.

name: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE
description:
Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE är trailäventyret för dig som vill kombinera löparglädje, utmaning och storslagen natur. Välj mellan 42 km, 21 km eller 10 km – och ta med hela familjen! Barn upp till 12 år springer helt gratis i Barnens Fjällmaraton.
Banan tar dig över karga fjällstigar, spänger och slingrande leder hela vägen fram till målet och den stämningsfulla After Run-festen på Experiumtorget i Lindvallen. Fjällmaraton Sälen är en löparupplevelse deluxe. Säkra din plats och upplev fjällen med oss!

images.alt_text: Två löpare springer på fjällstig i höstlandskap under Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE.
Löpare på fjällstig med vidsträckt utsikt över berg och himmel
Löpare på träspång i fjällandskap under Fjällmaraton Sälen tävling
Löpare i fjällterräng under en terränglöpning med färgglada markeringar och skyltar.

name: Craft Syv Søstre Skyrace
description: Craft Seven Sisters Skyrace is a challenging and spectacular mountain race on the Helgeland coast in Nordland, traversing the iconic De Syv Søstre mountain range. The race features technical terrain with steep climbs and descents, and offers fantastic views of the Helgeland coast. There are two distances: Syv Søstre, approximately 23 km with 2,900 metres of elevation gain, crossing all seven peaks, and Dronningruta, approximately 13 km with 1,300 metres of elevation gain, crossing the two northernmost peaks. Both distances are ISF-certified and UTMB Index races, making this an internationally recognised skyrace. The race takes place on 7 August 2027 and offers a memorable day in the mountains for local and visiting runners alike.
course_highlights: Technical terrain with steep climbs and descents
Fantastic views of the Helgeland coast from several peaks
ISF-certified course and UTMB Index race for both distances
additional: The race has two distances: Syv Søstre (23 km, 2,900 metres of elevation gain) and Dronningruta (13 km, 1,300 metres of elevation gain). All participants are required to download and use a GPX file on a suitable device. There are cutoff points along the course to ensure safety and emergency preparedness. A minimum of 1 litre of fluid is recommended at the start. Wool base layers are recommended in cold weather. The descent from Botnkrona requires extra concentration, and fixed ropes are in place at some points. The minimum age for Dronningruta is 14; participants under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian. The race is organised by Stigningsløp AS, with the aim of providing a safe and well-organised mountain race. It takes place on 7 August 2027 in Alstahaug. Both distances are certified by the International Skyrunning Federation and are included in the UTMB Index.

name: Møkster maraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Møkster maraton kr 1200,- ( Inkl. mat og drikke etter målgang og gratis show )

description: Møkster Marathon is held on the beautiful little island of Møkster in Austevoll municipality, on the outer edge of the ocean southwest of Bergen. The race offers a unique experience, with a course through varied terrain including asphalt, gravel and grass, and great views of islands, coves and the sea. There are three distances: marathon (42 km), half marathon (21 km) and the unique Nautical Marathon (7.8 km). After the race, participants can enjoy food, drinks and a concert in a welcoming atmosphere. All finishers receive beautiful medals, and the winners are awarded wild sheep skins and other great prizes.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt, gravel and grass
10 laps, with 69 metres of elevation gain per lap
Great views of lush natural scenery, islands, coves and the sea
additional: An early start for the marathon is available at 11:00, but early starters are not eligible for medals. A children's race for the youngest participants starts at 14:30, with no registration required. The café is open from 12:00 to 17:00, with food, cake and coffee included for marathon runners. The concert starts at 20:00; admission is free for marathon runners and half price for half-marathon runners. An extra boat departing at 22:00 for Hufthamar/Bekkjarvik can be purchased. There is a dedicated floating dock for private boats and a helicopter landing pad. Beautiful wild sheep skins are awarded to the winners of all three distances.

name: Hardanger halvmaraton
description: The Hardanger Half Marathon is organised by Øystese Sports Club and offers a peaceful race along the fjord, with views of Fonna. The fast course is entirely on asphalt, passing orchards, built-up areas and a lively town centre. The start and finish are at the beautiful Storeteigen Folk Museum. The race has become a tradition, attracting runners looking for a great half-marathon experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Fast 21.1 km asphalt course with 141 m of elevation gain
Passes orchards, cultural landscapes and the centre of Norheimsund
Start and finish at Storeteigen Folk Museum, with a refreshment station halfway
additional: Check-in starts at 10:00 at Storeteigen. The awards ceremony is at 14:00. Parking is recommended at the municipal car park near the waterworks. Members of Øystese Sports Club receive a discount when registering. The course has been officially measured by NFIF and has official records for the men's and women's categories.

name: Mjøsen Backyard 2027
description: Mjøsen Backyard is a unique and demanding trail race consisting of 12 laps with a total of 2,604 metres of elevation gain, equivalent to running from Mjøsa’s deepest point up to the water’s surface six times. The race challenges both body and willpower, offering a brutal but rewarding experience where strategy and endurance are essential. The course passes through varied terrain, including forest, open areas and technical sections, with steep climbs and beautiful views of Mjøsa. The concept is that the race starts on the hour every hour, and runners must complete each lap before the next start to continue. The first runner to finish the final lap wins the race.
course_highlights: 12 laps with a total of 2,604 metres of elevation gain
Steep climbs, including one with a 29.7% gradient after 3.4 km
Varied terrain with forest, open areas and beautiful views of Mjøsa
additional: Bib pickup is on Friday, August 7, from 16:00 to 18:00 and on race day until 30 minutes before the start. The race office opens at 07:00. Tents will be provided for Backyard runners, but you must bring your own chair and equipment. Running poles are not permitted. Participants will be provided with sports drink, gels and lefse at the venue, but are advised to bring their own food and drink. There is zero tolerance for littering along the course. A doctor and medical officer will be present at the venue. Portable toilets are available. HOKA will have demo shoes at the venue. Live results via EQ Timing. The course partly passes through Furuberget Nature Reserve, and participants are expected to show extra respect for the area.

name: Mjøsen Trail 2027
description: Mjøsen Trail is a spectacular trail race in Hamar, Innlandet, known for its steep climbs and fantastic views over Lake Mjøsa. The race offers several distances, from the challenging Backyard with 12 laps and over 2,600 metres of elevation gain to shorter distances such as the high-intensity 10 km. The courses pass through varied terrain with technical sections, and are suitable both for those seeking a tough challenge and for those who want to enjoy the running experience without competitive pressure. The event has a strong focus on nature and respect for the environment, with parts of the course in Furuberget Nature Reserve.
course_highlights: Steep climbs with gradients of up to 29.7%
Great views over Lake Mjøsa along the way
Varied terrain with technical sections and challenging climbs such as Elghufsbakken and Bratta
additional: Race bib collection is Friday 7 August from 16:00 to 18:00, and on race day until 30 minutes before the start. The race office opens at 07:00 on race day. HOKA awards the top three finishers in every distance and offers demo shoes at the race venue. There is zero tolerance for litter on the course. Participants in the 10 km, 21 km, 42 km and 80 km races receive sports drinks and some nutrition at the race venue and at the halfway point. Part of the course runs through Furuberget Nature Reserve, with extra emphasis on respecting nature. The Backyard race starts at the beginning of every hour, and runners must complete the lap before the next start to continue. Running poles are not allowed in the Backyard.

name: Kongsvinger Skogsmaraton
description: Kongsvinger Forest Marathon is a scenic forest race held on hilly, varied terrain north and west of Sæter farm. The event offers marathon, half-marathon, 10 km and 4.2 km distances. The main course is 21.1 km and follows forest roads and good trails past several lakes and wooded areas. The marathon consists of two laps of the main course, while the half-marathon is one lap. The event focuses on providing a good experience for all participants, with well-marked courses and several aid stations along the way.
course_highlights: Hilly, varied forest terrain north and west of Sæter farm
The course follows forest roads and good trails past Bogersjøen, Bogerfløyta and Trettbråten
9 aid stations per lap with water, sports drink, bananas and raisins
additional: The marathon course is run over two laps, and the half-marathon over one. There is no time limit for the race. Bringing a hydration pack, vest or belt is recommended because of the warm weather in August. Music is allowed during the race, but runners should stay aware of their surroundings. Please dispose of litter responsibly; everyone is encouraged to use the bins at the aid stations and in the start area.

name: Solan Gundersens Bergmaraton
description: Solan Gundersen’s Mountain Marathon is organized by Alvdal Sports Club and offers challenges for all ages and levels, from a children’s race to demanding distances for those looking to push themselves further. The race follows Alvdal’s popular hiking trails, starting and finishing at Steimoegga Sports Complex. Great atmosphere and enjoyable experiences for the whole family are a priority, with both recreational and competitive categories available. Participants may encounter familiar characters such as Solan Gundersen during the race, which also features food and drink stations along the course.
course_highlights: The race follows Alvdal’s well-used hiking trails
Start and finish at Steimoegga Sports Complex
Food and drink stations along the course and at the finish
additional: Participants can enter the recreational or competitive category. Distances include 1 km, 6 km, 22 km (half marathon) and 48 km (marathon+). Age limits apply: 15 years for 22 km and 18 years for 48 km. Changing rooms and showers are available at Steimoegga. Bibs must be worn visibly on the chest. A license must be purchased when registering. Food and drink can be purchased at the kiosk at the start/finish. Free parking is available at Steimoegga. Dogs are allowed in the recreational category for 22 km. There will be cutoff times for 48 km. The entry fee is paid when collecting the race bib or invoiced after the race. Participants can opt out of having their photos used in marketing. Registration is open until the start. The entry fee is paid via Vipps when collecting the race bib or invoiced after the race. Food and drink stations are available along the course, and free parking, changing rooms and showers are available at Steimoegga.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 20. Tapa linnajooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of events for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in different locations across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners the chance to enjoy both city and trail running. The 20th Tapa City Run takes place near Tapa Gymnasium and is part of the series’ long-standing tradition of bringing together recreational athletes and running enthusiasts. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and provide enjoyable running experiences.

name: Paldiski liigub
description: Paldiski Moves is the third stage of the West-Harju Movement Series, held at Paldiski Sports Centre. The course passes Paldiski’s main attractions, streets and shared-use paths, offering participants beautiful natural views and a historic atmosphere. Free children’s races are organised for the younger members of the family, with an emphasis on the joy of movement and lifelong physical activity. The event takes place as part of Paldiski City Day, when the series’ top performers are awarded, and the evening ends with a concert.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Jurbarkas 2026“, skirtos Nemuno metams paminėti
description: In Jurbarkas, on Nemunas Street. Children, young people, and adults are all invited to take part. Three distances are offered: 400 m, 3 km, and 12 km. The event starts at 11:00. All participants who finish will receive commemorative gifts, and the top athletes will receive trophies. This is a great opportunity to celebrate Nemunas Year actively and run together in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Choose from three distances: 400 m, 3 km, and 12 km
The race takes place on Nemunas Street in Jurbarkas
The 12 km distance consists of 4 laps
additional: Race bibs will be distributed from 10:00. Age groups by distance: 400 m — B12/M12 (born in 2014 or later); 3 km — B14/M14, B18/M18 (older participants compete without classification); 12 km — men and women in separate age groups. All participants who finish will receive commemorative gifts, and the top athletes will receive trophies. Race distances: 400 m, 3 km, 12 km; age groups; advance registration; registration will not be available on the day of the event.

name: Šilutės naktinis bėgimas „ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026“
location: Šilutė, Šilutės rajonas, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lithuania
description: The Šilutė night run “ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026” is a night running event for everyone who enjoys an active lifestyle—from families and beginners to experienced runners. The event takes place in Šilutė, with an illuminated night course, music, a lively atmosphere, and a variety of activities. Participants can choose the 1 km family, children’s and pets’ run, or the 5 km and 10 km distances. Participants will receive finish medals, prizes will be awarded to the fastest runners, and delicious food will be available.
course_highlights: Illuminated night course
Location: Kiškio dauba, Šilutė
Distances: 1 km, 5 km and 10 km
additional: Event programme: 18:00 bib number collection, 19:30 official opening, 20:00 1 km family, children’s and pets’ run, 21:30 5 km and 10 km runs. Participants can enjoy music, prizes for the fastest runners, a variety of activities, and delicious food. The event programme includes various distances and activities, and participants receive medals and prizes.

name: CJ Schmidt Hafentagelauf
description: The CJ Schmidt Harbour Day Run takes place in Husum, a city on the North Sea in Schleswig-Holstein, as part of the Husum Harbour Days festival. The event offers flat road races over various distances, including children’s and youth races, a 5 km race, a 10 km race, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. There is also the Husum Corporate Cup, in which company teams of four compete. The course runs through the city centre and along the harbour, combining urban streets with waterfront paths, accompanied by the fresh North Sea breeze.
course_highlights: Flat road races through Husum’s city centre and harbour
Course along the North Sea coast with a fresh sea breeze
A range of distances for children, young people and relay teams
additional: The organiser is Husumer Sportverein seit 1875 e.V. Timing is provided by Race Result, and registration is managed by LAV Husum. Typical August weather in Husum is around 25 °C, with mostly sunny days and average precipitation of 60 mm. The event also includes team and corporate races as well as family races, with a festive atmosphere in the harbour area. August weather is usually sunny, at around 25°C.

name: Volkslauf um den Mittelpunkt Deutschlands
description: The Volkslauf around the Center of Germany is a sporting event in Krebeck, suitable for young and old alike, as well as both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers various running and walking routes with varied elevation profiles, some of which are challenging and follow paved or asphalt paths. The races start and finish at the Krebeck sports field, and all participants receive fruit and drinks during and after the competition. Medals and prizes are awarded to the top finishers, and there are age-group rankings and on-site medical support.

name: Volkslauf um den Auesee
description: The course follows paved and partly asphalted paths around Auesee and is almost flat, with no significant elevation changes. The race is part of a popular regional running series with a total of nine events. It is organized by ATSV Espelkamp, which ensures a well-organized event and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
location: Śliwice, Tuchola County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny is a unique timed race held in Koszalin at Górka Piaskowa. Participants compete on a challenging, approximately 1-kilometre loop through hilly forest terrain with sandy sections. The race lasts exactly 1 hour, during which runners can complete as many laps as they wish; the winner is the runner who completes the most. At the finish, unique, very heavy medals await, along with a barbecue and bonfire, creating a friendly, sociable atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 1 km loop through challenging, hilly forest terrain
Varied surface with sandy sections
Challenging uphill sections and numerous elevation changes
additional: Start and finish at Górka Piaskowa in Koszalin. Electronic chip timing. Participants receive a race bib and safety pins. Drinks and medical support from the Polish Red Cross in Koszalin are available at the finish. After the race, refreshments include grilled sausage, sweet rolls, and a bonfire. Participant limit: 100. Entry is open to participants aged 18 and over with a current medical examination or a declaration.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a series of races that have promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate both sporting competition and the beauty of their surroundings. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the UAM Botanical Garden
Picturesque green spaces and natural surroundings
Alternative location by Lake Rusałka, 500 m from the start
additional: Race packs can be collected by an authorised representative. The organisers place particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of the proposed race locations. This summer marks the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka.

name: Złota Dycha
description: Złota Dycha is a road race held in Złotoryja, with distances of 5 and 10 kilometres. The course consists of 2.5 km loops, which participants complete twice or four times, respectively. The race is challenging, with a gently undulating course profile, and water stations along the route help participants stay hydrated during the race. After the event, the top runners in various categories are presented with awards. The event attracts runners from across the region and is organised with participants’ comfort and safety in mind.
course_highlights: The course consists of 2.5 km loops
Two distances: 5 km (2 loops) and 10 km (4 loops)
Water stations along the route: 4 on the 5 km course and 8 on the 10 km course
additional: The Race Office is open from 7:00 to 9:30 at the fountain of Delfin on ul. Rynek. Participant limit: 100 places for the 5 km race and 200 for the 10 km race, for a total of 300 participants. Each participant receives a race bib with a chip, a mini race pack, a commemorative medal and a post-race meal. Time limits: 60 minutes for 5 km and 105 minutes for 10 km. The awards ceremony for the top runners will take place after 12:00.

name: Kullamilen
organizer: Höganäs Friidrott tillsammans med lokala föreningar
description: Kullamilen är en årlig motionsfest på Kullahalvön som välkomnar löpare, joggare och gående i alla åldrar och nivåer. Loppen startar och slutar vid friidrottsarenan i Höganäs och erbjuder distanser för barn och ungdomar på 2,4 km, samt 5 km och 10 km för motionärer och tävlingslöpare. Banorna går till stor del längs havet med vacker kustutsikt och är sanktionerade av Skånes Friidrottsförbund. Evenemanget präglas av gemenskap, glada funktionärer och en trivsam atmosfär där rörelseglädjen står i centrum.
course_highlights: 10 km banan följer stora delar av Kullahalvöns kust med havsutsikt
5 km och 10 km banorna går på asfalt och grus med markeringar och funktionärer
Barn- och ungdomsloppen går på friidrottsbanan, 6 varv på 400-metersbanan
additional: Efteranmälan kan göras på tävlingsdagen mellan 09.30 och 11.30 vid sekretariatet på friidrottsarenan och senast 30 minuter före den egna starten. Nummerlappar hämtas från kl. 09.30 på tävlingsdagen. Vätskestationer finns vid cirka 3,5 km, 6,2 km och vid mål. Medalj till alla deltagare och prisutdelning sker för de snabbaste på 5 km och 10 km. 10 km erbjuds i både tävlings- och motionsklass. Veteranernas tävlingsklasser ingår i Skånska veterancupen.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.kullamilen.se/kullamilen-2027-preliminart-sondagen-den-8-augusti/): 2027-08-08 — "Vi siktar preliminärt på söndagen den 8 augusti 2027. Sanktion är sökt men datumet är ännu inte slutligt bekräftat." (was estimated 2027-08-08)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Vi siktar preliminärt på söndagen den 8 augusti 2027. Sanktion är sökt men datumet är ännu inte slutligt bekräftat.

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, Østmarka halvmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dagsbillett SOLO Deltakere kr 332,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Dagsbillett SOLO Deltakere kr 475,00 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%)

description: Østmarka Half Marathon is part of the Oslo Running Festival and offers an exceptional nature experience through some of the most beautiful areas of Oslomarka. The race follows scenic forest roads through varied terrain and past idyllic lakes, and is suitable both for those looking to run a good time and for those who want to enjoy a fantastic day outdoors in the forest. This is the first-ever half marathon in the Oslo Running Festival, with a mass start on August 8 at 11:00 at Rustadsaga Sportsstue in Oslo.
course_highlights: Course through beautiful areas of Oslomarka
Scenic forest roads and varied terrain
Idyllic lakes and nature experiences all the way to the finish
additional: Race bibs can be collected from Löplabbet Oslo sentrum from April 7. The same race bib is used throughout the series. A new race bib can be purchased for 75 kr. Courses will only be marked for the mass start. GPX files and Strava links for the course are available to download. Registration is binding, with no refunds or transfer of race bibs. The race can be completed during the festival period from July 30 to August 8; the mass start is on August 8 at 11:00. Early-bird prices are listed and may increase on January 1.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a simple, fast race event at Ås School in Eidsvoll, featuring a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop. The event offers seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon, and helps runners achieve fast times with a dedicated nutrition table along the course. Race bibs are collected using self-service at the venue, which has free parking, changing rooms and toilets. The race is known for its great atmosphere and the many runners who set personal records; it is a tradition to ring the bell at the finish to celebrate a new PB.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap
Venue at Ås School with free parking, changing rooms and toilets
additional: Race bibs are collected using self-service approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. The race has a dedicated nutrition table where runners can leave their own bottles and gels. At selected races, ninth-graders from Feiring School staff an official drinks station, which also raises money for their school trip. It is a tradition to ring the bell at the finish area to celebrate a new personal record. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Registration is via RaceDays; half-marathon runners can arrange their own drinks and nutrition.

name: Perseløpet ¤6 - 2027
description: Perseløpet is a race in Eidsvoll, starting and finishing at Ås School in Hammerås. The event features a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop and offers seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, designed for fast times. Participants can set up their own nutrition table, which they pass on every lap, making it easy to access their own supplies without the logistics of an aid station. The event has a friendly atmosphere, where personal records are celebrated with a bell near the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km
Personal nutrition table passed on every lap
additional: Race bibs are collected by self-service at Ås School approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, 9th-grade students from Feiring School staff an official drinks station that also raises money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area around Ås School. Race bibs are collected by self-service at the school from around two hours before the start. Runners can have their own nutrition table.

name: VI Ilgų nuotolių bėgiko Piotro Silkino jubiliejinis 85-mečio bėgimas
location: Kretingos Vasaros estrada, Maironio g. 15, Kretinga, Lithuania
description: The 85th-birthday run of long-distance runner Piotr Silkin is a traditional race held at Kretinga Summer Amphitheatre. The competition follows a lap format, with marathon participants completing one 2.2 km lap and twelve 3.3 km laps. The event celebrates longtime runner Piotr Silkin and attracts running enthusiasts from various places. Participants can enjoy both athletic competition and a welcoming community atmosphere.
course_highlights: The marathon course consists of 1 lap of 2.2 km and 12 laps of 3.3 km each
The competition takes place at Kretinga Summer Amphitheatre
The lap format lets spectators follow the race and support the participants
additional: Various distances and age groups will be offered at the event; results will be published, and registration is online.

name: Brunnenlauf
location: Iburg-Stadion, Bad Driburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bad Driburg Brunnenlauf is an annual running event organized by TV "Jahn" Bad Driburg e.V., welcoming runners of all ages. The challenging course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa park and the town, and finishes at Iburg Stadium. The event emphasizes fairness and sportsmanship and uses reusable-chip timing. Registration is online only; late entries are not possible.
course_highlights: Challenging out-and-back course with hills
The course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa park and the town
Finish at Iburg Stadium, Bad Driburg
additional: Timing is exclusively with the reusable chip from race result, worn on the foot with a chip strap. The chip deposit is 10€ and is refunded when the chip is returned. Participants may be disqualified for violations of fairness and good conduct. Online registration only; no late entries. Participation from age 18; children and students are free.

name: Diekseelauf
description: Der Diekseelauf ist ein beliebter Volkslauf rund um den Dieksee in Bad Malente-Gremsmühlen. Die Hauptstrecke umfasst 11,5 km und führt gegen den Uhrzeigersinn um den See herum durch malerische Orte wie Hafkamp, Timmdorf und Niederkleveez. Zusätzlich gibt es einen Jedermannlauf über 5 km sowie einen Kinderlauf über 1,5 km. Die Veranstaltung bietet auch Walking- und Wandermöglichkeiten und ist für Läufer aller Altersklassen geeignet. Für das leibliche Wohl und die Sicherheit der Teilnehmer ist mit Getränken, Sanitätsdienst und Umkleidemöglichkeiten gesorgt.
course_highlights: 11,5 km Rundkurs gegen den Uhrzeigersinn um den Dieksee
Strecke führt durch Hafkamp, Timmdorf, Niederkleveez und den Holm
Getränkeposten nach 5,5 km in Timmdorf
additional: Startunterlagenausgabe ab 8:30 Uhr. Nachmeldungen sind bis 30 Minuten vor dem Start möglich gegen eine Nachmeldegebühr von 4,00 € per Barzahlung via QR-Code. Zeitmessung erfolgt elektronisch mit Transponder in der Startnummer. Siegerehrungen ab ca. 12:00 Uhr. Toiletten, Umkleidezelt und Duschmöglichkeit im Sport- und Bildungszentrum vorhanden. Urkunden für alle Kinderläufer, Preise für die besten Teilnehmer in den verschiedenen Kategorien.

name: v-office-Europalauf
description: The 39th vOffice Europalauf is an international race connecting the Baltic seaside resorts of Neustadt, Pelzerhaken and Rettin along the half-marathon course. The route offers wonderful views across Neustädter Bucht and follows the beach promenade back to Neustadt, parallel to the beach. In addition to the half marathon, there are races over 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km, as well as a Bambini race. The event is a popular sporting event in the region and is organized by TSV Neustadt.

name: Stomperudkarusellen- løp nr 3
location: Stomperud Stadion, Lørenvegen 2, Sørum, Lillestrøm, Norway
price_range: Enkeltløp: 220 kr for voksne og 110 kr for barn, med lisens i tillegg
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a long-established series of races organized by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races with varying distances from 800 meters to 9 kilometers, including shorter options for children and young people. The races take place in scenic surroundings, with the start and finish at Stomperud Stadion and nearby areas. Participants use the same race number throughout the series, and the event is open to both adults and children. Children who are members of Sørum IL can take part for free when they register.
course_highlights: Race 3: Lysløypa, 6 km with a shorter option
Start and finish at Stomperud Stadion, Lørenvegen 2, Sørum
Varied terrain with gravel roads, trails, and an athletics track for shorter distances
additional: Participants use the same race number in all races in the series. Children who are members of Sørum IL can take part for free if they register no later than one week before race day. The races have shorter options for the youngest participants. Start locations vary between Sørum Skole and Stomperud Stadion depending on the race. Race no. 3 meets at Stomperud Stadion, Lørenvegen 2, Sørum. The prices listed by the organizer apply to 2026.

name: Stomperudkarusellen 2027. Bare løp 3 (Lysløypa)
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a long-running race series organized by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races of varying distances, including the 6 km Lysløypa, which is part of this year’s Race 3. The races are suitable for both adults and children, with shorter options for the youngest participants. Participants use the same bib number for all the races, and events take place at Stomperud Stadion and in nearby areas of Sørum.
course_highlights: Race 3 Lysløypa: 6 km, with a shorter 500 m option
Traditional routes in the local area around Stomperud Stadion
Shorter distances for children and young people
additional: Children who are members of Sørum IL can participate for free if they register no later than one week before race day. The races offer shorter options for the youngest participants. Events take place at Stomperud Stadion and in nearby areas with a well-maintained network of walking trails and running routes. The prices and race dates listed on the organizer’s website apply to 2026 and do not confirm a 2027 edition. In 2026, participants use the same bib number for all races in the series.

name: Sommerkarusell Ålesund - 3. løp
location: Vestenden av Lillevatnet, Spjelkavik, Ålesund, Norway
description: The Summer Series in Ålesund is a long-running race series organized by Ålesundløpene. The races take place in scenic surroundings by Lillevatnet and Brusdalsvatnet in Vasstranda, on relatively flat, paved courses measured by Kondis. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, starting from the western end of Lillevatnet in Spjelkavik. The series has its own prizes and awards a medal to those who take part in multiple races, attracting both recreational runners and competitive runners.
course_highlights: The courses run along Lillevatnet and Brusdalsvatnet in Vasstranda
Relatively flat paved courses with little traffic
Measured 5 km and 10 km distances
additional: The 10 km starts at 18:00 and the 5 km at 18:05. The races have their own prizes, with gift prizes awarded after each race. Participants who complete 2 or 3 races in the series receive a medal at the final race. Course records for both the 5 km and 10 km distances are documented. The participation record is 132 finishers. Distances: 5 km and 10 km. Registration is through EQ Timing. Participants who complete two or three races receive a medal at the final race.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 VI etapp 1000m
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage VI (1000 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is open to everyone interested in running. The series includes different distances and age groups, with participants earning points and winners determined by age group. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners. Registration is primarily available in advance, and on-site registration is possible until 18:30. The series winners will be awarded after the final race. To place among the prize winners, participants must take part in at least four stages.

name: Filter Temposari (5. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time-trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or roller skating. The stages take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring individual-start speed races. The races are short and intense, suitable for both recreational and advanced participants. The series also includes the Kullapada prize programme, which rewards consistent participation in every stage over the same distance.

name: 14. ETAPP / Järve terviserada
description: 14th STAGE / The Järve health trail is a 10-stage relay race around Lake Viljandi, held on varied terrain and a health trail with different surface types. Teams consist of 10 members, with an equal number of women and men, who take turns running the different stages. The start and finish are at Viljandi City Stadium, and runners are taken to the stages on buses provided by the organizers. The race is part of the tradition of the Suurjooks ümber Viljandi järve and offers a sporting experience for schools, companies, and sports clubs.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 4 etapas
description: The Jonava Running Cup is a traditional running series held in Jonava District to promote sport and physical activity. The competition is open to all runners, who can compete in different stages and age groups. Participants earn points at each stage toward the overall standings, while the courses run through various locations in Jonava District, offering an interesting and varied running experience. Registration is online, and race numbers are collected at the start venue on race day.
course_highlights: Stages take place in various locations in Jonava District: Šilai–Jaugeliškiai, Ragožiai, Juškonys, Salupiai–Bartoniai, Jonava
The start time for each stage is 19:30
Race numbers can be collected at the start venue on race day from 18:30 to 19:20
additional: Participants register separately for each stage. Participation is free. The courses may cross roads open to traffic, so participants must follow traffic rules. Registration deadlines vary by stage; race numbers are collected at the start venue on race day. Registration is online, the races take place in various locations in Jonava District, and participants are divided into age groups.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 5. etapp
location: Viljandi Lake Health and Ski Trail, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 5th stage of the Joosu Lake Run series is a running race organized by the Joosu sports club. It takes place on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy beautiful lake views and varied terrain. It is a great opportunity for both recreational and experienced runners to take part in a friendly and supportive environment.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lake views along the route
Varied terrain suitable for runners

name: Vetlanda Citylopp

price_tiers.distance: Dam, herr och motion (5 km och 10 km)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dam-, herr- och motionsklassen (10 km och 5 km)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kids F8/P8 - F12/P12 (1 km till 1,7 km) och Funkis (1 km)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Föreningar kan anmäla i F/P8-F/P12 samt Junior 5km

description: Vetlanda Citylopp är ett välkomnande stadsnära lopp som passar alla åldrar och nivåer. Start och mål är på Storgatan mitt i Vetlanda, och deltagarna kan välja mellan 5 km och 10 km på en lättlöpt och publikvänlig varvbana. För de yngre finns kortare distanser från 400 meter upp till 1,7 km. Evenemanget är en folkfest med aktiviteter och matservering på torget, där både löpare och åskådare kan njuta av en härlig dag tillsammans.
course_highlights: Lättlöpt varvbana i centrala Vetlanda
Start och mål på Storgatan mitt i stan
Publikvänligt med aktiviteter och matservering på torget
additional: Nummerlappsuthämtning och efteranmälan sker på Stortorget från kl. 12:00 på tävlingsdagen. Efteranmälan kan göras senast 30 minuter före start för respektive klass. Tidtagning sker med chip i nummerlappen och resultat publiceras live och på OK Njudungs hemsida. Omklädning och dusch finns i idrottshallen Hövdingen nära start/mål. Tidigare upplägg har omfattat barn- och ungdomsklasser samt en Funkis-klass. Tävlingsdagens nummerlappsutdelning, efteranmälan och aktiviteter har tidigare hållits på Stortorget.

name: BAMM
description: BAMM supported by OMM är ett tvådagars ultramaraton i arktisk fjällmiljö där deltagarna tävlar i par med bergsorientering i obanad terräng över stora områden. Tävlingen erbjuder flera klasser med olika svårighetsgrader och distanser, vilket gör den tillgänglig för både nybörjare och erfarna äventyrare. Under tävlingsdagarna får deltagarna uppleva spektakulära fjällmiljöer och utmanande navigering, med övernattning på fjället. BAMM är en unik möjlighet att kombinera fysisk utmaning med naturupplevelse i en av Sveriges mest natursköna miljöer.
course_highlights: Bergsorientering i obanad terräng
Tvådagars tävling med övernattning på fjället
Arktisk fjällmiljö med stora områden att navigera
additional: Deltagare tävlar i par (herr, dam eller mixlag). Transfer erbjuds från Kiruna flygplats till Hotell Riksgränsen och tillbaka, med anpassade tider efter flygavgångar. Tågstationen i Riksgränsen ligger nära hotellet. Boende, utrustningshyra, mat och praktisk information finns tillgängligt via arrangörens webbplats. Tävlingen genomförs i tvåmannalag. Obligatorisk utrustning ingår i förberedelserna; för BAMM 30 transporteras tält och sovsäck till det gemensamma nattlägret. OMM är huvudsponsor.

name: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt 7. løp
description: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt is an annual recreational race organised by Osterøy I.L. Friidrett. The race takes place in Valestrand and covers a distance of 4.4 km. It is a social and inclusive event, with evening start times for walkers and the main field. Traditionally, sveler, cordial and prizes are served, and course records are rewarded with cash prizes from HTB.
course_highlights: A 4.4 km course in Valestrand
Start times: 18:45 for walkers and 19:00 for the main field
Course records are rewarded with NOK 3,000
additional: Start times are 18:45 for walkers and 19:00 for the main field. Times in the walking field are recorded as 30 minutes or more. Traditionally, sveler from Toro, cordial from Saftsuse and prizes from Extra Valestrand are provided. The race is part of a series of races held throughout the year, including a Christmas race and a New Year’s race. Registration takes place at Furubakken sports ground, and payment can be made via Vipps 121337 or to account 3632.54.56676. In 2026, the start times were 18:45 and 19:00, with payment via Vipps. Participants received sveler, cordial and prizes.

name: Happy 24 hours 2027
description: Happy 24 Hours 2027 is an ultrarunning event held at Lersbrygga sports facility in Sande in cooperation with IL Sandvin. The race takes place on a 400-metre tartan track and offers three distances: 24-hour, 12-hour and 6-hour races. It starts on Friday evening and finishes on Saturday evening, with the running direction reversed every six hours. Everyone who completes at least one lap receives a medal, and buckets are awarded to the winners of the women’s and men’s categories.
course_highlights: 400-metre tartan track
Running direction reversed every six hours
Race held at Lersbrygga sports facility in Sande
additional: The final distance will be measured precisely at 21:00 on Saturday, 14 August. The organizer will provide cola, crisps and chocolate. There is space for drinks and food inside the track. The race may be cancelled or postponed due to force majeure, with no refund of the entry fee.

name: Geilo Trail Run
description: Geilo Trail Run offers a spectacular mountain-running experience with distances of 16K, 30K and marathon (42K), as well as a separate children’s race. The courses feature a great combination of flowing trails, technical terrain and challenging climbs in the beautiful surroundings of Geilo. The start and finish are at Vestlia Resort, and the race includes several aid stations along the way. The event has a great atmosphere, with social activities, an awards ceremony and an after-run party, and is suitable for both experienced and new trail runners.
course_highlights: The courses start by Ustedalsfjorden, with scenic views of Hardangervidda
Varied terrain with flowing trails, technical sections and challenging climbs
Finishes with a fast descent on the ski slopes back to Vestlia Resort
additional: On Friday evening, there is check-in and race bib collection, a social warm-up run and a pre-race pasta buffet at Vestlia Resort. On Saturday, the marathon starts at 08:30, the 30K at 10:30 and the 16K at 11:30. The children’s race (1 km) starts at 14:30. The awards ceremony is held at 16:00, followed by an evening after-run buffet and dancing. Lost property can be collected at the reception at Vestlia Resort.

name: 8. Wisent-RUN
location: Wisentgehege Springe, Springe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wisent-RUN is a popular race at Wisentgehege Springe, taking place for the eighth time. The event offers various race distances, including children’s races and timed competitions, set in a natural environment. With a family-friendly atmosphere and free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00, the race is a sporting highlight for all ages. The event is organised by VfV Concordia Alvesrode e.V. and is known for its welcoming atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Köhlerhütte in Wisentgehege Springe
Race routes through the natural surroundings of Wisentgehege
Timed children’s races and an awards ceremony
additional: Free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00. The 500 m children’s race, “Frischlingsrennen”, is untimed and for children born in 2021 or later. The 1 km children’s race is timed and includes an awards ceremony, for children born from 2016 to 2021. Ample parking is available. The event is open to everyone, with free admission for visitors. It offers an opportunity to explore the wildlife at Wisentgehege while also being active.

name: 24. Dammer Stadtlauf
description: The 24th Damme City Run is an evening road race through the center of Damme, organized by OSC Damme in cooperation with the City of Damme. The program includes three starts: a schoolchildren’s race, a general race for all participants, and the main evening race. After a two-year pandemic-related break, the race returns with an expected field of over 500 runners. The event is characterized by an open, local atmosphere, with on-site registration available, as runners fill the streets of the town center.
course_highlights: Evening road race through Damme city center
Three starts: schoolchildren’s race, general race, and main race
The course stays in the city center, with a lively atmosphere
additional: On-site registration is available, encouraging open, local participation. August weather is typically sunny, with temperatures between 14 and 25 °C. The event includes several categories, including children’s races and the main race, on a route through the city, with a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere.

name: 24. Knesebecker Einhornlauf
description: The Knesebeck Unicorn Run is a long-standing running event in the Isenhagen region, held annually in August. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on varied courses. Online registration is available through the RaceResult platform, where all results and certificates can also be accessed. The run takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Wittingen and attracts numerous running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Nordic walking option
Event held on the school grounds in Knesebeck
additional: Registration is online through RaceResult. The run takes place on Friday evening. Participation is limited to 100 people; registration and results are available online; the event takes place on the school grounds in Knesebeck.

name: 17. VSB Dresdner Nachtlauf
description: The VSB Dresden Night Run offers a beautifully illuminated route with views of the Dresden skyline. Torches and glow sticks create a special atmosphere. The 11.5 km route follows the Elbe to the Blue Wonder and returns along the Neustadt side of the river, while the 6.2 km route also runs along the Elbe and crosses the Albert Bridge to the finish. Alongside the sporting experience, there are children’s races and a special team competition for clubs and organizations. The event takes place at Heinz-Steyer-Stadion and is a highlight of the region’s running calendar.

name: 35. Speller Sparkassen-Sommernachtslauf
description: The 35th Speller Sparkassen Summer Night Run is a traditional race in Spelle, organized by SC Spelle-Venhaus. The event offers runners an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of Wählehof. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels and takes place in a relaxed atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Tavelsjö Halvmarathon
location: Tavelsjö Church, Tavelsjö, Umeå Municipality, Sverige
description: Tavelsjö Halvmarathon är ett familjevänligt löpararrangemang som erbjuder lopp för både vuxna och barn. Halvmarathonloppet startar och slutar vid kyrkan i Tavelsjö och är ett populärt mål för sommarträning. För barn finns ett Mini-lopp och ett ungdomslopp med tidtagning, vilket gör evenemanget till en fest för hela familjen. Alla deltagare får medalj och något gott efter målgång, och det finns även utlottningar av priser.
course_highlights: Halvmarathon med start och mål vid Tavelsjö kyrka
Ungdomslopp på 2,2 km med tidtagning
Barnlopp (Mini) som är populärt för hela familjen
additional: Ungdomsloppet startar kl 10:00 och är öppet för ungdomar 8-17 år. Föräldrar får gärna hjälpa barn som behöver stöd under ungdomsloppet. Presentkort finns att köpa som gåva och levereras inom en vecka efter beställning.

name: Midnattsloppet Stockholm
description: Midnattsloppet Stockholm är ett klassiskt nattlopp som arrangeras den 14 augusti 2027 med start på kvällen. Loppet erbjuder distanserna 10 km och 5 km, där deltagarna springer genom Södermalms pulserande gator i en festlig atmosfär fylld av musik, jubel och gemenskap. Förutom huvudloppen finns även maskeradklass och barnlopp, vilket gör evenemanget till en folkfest för alla åldrar. Midnattsloppet är känt för sin unika sena starttid och den speciella stämning som skapas mellan löpare, publik och funktionärer.
course_highlights: Originalbanan runt Södermalm i Stockholm
Start på kvällen med en unik nattloppstämning
Festlig atmosfär med musik och publikjubel längs banan
additional: Starttider varierar per lopp: Mini-loppet (300 m) startar mellan 11:45 och 15:30, barnlopp 2 km startar 18:30 och 18:50, 10 km startar 21:10, 5 km startar 21:40 och maskeradklassen startar 22:00. Företagslopp och lagtävlingar erbjuds för att stärka gemenskap och företagshälsa. Midnattsloppet arrangeras av Midnattsloppet Nordic AB, ett helägt bolag av Hammarby IF Friidrott, och överskottet går tillbaka till idrottsföreningarna.

name: 6 sjöar
description: 6 sjöar är ett lopp som går genom de vackra skogarna en bit utanför Uppsala. Du springer främst på små skogsvägar, med kortare sträckor av trail. Alla distanser rundar minst en sjö, men springer du hela marathonsträckan tar du dig runt 6 sjöar. Med miljön i åtanke ordnar vi gratis busstransport av löpare från Uppsala centralstation till starten i Fjällnora, och tillbaka efter loppet. Loppet är också fritt från engångsmuggar, i stället får varje löpare en återanvändbar mugg.

Flygfoto över sjöar och skog som kan relatera till 6 sjöar-loppet.
