name: ÅRC x Copperhill loop!
description:
Välkommen till vårt spännande Åre Run Club x Copperhill loop!

Den 14 augusti samlas löpare av alla nivåer för att bemästra Copperhill backen. Här kan du välja din egen sträcka – 5, 10, 15 eller 20 km – och du bestämmer själv hur många vändor du vill ta innan du korsar mållinjen! Vi tror på att alla ska kunna delta och njuta av denna fantastiska upplevelse tillsammans. Följ med oss på en oförglömlig löparfest, oavsett om du är nybörjare eller erfaren. Låt oss tillsammans skapa magiska löpminnen!

images.alt_text: Löpare i regn under Åre Run Club x Copperhill loop-loppet vid startlinjen

name: Bluesløpet
description: Bluesløpet is a running organization that arranges road races in Notodden, Telemark. The race has strong local roots and offers various distances for both children and adults. The event is known for combining the joy of running with a welcoming atmosphere in the town. It is a popular race among local runners and visitors looking for an active experience in Notodden.
course_highlights: Road races in central Notodden
Various distances, including a children’s race
Races in the scenic surroundings of Telemark
additional: Also organizes a children’s race called Teddy’s barneløp. The races are held in Notodden and nearby areas such as Heddal. Previous editions have included 5 km, 10 km, and a children’s race.

name: Bringebærløpet 2027
description: The Raspberry Run in Vollen is a family-friendly race offering distances for all ages and ability levels. The start and finish are at Vollenhallen, and the course runs through a scenic area, with only minor changes from previous years. The youngest participants run one lap of approximately 1 km on the roller-ski track, while older participants run 2.5 km or 5 km. The event focuses on participation and enjoyable sporting experiences, and you can also take part in the Raspberry Festival held alongside the race.
course_highlights: The course follows the roller-ski track at Arnestad through scenic surroundings
A children’s race of approximately 1 km for the youngest participants
A 2.5 km and 5 km race course with a mass start
additional: Schedule: 11:00 — bib pickup opens; 13:00 — mass start for 5 km; 13:30 — mass start for 2.5 km; 14:00 — start of the 1 km children’s race, with multiple starts; 15:00 — prize ceremony for competition classes aged 11 and up. The listed distances and start/finish area apply to the 2026 edition.

name: Pyttane Opp
description: Pyttane Opp is an uphill race on Sotra, running from Stølane at Ekerhovd to the radar dome at Pyttane. The race is 2.8 km long with 290 metres of elevation gain on asphalt, surrounded by beautiful scenery and offering a great view of all of Sotra from the top. There are two categories: the Recreational category for anyone who wants to reach the top without time pressure, and Paxon Elite, the competitive category with separate women’s and men’s divisions. The race is organized by the athletics group at Sotra Sportsklubb and welcomes everyone to enjoy a great running experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 2.8 km uphill race on asphalt
290 metres of elevation gain from Stølane to the radar dome at Pyttane
Great view of all of Sotra from the top
additional: Recreational category starts at 15:00; Paxon Elite starts at 16:00. Parking is limited, and if participation is high, a shuttle bus will run from Straume. Participants can leave their bags in the start area and collect them in the finish area at the top. The map and program will be published as they become available.

name: Hylja Vertikal 600
location: Lalm samfunnshus, Lalm, Vågå, Innlandet, Norway
description: Hylja Vertikal 600 is a vertical race event held in Lalm, Norway, organized by Lalm Idrettslag and Jotunfjell alpakka - Hylja Lodge. The race challenges participants with a steep ascent, offering a unique and demanding mountain running experience. It attracts local athletes and outdoor enthusiasts who enjoy testing their endurance and climbing skills in a scenic alpine environment.
course_highlights: Steep vertical climb with 600 meters elevation gain
Mountain terrain around Lalm
Organized by local sports club Lalm Idrettslag
additional: Previous editions have had a non-timed recreational class and a competitive class. The children's race, Hylja Horisontal, has had several distances for different age groups.

name: Grue Backyard 2027
description: Grue Backyard is a unique endurance race featuring 6.7 km loops through technical forest terrain. The race starts a new wave every hour, continuing until only one runner remains standing. Participants can complete one loop to earn a medal or push further for the finisher cap and the win. The event also includes the Grue Half Marathon, known as one of Norway's fastest half marathon courses, and the Gruemila 10 km race.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loops through technical forest terrain
New start every hour until one runner remains
Flat and fast 21.1 km half marathon course
additional: The race features hourly starts for the backyard loops, with medals awarded for completing one loop and a finisher cap for those who continue until the end. Previous editions have had up to 12 rounds, and participants who complete at least seven rounds have been able to receive a Grue Backyard Ultra Finisher T-shirt.

name: Ringeriksmaraton
description: Ringeriksmaraton is an annual running festival that began in 1995 and has grown to become Norway’s largest marathon relay. The race runs through the beautiful municipalities of Hole, Ringerike and Jevnaker, and offers distances and categories for everyone, including 8-person and 4-person relays, a pair marathon, half marathon and marathon. The event attracts recreational runners from all over the country and offers a sociable, active experience in beautiful surroundings. Children’s Ringeriksmaraton is also a popular part of the event, making it a family-friendly occasion.
course_highlights: The course runs through the municipalities of Hole, Ringerike and Jevnaker
Beautiful natural scenery, including Norway’s largest apple orchard
Varied terrain with asphalt, footpaths, forest roads and residential areas
additional: A mass start for all categories at Vik at 11:00, with an early start at 10:00 for runners using technical aids or with a finish time over 5 hours. Drink stations with squash and water at each relay exchange, as well as a muesli bar with salt at exchanges 3 and 6 for the half marathon and marathon. Toilets are available at several locations, but there are no shower facilities at Jevnakerhallen due to renovation. Løperbanken makes it possible to find a team if you are missing teammates. Race numbers and relay batons are handed out together. Registration is final, with no refund if you withdraw. Course maps, GPX files and practical information are available on the organizer’s website.

name: Bergen Skogsmaraton - Maratonkarusellen
description: Bergen Forest Marathon is an annual forest race held in Hordnesskogen, with the start and finish at the parking lot. The race features a loop of approximately 5.3 km, run multiple times depending on the distance: 8 laps for the marathon, 4 for the half marathon, and 2 for the 10 km. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners, offering a wonderful nature experience in the forest and good facilities, including changing rooms, water stations, and food in the finish area. The focus is on enjoyment and quality for all participants.
course_highlights: Loop course in Hordnesskogen, starting and finishing at the parking lot
Each lap is approximately 5.3 km long
Two water stations, passed three times per lap
additional: Race headquarters opens at 08:00 for race-number collection and bag drop. Start times: 10 km at 09:00, marathon at 10:00, half marathon at 11:00. Food and drink for everyone who finishes. Changing rooms and toilets are at Bjarghallen, approximately 250 metres from the start. Parking is available at Bjarghallen, but capacity is limited; public transport or carpooling is recommended. Clothing can be stored in a tent in the start area at your own risk. Late registration is possible up to the start, subject to availability. The start and finish are at the parking lot in Hordnesskogen. Bjarghallen is approximately 250 metres from the start. Registration is through EQ Timing, and late registration is possible up to the start if places are available.

name: Bekkjavatnet Opp
organizer: Ytre Hafstad Kreativ HUB og Førde IL
description: Bekkjavatnet Opp is a short, steep uphill race by Bekkjevatnet in Førde. The race follows a popular local hiking trail where participants can compete against friends. The event has attracted a large turnout and has been combined with activities and a gathering at Flatene School.
course_highlights: Short, steep uphill course by Bekkjevatnet
Local hiking trail in Førde
Winning times under ten minutes have been reported for a previous edition
additional: Previous editions have featured food sales, activities for all ages and a prize-giving ceremony, with Flatene School as the gathering place. Førde IL has handled registration and timing.

name: Trysilmila
description: Trysilmila is a trail race held in Østby in Trysil, suitable for both children and adults. The race offers varied terrain and beautiful scenery, and largely follows the Trysil Skimaraton course. It is a social and inclusive race day focused on the joy of running and a great atmosphere, with separate children’s races over suitable distances. All participants receive a finisher’s medal, and prizes are awarded in both the children’s race and the main races.
course_highlights: Varied surfaces, including gravel (approx. 3.5 km), trail and forest road (approx. 6.5 km), and some asphalt (approx. 200 m) on the 10 km course
Water stations at 3.8 and 7 km on the long course (10 km), and at 3.5 km on the short course (6.5 km)
The course largely follows the Trysil Skimaraton course near Østby
additional: Children’s race start times: 12:00 (ages 0–6, 500 m), 12:05 (ages 7–10, 800 m), 12:10 (ages 11–15, 1.8 km). The short 6.5 km course starts at 12:45 with timing; the long 10 km course starts at 13:00 with timing. The race office, parking and changing rooms are at Østby Samfunnshus near the stadium area. Bib collection and prize-giving take place at the race office on race day. Trysilmila is part of Trysildobbelen together with Trysil Skimaraton, with prizes for combined results.

name: Level-løp
description: Level Løp is a trail race for everyone, held in the beautiful surroundings of Hommersåk. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and 23 km, as well as a 1,000-metre children’s race, with varied terrain and elevation changes to suit both recreational and experienced runners. The race starts at Riska Church and features lovely trails, forest and challenging climbs. After finishing, participants can enjoy hot food and drinks, and prizes are awarded to the top men and women in all the main distances.
course_highlights: A trail race through Hommersåk’s varied and beautiful terrain
23 km with 1,100 metres of elevation gain, 10 km with 246 metres and 5 km with 87 metres
Water stations on the 10 km and 23 km courses
additional: Race bib collection is on Friday 14 August from 15:00 to 19:00 at Amboltveien 9, and on race day from 08:00 at the start area. Race-day registration is available at the start area from 08:00 to 12:45. The children’s race is divided into waves by age. Hot food and drinks are provided to all participants in the 23 km race. A kiosk sells hot food, snacks and drinks. Parking is at Riska Church, not at the start area. Toilets and changing rooms are available at the start/finish. Live results with finish times are available. Prizes are awarded on a rolling basis after runners finish. One prize is drawn at random from the race bib numbers. Scheduled start times are 09:00 for 23 km, 10:00 for 10 km, 10:20 for 5 km and 13:30 for the children’s race. The 10 km and 23 km races are for participants born in 2012 or earlier.

name: Skånevik Skyrace
description: Skånevik Skyrace is a spectacular mountain race on a challenging 24-kilometre circular course with 1,600 metres of elevation gain across varied and technical terrain. The race offers fantastic views of fjords and mountains, combining raw nature with the joy of running for both recreational runners and elite athletes. The start and finish are in Skånevik town centre, where activities create a lively atmosphere both on the course and in town. The event features official timing, several drink stations, and a wide range of participant amenities, including access to a pool, sauna and massage after the race.
course_highlights: 24 km circular course with 1,600 metres of elevation gain
Steep climbs and technical terrain with flowing trail sections
Fantastic panoramic views from Håfjellet (932 m above sea level) and Nepo (610 m above sea level)
additional: Start and finish at Skånevik Fjordhotell, with a Base Camp for race-number collection, information, music, food and a great atmosphere. Three drink stations along the course and several timing checkpoints. Free access to Sjøkanten Trivsel, including a pool, sauna and massage after the race. Minimum age: 16; runners must pass Juraskar by 3:00 p.m. Accommodation is available at Skånevik Fjordhotell and nearby Airbnb properties, camping and boat moorings. Registration for 2027 is sold out, but places may become available in May 2027. The 2027 edition is sold out; any available places may be released in May 2027. Minimum age: 16, and runners must pass Juraskar by 3:00 p.m. Participants receive food and drinks at 3–4 drink stations, a medal and a buff.

name: Kniveåsen Rundt
location: Pumpehuset ved Solumstrand renseanlegg, Drammen, Norway
description: Kniveåsen Rundt is a forest race around Kniveåsen in Drammen that welcomes everyone to participate. The race is free and suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking for an outdoor experience in forest terrain. The event has an inclusive atmosphere and is held annually, offering great opportunities to enjoy running in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Forest race around Kniveåsen in Drammen
Natural terrain with varied surfaces
Suitable for all levels
additional: The race is free to enter. Results from previous years and event videos are available on the website. The race is open to everyone. Registration is linked from the official website.

name: Nordkjosmila 2027
description: Nordkjosmila is a race in Nordkjosbotn, Balsfjord. In 2026, it featured a children’s race and races over 3.33 km and 10 km; the 10 km course was officially measured and approved, with individual timing. The race aims to become one of the region’s best road races.
course_highlights: The 10 km course was officially measured and approved in 2026
A 3.33 km race and a children’s race were offered in 2026
Held in Nordkjosbotn, Balsfjord

name: Budor løpefest 2027
description: Budor løpefest 2027 takes place on Saturday, 14 August, at Budor Gjestegård and offers 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon distances. The event offers an inclusive atmosphere for experienced runners and beginners alike, with the start and finish at Gjestegården. The courses run through scenic surroundings on trails and gravel roads, offering a spectacular running experience with beautiful panoramic views. The event also includes a free children’s race, Koiedalen rundt, with a medal for participants. Prizes are awarded to the three fastest finishers in each category in the 5 km, 10 km and 21 km races.
course_highlights: The courses run mainly on trails and gravel roads through scenic surroundings
Start and finish at Budor Gjestegård, with panoramic views
The half marathon has only 250 places and offers a memorable running experience
additional: Race numbers can be collected between 09:00 and 10:30 at Gjestegården. The half marathon starts at 10:00, the 10 km at 10:30 and the 5 km at 10:40. There are toilets and a few showers in the basement of Gjestegården, as well as the option to swim in Koiedalsvannet near the finish area. The children’s race, Koiedalen rundt, starts at 13:00 and is free. You can sell your race entry by contacting the organiser by email. All distances start and finish at Budor Gjestegård. Listed schedule: half marathon at 10:00, 10 km at 10:30 and 5 km at 10:40. The half marathon has 250 places, and the children’s race, Koiedalen rundt, is free.

name: Backyard ultra Golsfjellet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Backyard Deltakere kr 750,00 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3% transaksjonsgebyr)

description: Backyard Ultra Golsfjellet is a unique trail race with no asphalt, offering participants a full experience of fresh mountain air and scenic surroundings. The race is based at Oset Fjellhotell, which is exclusively booked for the event and filled with runners, supporters, and a great backyard atmosphere throughout the weekend. This is more than just a race; it is also a social weekend experience focused on food and spending time together, with all meals for runners prepared by the hotel’s renowned kitchen. The race is suitable for anyone looking for a challenging and social experience in the mountains.
course_highlights: The race takes place entirely on mountain terrain with no asphalt
Start and finish at Oset Fjellhotell, exclusively booked for the event
Delicious refreshments and food prepared by Oset Fjellhotell’s kitchen during breaks
additional: Race bibs and ankle chips can be collected at Oset Fjellhotell on Friday, August 14, from 19:00 to 21:00 and Saturday, August 15, from 07:30 to 08:30. The entire hotel is booked for the event, and a 20% discount is available for a two-night stay with discount code BYOSET. A pasta party is held on Friday evening and a gala dinner on Saturday evening, but neither is included in registration. A hotel buffet on Saturday evening is available to participants for 495 kr when reserved. Food and drink are central to the race, with easy access to refreshments during breaks. Accommodation and some meals are not included in the entry fee. The 2027 registration is listed with an Early Bird price.

name: Saudehornet Rett Opp 2027
location: Havna i Ørsta sentrum, Ørsta, Norway
description: Saudehornet Rett Opp is an annual uphill race in Ørsta that starts at the harbour in the town centre and climbs to the summit of Saudehornet, 1,303 metres above sea level. The course is 5.7 km long with a challenging climb, attracting amateurs, recreational runners and some professional athletes. The race has a rich history, including John Tvedt’s record run in 2007. It is a challenging and spectacular summit route that can also be hiked when there is no snow on the mountain.
course_highlights: 5.7 km course with 1,303 metres of elevation gain
Starts at the harbour in central Ørsta and finishes at the summit of Saudehornet
Challenging uphill race suitable for recreational and professional runners
additional: The route can be tried as a moderately challenging summit hike when there is no snow. Participants are mainly amateurs and recreational runners, but some professional athletes also take part. The event includes a recreational class and a separate children’s race to Skåla.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 27. Viru-Nigula Rahvajooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 offers a varied series of running and walking events, bringing together fitness enthusiasts and recreational athletes from spring to autumn. The 27th Viru-Nigula People’s Run takes place on the Viru-Nigula running track and in the long-jump pit. It is part of a long-running series that encourages participation across different age groups and distances. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and offer participants the chance to test their abilities. The events are well organized, with chip timing, ensuring participants an enjoyable and motivating running experience.

name: Kuldīgas 22. pusmaratons
description: The Kuldīga Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Kuldīga Municipality, bringing together local and visiting runners. The race takes place amid the scenic surroundings of the town and its nearby area, offering a chance to enjoy both a sporting challenge and beautiful natural views. The event is organized by Kuldīga Municipality Sports School, ensuring professional race management and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.

name: Schierker Sommerlauf
description: The Schierker Summer Run is a traditional race in the Harz, taking place for the 24th time. The event offers varied distances from 1 km to 16 km, running through the impressive landscape around Schierke. Runners enjoy breathtaking views, a unique atmosphere, and great support in the finish area at the Schierker Feuersteinarena. The race is part of the new Harzer Laufcup 2026 and is open to runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Run on paved forest roads, with two laps for the 8 km main race
Breathtaking views of the Brocken and the Harz landscape
Start and finish at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, with a great atmosphere
additional: The start and finish are at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, which has changing rooms and showers. The course follows paved forest roads. There is a refreshment station at the newly built toboggan run. Registration is online, and early registrants receive personalized race numbers. Use of the showers is included in the entry fee. The event is part of the Harzer Laufcup 2026. Courses on paved forest roads, online registration, personalized race numbers, refreshments included, electronic timing, certificates and trophies for the winners.

name: 100MeilenBerlin - Der Mauerweglauf
description: The 100MeilenBerlin – The Wall Trail Run is a historically significant ultramarathon that follows the route of the former Berlin Wall around western Berlin. The course of approximately 161 kilometers runs mostly on paved paths, but also includes trail-like and sometimes uneven sections. The start and finish are at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn-Sportpark in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. The race commemorates the victims of the division of Germany and is held annually, with the running direction alternating.

name: 2. Backyard Ultra-Marathon Tharandter Wald
description: The 2nd Backyard Ultra Marathon in the Tharandt Forest is organized by SC Freital e.V. and takes place in one of Saxony’s most beautiful forest regions. The course is a 6.7 km loop, mostly on forest trails, run alternately clockwise and counterclockwise. The start and finish area is at the Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg. A total of 100 starting places are available, and registration is via RaceResult.

name: 303 Maraton Antoniego Fili
description: The 303 Antoni Fili Marathon is a marathon held in Sztum, Mazowieckie. Runners have access to a training plan tailored to their level, helping them prepare optimally for the race. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to runners of various experience levels. The event takes place annually, and in 2026 it will be held on August 15.
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. The race listing can be managed and marketing partnerships arranged through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz - Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and join a close-knit running community in Wielkopolska and beyond.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The beauty of the proposed locations
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts

name: XII Rozłaziński Bieg po radość z życia
XXXIII Bieg im. Marszałka Józefa Piłsudskiego
Olsokløpet 2027
location: Ålvundeid, Sunndal, Møre og Romsdal, Norway
description: Olsokløpet is an annual race held in Ålvundeid, Møre og Romsdal. The race covers a distance of 9.7 km and starts at 13:00. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men, as well as to class winners, who receive a small prize. The event also includes activities for children in the form of an athletics carousel, and food sales with grilling organised by Ålvundeid Bygdekvinnelag.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Ålvundeid, Møre og Romsdal
Distance: 9.7 km
Activities for children, including an athletics carousel
additional: Prizes are awarded to 1st, 2nd and 3rd place, as well as to class winners. The top three women and men receive 1,000, 500 and 300 kroner, respectively. Food sales and grilling run from 11:00 to 15:00. Previous editions have awarded prizes to the top three and class winners, and included activities for children and food sales/grilling.

name: Rubjerg Knude løbet 2027
distance_verbose: Halvmarathon, 20 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km

name: Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See
location: Kurpark am Kanal, Bad Bederkesa, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See is a running event for participants of all ages and abilities, held on the third Sunday in August in Bad Bederkesa. The course passes through a natural setting and offers a motivating challenge for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The event promotes community and the joy of being active, making it a special experience for both race participants and recreational runners. The start and finish are in Kurpark am Kanal, and timing is by transponder.
course_highlights: Scenic course around Beerster See
Start and finish in Kurpark am Kanal
Free drinks on the opposite side of the lake and at the finish
additional: Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune opposite the castle. Showers are available at the Moortherme upon presentation of your race number. Timing is by transponder, which must be returned after the race. The cut-off time for the main races is 1 hour 45 minutes. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Course distances: 7.6 km; hiking, walking and Nordic walking: 1.1 km, 0.5 km and 14.6 km. Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Timing is by transponder.

name: Wohldenberger Waldlauf
description: The 21st Wohldenberger Forest Run offers runners of all ability levels varied routes through Wohldenberger Forest. For over two decades, this event has been one of the most popular in the Hildesheim region, attracting 200 to 300 participants each year. The course follows natural forest trails with changing surfaces and hilly sections, making it a true trail-running experience. There are suitable distances for beginners, families, walkers, and ambitious runners, from short children’s races to the challenging half marathon.

name: Wolfsburg Staffellauf powered by VfL Wob e.V.
description: The Wolfsburg Relay Race, organized by VfL Wolfsburg e.V., is a special team experience that brings together runners of all ages and backgrounds. This second edition of the relay marathon gives teams from schools, clubs, and companies the chance to enjoy the spirit of sport and teamwork together. The course runs through the green Stadtforst forest, with the start and finish at VW-Bad, where music will also add to the atmosphere. Children’s relay teams are supported by Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V., making participation particularly appealing.

name: Marceliński Bieg Letni 2026
description: Marceliński Summer Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the location’s aesthetic appeal. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural surroundings.

name: XXI Bieg Lesoków
description: The 21st Lesoków Run is an annual race held in Szemud as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event offers two routes, 5 and 10 km long, through the picturesque Kashubian countryside, encouraging participants to enjoy the outdoors. It attracts runners of different ages and experience levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local running culture.

name: Blodomloppet (Jönköping)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lilla Blodomloppet för barn upp till 12 år kostar 100 kr och kan anmälas till denna avgift ända fram tills dagen loppet går.

description: Blodomloppet i Jönköping är ett motionslopp som uppmärksammar den livsviktiga blodgivningen och välkomnar deltagare att gå, jogga eller springa 5 km eller 10 km. Det finns även en barnklass, Lilla Blodomloppet, för barn upp till 12 år med kortare banor. Loppet är en social och friskvårdsaktivitet där lag och individuella deltagare kan delta, och varje lag får en picknick-kasse som en del av startavgiften. Blodomloppet är en del av Sveriges största motionslopp med ett starkt fokus på hälsa och blodgivningens betydelse.
course_highlights: 5 km och 10 km löpning med tidtagning
5 km promenad utan tidtagning
Lilla Blodomloppet för barn upp till 12 år med 400/800 m bana
additional: Lag kan bestå av 3 - 5 deltagare och kan kompletteras med vakanta platser utan extra kostnad fram till 5 augusti via mail. Registrerade blodgivare får 40 kr rabatt vid anmälan. Picknick-kasse från ICA ingår i laganmälan och kan beställas extra för 250 kr/st. Friskvårdsbidrag kan användas via Wellnet, Epassi eller Benify. Lilla Blodomloppet är för barn upp till 12 år med kortare banor på 400/800 meter. Loppet uppmärksammar behovet av blodgivning. Deltagarna kan bilda lag, och det brukar avslutas med picknick.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/jonkoping/): 2027-08-17 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 17 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2027-08-10)

name: Convinistafetten
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sverige
description: Convinistafetten är Sveriges största stafett som arrangeras årligen i Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården i Stockholm. Varje lag består av fem deltagare som springer 5 kilometer var, och det finns även en promenadklass där laget går tillsammans. Evenemanget är en rolig och energifylld kväll som främjar teambuilding och företagsgemenskap. Efter loppet bjuds alla lag på en picknick med mat, dryck, frukt och kaffe i gröngräset. Convinistafetten har en lång tradition sedan 1986 och lockar över 3 000 lag varje år.
course_highlights: Varje lag springer fem sträckor om 5 km vardera
Start och mål vid växlingszonen i Stora Skuggan
Picknick med mat och dryck ingår efter loppet
additional: Stafettlagen startar i tre olika omgångar med första start cirka kl. 17:30. Promenadklassen startar cirka kl. 17:40. Lagledaren får alla nummerlappar hemskickade. Sista löparen hämtar picknicklådan i picknicktältet. Det finns möjlighet att boka extra picknicklådor och egna tältpaket för att förhöja upplevelsen. Titelsponsorn Convini bjuder lagen på picknick efter målgång.

name: Vestfold løpskarusell - 6. løp - Revetal

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 1200 kr. for ikke medlemmer frem til 31.12.26.

description: Vestfold Running Series 2027 is a series of 8 great races in the Tønsberg region, offering the joy of running, a sense of community and a great atmosphere for all levels. Each race has two distances and starts at 18:00, with electronic timing via EQ Timing. Participants can choose to run individual races or buy a season pass for all the races at a discounted price. The courses pass through varied and beautiful surroundings in Vestfold, and course descriptions are shared in a Facebook group and when registering for the season.
course_highlights: Two distances at each race, typically around 3 km and a double lap
Courses pass through varied terrain, including residential areas, lit trails and gravel roads
Start and finish at central locations such as the Sport1 store in Revetal
additional: Season-pass participants collect their race bib at the first race, while participants in individual races collect theirs at the race office 10 minutes before the start. The race bib must be kept for the entire series. Course descriptions and profiles are shared in the Facebook group and when registering for the season. Start at 18:00. Season passes and registration for individual races are available.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Fløymyrløpet
description: Flømyrløpet is the seventh race in the Sørdalskarusellen and has been held since 2001. The start and finish are at Skurvbrua by Nordseterveien, 6 km above Lillehammer. The race offers a tough, wet trail run over challenging terrain, including marshy sections and trails. There are two distances: a 5.4 km long course and a 2.81 km short course. The short course follows the long course up to Flømyra and then heads downhill to the finish. The race has a mass start and a virtual option, and is a traditional part of the Sørdalskarusellen, with a prize ceremony after the race.
course_highlights: A challenging 5.4 km trail run with wet and marshy sections
Start and finish at Skurvbrua, 6 km from Lillehammer city centre
The course follows a ski trail route up to the Flømyra shooting range, then continues along trails and roads back
additional: All mass starts begin at 18:30. The virtual race takes place 15–18 August. The discounted entry deadline is 13:00 on race day; the final entry deadline is 18:00 the same day. The prize ceremony is at approximately 19:15. The under-12 category uses the short course. It is possible to run the short course without timing. The course was adjusted in 2023 to avoid the worst of the marsh. Participants must register their time on My Page under the Self Timing tab. Flømyrløpet is part of the Sørdalskarusellen, a series of ten recreational races in the Lillehammer area. There is a long course of approximately 5.4 km and a short course of approximately 2.8 km.

name: 15. ETAPP / Vabaõhumuuseum
description: The Health Run and Walk is a multi-stage running and walking event held in various parts of Tallinn, including the Estonian Open Air Museum. Each stage offers a chance to enjoy beautiful nature trails and the benefits of recreational sport. The Estonian Open Air Museum stage is 4.2 km long and is well suited to both runners and walkers who want to spend active time outdoors. The event is a tradition and is open to everyone interested in recreational sport.

name: Blodomløpet 2027
organizer: Røde Kors Blodprogram, i samarbeid med Blodbanken Ahus og lokale friidrettslag
description: Blodomløpet is a fun run organized by the Norwegian Red Cross Blood Programme in cooperation with local blood banks and athletics clubs. The event focuses on raising awareness of blood donation and promoting a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog or run 500 metres, 5 km or 10 km, and proceeds from registration go to local athletics clubs that support children and young people. Inspired by Sweden’s largest fun run, the event aims to help create a healthier Norway without blood shortages.
course_highlights: Choice of 500-metre, 5 km and 10 km distances
The courses are clearly marked and include both paved and gravel surfaces
Proceeds go to local athletics clubs that support children and young people
additional: Registration is binding and entitles participants to a place in the event and a one-time licence where required. Participants may enter individually or as part of a team (maximum 5 participants). Photos and videos will be taken during the event and may be used for documentation and marketing. By registering, participants enter into an agreement with the organizing clubs and partners.

name: Liikumissari 8.Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VII etapp /Käru järve jooks
description: Liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VII etapp ehk Käru järve jooks on osa Järvamaa jooksusarjast, mis ühendab tervislikke eluviise väärtustavaid jooksuhuvilisi. Võistlus toimub Käru järve ääres ning on individuaalne jooksusarja etapp, kus arvestatakse erinevaid vanuseklasse. Sarja eesmärk on julgustada liikumisharrastust ja pakkuda võimalust osaleda mitmetel jooksudel üle Järvamaa. Iga etapi parimatele jooksjatele on välja pandud auhinnad ning hooaja kokkuvõttes tunnustatakse vanuseklasside esikolmikuid ja aktiivsemaid peresid.
course_highlights: Jooks toimub Käru järve ümbruses
Sarjas on erinevad vanuseklassid alates mudilastest kuni vanemaealisteni
Tulemused avaldatakse Järvamaa Spordiliidu veebilehel
additional: Jooksusarjas arvestatakse punktitabeli alusel, kus paremusjärjestus selgitatakse punktide põhjal. Sarja tulemuste arvestamisel lähevad arvesse 9 parema jooksu punktid. Hooaja kokkuvõttes loositakse auhindu kõikides jooksudes osalenute vahel.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 5. posms – Māras dīķis
description: Izskrien Rīgu is a running series for the whole family, held at five unique locations in Riga and offering unforgettable runs. The 5th stage will take place by Māras Pond, where participants will run on a scenic, flat course around the pond and through Māras Garden. The event is suitable for both active runners and beginners, offering various distances and the option to take part in a health run. At the end, the fastest runners and overall season winners are traditionally celebrated, followed by a concert and party.
course_highlights: Course around Māras Pond and through Māras Garden
Flat terrain, suitable for speed and enjoyment
The run takes place in a Riga park with beautiful natural scenery
additional: Bib collection starts at 18:00. Staggered starts for the children's distances take place at 18:30. Only bags with a special tag, provided at registration together with the race bib, may be left at the bag drop. Public transport is the recommended way to get there, as parking in the area is limited. The 5 km distance consists of 3 laps of a 1.52 km course.

name: Hagbloms Nattloppet
description: Hagbloms Nattloppet i Kalmar är en unik löparupplevelse som bjuder in till att gå, jogga eller springa 5 km i en härlig atmosfär med musik, belysning och överraskningar längs banan. Start och mål är vid Stortorget, där även varvning sker. Alla deltagare får en speciell medalj och en unik tröja vid föranmälan, samt dryck, frukt och chokladbit. Loppet är öppet för både män och kvinnor, och det finns även en promenadklass utan tidtagning. Arrangör är Högby IF med stöd av Hagbloms och andra sponsorer.
course_highlights: 5 km bana med start, varvning och mål på Stortorget i Kalmar
Löpning i egen takt med musik och belysning längs vägen
Speciell medalj till alla som fullföljer
additional: Nummerlapp och efteranmälan sker i Högby-tältet på Stortorget torsdagen 20 augusti kl. 15-17 och fredagen 21 augusti från kl. 18. Betalning kan ske med kort, kontanter eller swish. Alla anmälda till och med 16 augusti får Nattloppets unika tröja. Priser lottas ut, bland annat presentkort från Kallskänken. Öppet för gående, joggare och tävlingslöpare. Alla som fullföljer får en medalj; föranmälda deltagare får även loppets unika tröja.

name: Askes Fjällmaraton
location: Torget, Idre Fjäll, Idre, Älvdalen Municipality, Dalarna County, Sverige

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 50 kr som oavkortat går till Viggo Foundation

description: Askes Fjällmaraton är ett barnvänligt fjällmaraton på 1 km som arrangeras på fredagskvällen i Idre Fjäll. Loppet är väl markerat och passar alla barn födda 2015 och senare. Det finns ingen tidtagning, men alla deltagare får medalj och något gott vid målgång. Anmälan sker enkelt online eller på plats med Swish, och hela startavgiften går oavkortat till Viggo Foundation som stödjer neuroanpassad idrott för barn och unga.
course_highlights: 1 km lång bana med väl markerad bana
Start och mål på Torget, Idre Fjäll
Barnvänligt lopp utan tidtagning
additional: Anmälan kan göras online fram till 15 minuter innan start eller på plats vid nummerlappsutdelningen med Swish. Alla intäkter går till Viggo Foundation. Efter loppet väntar medalj och något gott till alla barn. Det finns även Fjällmaratonklubben för barn 4-12 år med roliga aktiviteter under lördagen. Intäkterna går oavkortat till Viggo Foundation.

name: Schleswiger Treppenlauf
description: The Schleswig Stair Run takes place for the 13th time in 2026 and features a new, attractive course starting and finishing at the Polierteich. Participants complete 10 laps with a total of approximately 940 steps, mostly on firm sand. The event offers both individual and duo competitions, with ample parking available at Stadtfeld. It is a sporting challenge in Schleswig, organised by the Spiridon Schleswig running club.
course_highlights: 10 laps with approximately 940 steps
Mostly firm sand underfoot
Start and finish at the Polierteich
additional: Start and finish at the Polierteich; ample parking at Stadtfeld; event runs from 18:30 to 21:00; individual and duo competitions available; mostly firm sand underfoot. Registration is open; parking at Stadtfeld; running time from 18:30 to 21:00.

name: 11. Lichterlauf Tangermünde
description: The Tangermünde Lights Run is an atmospheric race right on the Elbe in the historic imperial town of Tangermünde. Runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in a range of distances, including a children’s run, a 5 km fun run, a 10 km main race, and a team relay. The course runs along the picturesque Elbe promenade and offers a special atmosphere, followed by an after-run party in Tangermünde. The race is a community sporting event that puts fun, exercise, and team spirit center stage.

name: 19. Barßeler Hafenfestlauf
description: The 19th Barßeler Hafenfestlauf takes place near Barßel Harbor. The event offers races for various age groups, including Bambini races, schoolchildren’s races, a 5-kilometer race, Nordic walking, and a 10-kilometer main race. The course runs along paved roads and is suitable for all age groups. The event is organized by the Sport- und Turnverein Barßel and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, a supporting program, and refreshments.

name: Buntekuhlauf
description: Der Buntekuhlauf des SC Buntekuh e.V. in Lübeck ist eine vielseitige Laufveranstaltung für alle Altersgruppen und Leistungsniveaus. Die Strecken reichen von kurzen Läufen auf dem Sportplatzgelände bis hin zu längeren Distanzen, die mehrfach über Gehwege führen. Die Veranstaltung legt Wert auf Spaß an der Bewegung und bietet verschiedene Wettbewerbe, darunter Staffelläufe und Walking. Die Teilnahmebedingungen sind klar geregelt, und die Startunterlagen werden am Veranstaltungstag sowie am Vorabend ausgegeben.
course_highlights: Strecken auf dem Sportplatzgelände für 750 m und 1,5 km Läufe
5 km Strecke auf Gehwegen, keine Straßen- oder Radwegfreigabe
10 km und 15 km Strecken durch mehrfaches Durchlaufen der 5 km Runde
additional: Startunterlagen werden am 20. August 2027 von 18 bis 20 Uhr und am Veranstaltungstag ab 15 Uhr ausgegeben. Nachmeldungen sind bis zum 16. August 2027 um 20:00 Uhr möglich, danach eventuell am Veranstaltungstag, jedoch nicht garantiert. Es gibt keine personalisierte Startnummer, aber Urkunden werden mit den üblichen Angaben ausgegeben. Ummeldungen sind frühzeitig kostenlos möglich, später mit Gebühr.

name: Volkslauf Um die Taakener Ähren
description: The “Um die Taakener Ähren” fun run is a popular, family-friendly running event in Taaken. The event offers various races for all age groups, from a Bambini run and races for schoolchildren and joggers to the competitive 10 km main race and a relay. The course runs through the village of Taaken and its idyllic fields of grain, with fun and community at its heart. All participants receive pastries at the finish, and the winners are awarded traditional winner’s loaves. The village provides refreshments and drink stands, creating a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Mottenburger Meile
description: The Mottenburger Meile is a traditional cult race on the Elbe in Hamburg, held annually on the Friday after the Hamburg school holidays. The precisely measured out-and-back course is 7.5 km, equivalent to a Prussian land mile. The race starts and finishes on the banks of the Elbe below Halbmondweg/Elbchaussee and offers a romantic atmosphere with evening lighting. In addition to the sporting competition, the race supports the Hamburger Spendenparlament and remembers the Jewish victims of the Holocaust with a Stolperstein.

name: Ultravasan
description: Ultravasan 90 är ett terränglopp som startar i Berga by, Sälen, och erbjuder löpare den klassiska Vasaloppssträckan i somriga och natursköna miljöer. Starten går i gryningen kl. 05.00 och banan går via de historiska kontrollerna mot målet i Mora, med vyer över tallskogar, vattendrag, stigar och fäbodmiljöer. Loppet är 92 km långt, har SM-status 2026 och ingår i Vasaloppstrippeln; max antal deltagare är 2500 och åldersgräns från 17 år.
course_highlights: Gryningsstart 05:00 i Berga by - upplev soluppgången vid myrarna kring Smågan
Sju Vasaloppskontroller längs banan med dryck, energi, toaletter och sjukvård
Natursköna partier med ljusa tallskogar, ringlande vattendrag, upptrampade stigar och pittoreska fäbodmiljöer
additional: Nummerlapp och chip hämtas i Mora eller i Sälen dagarna före loppet eller på startplatsen. Startfållor öppnar 04:30 och din tid startar när du passerar startlinjen. Bagagetransport erbjuds till Mora och möjlighet finns att skicka ombytespåse till Evertsberg. Det finns vätskekontroller ungefär var femte kilometer samt toaletter och sjukvård vid alla kontroller. Max deltagare 2500, träningsstipendier 60 000 kr till segraren i dam- respektive herrklass. Ultravasan består av två ultramaraton längre distanser: Ultravasan 90 (Sälen - Mora, cirka 92 km) och Ultravasan 45 (Oxberg - Mora, cirka 45 km); båda avslutas i Mora och ingår i Vasaloppets sommarvecka.

name: Vasastafetten
description: Vasastafetten är ett terränglopp som arrangeras som en folkfest där hundratals lag, bestående av föreningar, företag, familjer och kompisgäng, delar på den klassiska sträckan från Sälen till Mora. Loppet är sommarens äldsta arrangemang och erbjuder en utmanande bana på totalt 92 kilometer uppdelat på tio sträckor mellan 4,5 och 15 kilometer. Starten går i Berga by i Sälen och loppet välkomnar både elitlöpare och motionärer från 8 år och uppåt. Anmälningsavgiften inkluderar busstransport för deltagarna på de två första sträckorna, och arrangören skickar ut startkuvert med nummerlappar och information till lagledaren i god tid före loppet.
course_highlights: Terränglopp mellan Sälen och Mora
Tio sträckor mellan 4,5 och 15 km
Start i Berga by, Sälen och mål i Mora
additional: Startkuvert med nummerlappar och informationsbrev skickas till lagledaren cirka två veckor innan loppet. Tidtagningschippet hämtas på tävlingsdagen vid Vasaloppsstarten i Sälen mellan 06:30 och 08:00. Bussbiljett till starten för sträcka 1 måste bokas, och löpare på sträcka 2 måste åka arrangörsbuss till Smågan. Från sträcka 2 till 10 ansvarar lagen själva för transport till och från växling.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://vasaloppet.se/lopning/vasastafetten-lopning/): 2027-08-21 — "Vasastafetten 2027 Datum 21 augusti" (was estimated 2027-08-14)

name: Midnattsloppet Göteborg
description: Midnattsloppet Göteborg är ett festligt och energifyllt nattlopp som går genom stadens puls och den livliga Avenyn med start och mål på Gustaf Adolfs torg. Loppet erbjuder två distanser, 5,2 km och 10 km, där deltagarna får uppleva en unik stämning med musik, publik och löparglädje sent på kvällen. Midnattsloppet är mer än bara ett lopp - det är en folkfest och en minnesvärd upplevelse som samlar löpare i alla åldrar och nivåer. Förutom individuella lopp finns även lagtävlingar och företagstävlingar som främjar gemenskap och rörelseglädje.
course_highlights: Två-varvsbana genom Göteborgs stadskärna och Avenyn
Start och mål på Gustaf Adolfs torg
Festlig stämning med musik och publik längs banan
additional: Starttider: 10 km startar kl. 21:15, 5,2 km startar kl. 22:54, maskeradstart för 10 km kl. 21:48 och för 5,2 km kl. 23:00. Maxtid för 10 km är 90 minuter från sista startgrupp. Vid varvning på 5 km stoppas löpare som anländer efter kl. 22:36 från att fortsätta andra varvet. Startpaket och tröja ingår i anmälan. Möjlighet att använda friskvårdsbidrag via Benifex, Epassi och Benefits. Företag kan köpa värdekoder för lag- och företagstävlingar. Första start för 10 km är kl. 21.15 och för 5,2 km kl. 22.54. I startavgiften för 5,2 km ingår bland annat tröja, tidtagning, vatten längs banan, förfriskningar efter målgång och digitalt diplom. Medalj kan köpas till.
