description: Blodomloppet i Halmstad är ett motionslopp som uppmärksammar den livsviktiga blodgivningen. Här kan du gå, jogga eller springa 5 km eller 10 km, antingen på egen hand eller tillsammans med kollegor och vänner. Loppet är en populär friskvårdsaktivitet som samlar deltagare i lag och avslutas med en gemensam picknick. Det är ett evenemang som kombinerar motion med ett viktigt samhällsengagemang och har en lång tradition i Sverige.
course_highlights: Bansträckning för 5 km och 10 km i natursköna Tylösand
Lilla Blodomloppet för barn och ungdomar
Vätskestationer längs banan
additional: Anmälan kan göras individuellt fram till tävlingsdagen 1 september. Startplatser säljs endast via hemsidan. Det finns möjlighet att hyra tält för företag eller lag vid målområdet med havsutsikt. Mat, dryck och glass kan köpas i kiosker och gatukök vid starten. Det finns omklädning, toaletter och förvaring vid evenemangsområdet. Loppet är planerat till 31 augusti 2027. Anmälan är ännu inte öppen och prisuppgifterna är preliminära.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/halmstad/): 2027-08-31 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 31 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2027-09-02)

name: Spring för kulturen
description: Spring för Kulturen är ett kulturlopp genom Stockholms stadskärna där konstnärer, kulturarbetare och alla intresserade samlas för att uppmärksamma kulturens värde. Loppet är en icke tävling och öppet för alla, där deltagarna kan springa, gå, rulla eller dansa längs banan. Starten sker vid Hakberget på Gärdet och målet är Sveriges riksdag, en sträcka på cirka 3 km som passerar centrala kulturinstitutioner och platser för beslut. Under loppet fylls gatorna med musik, dans, cirkus och andra kulturella uttryck, vilket skapar en levande rörelse för att synliggöra kulturens betydelse i vardagen.
course_highlights: Ca 3 km långt lopp från Hakberget, Gärdet till Sveriges riksdag
Passerar centrala kulturinstitutioner och platser där beslut fattas
Gatorna fylls med musik, dans, cirkus och andra kulturella uttryck
additional: Startplats är vid skulpturen Protest på Hakberget, Gärdet. Evenemanget är partipolitiskt oberoende och syftar till att skapa gemenskap och synliggöra kulturens värde i samhället. Uppgifter om 2026 anger start på Gärdet och avslutning på Gustav Adolfs torg.

name: Stomperudkarusellen- løp nr 4
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a traditional series of races organized by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races of varying distances, from 800 meters to 9 kilometers, and includes shorter options for the youngest participants. The races take place in scenic surroundings around Sørum, with the start and finish at Stomperud Stadion for most of the races. Participants use the same bib number throughout the series, which is open to children, young people, and adults.
course_highlights: Bingenrunden, 5 km with a shorter option
Aasgaardsrunden, 9 km with a shorter option
Lysløypa, 6 km with a shorter option
additional: Participants use the same bib number in all races in the series. Children who are members of Sørum IL can participate for free if they register no later than one week before race day. The races are held at various locations in Sørum, with Stomperud Stadion as the main venue. The meeting point is listed as Stomperud Stadion, Lørenvegen 2, 1923 Sørum.

name: Stomperudkarusellen 2027. Bare løp 4 (800 m bane)
description: Stomperudkarusellen Race 4 is a short 800-metre track race at Idrettsplassen Lørenfallet. The race takes place on 31 August 2027, starting at Stomperud stadion. A great opportunity to test your speed on the track and run with others in Stomperudkarusellen.
course_highlights: 800 metres on the track
Held at Idrettsplassen Lørenfallet
Starts at Stomperud stadion

name: Namdalskarusellen 2027 løp 6 - 3 km

description: Namdalskarusellen 3 km road race is a completely flat road race held in Spillum, with the finish at Coop Extra. The race is part of Namdalskarusellen, a series of races that promotes the joy of running and participation. Runners in various age groups can take part, and a porcelain mug is awarded to those who complete at least four of the eight races in the series. The meeting point is at Småbåthavna in Spillum, and the race is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Completely flat course in Spillum
Finish at Coop Extra
Participant prize for taking part in 4 of 8 races
additional: Age groups start at 12 years and are divided into several categories. A participant prize (porcelain mug) is awarded to those who take part in at least 4 of the 8 races in Namdalskarusellen.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: IFK Växjö Friidrott och Blodcentralerna i Kronoberg
price_range: 350–400 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (uppgifter kan uppdateras inför 2027)
description: Blodomloppet i Växjö är ett motionslopp som uppmärksammar den livsviktiga blodgivningen och välkomnar alla att gå, jogga eller springa 5 km eller 10 km. Loppet startar och slutar i vackra Linnéparken och erbjuder en flack och snabb bana med mycket publikstöd längs vägen. Det finns även en kortare barn- och ungdomsklass, Lilla Blodomloppet, som går i en slinga i parken. Blodomloppet är en social och friskvårdsaktivitet som passar både individuella deltagare och lag, och avslutas med en gemensam picknick.
course_highlights: Start och mål i Linnéparken, Växjö
Flack och snabb 5 km-bana, två varv för 10 km
Separat 5 km promenadsträcka och Lilla Blodomloppet i parken
additional: Anmälan kan göras individuellt eller i lag (max 5 deltagare per lag). Lagdeltagare kan delta i olika distanser. På evenemangsdagen går det att efteranmäla sig på plats i Linnéparken. Det finns en separat promenadklass på 5 km med egen bana. Nummerlappar och T-shirt delas ut på plats. Det finns möjlighet att delta med hund i en särskild hundklass. Omklädning och toaletter finns vid evenemangsområdet. Vätskestationer finns längs banan. Loppet avslutas med en gemensam picknick för deltagarna. Anmälan kan göras individuellt eller i lag med högst fem deltagare. Promenadklassens 5 km har en separat sträckning.

price_range: Sesongkort: 900–1200 kr ved påmelding innen 31.12.2026; deretter 960–1260 kr

description: Vestfold Running Series 2027 is a series of 8 great races in the Tønsberg region, offering the joy of running, community, and a great atmosphere for all levels. Each race has two distances, and starts at 18:00. The races take place in varied and beautiful surroundings, with electronic timing by EQ Timing. Participants can choose to enter individual races or buy a season pass for all races at a discounted price. Season-pass participants collect their race numbers at the first race, while individual entrants collect theirs from the race office before the start.
course_highlights: Start and finish right by the parking lot in Essoskogen
Two distances: 3 km (one lap) and 5.6 km (two laps)
After 200 metres, the route turns sharply right and goes down along the edge of the field
additional: Route descriptions and profiles are available in the Facebook group. Everyone can take part, regardless of level. The season pass offers a discount, and race numbers are handed out at the first race. Start at 18:00. Registration is available with a season pass or for individual races.

name: 17. ETAPP / Paljassaare poolsaar
description: STAGE 17 / The Paljassaare Peninsula is part of the Stamina Health Run series and takes place on 2 September 2026 in the Paljassaare Beach car park in Tallinn. The race distance is 6.5 km, and the course winds through the scenic landscape of the Paljassaare Peninsula, offering participants an enjoyable challenge and the chance to enjoy nature. The event is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking to take part in a sporting event focused on health and fitness. Stamina is the organizer and ensures a smooth, enjoyable race experience.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Vegmuseumsløpet

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Vegmuseumsløpet is held in the beautiful park of the Norwegian Road Museum at Hunderfossen in Lillehammer. The course is 3.5 km long and quite hilly, but designed to suit all ability levels. The race is part of Sørdalskarusellen and has a friendly, social atmosphere with plenty of participants. The event includes both a mass start and the option to take part virtually, and is a tradition marked by strong effort and broad participation across different age groups.
course_highlights: The course runs through the park of the Norwegian Road Museum at Hunderfossen
3.5 km of hilly terrain with 67 metres of elevation gain
Well-marked course with the start and finish in the park
additional: The race is held as both a mass-start event and a virtual event, with self-timing available. Parking at the Norwegian Road Museum requires payment via a machine or app. Toilets are available in the park. Sport1 Lillehammer will have a stand during the mass start. Buns are handed out to runners after they finish.

name: Mägede järve jooks 8. etapp , Järvamaa Järvede jooksud sarjas
description: Mägede Lake Run is the 8th event in the Järvamaa Lakes Run series and takes place in the Mägede sports area. This traditional regional race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and a sporting challenge. The routes wind between lakes and forests, making them suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event is part of Järvamaa’s active sports calendar and welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: Bėgimas, skirtas Kėdainių miesto gimtadieniui, „NAKTINIAI KĖDAINIAI 654”
Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie is a cross-country race held in Koszalin and the final event of the Leśne Piątki season. The course runs in the opposite direction to usual, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic Walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies for the top finishers in various age groups and disciplines. The race takes place on the Karnieszewice Forest District’s educational forest trail, amid scenic natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Course on the Karnieszewice Forest District’s educational forest trail
Start and finish at the car park on Słupska Street in Koszalin
The course runs in the opposite direction to usual, offering a fresh experience
additional: Race numbers with timing chips can be collected from the race office on the day of the event. Participants can compete in the running race, Nordic Walking, and mixed-pair categories. The race is part of the Tour Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, where participants can accumulate kilometres throughout the year. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies for the top finishers in the main classifications, Nordic Walking, and mixed-pair categories.

name: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail
location: Ramsviks Camping, Ramsvik, Sotenäs Municipality, Sverige
description: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail är ett unikt trail-lopp i etapper som äger rum i den natursköna miljön vid Ramsvik i Bohuslän. Under tre dagar upplever deltagarna totalt 77 kilometer av varierad terräng med massiva klippor, smala skogsstigar, kustsamhällen och vackra stränder. Loppet erbjuder olika startgrupper för gående, joggare och löpare, vilket gör det till en upplevelse som passar alla nivåer. Förutom tävlingen finns även aktiviteter för barn i Kids Camp och möjligheter till boende nära havet i Race Village. Detta är en höjdpunkt för alla som vill kombinera utmaning med storslagen natur och gemenskap.
course_highlights: 77 kilometer trail i etapper över tre dagar
Massiva klippor, smala skogsstigar och vackra stränder
Startgrupper för gående, joggare och löpare
additional: Deltagarna använder appen Pace+ för tävlingsbiljetter, starttider, scheman och kartor. Officiell boendepartner är Ramsvik Stugby & Camping vid havet, där även Race Village och aktiviteter efter målgång finns. Kids Camp erbjuder barn aktiviteter som segling, fiske och besök på Nordens Ark under tävlingen. Race Village finns vid Ramsviks Camping. Boende bokas separat; Ramsvik erbjuder boendepaket med stuga, frukost och middag. Kids Camp erbjuds för barn från 6 år.

name: Knarvikmila 2027 - Sparebanken Norge Stafetten
description: Knarvikmila is a long-standing running event that has grown since 1983 into a major community celebration featuring both sports and cultural activities. The event runs over several days and includes various races, seminars, concerts and family activities. The Sparebanken Norge Relay is a social and intense relay with five short legs, perfect for team-building and having fun together. The start and finish are at Knarvik Stadium, with good facilities such as changing rooms, showers and baggage storage in Nordhordlandshallen. After the relay, participants gather in the hall for food and mingling, with an awards ceremony for the top teams.
course_highlights: The relay consists of 5 legs between 400m and 1700m
Start and finish at Knarvik Stadium, with the relay exchange near the stadium
The course goes through Knarvik ungdomsskule, the car park, Juvikstølen and Brekkeløypa
additional: Race numbers and the relay baton can be collected at Nordhordlandshallen on Friday 16:00 - 17:45. The baton must be returned in the finish area. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at Nordhordlandshallen. Free parking in the area around the stadium. After the relay, there will be an awards ceremony and a social gathering with food and mingling at Nordhordlandshallen. The event address provided is Knarvik Stadion, 5916 Isdalstø.

name: Toila rahvajooks
description: Toila Rahvajooks on osa Ida-Viru jooksusarjast, mis toimub Toila SPA hotellis. See rahvaspordiüritus pakub võimalust nautida kaunist loodust ja sportlikku seltskonda. Jooks toimub septembri alguses ning on sobilik erineva tasemega jooksjatele. Üritus on traditsiooniline ja kogub osalejaid kogu piirkonnast.
course_highlights: Rajad kulgevad Toila SPA ümbruses
Kaunid vaated merele ja loodusele
Sobib nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele
additional: Toila Rahvajooks on Ida-Viru jooksusarja 7. etapp. Üritus toimub reedel ning algab kell 17:45. Toimumiskoht on Toila SPA hotell. Sarjas on kokku 8 etappi, mis toimuvad erinevates Ida-Viru piirkondades.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 28. Aseri Savijooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa running series is a traditional running and walking series offering distances suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in various locations across Lääne-Virumaa, offering runners diverse and interesting courses. The series lets participants enjoy both the competition and the sporting community, as well as the natural surroundings. Aseri Savijooks is one of the series’ events and takes place at Aseri Leisure Centre.

name: 24. Duderstädter Sparkassenlauf
description: The 24th Duderstadt Sparkassenlauf takes place in Duderstadt’s historic pedestrian zone. The event starts at 16:00 with the opening ceremony in front of the town hall, which is also the finish point for all races. Distances range from a 600 m Bambini run and 1.25 km school races to 5 km and 10 km races. Children and young people receive finisher medals, participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive neckerchiefs, and winners are rewarded with cake. The event is supported by the City of Duderstadt, Sparkasse Duderstadt and other sponsors.
course_highlights: Races through Duderstadt’s historic old town and pedestrian zone
Finish in front of the beautiful town hall
A range of distances from 600 m to 10 km, including races for children and young people
additional: The event opens at 16:00 with a ceremony led by patron and Mayor Thorsten Feike and the board of Sparkasse Duderstadt. The Bambini runs have participant limits of 250, while the school races have limits of 300 to 400 participants. Neckerchiefs are given as finisher gifts for the 5 km and 10 km races. No on-site late registration is available. The awards ceremony begins at 18:00. Multiple race distances, registration via the website, medals for children, neckerchiefs for longer races, event in the historic city centre

name: IHK-Ausbildungslauf move-on
location: Rostrup bei Oldenburg, Ammerland, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The training run “Move On!” is organized by the Oldenburg Chamber of Industry and Commerce (IHK) and takes place around the Zwischenahner Meer. The course is approximately 12 km long and runs from BBS Ammerland in Rostrup via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen, returning to Rostrup. It is aimed at trainers, apprentices, examiners, teachers and other people involved in vocational education and training in the Oldenburg region. In addition to the run, the event includes a program with race-number collection, team photos, a barbecue evening with music and an awards ceremony. The event takes place in all weather. Parking is available at BBS and at Bau-ABC Rostrup.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km circular route around the Zwischenahner Meer
Start and finish at BBS Ammerland in Rostrup
Route via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen
additional: Race numbers and T-shirts can be collected at BBS Rostrup on the day of the event from 14:00 to 15:30. There is a walking group starting at 15:00. The run starts in four groups from 16:00, at 4-minute intervals. After the run, a barbecue with a music act will take place from 18:00 at Bau-ABC near the finish. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 18:30. The IHK accepts no liability for accidents or theft. Valuables cannot be stored.

name: 23. Lehrter CityLauf
description: The 23rd Lehrte City Run is taking place, continuing a long-standing running tradition in downtown Lehrte. Races cover distances of 2, 4 and 10 kilometers, including Bambini and school races, as well as a 2-kilometer inclusive race. The 4- and 10-kilometer company competition will once again be sponsored by the KURTULUS GRUPPE. Music and a varied program featuring LSV departments will create a great atmosphere.

name: Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen är Sveriges största lopp för kvinnor och erbjuder en härlig löpupplevelse på 10 km i natursköna Södra Djurgården i Stockholm. Loppet präglas av gemenskap, styrka och individuella mål, och välkomnar alla kvinnor från 15 år och uppåt. Startgrupper delas in efter löparnivå för att skapa ett bra flöde och en positiv upplevelse för alla deltagare. Banan bjuder på vackra miljöer och mycket publikstöd längs vägen, vilket gör loppet till en festlig och inspirerande dag för löparglädje.
course_highlights: 10 km löpning i natursköna Södra Djurgården och Stockholms city
Startgrupper indelade i 12 nivåer från snabba löpare till promenadtempo
Möjlighet att välja en kortare 6 km genväg från startgrupp 12
additional: Startgrupper delas in i 12 nivåer för att skapa ett bra flöde. Möjlighet att välja bort tidtagning. Efteranmälan är möjlig digitalt fram till 1 timme innan första start i Stockholm och 2 timmar innan start i Sälen och Vemdalen, i mån av plats. Betalning kan ske via internetbank, Visa, MasterCard, Swish eller faktura via Klarna.

name: HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon
description:
Starten för HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon är placerad på Sundstorget utanför Dunkers Kulturhus. Banans unika sträckning innefattar sedan två kilometer löpning i Helsingborgs anrika och vackra centrum. Där får du uppleva historiska kvarter som Stortorget och medeltidsborgen Kärnan, för att sedan fortsätta genom stadsdelarna Tågaborg och Maria Park och naturreservatet Pålsjö skog. Allt avslutas sedan genom Laröd nedför Tinkarpsbacken och längs vår vackra strandpromenad med Öresund som glittrar framför dig.

Banan har en stigning på endast 95 meter med en backe upp mot Kärnan efter 2 kilometer, och en lång nerförsbacke mot havet efter 19 kilometer. När du springer HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon får du njuta av allt från pulserande city till avkopplande skog och hav.

Väl i mål får du njuta av din insats ute på trädäcket, och kanske fira med ett dopp i Öresund? Därefter går du ut på vårt evenemangsområde med aktiviteter för hela familjen, anhöriga och supporters.
additional:
START: 09:30, 09:33 & 09:36
LÄNGD: 21 097,5 meter
HÖJDMETER: Total stigning på 95 meter. 190 meter totalt (upp & ner)
UNDERLAG: ca 99% asfalt, 1% övrigt
HÖJDPUNKTER: City, Bergaliden, Slottshagen, Kärnan, Mariastaden, Maria Park, Pålsjö skog, Laröd, Tinkarsbacken & Strandpromenaden
STADSDELAR: City, Slottshöjden, Tågaborg S, Tågaborg N, Norr, Ringstorp, Mariastaden, Hittarp-Laröd
GPX: Finns att ladda ner på hemsidan.

images.alt_text: Startlinjen för HOKA Helsingborg Halvmaraton med löpare och åskådare på gatan
Löpare under loppet visar segertecken med fingrarna och svettig ansikte
En löpare knyter sina blå HOKA-skor på en stenlagd yta före loppet.
Tre löpare tävlar på en asfaltsväg under ett lopp i Helsingborg.
Publik vid löptävling håller upp skylt med texten "Smile! You paid to do this"

name: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun
description: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun är Göteborgs största traillopp som erbjuder fem utmanande distanser i vacker och varierad terräng nära staden. Loppen går på äventyrliga stigar, i lummig skog och över bergshällar med fantastisk utsikt, där tekniska partier blandas med lättsprungna sträckor. Start och mål är i historiska Kvibergs Park, och banorna tar dig från stadens utkanter ut i vildmarken med inslag av sjöar och magiska skogar. Efter målgång väntar en gemytlig AfterRun med mat och energi för att fira din prestation. Loppet passar både nybörjare och erfarna traillöpare som vill uppleva en riktig naturutmaning nära Göteborg.
course_highlights: Varierande tekniska och lättsprungna stigar i lummig skog och på bergshällar
Passage förbi idylliska sjöar och magiska skogar med inslag av historiska stenrösen
Start och mål i Kvibergs Park med utsikt över Göteborg och Säveå-dalen
additional: För 33 km start vid Angereds kyrka med gemensam buss från Kviberg. Självseedning i startgrupper på plats. Live tracking och mellantider. Obligatorisk utrustning krävs. Nummerlappsutdelning sker fredag och lördag före loppet. Rekommenderad kollektivtrafik med spårvagn och buss till Kviberg. Namnändring möjlig mot avgift fram till 3 september. Barnlopp finns som kompletterande aktiviteter. De flesta lopp startar och går i mål i Kvibergs Park. 33 km-loppet startar vid Angereds kyrka, med gemensam buss från Kviberg. För de längre loppen krävs bland annat vattenbehållare på minst 0,5 liter, energi och laddad mobiltelefon.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://gbgtrailrun.se/tavlingsinfo/): 2027-09-04 — "Datum 4 september 2027" (was estimated 2027-09-04)

name: Västgötaloppet Trail 2026
description: Västgötaloppet Trail är en utmanande och naturskön traillöpning som går i skog och terräng runt Dammen i Tvärred, strax söder om Ulricehamn. Deltagarna kan välja mellan tre distanser: 7 km, 17 km och 27 km, alla med start och mål vid samma vackra område. Banan bjuder på smala skogsstigar, mossbeklädda stenpartier och magiska vyer över Åsunden, vilket gör loppet till en upplevelse av äventyr, gemenskap och löparglädje. Efter målgång erbjuds varm mat och alla deltagare får medalj. För de yngsta finns ett gratis minilopp med fokus på lek och glädje.
course_highlights: Smala skogsstigar och kuperad terräng
Mossbeklädda stenpartier och hällmarker
Vackra vyer över Åsunden
additional: Alla distanser startar och går i mål vid Dammen i Tvärred. Parkering finns i närheten. Servering med mat och dryck, skön musik och solstolar finns på plats. Funktionärer och speaker hjälper publiken att följa loppets höjdpunkter. Varm mat ingår för alla deltagare efter målgång. Gratis minilopp för barn startar kl 10:45 med anmälan på plats. Max 300 deltagare. Samma anmälningsavgift oavsett distans. Reducerad avgift för barn och ungdomar.

name: Lasse-Majaloppet
description: Lasse-Majaloppet är ett skidlopp arrangerat av Arboga Skidklubb med tre olika distanser: 23 km, 13 km och 6 km. Loppet erbjuder en fin möjlighet att åka skidor i varierad terräng och är en traditionell tävling i Arboga. Det är en välkomnande tävling för både motionärer och tävlingsåkare.
course_highlights: Tre distanser: 23 km, 13 km och 6 km
Varierad terräng i Arboga
Arrangeras av Arboga Skidklubb
additional: Loppet har arrangerats sedan mitten av 1970-talet.

name: Mössebergslunken
description: Mössebergslunken är ett klassiskt löplopp i Falköping med IK Wilske som arrangör. Loppet har i över 50 år samlat tävlingslöpare och motionärer och avgörs på Mösseberg. Bansträckningen har ändrats genom åren, och 2022 presenterades en ny bana. Välkommen till ett traditionsrikt lopp i Mössebergsområdet.
course_highlights: Loppet går på Mösseberg i Falköping.
Bansträckningen har förändrats genom åren; en ny bana presenterades inför 2022 års lopp.
Ett traditionsrikt lopp med över 50 års historia.

name: Helsingborg Marathon
description:
Helsingborg Marathon är skapat med ett tydligt mål – att visa upp det bästa av vår stad. Från start på Sundstorget, med Dunkers Kulturhus som kuliss, bär det av söderut längs en flack och snabb öppning längs havet mot Råå småbåtshamn och vidare upp mot Ättekulla naturreservat.

Därifrån väntar två av stadens mest uppskattade naturupplevelser – Ramlösa brunnspark och Jordbodalen – innan banan tar dig rakt in i en unik miljö – Fredriksdal museer och trädgårdar. Här springer du bokstavligen genom en bondgård mitt i stan, innan kontrasterna blir som störst vid Helsingborg Arena och klassiska Olympia.

I loppets andra halva möter du historiska Kärnan, stillheten i Pålsjö skog och de historiska kvarteren kring Maria Park, snabblöpta Laröd innan du släpper på nedför Tinkarpsbacken och tar sikte på havet.

De sista 3000 meterna är något alldeles extra. Varje hundrade meter är markerad i en nedräkning mot målet på Gröningen. Längs upploppet möts du av ett hav av flaggor, vinden från Öresund och en känsla som bara Helsingborg kan ge.

I mål väntar trädäcket och firandet vid vattnet. En bana full av variation, upplevelser och energi – och känslan efteråt är densamma för alla – Det här gör jag om igen nästa år!
additional:
LÄNGD: 42 195 meter
HÖJDMETER: Total stigning på 135 meter. 270 meter totalt (upp & ner)
UNDERLAG: ca 89% asfalt, 10% hårdpackat grus, 1% övrigt
HÖJDPUNKTER: City, Råå hamn, Ramlösa brunnspark, Jordbodalen, Fredriksdal, Kärnan, Maria Park, Pålsjö skog, Laröd, Strandpromenaden
STADSDELAR: Centrum, Söder, Planteringen, Miatorp, Högasten, Råå, Ättekulla, Ramlösa, Elineberg, Närlunda, Fältabacken, Wilson Park, Eneborg, Olympia, Slottshöjden, Tågaborg S, Tågaborg N, Norr, Ringstorp, Mariastaden, Hittarp-Laröd
GPX: Finns att ladda ner på hemsidan

images.alt_text: Medaljer med blå band för Helsingborg Marathon tävlingen hängande på rad
Löpare i rörelse under ett maratonlopp med fokus på deras ben och skor.
Starten av ett löplopp med löpare och publik vid Helsingborg Marathon.
Löpare förbereder sig inför ett maratonlopp i stadsmiljö under soligt väder.
Löpare som hälsar på åskådare vid löptävlingens avspärrning.
Stor folkmassa vid starten för Helsingborg Marathon med färgglada rökexplosioner över gatan
Fyra löpare poserar vid en stor gong vid vattnet efter loppet.
En grupp åskådare vid ett utomhusevenemang, troligen ett lopp eller marathon.

name: Knarvikmila - FjordViking
description: KnarvikMila is a long-standing running event in Alver, Vestland, which has grown since 1983 into a major festival featuring both sporting and cultural events. The event spans several days and includes various races, seminars, concerts and family activities. FjordViking is a special challenge at KnarvikMila in which participants run three distances in one day and receive a special prize and cap upon completion. The races offer varied courses with clear markings and drink stations, and KnarvikMila places great emphasis on enjoyment, health and the environment.
course_highlights: Courses clearly marked with yellow arrows and signs every kilometre
Drink stations on NaturMila, 3 km, 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon
Start and finish at Knarvik Stadium, with good emergency preparedness and facilities
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Nordhordlandshallen, which opens Friday at 16:00, Saturday at 09:30 and Sunday at 09:00. Late registration is available Friday 16:00–20:00, Saturday 09:00–16:00 and Sunday 10:00–13:30, but should be avoided. Free parking is available at several locations in Knarvik, with parking attendants. Changing rooms and toilets are available at Nordhordlandshallen. Storage for valuables is provided. Environmental stations for waste and recycling are available. Everyone who completes FjordViking receives a specially designed cap.

name: Knarvikmila Halvmaraton
location: Knarvik Stadion, Knarvik, Alver, Vestland, Norway
description: Knarvikmila Half Marathon is being held for the 17th time and offers a beautiful, traffic-free course consisting of four laps of a 5.275 km route, with the start and finish at Knarvik Stadium. The course runs on asphalt and gravel, through the beautiful natural surroundings of Brekkeløypa and around Knarvik. There are 12 drink stations along the way, clear course markings, around 20 course marshals and Red Cross personnel on site. After finishing, participants receive water and bananas. Prizes are awarded to class winners, with cash prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Traffic-free course, starting and finishing at Knarvik Stadium
Asphalt and gravel course through Brekkeløypa
12 drink stations along the way
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Nordhordlandshallen, which is open Friday at 16:00, Saturday at 09:30 and Sunday at 09:00. Late registration is possible but should be avoided. It takes place at Nordhordlandshallen on Friday, Saturday and Sunday during the specified hours. Free parking is available at several locations in Knarvik, with parking attendants on site. Changing rooms and toilets are available at Nordhordlandshallen. The Red Cross and an event doctor will be on site for emergencies. Waste and recycling stations are available. Knarvikmila T-shirts are also available for purchase when registering and at the hall. Drink stations are provided along the course. The half marathon has a minimum age of 15 and is part of FjordViking.

name: Olasheiløpet
description: Olasheiløpet is a traditional race held on the first Saturday in September in Lillesand. The race offers three distances suited to different age groups and levels of ambition: 3.5 km for younger runners, 9.5 km for those seeking a moderate challenge, and 15.8 km for those who want an extra-tough course. The courses pass through varied terrain, including asphalt, gravel and trails, and offer beautiful natural scenery around Lillesand Stadium and Olashei. The children’s race is an informal event with no registration and starts just after the main field.
course_highlights: Long course of 11.2 km through varied terrain, including a floodlit trail, gravel road and paths
The highest point on the course is Olashei, at 166 metres above sea level, with steep downhill sections
Shorter 3.5 km course suited to younger runners, starting and finishing at Lillesand Stadium
additional: The children’s race (1.5 km) requires no registration and starts just after the main field, shortly after 12:00. The course will be marked and marshalled at every intersection. The long course is 11.2 km and includes a lap of the stadium before the finish. The short course is 3.5 km and runs through the floodlit trail and the area around the stadium. There are no drink or food stations during the race. Participants are encouraged to use a GPS watch or the Strava app for timing.

name: Numedalsløpet 2027
organizer: Lyngdal IL, Svene IL og Flesberg IL
description: Numedalsløpet 2027 is a traditional race first held in 1936 and one of the oldest sporting events in Numedal. The race follows easy forest trails for approximately 12 km from Høgheim in Lyngdal to Flesberg community centre. It is an inclusive event for both competitive runners and recreational participants, organised in collaboration by Lyngdal IL, Svene IL and Flesberg IL. The race offers nature experiences and a sense of community, and has grown into a popular event attracting participants from across the region.
course_highlights: 12 km course on easy forest trails
Start at Høgheim in Lyngdal and finish at Flesberg community centre
384.4 metres of elevation gain on the course
additional: Untimed recreational participants start from 11:30. The race and timed recreational event start at 13:00. Registration deadline: Thursday, 2 September 2027.

name: Vestfold Maraton
description: Vestfold Marathon is an inclusive running event that encourages recreational runners of all ages to be physically active, starting in Larvik and finishing at Jahn Teigens plass in Tønsberg. The event offers both a full and half marathon, as well as a relay with multiple legs, and emphasizes physical activity and social interaction. The courses are officially measured by Kondis, and the relay format allows everyone to take part, regardless of ability. The event creates a running celebration from Larvik to Tønsberg, with beautiful natural scenery along the way.
course_highlights: Start at Hegdal industrial area in Larvik and finish at Jahn Teigens plass at Tønsberg brygge
Relay with 8 legs for the marathon and 4 legs for the half marathon
The courses are officially measured by Kondis and include varied legs through urban and natural areas
additional: Relay teams can be women’s, men’s, or mixed teams, with at least one woman per team. Wheelchair racing with spiked wheels is permitted when registering. Water, bananas, and sports drinks are available at several aid stations. Changing rooms with showers are available at Tønsberg guest harbor. Race numbers can be collected in advance at Nortura Tønsberg or at the start venue on race day. No refunds are given for withdrawals or failure to finish. Photographers document the race, and images may be used for marketing. Anti-doping rules apply. The course and leg details provided refer to the 2026 information and may change for 2027. Registered participants can take part individually or as a relay team.

name: Jentemila
organizer: Jentemila, Christiania Glasmagasin og Anton Sport
description: Jentemila is a long-running, accessible girls’ race held at Bislett Stadium in Oslo on the first weekend of September. The race brings together thousands of girls of all ages and fitness levels for a weekend of running, walking or jogging 5 or 10 km, alongside entertainment, shopping, gifts and a well-stocked goodie bag for all participants. The event offers a unique running festival with music, competitions and socialising, and wraps up with bubbles and a lively atmosphere after the finish. Jentemila welcomes everyone to an inclusive and magical experience at Bislett Stadium.
course_highlights: A route on asphalt, gravel and trails, with challenging and varied sections
Choose between 5 km and 10 km distances
Start and finish at iconic Bislett Stadium, with Oslo streets closed to traffic
additional: Participants are divided into waves based on their expected finish time and distance. Waves start two minutes apart. It is possible to collect race bibs for several people by showing a QR code or giving their names. Goodie bags are handed out after the finish in exchange for a voucher. Medals are available to pre-order or buy at the stadium. Bag storage is available; luggage tags are attached to race bibs. After-run drinks are available to participants over 18. Discounts are offered for registering without a T-shirt and for group registrations (more than 4 people). A 15% student discount is available by sending proof of student status to the organiser after registering. Race bibs can be selected with or without a T-shirt; choosing no T-shirt gives a 100 kr discount. Groups of more than four get a 50 kr discount per participant. The 10 km is listed as starting at 14:00, and the 5 km and 10 km waves start two minutes apart.

name: Drammen Halvmaraton
description: Drammen Half Marathon is a spectacular running adventure that takes participants around a lightning-fast 10-kilometer loop twice. The race takes place in Drammen, Buskerud, and offers a fast, scenic course suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners. The event has a limited number of race bibs to ensure a good experience for all participants. In addition to the half marathon, a children’s race and other running activities are held under the same umbrella.
course_highlights: The course consists of a fast 10-kilometer loop run twice
The race goes through central Drammen and the surrounding areas
A limited number of race bibs ensures a good running experience
additional: A green race bib indicates that a medal was purchased in advance. A maximum of 8,000 race bibs are available for the Drammen Half Marathon. A children’s race, Minimaraton, is also held on the same day. No phone number is provided for contact, but inquiries are answered by email and through the contact form. The organizer states that a maximum of 8,000 race bibs are available for 2026. Race times can be followed live via Ultimate Sport Service LIVE.

name: Balestrand Trailrun
description: Balestrand Trailrun is a race held on a loop course starting and finishing at Kreklingen Stadium in Balestrand. The race follows beautiful trails and offers a scenic experience in the area. There are both a competitive class and a recreational class, so both fast runners and recreational runners can take part. The race is 5.4 km long and is suitable for anyone looking for a challenging and enjoyable trail run.
course_highlights: Loop course on beautiful trails in Balestrand
Start and finish at Kreklingen Stadium
Terrain with maintained trails and scenic surroundings
additional: The race has both a competitive class and a recreational class. It is a 5.4 km loop course on trails. Previous races, Balestrand Opp and Rundt, are now combined under Balestrand Trailrun, with a new route from 2025. Previous editions have included a competitive course, a recreational course and a free mini-run. Course lengths and practical information may vary from year to year.

name: Fløymila
description: Fløymila is a fun run held on Flekkerøy in Kristiansand, with distances suited to both children and adults. The event includes a 600-metre children’s race, as well as 5 km and 10 km distances. It is a popular event that brings together many participants for an enjoyable running experience in scenic surroundings. Fløymila welcomes everyone to take part and enjoy running on Flekkerøy.
course_highlights: Run on Flekkerøy amid scenic surroundings
Distances for children and adults: 600 m, 5 km and 10 km
A fun run with a great atmosphere and broad participation
additional: Distances include a 600 m children’s race, 5 km and 10 km Fløymila. Race bib collection and registration take place at the event. The race attracts many participants and is a fun run focused on community and enjoyment.

name: Nordmarkstravern
description: Nordmarkstravern is a traditional forest race in Nordmarka, Oslo, offering several distances for different ages and ability levels. The courses follow trails and gravel roads through some of Nordmarka’s most beautiful areas, with start points at Stryken, Skar, Hammeren and Nordberg school. The event offers everything from short, child-friendly routes to challenging ultra-distances, with an emphasis on clear course marking, refreshment stations and safety, including medical personnel and first aid. The race has an inclusive atmosphere, with categories for runners, people with strollers and wheelchair users.
course_highlights: Heltravern 30 km on trails and gravel roads from Stryken to Kringsjå by Sognsvann
Dobbeltravern 60 km, following the Heltravern course out and back
Kvarttravern 7 km, with 2.5 km on trails and the rest on gravel roads, suitable for children and families
additional: Start times: Dobbeltravern 60 km at 07:30; all other distances at 11:00. Prices include a race bib with timing, marked courses, prizes and category prizes. Bus transport to start areas is provided except for the 30 km, 60 km and 1.2 km distances. Bag transport from start to finish is available for all distances. Food and drink stations along the route. A mandatory NOK 50 licence fee for the Norwegian Athletics Association applies to participants without an annual licence. Registration is binding, but race bibs may be sold or transferred to another participant. Registration prices vary by distance and date. A mandatory one-time licence fee of NOK 50 is added for participants without an annual licence. The entry fee includes timing, marked courses, prizes, bag transport, and food and drink stations. Bus transport to the start areas is included for several distances.

name: Harstad Summits Trail Marathon
description: Harstad Summits Trail Marathon is a spectacular mountain race held in early September, starting and finishing in central Harstad. The race offers varied, hilly terrain, with trails crossing several local mountain peaks, and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners looking for a wonderful experience in nature. The event is part of Harstadtrippelen, which combines skiing, cycling and running throughout the year, creating an inclusive community celebration with activities for the whole family. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a chance to socialise in the finish area.
course_highlights: A route crossing several mountain peaks, with varied, hilly terrain
Spectacular views and experiences in nature in the Harstad area
Start and finish in central Harstad, with a community celebration and activities
additional: Distances: Marathon (42 km, 2,100 m elevation gain), Half Marathon (21 km, 950 m elevation gain), 12 km recreational run, 10 km boys/girls, children's race in the city centre. There are aid stations along the course and marked routes, and a banquet is held for volunteers and partners after the race. Prizes are drawn among participants, and there are activities and entertainment for the whole family.

name: Lovundmila
description: Lovundmila is a friendly race on beautiful Lovund, offering several distances, including 10 km, 5 km, and shorter races for children and young people. The race combines scenic surroundings with an inclusive atmosphere and attracts both local and visiting runners. The event is known for its great atmosphere, volunteer effort, and support from the local community. Lovundmila is more than just a race; it is a social event celebrating the joy of running in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Race on beautiful Lovund with wonderful scenery
Several distances: 10 km, 5 km, and shorter races for children
Great atmosphere with support from volunteers and spectators
additional: Previous editions have started and finished at Lovundmila Flerbrukshall.

name: Furusjøen Rundt-løpet/marsjen
description: Furusjøen Rundt-løpet is a traditional race that has been held since 1966, offering beautiful natural surroundings near Rondane. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, a 9 km walk and a children’s obstacle race, making it family-friendly. The course starts at Rudland Fjellsenter and crosses varied terrain, including gravel roads, trails, forest roads and asphalt, as well as scenic areas such as Frydalen Landscape Protection Area. Welcome to the mountains and to the Adventure in Rondane!
course_highlights: The course passes through Frydalen Landscape Protection Area, with beautiful scenery and reindeer habitat
The course’s longest uphill stretch is approximately 1.3 km long, with 35 m of elevation gain
Varied surfaces include gravel roads, trails, forest roads, marshland and asphalt
additional: The half marathon starts at 12:00, and the 9 km walk starts at 12:20. Late registration is available at the stadium until the start. There are age categories from 11 years old, as well as a family category. There are several aid stations along the course. The terrain includes wet marshland; stepping on tussocks and rocks is recommended for better grip. The start and finish are at Rudland Fjellsenter on Kvamsfjellet. The event also includes the Snipp-Snapp children’s obstacle race. Registration is through the organizer’s website.

name: Herdla Backyard Ultra
description: Herdla Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon that challenges both beginners and experienced runners to test their limits in a unique community. The race is organized by an experienced ultrarunner and focuses on safe participation, good facilities, and a course that gives participants the best possible conditions for success. Participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour, and the race continues until only one runner remains. Herdla Backyard Ultra is not just about winning, but about challenging yourself and sharing the experience with others.
course_highlights: The course is 6.7 km, with varied terrain and 135 metres of elevation gain
The start and finish area are the same for every loop
Each loop must be completed in under an hour, and the next loop starts on the hour, exactly
additional: Each participant receives a bib number and a timing chip for tracking. A reflective vest and headlamp are mandatory in the dark. Support is only allowed in the finish area between loops. The winner receives NOK 5,000, and prizes are drawn based on bib numbers. The race does not end until the last runner completes the final loop. All participants receive a medal. Timing and tracking are provided by Racetracker Norge.

name: Toughest
description: Toughest Oslo 2027 offers an unforgettable obstacle course racing experience in the spectacular terrain of Holmenkollen. The main race covers approximately 8 km with 30–40 varied obstacles, including the iconic Holmenkollen ski slope as the grand finale. Participants can choose between the full main race, a lighter 4 km Xplore course designed for fun and beginners, or a 2 km family-friendly course. The event welcomes everyone from amateurs to elite athletes, with options for fast lanes and penalty rounds to tailor the challenge.
course_highlights: Varied and challenging terrain in Holmenkollen
Approximately 30–40 obstacles of varied size and difficulty
Finish on the legendary Holmenkollen ski slope
additional: Fast lanes are available on selected obstacles for an extra challenge. Penalty rounds allow participants to skip difficult obstacles with a short jog penalty. Registration closes about one week before the event or when capacity is reached. Health care benefits can be used for registration via Benifex & Epassi. The main race has an optional Double Distance add-on of approximately 16 km. Registration closes about one week before the race or when capacity is reached, and prices vary depending on when you register.

name: Jentemila
description: Jentemila is a long-standing, accessible race for girls and women of all ages and fitness levels, held at Bislett Stadium on the first weekend of September. The race offers both 5 km and 10 km distances, and participants can choose to run, walk or jog. The event features two days of entertainment, shopping, gifts, competitions and a well-stocked goodie bag for all participants. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy sparkling drinks and celebrate in an inclusive, festive atmosphere. Known as Norway’s friendliest women’s race, Jentemila brings together thousands of participants for a unique running celebration.
course_highlights: The routes run on asphalt, gravel and trails, with a challenging and varied profile
Start and finish at Bislett Stadium, with streets in Oslo closed for the race
Wave starts every 2 minutes, based on the selected distance and expected finish time
additional: Participants can choose a race number with or without a T-shirt; choosing no T-shirt gives a NOK 100 discount. Groups of more than 4 people receive a NOK 50 discount per participant. Bag storage is available, with luggage tags included. Medals can be pre-ordered or purchased at the stadium. After the race, participants over 18 can attend an after-run with alcoholic or non-alcoholic drinks. Waves start every 2 minutes, and participants can submit the same expected finish time to run together in the same wave. Goodie bags are handed out after the finish in exchange for the coupon on the race number. Groups of more than four receive a NOK 50 discount per participant. The 5 km and 10 km waves start every two minutes.

name: Stordløpet
description: Stordløpet is a long-standing race organized by Stord Friidrett, a subgroup of Stord Idrettslag, which has a history dating back to 1914. The race takes place at Stord Stadium and brings together runners of various ages and abilities for a running festival in central Leirvik. The event is an important part of local sporting life and offers a great opportunity to take part in a well-organized race with a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Stord Stadium and in central Leirvik
Suitable for runners of all ages and abilities
Part of a local running festival with a great atmosphere
additional: Stord Friidrett also organizes other races, such as Parkløpet, with distances suited to children and young people. The club has members of all ages and offers a broad range of athletics events. A fun run and children's races of 400 or 800 metres have also been held. Information about distances and the course is from previous editions and does not confirm the details for 2027.

name: Lyderhorn Opp 2027
description: Lyderhorn Opp is an annual uphill race organized by Laksevåg Turn og Idrettslag, finishing at the summit of Lyderhorn, 396 meters above sea level. The course is approximately 3.8 km long and suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The event takes place in scenic surroundings in Bergen, and everyone who finishes receives a medal and a T-shirt. It is a traditional autumn event that brings together runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Uphill race finishing at the summit of Lyderhorn, 396 meters above sea level
Course length: approximately 3.8 km
Scenic surroundings in Bergen
additional: Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected at Sport1 at Vestkanten on Friday, September 4, from 16:00 to 21:00, with a 10% discount on any product. Race bibs can also be collected at the start, but collection in advance is recommended. There is ample parking, but using public transport, walking, or cycling is recommended. First-aid personnel and defibrillators are available along the course. Cash prizes are awarded to the three fastest men and women. Many gift prizes are drawn by race bib number. The organizer says Lyderhorn Opp will return in 2027. Distance and course details are based on previous editions; details for 2027 have not been provided.

name: Melshornløpet 2027
location: Sivert Aarflot-plassen, Volda, Møre og Romsdal, Norway
organizer: Foreininga Melshornets Venner og VTI Friidrett
description: Melshornløpet is an annual uphill race from central Volda to the summit of Melshornet, 807 metres above sea level. The course is about 7 kilometres long and offers a wonderful experience of nature, with a challenge from fjord to mountain. The race is open to competitive runners, recreational runners and participants in the non-competitive fitness run, with cash prizes in the junior and senior categories. The start is at Sivert Aarflot-plassen in Volda, and the finish is at the summit of Melshornet, with spectacular views over Voldafjorden and the Sunnmøre Alps. All participants receive a medal, and prize draws are held during the prize-giving in the start area.
course_highlights: Approx. 7 km from sea level to 807 metres above sea level
Scenic surroundings from fjord to mountain
Spectacular views over Voldafjorden and the Sunnmøre Alps
additional: The recreational category starts between 09:00 and 11:00, while the competitive categories have a mass start at 11:00. All participants in the competitive categories must carry a pack with the required equipment. Spot checks are conducted at the summit, with a time penalty for missing equipment. The prize-giving takes place at 14:30 in the start area, and you must be present to win a prize in the draw. The fitness run is an option without timing or competitive pressure, with starts between 09:00 and 11:00. The fitness run supports the Norwegian Cancer Society, and it is possible to shorten the route by starting from Bratteberg School. Recreational category starts between 09:00 and 11:00; mass start for the competitive categories at 11:00. The recreational category is unranked.

name: Run to the beat powered by Bang & Olufsen 2027
Jüri Jaansoni Kahe Silla jooks
description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional running event in Pärnu, held on the first weekend of September. It brings together thousands of sports enthusiasts and offers a 10 km run, Nordic walking and an evening run. The event takes place in the beautiful city of Pärnu and around its bridges, providing a sporting experience for participants of all ages. The event is organised by the Pärnu Two Bridges Club, which invites everyone to take part and enjoy being active.

name: Pärnu Õhtujooks ja Kahe Silla jooksu ratastoolisõit ja lastejooksud
description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional sporting event in Pärnu that brings together thousands of running enthusiasts on the first weekend of September. The event takes place in Vaasa Park and offers a range of distances and ways to take part, including an evening run, wheelchair race and children’s races. The Two Bridges Run is known for its beautiful route through the city and along the bridges, offering a sporting challenge and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants. The event is open to recreational and experienced runners alike and celebrates the joy of exercise and community spirit.

name: Bėgam už Kalvariją miesto gatvėmis XII
Sparkassen-City-Lauf Meppen
organizer: TV Meppen 1912 e.V. und SV Union Meppen 1947 e.V.
description: Der Sparkassen-City-Lauf Meppen ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf, der von den Vereinen TV Meppen 1912 e.V. und SV Union Meppen 1947 e.V. gemeinsam organisiert wird. Die Veranstaltung findet in der Innenstadt von Meppen statt und bietet Wettbewerbe für alle Altersklassen und Distanzen. Die Läuferinnen und Läufer erwartet ein abwechslungsreicher Kurs durch die Stadt mit motivierter Atmosphäre und zahlreichen Zuschauern. Die Abholung der Startunterlagen ist einige Tage vor dem Lauf möglich, Nachmeldungen sind vor Ort noch erlaubt.
course_highlights: Strecke führt durch die Meppener Innenstadt
Vielfältige Wettbewerbe für alle Altersklassen und Distanzen
Gemeinsame Organisation durch TV Meppen und SV Union Meppen
additional: Nachmeldungen sind persönlich in der Geschäftsstelle oder am Veranstaltungstag vor Ort möglich. Die Startunterlagen können ab dem 1. September während der Öffnungszeiten abgeholt werden. Am Veranstaltungstag ist die Abholung bis ca. 45 Minuten vor dem Start möglich. Die 5-km- und 10-km-Läufe zählen zur Laufserie Emsland (EL-Cup).

name: Wildman Harz
description: WILDMAN Harz is a challenging trail-running event around the mountain town of Wildemann in the Harz Mountains. The course features tough climbs, technical downhills, spruce forests and alpine meadows, offering an authentic trail-running experience in the Upper Harz. With distances from 1.5 km to 55 km, there is a suitable challenge for every trail runner. The event also features a varied program, including a pasta party and a barbecue party, making the weekend a special experience.
course_highlights: Tough climbs and technical downhills
Spruce forests and alpine meadows
Singletrack trails over rugged terrain around Wildemann
additional: Late registration is possible online up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late-registration fee of EUR 10. Age limits are defined for each course. The program includes a pasta party on Friday and a barbecue party on Saturday. There are race categories, mandatory equipment and aid stations. Registration is through the partner myRacePartner.com. Courses have up to 2,100 metres of elevation gain. Aid stations, timing, environmental and fair-play rules, a program including pasta and barbecue parties, and registration are required.

name: Borkumer Meilenlauf und Nordic Walking
location: Borkum, Nordseeinsel Borkum, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 20th Borkum Mile Run with Nordic Walking takes place on the North Sea island of Borkum. The varied routes lead through the island’s scenic beach and dune landscape and offer a suitable challenge for runners of all abilities, from the junior Pirate Run to the quarter marathon. The offshore climate and fresh sea air make the event a special experience, rounded off by an extensive programme for participants and their companions.
course_highlights: Routes through Borkum’s beach and dune landscape
Offshore climate and fresh sea air
A range of distances from the Pirate Run to the quarter marathon
additional: Late entries are possible on site on the day of the event up to 45 minutes before the start of the competition, for an additional fee of 5.00 EUR, but without entitlement to the full package of services or a T-shirt. Refreshments on the course and at the finish, changing rooms, bag storage, showers, and 90 minutes of free access to the Erlebnisdeck at Gezeitenland are included. Discounted ferry fares are also available on the event weekend. Routes along the promenade and beach; no age categories for Nordic Walking; refreshment stations on longer distances.

name: Fehmarn Marathon
description: The Fehmarn Marathon takes place annually on the island of Fehmarn and offers runners a varied route through the eastern part of the island. The main races follow roads, dike paths, and uneven country paths, providing a diverse running experience. The event starts at 9:30 a.m. at the sports ground at the Inselschule in Fehmarn. In addition to the marathon, there are other races with award ceremonies, and all participants receive an official marathon shirt. Timing is done using a foot chip attached to the running shoe, and the event takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Loops along roads, dike paths, and uneven country paths
Route through the eastern part of Fehmarn
Start and finish at the sports ground at the Inselschule
additional: Race number pickup is available the day before from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. and on the event day from 8:00 a.m. Award ceremonies take place after the races, staggered by race. Timing is done using a foot chip, which must be returned after the race; a fee of €15 is charged if it is lost. The event ends at approximately 3:15 p.m. with the arrival of the cyclist accompanying the final course sweep. Parking is recommended within walking distance of the start area. Late entries are possible until 30 minutes before the respective race. Shirts tend to run small, so larger sizes are recommended. The event takes place in all weather conditions; online registration is available, including running shirts and various categories.

name: Intern. Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run, organized by TSV Poggenhagen von 1946 e.V., is taking place. This traditional public race is scored in accordance with the German Athletics Regulations (DLO) and is recognized for all DLV public-race badges. Certificates are available for all placements for download online, and an awards ceremony will be held for the top three finishers in each category. A special prize will also be awarded to the largest registered group. Acceptance of the terms of participation and liability limitations is a prerequisite for taking part.

name: Volkslauf Eisbergen 2026
organizer: TuS Eisbergen TURN- UND SPIELVEREIN 1919 EISBERGEN e. V.
description: The Volkslauf Eisbergen is a long-standing running event in Porta Westfalica, offering various distances for children and adults. The course runs around the Eisbergen sports field and offers varied running options, with a 5.7 km Volkslauf and a 17.7 km long-distance race. Refreshments are also provided for participants, and the event is part of the Mühlenkreisserie. The course can also be viewed on Komoot, making it easy to prepare.

name: Volksbank Mitte Kurstadtlauf
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Kurstadtlauf in Heilbad Heiligenstadt is a longstanding race, taking place for the 27th time. The 19-kilometer route crosses the Dün and starts and finishes in the Vitalpark. A tree is planted for every participant to help reforest local woodlands, making the race particularly eco-friendly. The event offers a warm atmosphere and welcomes runners of all abilities.

name: 55. Brockenlauf
description: The Brockenlauf is Germany’s oldest mountain race and has been held annually in Ilsenburg in the Harz Mountains since 1927. The main 26.2 km course climbs 890 meters to the Brocken, the highest mountain in northern Germany, and offers a challenging experience with changeable high-mountain weather at the summit. The route passes through picturesque natural scenery and historic places, with impressive views. In addition to the main race, there are other shorter courses that also offer an experience in nature. The event is open to all runners, regardless of club membership.

name: Brokser Volkslauf
description: The Brokser Volkslauf takes place in Bruchhausen-Vilsen and offers running and walking events for all age groups. The event includes distances from 400 m to 20 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. Held in all weather, it offers participants a varied supporting program with a bouncy castle, drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The races start at the school and sports center, and children’s and youth races are rewarded with medals.

name: 46. Internationaler Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run invites all running enthusiasts to Poggenhagen. The event offers 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon races, all starting together. The scenic course runs around Poggenhagen, past the air base and as far as the bathing island in Steinhude. There are also 450 m and 850 m races for children. All races finish at the TSV Poggenhagen sports park.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
description: The International Race Walking Festival in Gdańsk is a prestigious sporting event that brings together competitors of different ages and skill levels. The festival features race walking events over 3 km, 5 km and 10 km, including the Polish Masters Championships and the Polish U23 Championships. The event also promotes physical activity among people with disabilities, offering wheelchair races and FrameRunning events. The festival also includes the open “Walk with the Postman” and the Defenders of the Polish Post Office Run, creating a sporting atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Race walking events over 3 km, 5 km and 10 km for different age categories
Polish Masters and U23 Race Walking Championships
Competition and activities for people with disabilities: wheelchair races and FrameRunning events
additional: Defenders of the Polish Post Office Energa Cup. The event promotes physical activity among people with disabilities by organizing parallel events adapted to their needs.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The XLVI Usedom Marathon is a unique race connecting two countries and offering unforgettable moments surrounded by nature. The route leads from Świnoujście along Europe’s longest seaside promenade, through the historic Kaiserbäder, coastal forests, and on to Wolgast. Runners will experience a variety of surfaces and landscapes, from asphalt and cobblestones to forest paths, with views of the Baltic Sea and a fresh sea breeze. The race starts at 9:00 in Świnoujście and finishes at Peene-Stadion in Wolgast, offering a unique sporting and maritime experience on the island of Usedom.
course_highlights: The route follows Europe’s longest seaside promenade
Varied surfaces: asphalt, cobblestones, and forest paths
Crossing the German-Polish border and views of the Baltic Sea
additional: Baggage transport to the finish stadium is provided. Time limits: runners must pass the Kölpinsee checkpoint (km 21.8) within 2:30 h and Zinnowitz (km 30) within 3:30 h. Runners who exceed the limits are withdrawn from the course and transported to the finish. After the time limits, there is no course support or refreshment stations.

name: XIV Grand Prix Nordic Walking Nowa Wieś Lęborska
Trondheim Maraton
distance_verbose: Maraton, Halvmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 0.6 km
description: Trondheim Marathon is Norway’s oldest marathon and is held annually on the first weekend of September in central Trondheim. The course runs through the city centre and offers beautiful, spectator-friendly surroundings, with the start and finish at Torvet. The event offers distances for all levels, from children’s races to the full marathon, and also includes relay races. The focus is on public health and the joy of running, with a wide range of training plans and support for participants throughout the year.
course_highlights: The course runs through central Trondheim, with the start and finish at Torvet
The full marathon consists of two laps; the half marathon is one lap
Scenic, spectator-friendly routes extend to Lade and Tempe
additional: Start and finish at Torvet in Trondheim. Relay races have four legs for both the half marathon (4 × 5 km) and the full marathon (4 × 10.55 km). All participants must have a licence, either an annual licence or a one-time licence purchased during registration. Bag storage is available inside City Hall. Pacers adjust their pace to the conditions and inclines. Medical support and first-aid training for race officials are provided. Participants must finish within the time limit to be recorded as having completed the race. The range of distances also includes the 2 km Children’s Marathon, the 600 m Children’s Mini Marathon, and relay races. The half-marathon relay has four 5 km legs, and the marathon relay has four 10.55 km legs.

name: Rødseterpytten Rundt 2027
description: Rødseterpytten Rundt 2027 is a running celebration for all ages in Asker, Akershus. The main race is a 9 km trail course for adults, with children’s races starting at 400 metres. The event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, and a kiosk will be open during the race. It offers an inclusive and enjoyable running experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 9 km trail course for adults
Children’s races starting at 400 metres
Suitable for both recreational and competitive running
additional: The race is organised by Tofte Fremad IF. A kiosk will be open.

name: Gå og løb med Støt Brysterne 5. sep. 2027
Ørestad Half Marathon & 10K
description: Flat half marathon and 10K by the sea on Kalvebod Fælled in Copenhagen. AIMS-certified course, starting and finishing at Naturcenter Amager, 5 minutes from Vestamager Metro. The course is flat, with only around 7 metres of elevation gain, and runs along the coast and through the nature reserve. In 2026, 801 runners from 50 nations finished. The entry fee includes chip timing, a medal and a digital diploma. There is room for around 1,000 runners.
additional: Half marathon starts at 10:00, 10K starts at 10:25. Start and finish: Naturcenter Amager, Granatvej 3, 2770 Kastrup. Price: half marathon DKK 495 (DKK 595 from 22/8-2027), 10K DKK 395 (DKK 495 from 22/8-2027).

images.alt_text: Løbere samlet ved startlinjen til Ørestad Half Marathon med race skilte og bib-numre.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Metsajooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Anija Parish, Estonia

name: Valmieras skrējiens
description: The Valmiera Run is an annual running event in Valmiera, offering various distances, including a half marathon and 10 km races. The races take place on certified courses, ensuring accurate distance measurements and a high standard of competition. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, offering the chance to enjoy running in a beautiful urban setting. The Valmiera Run is part of the Latvian athletics calendar and attracts participants from across Latvia.
course_highlights: Certified half-marathon and 10 km distances
The race takes place within the city of Valmiera
Precisely measured courses with an A-level certificate
additional: The courses are certified through 31.12.2027 with an A-level certificate issued by Arturs Onzuls. The event is part of the Latvian Athletics Association calendar and is organized in accordance with LAA regulations.

name: 16. Wardenburger Sommerlauf
description: The Wardenburg Summer Run is a long-standing race in Wardenburg that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 5 km to the 10-mile race; some start together and split at the Tillysee. The event focuses on fair, well-organized race management with chip timing and offers runners a varied route through the region. Children can take part in special untimed races, and Nordic walking is also on the program. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: The 10 km and 10-mile races start together and split at the Tillysee
Varied routes from 5 kilometers through the Wardenburg region
Timing with a chip integrated into the race bib
additional: No on-the-day entries are possible. Race bibs have an integrated chip; race bibs must be returned in the finish area. Running with dogs is not permitted. Baby joggers are allowed; participants with baby joggers should line up at the back. The Bambini run is without a race bib or timing. Toilets and changing rooms are available. Runners who exceed the 16:00 time limit will not be timed. Several distances; some races are not timed; participation is only permitted with a race bib; no on-the-day entries; organized via Laufmanager.

name: 8. Flensburg liebt dich Marathon
description: The Flensburg liebt dich Marathon offers a varied running experience, with routes through Flensburg’s modern and historic city center, along the Sonwik marina and by the harbor. The marathon consists of four 10.55 km laps with a maritime atmosphere and finishes at Südermarkt. There is also a half marathon over two laps of the same route, as well as other races, including a marathon relay, 10 km and 5 km races. The event sends a positive message about community and quality of life in the region and warmly welcomes runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Four 10.55 km laps through the city center, Sonwik marina and harbor
Flat roads along the Förde with a maritime atmosphere
Finish at Südermarkt in Flensburg
additional: Race packets are issued upon presentation of the digital registration confirmation or an identity document. The participant limit is 1,000 runners for the marathon and 2,000 for the half marathon. The awards ceremony takes place at Flensburg Galerie. For safety reasons, participation with electronic audio devices, walking poles, jogging strollers, pushchairs and animals is not permitted. Online registration only; race packet collection at Flensburg Galerie; various race distances, including a marathon relay, children’s races and trial training sessions.

name: DresdenHALF
location: Dresden city center, Dresden, Saxony, Germany
description: The DresdenHALF is an exciting half marathon that, for the first time, runs through the heart of Dresden. The 21.1-kilometer course follows the Elbe and passes some of the city’s most beautiful sights, with each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s partner cities. The event offers runners a unique experience amid a historic setting and international atmosphere. In addition to the half marathon, there are other races for children and recreational runners, making the weekend a special running experience.
course_highlights: 21.1 km through the heart of Dresden along the Elbe
Each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s 13 partner cities
Start at the World Trade Center Dresden, finish at the Saxon State Parliament
additional: The DresdenHALF starts at the World Trade Center Dresden and finishes at the Saxon State Parliament. The course is officially measured and eligible for rankings. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and the time limit is 3 hours. Every participant receives exclusive arm warmers and a finisher’s medal. The EWG Dresden5K includes an exclusive pom-pom beanie. Bib transfers are possible for a fee. All KidsRUN participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate. Officially measured course, minimum age 16, 3-hour time limit, merchandise and bib transfers available, including children’s races and pre-race events on September 5.

name: Schapener Volkslauf
description: The Schapen Volkslauf offers runners and walkers a choice of distances in a natural setting around the village of Schapen and the Riddagshausen ponds. The routes pass through idyllic woodland and pond landscapes, as well as historic places such as Schapen station. The 1.2 km route is especially family-friendly and is intended primarily for children and young people, accompanied by an adult. The event features a group warm-up, childcare and massages in exchange for a donation, and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running.
course_highlights: The 10.5 km route goes around the Riddagshausen ponds and through Buchhorst
The 6.1 km route passes Schäfer’s Ruh and the historic Schapen station
The 1.2 km route is for children and young people and can be completed once or twice
additional: Start times vary by route, from 9:15 a.m. to 10:20 a.m. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein 1921 Schapen e.V.

name: Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg
description: The Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg is a long-established running event held in Pinneberg. The event offers various distances for children, teenagers and adults, including a 1 km fun run for kindergarten children, a 2.5 km beginners’ and team run, and 5 km and 10 km courses for older participants. The races follow green loops through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark, with the start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark. The event is family-friendly, and spectators can watch and cheer on the children throughout the fun run.
course_highlights: Green loop through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark
Children’s fun run with 2 laps around Drosteipark
Start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark
additional: Late registration is available online until one hour before the start for a surcharge of €5.00. The team competition consists of 3 runners, whose individual times are added together; mixed teams are allowed. Online registration is available. Race bibs can be collected on September 4 and 5 at the VfL sports centre. Late registration is subject to a fee. The start and finish area is at Drosteiwiese.

name: Geithainer Herbstlauf
description: The Geithain Autumn Run is a family-friendly autumn race held at the Geithain Stadium in Geithain, Germany. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a 300 m Bambini Run, a 2.5 km Chestnut Run for children, a 7 km Fun Run, a 7 km walking route, and a 17 km scenic run for older participants and walkers. The start and finish are at the stadium, and the courses are GPS-measured and approved by the German Athletics Association. In addition to the races, there is a children’s programme, a bouncy castle, certificates, medals and small prizes. Every fifth finisher in races of 7 km or longer is rewarded with a bottle of sparkling wine.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Geithain Stadium
GPS-measured courses ranging from 0.3 km to 17 km
Family-friendly programme with children’s races and walking routes
additional: Every fifth finisher in the 7 km races or longer receives a bottle of sparkling wine. The event is organised by Impact Geithain e. V., with support from FSV Alemannia Geithain e. V. The children’s programme and bouncy castle are part of the event. The event includes children’s races, childcare, certificates, finisher medals, small prizes for children and a special bonus: every fifth finisher in the longer races receives a bottle of sparkling wine.

name: 10. Parchener Fiener-Cross
description: The Parchen Fiener Cross is a long-standing cross-country race in the Jerichower Land district, held in northern Saxony-Anhalt as part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP running series. The event attracts numerous runners of all ages each year and offers additional competitions, including the Heidel Team Cup and a family classification. The race takes place at the Klapperhalle on Parkstraße in Parchen and is known for its varied cross-country course. The event promotes running in the region and brings together sporting competition and a sense of community.

name: 15. Brunsberglauf
location: Holm-Seppensen, Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: Der Brunsberglauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung in Holm-Seppensen bei Buchholz, die jährlich am ersten Sonntag im September stattfindet. Angeboten werden verschiedene Streckenlängen von Kinderläufen bis zum Halbmarathon, die durch abwechslungsreiche Landschaften rund um den Brunsberg führen. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch eine familiäre Atmosphäre, eine professionelle Organisation von Läufern für Läufer und ein attraktives Rahmenprogramm aus. Für Verpflegung ist auf den langen Strecken mit Wasserstationen und im Ziel mit Tee und Sportgetränken gesorgt.
course_highlights: Strecken führen durch die abwechslungsreiche Landschaft rund um den Brunsberg
Kinderläufe finden auf dem Sportplatz statt
Wasserstationen auf den langen Strecken und Verpflegung im Ziel
additional: Der Transponder zur Zeitmessung wird kostenlos ausgeliehen und ist am Fußgelenk zu tragen. Bei Verlust wird eine Gebühr von 40 EUR erhoben. Es gibt eine Teamwertung auf den 5 km- und 11,7 km-Strecken mit mindestens vier Läufern. Nachmeldungen sind nur am Veranstaltungstag möglich und kosten 3 EUR Aufpreis. Umkleiden, Duschen und Sporttaschenaufbewahrung sind in der Sporthalle vorhanden.

name: 23. Schoninger Volkslauf
location: SC Schoningen Turnhalle, Schoningen, Uslar, Lower Saxony, Germany
distance_verbose: 24.3 km, 17 km, 11 km, 10 km, 9 km, 6 km, 5 km, 2.3 km
description: Der Schoninger-Volkslauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die jährlich in Schoningen stattfindet. Der Lauf lädt Laufbegeisterte, Wanderer, Familien und Sportneulinge ein, die schöne Natur rund um Schoningen aktiv zu erleben. Die Veranstaltung findet in der Turnhalle des SC Schoningen ihren Mittelpunkt und startet am Morgen. Es gibt verschiedene Strecken für alle Altersgruppen und Leistungsniveaus, sodass jeder teilnehmen kann.
course_highlights: Lauf durch die herrliche Natur rund um Schoningen
Strecken für Laufen, Wandern und Walking
Familienfreundliches Laufevent im Solling
additional: Es gibt Angebote für Laufen, Wandern und Walking. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Familien, Sportneulinge und erfahrene Läufer.

name: 37. CURREX Alsterlauf
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf is a traditional road race in Hamburg, held on a flat, traffic-free loop around the Inner and Outer Alster lakes. The event offers a unique start and finish atmosphere in Hamburg city center and is one of Europe’s largest 10-kilometer road races.
