In addition to the main 10 km race, there are also 5 km events, a schoolchildren’s race, and the R5K Tour for young runners. The courses are officially measured and ideal for fast times.

name: 6. Tuchmacher Stadtlauf
description: The Tuchmacher City Run in Bramsche is a popular event with several race distances that attracts numerous participants each year. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and varied route through the city center. The 10 km main race is particularly popular with competitive athletes, while the schoolchildren’s race draws a large field and creates a lively atmosphere. The Bramscher Rumläufer organize the event with great dedication, supported by local schools and sponsors.

name: R5K - 5K Alsterlauf Hamburg 2026
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf Hamburg is a traditional running event featuring officially measured, flat, paved courses along the Outer Alster and on Ballindamm. The event offers various distances, including 10 km, 5 km and children’s races, and is open to runners of different age groups. The races are traffic-free and safely supervised by police and race marshals. The Hamburg 10 km Road Championships are also held as part of the Alsterlauf.

name: Dörverden läuft 2026
description: The run in Dörverden is a versatile running event suitable for all ages and ability levels. The measured courses range from 1.8 km for walking and running to the 10 km main race, which consists of two 5 km laps. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes community sport in the Lower Saxony region. Races start in staggered intervals from 10:00 a.m., so every participant can find a suitable event.

name: Glomb City Marathon Bremerhaven
description: The GLOMB City Marathon Bremerhaven is an annual marathon in Bremerhaven, held since 2005. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon and a 10 km race. The course is a flat loop starting and finishing in front of the Bürgermeister-Smidt-Gedächtniskirche, and runs through the city center and Havenwelten. Runners enjoy an attractive route with many sights and a unique setting along the water and harbor facilities. The event is organized by the event agency Execute Sports Events, which ensures professional organization.

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
location: Obliwice, Nowa Wieś Lęborska, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: We invite you to the 44th International Open Cross-Country Race for the Forest Cup in memory of Tomasz Hopfer, which will take place in Obliwice. The main race course is 6.4 km long and consists of two 3.2 km loops, with the start and finish in the same place. The event has a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for the whole family amid nature. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and a track and field athlete, and also promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the local community.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is Poland’s oldest continuously held 10-kilometre road race, taking place in Gdańsk. The race starts at the historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The course is certified and marked every kilometre, and the finish is at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, providing an extra attraction for participants. The event attracts up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Defenders of the Coast in 1939.

name: VII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Zblewo
location: Twardy Dół, Zblewo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: X Bieg Neptuna
location: Trzebież, Police County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
price_range: 350 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (preliminära uppgifter för 2027)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: därefter sker en höjning på 50 kr (400 kr)

description: Blodomloppet i Eskilstuna är ett motionslopp som uppmärksammar den livsviktiga blodgivningen. Deltagarna kan välja att gå, jogga eller springa 5 km eller 10 km, antingen individuellt eller i lag. Loppet startar och slutar i Stadsparken och bjuder på en vacker bana längs åpromenaden och stadens gator. Det finns även ett Lilla Blodomloppet och Specialomloppet för de som vill delta på kortare distanser. Blodomloppet är en social och hälsosam aktivitet som avslutas med en gemensam picknick för deltagarna.
course_highlights: Start och mål i Stadsparken, Eskilstuna
5 km och 10 km banor längs åpromenaden och stadens gator
Kontrollmätt 5 000 m bana av SFIF Förbundsbanmätare
additional: Anmälan kan göras individuellt eller i lag om 3-5 deltagare med picknick för 5 personer inkluderad. Lagdeltagare kan delta i olika distanser/klasser (ej Lilla Blodomloppet). Sista dag att anmäla lag är 31/8. Lilla Blodomloppet och Specialomloppet startar i Stadsparken med kortare banor inne i parken. Banan är kontrollmätt och tidtagning sker på 5 km och 10 km distanserna. Lilla Blodomloppet är för barn upp till 12 år; Specialomloppet är 1,5 - 3 km.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/eskilstuna/): 2027-09-06 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 6 september 2027" (was estimated 2027-09-06)

name: Varden Opp 2027
description: Varden Opp is an uphill race from central Molde to the Varden viewpoint. The listed course is 3.8 kilometres long with 404 metres of elevation gain. The start is at PLASSEN, at the bottom of the stairs.
course_highlights: 3.8 km uphill from central Molde to Varden
404 metres of elevation gain
Start at PLASSEN, at the bottom of the stairs
additional: The 2026 edition was cancelled.

name: Namdalskarusellen 2027 løp 7 - Klompen opp
description: Namdalskarusellen 2027 Race 7 – Klompen Up takes place in Namsos and offers an exciting cross-country race for runners looking for a challenging and sociable running experience. The event takes place on Tuesday, 28 September 2027, with a start time of 15:00. The race is part of Namdalskarusellen, a popular regional race series that brings together local and visiting runners. Participants can look forward to a great day of running through varied terrain and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through varied natural terrain
Held in Namsos, with a map and directions available
Part of the popular Namdalskarusellen race series
additional: Tickets are sold through EQ Timing via the Aett platform. The event runs from 15:00 to 21:00. Tickets can be purchased via a link on the event page. Frequently asked questions are often available for participants. Registration is via EQ Timing.

name: Self-Transcendence 2 mailin juoksu, Vaasa
description: Self-Transcendence 2 Mile Run Vaasa takes place every Tuesday from May to September at 19:00 on the Hietalahti Peace Mile. The route is a 1-mile park course, run twice. The start and registration are behind the swimming pool. The run offers a fast and pleasant park route suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus, Skärblacka, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sverige
description: Skärblackaloppet är ett årligt stadslopp som går genom vackra Skärblacka i Östergötland. Loppet erbjuder en folkfest där alla kan delta, oavsett om man väljer att springa 6 km, gå 4 km eller heja på vid sidan av. Banan går på asfalt, cykelvägar, grus och delvis stig med start och mål vid Folkets Hus. Det finns fina priser och spännande inslag som Mericonspurten och prisutdelningar för både löpare och gående.
course_highlights: 6 km löpning genom Skärblacka på asfalt, cykelvägar, grus och stig
4 km gåklass utan tidtagning med start och mål vid Folkets Hus
Mericonspurten sista 300 meter med chans till presentkort
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas hos ICA Supermarket i Skärblacka tisdagen innan loppet mellan 11-18 eller vid Folkets Hus senast en timme före start. Efteranmälan kan göras vid nummerlappsutdelningen och på tävlingsdagen mot förhöjd avgift. Det finns pris till de snabbaste löparna, presentkort för Mericonspurten, samt priser för att plocka upp trimmers och däck längs banan. Gåklassen är utan tidtagning och hundar är inte tillåtna. Funktionär med lättare vård finns på plats. Det finns även en 4 km-klass för gång.

name: Blodslitet
description: Blodslitet is an international ultra-long-distance orienteering race and a long-standing season finale in Norway, organized annually by Fredrikstad Ski Club. The race offers challenging and varied courses in beautiful terrain, with mass starts in all classes, including the Norwegian Ultra-Long-Distance Championships. The terrain at Gillingsrød consists of open spruce and pine forest, marshland, and demanding hilly sections, and is suitable for elite athletes, recreational runners, and young participants alike. Blodslitet is known for its lively arena atmosphere and exciting battles on the course.
course_highlights: Ultra-long-distance race with mass starts in all classes
Varied terrain featuring spruce and pine forest, marshland, and hilly sections
New orienteering map at a scale of 1:15000, 1:10000, or 1:7500
additional: Parking is available in fields 200–700 meters from the arena, with a parking fee of 75 NOK payable via Vipps. Race office with collection of bib numbers and maps. EmiTag is used for timing; rental of an EmiTag costs 50 NOK. Kiosk serving food and drinks, as well as sports equipment for sale at the arena. Childcare and a Småtroll program are available. Poor mobile coverage, but a guest network from NOF is available. First aid at the arena. Start and finish at the arena, with mass starts in all classes.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Tverrløpet
location: Kleivbakken above Håkons Hall, Lillehammer, Norway
description: Sørdalskarusellen - Tverrløpet is the season finale of Sørdalskarusellen, a series of ten recreational races held from April to September. The race is suitable for everyone, regardless of fitness, age or ambitions, and focuses on the joy of running, community and personal achievement. The event offers an enjoyable race experience with a mass start and the option to run virtually. The start is at Kleivbakken above Håkons Hall in Lillehammer, and the distance is approximately 3.9 km.
course_highlights: Approximately 3.9 km course
Start at Kleivbakken above Håkons Hall in Lillehammer
Season finale of Sørdalskarusellen, with a mass start
additional: You can participate virtually from 5 to 8 September. The race is part of a series of ten recreational races suitable for all levels and ages. The organisers are Innlandet Corporate Sports Association and Tele BIL. The event emphasises the joy of running, community and personal achievement. Tverrløpet can also be completed virtually. The listed 2027 event is dated 8 September, but the date and time of the mass start should be confirmed with the organisers’ latest information.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 4 etapas
description: The Ukmergė Factory Cross-Country Cup 2026 is a five-stage sporting event featuring cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling, and rogaining competitions. The event encourages active leisure in nature and promotes sport among participants of all ages. The competitions take place in Ukmergė, and the main organizer is the public institution Sportas miške. Participants compete by age group and event type, with a mass start for all groups. The time limit for the competitions is 120 minutes, except for Mini Rogaining.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 6. etapp
description: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 6. etapp on jooksu- ja kepikõnniüritus, mis toimub Tervise- ja suusarajal ümber Viljandi järve. See sarjaetapp pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida kaunist järveäärset maastikku ning tervisesporti meeldivas seltskonnas. Üritus on osa traditsioonilisest jooksusarjast, mis ühendab Viljandimaa jooksuhuvilisi.
course_highlights: Tervise- ja suusarada ümber Viljandi järve
Kaunis järveäärne maastik
Sobib nii jooksjatele kui kepikõndijatele

name: Sormlands 100 Trail Run
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run är ett löpevenemang som bjuder på en unik upplevelse genom en av Sveriges mest biologiskt mångfaldiga regioner. Loppen sträcker sig från 8 km upp till 100 miles och går på en blandning av skogsstigar, tekniska kustleder och snabba partier. Tävlingen välkomnar löpare i alla åldrar och nivåer och erbjuder en minnesvärd helg i Nävekvarn med vacker natur och utmanande terräng.
course_highlights: Blandning av skogsstigar, tekniska kustleder och snabba partier
Olika distanser från 8 km till 100 miles
Vacker och biologiskt mångfaldig region längs Sörmlandsleden
additional: Alla distanser är cupless, deltagarna måste ta med egen kopp för dryck. Efter loppet finns tillgång till bastu och Nävekvarn Folkets Park. Välutrustade vätskestationer med bland annat Coca-Cola, Umara, kaffe och lokalproducerad mat. GPS-spårning och live-resultat erbjuds. Obligatorisk utrustningslista varierar per distans, inklusive mobiltelefon, navigationsverktyg, första hjälpen-kit och pannlampa för längre distanser. Transport från målet erbjuds för 50 km-distansen med buss till Nyköping Centralstation. Lopphelgen pågår 10 - 12 september 2027. Anmälan öppnar 1 december.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sverige
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run är ett ultralopp som bjuder på en unik upplevelse genom en av Sveriges mest artrika regioner. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser från 8 km upp till 100 miles, med varierande terräng som inkluderar skogsstigar, tekniska kustleder och snabba partier. Tävlingen välkomnar löpare i alla åldrar och nivåer och lovar en minnesvärd dag i vacker och utmanande natur. Efter loppet finns tillgång till bastu och lokalt producerad mat och dryck i Nävekvarn Folkets Park.
course_highlights: Blandning av skogsstigar, tekniska kustleder och snabba partier
Vackra och utmanande trailsträckor i Sörmlandsleden
Välförsedda vätskestationer med varierad energi och dryck
additional: Alla distanser är cupless, deltagarna måste ta med egen kopp för dryck. Obligatorisk utrustning inkluderar bland annat GPS-tracker, mobiltelefon med viktiga nummer, första hjälpen-kit, regnjacka och pannlampa med extra batterier. Välförsedda vätskestationer finns längs banan med bland annat Coca-Cola, Umara, kaffe, frukt, chips och lokala specialiteter. Efter loppet erbjuds tillgång till bastu och lokalt producerad mat och alkoholfri öl. Transport från målet för 50 km-loppet erbjuds med shuttlebusser till Nyköping Centralstation.

name: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt 9. løp 2027
description: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt is a traditional fun run organized by Osterøy IL Friidrett. The race follows a 4.4 km course, starting and finishing at Furubakken sports ground in Valestrandsfossen. There are two start times: walkers at 18:45 and the main field at 19:00. Participants can enjoy a friendly, inclusive atmosphere, with prizes, squash and sveler served after the race. The event is part of a series of races held throughout the year, and course records are rewarded with cash prizes.
course_highlights: 4.4 km course around Valestrandsmarka
Start and finish at Furubakken sports ground
Two start times: walkers at 18:45 and the main field at 19:00
additional: HTB awards NOK 3,000 for course records. Sveler from Toro and squash from Saftsuse are served after the race. Registration is at Furubakken sports ground until the start. The race is part of a series of events throughout the year, including a Christmas race and a New Year's race. No race licence is required. The walking group is recorded as taking 30 minutes or more.

name: Finlandiaviesti
location: Jyväskylä, Rantaraitti, Jyväskylä, Central Finland, Finland
description: The event offers runners a range of distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, and a marathon, and is suitable for runners of all levels. The route follows Jyväskylä’s Rantaraitti, which has been awarded Finland’s most beautiful transport route, offering a flat and fast running experience. Finlandia Marathon is known for its runner-friendly route, excellent atmosphere, and memorable event weekend amid the beautiful scenery of Central Finland.

name: Emder Sparkassen Delftlauf
description: The Emder Sparkassen Delftlauf takes place at Hafentor in Emden and is organized by Emder Laufgemeinschaft e.V. The event offers 6-kilometer and 10-kilometer runs, as well as 6-kilometer walking/Nordic walking. The course runs through the city of Emden and is conducted according to the International Competition Rules. Timing is done with a chip provided by the organizer, and certificates are awarded to the three fastest women and men. The race is open to everyone, including unaffiliated participants.

name: Lauf der Bildung Aschersleben
description: The Lauf der Bildung in Aschersleben is a family-friendly city race on Friday evening, starting and finishing at Augustapromenade. The course passes through the historic city wall area and offers distances of 2.3 km, 4.6 km and 9.2 km for children, recreational runners and ambitious runners completing multiple laps. The event is part of the Solvay Cup and attracts both club runners and local families. The atmosphere is small and welcoming, and the event is well organised by the Kreisvolkshochschule Aschersleben.

name: MOSSARUN
description: Mossarun är ett litet, välkomnande välgörenhetslopp i södra Sverige med fokus på tekniska singeltracks och gemenskap framför prispengar. Huvudformatet är en 17 km-loop som används av 24h-ultran; det finns även 51 km och ett barnlopp. Banans karaktär är teknisk och kuperad med många små, branta kullar och mestadels singeltrack. Arrangörerna betonar enkelhet, hållbarhet och att en stor del av avgiften går till välgörenhet.
course_highlights: 17 km loop - används för 24h-ultra (51 km = 3 varv)
Cirka 500 m höjdmeter per varv (enligt barometriska klockor)
90% singeltrack, 10% grus; teknisk terräng med många små backar
additional: Boende: möjlighet att sova i ladan (20 - 30 platser) eller i tält på området; för- och efterloppets sociala inslag include lägereld, BBQ/pizza. Wood-fired pizza säljs (100 - 120 kr, 13:00 - 15:00). 24h-löpare passerar baslägret varje varv; särskilda moment för 24h ("chainsaw segment") - se tävlingsregler. Arrangemanget erbjuder separata toaletter/omklädningsrum och tillgång till mensprodukter; stöd för att hitta nattkompis för mörka varv. Swish-donation till WAR Child 900 55 47 (skriv "mossarun"); alternativt gör donation via respektive NGO:s webbplats. Registrering kräver bevis på donation till War Child eller annan NGO; evenemanget inkluderar möjlighet till flera distanser och ett barnvänligt spår.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet är ett välrenommerat lopp som arrangeras av Åtvidabergs IF sedan 1983. Loppet bjuder på en varierad bana med asfalt, grusvägar och skogsstigar i naturskön och lagom kuperad terräng runt Bysjön i Åtvidaberg. Start och mål är vid Edbergavallen, och loppet erbjuder flera distanser för både barn och vuxna, med tidtagning på de flesta. Det är en familjevänlig och inkluderande tävling med medaljer till alla som fullföljer samt speciella minnesmedaljer för trogna deltagare.
course_highlights: Omväxlande underlag: asfalt, grusvägar och skogsstigar
Naturskön terräng runt Bysjön med måttlig kupering
Terrängspår och elljusspår i 10 km-klassen som är utmanande
additional: Starttider: 700 m kl 11:30, 1,3 km kl 11:40, 5 km och 10 km kl 13:00. Nummerlappar hämtas från kl 10:00 på tävlingsdagen vid Edbergavallen. Omklädning, dusch och toaletter finns vid Kanonvallen. Kiosk med varm korv, dryck och godis finns på tävlingsområdet. Lag består av 4-6 deltagare i valfria klasser och får en picknickkasse från ICA Supermarket att dela efter målgång. Efteranmälan är möjlig på plats från kl 10:00 med swish eller kontanter, dock inga rabattkoder vid efteranmälan på plats. Loppet har traditionellt arrangerats den andra lördagen i september och erbjuder distanser för barn och vuxna.

name: Norasjön Runt
description: Norasjön Runt är ett klassiskt halvmaraton i Nora med en lång tradition som sträcker sig tillbaka till 1929. Banan går runt Norasjön och bjuder på omväxlande natur med skog, öppna fält och passager över åar. Loppet välkomnar både tävlingslöpare och motionärer.
course_highlights: Halvmaratonbana runt Norasjön
Omväxlande natur med skog och öppna fält
Passager över åar
additional: Loppet har arrangerats sedan 1929.

name: Hagenloppet
description: Hagenloppet är ett traditionellt löplopp som arrangeras i Billingen, Skövde. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser, inklusive 8,8 km, 4,4 km, 2,5 km samt ett knattelopp för de yngsta deltagarna. Banan är publikvänlig och består av två loopar med start och mål vid skidstadion. Loppet präglas av en härlig löparglädje och har en lång historia med många deltagare från olika åldersgrupper.
course_highlights: Banan är 4,4 km lång och består av två loopar
Start och mål vid skidstadion på Billingen
Publikvänlig bana med tydliga markeringar och funktionärer
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas på skidstadion från 10:00 och senast 30 minuter före start. Tidtagning sker med chip som är fastsatt på nummerlappen. Vätska finns vid varvning och målgång. Medalj till alla som fullföljer. Priser delas ut till snabbaste löpare i olika klasser. Efteranmälan är möjlig på tävlingsdagen från 10:00 till 45 minuter före start. Servering finns i anslutning till målet. Parkering sker vid stora parkeringen på Billingens Fritidsområde.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna StadsTrail är ett motionslopp som erbjuder en unik naturupplevelse och utmaning med tre distanser: 5, 10 och 21 km. Loppet bjuder på varierad terräng med allt från asfalt till slingrande stigar genom bokskog och upp på Grännabergets topp. Start och mål är centralt placerade på Gränna torg, där deltagarna får njuta av vackra vyer över Vättern och en gemensam start. Alla deltagare får en unik medalj och tidtagning sker på samtliga distanser. Loppet passar både nybörjare och erfarna löpare som vill kombinera prestation med naturupplevelse.
course_highlights: 21 km bana med blandning av asfalt, trail och grusvägar
Passage genom bokskog och upp på Grännabergets topp
Start och mål på Gränna torg med vyer över Vättern
additional: Gemensam start från Gränna torg genom staden till hamnen där tidtagning börjar. Arenan ligger mitt i Gränna med närhet till butiker, fik och boenden. Banorna kan komma att förändras beroende på förutsättningar och tillstånd. Tidtagning och medalj vid målgång.

name: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra
location: Ästad Vingård, Tvååker, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sverige
description: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra är ett unikt trailrace som hålls vid Ästad Vingård. Loppet följer en 6,7 km lång rundbana i vackra omgivningar med start varje hel timme. Deltagarna springer varv efter varv tills endast en löpare återstår, vilket skapar en spännande och utmanande tävlingsform. Evenemanget erbjuder en härlig atmosfär och möjligheten att njuta av Ästad Vingårds natursköna miljö under en hel helg.
course_highlights: 6,7 km lång rundbana i Ästad Vingårds vackra omgivningar
Start varje hel timme med varvning tills endast en löpare återstår
Natursköna vyer med bokskogar, granskogar och mossar
additional: Start sker varje hel timme från kl. 09:00. Den som inte hinner runt banan till nästa start är ute ur loppet. Loppet fortsätter tills endast en deltagare är kvar som springer ett avslutande eget varv. Banan är en varvbana vilket ökar säkerheten och gör loppet publikvänligt samt möjliggör utrustningsbyte vid varvning. Arrangemanget uppmuntrar till gemenskap och respekt för naturen. Första starten är klockan 09.00. Loppet pågår tills en deltagare återstår och den löparen springer ett avslutande varv.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM är ett traillopp i södra Stockholms vackra och mäktiga naturreservat Paradiset. Loppet erbjuder utmanande terränglöpning på slingrande stigar, över myrar och spångar, där löparna får uppleva både skog, fjäll och hav. Distanserna är 26 km, 13 km och 6 km, och 26 km-distansen är en deltävling i Outnorth Trailtour. Loppet präglas av en stark gemenskap och en festlig stämning efter målgången.
course_highlights: Vacker vild terräng med berghällar och öppen tallskog
Små vindlande stigar, myrar och spångar
26 km distansen är deltävling i Outnorth Trailtour
additional: Loppet erbjuder tre distanser: 26 km, 13 km och 6 km. Terrängen är krävande och ger en stark känsla av prestation. 26 km. Loppet ingår i Outnorth Trailtour.

name: Södra änggårdsloppet
description: Södra Änggårdsloppet är ett traillopp på 8 km med 310 höjdmeter genom den natursköna miljön i Änggårdsbergen. För tredje året i rad bjuder arrangörerna in till en löparfest med en bana som passar både tävlingsinriktade och motionärer tack vare uppdelade startgrupper. Evenemanget erbjuder en festlig atmosfär med rökfyrverkerier, foodtrucks, DJ och aktiviteter för familj och vänner. Deltagarna får en fin medalj, bubbel vid incheckning och alkoholfri öl vid målgång. Loppet arrangeras av WAI AB och är ett tillfälle för både löpare och publik att njuta av traillöpning i Göteborgsområdet.
course_highlights: 8 km traillopp med 310 höjdmeter
Banan går genom Änggårdsbergen natursköna miljö
Startfältet delas upp i grupper för både tävlingsinriktade och motionärer
additional: Startfältet delas upp i grupper för att skapa en bekväm upplevelse för både tävlingsinriktade och motionärer. Det finns bubbel vid incheckning och alkoholfri öl vid målgång. Evenemanget inkluderar rökfyrverkerier, foodtrucks och DJ för en festlig stämning. Tidigare upplagor har haft foodtrucks, DJ, rökfyrverkerier samt medalj och dryck till deltagarna.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet är ett familjevänligt tävlings- och motionslopp som arrangerats sedan 2007 i Saltsjö-Duvnäs. Loppet är främst avsett för boende i Nacka, Värmdö och Saltsjöbaden men välkomnar även andra deltagare. Start och mål är i Ringparken, och loppet har en stark lokal förankring med fokus på att behålla sin karaktär som ett familjeevenemang för alla åldrar. 2027 firar loppet 20 år med nya startklasser och fortsatt gemenskap för grannar och löpare.
course_highlights: Start och mål vid Ringparken i Saltsjö-Duvnäs
Banor på 1,7 km, 5 km och 10 km (10 km är två varv av 5 km-banan)
Banan inkluderar varierande terräng med backar, strandpromenad och vyer runt Duvnäs Udde
additional: Tidtagarchip är numera integrerat i startnummerlappen. Sekretariatet öppnar dagen före och på tävlingsdagen. Loppet har begränsat antal deltagare för att behålla familjekänslan. Knatteloppet har en egen kort bana runt Ringparken.

name: Innovationsstafetten
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park och Medicon Village
description: Innovationsstafetten är en stafett med lag om 2 - 4 personer som går av stapeln i Nobelparken på Brunnshög i Lund. Banan är cirka 5,4 km lång och slingrar sig genom områden som ESS och Kunskapsparken med en blandning av asfalt och grus. Stafetten är en del av Innovationsloppet & stafetten där deltagarna tillsammans kickstartar hösten med en energiboost i en härlig och inkluderande atmosfär. Loppen hyllar Lund som innovationsstad och arrangeras i samarbete mellan IFK Lund Friidrott och Ideon Science Park.
course_highlights: Banan är cirka 5,4 km och går från Nobelparken via ESS och Kunskapsparken
Blandat underlag med asfalt och grus, samt en flack bana med cirka 10 meters höjdskillnad
Utsikt över nordvästra Lund från en kulle i Kunskapsparken
additional: Stafettlagen kan vara dam-, herr- eller mixedlag med 2 - 4 personer där dubblering av löpare är möjlig. Start och mål är i Nobelparken på Brunnshög. Stafetten startar 15 minuter före det individuella loppet. Efter målgång kan deltagarna välja mellan medalj eller korv. Det finns goda kommunikationsmöjligheter med spårvagn och buss till tävlingsområdet. Lag tävlar i dam-, herr- eller mixedklass. Varje löpare springer ungefär 5 km.

name: Enköpingsloppet
description: Enköpingsloppet är en årlig löparfest i Enköping som samlar hundratals löpare från hela Sverige. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser för motionärer på alla nivåer, från barnlopp till längre mil-lopp, och är en folkfest för hela staden. Banorna är natursköna och platta, med vackra vyer över parker och vattenområden i Enköping. Det finns gemensam uppvärmning, musik och hejarop längs banan samt målservice med återhämtningsdryck och snacks.
course_highlights: Vacker två varvs-bana runt Drömparken (5,5 km)
Platt och naturskön 10 km-bana genom Enköping, kontrollmätt av Svenska Friidrottsförbundet
Vattenstation halvvägs på 10 km-banan, musik och hejarop längs vägen
additional: Gemensam uppvärmning ca 15 min innan start på respektive lopp. Målservice med återhämtningsdryck och snacks till alla löpare. Resultatservice med sluttid direkt på webben efter målgång. Evenemangsområdet öppnar 10:00 på ENA-vallens IP. Starttider: 11:00 Ajabaja Cancer-loppet (barnlopp), 12:30 APC-loppet (5,5 km), 14:00 ICA Maxi-milen (10 km). Prisutdelningar sker efter respektive lopp. Evenemangsområdet ligger vid ENA-vallens IP. Den officiella webbplatsens uppgifter om 2027 anger ett annat loppdatum än det angivna datumet 11 september.

name: Hogialoppet 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deltagaravgiften är 100 kronor per vuxen vid anmälan till klasserna DAM och HERR

description: Hogialoppet är ett motionslopp i Stenungsund som fokuserar på rörelseglädje och gemenskap. Deltagarna kan välja att springa, jogga eller promenera på två olika distanser, cirka 3,1 km eller 6,5 km. Loppet välkomnar alla, inklusive barn, hundar och deltagare med barnvagn eller stavar. Eventområdet erbjuder aktiviteter och underhållning för hela familjen under tävlingsdagen.
course_highlights: Banan är cirka 6,5 km lång och går från Hogia, över Hallerna till Kyrkenorum och längs Ucklumsvägen tillbaka
Vätskestation finns efter cirka 3 km
Målgång på eventområdet med vatten och frukt till deltagarna
additional: Startfältet delas upp så att deltagare med stavar, hundar eller barnvagnar ställer sig längre bak för att undvika trängsel. Nummerlappar kan hämtas från kl 09:00. Eventområdet är öppet 09:30-13:30 och erbjuder tipspromenad med frågor för både vuxna och barn. Det går bra att delta med barnvagn, hund eller stavar. För 2026 års lopp anges att vuxenavgiften går oavkortat till BRIS. Hundar, barnvagnar och gångstavar är tillåtna. Loppet har även haft ett kortare barnlopp.

name: Innovationsloppet
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott och Ideon Science Park
description: Innovationsloppet & stafetten är ett löpevenemang som äger rum i Nobelparken på Brunnshög i Lund. Loppet erbjuder en individuell 11 km distans eller en stafett med 4 sträckor om 5,5 km vardera. Banan slingrar sig genom områden som ESS och Kunskapsparken och bjuder på en flack och varierad terräng med asfalt och grus. Evenemanget hyllar Lund som en innovationsstad och är öppet för både dam-, herr- och mixedlag i stafetten samt individuella löpare. Start och mål är centralt placerade i Nobelparken med goda kommunikationer via spårvagn och buss.
course_highlights: Banan är cirka 5,4 km per varv med två varv för individuella löpare
Terrängen är flack med cirka 10 meters höjdskillnad och består av asfalt och grus
Utsikt över nordvästra Lund från en kulle i Kunskapsparken
additional: Stafettlagen består av 2 - 4 personer och kan vara dam-, herr- eller mixedlag. Vid färre än 4 personer i laget måste dubblering ske. Stafetten startar 15 minuter före det individuella loppet. Efter målgång kan deltagarna välja mellan medalj eller korv. Startavgiften omfattar startplats, nummerlapp med tidtagning och medalj eller korv efter målgång. Deltagare väljer medalj eller korv vid anmälan.

name: Spåkefjellet Opp
location: Arna Stadion, Ytre Arna, Bergen, Norway
description: Spåkefjellet Opp is an uphill race in Ytre Arna, starting at “Poteten” and finishing at the top of Spåkefjellet. The course is approximately one kilometre long, and the event at Arna Stadium also features children’s races. Children and adults alike are invited to an active day of running with Arna Turn and Idrettslag.
course_highlights: Approximately one kilometre uphill from “Poteten” to the top of Spåkefjellet
Children’s races of 200 and 600 metres
Race-day start and gathering point at Arna Stadium in Ytre Arna

name: Kongskleiva Opp
description: Kongskleiva is Bekkjarvik’s most popular hike, a refreshing and scenic walk that rewards you with a 360-degree view from the top of Kongsfjellet. The route passes through beautiful countryside along a superb Sherpa trail and includes a stop at Taushaugen, with views over Bekkjarvik. It’s an ideal outing for both exercise and enjoying nature, where you may spot local wildlife such as sea eagles and wild sheep. For the fittest, there is an official record time of an impressive 05:31.
course_highlights: A superb Sherpa trail through beautiful countryside
360-degree views from the top of Kongsfjellet
A chance to see sea eagles and wild sheep
additional: Parking is limited at the start of Kongskleivo; parking at Selbjørn Primary School, Bekkjarvik Torg or Leirvikjo is recommended. The hike can start from Bekkjarvik Torg or Leirvikjo and includes steps leading to the top. It suits all fitness levels if you adjust your pace. Kongskleiva Opp is listed as 5 km. A results overview for 2026 lists the race as cancelled.

name: Grimstad Maraton
price_range: Gratis barneløp; 250–600 kr for individuelle distanser; maratontrippel 950 kr; stafett 300 kr per deltaker

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Avgift: 250,- Passer for deg som vil løpe eller gå uten tidtaking.

description: Grimstad Marathon is an inclusive running festival held on 11 September 2027 in beautiful Grimstad. The event is suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and offers distances from a 3 km fun run to a full half marathon, including a relay and a triple challenge. The start and finish are at Grimstad Library in the town garden, and the course features scenic surroundings, including streets in the town centre and cheering spectators. All participants receive medals, and there is also a free children’s race, Sparrisløpet.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Grimstad Library – Byhaven
The course passes through beautiful Groos and charming town-centre streets
Pace setters for the 10 km and half marathon at various finish times
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the Library in Byhaven on Friday from 16:00 to 18:00 and on Saturday from 08:00. Changing facilities and storage lockers are available; bring your own padlock. EQ Timing handles registration, payment, timing and results. The 10 km and half marathon have pace setters for various finish times. The 3 km fun run is suitable for running or walking and is not timed. The 3 km distance is untimed and can be run or walked.

name: Nærsnes Backyard
description: Nærsnes Backyard is a social, accessible race held in Nærsnes, Asker. It is suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and has both a children’s course and a longer adults’ course. The event focuses on participation and inclusion, and aims to be climate-neutral. It is a pleasant day with activities for the whole family, including a market, bouncy castle and face painting.
course_highlights: The course starts at the sports field and follows footpaths, trails and gravel roads in the area around Nærsnes.
Includes a steep hill of approximately 500 metres leading up to a farm.
Finishes with a lap of the football field and a finish beneath the finish arch.
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Sport1 (Rortunet) in the days before the race. The children’s race starts at 12:15, with a medal and ice cream from Joker Nærsnes. Activities include a market, bouncy castle, face painting and Wipe out for children and adults. The evening ends with lit fire pans from 19:00 to 23:00. Registration for 2027 is mentioned on the organiser’s website.

name: Oslos bratteste
description: Oslos Bratteste is a challenging uphill race in Oslo that starts at the bottom of Wyllerløypa and climbs 407 metres of elevation to the top by Tryvannstårnet. The course is 2.7 km long and features a demanding climb, including sections such as “Helveteskneika” and a final steep uphill with a gradient of almost 20%. The race is for everyone, whether you compete in the timed race class or choose the Flex class for a more relaxed experience. All participants receive a medal, a Rab hat/headband, a drinking cup and a race bib, and there is a prize draw with great prizes. The event has a social and inclusive feel and encourages public transport and a sense of community.
course_highlights: 2.7 km course with 407 metres of elevation gain
The steepest section, “Helveteskneika,” comes after 400 metres and climbs 80 metres
Final 630-metre uphill with an average gradient of almost 20%
additional: Wave starts, with the first wave at 14:00 and subsequent waves every 5 minutes. Warm-up before the start. Bags can be dropped off at the top or transported from the start by baggage vehicles. Water stations along the course. An after-run with food and drinks is recommended at Vidsjå. Participants are encouraged to use public transport, with extra services scheduled.

name: TFS FrontYard Festningen
description: TFS FrontYard Festningen is a unique race held at the historic Kristiansten Fortress in Trondheim. The race consists of a challenging 3 km loop course, with each lap needing to be run faster than the previous one, creating an exciting and tactical competition. The event offers a lively atmosphere, with the option to set up your own camp, and food and drinks available for both participants and spectators. This race is for anyone looking for a fun and challenging experience in the city's most iconic surroundings.
course_highlights: 3 km loop course at Kristiansten Fortress
Start and finish inside the fortress
Challenging race with the pace increasing each lap
additional: On race day, participants are advised to arrive well before the start. You can set up your own camp on Friday evening. Food and drinks are sold on site, but you must bring your own race nutrition or buy it at race bib collection. There is no parking at the fortress, and participants are encouraged to use public transport, cycle or walk. Spectators can follow the race live via RaceTracker. Camps can be set up from Friday evening. Parking is not available at the Fortress; the organizer encourages people to walk, cycle or use public transport. Registration via RaceTracker.

name: Jentebølgen - Steinkjer
description: Jentebølgen in Steinkjer is an inclusive race for girls and women of all ages, held as part of the Vi bryr oss race. The event brings participants together for an energising experience focused on achievement, community and mental health. The race takes place at Steinkjer Torg and offers a welcoming setting for being active with friends, family and colleagues. Participation also supports Mental Helse Ungdom through a contribution for each race entry sold.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Steinkjer Torg
Focus on community, achievement and mental health
Open to girls and women of all ages
additional: The race entry includes access to the race, insurance and ticket fees. The event supports Mental Helse Ungdom with NOK 10 for each race entry sold. The race is a meeting place focused on safety, inclusion, entertainment and activities. A previous local “Vi bryr oss” race listing stated that 50% of ticket revenue goes to Mental Helse Ungdom.

name: Trolljegerprøven Bergen
description: Trolljegerprøven Bergen is a Norwegian trail obstacle race that combines endurance, strength, and fun in the true wilderness. The race offers a challenging and inspiring experience for all levels, with nature-based obstacles that test both body and mind. The event is part of Trolljeger’s many exciting events in Bergen and Sandnes, and is suitable for both large and small groups. Preparation and training are available through Trolljegerhallen and outdoor sessions, so participants can get into top shape for the race.
course_highlights: Norwegian trail obstacle course with nature-based obstacles
A combination of endurance, strength, and fun
Suitable for all levels and ages
additional: Trolljegerhallen offers training and preparation for obstacle races. Tailored group days with adapted activities are also available. The race is held in Bergen and Sandnes, with several events for both large and small groups.

name: Skjervøy 20:1000
description: Skjervøy 20:1000 is a challenging mountain race combining a 20 km distance with 1,000 metres of elevation gain in scenic surroundings on Skjervøy, at the edge of the open sea at 70 degrees north. The race features steep, technically demanding trails, cart tracks and boardwalks across marshland, with spectacular views and varied terrain around Skjervøy centre. It is suitable both for the fittest runners and for those looking for a manageable challenge, with recreational and competitive classes. A shorter 10 km course with 500 metres of elevation gain is also held, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The event has a social focus and aims to inspire more people to experience the island’s wonderful routes.
course_highlights: Steep, technically demanding trails with narrow sections
Cart tracks in hilly terrain and boardwalks across marshland
Wonderful views at 70 degrees north and a varied course around Skjervøy centre
additional: The 1 km children’s race is free, with registration on race day. Race bibs can be collected at Sporten Skjervøy on Thursday, Friday and Saturday before the race. Aid stations with water and cordial are located at 8 km and 12 km on the 20:1000 course, and at 3 km on the 10:500 course; runners must bring their own bottle or cup. Poles are allowed, but runners are responsible for their own safety. Headphones are not allowed. The time limit is 7 hours for the recreational class and 5 hours for the competitive class on the 20:1000. Prizes include cash prizes for the three fastest runners in the competitive class, a prize for a new course record, and draw prizes for all finishers. There is also a sprint prize (Seppalaspurten) on the final 160 metres. The programme lists separate starts for the recreational and competitive classes in the 20:1000 and 10:500. The children’s race is 1 km.

name: Trysilrypa
description: Trysilrypa is Norway’s largest mountain race and walking event for women, held in the beautiful autumn-coloured Trysil Mountains. The event offers distances of 6, 10 and 13 km, with the start and finish at SkiStar Lodge in Fageråsen. Participants can choose to run, hike or speedwalk, and enjoy a weekend filled with nature, fun and a sense of achievement alongside thousands of other women. Trysilrypa is an annual weekend for women that combines physical activity with socialising in mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Routes of 6, 10 and 13 km in beautiful high-mountain terrain
Start and finish at SkiStar Lodge in Fageråsen
Autumn-coloured mountain scenery in Trysil
additional: Participants can choose to run, hike or speedwalk. A weekend for women with a social programme is also held at SkiStar Lodge, the event venue.

name: Valdresløpet
description: Valdresløpet is a challenging trail race that truly puts your running fitness and trail skills to the test. The half-marathon course offers varied terrain and a wonderful experience in the traditional mountain-farm region. There are also shorter distances, including a quarter marathon, and several mini-races for children in different age groups, so the whole family can take part and enjoy a sense of achievement.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 21.1 km with 570 m of elevation gain on varied terrain
Quarter marathon of 10.3 km, starting at the same place as the half marathon, but following its own route up Knippesetvegen
Several mini-races for children from 450 m to 3.9 km, adapted to different age groups
additional: The race bib must be attached visibly to the front of the chest, with two timing chips on the back. Race headquarters opens at 10:00 on race day. The Red Cross will be on standby with an ATV patrol and a treatment tent. Awards are given in 10-year age groups, with medals and Valdres Ost for the top three in each group. Refreshment and food stations on the half-marathon course are at 7.3 km, 12.9 km and 17.7 km. The quarter marathon has a refreshment station after 6.7 km. Start location: Vasetgrende 1, 2960 Røn. The event also includes three distances for children.

name: Nordfjordryggen fjelløp 10.-11. sept. 2027

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 750 kr (inkluderer transport til start, startnummer og felles kveldsmat fredag)

description: Nordfjordryggen Fjelløp is a mountain race following seven mountain peaks from Utvikfjellet to the centre of Sandane in Gloppen. The course is 30 km long and follows established hiking trails, with 25 km through untouched nature above the tree line and panoramic views of glaciers, fjords and mountains. The race is held as a sociable weekend with activities for everyone, including an evening get-together with mingling and supper on Friday, and a finish-line celebration in the centre of Sandane on Saturday. There is also an accessible trail race for children and young people, and the event has no timing or race numbers for participants taking part at their own pace.
course_highlights: 30 km course with 1,200 m of elevation gain over seven mountain peaks
25 km through untouched nature above the tree line, with panoramic views of glaciers, fjords and mountains
Well-marked high-mountain trail with several water stations along the way
additional: Start at Utvikfjellet (600 m above sea level), with bus transport from Sandane bus station from 7:30 to 9:00. Social evening with a barbecue, race-number distribution and race briefing on Friday evening in Trivelsskogen. Finish-line celebration in the centre of Sandane on Saturday, with a prize-giving ceremony and banquet for participants and volunteers. The race has water stations at Tisthammarskaret, Svinestrandsvatnet and Moldatjønna. Children's race and accessible trail race for children and young people aged 3–16 on Friday evening.

name: Skogsløp med innlagt KM terrengløp
description: The forest run, which includes the Troms District Championships in cross-country running, is organized in Bardu by Bardu IL Friidrett, which aims to create activity and enjoyable experiences for athletes of all ages. The race is part of the club’s tradition of cross-country running and athletics activities, and takes place in scenic surroundings with varied terrain. Bardu IL Friidrett works with several clubs in Troms to strengthen the athletics community in the region and offers an inclusive environment for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country running on varied forest terrain
Includes the district championships in cross-country running
Scenic surroundings in Bardu
additional: Bardu IL Friidrett offers an inclusive environment for all ages and ability levels, with training and activities such as athletics school, Steilia Opp, and the TINE relay. The club works with other athletics clubs in Troms to strengthen the community and welcomes more volunteers and athletes to join the team.

name: Kyststien Rundt 2027
location: Bud, Hustadvika, Møre og Romsdal, Norway

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Preliminärt pris for løpet 2027 er 500 kr pluss eventuelt 100 kr for transport.

description: Kyststien Trail Ultra is an unforgettable 50 km ultrarun along the Coastal Trail, from Blokkebukta Camping to Gon Camping. The race offers varied terrain, including sandy beaches, technical trails along cliffs and coves, and spectacular panoramic views of the sea and lush landscape. It is a challenge for adventurous runners looking to test their physical and mental limits while experiencing the beauty of nature. The race celebrates community and a shared passion for nature and running, with locally made medals for everyone who finishes.
course_highlights: 50 km of varied terrain with sand, grass, mountains, stairs, rocks, and roots
The course follows the blue-marked Coastal Trail, with extra signage and a GPX file available
Spectacular views of the sea, cliffs, and lush landscape
additional: Race bibs can be picked up the evening before or on race day. The finish is at Gonhytta, where water, snacks, and hot soup will be served. Prizes for the top 3 women and men, plus a race-bib draw. All finishers receive a locally made birch medal. Free hot showers and the option of a cold sea swim after finishing. Five staffed aid stations along the course with first aid, toilets, drinks, and snacks. The sports drink is homemade and contains sugar, salt, honey, and lime juice.

name: Urke Challenge Saksaløpet 2027
location: Urke Kaihus, Urke, Ørsta, Møre og Romsdal, Norway
description: Saksaløpet Urke Challenge is an uphill race from Urke in Hjørundfjorden. The course follows Saksaråsa from Urke Kaihus to the entrance to the summit of Saksa, at 1,040 m above sea level, with views of the mountains and fjord along the way. You can enter the recreational class or the competition class. Head to Urke for a race experience in a distinctive mountain and fjord landscape.
course_highlights: Uphill course on Saksaråsa from Urke Kaihus
Finish at the entrance to the summit of Saksa, at 1,040 m above sea level
Views of Hjørundfjorden and Norangsfjorden
additional: Previous editions have had both a recreational class and a competition class. In 2024, carrying a backpack weighing at least 2.5 kg was compulsory, poles were not allowed, and there were water stations along the course.

name: Ålesund Trail 2027
description: Ålesund Trail 2027 is a trail race offering challenges in some of Norway’s most beautiful surroundings, with Borgundfjorden and the Sunnmøre Alps as a backdrop. The event offers three distances: a 15 km main race that starts in the city and climbs into the mountains to around 450 metres above sea level, a challenging 2.75 km uphill race with 313 metres of elevation gain, and a short 500-metre children’s race. The event is suitable for all levels, from recreational runners to competitive athletes, and emphasises a great atmosphere, safety and sustainability. Mandatory equipment is required for the 15 km race, and staffed aid stations are available along the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: 15 km trail race with a high point of around 450 metres above sea level
Challenging 2.75 km uphill race with 313 metres of elevation gain and a 20% gradient
Panoramic views of the Sunnmøre Alps and Borgundfjorden
additional: Start times: Uphill race 10:00, Children’s race 11:00, Main race 15 km 12:00. Mandatory equipment for the 15 km race: fully charged mobile phone, at least 500 ml of drink, trail shoes, clothing suited to the conditions; food/energy is recommended. Staffed aid station halfway through the 15 km race and at the finish of the uphill race. Equipment checks may take place at the start and along the course. Medical personnel will be present at the start, finish and aid stations. The organiser may stop the race if safety is threatened. Participants are obliged to help injured runners. The event emphasises leaving no trace and sustainability. The uphill race starts at 10:00 and the children’s race at 11:00. Course maps, elevation profiles and GPX tracks are available, and registration is via the website.

name: Torvikbukt 6 topper 2027
location: Torvikbukt, Gjemnes, Møre og Romsdal, Norway
description: Torvikbukt 6 Topper is a challenging mountain race held in Torvikbukt, with several distances suited to different age groups. The race offers spectacular scenery, with six peaks adding up to a significant elevation gain, and is suitable for youth, junior, and senior runners. The event has a long tradition and attracts both recreational and competitive runners looking for a challenging and scenic experience.
course_highlights: The course includes six mountain peaks with up to 2,000 metres of elevation gain in total
Scenic surroundings in Torvikbukt with varied terrain
Several distances suited to youth, junior, and senior runners, with different lengths and elevation gains
additional: Start times vary by class: Tour class at 08:00, recreational runners at 10:00, seniors at 11:00, juniors and recreational runners at 11:30, and youth at 11:40. Registration is through EQTiming or in person for the tour class. Elevation profiles and maps of the course are available on the Instagram page. In previous years, the start and finish have been at Gjemneshallen.

name: Tahko Trail Run
organizer: Kuopio-Tahko Markkinointi Oy ja TAHKOcom Oy
description: Tahko Trail Run is a new trail running event held amid the stunning scenery of Tahkovuori. The event offers four different distance options, suitable for both first-timers and experienced trail runners. The routes wind through varied, nature-rich terrain, with heart-pumping climbs and breathtaking views. The event focuses on memorable experiences, atmosphere, and well-marked routes with aid stations. The finish area has a race-day atmosphere, food, and the option to use the sauna and showers at Break Sokos Hotel Tahko.

name: SaaristoTrail
description: SaaristoTrail is an exciting trail running event in Parainen, offering varied routes amid stunning archipelago scenery. The event features three main distances: 7 km, 14 km and a 21 km half marathon, suitable for both beginner and experienced trail runners. The routes include varied trails, fitness tracks and significant elevation changes, including the steep climbs of Svinövuori, offering unforgettable views and a challenge. The event’s relaxed atmosphere and careful organisation make it an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Den Genfundne Bro Løbet - Cannonball Halvmaraton Løb
Tallinna Sügisjooks 10 km
location: Vabaduse väljak, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Tallinn Autumn Run 10 km is an autumn running event held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn. The start is on 12 September 2026 at 14:00. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers, with timed and untimed participation options. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and the city’s autumn beauty.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through central Tallinn
Participate by running or walking, with or without timing
Start and finish at Freedom Square
additional: Discounts: 20% off for seniors aged 60 and over and young people under 20. A 10% group discount applies when at least 10 people register together. The event offers discounts for seniors, young people and groups, and is part of the Tallinn Marathon, taking place on 11–13 September 2026.

name: Nike Noortejooks
description: Nike Youth Run is a running event for young people, held at Freedom Square in the heart of Tallinn. It is part of the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon event series and offers young people the chance to take part in a fun, sporting event. The race starts in the evening, creating a pleasant atmosphere and encouraging an active lifestyle among young people. Registration is easy, and early-bird prices are available.
course_highlights: Held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn
Evening start at 18:30
A safe running environment suitable for young people
additional: Registering early can secure lower entry fees. Young people and seniors can also get special discounts in the Tallinn Marathon series. Participants are provided with a safe running environment and well-organised event. The race takes place in Tallinn’s Old Town and at Freedom Square. Participants can join a community of young athletes, and awards are presented to the top finishers.

name: 84. laste Paala järve jooks
description: The 84th Paala Lake Children’s Run is a traditional children’s running event held on the shore of Paala Lake near Viljandi. The event offers distances suited to different age groups, ranging from 300 metres to a two-lap run around the lake. Organised by the JOOSU recreational sports club, it gives children the chance to enjoy being active and spend time in nature. The run starts on 12 September 2026 at 10:00. Prizes and souvenirs are provided for participants.

description: Zilo kalnu Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, held on Latvia’s most beautiful forest trails. The event offers a range of distances for different ages and fitness levels, allowing participants to enjoy a scenic and challenging trail run. It welcomes both beginners and experienced runners, with awards for the top finishers in different age groups and distances. The Zilo kalnu event takes place in the city of Ogre and is part of a wider series of races held throughout Latvia.
course_highlights: A variety of surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails, and off-road terrain
Five different distances are available for different age groups and fitness levels
The event takes place in Ogre, amid beautiful natural scenery and challenging trail sections
additional: Late registration is available on race day until 30 minutes before the distance start. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first; hiking participants can set off on the course between 9:00 and 10:30, with no timekeeping. Discounts are available for juniors, seniors, and special groups. Participant profiles are created and managed through the Stirnubuks.lv profile page.

name: Volvo Tierparklauf
description: The Volvo Tierparklauf takes place at Berlin Zoo and is especially family-friendly and suitable for beginner runners. The course runs through the zoo, past various animals such as monkeys and flamingos, and offers a unique atmosphere with free admission for participants and their companions. The event is part of the popular Berlin läuft! series and is known for its animal-themed atmosphere and comprehensive race pack.
course_highlights: Course through Berlin Zoo with views of monkeys, flamingos and other animals
Free admission to the zoo for participants and their companions
Running festival for the whole family on the event grounds
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder attached to the shoe. Participants receive a comprehensive race pack, with refreshment points, toilets, an online certificate and free admission to the zoo. Groups of 15 or more receive a 10% discount and can collect their race packs together. Late entries are possible up to one hour before the start. Additional services such as event shirts, medal engraving and HD finish-line videos can be booked. Free admission, run through Berlin Zoo, family-friendly, course passes animals

name: Freiberger Herbstlauf
location: Platz der Einheit, Freiberg, Saxony, Germany
description: The Freiberger Autumn Run is a traditional race through Freiberg’s municipal forest, starting at 10:00 a.m. at Platz der Einheit. The varied program offers races for the whole family, including Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, distances from 2 km to the half marathon, a company relay, and the Einfach?Mensch!Lauf. The varied routes lead through the surrounding forests and include some climbs, making the race particularly appealing.
course_highlights: Route through Freiberg’s municipal forest
Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports venue
Varied routes with some climbs
additional: Activities for the whole family include Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, a company relay, and a one-wheel race. Distances range from 400 m to the half marathon. Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports venue. Multiple events include the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, children’s races, Nordic walking, a one-wheel race, and team competitions; the event takes place in the municipal forest and at Platz der Einheit.

name: 10-Teiche-Marathon
description: The 10 Ponds Marathon in Hahnenklee is a scenic marathon held in September as part of the HarzerWanderWochen. The course takes runners through the Upper Harz, offering the chance to experience the region’s natural beauty and numerous ponds. The event is part of a ten-day hiking program featuring a variety of activities and live music. The marathon is a special challenge for runners who appreciate combining athletic achievement with enjoying nature.

name: 3. Wunstorfer Citylauf
description: The Wunstorf City Run is a running event in the city center of Wunstorf, organized by TuS Wunstorf. The race starts and finishes in front of the town church, which serves as the event hub. There are various distances, from a 400-meter Bambini run and several children’s and youth races to the 10-kilometer main race. The course is a 1,400-meter loop through the city center, run a different number of times or in a modified format depending on age group and distance. The City Run thus offers suitable races for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Neubrandenburger Staffelmarathon (LC/NLC)
description: The Neubrandenburg Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay competition held in Neubrandenburg. The event is organized by SV Turbine Neubrandenburg e.V. and gives runners the opportunity to tackle the marathon distance together as teams. The start is at 9:30 a.m., and the event runs until around 2:30 p.m. The club’s running group organizes the event and looks forward to welcoming many participants.

name: Rudelsburglauf
description: The Rudelsburglauf is a long-standing running event along the Rudelsburg near Bad Kösen, organized by LG Rudelsburg 1995 Bad Kösen e.V. The race takes place annually and gives runners of all ability levels the opportunity to experience the beautiful local region together. The event is a highlight in the club’s calendar and combines a sporting challenge with an experience of nature. Information about the race details and registration is published in good time before the event.

name: Schledehausener Berglauf
description: The Schledehausener Berglauf is a 10-hour hill-running event in Schledehausen, part of Bissendorf, Germany. The race starts and finishes at the Schledehausen sports hall. The goal is to climb and descend a short hill as many times as possible, accumulating the most elevation gain within the time limit. The course is 700 metres long and has an elevation gain of 32 metres, with an average gradient of 10%. There are individual, relay and team categories. Omas on Tour organises the race as a charity event in support of HelpAge Deutschland e. V.

name: Spiegelsbergelauf
description: The Spiegelsbergelauf in Halberstadt offers varied running routes for all ability levels. The 14 km route passes over the Gläserner Mönch and, with its elevation gain and terrain, is a real challenge. The 8 km loop around the Jagdschlösschen combines speed and nature, while the 4 km route through the Spiegelsberge offers a relaxed introduction to racing. The youngest runners can take part in a 400 m fun run. The event is organized by SwimBikeRun Halberstadt e.V. and takes place at the Sportanlage Friedensstadion.

name: ULTRAMARATHON DM im 100km-Straßenlauf
description: The 38th German 100 km Ultramarathon Championships will take place at Wartenberg Stadium in Berlin-Wartenberg. This road race is a demanding long-distance event that requires endurance and mental strength. The event is aimed at experienced ultrarunners and offers an official championship atmosphere under the auspices of the German Athletics Association. Participants can look forward to professional organization and an athletic challenge.

name: Unstrutlauf
description: The Unstrut Run is a versatile running event in Dingelstädt, offering suitable distances for all ability levels, from 2 km to the half marathon (21.1 km). The varied routes follow the Unstrut and feature scenic highlights, paved cycle paths and short climbs. Drinks, fruit and bratwurst are provided. All proceeds are donated to charitable projects in the region, giving the event a special social character.

name: II Ćwiartka Drzymały
location: Miasteczko Krajeńskie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Mälarömilen
description: Mälarömilen är ett återkommande löplopp på Ekerö som välkomnar löpare på alla nivåer och hela familjen. Loppet erbjuder fyra olika distanser, från knattelopp för de yngsta till det klassiska huvudloppet på 10 kilometer. Banorna går genom natursköna miljöer med asfalterade gångvägar och parkstigar, och start och mål är vid Träkvista idrottsplats. Mälarömilen arrangeras av Mälarö SOK och hela överskottet går tillbaka till deras idrottsverksamhet.
course_highlights: Trevliga och löpvänliga banor på asfalterade gångvägar och parkstigar
Skyltar vid varje kilometerpassering
Start och mål vid Träkvista idrottsplats med natursköna omgivningar
additional: Efteranmälan är möjlig på tävlingsdagen i mån av plats. Det finns vätskestation strax efter start/varvning. Toaletter, duschar och omklädningsrum finns i KOM-huset på Träkvista idrottsplats. Första hjälpen-tält är bemannat under hela evenemanget. Alla lopp startar och går i mål vid Träkvista idrottsplats. Gruppanmälan för team och företag erbjuds.

name: Rådalunken
description: Rådalunken är ett årligt löparlopp och motionslopp som arrangeras av Lidköpings VSK sedan slutet av 1960-talet. Loppet hålls i Råda och erbjuder klasser och distanser upp till 18 km. Det brukar arrangeras andra lördagen i september och är ett välkommet evenemang för löpare i alla åldrar. Samma dag arrangeras ofta Paprikaloppet för barn i samarbete med Ica Hjertbergs.
course_highlights: Löpning i natursköna Råda
Klasser och distanser upp till 18 km
Traditionsenligt andra lördagen i september
additional: Rådalunken arrangeras tillsammans med Paprikaloppet för barn samma dag. Loppet har klasser och längder upp till 18 km. Arrangemanget är en del av Lidköpings VSK:s årliga tävlingsprogram. Tidigare upplagor har erbjudit Papricaloppet för yngre barn. Tidtagning har skötts av C-time och Umara sportdryck har serverats.

name: Brotorp Trailrun
location: Skogsluffarnas klubbstuga Brotorp, Bagarmossen, Stockholm, Sverige
description: Brotorp Trailrun är ett tufft och trevligt traillopp som går längs en teknisk varvbana på 7 km genom Nackareservatets finaste delar. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser inklusive barnbana, 7 km, 14 km och 21 km med start och mål vid Skogsluffarnas klubbstuga Brotorp i Bagarmossen. Banorna bjuder på varierande terräng med stigar nära sjöar och höjder, markerade med orange snitslar och skyltar. Under loppet finns energistationer med vatten, sportdryck och bananer, och efter målgång serveras hamburgare till löpare på de längre distanserna. Tidtagning sker med sportident och prisutdelning sker för de tre bästa i varje kategori.
course_highlights: Teknisk varvbana på 7 km med orangea snitslar och skyltar
Banan går genom Nackareservatets finaste delar med sjöar och höjder
Energistationer var 3,5 km med vatten, sportdryck och bananer
additional: Start- och mål vid klubbstugan Brotorp. Nummerlappsutlämning sker på tävlingsdagen minst en timme före start. Servering och fika finns vid klubbstugan. Maxtid 4 timmar för längsta distansen, alla måste vara i mål före kl 14. Duschar finns men rekommenderas att användas hemma. Prisutdelning planeras ca 12:30. Rabattkod finns för barn som springer 7 km (50% rabatt). Barn som anmäler sig till 7 km får enligt arrangörens information 50 procent rabatt med rabattkoden ”barnrabatt”.

name: Vildmarksmilen
description: Vildmarksmilen är ett roligt terränglopp som går i vacker natur i Hemlingby friluftsområde i Gävle. Banan är omväxlande med varierande terräng som påverkas av väderförhållanden, vilket gör loppet utmanande men tillgängligt för löpare vana vid småstigar och obanad terräng. Start och mål är vid Spårcentralen, och loppet avslutas med en rejäl stigning uppför Hemlingbybergets slalombacke. För de som vill ha en större utmaning rekommenderas Vildmark15, men detta lopp utgår 2026 på grund av anläggningsarbeten.
course_highlights: Omväxlande terräng med stigar, rötter, stenar och myrmark
Vätskekontroll vid 5 km och vid mål
Avslutande stigning uppför Hemlingbybergets slalombacke innan mål
additional: Efteranmälan kan göras på plats fram till 15 minuter innan start. Nummerlappsutdelning, efteranmälan samt start och mål är vid Hemlingby Spårcentral. Hemlingbystugan är stängd för närvarande, och inga mat- eller fikaserveringar erbjuds där. Alla som fullföljer loppet får medalj, och det finns prestations- och utlottningspriser. År 2026 användes en alternativ bansträckning på grund av anläggningsarbeten i Hemlingby friluftsområde, och Vildmark 15 utgick.

name: Jentebølgen - Hitra
description: Jentebølgen Hitra 2027 is an inclusive race for girls and women of all ages, taking place on 12 September 2027. The event focuses on achievement, community and a great atmosphere, and aims to create a meeting place filled with energy and the joy of running. The race is held every other year on Hitra and Frøya, and invites participants to a morning of activities and entertainment. The race bib provides entry to the race, including insurance and the ticket fee.
additional: The race bib includes insurance and the ticket fee. The event supports Mental Helse Ungdom with NOK 10 per race bib sold. There is also registration for businesses and sports clubs, with separate prices and terms. NOK 10 from each race bib sold goes to Mental Helse Ungdom. The event venue has not yet been decided.

name: Neskollen løpsfestival 2027
description: Neskollen Running Festival 2027 is Hvam Runners’ signature race, offering a trail run with fantastic views of Romerike. The race is suitable for all levels and includes distances of 4.5 km, 0.5 km, and 1 km for children. The event takes place on September 12, 2027, and offers a great opportunity to enjoy running in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail run on varied terrain
Fantastic views of Romerike
Races for all levels, including children’s races
additional: The race includes distances of 4.5 km, 0.5 km, and 1 km children’s races. The organizer is Hvam IL Friidrett. The starting point is Neskollen. The race is Hvam Runners’ signature event, with a focus on community and the joy of running. Registration is stated to open on June 1, 2027.

name: Strandmila 2027
description: Strandmila is an inclusive race day in the beautiful Alcoa Environmental Park, where everyone can take part regardless of age or ability. The event features a nature trail for walkers, a children’s race for the youngest participants, and 5 km and 10 km races. It is a free, family-friendly day with prizes for class winners and children’s race participants, as well as a gift-card draw for nature trail participants. The kiosk in FLIK’s clubhouse will be open, making for an active and enjoyable experience for the whole family.
course_highlights: A 5 km nature trail for walkers
A children’s race of approximately 600–800 metres
5 km and 10 km races in Alcoa Environmental Park
additional: Registration via EQ Timing from 25 August or on-site up to 30 minutes before the start. Kiosk sales at FLIK’s clubhouse. Start times: 12:00 nature trail, 13:45 children’s race, 14:00 5 km and 10 km races.

name: Tampere Maraton 13.9.2026
description: Tampere Marathon is a true city marathon, run in the heart of Tampere. The event offers a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, a minimarathon for the youngest members of the family, and a marathon relay for teams of four. The course runs through the city centre and along Tampere’s waterways, mostly on asphalt and partly on gravel paths, offering beautiful urban scenery and a challenge for runners. The start and finish area is at Tampere Stadium, which has good transport connections. Organised by runners for runners, the event offers the joy of achievement to runners of all ages and abilities.

name: Ruskahölkkä
description: Ruskahölkkä is a versatile cross-country running event in Oulainen, offering categories and distances for runners of all ages and fitness levels. The competition is held in the Honkamaja area and includes distances ranging from 0.3 km children’s races to 10 km open races, as well as recreational categories. Prizes are awarded in every category, and there are also prize draws, including a bicycle raffle. Runners have access to changing rooms with showers, and the event is part of Oulaisten Taru’s wide-ranging sporting activities.

name: Hiekkojen Herruus Trail Run
description: Hiekkojen Herruus Trail Run offers fast-paced and suitably challenging routes through Kalajoki’s magnificent pine forests and coastal scenery. The route winds along pine-needle trails and includes technically challenging sections that test runners’ fitness and skills. The race is part of a two-day event, which also features an MTB race and a combined race. Welcome to experience the unique atmosphere of Kalajoki’s sandy terrain and challenge yourself!

name: RUN & RAVE Palanga
description: RUN & RAVE Palanga is a new community initiative for people who love movement, music, and good energy. The event takes place in Palanga and includes mobility training, a 5 km social run with DJ music, an ice bath ritual, and coffee breaks. It’s a great opportunity to meet new people, make connections, and experience summer energy at a single morning event. Registration is required, and participants are invited to bring running shoes, swim shorts, and a towel.

name: 6. DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused extreme experience in the wooded Deister hills near Springe. The event offers running and walking routes of 10 km, 21.1 km (half marathon) and 42.2 km (marathon), with challenging climbs, including the Deisterhölle, with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch. Participants enjoy a well-marked course with aid stations, places to sit and filled rolls for walkers. The event is all about consideration for others and enjoying nature, with awards for the fastest runners and a finisher’s gift as a souvenir.
course_highlights: Deisterhölle with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch
Marathon walk with an additional climb to Bielstein and the Deister ridge
Aid stations with places to sit and filled rolls
additional: Race bib collection from 7:15 a.m. at IGS Springe. Chip timing with a rental chip; return the chip to receive a wheat beer glass as a finisher’s gift. Showers and changing rooms in the IGS Springe sports hall. Parking at IGS, netto and BZE. Travel by S5 to Springe station, then a 10-minute walk to the Nord school centre. Awards ceremonies: 10 km and half marathon at 12:00, marathon at 14:30. Sew-on patches for walkers. Trail event with challenging terrain, refreshments at aid stations, and options for runners and walkers.

name: Braker hkk Lauf
description: The 19th Braker hkk Run takes place in Brake (Unterweser). It is a short running event with distances of 850 meters and 10 kilometers. The race offers an enjoyable running opportunity in typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. Please check the exact event details directly with the organizer.
course_highlights: Distances: 850 m and 10 km
Typical September weather with approximately 19°C and 45 mm of precipitation
Start location in Brake (Unterweser)
additional: The race includes two distances: 850 meters and 10 kilometers. September weather is typically mild and cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event usually takes place in comfortable temperatures of around 19°C. Participants should check the latest details with the organizer before registering.

name: Kiel Lauf
description: The Kiel.Lauf is a long-established running event in Kiel, with various competitions for all age groups. The main event is the half marathon, covering 21.1 kilometers through western Kiel and attracting both recreational runners and elite athletes. The 10.2-kilometer fun run is the event’s largest race by participation and offers a lap through Kiel city center with a great atmosphere. There are also shorter races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: The half marathon runs across western Kiel
The fun run goes through Kiel city center
A range of distances from approx. 0.7 km to 21.1 km
additional: The half marathon starts at 10:50 a.m. and the fun run at 09:45 a.m. Due to construction work, short-notice course changes may occur and will be announced in good time. The event is very popular, with more than 10,000 runners. There are various races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly. The event includes street closures and participant information, and offers technical running shirts for most categories.

name: Othaler Gutshof Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Othaler Gutshoflauf is a young but popular running event starting and finishing at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal. The event offers distances ranging from 0.5 km to the 21.1 km half marathon, which is known as the Intersport Liebig Half Marathon and passes through several villages. The race gives participants the chance to explore the eastern foothills of the Harz on varied routes. Around 350 runners take part each year, highlighting the event’s growing popularity.
course_highlights: Half marathon route through Sotterhausen, Holdenstedt, Klosterrode and Beyernaumburg
Start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal
Distances ranging from 0.5 km to 21.1 km
additional: Start times: 09:00 half marathon, 09:45 10 km run/walk, 10:00 5 km run/walk, 10:05 0.5 km run, 10:15 1 km run, 10:30 2 km children’s race. Routes for children, recreational runners and competitive runners; start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm in Othal; supported by sponsors such as Intersport Liebig and Autohaus Liebe.

name: Rathaus Center Dessauer CityRUN
description: The 26th Dessauer Rathaus-Center CityRUN is a long-standing race in downtown Dessau that has attracted runners from the region and beyond for many years. The route follows a circuit through the city’s central streets, with the start and finish on Zerbster Straße near the Rathaus-Center. The race offers a sporting challenge in an urban setting and is part of a varied sports programme organised by Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising major sporting events in the region for decades.
course_highlights: Circuit through downtown Dessau
Start and finish on Zerbster Straße at the Rathaus-Center
Route along Steinstraße, Askanische Straße and Kavalierstraße
additional: Volksbank children’s race for children up to 9 years old over 1,000 metres, free for all children and schoolchildren from Dessau. The organiser is Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising numerous major sporting events in the region for over 20 years. Various distances, including children’s races; company race; on-site registration available; finisher medals

name: 17. Parklauf Tangerhütte
description: The 17th Park Run Tangerhütte takes place in the idyllic Tangerhütte City Park and is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP race series in the north of Saxony-Anhalt. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including 1.1 km for young runners, 2.9 km for youth, and 5.4 km and 10.3 km for adults. The routes pass around Spiegelsee and by sights such as the New Palace and the Mausoleum. In the finish area, SV Germania Tangerhütte provides refreshments for participants, including grilled food, drinks, fruit, coffee, and cake.

name: 21. swb-Marathon Bremen
description: The 21st swb-Marathon Bremen is taking place, offering runners a varied running experience through Bremen. The start and finish are at Bremen’s Market Square.
