The course passes well-known sights including Werdersee, Weserwehr, Rhododendron-Park, the University, Bürgerpark, Überseestadt and Schlachte, and ends with a run through the Weserstadion. In addition to the marathon, there is also an AOK half marathon, a HIRSCH 10K race and an AOK children’s race. The event is aimed at both beginners and experienced runners and promises an unforgettable day of sport, with a great atmosphere and support from spectators.

name: 43. Internationalen Airport Race
description: The 43rd International Airport Race in Hamburg is taking place, offering a varied running experience around Hamburg Airport. The 10-mile race traditionally starts at 11:00 a.m. at the LSV sports grounds on Borsteler Chaussee. In addition to the main 10-mile race, there are also 5 km events and the Mini Airport Race. The unique airport setting offers ever-changing views and a special atmosphere.

name: Dübener Heidelauf
description: The Dübener Heide Run is a traditional forest race held at the scenic Obermühle in Bad Düben, a spa town in northern Saxony. The event is organized by SV Bad Düben and offers courses for children, teenagers, and adults. With distances ranging from 500 m to the half marathon (21.1 km), the race appeals to both young runners and experienced long-distance athletes. It is part of the regional athletics structure for northern Saxony and Leipzig and is known for its family-friendly, club-oriented character.

name: Eicklinger Volks- und Familielauf
description: The 1st Eicklingen Community and Family Run is aimed at active families who want to spend an enjoyable day running together. The focus is on fun and the joy of running, without the pressure of competition. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for all age groups and encourages people to get active together.

name: Kristall Lauf Weißwasser
description: The Kristall-Lauf Weißwasser is a versatile popular race that welcomes runners and walkers of all ages. The course crosses mixed terrain, including asphalt, concrete, sand paths and forest trails with roots. The race is part of several regional competitions, including the Bezirksrangliste Dresden, the Sachsenenergie Läufer-Cup and the Niederlausitz-Cup. It also offers an official walking competition recognized by the German Athletics Association. A special feature is the traditional team race, which encourages community and team spirit.

name: runroll City
description: The runroll City event takes place in Bielefeld and offers a fast-paced sporting experience on a flat, 7.2-kilometer course through the heart of the city. The course is ideal for fast times and is suited to both intensive running training and a quick race. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban setting and become part of a dynamic event.

name: Zeuthener Jedermannslauf
description: The Zeuthen Jedermannslauf is a popular community run held every September in Zeuthen. It offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from 400 m to 10 km. The event is family-friendly and promotes recreational sport in the region. The races start at Zeuthen S-Bahn station and follow a varied route along the forest promenade.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The II Złotowska Dziesiątka is a 10 km road race held in Złotów. The course consists of two 5 km loops and runs along the city’s picturesque streets. The event is a great opportunity for running enthusiasts to enjoy an active day and compete in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers ensure participants’ safety and the smooth running of the event.
course_highlights: The course consists of two 5 km loops
A road race in the center of Złotów
Scenic views and safe conditions on the course
additional: The race takes place over two 5 km loops. The organizer works with the relevant services to ensure the safety of runners, pedestrians, and drivers. The ZCAS office is located at al. Mickiewicza 18 in Złotów.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting automotive events held at the Poznań race track. Participants can compete, train, and take part in qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at motoring enthusiasts and also offers the option to rent cars and take one-to-one lessons with instructors. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of motorsport and hone your skills on a professional track.
course_highlights: Poznań race track with professional facilities
Opportunity to take part in various rounds and qualifying events during the 2026 season
Training options and one-to-one lessons with instructors
additional: You can rent a car for yourself to drive on the track or as a gift. The entry package includes participation by one team member, the option to take part in a co-drive (age >17), full catering, individual timing, and instructor-led training options. To confirm participation, payments must include the required wording in the payment reference.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are annual running events held in Środa Wielkopolska. The event combines sporting competition with bringing together the region’s legal community. It attracts both professionals and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time actively outdoors. Registration for the run is now open, and participants can expect a well-organized event with a long-standing tradition.
course_highlights: The course runs through the scenic areas of Środa Wielkopolska
The run combines competition with bringing together the legal community
Held annually and backed by a long-standing tradition

name: Chyża 10
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a popular 10 km race organized by the Chyży Nowotomyski Running Club in Nowy Tomyśl. The course is fast and popular with participants, and the race takes place in a friendly atmosphere. It also counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix. The race is scheduled to start at 9:00, making for comfortable racing conditions. The organizers warmly invite runners to this event, which brings together a passion for sport and the local community.
course_highlights: A fast course popular with runners
A 10 km race in Nowy Tomyśl
Counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix
additional: The race office is open from 07:00 to 08:30 on race day. Winners’ awards ceremony at 10:45. The race is co-funded by the Municipality of Nowy Tomyśl and Nowotomyski County.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Północy XI Maraton Bieg Czterech Latarni
location: Hel, Jastarnia, and Rozewie, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Northern Running Festival is a unique running event held on the Hel Peninsula, combining tradition with fresh energy. The event includes a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a race for children and teenagers—the Little Lighthouse Keeper Run. The course passes through scenic spots in Hel, Jastarnia and Rozewie, and participants get to run surrounded by four lighthouses, making this race unique in Poland. It is an excellent choice for runners of all abilities who want to combine sport with the beauty of the coastal landscape.
course_highlights: The course runs along Puck Bay, with views of the sea
Passes four lighthouses: Hel, Jastarnia and two in Rozewie
Scenic landscapes of the Hel Peninsula and the coast
additional: The marathon relay races have been cancelled due to too few registrations. The marathon course is available to download in GPX, KML and TCX formats. The Władysławowo Municipality Resident Card can be used for discounts on entry fees. The Little Lighthouse Keeper Run is for children and teenagers up to 14 years old.

name: II Bieg Tropem Wilka
location: Korpele, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Crow Mountain Survival
description: The Crow Mountain Survival obstacle race in Bremen is an exciting adventure entering its ninth edition. Distances range from 1.2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, with challenging obstacles and spectacular water sections, including a swim across Lake Werdersee. The event offers challenges for beginners and experienced OCR veterans, as well as inclusive races for people with disabilities. The varied course runs through forests, meadows and different types of terrain, testing endurance, strength and agility. Children and newcomers can take part in special untimed races that make it easier to get started.
course_highlights: Spectacular swim across Lake Werdersee
Varied course through forests, meadows and different types of terrain
Challenging obstacles involving climbing, balancing, crawling and traversing
additional: Wave starts of 10 participants every 60 seconds for the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km races; participants are grouped by pace at registration; untimed junior and inclusive races; medals and certificates for all participants; start times vary by distance, e.g. junior race at 09:30 and taster race at 12:00; children under 12 require prior approval to participate on certain courses. Distances from 5 km to 15 km, including water sections, natural trails through forests and meadows, challenging obstacles, and junior, taster and inclusive races.

name: Namdalskarusellen 2027 løp 8 - Spillumsmarka rundt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 80,- (+ lisens) for enkeltløp i karusellen.

description: Namdalskarusellen 2027 Race 8 - Spillumsmarka Rundt is part of the Namdalskarusellen series, organized by Namdal Running Club in Namsos, Trøndelag. The event offers two distances: a long course of approximately 7.5 km that follows the floodlit trail with a detour onto the mountain trail, and a short course of approximately 4.5 km that is a loop on the floodlit trail. The race is suitable for all age groups, with age categories on the long course, and timing is available on the short course. Participants who complete at least 4 of the 8 races in the series receive a participant prize in the form of a porcelain mug.
course_highlights: Long course of approximately 7.5 km, starting and finishing at the ski lodge
The course follows the floodlit trail, detours onto the mountain trail, and returns via the barrier
Short course of approximately 4.5 km, a loop on the floodlit trail, with timing
additional: Participants who complete 4 of the 8 races in the Namdalskarusellen receive a porcelain mug. Age categories are available on the long course for runners aged 12 and up, across several age groups.

name: 3-vannsløpet høst
price_range: 170 kr for enkeltstart; 400 kr for familie

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ordinær påmeldingsfrist er 14.9. Kr. 170 for enkeltstart

description: The 3-vannsløpet is an annual race organised by Byåsen Idrettslag that runs around three lakes in Trondheim: Kyvatnet, Lianvatnet and Haukvatnet. Participants can choose from three distances: 2 km (one lake), 6 km (two lakes) or 8 km (three lakes). The race is suitable for all ages, with age groups from 8 years and up, and there is also a free children’s race for the youngest participants. The start and finish are by the dam at Kyvannet, and prizes and draw prizes are offered. The event has a welcoming atmosphere, with a café and changing rooms at Myrahallen.
course_highlights: Run around three scenic lakes: Kyvatnet, Lianvatnet and Haukvatnet
Three distances: 2 km, 6 km and 8 km
Start by the dam at Kyvannet, with a café and changing rooms at Myrahallen
additional: Start times: 18:05 for football teams, 18:07 for one-lake runners, 18:15 for two-lake runners and 18:25 for three-lake runners. Late registration is available on race day for an additional 50 kr. Race numbers can be collected at the race office in Myrahallen. Free children’s race at 17:30, with separate courses for ages 2–7. All children up to age 12 receive prizes; cash prizes go to the three fastest men and women in the 3-vannsløpet. Juice is served at the finish. Parking is available at Ugla school, Kyvannet swimming area and Kyvannet kindergarten; there is limited parking at Myra. Cycling or taking the tram or bus is recommended. The start is by the dam at Kyvannet, with the event area, race office, café and changing rooms at Myrahallen. A free children’s race is also listed. Price and event details are from the 2026 edition.

name: Vestfold løpskarusell - 8. løp - Hortensmarka Rundt

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 1200 kr. for ikke medlemmer frem til 31.12.26.

description: Vestfold Running Series 2027 is a series of 8 great races in the Tønsberg region, offering the joy of running, a sense of community and a great atmosphere for runners of all levels. Each race has two distances and starts at 18:00, except Hortensmarka Rundt, which starts at 13:00. Participants can choose individual races or purchase a season pass for all races at a discounted price. The races take place in beautiful surroundings, with electronic timing provided by EQ Timing. Course descriptions are shared in a Facebook group.
course_highlights: Two distances at each race
Great running experiences in the Tønsberg region
Electronic timing via EQ Timing
additional: Season-pass participants collect their bibs at the first race, while participants in individual races can collect theirs from the race office 10 minutes before the start. Course descriptions and profiles are available in the Facebook group. The races use electronic timing via EQ Timing.

name: Terrengløp i Smidalen
organizer: Nidelv IL Friidrett og Nidelv IL Ski
description: Terrengløp i Smidalen is an accessible cross-country race for children and young people in grades 1–7, organized by Nidelv IL Friidrett og Ski in collaboration with Kjeldsberg Eiendom AS. The race takes place on a circuit of approximately 1,000 meters, with distances adapted to the participants’ grades. Everyone starts together, and the event encourages varied training and competition in an inclusive environment. It is an important offering for children at Nidelv IL and part of the club’s sponsorship agreement. The race is held several times during the year, with the season’s final race on 15 September.
course_highlights: A cross-country circuit of approximately 1,000 meters
Race distance adapted by grade: grades 1–3 (1 lap), grades 4–5 (2 laps), grades 6–7 (3 laps)
All participants start together
additional: The races are held several times a year, with a focus on children and young people at Nidelv IL. Coaches and team leaders are encouraged to prioritize participation over their own training. The event is part of a sponsorship agreement with Kjeldsberg Eiendom AS. Previous race formats had one lap for grades 1–3, two laps for grades 4–5, and three laps for grades 6–7.

name: B2Run Berlin
description: B2Run Berlin is a corporate run with a route of around 5.7 km around Berlin’s Olympic Stadium. The run ends with an emotional finish in the historic Olympic Stadium and offers a unique team event for companies and individual entrants from Berlin and the surrounding area. The focus is on team spirit, motivation and fun rather than personal bests, making it ideal for beginners, walkers and experienced runners. The event combines physical activity with workplace health promotion and a professional supporting program featuring an emcee and music.

name: Mjärdevistafetten
location: Collegiumparken, Linköping Science Park, Linköping, Sverige
description: Mjärdevistafetten är en publik och livlig stafett i Collegiumparken i Linköping Science Park. Lagen består av fyra personer och varje löpare springer cirka 3 kilometer. Tävlingen välkomnar både elitlag och motionsgäng, gärna med färg och fantasi längs banan. Efter målgång väntar aktiviteter, matförsäljning och prisutdelning med utlottning.
course_highlights: Stafettbana på cirka 3 kilometer per löpare
Fyra löpare per lag
Bana i Collegiumparken i Linköping Science Park
additional: Startskottet går enligt befintlig evenemangsinformation klockan 17.00. Efter loppet ordnas aktiviteter, matförsäljning och prisutdelning med utlottning.

name: LöpRallarn
description: LöpRallarn är ett löplopp som arrangeras av Bottnaryds IF vid Bottnaryds IP. Loppet erbjuder distanser på 7,5 km och 15 km med en bana som inkluderar slingor i varierande terräng. Evenemanget lockar både ungdomar och vuxna löpare och präglas av en härlig sensommarsstämning med energiska deltagare. Loppet har en tradition av att samla ett fint startfält och erbjuder en trevlig utmaning för både tävlingsinriktade och motionslöpare.
course_highlights: Bana på 7,5 km och 15 km med två slingor
Terräng med varierande underlag
Start och mål vid Bottnaryds IP
additional: Loppet har två distanser: 7,5 km och 15 km. Tidigare år har loppet haft startgrupper och lockat över 100 deltagare. Resultat och kontaktperson finns via christian.wigren@rallarloppet.se. Kortare distanser på 1 och 2 km finns också. Bottnaryds IF:s sidor anger olika datum för 2027 års lopp.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.bottnarydsif.se/bottnarydsif-rallarloppen-loprallarn): 2027-09-16 — "RallarLoppen 2027 16 sep" (was estimated 2027-09-05)

name: Fyri Trail
description: Fýri Trail by Salomon is a unique trail race in Hemsedal, Norway, offering spectacular experiences in the Norwegian mountains. The race is the final event in the Salomon Golden Trail Nordic Series and offers three distances: 29 km, 18 km and 56 km ultra. Participants can look forward to challenging technical sections such as “Queen of the Hill,” with 550 metres of climbing, and “Max Effort,” with 600 metres of descent. After the race, runners gather for a festive “Mud & Champagne” celebration with live music and an inclusive atmosphere that celebrates every achievement.
course_highlights: Queen of the Hill: 3 km of technical climbing with 550 m of elevation gain
Max Effort: 4 km downhill run with 600 m of elevation change
The race starts just outside Fýri Resort, on varied surfaces including asphalt, gravel and wide trails
additional: There are two start groups for the 18 km and 29 km distances, starting at 09:15 and 10:30. The elite group (top 50 men and women) starts in a separate corral near the start line. A “Mud & Champagne” after-run party with live music is held, along with a Superhero Celebration Hour where the final runners are celebrated. Accommodation and winter packages are also available at Fýri Resort.

name: SportScheck RUN Hannover
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The SportScheck Run Hannover is an evening night run that transforms Hanover’s city centre into a spectacular display of lights. Runners can choose between a 1 km children’s race and 5 km and 10 km courses, which pass through the illuminated city centre and landmarks such as Opernplatz, the Lower Saxony State Parliament, Kröpcke and the New Town Hall. The nighttime atmosphere makes the run a particularly memorable experience. The fastest runners can take part in a 10 km SpeedRUN, with a target time of under 50 minutes. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and also offers training plans to help them prepare.

name: ONW-Lauf Dannenberg 2025
description: There are three race distances of 2.1 km, 4.2 km and 10.5 km, starting at the Market Square. The event welcomes participants of all ages and supports a good cause while fostering a strong sense of community. The entry fee for female students is covered; adults pay 6 euros. Groups of four or more can enter the team competition and win trophies.

name: Kung Björn Loppet

price_tiers.distance: Mini Kung Björn (barn upp till 7 år)
Lilla Kung Björn (barn upp till 12 år)
10 km, 6 km och Trail ca 5 km

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmälan sista veckan 345 kr för samtliga klasser

description: Kung Björn Loppet är ett terränglopp i Uppsala som välkomnar elitlöpare, motionärer och barn i alla åldrar med familjen i centrum. Loppet arrangeras vid OK Linnés klubbgård och erbjuder flera distanser inklusive barnlopp, 6 km, 10 km och ett traillopp på cirka 5 km. Banorna består av grusväg, skogsstig och asfalt med vätskestationer längs de längre distanserna. Efter loppet sker prisutdelning och utlottning av priser bland deltagarna.
course_highlights: Terränglopp med grusväg, skogsstig och asfalt
Banor på cirka 10 km, 6 km och traillopp på cirka 5 km
Två vätskestationer på 10 km-banan och en på 6 km-banan
additional: Nummerlappar med elektroniska chip hämtas hos Löplabbet dagen före tävlingsdagen eller på tävlingsdagen från kl 09:00. Det finns omklädningsrum med dusch och toalett vid tävlingsområdet, men utrymmet är begränsat. Kiosk finns med försäljning av dryck, varmkorv och fikabröd. Startgrupper finns för 10 km med möjlighet att välja mellan snabbare och långsammare grupper. Parkering finns mot avgift, men kollektivtrafik och cykel rekommenderas. Evenemanget har nummerlappsutlämning med elektroniska chip och prisutdelning.

name: Kistaloppet
location: Jan Stenbecks torg, Kista, Stockholm, Sverige
description: Kistaloppet är ett uppskattat löpevenemang i Kista, Stockholm, som erbjuder lopp för hela familjen med distanser från 400 meter för de yngsta till 5 km för vuxna. Loppet går genom Kistas unika miljöer, inklusive miljonprogrammets höghus, Järvafältets grönområden och IT-klustret som gjort Kista känt som norra Europas Silicon Valley. Evenemanget präglas av en folkfest med musik och underhållning längs banan och en inkluderande atmosfär där alla deltagare får medalj. Kistaloppet arrangeras av Löparakademin, en ideell organisation som arbetar för att främja hälsa och rörelse i förorten.
course_highlights: 5 km kontrollmätt bana genom Kistas miljonprogram och grönområden
Start och mål vid Jan Stenbecks torg, centralt i Kista
Underhållning och musikstationer längs banan för extra pepp
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas i tävlingscenter i Kista Galleria, lokal mitt emot McDonalds, fredagen 12:00-18:00 och lördagen 09:15-13:00. Efteranmälan är möjlig på plats i mån av plats. Vätskestation finns vid målgång. Sjukvårdspersonal finns på plats. Alla deltagare får specialdesignad medalj. Musik och DJs längs banan skapar folkfeststämning. De publicerade uppgifterna gäller upplagan 2026 och bekräftar inte datum eller anmälningsvillkor för 2027. För 2026 anges även ett 1,6 km Fun Run utan tidtagning samt barnlopp på cirka 1,6 km och 500 meter.

name: Black River Run, 100 miles
location: Västerås SOK clubhouse Orientalen, Västerås, Sverige
description: Black River Run är ett ultra maratonlopp i Västerås med flera distanser, inklusive 100 miles, 50 miles, Instegsultra (48 km), 20 miles och 10 miles. Start, varvning och mål är vid Västerås SOK:s klubbstuga Orientalen, där det finns omklädning, dusch och bastu. Banan består av ett varv på 10 miles (16,1 km) med varierande underlag som tekniska stigar, motionsspår, grusväg, vandringsled och asfalt. Loppet erbjuder bältesspänne till de som springer 100 miles under 24 timmar och medalj till övriga som slutför loppet, med möjlighet att skänka medaljen till förmån för Läkare utan Gränser.
course_highlights: Varierande underlag: tekniska stigar, motionsspår, grusväg, vandringsled och asfalt
Ett varv är 10 miles (16,1 km)
Start, varvning och mål vid Västerås SOK:s klubbstuga Orientalen med omklädning, dusch och bastu
additional: Om du springer 100 miles under 24 timmar får du ett bältesspänne. De som vill kan avstå medaljen till förmån för Läkare utan Gränser, och då skänks 20 kr per medalj till organisationen. Det finns även dusch och bastu i klubbstugan vid starten/målet. Löpare som klarar 100 miles inom 24 timmar får ett bältesspänne; övriga som fullföljer får medalj.

name: Lergöksloppet
description: Lergöksloppet är ett löplopp som går på stigar och skogsvägar i den vackra Kronoskogen i Ängelholm, vilket erbjuder en naturnära och inspirerande miljö för löpare i alla åldrar. Efter målgång bjuds deltagarna i klass 1 på frukt och saft, medan övriga klasser kan njuta av kaffe eller te. Loppet är välkomnande för både stora och små löpare och präglas av en fin gemenskap i naturskön miljö.
course_highlights: Banorna går på stigar och skogsvägar
Loppet hålls i Kronoskogen i Ängelholm
Naturnära och inspirerande miljö
additional: Efter målgång serveras frukt och saft till deltagare i klass 1; övriga klasser erbjuds kaffe eller te.

name: Klarälvsloppet Run 21k
description: Klarälvsloppet Run 21K är en snabb och naturskön halvmara som går på en lätt sluttande, asfalterad banvall från Forshaga Lärcenter till Karlstad. Banan är helt bilfri och utan branta stigningar, vilket ger optimala förutsättningar för att sätta personliga rekord. Loppet följer Klarälvsbanan genom det värmländska landskapet och erbjuder en unik löpupplevelse på nio mils asfalterad naturstig. Det finns tre officiella vätskekontroller längs banan med vatten och sportdryck, och i mål väntar frukt och fika. Starten sker på lördagen kl 10:30 med gemensam uppvärmning i startområdet.
course_highlights: Lätt sluttande asfalterad banvall från Forshaga till Karlstad
Helt bilfri bana utan branta stigningar
Tre officiella vätskekontroller med vatten och sportdryck
additional: Start och nummerlappsutdelning sker vid Forshaga Lärcenter kl 09:00 - 10:00 på tävlingsdagen. Deltagare måste klara loppet inom maxtiden 2:45. En minibuss följer efter startfältet och plockar upp deltagare som inte klarar maxtiden. Bussar går från Karlstad Stadsbibliotek till startplatsen för de som köpt busstransport. Vid målet finns frukt och fika. Betalning på plats sker endast med kort eller Swish. Sjukvård finns vid start, mål och vätskestationer. Arrangören beskriver loppet som en möjlig ”Skandinaviens snabbaste halvmara?”.

name: TronFjellet Ultra 2027
description: TronFjellet Ultra is a challenging, self-navigated mountain ultramarathon of approximately 50 km with 3,000 meters of elevation gain in Østkjolen, Alvdal. The race features a rugged, technically demanding route with long sections off-trail, steep descents, and exposed high-mountain terrain. Participants must navigate using a GPS track with no route markings, be self-sufficient throughout, and contend with challenges such as rapidly changing weather and demanding terrain. With a maximum of 25 participants and a 24-hour time limit, this race is for strong, experienced ultrarunners seeking an iconic mountain challenge in Østerdalen.
course_highlights: Approximately 50 km with 3,000 meters of elevation gain
Self-navigated, with no marked trails; GPS-based navigation
Technically demanding mountain terrain with steep descents and exposed sections
additional: Maximum 25 participants. 24-hour time limit. No marked trails; the race requires GPS navigation using a GPX track. 100% self-sufficient throughout, with no aid stations or drop bags. Pacers and pets are not allowed. Live tracking for safety. The race is 100% self-sufficient, with no food station or drop bag, and has a 24-hour time limit. Live tracking, maximum 25 participants.

name: BMW Oslo Maraton inkl. NM maraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris for deltagelse på 10 for Grete er 800 kroner. Administrasjonsgebyr på 6,75% + 3 kr er inkludert i prisen. Engangslisens (50 kr) vil komme i tillegg.

description: DNB Oslo Marathon is one of Norway’s largest road races, with over 29,000 participants, and offers distances for all ages and levels, including the marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and the children’s event Extra Oslo Mini Marathon. The race takes place in central Oslo on a varied course with beautiful city and fjord views. It is an inclusive event with dedicated para categories and a wheelchair race, and places great emphasis on a positive participant experience, with aid stations, pacers, and a wide range of services. The race takes place on September 18, 2027, and has a new registration system for 2027.
course_highlights: The marathon course has approximately 350 metres of elevation gain and consists of two laps of the half-marathon course
The half-marathon course has approximately 175 metres of elevation gain and runs through central Oslo
The 10 km course has approximately 50 metres of elevation gain and is suitable for all levels
additional: There are aid stations approximately every 5 kilometres, with Maxim energy drink and water included in the registration fee. Pacers carrying flags guide runners toward various finish times and provide motivation. Group registration is available, with discounts for groups of at least 10 participants and consolidated invoicing. Cancellation insurance is also available when registering. GPX files for the courses are available to download. Previous editions have also offered the half marathon, 10 km, and Oslotrippelen.

name: BERGAN BYGG Brakvatnet halvmaraton + stafett
description: Bergan Bygg Brakvatnet Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon organized by Osterøy IL Friidrett. The race takes place around Brakvatnet on Osterøy, on a course of eight laps of 2,595 metres plus 337.5 metres, with the start and finish by the bathing area. The event also includes a relay and a children’s race, and provides changing and toilet facilities as well as food in the finish area. It attracts both recreational runners and competitive athletes, offering beautiful scenery and a challenging course in picturesque surroundings.
course_highlights: The course consists of 8 laps around Brakvatnet plus 337.5 metres to the start/finish
Start and finish by the bathing area at Brakvatnet
Course records: Espen Borge Joensen 1.18,02 (2024) and Hilde Aasheim 1.24,29 (2013)
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:00. Changing tents and toilets for women and men are available in the finish area. Food is served in the finish area, with Vipps as the preferred payment method. Parking is limited; parking at Valestrand school or Valestrandsvatnet is recommended. Cars cannot be driven from the start area. The course is 2,595 metres per lap around Brakvatnet. Previous editions have had the half-marathon and relay start at 12:00. Changing tents, toilets and a dining room are listed in the finish area. Parking is recommended at Valestrand school or the car park at Valestrandsvatnet; it is not possible to drive all the way to Brakvatnet.

name: Muruvik Backyard Ultra
description: Muruvik Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon held in Malvik, Trøndelag, starting at Muruvik Community Hall. The course is 6.7 km long and follows an out-and-back route along the idyllic Malvik Trail to Hommelvik. Its flat profile offers good opportunities for a record. The race is run in one-hour laps, and runners must complete one lap every hour until only one runner remains. This creates an exciting, tactical challenge for ultrarunners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop along the Malvik Trail between Muruvik and Hommelvik
Flat course offering good opportunities for a record
The course includes a short trail section with a slight climb before returning to the Malvik Trail
additional: Meet and start at Muruvik Community Hall. Parking is limited, so carpooling is recommended. Luggage transport from the parking area to the start area is available. Muruvikstua and tents are available for storage and overnight stays. Simple refreshments, including drinks and snacks, are provided. Personal support is permitted within the start and finish area, but not out on the course. Race bibs and timing chips will be distributed closer to race day.

name: Bryneløpet
description: Bryneløpet is an annual race organized by Bryne Friidrett for primary school children in grades 1 to 7. It has been held since 2013 and takes place during the Potetfestivalen in Bryne. The race starts between M44 and Brynesenteret and follows a route around the lower part of Fritz Røed Park, covering approximately 400 meters. Participants are divided into groups by age and gender for a safe and enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: The route starts between M44 and Brynesenteret
Around the lower part of Fritz Røed Park
Approximately 400 meters, with the start and finish in the same place
additional: Participants start in groups by grade and gender: girls and boys in grades 1–2, girls and boys in grades 3–4, and girls and boys in grades 5–7. Race numbers are handed out in the play area at the start/finish. The race is held in connection with the Potetfestivalen. For the 2026 edition, race numbers could be collected outside Jordbærpikene in M44; corresponding practical information for 2027 has not been provided.

name: Backyard Kristiansand ultra
description: Backyard Kristiansand is a unique ultrarun where participants run a gently rolling loop of approximately 6.7 km every hour on the hour, for a maximum of 12 laps. The race combines tactics and endurance: runners can choose to run fast to earn breaks or take it easy to conserve energy. The event has a social focus and a low barrier to entry, and offers simple refreshments and a place to rest at Gimlehallen in Kristiansand. Everyone who completes 12 laps receives a cup, and those who reach the ultradistance receive a Norwegian-made wooden medal.
course_highlights: Gently rolling loop of approximately 6.7 km, with asphalt (70%) and gravel (30%)
The race takes place at Gimlehallen, with the start and finish at the hall’s exit
A maximum of 12 laps, for a total of 80.4 km if completed
additional: Participants must bring their own drinking cup, headlamp and reflective vest. Bib pickup is at the Gimlehallen cafeteria on Friday 17:30-19 and Saturday 07:45-08:30. There is a designated rest area in the hall, and participants are encouraged to bring their own chair. Simple snacks, coffee, sweet tea, broth, and cold/hot water are served. The maximum number of participants is 500. Support is not permitted indoors or on the course, only in the outdoor start and finish area.

name: Sandnes Halvmaraton
description: Sandnes Half Marathon takes place on 18 September 2027, starting and finishing at Bogafjellhallen. The courses are officially measured and offer beautiful scenery around Stokkalandsvatnet, Sandvedparken and Bogafjell, with varied terrain including a steep hill up to Bogafjell Church. The event offers distances for everyone, from a children’s race to a half marathon, with drink stations along the way. It is a great opportunity for both recreational and experienced runners to enjoy the scenic surroundings of Sandnes.
course_highlights: Officially measured 21.1 km course with two laps around Stokkalandsvatnet and Sandvedparken
Steep hill up to Bogafjell Church on the 5 km and children’s race courses
Drink stations after approximately 3 km (for the 5 km and 10 km/half marathon) along the course
additional: You can travel to the start by public transport by taking the train to Ganddal station and walking 30 minutes to Bogafjell, or by taking the bus to Bogafjell. The children’s race starts at 12:00 and can also serve as a warm-up for adults who want to run with the children. The half marathon starts at 13:00. The start location may be adjusted due to work at the venue. Ganddal station and the bus to Bogafjell are the stated public transport options.

name: Fýri Trail by Salomon
description: Fýri Trail by Salomon invites you to a unique trail-running experience in the Norwegian mountains at Fýri Resort in Hemsedal. This race is the final event in the Salomon Golden Trail Nordic Series and offers three distances: 29 km, 18 km, and a 56 km ultra. The race combines demanding technical trails with spectacular scenery, including the challenging “Queen of the Hill” climb and the fast “Max Effort” descent. After the race, participants can celebrate at the “Mud & Champagne” party, creating a social and inclusive atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: Queen of the Hill: 3 km technical climb with 550 m of elevation gain
Max Effort: 4 km descent with 600 m of elevation loss
Start just outside Fýri Resort on varied surfaces including asphalt, gravel, and wide trails
additional: The race has two start groups based on expected finish time, with an Elite group for the top 50 men and women starting in a separate wave. Shuttle buses run from Fýri Resort before the start. After the race, the “Mud & Champagne” party features live music and a Superhero Celebration Hour to honour the final runners. Fýri Resort is the festival’s meeting point. The programme may include test runs, talks, an awards ceremony, and the Fýri Trail Party.

name: Ulvøyløpet
organizer: Ulvøy Challenge (Melbu Idrettslag, Stokmarknes Idrettslag og Lekang Ski- og Bygdelag)
description: Ulvøyløpet is a beautiful trail race through Hadseløya’s stunning landscape in the heart of Lofoten and Vesterålen. The race offers two distances, 13 km and 26 km, with varied terrain featuring technical trails, forest roads and open mountain trails. Whether you’re looking for a challenge or a wonderful experience in nature, Ulvøyløpet offers spectacular views and flowing trails that let you pick up the pace. The event has a long tradition and is organised by volunteers in support of local sports clubs and children and young people.
course_highlights: 13 km course with 450 metres of elevation gain, featuring technical and steep trails, forest roads and open mountain trails
26 km course with 1,000 metres of elevation gain and varied terrain, including forest roads, technical trails and mountain landscape
Flowing trails between Moan and Barheia are a highlight of the long course
additional: The recreational class starts between 09:00 and 11:00. Race numbers can be collected at Corner Sport in Stokmarknes or at Stokmarknes Stadium on race day from 08:30. Drop-bag transport from the start to the finish and return transport from Melbu to Stokmarknes after the race are available. There is ample parking at the start and finish, and toilets are available. The café in the finish area is open from 11:00 to 16:30. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at approximately 14:30 at Havfisk Arena, Melbu. The courses are marked with flags and signs, and downloading the GPX file for navigation is recommended. Aid stations offer bananas, cordial, sports drink and water (bring your own cup). Littering along the course is prohibited. A recreational walk along the 13 km course is also available. Walking participants register at Stokmarknes Stadium and may start between 09:00 and 11:00.

name: Bergan Bygg Brakvatnet Halvmaraton
description: Bergan Bygg Brakvatnet Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon held at Brakvatnet on Osterøy. The course consists of eight laps around Brakvatnet plus an extra 337.5-meter section, with the start and finish at the bathing area. The event also includes a children’s race and a relay. Changing and toilet facilities are available in the finish area, and food is for sale. The race attracts both local and visiting runners and offers a scenic, varied route around the lake.
course_highlights: The course consists of 8 laps around Brakvatnet plus 337.5 meters
Start and finish at the bathing area by Brakvatnet
Scenic course approximately 2 km from Valestrandsfossen on Osterøy
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:00, and the half marathon and relay start at 12:00. There are changing tents and toilets for both women and men in the finish area. Food is for sale in the finish area; Vipps or cash is preferred. Parking is limited, and participants are encouraged to park at Valestrand School or by Valestrandsvatnet. Cars are not driven from the start area. The finish area has changing tents, toilets, and a dining room. Parking is at Valestrand School or the parking lot by Valestrandsvatnet.

name: Renforsin maraton, Kajaani
description: Renfors Marathon is a charity running event held in Kajaani, with proceeds supporting local youth sports. The event offers a wonderful route alongside Kajaani’s most beautiful river scenery and sights, including near the ruins of Kajaani Castle. Raatihuoneentori serves as the start and finish area, and the route follows the banks of the Kajaani River. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon, a quarter marathon, and children’s races for different age groups.

name: Kyröö-hölkkä 19.9.2026
description: Kyröö Run is a relaxed running event held in the beautiful rural landscapes of Isokyrö. The event offers suitable distances for both joggers and faster runners, and the race also determines the unofficial Finnish championship medals in gravel running. The start is at the Kyrö Visitor Centre, and the route runs through varied but flat terrain. Join us to enjoy the fun of exercise in good company and run where the asphalt ends!

name: Ylivieska Trail Run – Meleko hyvä polokujuoksutapahtuma
description: Ylivieska Trail Run is a trail-running event held at Törmälä Camp Centre and Rantakalla in Ylivieska. The event offers competitive categories for men and women over 14 km, as well as recreational and hiking categories over 1.5 km, 5 km and 11 km. Prizes are also available in the youth categories, and the youngest children can take part in a free stadium dash. An extended weekend at Jäkälähovi in Kalajoki will be drawn among all participants. The event offers a variety of options and is suitable for trail runners of different abilities.

name: HOKA Messilä Vertical
description: HOKA Messilä Vertical is a unique competition where the goal is to accumulate the most elevation gain within a given time. The race takes place at the Messilä Ski Resort in Hollola, and participants run a 1.2 km course with approximately 90 metres of ascent and descent per lap. There are three categories, with time limits of 1, 2 or 4 hours. The winner in each category is the participant who completes the most laps. The event is open to all ages, and the atmosphere is relaxed but challenging, making it suitable for both first-time and experienced runners.

name: Løb Mellem Husene i Aalborg SØ 2026
Jõhvi rahvajooks
organizer: Jõhvi kultuuri- ja spordinõunik Avo Sambla
description: The Jõhvi People’s Run is a traditional running event, taking place for the 39th time at Heino Lipp Stadium in Jõhvi. This year, the course has been updated: in addition to city streets, it also runs through a park and the shops of Pargi Centre. The event offers an exciting and varied running experience over both the 5 km and 10 km distances. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a good sporting challenge.

name: 13. Saarepeedi mägede jooks
description: The 13th Saarepeedi Hills Run is a traditional running event held near the Saarepeedi Community Centre. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and hilly trails. It is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking to test their endurance and agility. The organizers welcome all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy an active day.

name: Bėgimas „Ateik ir įveik!", skirtas prof. K. Baršausko atminimui
description: The “Come and Conquer!” run is a traditional event organized by Kaunas University of Technology in memory of Prof. K. Baršauskas. It invites participants to test their strength on a variety of running and walking routes, including a new 5 km run with dogs. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively, promote a healthy lifestyle, and take part in a community sporting event. The competition takes place at the KTU Stadium and in Ąžuolynas, and participants receive commemorative medals and prizes by age group.

name: We Run Riga pusmaratons Mežaparkā

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pasākuma dalības maksa iekļauj iespēju piedalīties visās pasākuma aktivitātēs un skrējienos, tai skaitā vairākās distancēs, ja pasākuma programma to ļauj, We Run Riga oficiālo Nike sporta T-kreklu, piemiņas medaļu un citus atbalstītāju sagatavotos labumus.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pasākuma dalības maksa iekļauj iespēju piedalīties bērnu skrējienā un citās pasākuma aktivitātēs, We Run Riga oficiālo Nike sporta T-kreklu, piemiņas medaļu un citus atbalstītāju sagatavotos labumus.

description: The We Run Riga Half Marathon in Mežaparks is the biggest running festival of the autumn, taking place on 18 September in Mežaparks, Riga. The event offers a range of distances, including a half marathon, relay, 10 km and 5 km runs, as well as children’s races. Participants receive an official Nike running T-shirt, a commemorative medal and other benefits. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, and participants can take part in several distances at once, choosing their distance at the starting line.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 21.0975 km in Mežaparks
2 × 10.5 km relay
Races over various distances: 5 km, 10 km and children’s races
additional: Participants can take part in several distances at once, choosing their distance at the starting line. The entry fee includes an official Nike running T-shirt, a commemorative medal and other participant benefits.

name: 9. Bernburger Halbmarathon
description: Der Bernburger Halbmarathon findet am 18. September 2027 am Rosenhag in Bernburg statt. Die Hauptstrecke führt entlang der Saale durch die Bernburger Talstadt, über die Marktbrücke und weiter bis unterhalb des Schlosses in Plötzkau, bevor es zurück zum Ziel am Saaleufer geht. Neben dem Halbmarathon werden auch 5 km und 12 km Läufe angeboten, die ebenfalls landschaftlich reizvolle Strecken entlang der Saale umfassen. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine elektronische Netto-Zeitmessung, Finisher-Medaillen und eine Siegerehrung für die besten Läuferinnen und Läufer.
course_highlights: Strecke entlang der Saale mit zwei Saaleüberquerungen
Wendepunkt unterhalb des Schlosses in Plötzkau
Start und Ziel am Rosenhag an der Tiergartenschänke/Anleger Saalefee
additional: Startnummernausgabe am 17.09.2027 von 18:00 bis 20:00 Uhr und am Renntag ab 08:30 Uhr. Elektronische Netto-Zeitmessung über Startnummer. Nachmeldungen sind bis 30 Minuten vor dem jeweiligen Start gegen eine Gebühr von 2 € möglich. Zeitlimit für Halbmarathon 3 Stunden, für 5 km und 12 km jeweils 2 Stunden. Finisher-Medaille und Urkunden (auch online) inklusive.

name: Insellauf Rund um Amrum
location: Norddorf auf Amrum, Nordfriesland, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Insellauf Rund um Amrum is a popular fun run for everyone, held annually in late summer in Norddorf on the North Sea island of Amrum. The event offers a sporting challenge amid the unique natural surroundings of the Wadden Sea National Park, a World Heritage Site. Participants can enjoy the varied landscape of dunes, Kniepsand and sea views. The race is an appealing way for both locals and holidaymakers to combine physical activity with experiencing nature.
course_highlights: Run through the varied landscape of Kniepsand and dunes
Course in the Wadden Sea National Park, a World Heritage Site
Start and finish in Norddorf on Amrum
additional: The Insellauf takes place annually in late summer. The event is part of Amrum’s extensive sports programme. The venue is the AOK-Nordseeklinik, Strunwai 23, in Norddorf on Amrum. The event takes place in the Wadden Sea National Park area and emphasises experiencing nature and beach activities. Registration is possible on site or by email, with refreshments and support provided by local partners.

name: Röderhof-Benefiz-Lauf
description: The Röderhof Charity Run takes place in Diekholzen and offers various running and walking distances for all age groups and ability levels. This traditional charity event focuses on the enjoyment of running and working together for a good cause. Distances range from 500 metres to 10 kilometres, including special wheelchair races. Start times are staggered to ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 500 m to 10 km
Inclusive wheelchair races and walking routes
Run through the scenic surroundings of Diekholzen
additional: Online registration closes on 15.09 at 21:00. Late registration is possible on the event day up to 1 hour before the start, with an additional late-registration fee of 2 euros. Payment by direct debit is possible. The event has multiple start times for different distances and categories, including special wheelchair races and walking routes. Various running events, wheelchair races, walking, and the option to donate via PayPal

name: 32. Stadtparklauf
description: The Stadtparklauf Sondershausen is a traditional running event held annually in Sondershausen City Park. It offers various distances from 500 m to 10,000 m and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The route winds through the picturesque city park, offering a pleasant running atmosphere in a green setting. The event is organized by SV Glückauf Sondershausen e.V. and is very popular in the region.

name: 6. The Devil's Loop - Langenberg Backyard Ultramarathon
description: The Devil's Loop - Langenberg Backyard Ultramarathon is a challenging ultramarathon held in Enge-Sande, Schleswig-Holstein. The race is part of the Waterkant Cup and offers runners the opportunity to test their endurance on a demanding course. The organizer, Sportverein Enge-Sande von 1959 e.V., is a multi-faceted club offering a wide range of sporting activities. The event is aimed at ambitious runners looking for a special challenge.

name: Duinger Berglauf
description: The Duinger Berglauf takes place in Duingen, Lower Saxony, and offers races for children and adults. The event starts and finishes at the OBS sports hall and includes short children’s races as well as more challenging 5 km and 10 km hill runs with around 110 metres of elevation gain. Organized by Duinger Sport-Club e.V., the race has been an accessible local hill-running event for 19 years. After the race, all participants receive free access to the indoor swimming pool and sauna, with changing rooms, showers, and refreshments available on site.

name: Edeka Ladage-Lauf Wennigsen
description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen offers a varied programme for all age groups, with distances ranging from about 600 m for kindergarten children to 10 km for adults. The races take place on a varied loop course on the grounds of Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School, running through residential areas and along field paths, with a special atmosphere at the start and finish. Alongside the sporting competition, the event also has a social focus, as proceeds from the main race are donated to the Bastlergemeinschaft der Wennigser Wasserräder e.V. The event is a popular community run with a family-friendly atmosphere and a long tradition in the region.

name: Freimarktslauf
description: The Freimarktslauf in Garrel is the region’s largest community race, offering a varied running experience for young and old, beginners and professionals on its flat loop courses. The event features distances ranging from a 400 m children’s race to the 10 km main races, which take place on a flat 2.5 km loop through Garrel. Alongside the sporting competition, community and fun take center stage, supported by RunClub Garrel, which specifically encourages beginners. More than 1,300 participants make the race a popular event filled with unforgettable moments.

name: Klausdorfer Kranichlauf
description: The Klausdorf Crane Run invites runners of all ages to take part in various races through the beautiful surroundings of Klausdorf. Times are recorded using a chip issued with the race number. Every participant receives a certificate and a medal, and the top three finishers in each race are honored separately. Refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish, and changing rooms and restrooms are available at Vorpommernhus. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes.

name: Wilstermarsch Lauf
description: Der Wilstermarschlauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung in Wilster, die am 18. September 2027 zum 35. Mal stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Laufdistanzen für Kinder und Erwachsene, darunter 400 m, 2 km, 5 km und 10 km Läufe sowie Walking-Strecken. Start und Ziel sind im Wilstermarschstadion, und die Strecke führt durch die landschaftlich reizvolle Wilstermarsch mit flachem Terrain. Neben dem sportlichen Wettkampf sorgt ein buntes Rahmenprogramm mit Spielen, DJ, Hüpfkissen und Verlosungen für Unterhaltung und eine familiäre Atmosphäre.
course_highlights: Flache Streckenführung durch die Wilstermarsch
Start und Ziel im Wilstermarschstadion
Kinderläufe mit Stadionrunde und Strecken durch Wilster und Umgebung
additional: Der Wilstermarschlauf ist Teil des Steinburg Cups. Es gibt ein Rahmenprogramm mit Spielen, Hüpfkissen, DJ, Grillbude, Erfrischungen und Fotowand. Die Veranstaltung wird von ca. 40 Helfern unterstützt, und es gibt Verlosungen von Preisen und Gutscheinen für Teilnehmer. Die Veranstaltung wird vom MTV Wilster e.V. organisiert.

name: Wutzseelauf
description: The Wutzseelauf in Lindow (Mark) is a family-friendly fun run taking place for the 21st time. The varied courses loop around Lake Wutzsee through the Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park and offer running opportunities for all ages, from Bambinis to experienced runners. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere, professional chip timing and varied supporting programme. Participants can choose distances from 600 metres to 22 kilometres, including Nordic walking. Award ceremonies take place after the races, and every finisher receives a certificate to download or print on site.

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the scenic Gontyniec massif. Runners cover as much distance as possible, with fully equipped aid stations after each loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, beautiful views of the Noteć Valley, and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It’s a special experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable memories.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
location: Parking przy Operze Leśnej, Sopot, Poland
description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race held in the scenic surroundings of the Forest Opera in Sopot. The route runs through the forest, with numerous climbs and descents, including a steep climb up Łysa Góra, and passes former ski jumps and residential areas. The start and finish are in the parking lot by the Forest Opera, and the participant limit is 250. The race is part of the Run in Sopot series, which also includes beach races.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the parking lot by the Forest Opera in Sopot
The route runs through the forest and past former ski jumps on Łysa Góra
A steep climb up Łysa Góra and varied terrain with switchbacks
additional: The finish is at the starting point. Only people wearing a race bib may be on the course. Competitors line up in the designated start area.

name: Trollhättan City Trail
description: Trollhättan City Trail är ett terränglopp genom centrala Trollhättan som startade 2016. Loppet utgår från Folkets Park och tar löparna genom varierad terräng med inslag av stadsmiljö, kuperade stigar, trappor och natursköna områden som Kopparklinten, Gamle dal, flera slussar, Olidan och Kungsgrottan. Det finns flera distanser att välja mellan, från en kort barnvänlig Mini Trail till längre utmanande banor upp till 22,5 km. Loppet erbjuder även startklasser för löpning med hund på vissa distanser, vilket gör det till ett inkluderande och gemenskapsfyllt evenemang.
course_highlights: Terränglopp med kuperade stigar och pulshöjande trappor
Passerar flera slussar, Kopparklinten, Gamle dal, Olidan och Kungsgrottan
Mix av stadsmiljö och naturnära upplevelser
additional: Nummerlappsutdelningen öppnar 11:30. Starttider: 13:00 för Mini Trail 0,8 km, 14:00 för City Trail 8,5, 14 och 22,5 km, samt 14:15 för City Trail 8,5 och 14 km med hund i koppel. Prisutdelning sker cirka 30 minuter efter första målgång. Loppet erbjuder egna startgrupper för löpning med hund i koppel på 8,5 km och 14 km. Mini Trail är ett barnlopp utan tidtagning och tävling för 0-12 år. Start och mål i Folkets Park. Tidigare upplagor har erbjudit 8,5 km, 14 km och 22,5 km samt Trollhättan Mini Trail på cirka 0,8 km.

name: Hökensås Trail
location: First Camp Hökensås, Tidaholm Municipality, Sverige
description: Hökensås Trail är ett terränglopp med start vid First Camp Hökensås, där tallmo och böljande åsar skapar en naturnära löpupplevelse. Välj mellan distanserna 5,5 km, 11,5 km och 19 km. Loppet passar både dig som vill prova trail och dig som söker en längre utmaning i skogsmiljö.
course_highlights: Löpning på Hökensås tallmo och böljande åsar.
Tre distanser: 5,5 km, 11,5 km och 19 km.
Start och mål vid First Camp Hökensås.

name: Billingehusloppet
description: Billingehusloppet är ett traditionsrikt terränglopp med anor från 1966, arrangerat av IFK Skövde Skidor. Loppet har historiskt haft varierande distanser, men sedan 1993 tävlar både män och kvinnor på 10,5 km. Det finns även klasser för yngre deltagare såsom Knatteloppet och Lilla Billingehusloppet samt en stavgångsklass för motionärer. Loppet har lockat många kända svenska löpare genom åren och är en uppskattad tävling i Skövde.
course_highlights: Terränglopp med anrika traditioner sedan 1966
Tävling på 10,5 km för både män och kvinnor sedan 1993
Klasser för yngre löpare och stavgång
additional: Nya klasser för yngre deltagare finns, inklusive Knatteloppet och Lilla Billingehusloppet. Det finns även en stavgångsklass för de som föredrar det. Banrekord finns dokumenterade för herrar och damer på 10,5 km samt äldre distanser.

name: Coop Linköping Runt
description: Coop Linköping Runt är ett stadslopp i Linköping med Trädgårdsföreningen som samlingsplats. Här kan löpare mötas för en dag med rörelse och löparglädje i en välkomnande miljö. Loppet arrangeras av Linköpings GIF, och anmälan till 2026 års upplaga är öppen.
course_highlights: Trädgårdsföreningen är loppets samlingsplats.
Loppet går i Linköping.
Detaljer om bansträckningen framgår inte av de tillgängliga källorna.
additional: Linköpings GIF-medlemmar kan delta gratis i alla klasser med kampanjkoden LGIF2026.

name: Sicklaloppet
description: Sicklaloppet är höstens stora löparfest i Nacka med motionslopp för alla åldrar och nivåer. Huvudloppet är ett 10 km motionslopp som går längs vackra sjöstränder i Sickla och Hammarby Sjöstad med start och mål i Sickla Köpkvarter. Det finns även ett 5 km Energilopp samt Lilla Sicklaloppet för barn upp till 12 år och Mini Sickla för de allra minsta. Loppen erbjuder en naturskön och snabb bana med en härlig atmosfär och mycket publikstöd. Sicklaloppet arrangeras av Järla IF Orientering och är ett folkhälsoevenemang för Nacka och Stockholm.
course_highlights: Banan går längs sjöstränder i Sickla och Hammarby Sjöstad
Underlaget består av asfalt, grus och träbrygga
Start och mål i Sickla Köpkvarter med publik och musikunderhållning
additional: Tävlingsplatsen öppnar kl 08.00 på Marcusplatsen i Sickla Köpkvarter med nummerlappsutdelning och anmälan på plats. Det finns foodtrucks och partners på plats. Lilla Sicklaloppet har starttider från 09.15 till 10.15 för olika åldersklasser. Sicklaloppet 5 km startar kl 11.45 och 10 km startar kl 13.00. Maxtid för 10 km är 1 timme och 15 minuter med rep vid Kyrkviken efter ca 7,5 km. Banan är kontrollmätt av Svenska Friidrottsförbundet. Start och mål för alla lopp är i Sickla Köpkvarter. Loppets webbplats beskriver 2026 års upplaga.

name: Lina Roindt

late_fee.price: 100 kr gebyr ved påmelding på løpsdagen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kr 30,- i tillegg for engangslisens for de som ikke har helårslisens

late_fee.price: 100 kr gebyr ved påmelding på løpsdagen

description: Lina Roindt is a traditional race organized by Rindal IL, bringing competitive runners, recreational runners, and walkers together for a major family day at Torshall in Bolme, Rindal. The 10.8 km route is on asphalt and forms a loop around Rindal town centre, with a 6.7 km option for the recreational class. The event includes competitive classes for different age groups, an untimed recreational class, and a school cup for grades 5–10. There is an awards ceremony, sprint prizes, prizes for course records, and raffle prizes in the recreational class. Lina Roindt attracts high participation and is known for its great atmosphere and efficient organization.
course_highlights: 10.8 km asphalt route around Rindal town centre
Recreational class with a 6.7 km option via Sunnabrua and Elvepromenaden
Course records are rewarded with NOK 1,000
additional: Start and finish at Torshall in Bolme. Race office at the start. Changing facilities at Rinnvollen Football Stadium. Awards ceremony for competitive classes at 15:00 at Torshall. The recreational class starts between 11:00 and 12:30. The «Bjergpris» sprint prize of NOK 300 is awarded after 2.7 km. One-third of participants receive prizes in each class, including cash prizes for the top three overall, regardless of class. The school cup is for grades 5–10, with a prize for the class with the highest participation. An untimed recreational class and a school cup for pupils in grades 5–10 are offered. The stated distances and practical details apply to previous editions and may change for 2027.

name: Gjesdalmilå
description: Gjesdalmilå is an annual race organized by Gjesdal Idrettslag and held in Ålgård. The event offers distances for children, 5 km and 10 km, as well as a double distance for those who want to run both the 5 km and 10 km. The courses pass through scenic surroundings, with the start and finish at Sentralidrettsanlegget, and feature varied terrain with both easy-running sections and some hills. The event is a natural choice for both recreational and elite athletes in the region and promotes the joy of sport for all ages.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is easy to run, with fewer hills, and consists of several loops around Solås skole and Åfaret.
The 10 km course crosses the E39 through the underpass and follows Edlandsvatnet over varied terrain.
The finish is on the athletics track at the finish line at Sentralidrettsanlegget.
additional: Schedule: The children's race starts at 12:00, the 5 km starts at 12:30, and the 10 km starts at 13:30. The double distance involves running both the 5 km and 10 km. The children's race is 650 metres and takes place in the area around Ålgård Stadion. For 2027, the schedule is: children's race at 12:00, 5 km at 12:30, and 10 km at 13:30.

name: Storehornet 497 - 2027
location: Storehornet, Godøya, Giske, Møre og Romsdal, Norway
description: Storehornet 497 is a hill race on Godøya, with a course climbing to the summit of Storehornet, 497 meters above sea level. The race is 4 kilometers long and offers a direct challenge from the island up towards the mountain. Join a running experience with the finish at the top of Godøya.
course_highlights: 4-kilometer hill race
Finish at Storehornet, 497 meters above sea level
The course is on Godøya in Møre og Romsdal

name: KOMIA Kyrkösjärven kierros
description: KOMIA Kyrkösjärvi Loop is Seinäjoki’s legendary and popular running event, taking runners around Kyrkösjärvi. The event venue is Kyrkösjärvi Beach and the Käpälikkö Nature Centre, where the start, finish, parking and event centre are located. The main distance is a 15.4 km route. There is also the shorter, approximately 4.3 km Pikku Kyrkkäri for young people or as a jog, as well as the 400–500 m Mini Kyrkkäri for the youngest family members. The event offers a memorable running experience surrounded by nature and is open to participants in different age groups and categories.

name: Juutuanvaaran kymppi – polkujuoksu Inarissa 2026
location: Juutunvaaran vanha metsä, Inari, Lapland, Finland
description: Juutuanvaara Ten is a new trail-running event in Inari, offering memorable trails of various lengths for all runners. The route runs through the old forest of Juutunvaara, with varied terrain ranging from pine heath to mountain birch woodland and spectacular views of Lake Inari. The race starts at 12:00, and participants are offered honorary prizes and commemorative medals. The event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, and participants receive a race sausage and a drink.

name: Rakvere 43. Rahvajooks
description: The 43rd Rakvere Folk Run is a traditional mass-sport event that welcomes all running enthusiasts. The race takes place at Rakvere City Stadium and offers a variety of distance options for both children and adults. The courses have been carefully chosen to provide an enjoyable running experience and promote a healthy lifestyle. The event is open to anyone sufficiently trained to complete their chosen distance.

name: Aerzener twinfit-Volkslauf
price_range: € 5,– bis € 9,– je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
description: The Aerzener twinfit Volkslauf is a family-friendly running event with various distances, starting and finishing in Aerzen. It offers 5 km and 10 km Volkslauf races, a 5 km company and team race, a 1.8 km school race, and a free children’s race. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere, refreshments, and an awards ceremony. The races are DLV-rated, and prizes and a participant raffle are available.
course_highlights: Start and finish at twinfit, Königsförder Straße 19, 31855 Aerzen
5 km and 10 km Volkslauf races, plus a 5 km company and team race
1.8 km school race and free children’s race
additional: Changing facilities with showers are available at twinfit. The awards ceremony is scheduled for around 13:30, with certificates for places 1–3 and a raffle. Drinks are available along the course and snacks in the finish area. Parking is available at twinfit.

name: Druffeler Volkslauf
description: The Druffeler Volkslauf takes place in Rietberg-Druffel and offers timed races over 1 km and 10 km. The event supports a solidarity initiative in sport that promotes running and maintains a relief fund for the families of injured runners. Members of laufen.de can benefit from the “Book smart, pay less!” formula. The course is officially measured and eligible for rankings.
course_highlights: Timed races over 1 km and 10 km
Start in Rietberg-Druffel
Typical September weather: around 19 °C and mostly cloudy skies
additional: Registration supports a solidarity sports initiative and a relief fund for injured runners. Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with a minimum of 10 °C and average precipitation of 45 mm; skies are mostly cloudy. Registration via laufen.de may offer a discount; supports charitable causes; ask the organizer for details before registering.

name: Jesteburger Volkslauf
description: Der Jesteburger Volkslauf wird vom VfL Jesteburg veranstaltet und bietet eine breite Auswahl an Laufstrecken von 2,3 km bis 10,5 km, sodass für Läufer aller Leistungsstufen etwas dabei ist. Die Veranstaltung findet in Jesteburg statt und ist eine beliebte Gelegenheit für Sportbegeisterte, sich in einer freundlichen und familiären Atmosphäre zu messen. Die Strecken führen durch abwechslungsreiche Landschaften und bieten sowohl für Freizeitläufer als auch für ambitionierte Athleten ein tolles Lauferlebnis.
course_highlights: Vielfältige Streckenlängen von 2,3 km bis 10,5 km
Laufstrecken durch abwechslungsreiche Landschaften in Jesteburg
Geeignet für Läufer aller Alters- und Leistungsgruppen
additional: Die Anmeldung erfolgt online bis zum 17.09.2027 (24:00 Uhr) über www.stgk.de. Es gibt keine expliziten Angaben zu Startzeiten oder Wellen. Der VfL Jesteburg bietet eine familiäre Vereinsatmosphäre mit vielfältigen Sportangeboten. Kontaktzeiten der Geschäftsstelle sind mittwochs und donnerstags von 17:00 bis 19:00 Uhr. Nachwuchsläufe über 400 m und 800 m sowie Walking über 10 km.

name: 12. PSD Bank Halbmarathon
description: The PSD Bank Half Marathon in Hamburg is a fast, flat running event that takes runners through the Wandsbek district and as far north as Berne subway station. The course then heads back via Rahlstedt and Tonndorf to the start and finish area on Wandsbeker Marktstraße. The race is known for its unique atmosphere, with support from spectators and live bands along the course, and takes place in late summer at dusk.

name: 14. Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra
description: The Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon held in Northeim. The course passes through varied terrain and offers a special challenge for experienced ultrarunners. The event has a long tradition, with numerous finishers and records that underscore the race’s high quality and athletic demands. Participants can download the course GPX track to prepare optimally.

name: 28. Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The 28th Hiddestorf Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. The event offers distances of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km, and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied program of activities that includes face painting for children. The event is open to all runners; club membership is not required.

name: 8. Altstadtlauf Salzwedel
description: The Altstadtlauf Salzwedel is part of the Elbe-Ohre-Cup and will take place for the eighth time in 2026. The course runs through the historic old town of Salzwedel on a 5 km loop. The longer distances, 10 km and half marathon, are run over multiple loops accordingly. The event is organized by Sportclub Demker ’95 e.V. and offers runners in northern Saxony-Anhalt an attractive racing opportunity.

name: Bordesholmer Seelauf SEE +RUN
description: Der SEE & RUN ist eine Laufveranstaltung des TSV Bordesholm, die jährlich am Bordesholmer See stattfindet. Nach einer Absage im Jahr 2026 richtet sich der Fokus nun auf die Neuauflage am 19. September 2027. Die Veranstaltung steht für ein sicheres und qualitativ hochwertiges Lauferlebnis in einer schönen Naturkulisse und richtet sich an Laufbegeisterte aller Altersgruppen.
course_highlights: Lauf rund um den Bordesholmer See
Naturnahe Strecke mit abwechslungsreichem Terrain
Veranstaltung in familiärer und sportlicher Atmosphäre
additional: Das Anmeldeportal für 2026 ist geschlossen, Rückabwicklung der Startgelder erfolgt per E-Mail. Die Veranstaltung wurde 2026 aufgrund organisatorischer und personeller Engpässe abgesagt. Der Veranstalter ist der Turn- und Sportverein Bordesholm von 1906 e.V.

name: CANOSSA Benefiz Berglauf
description: The CANOSSA Charity Mountain Run® in Bad Harzburg is a challenging fundraising run through Harz National Park. Participants can complete the course by running, Nordic walking or hiking. It finishes at the CANOSSA Column on Burgberg. The run supports inclusive work with children and young people in the Goslar district, combining a sporting challenge with social commitment. After the run, participants can enjoy a festive after-race event with music, refreshments and an awards ceremony.

name: Citylauf Leer
description: The Citylauf Leer is a traditional running event held in Leer city center at Denkmalsplatz. The event offers races for various age groups and distances, including Bambino, Teeny, 5 km, and 10 km races. The route follows closed circuits through the town center, with refreshment stations along the course and in the finish area. All participants receive a T-shirt (while supplies last), and attractive non-cash prizes and certificates are awarded to the top runners. The event is open to individual and team rankings and takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Grebinlauf
description: The Grebinlauf takes place in Grebin and offers varied routes for runners, walkers, children, and relay teams. The event is known for its great atmosphere and a special finish on the Grebin sports field. One highlight is the turning point at the Grebin Mill, which makes the course special. Registration is through the Davengo platform.

name: Heidelauf Halle am 20.09.2026
description: The 278th Heidelauf Halle takes place in Halle (Saale) and is organized by SV Halle Triathlon. The event gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a long-standing race. The course runs around the Heidebad and offers varied running terrain. Registration is open until race day.

name: Lohelauf
description: Der Lohelauf in Wentorf bei Hamburg ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die Läuferinnen und Läufer aller Altersklassen und Leistungsniveaus anspricht. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Streckenlängen und legt besonderen Wert auf Gemeinschaft und Inklusion, wie der erstmals angebotene 200-Meter-Lauf für Menschen mit Behinderung zeigt. Neben dem sportlichen Wettkampf gibt es ein buntes Rahmenprogramm mit Verpflegung und Unterhaltung für die Teilnehmer und Zuschauer. Die professionelle Zeitnahme und die Unterstützung durch zahlreiche Helfer sorgen für einen reibungslosen Ablauf.
course_highlights: Laufstrecken durch die Wentorfer Lohe
Inklusiver 200-Meter-Lauf für Menschen mit Behinderung
Verpflegung mit frischem Obst und Wasser durch REWE
additional: Die Veranstaltung wird von der Bürgermeisterin Kathrin Schöning begleitet, die auch die Siegerehrungen durchführt. Das DRK sorgt für medizinische Absicherung und unterstützt bei der Stromversorgung. Die Zeitnahme und Auswertung erfolgen professionell durch das RaceResult-Team. Es gibt ein Rahmenprogramm mit einer Fußballdartscheibe der Haspa zur Unterhaltung.

name: Sparkassen-Küstenmarathon 26
description: The Sparkassen Coastal Marathon in Otterndorf is a long-standing race on the North Sea coast. The event offers various distances, from a Bambini run for kindergarten children to the classic marathon of 42.195 km. The courses pass through the historic old town, along the Elbe dike and by the water, guaranteeing a varied and scenic running experience. In addition to the marathon, there are also half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as relay and walking events. The event places emphasis on community, endurance and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Weddelbrooker Dorflauf
description: Der Weddelbrooker Dorflauf ist eine beliebte Laufveranstaltung in Weddelbrook, die Läufer aller Altersklassen anspricht. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Streckenlängen von 900 m für Bambinis bis zu 10 km für erfahrene Läufer. Die Läufe finden auf abwechslungsreichen Strecken statt, die durch die Gemeinde führen und für eine familiäre Atmosphäre sorgen. Der Dorflauf ist bekannt für seine gute Organisation und die herzliche Unterstützung durch zahlreiche Helfer.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km, 3,2 km und 900 m Bambini-Strecken
Start auf dem Sportplatz mit einer 900 m Runde für Bambinis
Familiäre Atmosphäre mit vielen Teilnehmern und Helfern
additional: Die Läufe starten nacheinander: zuerst 10 km, dann 5 km, anschließend 3,2 km Junioren und zuletzt die Bambinis auf der 900 m Runde. Die Veranstaltung zieht viele Teilnehmer an und wird von zahlreichen Helfern unterstützt.

name: Wilscher FUN-RUN
description: The Wilsche FunRun is a longstanding race that has been held annually at the Wilsche sports field in Gifhorn since 2005. It is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup and offers an appealing race over a 10 km distance. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and strong participation, and is an established part of the regional running scene. The race starts promptly at 10 a.m., and the event is supported by local organizations such as the fire brigades and the German Red Cross.

name: Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. It offers routes of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied supporting program that includes face painting for children. The event is particularly suitable for runners of all ages and places great emphasis on a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.

name: 12 Bieg "Król Parku"
location: Park Miejski w Mosinie, Mosina, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th “King of the Park” Run is an annual running event organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of the town park, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. It attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional support and a generous race pack.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechit Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at St. Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, following the route of Otto III’s historic journey. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timekeeping, and course safety. Participants receive a race package with a medal and a recovery meal.

name: II Bieg Farmera
description: The 2nd Farmer’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Police. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course, and participants can use training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help participants prepare optimally for the race. This sporting event is aimed at runners who value good organization and opportunities for development.

name: VII Bieg Pocztyliona
description: The 7th Pocztylion Run is a 10 km race taking place in Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy friendly competition in a welcoming atmosphere.

name: 12 Bieg Ziemi Puckiej
location: Połczyno, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, løp 5
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is an inclusive running series for everyone aged 9 and over, with five races throughout the year. The races are held on Mondays, starting at 19:00, except for the fifth race on 20 September, which starts at 18:30. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. This is a friendly recreational race that welcomes both joggers and runners.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: A discount is available when registering for all six races before the second race. You can also register for individual races via eqtiming.no. The races are held on Mondays. Start time: 18:30. Registration takes place online via EQ Timing. You can register for an individual race or receive a discount by registering for all six races before the second race.

name: Namdalskarusellen 2027 løp 9 - Museumsløpet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris : 80,- (+ lisens) for enkeltløp i karusellen.

description: Museumsløpet is a race in the Namdalskarusellen, held in Namsos, with the start and finish at Namdalsmuseet. The course runs through scenic surroundings, including Kjærlighetsstien, and continues via Tiendeholmsvegen, Sven Oftedals veg, Solvangsgata and Namdalsvegen back to the start.
