name: Runfest
description: Runfest is an ambitious three-day road-running festival in Sandnes, the hometown of Olympic champion Jakob Ingebrigtsen. The festival will be held for the second time from 30 September to 2 October 2027, with race days on Friday 1 October and Saturday 2 October. Runfest combines elite competition with the joy of running and focuses on public health, physical activity and community. Participants of all ages and abilities are welcome to take part in a wide range of races and activities in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Run in Sandnes, on the edge of Norway, with start locations suited to the 1500 m, 5 km, 10 km and 21 km distances
Aid stations with sports drink and water approximately every 5 km
Pacers available for several distances to help runners reach their goals
additional: Race numbers can be collected before and on race day; collecting them the day before is recommended to avoid queues. Changing facilities and bag storage are available at Thon Senter Sandnes. The official AfterRun, with a bar, street food, live concert and DJ, will be held on Saturday 3 October. Runfest Summit takes place on 30 September as a professional gathering focused on public health. Runfest Summit takes place on 30 September 2027. All finishers receive a medal.

name: Áskorun ársins 2026 / We Challenge the Year 2026
Rosa Sløyfe-Løpet Stavanger
description: The Rosa Sløyfe Run in Stavanger is an important and inclusive event held in support of the breast cancer cause. The route circles idyllic Mosvatnet, with the start and finish at Mosvangen Camping, and offers beautiful autumn colours and scenery. There are three distances: a free children’s run for the youngest participants, a short 3 km route with no timing, and a new 5 km long route with timing. The participant pack includes a race bib, neck warmer, bag and medal, and the event places a strong emphasis on community and support for the Pink Ribbon campaign.
course_highlights: The route circles idyllic Mosvatnet and features beautiful autumn scenery
Start and finish at Mosvangen Camping
The route is accessible to both runners and wheelchair users
additional: The participant pack includes a race bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. The children’s run is approximately 400 metres and is free for children aged 3–9. The short route (3 km) is not timed, while the long route (5 km) is timed. Participants in the short and long routes are insured through a licence with the Norwegian Athletics Association. You can donate any amount to the Pink Ribbon campaign when registering. The event area opens at 10:00, with activities such as a prize wheel and glitter station. Company registration is available for groups of ten or more participants.

name: Oslo Trail Challenge
description: Oslo Trail Challenge is a trail ultramarathon that takes place in the forest areas of Lillomarka, Nordmarka and Romeriksåsen, north of central Oslo. The race offers demanding and scenic trails suited to ultrarunners looking for a challenging experience in varied Norwegian forest terrain. The organizer, Langt og Lenge, has extensive experience with ultramarathons and offers a race focused on enjoying nature and the joy of running.
course_highlights: Trail ultramarathon in the forest areas of Lillomarka, Nordmarka and Romeriksåsen
Varied and demanding forest terrain north of central Oslo
Scenic trails with challenging sections
additional: Previous editions have used GPS navigation on unmarked courses.

name: Friday Night Run 2026
description: Friday Night Run is an energetic night run in central Tartu, taking place on 2 October at Town Hall Square. The distance is approximately 4 km, along city streets, offering a chance to enjoy the atmosphere of the autumn city with friends. This is not a race; participants can choose to run with or without timing. The event features music and a live concert, creating a lively evening atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 4 km course in central Tartu
The course runs along city streets and park paths
One split-timing point on the timed distance
additional: The race number must be pinned to the chest and visible throughout the distance. The timing chip is attached to the back of the race number and is for single use. Participants have 45 minutes to complete the course; the finish closes at 21:45. The entry fee includes a marked course, race number, timing (if using a chip), services at the finish, and medical assistance if needed. Registration is available online until 2 October at 17:00 and on site until 20:30. The event includes online and on-site registration, medals and T-shirts for participants, and group discounts.

name: Ekerumsloppet
location: Ekerum Resort, Borgholm Municipality, Öland, Sverige
description: Välkommen till Ekerumsloppet, ett höstigt terränglopp på Öland med start och mål vid Ekerum Resort. 10-kilometersbanan går på skogsstigar runt Ekerum och Rällaskogen, och ungdomar kan springa en bana på cirka 1,3 kilometer. Ett trevligt tillfälle att uppleva Ölands natur i löparskorna.
course_highlights: Terränglöpning på skogsstigar
Bana runt Ekerum och Rällaskogen
Start och mål vid Ekerum Resort
additional: 10 km för vuxna och cirka 1,3 km för ungdom. Enligt befintlig information är starttiderna 11:00 respektive 10:00.

name: Tidaholm Marathon
description: Tidaholm Marathon är ett motionslopp som arrangeras i Tidaholm och erbjuder både motion och tävling, individuellt och som stafett. Loppet är en del av Motionsloppet.se:s serie av evenemang och inkluderar även Svenska Mästerskapen i Halvmarathon. Det är en välkomnande tävling för löpare på olika nivåer och arrangeras av Cykelklubben U6 och Grebbestad Multisport.
course_highlights: Löpning i och runt Tidaholm
Individuellt lopp och stafettmöjlighet
Inkluderar Svenska Mästerskapen Halvmarathon
additional: Leverantör av sportdryck på evenemangen är Umara.

name: Rya Åsar Trail Run 2025
location: Rya Åsar Nature Reserve, Borås, Sverige
description: Rya Åsar Trail Run är ett uppskattat traillopp i Borås som bjuder på vacker och varierande terräng i naturreservatet Rya Åsar. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser som passar både nybörjare och erfarna traillöpare, med utmanande backar och fina vyer. Vid start- och målområdet skapas en härlig stämning med musik, utställare, mat och en runners lounge. Evenemanget har en familjekänsla med barnlopp och en folkfest i skogen som lockar många deltagare varje år.
course_highlights: Varierad traillöpning med fina stigar och utmanande backar
Djävulsbacken - en 300 m lång backe med 75 m höjdskillnad
Vackra vyer vid Rya Klint, Fjällsjön och Hestrastugan
additional: Start och mål vid platån på Rya Åsar med musik, utställare, runners lounge och matservering. Nummerlappsutdelning fredag och lördag. Chiptidtagning med startgrupper för elit, snabb löpare och motionär. Väskinlämning finns. Toaletter, omklädning och duschmöjligheter vid Borås Camping. Vätskekontroller med sportdryck från Umara på 24 km och 12 km banorna. Barnlopp finns på 800 m och 1,8 km. Det finns barnlopp och sanktionerade tävlingar.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
description: John Bauer Trail Run är ett tufft och rejält backigt terränglopp som arrangeras vid IKHP-stugan på Huskvarnaberget i Huskvarna. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser för både vuxna och barn, med en varierad bana som går på stig och bitvis obanat underlag. Deltagarna kan njuta av vacker utsikt över Vättern och utmanande backar, inklusive den berömda Strutsabacken där Bergatrollet-tävlingen avgörs. Evenemanget präglas av en familjär atmosfär med aktiviteter och gemenskap kring IKHP-stugan.
course_highlights: Tuff och backig terräng med både stig och obanat underlag
Passage genom Ulvadalen med rik flora och naturupplevelser
Strutsabacken - en brant slalombacke som avgör Bergatrollet-tävlingen
additional: Nummerlappar med chip för tidtagning hämtas senast 11:15 i IKHP-stugan. Tidtagning sker med chip i nummerlappen och ger både totaltid och backtid för Strutsabacken. Omklädningsrum med duschar och toaletter finns i IKHP-stugan. Vätskekontroller finns på flera platser beroende på distans. Efteranmälan kan göras på tävlingsdagen mellan 9:00 - 11:00 om platser finns kvar. Medlemmar i IKHP får halva avgiften med rabattkod. Evenemanget uppges vara familjevänligt och erbjuda servering och aktiviteter vid start och mål samt omklädning och dusch i IKHP-stugan.

name: Broloppet Motala
description: Broloppet Motala är ett populärt löplopp som arrangeras av Motala AIF Friidrott med start och mål i Stadsparken i Motala. Loppet erbjuder en nygamla bansträckan som går genom centrala delar av Motala, vilket ger en fin löpupplevelse i stadsmiljö. Det finns två distanser, 5 km och 10 km, där 10 km-loppet har en egen fil för varvning på första varvet. Under loppet finns vätskekontroller vid bron och vid varvning för att ge löparna bästa möjliga stöd.
course_highlights: Start och mål i Stadsparken, centralt i Motala
Nygamla bansträckan genom stadens centrum
Vätskekontroller vid bron (ca 3 km) och vid varvning
additional: Efteranmälan sker på tävlingsdagen 3/10 kl 10:00-12:30 på Team Sportia. Nummerlappar hämtas på Team Sportia från fredag 2/10 kl 10:00-18:00 och lördag 3/10 kl 10:00-12:30. Omklädning finns hos Actic Stora Torget. Väskinlämning sker vid scenen.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: Förbifartspremiären är ett unikt lopp som arrangeras en enda gång och ger deltagarna möjlighet att springa eller promenera på den nya E4:an mellan Hjulsta och Häggvik, både ovan och under jord. Loppet erbjuder olika klasser och distanser för alla nivåer, från promenad till tävling, med start och mål vid nya trafikplats Akalla i Stockholm. Det är en once in a lifetime-upplevelse där du får vara först med att beträda den nya vägen innan den öppnas för trafik.
course_highlights: Loppet går både ovan och under jord i nya E4 Förbifart Stockholm
Start och mål vid nya trafikplats Akalla
Valmöjlighet att välja avfart efter ca 4, 7 eller 12 km i motionsklassen
additional: Nummerlapp skickas antingen hem med post eller hämtas på plats beroende på deltagarens adress. Tävlingsklass startar kl 09:00, motionsklass har starttider mellan 10:00 och 17:30, och promenadklassen Herr Gårman startar mellan 18:00 och 19:30. Max tid i tävlingsklass är 1 timme och 30 minuter. Startplats är personlig och kan inte överlåtas. Evenemangsområdet nås enklast med tunnelbana till Akalla.

name: Avesta Night Sky Run
description: Avesta Night Sky Run är ett höstevenemang arrangerat av Dalaportens OL i Avesta. Loppet erbjuder en spännande löpupplevelse i natursköna omgivningar och är en del av Dalaportens orienteringsaktiviteter. Deltagarna kan anmäla sig via MittLopp och njuta av en välorganiserad tävling med god service. Tillsammans med Backyard Ultra skapas en unik löparhelg i oktober.
course_highlights: Löpning i natursköna omgivningar runt Avesta
Del av Dalaportens OL:s höstevenemang
Backyard Ultra med 6,7 km varv och gemensam start varje timme
additional: Backyard Ultra startar kl 11:00 den 3 oktober med en bana på 6,7 km mestadels på gång- och cykelbana. Varje timme startar ett nytt varv med gemensam start och tävlingen pågår tills endast en deltagare återstår. Servicedepå finns vid varvningen med dryck och energi. Anmälan till Backyard Ultra sker via mail till AvestaUltra@outlook.com med anmälningsavgift 350 kr. Max 80 deltagare. Tidigare upplagor har arrangerats tillsammans med Avesta Backyard Ultra.

name: Hiit Out Trailrun 12 km
description: HIIT OUT Trailrun är ett traillopp som bjuder på varierad terräng med skog, stigar, höjdskillnader och tekniska partier i Mellingerum, Oskarshamn. Loppet fokuserar inte bara på tiden i mål utan på upplevelsen längs vägen, med utmaning, löparglädje och en härlig naturupplevelse. Distansen 12 km är en av flera valbara banor, lämpade för både vana traillöpare och nybörjare från 15 år och uppåt. Arrangemanget präglas av en gemytlig atmosfär med engagerade funktionärer och publik.
course_highlights: Varierad terräng med skog och stigar
Höjdskillnader och tekniska partier
Naturnära upplevelse längs trails
additional: Alla från 15 år är välkomna att delta. Loppet arrangeras med fokus på upplevelsen och löparglädjen, inte bara tävlingstid. Tidigare års resultat visar deltagande på distanserna 8 km, 12 km och 16 km. Medalj delas ut vid målgång.

name: Rosa Sløyfe-løpet Trondheim
description: The Rosa Sløyfe Run in Trondheim is an annual event held in support of the breast cancer cause. The route follows the Nidelva River, starting and finishing at Trondheim Torg, and offers two distances: a short course of approximately 3.5 km with no timing and a long course of approximately 5 km with timing. There is also a separate children’s race for children aged 3 to 9, which is free and includes activities in the start area. All participants receive a race pack with a race bib, neck warmer, bag and medal, and the event brings together thousands of participants in a sea of pink for a good cause.
course_highlights: The route runs through a beautiful area along the Nidelva River
Short course: approx. 3.5 km, untimed
Long course: approx. 5 km, timed
additional: The short course is untimed, while the long course is timed. The children’s race is approximately 400 metres and free for children aged 3–9. The event area opens at 10:00, and activities in the start area include dancing, a wheel of fortune and a glitter station. Participants in the short and long courses are insured through a licence with the Norwegian Athletics Federation, which also supports the cause.

name: Turufjell Trail
description: Turufjell Trail offers a varied running experience in Hallingdal, with 5 km and 13 km trail races for adults, as well as a children’s race for the youngest participants. The courses follow small, winding trails and open mountain areas with beautiful views of Vassfaret. The event is suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, with the start and finish at Turufjell Kafé. Timing is provided for all adult distances and the children’s race, and all children receive a medal and a prize at the finish.
course_highlights: 13 km course climbing Trøgadissnatten (892 m above sea level) and Veslefjell (993 m) with views of Vassfaret
5 km course via Slåtteliheisen, past Snøtjern, then down a gravel trail and gravel road towards the finish
Water stations at 2 km, Veslefjell (7.5 km) and the finish
additional: Parking at T-kroken and Turufjell Kafé. Race numbers can be collected at Tipien by Turufjell Kafé. All participants receive a medal. Prizes are awarded to the three fastest women and men in the 13 km race. Prize draws are held using adult race numbers. Toilets are available at Turufjell Kafé and T-kroken. There are no shower facilities, but you can take a dip at Øvre Vesleåtjern, approximately 1.5 km from the start/finish. Bag drop is available in the start area.

name: Sørfjorden halvmaraton
description: The Sørfjorden Half Marathon is organized by Idrettslaget Fri in Arna, Bergen, and was first held in 2020. The course has been officially measured and certified internationally since 2024 and attracts around 1,000 participants. It is a recreational race focused on a welcoming atmosphere and quality, set in scenic surroundings in Vestland. IL Fri is known for its commitment to athletics and recreational running, with Arna Idrettspark as its home venue.
course_highlights: Officially measured and internationally certified half-marathon course since 2024
Held in scenic surroundings in Arna, Bergen
Course route starting north of Londalskrysset (from related races in the area)
additional: The race is organized by IL Fri, a club with a long tradition and a welcoming athletics and recreational running community. Registration and all necessary information are available on the race’s website, sorfjordenhalvmaraton.no. The organizer’s home venue is Arna Idrettspark.

name: Austevollsløpet
description: Austevollsløpet hosts a flexible relay for businesses, with up to five participants per team and a total course of approximately 21 km. The race runs from Kalve to Austevoll Sports Ground, and participants can divide the distance as they wish, making the relay accessible to many. The event creates a festive atmosphere, with spectators cheering along the course, and all participants receive a specially designed medal. Proceeds from the event go towards the athletics group’s activities and training camps in Austevoll.
course_highlights: A relay course of approximately 21 km from Kalve to Austevoll Sports Ground
Up to five participants per team, with flexible leg distribution
Spectators along the course with flags and music, and changeover points at food stations approximately every 5 km
additional: A bus leaves Austevoll Secondary School at 11:45 and stops at the changeover stations for drop-off and pick-up. All participants receive a medal. The event is supported by Austevoll Kraftlag as its main sponsor. Teams may have fewer than five participants if they wish. Distance options have varied between editions. In 2026, the business relay cost NOK 1,000 per team, and the Mini-Mini Marathon was free.

name: Tromsø Backyard Ultra
description: Tromsø Backyard Ultra is a unique Arctic ultrarun in the heart of Tromsø, where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour. The race challenges endurance and tactics, as each loop must be completed within an hour to continue. It is suitable for all levels, whether you want to test your limits or take part in a social and motivating training session. The race takes place on Tromsdalen’s beautiful network of trails, mostly on gravel roads with some asphalt, offering a special experience in Northern Norwegian nature.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop in Tromsdalen
The course is mostly on gravel roads, with some asphalt
Start/finish outside TUIL Arena in Tromsdalen
additional: Race bibs must be collected well before the race. Parking is available at Entrance A or Elvestrand Cemetery. Discounted accommodation may be available at Tromsø Lodge and Camping. Participants run one loop every hour and must be ready at the start line when the next loop begins. All starters receive a participant medal. The winners in the women’s and men’s categories are determined after 24 loops. Distances build up over the loops: 4 loops is approximately 26.8 km, 7 loops approximately 46.9 km, 12 loops approximately 80 km, and 15 loops approximately 100.6 km.

name: Nesbyen Backyard 2027
description: Nesbyen Backyard takes place on the first Saturday in October, featuring 6- and 12-hour Backyard Ultra races in beautiful Nesbyen, Hallingdal. The race offers a flat, fast 6.7 km loop that runs mainly on asphalt, with some sections on gravel and trail, challenging runners to complete one loop every hour. This unique race combines endurance, tactics and community in a social and motivating atmosphere, with prizes for everyone who completes the race and door prizes from local sponsors. The race starts at Nesbyen Sports Hall at 10:00 and is suitable for both beginners and experienced ultrarunners.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop with less than 30 metres of elevation gain
The course runs mainly on asphalt, with some sections on gravel and trail
Flat, fast course through Nesbyen town centre amid beautiful autumn scenery
additional: Start and finish at Nesbyen Sports Hall, with changing rooms, showers, toilets and an indoor lounge. A kiosk with food and drinks is available. The race’s Backyard area serves as a social gathering place between loops. More than 20 door prizes from local sponsors. The train station is a 20-minute walk from the start area. The course is Norway’s flattest Backyard loop, with less than 30 metres of elevation gain. Accommodation is available along the course, including at Hagaled Guesthouse. Starts at Nesbyen Sports Hall on 2 October 2027 at 10:00. Registration via EQ Timing. Prices increase in stages as the registration deadline approaches. Prizes for everyone who completes at least one loop, as well as placement prizes and door prizes.

name: Nesaksla opp 2027
description: Nesaksla Opp is Norway’s steepest uphill race, held in Rauma. The race climbs to the popular hiking destination Nesaksla, with a gradient of 34.4% over a distance of 2,000 metres and an elevation gain of 687 metres. This challenging race attracts many participants each year, and the summit register at Nesaksla has around 4,000 signatures. The race takes place on Tuesday, 12 January 2027, starting at 12:00.
course_highlights: Norway’s steepest uphill race, with a 34.4% gradient
2,000-metre course
Elevation gain of 687 metres
additional: The race is held in Rauma and starts at 12:00. Nesaksla is a popular hiking destination, with around 4,000 signatures in the summit register each year.

name: Loimaan Lenkki
description: Loimaan Lenkki is an autumn running event held in the centre of Loimaa. Four distances are available: 1.2 km, 2.4 km, 5.2 km and 10.4 km, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. The start is at Viljavarastontie 4, and the event offers a great opportunity to get active and enjoy a sense of community. Registration is open, and the event is organized by Loimaan Seudun Nuorkauppakamari.

name: KOMIA Esi-Talvijuoksusarja
description: The KOMIA Pre-Winter Running Series is a six-part winter running series that gives runners of all levels the opportunity to test themselves and track their fitness progress. The fast, flat routes start at Pajuluoma School and offer 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances. The series begins with the Pre-Winter Run in early October and continues into spring. The top performers are rewarded at the end of the series, and the races are suitable for recreational and competitive runners alike.

name: Keurusselän Syyslenkki
description: Keurusselkä Autumn Run is a varied autumn event in the beautiful scenery of Keuruu, offering trail running and mountain biking. The trail run has two distances, 6.4 km and 12 km, while mountain biking offers several distances in different categories, including children’s and e-bike categories. The event also includes children’s runs and the option to enjoy the hotel spa as part of the entry fee. The routes pass through the terrain around Resort Keurusselkä and Montosvuori, featuring hilly running and technically varied trails. Participants can also enjoy offers at the hotel restaurant on event day.

name: 15. Tartu Linnamaratoni Lastejooksud
description: The Tartu City Marathon children's races are open to all children, with the joy of taking part as the main goal. Recommended guidelines apply to distances and age groups, but every child is welcome on the course and treated equally. Bib numbers are issued one hour before the start, and the event is not ranked. The event takes place in Tartu Town Hall Square, with registration available both in advance and on site.

name: Dubultmaratons Taisnais Ērgļu stacijā
location: Sauriešu dzelzceļa stacija, Saurieši, Ropaži Municipality, Latvia
description: Dubultmaratons Taisnais is an endurance race along the embankment of the former Saurieši–Ērgļi railway line. The routes are marked and easy to follow, and can be completed by running, Nordic walking, or walking while enjoying Latvia’s beautiful natural scenery. The race offers three distances: double marathon (84.4 km), marathon (42.195 km), and half marathon (21.0975 km). It is organized by the Taisnais association in cooperation with the municipalities of Ogre and Madona. The start and finish are at railway stations. The race aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and identify Latvia’s most enduring long-distance runners and Nordic walkers.
course_highlights: The route follows the embankment of the former Saurieši–Ērgļi railway line
A flat sandy path with no climbs, passing through dense forest, open areas, and over river bridges
The start and finish are at railway stations, and the course is clearly marked
additional: Participants must be at least 18 years old. Spectators may accompany participants on foot or by bicycle without disturbing others, but may not help them move along the course. Finish times differ for runners and Nordic walkers in each distance.

name: Lāčplēšu kross Rīgas Mežaparkā
description: Lāčplēšu Cross is a patriotic trail and obstacle race held in Riga’s Mežaparks. The event offers a range of distances for both children and adults, with participants following a marked course featuring natural and man-made obstacles. It brings together participants of different ages and fitness levels, including accomplished athletes, and fosters a sense of patriotism and unity through sporting activities. All participants receive a commemorative medal at the finish, and the fastest runners in the main distances receive cash prizes.
course_highlights: Marked course through Mežaparks’ trails and meadows
Natural obstacles: sandy areas, roots and forest terrain
Man-made obstacles on various distances
additional: The event centre is located in the Great Meadow of Mežaparks. During the event, younger participants can take part in craft workshops, try archery and watch knight demonstrations. There are also interactive games about waste sorting and green living. An awards ceremony and a raffle with valuable prizes take place after the races. Participants can buy food and drinks at the event centre.

name: 16. Köhlbrandbrückenlauf
description: Der Köhlbrandbrückenlauf ist Deutschlands größter Brückenlauf und führt über das Wahrzeichen im Hamburger Hafen. Die Strecke bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern ein einzigartiges Erlebnis mit beeindruckenden Ausblicken auf den Hafen und die Köhlbrandbrücke. Die Veranstaltung zieht jährlich zahlreiche Teilnehmer an und ist bekannt für ihre besondere Atmosphäre und die sportliche Herausforderung.
course_highlights: Lauf über die berühmte Köhlbrandbrücke im Hamburger Hafen
Beeindruckende Hafenpanoramen während des Laufs
Strecke auf dem Süd/West-Terminalgelände mit urbanem Hafenflair
additional: Die Anmeldung öffnet am 3. Dezember 2026 und ist erfahrungsgemäß schnell ausgebucht. Es gibt eine Kleideraufbewahrung am Veranstaltungstag, und jede:r Finisher:in erhält eine Medaille. Die Anreise wird empfohlen mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder Fahrrad, da Parkmöglichkeiten sehr eingeschränkt sind.

name: 26. Bismarck-Gedenklauf
description: The Bismarck Memorial Run is an annual road and forest race in Schönhausen (Elbe), Saxony-Anhalt, held on German Unity Day. Organized by SV Preussen 27 Schönhausen, it is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP and offers 6.5 km and 13 km distances, as well as shorter races for children and young people. The course starts at the club’s sports center and follows paved roads into the forest, past Kollerberg. The longer distance is run twice. The event honors Otto von Bismarck, Schönhausen’s most famous son, and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments at the sports center.

name: 28. Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The 28th Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf takes place in Alfeld, Lower Saxony. Various distances are offered for adults, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, all finishing in Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, signposted courses are ideal for running at a steady pace. There are also races for children and teenagers, making for a varied program.

name: Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The Alfelder Leinetal Run takes place in Alfeld, Germany. Races are offered over 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, all finishing at Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, marked courses are ideal for maintaining a steady pace. There are also races for children and young people, making for a varied program.

name: Cross der deutschen Einheit
description: The Cross der Deutschen Einheit in Weißensee is a traditional cross-country race organized by the sports club Blau-Weiß 1921 Weißensee e.V. This race is being held for the 35th time and offers various competitions for all age groups, including Bambini races, youth races, a 3.5 km race, a 10.5 km race, a half marathon, and walking/Nordic walking. The course runs around the Gondelteich, with varied sections including climbs and stairs, and offers a sporting challenge for runners of all ability levels. A jubilee relay race rounds off the program and requires no registration or entry fee.

name: Duvenstedter Dorflauf
description: The Duvenstedt Village Run is a traditional race around Alt Duvenstedt, held annually on German Unity Day. With several distances for children, teenagers, and adults, it offers a suitable challenge for all age groups. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, volunteer involvement, and wonderful village community. The course is clearly marked and offers varied running scenery in and around Alt Duvenstedt.

name: Herbstlauf TuS Ofen
location: Ofen, Bad Zwischenahn, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The TuS Ofen Autumn Run is a family-friendly event taking place for the 35th time. It offers distances for all age and ability groups, from 800 m for the youngest participants and a 3 km schoolchildren’s run to a 5 km walking event and fun run, and the 10 km EDEKA-Böse Run for ambitious runners. The start and finish are at the TuS Ofen sports field. A large cake buffet in the sports hall will provide refreshments, and all participants will receive a gingerbread heart at the finish as a special treat.

name: Krautsander Insellauf
description: The Krautsand Island Run is a long-standing running event on the Elbe island of Krautsand near Drochtersen. Organized by SV Dornbusch and TV Wischhafen, the race offers an attractive route in a natural setting. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and takes place annually on October 3. It is organized by the Kehdingen Athletics Association, which ensures everything runs smoothly.

name: Langeooger Sanddornlauf 2026
description: The Langeoog Sea Buckthorn Run takes place on the island of Langeoog and offers races for different age groups. The main races cover 5 km and 10 km on paved paths and roads, ideal for island residents and visitors. There are also dedicated races for young runners: 400 m (Bambini) and 1,000 m (youth). The event marks the end of the island running series and is supported by the island school. The awards ceremony takes place in front of the Haus der Insel, where runners gather after crossing the finish line.

name: Strausseelauf
description: The Straussee Run in Strausberg is a traditional annual running event. It gives runners of different ability levels the opportunity to compete and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Straussee. The event is organized by Kultur- und Sportclub Strausberg e.V. and takes place at Theodor Fontane Gymnasium in Strausberg. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.

name: 4 Moore Ultratrail-Marathon
description: The 4 Moore Ultratrail Marathon is a non-commercial 53-kilometer ultratrail run through the countryside around Langenhagen. The route passes through a variety of moorland and heathland areas, including Kananoher Forst, Schwarzes Moor, Otternhagener Moor, Helstorfer Moor, Große Heide and Bissendorfer Moor. The course is unmarked and navigated by GPS; the final GPS track and a briefing are sent by email in advance. Three aid stations provide drinks and snacks. Participants must bring their own hydration containers and cups. Entry is limited to 50 runners, and the time limit is 9 hours.

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
Hostruset

price_tiers.distance: 5 km Män, Kvinnor, PF19, Veteraner 50+ och Motion

description: Hostruset är ett snabbt 5 km lopp och motionslopp som arrangeras i Örebro med start och mål vid Björkhagaskolan. Banan går på cykelvägar runt Varbergaskogen och är kontrollmätt av Svenska Friidrottsförbundet. Loppet ingår i Södra Svealands Löparserie och erbjuder klasser för både tävling och motion. Det finns även ett barnlopp på 700 meter för de yngsta deltagarna. Omklädning och dusch finns på plats, och arrangören uppmanar till samåkning eller cykel på grund av begränsade parkeringsmöjligheter.
course_highlights: Snabblöpt 5 km bana på cykelvägar runt Varbergaskogen
Start och mål vid Björkhagaskolan i Örebro
Kontrollmätt av förbundsbanmätare enligt Svenska Friidrottsförbundet
additional: Startgrupper testas på 5 km loppet: över 25 min startar kl. 12:30, under 25 min startar kl. 12:45. Nummerlappar delas ut tävlingsdagen. Tidtagning sker med transpondrar som måste lämnas tillbaka efter loppet, annars debiteras 400 kr. Prisutdelning sker vid start/mål-området med hederspriser till topp 5 i Män/Kvinnor och topp 3 i PF19 och Veteran 50+. Omklädning och dusch finns i Björkhagaskolan. Väldigt begränsade parkeringsmöjligheter, rekommenderas samåkning eller cykel.

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme
location: Villands Vånga, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sverige
description: Vånga Mountain Xtreme är ett utmanande traillopp som erbjuder tre distanser: 8 km, 16 km och 40 km, med stigningar på 300, 600 respektive 1500 meter. Loppen går i vildmarksmiljö med slingrande stigar, små tjärnar och djupa stenbrott, och bjuder på vackra vyer och krävande backar. Deltagarna får verkligen uppleva Vångabergets olika sidor, där den längsta distansen innebär att berget bestigs fem gånger. FK Göingarna välkomnar löpare och publik till en minnesvärd och tuff traillöpningsupplevelse i Villands Vånga.
course_highlights: Slingrande stigar i ren vildmark
Vackra vyer vid små tjärnar och djupa stenbrott
Utmanande stigningar: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1500 m (40 km)
additional: Efteranmälan kan göras på plats fram till cirka en timme innan start med betalning via Swish. Det finns även ett barnlopp, VMX Kids, med fri anmälan på plats. Loppen är sanktionerade av Svenska Friidrottsförbundet. Överlåtelse av startplats är möjlig enligt villkor på hemsidan. Distanserna som anges är 8, 16 och 40 km samt VMX Kids. Traillöparskor rekommenderas.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton, maraton
description: Perseløpet is a race at Ås School in Eidsvoll, offering a simple and efficient race setup focused on fast times. The course is a flat, measured 2,633-meter loop, with distances ranging from 3 km to 100 km. Participants can set up their own nutrition table, which they pass each lap, making nutrition management easy and personal. The event has good facilities, with bib pickup, changing rooms and toilets inside the school, as well as free parking. Perseløpet is known as a race where many runners set personal records, and participants are encouraged to celebrate by ringing the bell at the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, measured 2,633-meter loop
Your own nutrition table, passed each lap
Race starting at Ås School, with good facilities such as changing rooms and toilets
additional: Bib pickup is self-service at the school, approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, the 9th grade at Feiring School staffs an official drinks station to raise money for the school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area around Ås School. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan lap times. All distances take place in the same area and use the same weather forecast. Registration is through RaceDays. The course is AIMS-approved.

name: Steinkjer Skogsmaraton
description: Steinkjer Forest Marathon is a demanding trail race with a tough and challenging course featuring steep climbs and descents. The course follows the beautiful trails of Oftenåsen, giving participants a sense of achievement amid scenic surroundings. The start and finish are at Lerkehaug by Steinkjer Shooting Range, where facilities include parking, race bib collection and baggage storage. At the venue, participants can enjoy coffee brewed over a campfire and freshly made waffles while they wait for the start.
course_highlights: Tough and challenging trail course with steep climbs and descents
The course follows the beautiful trails of Oftenåsen through scenic surroundings
Start and finish by Steinkjer Shooting Range, with good facilities and a welcoming atmosphere
additional: Participants can choose to take part with or without timing on both distances. Race bib collection and baggage storage are available at the venue. Coffee brewed over a campfire and freshly made waffles are on sale by the fire. The course includes a water station at Sagkorsen. Half-marathon runners complete two laps of the course, while quarter-marathon runners complete one lap. Participation is available with or without timing.

name: RE-MILA 2027
description: RE-MILA is a fun run for all ages, starting and finishing in Revetal town centre. The event offers distances of 600 metres for children, 2.5 km for youth, and 5 and 10 km for adults and youth. The race has wave starts with pacers and follows Kondis’s recommended age-group categories. All participants receive a medal, with prizes for age-group winners and the top runners in each distance. Race bibs can be collected the day before or on race day in Revetal.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Revetal town centre, by the Sport1 store
Wave starts with up to 8 waves and pacers
Free parking in nearby parking garages and open-air parking spaces
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the Sport1 store in Revetal on the Saturday before the race from 12:00–15:00, or on race day from approximately 12:00. All participants in the children’s race receive a free T-shirt and a medal. The waves start 15–30 seconds apart, with the fastest wave first. The official website states that all participants receive a medal. A free T-shirt is specified for participants in the children’s race.

name: Perseløpet ¤7 - 2027
description: Perseløpet is a simple and efficient running event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, designed to help runners achieve good times. The race takes place on a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop course, with seven distances ranging from 3 km to 100 km. Participants have their own nutrition table, which they pass each lap, giving them full control over their own nutrition without the logistics of aid stations. The event has a friendly atmosphere, where personal bests are celebrated by ringing the bell at the finish area. Perseløpet is organised by Feiring IL and attracts both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop course
Your own nutrition table by the course for personal refuelling
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, with the opportunity to achieve good times
additional: Race bibs are collected via self-service at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, ninth-grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan lap splits. Weather forecasts and the course elevation profile are available via the website. Race bibs can be collected via self-service at the school from approximately two hours before the start. Registration is via RaceDays.

name: Solvalla Trail
location: Solvalla Sports Institute, Nuuksio, Espoo, Finland
description: The event offers runners the chance to enjoy scenic trails on two different distances: 9 km and 18 km. Esbo IF organizes the event, which is suitable for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. Join us for a fast-paced and memorable trail-running event amid stunning scenery.

name: 25. Benther-Berg-Lauf
location: VSV Benthe Sportplatz, Am Hammfeld, Ronnenberg-Benthe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Benther-Berg-Lauf takes place in Ronnenberg-Benthe and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover. The event offers a variety of race distances for all age groups, from Bambini and children’s races to a half marathon covering 21.8 km. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of the Benther Berg and offers a varied running experience for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. Race number and transponder pickup starts at 8:30 a.m. in the gymnasium of VSV Benthe. Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before each start.
course_highlights: 21.8 km long-distance race (half marathon) through the Benther Berg
A range of distances from the 550 m Bambini race to the 21.8 km long-distance race
Part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event up to 45 minutes before each start, with an additional late-entry fee of €5 (€2 for the Bambini and children’s races). Parking is available in a designated lot behind the sports facility; on the day of the event, access is only possible as far as the dead end. Groups of 5 or more can request a discount by email.

name: 31. Geiseltalseelauf
description: The Geiseltalsee Run is a long-standing running event in Braunsbedra that welcomes runners of all ability levels. The route passes through the scenic surroundings of Lake Geiseltal and offers a sporting challenge across varied terrain. The event is very popular and attracts numerous participants every year. Alongside the competition, the sense of community is also a central part of the event.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Geiseltal
Varied terrain with scenic views
Half marathon with a course record set the previous year
additional: Late entries are possible on race day up to 1 hour before the start. The event also includes children’s and youth races as well as walking events. It takes place in Braunsbedra at Lake Geiseltal and is part of the Landescup. The exact start and finish locations can be found on the official website.

name: 14. Burgdorfer Spargel-Lauf
description: The Burgdorf Asparagus Run is an annual running event held as part of the Oktobermarkt town festival in Burgdorf. The routes run along the Aue and through the city center, with the start and finish at the Auebrücke Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße. The event offers 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km races, as well as Nordic walking and a children’s race.

name: 23. Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: Der Mitteldeutsche Marathon verbindet die Metropolregion Mitteldeutschland mit einer einzigartigen Strecke von Leipzig nach Halle (Saale). Der Marathon startet am Sportforum in Leipzig und führt durch zwei Bundesländer und zwei Städte, bevor er im historischen Zentrum von Halle endet. Neben dem Marathon gibt es weitere Disziplinen wie den Händellauf Halbmarathon, Halbmarathonstaffel, 10-km-Lauf, 10-km-Walking, Salzwirkerlauf und AOK Schnupperlauf. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern aller Leistungsstufen ein abwechslungsreiches und kulturell interessantes Lauferlebnis.
course_highlights: Start des Marathons am Sportforum Leipzig
Zieleinlauf im über 1.200 Jahre alten Halle (Saale)
Quer durch eine der grünsten Städte Deutschlands beim Händellauf Halbmarathon
additional: Die Strecken für Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, Salzwirkerlauf und Schnupperlauf sind Rundkurse mit Start und Ziel am Marktplatz in Halle (Saale), außer dem Marathon, der von Leipzig nach Halle führt. Alle Strecken sind vorbehaltlich behördlicher Genehmigung. Es gibt verschiedene Disziplinen und Staffeln, darunter auch eine Mitteldeutsche Hochschulmeisterschaft. Startunterlagen können abgeholt werden, Nachmeldungen und Ummeldungen sind möglich.

name: Boitzer Herbstlauf
description: The Boitzer Autumn Run is a local autumn race with walking in Walsrode, Lower Saxony, organized by the SV Kirchboitzen sports club. In 2026, the event will be held in person for the 19th time and is open to runners and walkers of all ages. Participants can get the key information directly from the organizing team on site. Further practical details are provided by SV Kirchboitzen.

name: Cottbuser Oktoberlauf
description: Der Cottbuser Oktoberlauf ist ein traditionsreicher Laufwettbewerb, der im Sportzentrum Cottbus im Leichtathletik-Stadion und vorwiegend im angrenzenden Waldgebiet mit festen Wegen und Radwegen stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Distanzen von 400 Metern bis zum Halbmarathon (21,1 km) sowie Walking- und Crossläufe für unterschiedliche Altersklassen. Die Läufe sind Teil des Sparkassen Lauf- und Walking Cups und zeichnen sich durch abwechslungsreiche Strecken mit teils befestigten und unbefestigten Wegen aus. Für alle Teilnehmer gibt es eine Erinnerungsmedaille und Online-Urkundendruck, zudem werden Pokale und Sachpreise für die besten Läufer vergeben.
course_highlights: Strecken führen durch Waldgebiet mit festen Wegen und Radwegen
Verpflegungspunkte an der Spreebrücke
Vielfältige Strecken mit teils befestigten und unbefestigten Wegen, inklusive Hindernissen im Kids Run
additional: Zeitnahme erfolgt mit Fußgelenkstransponder, der nach dem Zieleinlauf abzugeben ist. Bei Verlust oder Defekt wird eine Gebühr von 20 EUR fällig. Die Startnummer ist sichtbar auf der Brust zu tragen. Nachmeldungen sind online vom 29.09. bis 02.10.2027 sowie am Veranstaltungstag bis eine Stunde vor Start möglich. Es gibt Altersklassensiegerehrungen mit Urkunden und Pokalen. Die Veranstaltung ist Teil des Sparkassen Lauf- und Walking Cups.

name: Gaudilauf 14
organizer: Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Gaudilauf is a traditional race held in Bad Liebenwerda. The route runs from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda back to Munich and offers a scenic course along the Elster. The event is characterized by a friendly atmosphere, with the competitive aspect taking a back seat. Refreshments are provided every 5 kilometers, and participants can look forward to a relaxed celebration at the finish with drinks and grilled food. A bus transfer from the finish back to the start is available on request.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The Ovenhausen Autumn Run is a traditional race held annually on the first Sunday in October and organized by TuS Ovenhausen. The event offers various distances for different age and performance groups, including a challenging 20.8 km tour through forests and hills, as well as shorter races for young athletes. The course is varied, with sections on cycle paths, in the Grubestadion, and through the forest. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes, and usually takes place in pleasant autumn weather.

name: Oktoberlauf Embsen
description: Der Oktoberlauf Embsen findet voraussichtlich am Sonntag, den 3. Oktober 2027 in 21409 Embsen statt. Angeboten werden Laufwettbewerbe über 5 km und 11 km sowie Wettbewerbe für Kinder und Jugendliche. Das Ziel aller Wettbewerbe ist an einem gemeinsamen Ort. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Läufer aller Altersgruppen und bietet eine sportliche Herausforderung in der herbstlichen Umgebung Embsens.
course_highlights: Laufstrecken über 5 km und 11 km
Gemeinsames Ziel für alle Wettbewerbe
Wettbewerbe für Kinder und Jugendliche
additional: Die genauen Zielorte werden nur mit RUNME Premium angezeigt. Es gibt keine detaillierten Informationen zu Startwellen, Teilnehmerbegrenzungen oder Nachmeldungen auf der Website.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The Poznań Marathon is the 25th-anniversary edition of the city’s premier 42.195 km marathon, held in the heart of Poznań. The route runs along the city’s most important streets, including a return to the Old Market Square after 18 years, as well as scenic locations such as Sołacki Park, Malta and Enea Stadium. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and enthusiastic spectator support. Organizers have prepared a new, attractive course and a rich accompanying program, including children’s races and shorter distances.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Old Market Square, Ratajskiego Square and Wolności Square
Runs through the scenic areas around Malta and Sołacki Park
Finish at Plac Marka, at the Poznań International Fair
additional: The start for wheelchair athletes is at 8:55, and for runners at 9:00. Start corrals are assigned according to the declared marathon finish time and marked with colored stripes on race bibs. The participant limit is 8,000. The race office is open October 2–3 at the Poznań International Fair.

name: Olsztyn Półmaraton
description: The Olsztyn Half Marathon is an annual 21.1 km race held around the picturesque Lake Ukiel in Olsztyn. The course has a mix of surfaces, including compacted gravel, forest trails, asphalt, and paving blocks. The route is marked every kilometer, and runners have access to at least two refreshment stations. The event also features a 5 km race and races for children, creating a sporting atmosphere for the whole family. The organizers provide professional support and an appealing schedule, welcoming both recreational and experienced runners.
course_highlights: 21.1 km course around Lake Ukiel
Mixed surfaces: gravel, forest trails, asphalt, and paving blocks
At least two refreshment stations on the course
additional: The time limit is 3 hours for the half marathon and 45 minutes for the 5 km race. The race office is open on the day before and on race day. Registration is not available on race day. The course is not certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA).

name: Bieg o Puchar Wójta Mikołajki Pomorskie
Rosa Sløyfe-løpet Bergen
description: The Rosa Sløyfe Run in Bergen is an annual event that brings together thousands of participants to support the breast cancer cause. The race starts and finishes at Torgallmenningen in central Bergen, and offers two distances: a short course of approximately 3 km and a long course of approximately 6.4 km. A free children’s race for children aged 3 to 9 is also held. All participants receive a race pack with a race bib, neck warmer, bag and medal, and the event creates a sea of pink in the city in support of an important cause.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Torgallmenningen in central Bergen
Short course of approximately 3 km and long course of approximately 6.4 km through attractive urban areas
Free children’s race of approximately 400 metres for children aged 3–9, with activities in the start area
additional: The race pack includes a race bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. The short course is not timed, while the long course is timed. Participants in the short and long courses are insured through a licence provided by the Norwegian Athletics Federation, which also supports the cause. The children’s race is free and organised in collaboration with Espira Kunnskapsbarnehagen. The event area opens at 14:00, with activities including a prize wheel and glitter station.

name: Rosa Sløyfe-løpet Haugesund
description: The Rosa Sløyfe Run in Haugesund is an annual event supporting the breast cancer cause and bringing together thousands of participants for a colorful and engaging celebration. There are three distances: a free children’s race for the youngest participants, a short course of approximately 3 km without timing, and a long course of approximately 5 km with timing. The start and finish are at the athletics stadium, and the course goes around scenic Vangen. All participants receive a race pack with a race number, neck warmer, bag, and medal. The event also includes a warm-up, prizes, and an uplifting podium ceremony.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the athletics stadium in Haugesund
Course around scenic Vangen
Children’s race for ages 3–9, with activities in the start area
additional: The race pack includes a race number, neck warmer, bag, and medal. The short course is untimed, while the long course is timed. Race numbers can be collected in advance or from 2 hours before the start in the start area. Participants can walk, jog, or run; time and pace are not the most important things. There is a warm-up before the races, followed by prizes and a podium ceremony. The children’s race includes dancing and activities in the start area.

name: /M.Pirksaare/Türi Tehisjärve jooks, liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 11. etapp
description: The Türi Artificial Lake Run is part of the 8th Järvamaa Lakes Running Series, offering a variety of running opportunities for different age groups. The course loops around Rava Artificial Lake and features varied terrain of sand, soil and gravel. The best runners will be awarded, and the event is suitable for both recreational runners and young running enthusiasts. The event takes place on October 7, 2026, by Lake Rava in Järvamaa.

name: Dark Run Lahti
description: Dark Run Lahti is a unique running experience held on a darkening autumn evening amid the stunning scenery of Salpausselkä. The event offers 5 km and 10 km distances suitable for participants of all fitness levels. Runners follow outdoor trails for most of the route by headlamp, and the event also includes the optional Dark Forest horror experience, which adds excitement along the course. The atmospheric event center is located at Lahti Sports Center, and the run is followed by an awards ceremony and prize draws.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 5 etapas
description: The Ukmergė Factory Cross-Country Cup 2026 is a five-stage sporting event aimed at promoting running, cycling and orienteering in nature. The competitions take place in Ukmergė, with participants competing in cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling and rogaining events. The event encourages active leisure for people of all ages and fosters young people’s interest in sport. The races start at the stadium of Šilas Basic School, and the time limit is 120 minutes (except for Mini Rogaining).

name: Ukmergės fabrikų kroso taurė
description: The Ukmergė Factory Cross-Country Cup 2026 is a five-stage sporting event featuring cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling, and rogaining competitions. The event takes place in Kopūstėliai Forest in Ukmergė and aims to encourage active recreation in nature and promote sport among participants of all ages. The start is shared by all groups and takes place in the evening; participants compete in age groups and event categories. The main organiser is VšĮ Sportas miške, and the event is supported by several Ukmergė companies.

name: Ultunamilen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott

description: Ultunamilen har under många år arrangerats av Upsala IF men 2026 ersätts det av Gränbyloppet som hålls i Gränbyparken i Uppsala. Gränbyloppet fokuserar på löparglädje och trygghet i området, med start och mål nära IFU Arena. Loppet ingår i Terrängserien och erbjuder flera klasser och distanser för ungdomar och vuxna, med en bana som går i parken och dess omgivningar.
course_highlights: Start och mål i korsningen nordöst om pergolan i Gränbyparken
Bana i Gränbyparken med varv på 2,5 km (blå bana)
Loppet arrangeras i samband med Terrängseriens avslutning
additional: Samtliga deltagare får bära synlig nummerlapp. Närmaste parkering finns på Gränbystaden. Terrängseriens sista dag genomförs i samband med Gränbyloppet för ungdomar 14 år och yngre. Resultat publiceras i anslutning till loppet.

name: Bohusläns Bästa
location: Havstenssund to TanumStrand, Tanum Municipality, Sverige
description: Bohusläns Bästa är ett 22 km långt traillopp som går från Havstenssund till TanumStrand och utgör finalen i Outnorth Trailtour. Loppet bjuder på en naturskön bana med klippor, bryggor, doft av tång och vyer som ger ro i sinnet samtidigt som kroppen får jobba hårt. Här samlas den svenska trailrunning-eliten för spännande uppgörelser i en unik miljö där fjäll, skog och hav möts. Deltagarna kan även förlänga upplevelsen med boende och bankett på TanumStrand Spa & Resort.
course_highlights: 22 km traillöpning från Havstenssund till TanumStrand
Natursköna vyer med klippor, bryggor och doft av tång
Del av Outnorth Trailtour med Sveriges trailrunning-elit
additional: Boende och bankett erbjuds på TanumStrand Spa & Resort för att fullända helgen. Prenumeranter får tillgång till nyhetsbrev med aktuell information och erbjudanden, bland annat 20% rabatt på Asics trailskor hos Outnorth. Arrangörstexten tipsar om boende och bankett på TanumStrand.

name: Skrylle Challenge
location: Skryllegården, Södra Sandby, Lund Municipality, Sverige
description: Skrylle Challenge är ett löpevenemang som hålls vid Skryllegården i Södra Sandby. Tävlingen erbjuder en utmanande 25 km bana för både damer och herrar, där deltagarna får uppleva vacker natur och varierande terräng i Skrylleområdet. Evenemanget samlar löpare från olika klubbar och orter, vilket skapar en gemenskap och tävlingsanda. Skrylle Challenge är en uppskattad tävling för både erfarna löpare och entusiaster som vill testa sin uthållighet i en naturskön miljö.
course_highlights: 25 km löpning i varierande terräng
Natursköna vyer i Skrylleområdet
Utmanande bana för både damer och herrar
additional: Deltagarlistor visar separata startnummer och föreningar för damer och herrar i 25 km-klassen.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen är ett löplopp som arrangeras av Ryssbergets IK i Bromölla med start och mål vid Sparbankshallen. Loppet erbjuder en bana som är tydligt markerad med pilar, streck och band, och funktionärer finns på plats för att visa vägen. Deltagarna kan förvänta sig vätskekontroller med vatten och sportdryck samt en trevlig atmosfär med servering av fika och grillad korv efter loppet. Priser delas ut till de bästa i varje klass och sjukvårdspersonal finns tillgänglig vid start- och målområdet. Genom anmälan godkänner deltagarna publicering av namn och resultat samt användning av bilder och filmer från tävlingen.
course_highlights: Banan är markerad vid varje kilometer med pilar, streck och band
Vätskekontroller med vatten och sportdryck vid varvning och mål
Start och mål vid Sparbankshallen i Bromölla
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas senast 30 minuter före start i Sparbankshallen och ska bäras framtill på bröstet. Prisutdelning börjar klockan 12:30. Anmälan sker i första hand via föranmälan, men efteranmälan kan ske på plats. Arrangemanget följer Svenska Friidrottsförbundets regler för långlopp. Tävlingsinformationen anger att priser delas ut till de bästa i varje klass. Nummerlapp hämtas senast 30 minuter före start. De publicerade uppgifterna gäller upplagan 2026 och bekräftar inte datumet 9 oktober 2027.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run är ett välgörenhetslopp som syftar till att synliggöra vikten av fysisk aktivitet för psykisk hälsa. Loppet arrangeras vid Sjöhistoriska museet i Stockholm och erbjuder en lättlöpt 5 km bana runt Djurgårdbrunnsviken. Alla deltagare bidrar till psykiatrisk forskning då allt överskott går oavkortat till detta ändamål. Mental Health Run välkomnar alla oavsett bakgrund eller motionsvana och främjar gemenskap och rörelseglädje.
course_highlights: Start och mål vid Sjöhistoriska museet
Lättlöpt/lättgången 5 km bana runt Djurgårdbrunnsviken
Bana i naturskön miljö på Djurgården
additional: Medalj kan väljas som tillval vid anmälan. Hundloppet är ett särskilt lopp där deltagare springer eller promenerar tillsammans med sin hund, som ska vara kopplad under hela loppet. Hundloppet fokuserar på rörelseglädje och gemenskap snarare än prestation. Deltagande sker på egen risk och hundägaren ansvarar för sin hund. Vid hundloppet startar man sist i loppet. Det finns även ett virtuellt lopp 10 - 31 oktober 2027. Medalj ingår för deltagare på plats. Sista anmälningsdag för loppet på plats är 8 oktober 2027 kl. 12.00.

name: Göteborg Marathon
description: Göteborg Marathon är en traditionell tävling som genomförs för 52:a gången och erbjuder både maraton och halvmaraton. Banan är flack och rak med start och mål vid anrika Slottsskogsvallen i Göteborg, och följer en vändpunktsbana längs den gamla banvallen vid kusten med vackra vyer över havet och skärgården. Loppet är välorganiserat med vätskestationer var fjärde kilometer och en trevlig atmosfär som välkomnar löpare i alla klasser. Det är en perfekt tävling för dig som vill springa snabbt och njuta av en naturskön bana nära havet.
course_highlights: Flack och rak bana längs gamla banvallen vid kusten
Vändpunkt vid båtuppläggningen Lilla Amundön efter cirka 10,5 km
Vätskestationer var fjärde kilometer med vatten, sportdryck, Coca-Cola, banan och russin
additional: Start och mål är inne på Slottsskogsvallen. Startgrupp 1 för maraton startar 10:00, startgrupp 2 för halvmaraton (mål under 1 tim 45 min) startar 10:30, och startgrupp 3 för halvmaraton (mål över 1 tim 45 min) startar 10:45. Efter målgång erbjuds deltagarna dryck och smörgås. Det finns möjlighet att transportera egen vätska/energi till vätskestationerna. Nummerlappen måste bäras synligt under hela loppet. Loppet erbjuder maraton och halvmaraton. Bansträckningen kontrollmättes 2024.

name: Umemaran
organizer: Jalles TC Umeå och IFK Umeå
description: Umemaran är en löpfest som samlar löpare i Umeå och arrangeras av Jalles TC tillsammans med IFK Umeå. Loppet erbjuder både marathon och halvmarathon med en snabb och naturskön bana som följer Umeälven via Ön på båda sidor. Evenemanget är en tradition sedan 1973 och fungerar även som Norra Norrlandsmästerskap för marathon. Deltagarna erbjuds vätska var fjärde kilometer, medalj vid målgång samt kaffe och smörgås efter loppet.
course_highlights: Snabb bana som följer Umeälven via Ön på ömse sidor
Varje kilometer är skyltad och banan är kontrollmätt av SFIF:s leg banmätare
Vätskekontroller med Umara sportdryck och vatten cirka var fjärde kilometer
additional: Slowrunners med sluttider 4:45 eller längre kan starta kl. 10:00 efter föranmälan. Omklädnad och dusch finns i Jubileumshallen vid startområdet. Nummerlappar och chip hämtas senast 45 minuter före start på Tegs Centralskola, med möjlighet till uthämtning dagen innan på Team Sportia Ersboda. Prisutdelning sker direkt efter 21 km och cirka kl. 16:20 för 42 km i Aulan på Tegs Centralskola. Alla fullföljande på 42 km har chans att vinna en cykel i utlottning vid prisutdelningen. Maratonloppet utgör Norra Norrlandsmästerskap för seniorer och veteraner.

name: Tjurruset
organizer: Marathongruppen tillsammans med Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK
description: Tjurruset är ett utmanande och roligt terränglopp i Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, där deltagarna kan välja mellan 5 eller 10 kilometer. Loppet bjuder på leriga passager, trailstigar och väta, och är perfekt för dig som inte räds smuts och vill ha en annorlunda löpupplevelse. Efter loppet finns möjligheter till dusch och avsköljning, och arrangemanget präglas av en gemenskap där kämparglöden är viktigare än löpteknik. Tjurruset arrangeras av Marathongruppen tillsammans med friidrottsklubbarna Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK, och överskottet går tillbaka till idrotten.
course_highlights: Terräng med leriga passager och väta
Trailstigar i Norra Djurgården
Utmanande skogsterräng med naturliga hinder
additional: Efter loppet finns varma duschar i tält några minuters promenad från målet samt enklare avsköljningsmöjligheter direkt efter målgång. Det finns sopstationer för kläder som inte får tas med hem. Skor med bra grepp och oömma kläder rekommenderas starkt då leran kan suga av skon mitt i steget. Företag och större grupper kan ordna gemensam anmälan och boka företagstält.

name: Running Lights Alingsås 2026
description: Running Lights är ett magiskt löparevent som äger rum under den berömda ljusfestivalen Lights in Alingsås. Loppet erbjuder distanser för alla åldrar och nivåer, från Knatteloppet för de yngsta till 10 km för de mer erfarna löparna. Upplev en löparfest i magisk belysning genom vackert upplysta miljöer i centrala Alingsås. Running Lights är även en del av Västsvenska löparcupen, vilket ger extra tävlingsmöjligheter för föreningslöpare.
course_highlights: Start och mål vid toppen av Stora torget (Kungsgatan)
Banor genom vackert upplysta miljöer under Lights in Alingsås
Olika distanser från 300 m till 10 km med varierande rundor runt torg och parker
additional: Starttider per distans: Maxi-Knatte 300m kl 16:00, Energiloppet 600m kl 16:30, Ungdomsloppet 1660m kl 16:45, Stafetten 3 x 1660m kl 17:05, 5 km kl 18:00, 10 km kl 19:00. Banorna är varv runt Stora torget, ån, torgen och Museiparken. Stafetten är för lag om 3 personer som springer ett varv var. Nummerlappsutdelning och löparmässa hålls på Estrad, Bryggerigatan 2. Loppet ingår i Västsvenska Långloppscupen och Västsvenska löparcupen.

name: Borgen Outdoor Run
description: Borgen Outdoor Run är ett utmanande terränglopp som arrangeras i Alandsrydsterrängen vid Friluftsgården Borgen i Värnamo. Loppet bjuder på en rolig och varierad bana med inslag av skidbacke och skogsstigar, vilket ger en fin naturupplevelse för deltagarna. Arrangemanget är väl etablerat och lockar löpare som uppskattar både utmaning och gemenskap i en naturskön miljö.
course_highlights: Terränglopp i Alandsrydsterrängen
Passage genom skidbacken Alandsrydsbacken med höjdskillnader
Naturskön och varierad bana med skogsstigar
additional: Markarbete pågår vid skidbacken Alandsrydsbacken (mellan 2-3 km) för att höja fallhöjden, vilket kan medföra mindre justeringar av banan i det området. Enligt evenemangsinformationen är loppet öppet för alla åldrar och deltagare kan springa individuellt eller i ett föranmält lag.

name: Terräng DM
description: Välkommen till DM i terränglöpning som arrangeras vid Nytorps bollplan nära Hammarby Södra skola. Tävlingen bjuder på en bana som mestadels går på gräs med en kort backe på 70 meter med asfaltunderlag. Här kan löpare i olika åldersklasser och veteranklasser delta i varierande distanser. Nummerlappar och avprickning sker i sekretariatet vid startområdet.
course_highlights: Banan går mestadels på gräs
En 70 meter lång backe med asfaltunderlag
Start och mål vid Nytorps bollplan nära Hammarby Södra skola
additional: Avprickning och nummerlappar sker i sekretariatet invid start. Grenprogrammet omfattar ungdoms- och veteranklasser. Avprickning och nummerlappar hämtas i sekretariatet intill starten.

name: Gränbyloppet
price_range: 100–200 kr för icke-medlemmar (2026 års priser); gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott
description: Gränbyloppet arrangeras av Upsala IF Friidrott och tar över efter Ultunamilen med fokus på löparglädje i Gränbyparken i Uppsala. Loppet genomförs i samband med Terrängserien och erbjuder flera klasser och distanser för ungdomar och vuxna. Start och mål är placerade i korsningen strax nordöst om pergolan mitt i Gränbyparken, nära IFU Arena. Loppet är öppet för både medlemmar och icke-medlemmar med en enkel och tydlig anmälningsprocess online.
course_highlights: Start och mål i korsningen nordöst om pergolan i Gränbyparken
Bana i Gränbyparken med blå slinga på 2,5 km per varv
Loppet arrangeras i samband med Terrängseriens avslutning
additional: Samtliga deltagare får bära synlig nummerlapp. Start och mål är ca 800 meter från IFU Arena. Närmaste parkering finns på Gränbystaden. Terrängseriens sista dag genomförs i samband med Gränbyloppet för ungdomar 14 år och yngre. Loppet genomförs i samband med Terrängserien, vars sista dag riktar sig till ungdomar 14 år och yngre. Uppgifter om distanser och avgifter avser 2026 års upplaga.

description: Bergensløpet celebrates an anniversary with a double running festival in beautiful surroundings in Bergen. The race starts and finishes in historic Nygårdsparken and runs along Store Lungegårdsvann, Fløen and Møllendal. Two distances are offered, 5 km and 10 km, both on a fast, officially measured course. A free children's race is also held for children up to 11 years old, with a medal for every participant.
course_highlights: Start and finish in historic Nygårdsparken
The course runs along Store Lungegårdsvann, Fløen and Møllendal
Fast, officially measured 5 km course; the 10 km runners complete two laps
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:45 at Vitalitetssenteret by Møhlenpris sports ground. Toilets are available at the collection point and in the clubhouses. The children's race starts at 12:00, the 5 km at 13:00, and the 10 km at 14:00. The children's race is approximately 500 metres, free, and has no timing or rankings; all children receive a medal. The autumn edition is listed as taking place on Saturday, 10 October. The date for the 2027 edition matches the race date of 9 October in the listing.

name: Gausta Challenge
description: Gausta Challenge is an accessible race held on Saturday, 9 October in Tinn, Telemark. The race goes around Kvitåvatn and covers approximately 6 kilometres on gravel roads. It is suitable for anyone looking for an enjoyable and accessible running experience in beautiful surroundings. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is a popular autumn race in the region.
course_highlights: Race around Kvitåvatn
Approximately 6 km on gravel roads
An accessible race for all

name: Kystløpet
description: Kystløpet is a race in Egersund, featuring an 11 km distance that has been held in recent years. The course follows the old railway line and the walking trail. Previous editions have offered both timed and recreational classes, and the race welcomes runners for an active day by the coast.
course_highlights: 11 km race distance
Route along the old railway line
Also follows the walking trail in Egersund

name: Flisa Backyard
description: Flisa Backyard is a friendly autumn event held at beautiful Myrmoen in Flisa. The race welcomes everyone who wants to challenge themselves, test their fitness or simply enjoy a fantastic day in beautiful surroundings. The event is open to everyone born in 2013 or earlier and offers an inclusive, magical atmosphere. The race is organised by Flisa Allianseidrettslag, which has a long tradition as a sports club in the area.
course_highlights: The race takes place at beautiful Myrmoen in scenic surroundings
Open to everyone born in 2013 or earlier
One of the autumn’s friendliest events, with an inclusive atmosphere
additional: Everyone born in 2013 or earlier may participate. The event is organised by Flisa Allianseidrettslag, which has used Rubic as its membership system. Registration is via racetracker.no. Flisa Backyard is an inclusive, social race in the scenic surroundings of Myrmoen. The listed registration price is 450 kr, increasing to 550 kr from 18 January, 650 kr from 1 April and 750 kr from 1 August. Registration includes a choice of single-event or annual licence, and camping can be reserved.

name: Gausta Challenge
location: Gausta Fjellresort, Gausta, Tinn, Telemark, Norway
organizer: Rjukan IL – Friidrett & Triathlon og Gaustablikk Fjellresort
description: Gausta Challenge is a low-key race held on Saturday, 9 October 2027, at Gausta Fjellresort. The race follows a roughly 6 km gravel road around Kvitåvatn, starting and finishing at the paddle tennis court. It is suitable for all ages and fitness levels, with staggered starts and timing, and participants can run, walk or take it easy. The event is a collaboration between Rjukan IL - Friidrett & Triathlon and Gaustablikk Fjellresort, and aims to encourage physical activity in beautiful autumn surroundings.
course_highlights: Approx. 6 km gravel route around Kvitåvatn
Start and finish at Gausta Fjellresort, by the paddle tennis court
The route is hilly, with a long downhill section and flat stretches
additional: The children’s race for ages 0–10 starts at 14:00. The 6 km race is open to participants aged 10–99. The start and finish are at the paddle tennis court near the floating saunas. The route is run counterclockwise. Gausta Challenge 2027 takes place on Saturday, 9 October at 13:00. The children’s race starts at 14:00.

name: Hortensløpet
description: Hortensløpet is a celebration for everyone in central Horten, suitable for all levels. The event offers three distances: 5 km for everyone looking to enjoy running and a sense of community; a separate children’s race over a short distance, with a great atmosphere; and 10 km, the flagship distance for those who want to challenge themselves and experience achievement and endurance. The event emphasizes an accessible, welcoming atmosphere and offers a sporting classic in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 5 km distance with an accessible format and a great atmosphere
A separate children’s race over a short distance, full of the joy of running
10 km flagship distance offering a sense of achievement and endurance
additional: Interactive course map with location services. Option to search for photos by face or bib number. Pace and pacer calculator based on your desired finish time. The course map is available as an interactive map.

name: Joutenlammen Jotos 2026, Kajaani
description: Joutenlammen Jotos is a running event organized by Kajaani Parish and held at the Joutenlampi course center. The event offers three distances: the main 10 km run for adults, a 3 km run for young people, and a children’s run of approximately 1.5 km. The route runs mainly along gravel roads. The event begins at 11:00 with a forest church service, followed by soup lunch. Joutenlammen Jotos is a community-oriented, family-friendly event that invites people of all ages to get active and enjoy nature.

name: Hercules Trail Run
description: Hercules Trail Run is a trail running event being held for the tenth time, inviting runners to experience Porvoo’s most beautiful trails and seaside scenery in the fresh October air. The event offers a variety of route options for all fitness levels, from the 2 km children’s Trail Dash to a 42 km trail run. Race day begins with the children’s Trail Dash and continues with several different distances, taking runners along beautiful and varied trails in the Porvoo area. The entry fee includes a range of services, and photos and videos will be taken during the event and used for event communications.

name: Säkylänharjun polkujuoksu
description: The event offers trail-running enthusiasts a variety of routes, including one that passes through Klopin monttu. The event centre is conveniently located, and the event is known for its proven concept. Participants can choose from different distances and enjoy the tranquillity of nature and varied terrain.

name: Backyard Outland Edition
description: Backyard Outland Edition i Gistrup er et unikt ultraløb, hvor deltagerne løber gentagne runder på 6,7 km asfalt hver time. Løbet byder på to hoveddistancer: et 12-timersløb med start kl. 06.00 og et 7-timersløb med start kl. 11.00. Ruten er flad og foregår på asfaltveje, hvor løberne skal holde venstre side og dele ruten med øvrig trafik. Der er depot med væske og snacks, og efter løbet er der bad og omklædning til rådighed. Arrangementet foregår ved Vaarst-Fjellerad Boldklub, og overskuddet går til boldklubben.
course_highlights: 6,7 km pr. runde på asfaltveje
Ny runde starter hver hele time
Ruten deles med øvrig trafik; løberne skal holde venstre side
additional: Manuel registrering af runder. Startsted: Vaarst-Fjellerad Boldklub, Vaarstvej 173, 9260 Gistrup. Medløbere kan starte på hele timer mellem 06.00 og 17.00. Løbet slutter kl. 18.00. Der er depot med væske og snacks samt adgang til toilet, bad og omklædning.

name: Lysfald Løbet 3. oktober i Fårup Sommerland 2026
Kaišiadorių maratonas 2026
description: This event marks a new tradition, bringing together runners from Lithuania and abroad. The marathon will take place in an active, sporty city known for its sporting events and active lifestyle. The event is organized by BK “Kaišiadorys bėga,” Kaišiadorys District Municipality, Kaišiadorys Education and Sports Center, and VšĮ “Maratomanija.”

name: Bėgimas Gintarinė jūrmylė
organizer: Klaipėdos miesto sporto bėgimo klubas “Gintarinė jūrmylė”
description: “Amber Sea Mile” is an international running race held in beautiful Smiltynė. The event offers a range of distances: 0.5 nautical miles for children, 1 nautical mile for anyone who wants to take part, 3 nautical miles for women, and 6 nautical miles for men and professionals. The start and finish are at the Sports and Wellness Base, and participants are treated to army-style porridge and tea. The race tradition commemorates the winners’ names on a memorial stone raised from the bottom of the lagoon.
