description: Stirnu buks is a popular trail running series held on Latvia’s most beautiful forest trails, offering a range of distances for participants of different ages and fitness levels. The series aims to bring participants into nature, where they can improve their physical and mental well-being while enjoying scenic routes. The Grand Finale in Priekuļi is one of the series’ final and most anticipated events, bringing together trail runners from all over Latvia. The event welcomes both beginners and experienced athletes, and also offers special distances for young people and children.
course_highlights: Routes and trails with varied surfaces — asphalt, gravel, forest roads and off-road terrain
Five different distances are available for different age groups
The race takes place on scenic trails in Latvia’s forests
additional: Participants can register on the event website in the “Your profile” section. Last-minute registration is available on race day no later than 30 minutes before the start of the relevant distance. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first; hiking participants can set off on the course from 9:00 to 10:30, with no timing. After 12:00, fast runners may be encountered on the courses. Discounts are available for juniors, seniors and special groups. Season passes are available at a discount, and the fee varies depending on the time of registration.

name: Vorlauf zum Harz-Gebirgslauf
description: The Harz Mountain Run warm-up is a free test run held one week before the main race. It gives runners the opportunity to check their fitness and get to know the Harz Mountain Run courses. The event starts together at 9:30 a.m. in Himmelpforte, Wernigerode, and offers distances of 2 km, 5 km, 11 km, and 22 km. At the finish, participants are welcomed with tea and bread with lard. No registration is required, but the courses are not yet marked.

name: 25. Volkslauf um den Altwarmbüchener See
description: The Volkslauf around Lake Altwarmbüchen is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. The race gives runners the opportunity to discover the Hannover Region on foot and take part in a varied range of running events. Each participation earns a stamp in the running pass, which is available both digitally and in a traditional format. The event is aimed at recreational athletes and promotes active movement in the region.

name: Brakelsieker Volkslauf "Am Fuße des Mörths"
description: The Brakelsiek fun run “At the Foot of the Mörth” is a classic local running, walking, and Nordic walking event in Schieder-Schwalenberg, held on a Saturday afternoon in October. Various distances are offered for adults and young people, including 5 km, 9 km, and 15 km runs, as well as 5 km and 9 km walking and Nordic walking. The start and finish are at the Brakelsiek sports field, and the route runs around the village sports field, with a gently rolling rural profile at the foot of the Mörth. The event offers a lovely opportunity to enjoy the autumn landscape in a relaxed atmosphere.

name: Parforceheide Crosslauf
description: The Parforceheide Cross-Country Run has been organized by RSV Eintracht 1949 in Stahnsdorf since 2008, giving recreational runners in the region the opportunity to discover the varied landscape of the Parforceheide. The course starts at the sports ground on Heinrich-Zille-Straße and passes the Südwestfriedhof cemetery, continuing through woods and natural surroundings with small climbs, sandy sections, and stretches of asphalt and cobblestones. Races are offered over 1 km (Bambini), 3 km (schoolchildren), 5 km, and 10 km for young people and adults. After the run, the organizer provides food and refreshments, and football matches are often held at the sports ground, making for a lovely day of sport for participants and their companions.

name: Solvay Lauf
description: The Solvay Run Bernburg is a 5 km race in Bernburg, Saxony-Anhalt. The race starts at Krumbholzallee 8 at 10:00 a.m. Part of the Solvay Cup, it combines cross-country and road running, so it is not an easy, flat city course. It is aimed primarily at local clubs and usually attracts 100 to 300 runners. The event offers professional timing, online results, certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop and refreshments at the finish.

XIV Cross Centaura

location: Hässelby IP, Loviselundsvägen 100, Hässelby, Stockholm, Sverige

description: Hässelbyloppet är ett klassiskt 10 km-lopp som arrangeras i nordvästra Stockholm med en flack och snabb bana genom Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta och Vällingby. Loppet har en lång tradition och arrangeras av Hässelby SK Friidrott. Samma dag hålls även Lilla Hässelbyloppet, ett barn- och ungdomslopp med kortare distanser och tidtagning från 9 år. Banan är officiellt kontrollmätt och loppet är sanktionerat av Svenska Friidrottsförbundet. Start och mål är vid Hässelby Idrottsplats, nära tunnelbanan.
course_highlights: Flack och snabb 10 km-bana genom nordvästra Stockholm
Start och mål vid Hässelby Idrottsplats, nära tunnelbanan
Lilla Hässelbyloppet för barn och ungdomar med tidtagning från 9 år
additional: Farthållare finns mellan 37:30 och 60 minuter. Nummerlappsutdelning öppnar dagen före loppet. Lilla Hässelbyloppet har tidtagning från 9 år och erbjuder dryck och tilltugg efter målgång. Starten för Hässelbyloppet sker på ett stort gärde cirka 400 meter från Hässelby Idrottsplats. Lilla Hässelbyloppet har nummerlapp och tidtagning från 9 års ålder. Start och mål är vid Hässelby IP, Loviselundsvägen 100. Den officiella webbplatsen anger 3 oktober 2027 som datum för Hässelbyloppet.

name: Fredrikstadmarka Rundt 2027
description: Fredrikstadmarka Rundt is a traditional forest race that has been held since 1974. The course is 20 km long and is considered one of the true classics among Norwegian forest races, with a runnable route featuring pleasant trail sections and good gravel roads. The start and finish are at FIF-huset in Fredrikstad, and the course offers both flat terrain and some steep climbs, especially in the final section towards Skihytta. A shorter distance called Markatier'n is also held, using the same start and finish area and sharing the 20 km course for the first 5.5 km.
course_highlights: 20 km forest race on a runnable route of trails and gravel roads
Three water stations along the course at approximately 5.5 km, 10 km and 14 km
Steep climbs and challenging terrain, especially between 9 and 14 km
additional: There are 3 water stations offering water and cordial along the way, as well as drinks at the finish. The start and finish are at FIF-huset, Ilaveien 132, Fredrikstad. The course has remained largely unchanged since 1974. Course records are 1:07:08 for men and 1:16:17 for women. Registration and results services are stated to be provided in cooperation with EQ Timing.

name: Eremitageløbet
description: The Eremitage Run is a cannonball race in hilly terrain north of Copenhagen. The recreational race always takes place in early October and is the only race in Dyrehaven, north of Copenhagen.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 LIUF Trail
Royal Aarhus City Marathon 2027
location: Vester Allé ved ARoS, Aarhus C
description: Royal Aarhus City Marathon is the first city marathon in Aarhus since 2008. The route is one lap of 42.195 km, starting and finishing on Vester Allé by ARoS. You’ll run through the Marselisborg Forests, along the bay and past the Infinite Bridge, across the harbour and out to Aarhus Ø, past Dokk1 and the Cathedral, and around Brabrand Lake before returning to the city centre. The highest point on the route is 60 metres, and around 20 km are car-free paths and pedestrian streets. The time limit is 6 hours. The entry fee includes chip timing (RACE RESULT), a medal, a running shirt, aid stations every 5 km with water and sports drink, baggage storage and a digital certificate. Early bird price: DKK 695 through 24 December 2026; afterwards, DKK 795. The organiser is Strata Endurance Events, which also organises Royal Copenhagen City Half and Ørestad Half Marathon.
additional: Start at 09:00 on Sunday 10 October 2027 on Vester Allé by ARoS; finish at the same location. Interactive route map: https://racm-map.vercel.app · Strava route: https://www.strava.com/routes/3550794644934219702. The route is provisional pending final approval from Aarhus Municipality and the police.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 7. Võsu Sügisjooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series that offers a variety of running opportunities for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in the Lääne-Virumaa region, offering runners beautiful scenery and an enjoyable sporting experience. Võsu Autumn Run is the 7th stage of the series. It takes place in the Võsu Laine area and is part of a long-running traditional race series. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and enjoy running and recreational sport.

name: 71. Viljandi Linnajooks
description: The Viljandi City Run is a traditional endurance race held every year on the second Sunday of October in the city of Viljandi. The race route goes around Lake Viljandi, and the event is one of Estonia’s oldest sporting competitions, attracting top runners from across the country. In addition to the main race, several recreational sports events take place, including children’s races for different age groups. The Viljandi City Run course is 10.4 km long, offering an energetic and enjoyable experience for both recreational runners and professional athletes.

name: Büdelsdorfer Eiderlauf
description: The Büdelsdorf Eiderlauf is a traditional autumn race in Büdelsdorf, Schleswig-Holstein, organized by SG Athletico Büdelsdorf. It offers classic local road-race distances, including 5 km and 10 km, on flat, manageable courses that are ideal for recreational runners and beginners. The start and finish are often at Eiderstadion, giving the event a friendly, informal atmosphere. The race attracts children, young people, and local club runners, and is a fixture on the regional autumn running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat road-race distances
Start and finish at Eiderstadion
Family-friendly local club race
additional: The race takes place in typical October weather, with daytime temperatures around 14 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Distances range from 1.5 km to 11.1 km, including children's races. After a break during the COVID-19 pandemic, the format was adjusted to incorporate the start and finish in the stadium. Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, 5.8 km, 10.9 km, 11.1 km; flat courses; autumn event; start and finish in the stadium; open to all age groups

name: Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof-Lauf 2026
location: Schloss Erbhof, Kirchwiehe, Thedinghausen, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof-Lauf takes place in Kirchwiehe, directly opposite Schloss Erbhof in Thedinghausen, Lower Saxony. Organized by TSV Thedinghausen, this road race has welcomed children, teenagers, active adults and Masters since 2016. Distances on offer are 10 km, 5 km and an 800 m children’s race, which takes place in the Baumpark near the start and finish. The course is a measured, flat 5 km loop that is also suitable for Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Measured, flat 5 km loop
The 10 km course covers the loop twice
800 m children’s race in the Baumpark, right by Schloss Erbhof
additional: October weather is typically 14 °C, with lows around 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The children’s race, “Löwenlauf,” is designed especially for the youngest participants and takes place near the start and finish area. Start and finish in Kirchwiehe opposite Schloss Erbhof; children’s race in the Baumpark; October weather with temperatures around 14°C, lows of 6°C, 40 mm of precipitation and mostly cloudy skies.

name: Stadtwerke Lübeck Marathon
price_range: 45 € bis 85 € je nach Disziplin und Anmeldezeitraum
description: The Stadtwerke Lübeck Marathon offers runners a diverse range of distances in the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck. In addition to the classic marathon, the event includes a duo marathon, half marathon, relay race and other shorter races suitable for all ages and ability levels. The course winds through the picturesque city and offers a sporting challenge with regional championship scoring. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and emphasizes community and a passion for sport.
course_highlights: Marathon with Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring
Duo marathon relay point in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea
Course through the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck
additional: A preferred bib number can be selected free of charge during the early registration phases, subject to availability. Relay race with 10 x 4.2 km. Handbike half marathon on the same course as the runners’ half marathon. Duo marathon relay point in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea.

name: Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K
description: The Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K is Berlin’s fastest 10-km race, starting in front of Charlottenburg Palace. The course runs through Berlin Zoo and offers a unique running experience in the capital. In addition to the classic 10-kilometer course, there is also a 2 x 5 km relay and a 4.2 km short course from the zoo to Charlottenburg Palace. The event is suitable for all abilities and age groups and offers a large running festival for the whole family.

name: 19. Burger-Rolandlauf
description: The Burger Rolandlauf is a traditional race that normally takes place in Burg and is jointly organized by Rolandgymnasium Burg and LG Ihleläufer Burg. The course runs through the town along the Ihle, through the forest and past the Bismarckturm, finishing in the school courtyard. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program with music, activities for children and refreshments. The 2026 event in Burg was cancelled due to a lack of permits; instead, a replacement event will take place in Tangerhütte City Park.

name: Frühstückslauf
description: The breakfast run in Wernigerode is a group run without timekeeping, leading from the market square up to Wernigerode Castle. The route is about 3 kilometers long, with an elevation gain of 100 meters. The run takes place as a group and is free of charge. A light snack is served afterward, making it a sociable event.

name: H/21 Halbmarathon
description: The H/21 Hannover Half Marathon is a new running event on the national events calendar, combining urban flair, modern beats and green sections of the course. The start and finish are in the heart of Hannover, and the route passes notable hotspots throughout the state capital. The event takes place in autumn and offers a special running experience in a vibrant urban setting. Join the prologue as Hannover begins a new chapter in running history.

name: Porta Volkslauf
description: Der Porta-Volkslauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung in Porta Westfalica, die seit über drei Jahrzehnten Teil der regionalen Mühlenkreisserie ist. Die Veranstaltung zieht Läufer aller Altersklassen an, von ambitionierten Wettkämpfern bis zu Genussläufern. Die Strecke führt rund um den Nammer Sportplatz und durch das Naturschutzgebiet Nammer Unterholz, bietet abwechslungsreiche und flache Abschnitte sowie ein herrliches Panorama auf die Porta. Die herzliche Atmosphäre entlang der Strecke macht den Lauf zu einem besonderen Gemeinschaftserlebnis.
course_highlights: Strecke über Straßen und Feldwege rund um den Nammer Sportplatz
Befestigte Wege im Naturschutzgebiet Nammer Unterholz
Herrliches Panorama auf die Porta mit flachen und abwechslungsreichen Streckenabschnitten
additional: Der Lauf ist Teil der Mühlenkreisserie und findet auf der heimischen Sportanlage in Nammen (Poggenbeeke) statt. Streckenpläne für Kurzstrecke (5.500 m), Mittelstrecke (8.800 m) und Langstrecke (17.000 m) sind als PDF verfügbar. Parkmöglichkeiten sind rund um die Sportanlage ausgewiesen, Parken in Einfahrten oder an Feldwegen wird nicht empfohlen.

name: Sebastian Fredrich Gedenklauf (LM/LC/NLC)
description: The Sebastian Fredrich Memorial Run is a long-standing running event in Lubmin, organized by the triathlon and running group of HSG Uni Greifswald. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere, supported by many volunteers. The route passes through scenic sections and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of an active running and triathlon community in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania.

name: Storkower See Lauf
description: The Storkower See Run is a traditional running event organized by Triathlonverein Fürstenwalde 1990 e.V. and approved by the Brandenburg Athletics Association. Runners of different age groups and ability levels can take part on various distances around Lake Storkow. The event offers a fair competitive atmosphere and is open to running enthusiasts of all ages. Online registration opens in January, and participants are included in an official participant list.

name: Wendlandmarathon
description: The Wendlandmarathon Kolborn is a traditional road race in Lüchow, Lower Saxony, held since 1993. The event offers a wide range of distances, from the marathon and half marathon to short children’s races, appealing to both long-distance runners and families. The course is measured to AIMS/IAAF standards and has kilometre markers and aid stations. Practical facilities for participants include parking, showers, changing rooms and certificates, as well as finisher medals for children.

name: Dobromiejski Festiwal Biegów i Nordic Wa...
location: Swobodna, Gmina Dobre Miasto, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Piwna Mila
location: Wąsowo, Kuślin, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Beer Mile is a unique race over a flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres and the main event on the third day of the Sun Festival in Wąsowo. Participants start immediately after drinking a beer, and beer stations are placed along the course approximately every 500 metres. Runners must drink the beer at each station. This sporting celebration brings together runners, spectators and families, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a special finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: Flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres
Beer stations approximately every 500 metres
The race starts after runners drink their first beer
additional: 9:30–10:30. The race bib must be pinned to the front of your clothing and must not be altered. You can order a T-shirt when paying for your race bib in the Runner’s Panel. Photos from the event will be available after the race.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
location: Skrzeszewo, Gmina Żukowo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Friendship Run is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland. The race takes place in the picturesque area around Skrzeszewo, giving participants the chance to spend time actively and discover the charms of Kashubia. The series attracts runners of different ages and abilities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque landscapes of Kashubia
The race takes place in a natural, welcoming environment
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
location: Wąsowo, Kuślin, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Październikowy
location: Łubianka, Toruń County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful wooded settings of city parks and forests. In Poznań, the course loops around Lake Rusałka, starting near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, with the finish by the municipal beach on the lake. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to more experienced runners, who can compare their results on the same course over the years. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start near Św. Wawrzyńca Street; finish by the municipal beach on Lake Rusałka
Suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event follows a consistent schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. Participants under 16 may take part with the consent of a parent or guardian. The series also includes races for children and young people.

name: Pielgrzymi Półmaraton o Memoriał Jana Pawła II
Rosa Sløyfe-løpet Kristiansand
organizer: Kreftforeningen og Brystkreftforeningen, i samarbeid med Springtime Group
price_range: Mini: gratis; kort og lang løype: 500 kr + administrasjonsgebyr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kort løype - 17:00 Deltakere kr 500,00 + Adm. gebyr (30 NOK + 3%)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lang løype - 19:00 Deltakere kr 500,00 + Adm. gebyr (30 NOK + 3%)

description: The Pink Ribbon Run in Kristiansand is an annual event held to support the breast cancer cause. The run starts and finishes at Aquarama in the city centre, and the course passes through beautiful areas around Kristiansand. Participants can choose between a short course of approximately 3.4 km or a long course of approximately 5.5 km. There is also a separate children’s race for children aged 3 to 9. All participants receive a race pack with a bib, neck warmer, bag and medal, and the event brings together thousands of people in a sea of pink for a good cause.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Aquarama in central Kristiansand
Short course of approx. 3.4 km without timing
Long course of approx. 5.5 km with timing
additional: The race pack includes a bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. The Mini children’s race is free and approximately 400 metres long, with activities in the start area. The short course is untimed, while the long course is timed. Race numbers can be collected in the start area from 2 hours before the start, or in advance to avoid queues. Participants in the short and long courses are insured through a licence with the Norwegian Athletics Association, which also supports the cause. Companies can register using separate registration forms and manage participants through My Page. The race pack contains a bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. NOK 250 of the race entry fee goes in full to the Pink Ribbon campaign.

name: Nummela BackYard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon running event in which competitors run 6.706-kilometre laps within an hour, continuing for as long as multiple runners are able to keep going. The competition is unique because it has no predetermined finishing time or distance, and the winner is the one who runs one more lap than the others. The event is held at the Polku Hotel in Vihti and offers a challenge for runners who value perseverance and endurance. The competition originated in the United States and is also known as “Just one more Loop.”

name: Frikarusellen løp nr.1 2027/28
description: Frikarusellen løp nr.1 2027/28 arrangeres i Espeland og er en del av en løpsserie som samler løpere i hele Norge. Løpet tilbyr en flott mulighet til å teste formen tidlig i sesongen, med et variert terreng som passer både mosjonister og mer erfarne løpere. Arrangementet er godt organisert med påmelding og tidtaking via EQ Timing, og det er en sosial arena for løpsinteresserte i regionen. Arrangøren ønsker alle velkommen til en hyggelig løpsopplevelse i naturskjønne omgivelser.
course_highlights: Løpet går i variert terreng i Espeland
Passer både mosjonister og erfarne løpere
Del av en større løpsserie med god organisering

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run är ett unikt traillopp i Sollentuna med fokus på upplevelsen av mörker och natur. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser, inklusive en utmanande 30 km bana där löparna navigerar med hjälp av GPS och karta. Start och mål är vid Väsby gård, och banan är markerad med reflexer för att skapa en magisk atmosfär i pannlampans sken. Loppet är öppet för löpare från 18 år och uppåt, med särskilda regler för yngre deltagare på kortare distanser.
course_highlights: Bana markerad med tydliga reflexer för nattlöpningsupplevelse
Navigering med GPS och karta på 21 km och 30 km distanser
Start och mål vid Väsby gård i Sollentuna
additional: Fri starttid mellan 18:00-19:30 för 5 km och 10 km. För 21 km och 30 km är start lördag 17 oktober kl 16:45 respektive 16:00. Åldersgräns 18 år, men 15-18 år får springa 5 och 10 km om vuxen följer med. Rekommenderas att ha ordentlig pannlampa, gärna extra lampa för 30 km. Maxtid för 30 km är 4 timmar och 30 minuter. Energistationer finns längs 21 km och 30 km banorna. Tidigare arrangörsinformation anger 18 års åldersgräns och 4 timmar och 30 minuters maxtid för 30 km.

name: 53. Saaremaa kolme päeva jooks
description: The Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running event in Kuressaare, inviting all running enthusiasts to take part. The competition offers several distance options and age groups, with opportunities for both young people and adults. Registration takes place on site, and the entry fee is affordable, making the event accessible to a wide range of participants. The competition is part of a larger running series, which also includes season standings and an awards ceremony.

name: Stockholm Cross Country
description: Stockholm Cross Country är ett terränglopp i Stockholm som arrangeras av Turebergs Fri-idrottsklubb. Loppet erbjuder utmanande distanser i natursköna miljöer på Gärdet, med banor på 2,5 km och 5 km. Det är ett populärt lopp för både motionärer och tävlingslöpare som vill testa sin terrängkapacitet i en vacker stadsnära miljö. Evenemanget har en lång tradition och lockar löpare i alla åldrar.
course_highlights: Terränglopp i naturskön miljö på Gärdet i Stockholm
Två distanser: 2,5 km och 5 km
Arrangerat av Turebergs Fri-idrottsklubb

name: Vistakulle Backyard
description: Vistakulle Backyard är ett löpevenemang i Vistakulle-området nära Gränna, arrangerat av Rudu Friskvård i samarbete med Bauer Activities. Loppet vänder sig till den som är lite äventyrlig och träningsintresserad och betonar naturupplevelsen lika mycket som prestationen. Evenemanget genomförs och erbjuder en minnesvärd bana i naturnära, kuperad terräng.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baueractivities.se/loppen/vistakulle-backyard/): 2026-10-17 — "17 Oktober 2026 07.00-19.00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet är ett familjevänligt löplopp som bjuder på en härlig dag i Hellasgården, nära stan. Loppen går genom det vackra Hellasområdet förbi sjöar och kullar på fina löparstigar och vägar. Det finns lopp för alla åldrar, från de allra minsta barnen som kan springa 100 meter utan föranmälan till barn 5-8 år på en platt bana. Dagen erbjuder löparglädje, uppförsbackar, musik och en fin höstmiljö med servering och aktiviteter för hela familjen.
course_highlights: Lopp genom Hellasområdet med sjöar och kullar
Härliga löparstigar och vägar
Platt bana för barn 5-8 år
additional: Första start klockan 10 och sista start för 10 km beräknas vid 12-tiden. Det finns gott om parkeringar och cykelparkering vid startområdet. Prisutdelningar sker löpande. Friidrottsaktiviteter finns på plats med stationer för att prova springa, kasta och hoppa. Alla barn födda 2022 och senare kan springa 100 m utan föranmälan och får medalj. Serveringen är öppen under dagen. Första start är kl. 10 och 10-kilometersloppet beräknas starta omkring kl. 12. 100-metersloppet för de yngsta kräver ingen föranmälan. Parkering finns och servering är öppen.

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Växjö Marathon är en snabb och platt maratonbana som går i åtta varv runt den vackra Växjösjön. Banan är mestadels asfalterad med en kortare sträcka på fint grus och har en mycket liten höjdskillnad på cirka 3 meter per varv. Evenemanget välkomnar både erfarna löpare och nybörjare, och erbjuder även stafettlopp där lag kan delta tillsammans. Detta är den 32:a upplagan av loppet och det är känt som Sveriges snabbaste maratonbana. Banan är snitslad och har både förcyklist och flaggvakter, men är inte avlyst under loppet.
course_highlights: Åtta varv runt Växjösjön
Platt och snabb bana med ca 3m höjdskillnad per varv
Underlag mestadels asfalt med ca 300 meter fint grus
additional: Banan är snitslad och det finns förcyklist och flaggvakter. Det finns även stafettlopp där lag kan delta tillsammans. Barnlopp arrangeras också. Sportdryck, kosttillskott och energi- och proteinbars finns tillgängliga. Arrangören är Växjö Löparklubb. Maratonstafetten har fyrmannalag där varje löpare springer två varv. Banan är inte avlyst från gång-, cykel- eller motortrafik.

name: Åhus TrailRun
description: Åhus TrailRun är ett utmanande traillopp som går i strandskogarna och längs havet söder om Åhus i Skåne. Deltagarna kan välja mellan fyra distanser: 2,5 km, 6 km, 11 km och 17 km, samt ett barnlopp utan tidtagning. Banorna bjuder på en småkuperad terräng med en mix av stigar, sanddyner, backar och sandlöpning vid havet, vilket ger en unik löparupplevelse. Loppet ingår i Skåne Trailcup och erbjuder även lagtävling med fina priser. Arrangemanget är öppet för alla och har en familjär och välkomnande atmosfär.
course_highlights: Småkuperad terräng med varierande underlag
Mix av stigar, sanddyner och utmanande backar
Sandlöpning utmed havet
additional: Deltagartak på 1000 deltagare. Barnloppet är ca 350 m långt med individuell start och fri startavgift. Starttider: 2,5 km och 6 km startar kl 12:30, 11 km och 17 km startar kl 12:40, barnloppet startar individuellt mellan kl 13:00-15:00. Maxtid för 17 km är 2 timmar och 50 minuter. Parkering är begränsad och sker enligt funktionärers anvisningar. Värdesakshantering erbjuds mot en avgift på 20 kr. Toaletter finns 200 meter från arenan. Arenan vid Strandridaregården ligger cirka 100 meter från havet. Barnloppet är cirka 350 meter och utan tidtagning. Priserna är rapporterade för 2026 års upplaga.

name: Varberg Halvmarathon
description:
Välkomna till Varberg Halvmarathon lördagen den 16 oktober 2027 – höstens stora löparfest! 21,1 km och 11,5 km.

Längs banan passerar du stora delar av Varberg. Man springer längs stranden i Apelviken och uppe på Hästhagaberget med vidunderlig utsikt över havet. Banan går också genom flera parker/stadsskogar, bland annat den fina Påskbergsskogen och Brunnbergsskogen.
additional: All info och anmälan: https://varberghalvmarathon.se

images.alt_text: Löpare i startfältet för Varberg Halvmarathon i skogsmiljö under dagtid
Löpare vid kusten under Varberg Halvmarathon, glada och energiska på stigen.
Fyra löpare med Varberg Halvmarathon nummerlappar och medaljer efter loppet utomhus på gräs.
Löpare vid en vätskestation med bullar och drycker under ett utomhusevenemang.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K är ett lopp som passar alla, från elitlöpare till glada motionärer, och erbjuder en helt platt och snabb bana i centrala Jönköping med start vid Lillsjöplan. Banan är kontrollmätt av Svenska friidrottsförbundet och seedningsgrundande för många lopp i Sverige och internationellt. Loppet bjuder på en härlig stämning med farthållare för olika tider och möjligheten att delta i lagtävlingar med vänner. Det är ett perfekt tillfälle att slå personbästa eller bara njuta av en trevlig löprunda tillsammans med kollegor eller kompisar.
course_highlights: Helt platt och snabb bana i centrala Jönköping
5 km springer ett varv, 10 km springer två varv
Vätskestation med sportdryck från UMARA längs banan
additional: Farthållare med flagga för tider 40, 45 och 50 minuter på 10K. Lagtävling med 10% rabatt vid anmälan tillsammans med två vänner. Uppvärmning tillsammans med Fitness24Seven kl. 10:40 i start/målområdet. Begränsad väskinlämning i startområdet på morgonen. Parkering finns i närliggande parkeringshus med avgift. Anmäl tre personer som ett lag för 10 % rabatt på anmälningsavgiften och chans att vinna priser. Upp till fem löpare kan anmälas samtidigt.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run Hundtrail är ett unikt kvällslopp i Sollentuna där du kan springa tillsammans med din hund på 5 eller 10 kilometer. Banorna är markerade med reflexer och pannlampa är obligatoriskt för att skapa en magisk mörkerupplevelse. Loppet är öppet för löpare från 18 år, men ungdomar mellan 15 och 18 år kan delta om de följs av en vuxen. Det är en oförglömlig kväll som uppskattas av både två- och fyrbenta deltagare.
course_highlights: Banorna är markerade med reflexer
Fri starttid mellan 18:00 och 19:30 (till 19:00 för 10 km)
Obligatorisk pannlampa och hunden ska vara kopplad
additional: Max en hund per löpare. Åldergräns 18 år, 15-18 år får delta med vuxet sällskap. Hunden måste vara kopplad och trivas med andra hundar och människor. Loppet sker i mörker med trånga passager och täta hundmöten, så reaktiva hundar rekommenderas inte. En hund per löpare; hunden ska vara kopplad. Fri starttid kl. 18.00 - 19.30 för 5 km och kl. 18.00 - 19.00 för 10 km. Åldersgräns 18 år; ungdomar från 15 år kan delta tillsammans med en ansvarig vuxen.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholms Brantaste är ett intensivt och energifyllt lopp som utmanar dig att både springa upp och ned för de branta sluttningarna i Hammarbybacken. Banan är drygt 3 km lång och innehåller tre stegringar där du tar dig upp för två olika skidbackar. Loppet passar både erfarna löpare och nybörjare som vill testa sin mjölksyra och pannben. Målgång sker på toppen av Hammarbybacken med en fantastisk utsikt över Stockholm som kuliss.
course_highlights: Drygt 3 km med tre stegringar
Uppför två olika skidbackar
Mål på toppen av Hammarbybacken med utsikt över Stockholm
additional: Nummerlappsutdelning sker på evenemangsområdet Hammarby Fabriksväg från kl 09.30 på tävlingsdagen. Nummerlappen är personlig och ska bäras på bröstet med säkerhetsnålar. Det finns vätskekontroller längs banan. För stafetten genomför lagen totalt 8 varv på ca 1 km vardera, med 2-4 personer per lag. Barnlopp finns för åldrarna 7-12 år (ca 500 m) och 0-6 år (ca 300 m, anmälan via Skistar). Evenemangsområdet nås lätt med kollektivtrafik, parkering är begränsad. Stafetten omfattar cirka 8 km för lag om 2 - 4 personer. Brantaste Mini är cirka 500 meter för barn 7 - 12 år och Valles Kompislopp cirka 300 meter för barn 0 - 6 år. Start och mål ligger vid Hammarbybacken; arrangören rekommenderar kollektivtrafik eftersom parkering saknas vid backen.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 75 kr

description: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026 är ett unikt löpevenemang som firar sitt 5-årsjubileum. Loppet består av ett 6706 meter långt varv som startar vid Bubblan i Toredal och går på asfalt och grus. Deltagarna springer så många varv de orkar under tolv timmar, med start varje heltimme från 09:00 till 20:00. Det gäller att klara varje varv på under en timme för att få fortsätta, och den som är uthålligast och snabbast på sista varvet vinner. Det finns dam- och herrklass, och även en MiniBackyard för barn och ungdomar som vill springa kortare sträckor.
course_highlights: Varvet är 6706 meter långt med cirka 80% asfalt och 20% grus
Banan innehåller flera längre stigningar, bland annat upp mot Sandbäcksvägen och strandpromenaden
Start och mål vid Bubblan i Toredal med en avslutande platt asfaltsträcka in mot gräsplanen
additional: Loppet startar varje heltimme från 09:00 till 20:00 med upp till 12 varv på tolv timmar. Löpare måste klara varje varv på under en timme för att få fortsätta. MiniBackyard startar kl 14:00 och pågår i max 45 minuter. Anmälan till MiniBackyard sker på plats. Fika serveras kl 20:00 efter sista varvet. Första starten är kl. 09.00 och sista starten kl. 20.00. Det finns även en Minibackyard med en slinga på minst 670 meter; anmälan på plats kostar 75 kr.

name: Oktobermila
description: Oktobermila is a race organised by Ålesundløpene in Ålesund.

name: Ivar Formos Minneløp 2027
description: Ivar Formos Memorial Race is a long-running trail race in Oslo, offering scenic and challenging routes in Nordmarka. There are distances for both children and adults, including a tough 17 km course that follows the terrain where Ivar Formo trained to become an Olympic champion. The start and finish are at Sognsvann Snow Park, and the routes feature beautiful trails, panoramic views of the city, and several aid stations along the way. It is a sweaty delight for anyone who enjoys running in the forest, with a new 10 km course that is rolling and challenging without steep climbs or descents.
course_highlights: 17 km course starting and finishing at Sognsvann Snow Park, with panoramic views of Oslo from Vettakollen and Frønsvollen
The course passes well-known spots such as Båntjern, Skjennungstua, Ullevålseter, and Lynhytta, with aid stations
New 10 km course on beautiful forest trails, with challenging, rolling terrain and no steep hills
additional: A timing chip is included in the race bib, except for the children's race, which is untimed. Late registration is available on race day via the EQ Timing app. Registration is binding, with no refunds in case of illness or injury. Race bibs can be resold via EQ Timing. No T-shirts will be sold in 2027 due to low interest. In 2027, the race will be held for the 15th time. A one-time license from the Norwegian Athletics Federation is required if you do not have an annual license.

name: Volda Bakgårdsultra 2027
description: Volda Bakgårdsultra is a social and inclusive ultramarathon based on the backyard ultra concept, where participants run 12 laps of 6.7 km, with a new start every hour on the hour. The race starts in the SpareBank 1 Hall at Volda Stadium and is suitable for all levels, from those who want to complete one lap to those aiming to finish the classic ultra distance of 50 miles (80.4 km). The event has been a success since 2025 and offers a unique running experience focused on community and personal challenge. Between laps, participants can rest in the hall, with access to a drop bag area and kiosk. Registration for 2027 opens on 16 January at 20:00 via EQ Timing.
course_highlights: 12 laps of 6.7 km, with a start every hour on the hour
The course is mostly gravel road with little elevation gain
Start and finish in the SpareBank 1 Hall, with access to a rest area and drop bag area
additional: The race has a basic aid station with water, sports drinks, fruit and salty snacks. Participants can also bring their own food and drinks and set up personal drop bags by the start/finish area. Free parking is available at Volda Stadium, and Volda town centre is within walking distance of the venue. Volda Airport Hovden is a 10-minute drive away. The hall has a kiosk selling coffee, soft drinks, chocolate and other light refreshments. Participants must have a valid licence from the Norwegian Athletics Federation or purchase a one-day licence when registering. The provisional date is 16 October 2027, with a start at 08:00. Registration has not opened yet; the final date and registration information are to be confirmed in January 2027.

name: Furumomila 2027
description: Furumomila is a traditional cross-country race, held for the 44th time at Furumo Idrettspark. The event offers several distances, including a 10 km cross-country race, MiniMil, a walking event and SpareBank1 Modum’s cross-country race. Participants can look forward to generous cash prizes, gift cards, medals and pins. This autumn adventure welcomes both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: 10 km cross-country race over varied terrain
Several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 1.5 km, MiniMil and a walking event
Start and finish at Furumo Idrettspark
additional: Race bibs can be collected in the tent by the clubhouse before the start. Showers and changing rooms are available. Parking and a shuttle bus are offered. Prizes are awarded shortly after finishers cross the line in the different distances. A one-time licence is required for those without an annual licence, in accordance with the rules of the Norwegian Athletics Federation. Previous editions have had race bib collection at the clubhouse.

name: Hytteplanmila
description: Hytteplanmila is an annual fun run held at Svensrudmoen in October. The race features a fast, gently undulating 10-kilometre course, known as one of Norway’s fastest 10K road race routes. Participants can experience a varied course with both easy and challenging sections, including a demanding finish on Pulsbakken. The event attracts both recreational runners and elite athletes, with separate start groups for the elite field.
course_highlights: Fast, gently undulating 10-kilometre course
The race’s challenging finish on Pulsbakken
Great views over Steinssletta and historic sites such as Mo gård
additional: Registration opens in November. Entry fees are non-refundable and cannot be transferred. Those who register by the deadlines receive a buff and running socks, distributed on race day. It is possible to pre-order a race pack with energy products. Elite athletes can register by email for separate start groups. Buses to the race are arranged from Oslo and Gardermoen. The time limit is 1 hour and 40 minutes. Registration for 2027 opens in November; information about the entry fee has not yet been published.

name: Hiidenkierros
description: Hiidenkierros is a trail running event held in the Neitvuori area of Mikkeli. The routes wind through beautiful lake scenery and along technical trails, offering runners varied terrain, including rocky outcrops and the shores of forest ponds. The event centre is the idyllic Hiidenmaa farm, creating a unique atmosphere for the event. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and also offers a 4 km distance for children.

name: Saaremaa Kolme Päeva Jooks
description: Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running competition held in the village of Iide. The competition consists of three stages, where participants can enjoy Saaremaa’s beautiful nature and varied terrain. The competition is open to different age groups and offers a friendly, supportive atmosphere for all running enthusiasts. Participants are provided with electronic timing, reusable race bibs and drinking cups, and a sweet treat and a drink after the run.

name: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė
description: The Graužikai–Kelmė Run is a traditional race in Kelmė District held in memory of Vaidotas Rimkus. The event takes place in October and aims to promote running and athletics in Lithuania, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and increase physical activity among local residents. It attracts runners of all ages, who can choose from several distances, including the 8 km main race. Participants are awarded cups, medals, and commemorative prizes.

name: TeutoMarsch
location: Grundschule Hohne, Lengerich-Hohne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Teutomarsch is a unique hiking and running experience through the Teutoburg Forest and its surroundings. Organized by Turnverein Hohne von 1911 e.V. in Lengerich, the Teutomarsch offers two routes designed to delight participants. The event is very popular, and places fill up quickly. The exact route is still being finalized, but promises to be a wonderful and unique course. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and dogs are allowed on a leash.
course_highlights: A unique route through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area
Two different routes for a special experience
A nature experience in the Lengerich-Hohne region
additional: Registration for the Teutomarsch 2026 sold out within 30 minutes, with 500 places available. There is a waiting list. Participants consent to being photographed and filmed and to the publication of the images and footage. Entry fees are non-refundable. Minimum age: 16. The organizer accepts no liability for personal injury or property damage, or for loss or theft. Trail running, no timing, aid stations along the route, start and finish at Grundschule Hohne, participant limit: 500

name: Prignitzer Moormeile
description: The Prignitz Moor Mile in Bad Wilsnack is a traditional race taking place for the 26th time. The event offers a range of distances from 1 km to 12.4 km, running through the Wilsnack forests and the Kurpark, and around the Karthanehalle. The races are suitable for children, teenagers, and adults, and are part of the Prignitz Cup and the Brandenburg Cup. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, good on-course refreshments, and professional timing.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
location: Luzino, Wejherowo County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and environmental protection. The races take place on forest trails around the park’s highest elevation, Dziewicza Góra. Participants can choose from 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic Walking event, and shorter races for children and young people. The event brings together runners of different ages and ability levels, creating a welcoming atmosphere of sporting competition and recreation.
course_highlights: The course follows a 5.15 km loop entirely on forest trails
The route climbs twice to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the highest point in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park
The route passes through the event center after approximately 3.7 km, where spectators can cheer on the runners
additional: The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30 in the building of the Łopuchówko Forest District Education Center. Children’s races start between 9:00 and 9:45, over distances of 200m, 500m, 1000m, and 1500m. The 5 km race starts at 10:50, the 10 km race at 11:00, and Nordic Walking at 11:02. The participant limit is 500. After leaving the forest, runners finishing the race should head to the left side of the balloon marked Finish; 10 km runners pass under the Finish balloon and continue for a second loop.

name: 35 Orla Pięść
location: Świeszyno, Koszalin County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: III Festiwal Biegowy w Nadleśnictwie Kli...
location: Sowno, Goleniów County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Halvmarathon är en lättspringen och snabb halvmara i naturskön miljö med start och mål vid Näsby Slott. Banan bjuder på kustnära vyer längs Värtans strand, en naturskön slinga runt Rönningesjön och avslutning tillbaka vid havet med utsikt mot Bogesundslandet. Loppet är kontrollmätt och arrangeras av Täby IS Friidrott, och passar löpare som vill avsluta säsongen på en snabb och vacker bana. Tidigare år har loppet varit mycket populärt med begränsade platser, så arrangören uppmuntrar tidig anmälan.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presenterar Täljemilen - höstens kanske snabbaste kontrollmätta millopp på Geneta Sportfält i Södertälje. Banan går till 100% på cykel- och gångväg och är helt asfalterad, vilket gör loppet mycket snabbt och lämpligt för dem som jagar personbästa. Vätska finns vid 5 km och vid målgång. Istället för medaljer skänker arrangören en summa till Barncancerfonden för varje anmäld löpare; priser delas ut till topp 3 i dam- respektive herrklass och det hålls även utlottning av cirka 20 priser.

name: Skövdeloppet
description: Skövdeloppet gör 2026 comeback med en ny, stadsnära bana som i huvudsak följer gång- och cykelbanor genom flera av Skövdes bostadsområden. Tävlingsdag är 18 oktober och loppen är tänkta som lättlöpta banor i stadsmiljö som passar både motionärer och tävlingslöpare. Det erbjuds tre distanser (21,1 km, 10 km och 5 km) med gemensam start och mål vid Lillegårdens Fritidsområde.

name: Gjesdal Trailrun
location: Gjesdal IL athletics facility, Solås, Ålgård, Gjesdal, Norway

description: Gjesdal Trailrun is a true trail race held amid beautiful natural surroundings in Ålgård, starting from Gjesdal IL’s athletics facility at Solås. The race mainly follows trails in the terrain northeast of the facility, climbing Kodlifjellet and Håfjellet, and is suitable both for those looking for a scenic mountain hike and for those who want to compete. Three distances are offered: 10 km, 6 km and a 1.3 km children’s race. The route follows regular hiking trails that can be challenging, with rocky and slippery sections, so good trail shoes are recommended.
course_highlights: Trail race on paths in the terrain northeast of Gjesdal IL’s athletics facility
The main course climbs Kodlifjellet and Håfjellet
Challenging sections with rocks and slippery areas
additional: Race number distribution opens at 10:00 at the Gjesdal IL clubhouse. The children’s race starts at 11:30. Both timed and untimed starts are available for the 6 km and 10 km distances. There is a time limit for the 10 km distance, with runners required to pass Kodlifjellet within approximately 35 minutes and the junction between the 6 km and 10 km routes within 40 minutes. The online registration fee of NOK 20, plus any NFIF one-time licence, is additional. Previous editions have featured 10 km, 6 km and a 1 km children’s race. Good trail shoes with good grip are recommended.

name: Neskollen Frontyard 2027

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: inkludert servering av snacks, drikke, frukt og pizza

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barneløp med inntil 5 runder rundt tjernet

description: Neskollen Frontyard 2027 is a unique race organised by Hvam IL, where participants run 3 km laps that must be completed progressively faster. The race combines competition with a family-friendly, social atmosphere, with indoor breaks at Nes Arena where snacks, drinks, fruit and pizza are served and included in the price. Frontyard challenges both running fitness and tactics, and prizes are awarded to the best woman, the best man and the fastest overall time after 15 laps. The start and finish are at Nes Arena, which has convenient facilities including toilets and parking right outside.
course_highlights: 3 km laps that must be run faster with each lap
Start and finish at Nes Arena, with indoor breaks
The course includes approximately 700 metres of gravel, with the rest on asphalt
additional: The start, finish and breaks are indoors at Nes Arena, which has 12 toilets and parking right outside. The course includes approximately 700 metres of gravel, with the rest on asphalt. Remember to wear your race bib visibly on the outside of your clothing. The children’s race starts at approximately 10:01. Previous editions have served snacks, drinks, fruit and pizza during breaks at Nes Arena.

name: Krusensterni jooks
description: The Krusenstern Run is a traditional running race that starts at the Purila bus stop and finishes at Hagudi Manor. The race is 4.2 km long and is suitable for schoolchildren, pensioners and adults. The top men and women are awarded prizes, with special prizes also awarded to veteran athletes, the youngest and oldest finishers, and the largest family. Participants take part at their own risk, and all finishers are offered water, a treat and hot tea.

name: Botanic Five Kaunas
location: Botanical Garden of Vytautas Magnus University, Kaunas, Lithuania

name: Oldenburg Marathon
price_range: 35 Euro für Sportshirt (genaue Startgebühr nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon offers runners a varied programme featuring a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, 10 km city run, 5 km run and children’s mile run. The course passes through Oldenburg and Wardenburg and is known for its excellent refreshments and friendly atmosphere. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and also offers a public race series with additional events throughout the year. Participants receive high-quality long-sleeved shirts, and extensive services are available on site.
course_highlights: Refreshment stations every 5 km on courses of 10 km or longer, offering water, sports drinks and fruit
Showers at the sports hall of Graf Anton Günther School, approximately 300 m from the start/finish area
Changing facilities and baggage drop-off on Parking Deck 1 at Schlosshöfe
additional: Race packs will be available at Schlosshöfe from 11 a.m. on 11 October. On race day, collection opens at 7 a.m. for marathon runners and at 8 a.m. for everyone else. Group registration is available. After the race, extensive refreshments will be provided, including drinks, fruit, coffee, tea, pastries and non-alcoholic wheat beer. Physiotherapy students will offer free massages. Portable toilets and changing facilities are available. Several race distances; start in Wardenburg; road closures in the city centre; medals for finishers; online registration available.

name: 20. Müggelsee-Halbmarathon
description: The Müggelsee Half Marathon is a scenic race in southeast Berlin that runs entirely around the Großer Müggelsee. The event offers three distances: a half marathon, 10 kilometers, and 5 kilometers, each set up as either an out-and-back course or a loop. The route passes through the historic Spree Tunnel and offers idyllic views of Berlin’s largest lake and the surrounding Müggelberge. The race is suitable for all runners, whether they are aiming for personal bests or simply want to enjoy the community and nature. The start and finish are at Müggelseeperle, and the race takes place.

name: Hubertuslauf
description: Der Hubertuslauf in Neuruppin ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die vom Kreissportbund Ostprignitz-Ruppin organisiert wird. Angeboten werden Läufe über 8 und 15 Kilometer, ein 3-km-Firmenlauf sowie ein Walking-Wettbewerb über 8 Kilometer. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Sportler:innen aller Leistungsstufen und findet jährlich statt. Die Strecke führt durch die landschaftlich reizvolle Umgebung von Neuruppin und bietet sowohl Läufern als auch Walkern ein abwechslungsreiches Erlebnis.
course_highlights: Läufe über 8 und 15 Kilometer
3-km-Firmenlauf
Walking-Wettbewerb über 8 Kilometer

name: 52.Maraton Dębno 2026
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dębnie
description: The 52nd Dębno Marathon is the oldest and one of the fastest marathons in Poland. The 42.195 km course, certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), runs through the streets of Dębno and the surrounding area, offering ideal conditions for personal bests. The event has a rich tradition dating back to 1966 and attracts both amateur and professional runners from Poland and abroad. Participants can expect professional organization, numerous refreshment stations, and enthusiastic support from spectators. The marathon is also an opportunity for the running community to come together and a celebration of sport for the whole family.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
description: The XVII Puck Region Half Marathon is a well-known running event in Pomerania, returning in a new format under the STONE TRI & RUN banner. Held in autumn, it offers a refreshed course and a unique atmosphere, serving as the final event in the Puck Running Triad. It’s an ideal opportunity to end the running season on a high note, competing in the half marathon or shorter races and Nordic walking events. The organizers provide participants with comprehensive information and support, including the event schedule, course maps, and baggage-drop areas.
course_highlights: Refreshed half-marathon course measuring 21.097 km
Autumn atmosphere and the final event in the Puck Running Triad
Additional 5 km race and 5 km Nordic walking event
additional: Race office open 15:00–20:00 and 7:00–9:00 on race day at MOKSiR Puck. Baggage drop available 8:00–13:00. Start times: half marathon 10:00, 5 km race 10:05, 5 km Nordic walking 10:07. For children: Mini Kids Run (approx. 400 m) and Mega Kids Run (approx. 800 m) after the half marathon. Winners’ awards ceremony at 13:00.

name: 40. Bieg Barbórkowy o Lampkę Górniczą – Sztafeta Międzyzakładowa
Necon Vinterkarusell 27-28 løp 1 (18. okt)
description: Necon Winter Series is a winter running series consisting of 8 races held at Fana Stadium in Bergen from November to April. The races have a mass start and offer two distances, 5 km and 10 km. Participants can choose their distance during the race at the turnaround point. The start and finish are at Fana Stadium, and the races follow varied terrain, with intermediate times available along the way. The series is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking for a social and challenging winter series.
course_highlights: Mass start for the 5 km and 10 km, with the option to choose a distance during the race
The course starts at Fana Stadium, with turnarounds at Sandsli and Plantasjen in Kokstad
Intermediate times are recorded at 2.5 km, 5 km and 7.5 km for the different distances
additional: Start and finish at Fana Stadium from 18:45. Start waves are based on expected finish times to avoid crossing Grimseidvegen. Wave 0 starts at 18:45 for 10 km runners expecting to finish in over 55 min. Wave 1 starts at 19:00 for 5 km runners expecting to finish in under 22:30 min and 10 km runners expecting to finish in under 45 min. Waves 2–4 start at 2-minute intervals, based on expected finish times. Participants register for the 5 km when signing up; the distance is chosen automatically during the race at the turnaround point.

name: Pukinmaki Run Helsinki 18.10.2026
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki, offering distances of 1 km for children, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course is flat and fast, mainly on asphalt and outdoor trails, and loops around the boundaries of Pukinmäki. The event is open to runners of all ages and abilities, offering a chance to enjoy exercise and beautiful nature together with others. The event hub is located at Pukinmäki Sports Park, and refreshments and snacks are available.

name: Coop Tartu jooksuõhtud 2026 IV etapp
description: Coop Tartu jooksuõhtud on Tartu Suusaklubi korraldatud jooksusarja neljas etapp, mis toimub Raadi pargis. See on meeldiv ja sportlik üritus, mis kutsub jooksuhuvilisi nautima sügisest loodust ja aktiivset liikumist. Sarja raames on võimalik osaleda erinevatel distantsidel ning kogeda sõbralikku võistlusõhkkonda.
course_highlights: Jooksud toimuvad Raadi pargi kaunites ja mitmekesistes maastikes
Rajad sobivad nii algajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele
Võimalus nautida sügisest loodust ja värsket õhku

name: Emili jookseb
description: Emili Runs is a cheerful school community running event held in Kadriorg Park in autumn, with students, teachers and parents taking part. The focus is on the joy of movement and supporting one another, not on speed. This traditional event fosters a sense of togetherness and offers the community enjoyable moments of exercise in the fresh air. The first run took place amid golden leaves and was an inspiring start to the school holiday.

name: Älvsjöloppet night trail
location: Gamla Älvsjö IP, Älvsjö, Stockholm, Sverige
price_range: 250 kr; gratis för medlemmar i OK Älvsjö-Örby
description: Älvsjöloppet Night Trail är ett spännande kvällslopp på 5 km som går i kuperad terräng i Älvsjöskogen med 150 meters stigning. Start och mål är vid Gamla Älvsjö IP, cirka 15 minuters promenad från Älvsjö station. Loppet är ett reflexspår och kräver en ljusstark pannlampa, helst med minst 1000 lumen, samt bra trailskor för att klara av terrängen. Efter målgång bjuds alla löpare på korv och dryck i en gemytlig atmosfär. Loppet arrangeras av OK Älvsjö Örby och är öppet för alla, med gratis deltagande för klubbmedlemmar.
course_highlights: 5 km reflexspår i kuperad terräng med 150 m stigning
Start och mål vid Gamla Älvsjö IP, nära Älvsjö station
Kräver ljusstark pannlampa och trailskor med bra fotfäste
additional: Nummerlapp och tidtagningspinne delas ut 18.15-18.45. Pinne/chip ska återlämnas vid målgång. Toalett och omklädningsrum finns på området. Parkering finns i området och på Herr Stens väg 2, men rekommenderas att gå, cykla eller springa till start. Liveresultat och resultatlista finns på alvsjoloppet.se. Efter målgång bjuds korv och dryck till alla löpare, ingen övrig servering. För 2026 rekommenderas pannlampa på minst 1000 lumen och trailskor, gärna med metalldobb.

name: Ambla SK SV suusatajate seeriajooks+kepikõnd
description: Ambla SK SV suusatajate seeriajooks+kepikõnd on mitmeetapiline jooksu- ja kepikõnni võistlussari, mis toimub Kangrumäel Järva maakonnas. Võistlus koosneb viiest etapist, kus neli esimest toimuvad eraldistardiga ja viimane ühisstardiga. Arvesse läheb nelja parima etapi tulemus ning osalejad jagunevad erinevatesse vanusegruppidesse. Võistlus on mõeldud suusakeppidega jooksjatele ning pakub vajadusel ka suusakeppide laenutust. Iga viie etapi läbinu saab eriauhinna.
course_highlights: Viis etappi: neli eraldistarti ja viimane ühisstart
Võistlus toimub Kangrumäel Järva maakonnas
Võistlusarvestus ainult suusakeppidega jooksjate vahel
additional: Võistlusel on vanusegrupid alates 6. eluaastast kuni 55+ aastastele. Vajadusel on võimalik suusakeppe laenutada.

name: 3. Holstre-Polli ööjooks
location: Holstre-Polli Sports Centre, Holstre, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: The 3rd Holstre-Polli Night Run takes place on the health and ski trails of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre in Viljandi County. This night run gives participants the chance to experience the wilderness and tranquillity surrounding the sports centre. The event is part of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre’s sports event series and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners. Participants can enjoy a unique night-running experience amid beautiful nature.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C är en av Östergötlands mest unika och tuffa löpartävlingar som hålls vid foten av Pernilla Wibergs hemmabacke i Yxbacken, Norrköping. Loppet utmanar deltagarna med fem varv uppför en backe med 100 höjdmeter på 350 meter, totalt cirka 7 kilometer. Oavsett om du springer snabbt eller tar det lugnt är alla välkomna att delta och det viktigaste är att ta sig upp. Nytt för i år är även en stafett som ger en extra dimension till tävlingen. Barn deltar gratis i Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C, vilket gör det till en familjevänlig löparfest.
course_highlights: Fem varv uppför Yxbacken med 100 höjdmeter på 350 meter per varv
Totalt cirka 7 kilometer i en unik tävlingsmiljö i Östergötland
Start vid foten av Pernilla Wibergs hemmabacke
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas hos XXL fredag 23 oktober kl 14 - 18 eller vid start- och målområdet senast en timme innan start. Nummerlappen innehåller ett tidtagningschip som måste användas för att registrera tid. Alla deltagare som passerar mållinjen får en medalj sponsrad av Energi & Inneklimat. Företag kan hyra partnertält vid tävlingsområdet för teamkänsla och exponering via Rent a Tent. E2C var titelpartner för fjärde året i 2024 års upplaga.

name: VSM terräng
description: Terräng-SM arrangeras av Västerås FK och Svenska Friidrottsförbundet på Rocklunda IP i Västerås. Banan är 2 km lång och består till största delen av gräs med inslag av annat underlag, inklusive lättlöpt gräs och grusväg. Tävlingen omfattar flera klasser inklusive seniorer, ungdomar, veteraner och parafriidrottare, med individuella lopp och lagtävlingar. Evenemanget erbjuder även möjligheter till förbokad lunch och goda boendemöjligheter nära arenan.
course_highlights: 2 km lång bana med mestadels gräs och inslag av annat underlag
Lättlöpt gräs och 2-3 meter bred grusväg som passeras fyra gånger per varv
Hinder i form av höbalar på delar av banan
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas ut vid start- och målområdet senast 60 minuter före start. Insläpp till startområdet sker 10 minuter före start och stänger 2 minuter före start. Vatten finns vid varvning och målgång, samt Dextrosol vid målgång. Omklädning och dusch finns i Expandia Arena. Avgiftsfri parkering och lokalbussar finns tillgängliga. Egna klubbtält kan sättas upp på markerad plats. Förbokad lunch serveras på Good Morning Hotels nära arenan. Dopingkontroll kan genomföras under tävlingshelgen. För 2026 års arrangemang låg tävlingsområdet på Rocklunda IP i Västerås. Arrangörssidan uppger att Västerås FK lämnade över värdskapet för Terräng-SM 2027 till Mora.

name: Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail
description: Välkommen till andra upplagan av Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail, ett unikt och spännande löpevenemang i Kråksångsskogens höstmörker. Loppet består av 13 varv på en 3,5 km lång slinga där varje varv måste klaras på max 30 minuter. Efter sjätte varvet byter löparna riktning, vilket ger en extra dimension till tävlingen. Det är ett småskaligt lopp med begränsat antal startplatser och pannlampa är obligatoriskt eftersom nästan hela loppet sker i mörker. Alla deltagare som klarar minst ett varv får en fin medalj i trä, och vinnarna får unika vinnarmedaljer.
course_highlights: 13 varv på en 3,5 km slinga med max 30 minuter per varv
Byte av löpriktning efter sjätte varvet
Banan är markerad med reflexer och snitslar, underlag mestadels stigar och cirka 700 meter grus
additional: Energi serveras under varv 7 och 8 (pizza från lokal pizzeria) samt godis, banan, chips, kaffe, varm buljong, sportdryck och vatten. Bekvämligheter är mycket begränsade med självservering av energi, en varm brasa och cirka 25 kvm skydd under tak. Toalettbesök sker ute i skogen. Max 70 startplatser. Varje varv startar var 30:e minut, och om man klarar ett varv snabbare får man vila tiden som blir över innan nästa varv startar. Pannlampa och mobiltelefon anges som obligatorisk utrustning. Tävlingssidan anger 70 startplatser.

name: Halloween Night Trail
location: Friluftscentrum Karlsnäs, Ronneby, Blekinge County, Sverige
description: Halloween Night Trail är ett spännande traillopp i mörker vid Karlsnäsområdet norr om Ronneby med distanserna 2 km, 5 km och 10 km. Loppet bjuder på en unik Halloween-stämning med teman som Zombie höjden, Greve Drakulas boning och Fladdermusgrottan längs banan. Arenan är vid Friluftscentrum Karlsnäs där målet är inomhus och efter loppet serveras grillad hamburgare och dryck som ingår i startavgiften. Loppet arrangeras av Ronneby Orienteringsklubb som har lång erfarenhet av stora orienteringstävlingar.
course_highlights: Löpning på små stigar och i terräng med reflexer som visar vägen i mörkret
Tematiska inslag som Zombie höjden, Kyrkogården, Greve Drakulas boning och Fladdermusgrottan
Målområdet är inomhus vid Karlsnäs friluftscentrum
additional: Elektronisk tidtagning för 5 km och 10 km, ingen tidtagning på 2 km. Nummerlapp och chip hämtas från kl. 17:00 på arenan. Prisutdelning preliminärt kl 20:45. Rekommenderas skor med bra grepp och pannlampa. Föräldrar kan springa med barn på 2 km utan anmälan. Specialdesignad medalj till alla deltagare. Startavgiften inkluderar hamburgare och dryck. Elektronisk tidtagning erbjuds på 5 och 10 km, men inte på 2 km. Målområdet är inomhus.

name: Rosa Sløyfe-løpet Oslo lørdag
organizer: Kreftforeningen og Brystkreftforeningen, i samarbeid med Springtime Group
price_range: 500 kr + 30 kr i administrasjonsgebyr og 3 % transaksjonsgebyr; Mini er gratis

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Distanse: Kort løype - Lørdag 23. okt - kl. 12.00 Deltakere kr 500,00 + Adm. gebyr (30 NOK + 3%)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Distanse: 5 KM - Søndag 24. okt - kl. 12.00 Deltakere kr 500,00 + Adm. gebyr (30 NOK + 3%)

tiers.description: Distanse: 10 KM - Søndag 24. okt - kl. 14.00 Deltakere kr 500,00 + Adm. gebyr (30 NOK + 3%)

description: Rosa Sløyfe-løpet Oslo is an annual race held in support of the Pink Ribbon campaign. On Saturday, the event offers a short untimed course from Nedre Foss gård to Nydalen. On Sunday, participants can choose between timed 5 km and 10 km races, starting and finishing at Rådhusplassen. The course passes through some of Oslo’s most iconic areas, including Aker Brygge, Tjuvholmen and Akershus Fortress, offering an urban and atmospheric experience. The event is for everyone, whether you want to race for a time, run with colleagues or simply be part of the sea of pink.
course_highlights: Course through Aker Brygge, Tjuvholmen and Akershus Fortress
Start and finish at Rådhusplassen in central Oslo
Urban, atmospheric course with beautiful views
additional: Saturday’s short course is untimed and suitable for anyone looking for a more relaxed experience. The race packet includes a race bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. Pacers will be available for Sunday’s 5 km and 10 km races at different paces to help participants maintain a steady speed. Race bibs can be collected in advance or from two hours before the start on race day. Participants are insured through a licence provided by the Norwegian Athletics Federation, and half of the entry fee goes directly to the Pink Ribbon campaign. Timing is available for the 5 km and 10 km. The free Mini Run, approximately 400 metres, is for children aged 3 to 9. The participant package includes a race bib, neck warmer, bag and medal.

description: Bergen Marathon will be held for the 40th time on Saturday, October 23, 2027, starting and finishing at Fana Stadium in Bergen. The race is part of Maratonkarusellen, which offers both a full and a half marathon, and aims to ensure that all participants enjoy themselves despite the challenges of the race. Maratonkarusellen works with BFG Bergen Running Club and places great emphasis on the quality of its events. The minimum age for the marathon is 18.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Events include both a full and a half marathon
Organized in cooperation with BFG Bergen Running Club
additional: Kondis members receive a NOK 50 discount. A year-long license from the Norwegian Athletics Association can be provided to avoid the one-time license fee. Those without a license must purchase a one-time license. The event offers a half marathon and a marathon. The listed prices apply to the 2026 edition and may change before the 2027 race.

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Backyard Sandefjord is a unique ultrarun being held for the 14th time in 2027. The race consists of a slightly hilly loop of approximately 6.7 km, run every hour on the hour, with a maximum of 12 laps in total. Participants must start each lap to continue, and the last runner to start the final lap is declared the winner. The event has a social focus and a low participation threshold, and offers facilities such as snacks, hot drinks and places to rest in the hall. Everyone who completes 12 laps receives a cup, and those who reach the ultradistance receive a Norwegian-made wooden medal.
course_highlights: Slightly hilly loop of approx. 6.7 km
The course is marked with yellow arrow signs, red marker flags and white arrows on asphalt
Maximum of 12 laps, 80.4 km in total if completed
additional: Participants must bring their own cup, headlamp and reflective vest. Race bib collection is Friday 17:00–18:30 and Saturday 08:30–09:30. Support is only permitted outdoors. Snacks, coffee, sweet tea, broth, cold/hot water and hot dogs are available after the 7th lap. Participants must bring their own chair; there is no room for sun loungers. Enter through the large gate at the back of the hall; parking is available. Start and finish at Runarhallen, Klavenesveien 20. Maximum 350 participants.

name: Fredrikstad Multiconsult Maraton 2027
description: The Fredrikstad Multiconsult Marathon takes place in Fredrikstad and consists of three identical 14 km laps, followed by an extra 195-metre finishing section so that the kilometre markers are in the same place on each lap. The course starts and finishes at FIF-huset and includes asphalt, gravel and forest roads in Fredrikstadmarka. There are aid stations along the route with water, squash and sports drink, as well as cola and bananas on the final laps. The race has been held since 2001 and offers a varied, scenic course with marshals at important intersections.
course_highlights: The course consists of three 14 km laps, plus an extra 195 metres to ensure the kilometre markers are in the same place on each lap
The first half is on asphalt; the rest is on gravel and forest roads in Fredrikstadmarka
Three aid stations per lap with a range of drinks and food
additional: An early start at 10:00 is available for runners who expect to take more than 5 hours. The race office and bib collection open at 09:00 on race day at FIF-huset. Parking is at Stjernehallen, about a 5-minute walk from the start/finish. Changing rooms and toilets are available at FIF-huset. There are no pacers during the race. Online registration is open until 1 hour before the start. There are three aid stations per lap. The race office, changing rooms and toilets are at FIF-huset; parking is at Stjernehallen.

description: Snipsøyrvatnet Rundt is one of Sunnmøre’s most traditional recreational races, organised by Hareid IL. The race goes around Snipsøyrvatnet and starts at Ward1 in Bjåstad, marking the beginning of the autumn season. Participants register at Hareid Clubhouse before the race and can warm up with a 3 km jog to the start area. The race is open to both seniors and juniors, with a friendly and inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race goes around Snipsøyrvatnet
Start and finish at Ward1 in Bjåstad
A 3 km warm-up jog from registration to the start
additional: Registration takes place at Hareid Clubhouse from 12:00 to 13:45. Participants must make their own way from registration to the start area, either with a 3 km warm-up jog or by car. Changing facilities are available at Hareid Clubhouse. A one-time licence from the Norwegian Athletics Federation is an additional cost for those without an annual licence for road running. Parking is available at Ward1, Bigset Bedehus or Kulturoasen. The start is at 14:00; participants must make their own way approximately 3 km from registration to the start. Parking is listed at Ward1, Bigset Bedehus and Kulturoasen, and changing facilities are available at Hareid Clubhouse.
