name: Yddingeloppet
description: Yddingeloppet är ett av Skånes största terränglopp som arrangeras i den vackra och tuffa terrängen i Bokskogen, Torup utanför Malmö. Loppet går alltid sista söndagen i oktober med start och mål vid Torups Friluftsgård. Det finns motionsklasser på 6 km och 12 km samt promenad/stavgång på 6 km, och tävlingsklasser för olika åldrar och veteranklasser. Alla deltagare får nummerlappar med tidtagningschip och en medalj vid målgång. Prisutdelning sker för de främsta i tävlingsklasserna och vinnare i veteranklasser får pris hemskickat.
course_highlights: Terränglopp i höstvackra Bokskogen, Torup
Två sträckor: 6 km och 12 km
Start och mål vid Torups Friluftsgård
additional: Nummerlappar med tidtagningschip till alla startande utom promenad- och stavgång. Nummerlappar kan hämtas på kansliet veckan före loppet eller på tävlingsdagen från kl. 8.30 till en timme före start. Prisutdelning för 1 - 3 i tävlingsklass 6 och 12 km dam och herr ca kl. 12.30. Start- och målområde har parkering och goda kommunikationer med buss 150 och 148. Samåkning rekommenderas. Loppet har tidigare arrangerats i slutet av oktober.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken är ett traditionsrikt löplopp som firar 50 år 2026. Loppet arrangeras av Boxholm-Ekeby Skidklubb och går av stapeln vid Boxholms skidstadion. Det är ett uppskattat evenemang för löpare i alla åldrar och nivåer, med en vacker och utmanande bana. Mer information och anmälan kommer att finnas tillgänglig närmare tävlingsdagen.
course_highlights: Vacker bansträckning runt Sjögarpsområdet
Utmanande 14 km bana med banprofil tillgänglig
Loppet arrangeras vid Boxholms skidstadion
additional: Loppet firar 50 år 2026. Det finns länkar till inbjudan, PM, startlista och preliminära resultat från tidigare år. Banprofil och karta över banan finns tillgängliga för löpare. Samling anges till kl. 09.30.

name: Hindås Trail
description: Hindås Trail är en löpfest som arrangeras på fina motionsspår i Hindås. Deltagarna kan välja mellan distanserna 1 km för barn, samt 5 km och 15 km för vuxna. Det är en tävling för de som vill springa snabbt och en fin löptur för de som prioriterar upplevelsen. I mål bjuds deltagarna på kaffe och kexchoklad, och det finns även varmkorv och förstärkt fika till försäljning. Allt överskott går oavkortat till den uppskattade skidverksamheten i Hindås.
course_highlights: Fina motionsspår i Hindås
Barnlopp på 1 km på lättare bana
Val mellan 5 km och 15 km distanser
additional: Det finns varmkorv och förstärkt fika att köpa till bra pris. Allt överskott från Hindås Trail går oavkortat till skidverksamheten. Kaffe och kexchoklad ingår efter målgång. Varmkorv och förstärkt fika har funnits till försäljning. Överskottet går till Hindås Skidklubbs skidverksamhet.

name: Löfstad Slott Trail
description: Löfstad Slott Trail är ett stämningsfullt traillopp som arrangeras i höstmörkret kring det historiska Löfstad slott. Loppet erbjuder en unik löpupplevelse där deltagarna springer genom slottsparken, skogsstigar och obanad terräng upplyst av pannlampor. Evenemanget består av två lopp: Lilla Skymningsloppet för barn i parkmiljö och Löfstads Mörkaste, ett 7 kilometer långt mörkerlopp för vuxna. Löfstad Slott Trail kombinerar natur, historia och gemenskap i en vacker och utmanande miljö.
course_highlights: 7 km mörkerlopp på grusvägar, stigar och obanad skogsterräng
Banan är utmärkt med reflexer och snitslar
Lilla Skymningsloppet 1000 meter i parkmiljö utan tidtagning
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas från 15:00 på slottsgården. Löfstads Mörkaste startar 17:00 och kräver pannlampa och trailskor. Lilla Skymningsloppet är ett barnlopp utan tidtagning och med deltagarpris till alla. Gemensam prisutdelning sker efter loppet. Direktanmälan finns på plats. Parkering finns upp till 500 meter från slottet. Pannlampa är obligatorisk för 7 km-loppet och trailskor rekommenderas. Barnloppet genomförs utan tidtagning. Start och mål är vid Löfstad slott.

name: Ottestad løpsfestival
description: Ottestad Running Festival is organized by Ottestad Idrettslag and consists of three races: HOKA Ottestad Rundt over 17 kilometers, the Spenst Run over 5 kilometers, and the Sport1 Sprint for children, with distances of 400 meters, 1 km, and 1.8 km. The race starts and finishes at Ottestad Idrettspark, which has excellent facilities, including a café, refreshments, changing rooms, and showers. The course follows Ottestadstien, a scenic hiking trail through a cultural landscape of wooded areas and farmland, with beautiful views of Mjøsa. The event is family-friendly and offers both timed and recreational races.
course_highlights: The course follows Ottestadstien through a cultural landscape of wooded areas and farmland
Fantastic views of Mjøsa during the race
Start and finish at Ottestad Idrettspark, with a café and changing-room facilities
additional: The HOKA Sprint is a separate 430-meter segment on the 17 km course where participants can compete to be the fastest on Strava and win HOKA shoes. The segment has its own refreshment station, music, and spectators. A one-time race license is an additional cost for those without an annual license, and athletes up to age 12 are covered by NIF's child sports insurance. The 5 km and 17 km races can be run with or without timing. Listed prices apply to 2026, and a one-time race license is an additional cost where applicable.

name: Norgestesten 2027 3
description: Norgestesten is an efficient and inclusive running event held at Jessheim Athletics Stadium. The race offers distances ranging from an 800-metre children’s race to a half marathon, all with a mass start on a flat, fast 3,146-metre loop course. Many experienced pacers help participants find the right pace, and the event prioritises simple logistics, with parking and the train station nearby. Proceeds support sports for children and young people, and self-service bib collection is available from 09:00 on race day.
course_highlights: Flat 3,146-metre loop course
Mass start for all distances
Many experienced pacers available
additional: The children’s race starts at 09:30 and is approximately 800 metres long. Self-service bib collection is available from 09:00 in the start area. Toilets are available at Jessheim Athletics Stadium and in the ice rink and multi-purpose hall. Tables are provided for runners’ own drinks at the start, along with water and sports drinks along the course. The half-marathon cut-off time is 2 hours and 30 minutes. The race is organised by volunteers, and proceeds support sports for children and young people.

name: KM terrengløp 2027
description: The Molde Cross-Country Championships are held at Retiro and offer runners aged 11 and up a great opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The event includes several distances for children and young people, with a prize ceremony and kiosk available. This traditional local competition brings runners of all ages together for an enjoyable day of running and socialising.
course_highlights: Cross-country running at Retiro in Molde
Several distances for children and young people aged 11 and up
Kiosk with cakes and a prize ceremony
additional: Registration for the championship distances is via eqtiming.no. Children can register for the kids’ race on site up to 15 minutes before the start. All participants in the kids’ race receive a prize. The event includes several start times from 12:00 to 13:00, with different distances.

description: Pärnu Rannajooks on hooaja lõpetav jooksu- ja kepikõnnisündmus, mis toimub Pärnu kaunis rannapiirkonnas. Osalejad saavad valida 5 või 10 kilomeetri distantsi vahel, mis kulgeb mereäärse promenaadi ja linnale iseloomulike arhitektuurimälestiste vahel. Rada pakub kauneid loodusvaateid ning sobib nii jooksjatele kui ka kepikõndijatele. Lisaks on kavas lastejooksud ja virtuaaljooksud, mis võimaldavad osaleda ka kodust.
course_highlights: Rada kulgeb Pärnu rannapiirkonnas mereäärsel promenaadil
Kaunid loodusvaated ja linnale omased arhitektuurimälestised
Distantsivalikus 5 ja 10 kilomeetrit, sobib jooksjatele ja kepikõndijatele
additional: Distantsid on võimalik läbida jooksu või kepikõndimise vormis. Lisaks toimuvad lastejooksud ja virtuaaljooksud. Rada viib osalejad ka rannapromenaadile, pakkudes merevaadet.

name: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“
description: The “Around Lithuania” Run is a traditional running event held in Rumšiškės, on the grounds of the Lithuanian Open-Air Museum. The event offers a range of distances, from a 300 m children’s race to the 21.098 km half marathon, which is the main event and counts toward the Lithuanian Running Cup standings. Participants start according to age-group handicap rules, and the event program includes registration, starts for different distances, and awards. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors and compete with running enthusiasts from all over Lithuania.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 300 m children’s race to a 21.098 km half marathon
Starts follow age-group handicap rules
Location: Lithuanian Open-Air Museum in Rumšiškės
additional: Event program: 09:00 registration and race number distribution, 10:45 competition opening, starts for different distances from 11:00 to 13:00, awards from 14:00. The main distance is 21.098 km, consisting of 4 laps. The age-group handicap system allows less competitive participants to start earlier. The event takes place in Rumšiškės, with online registration available. The program includes starts, awards, and special groups.

name: Volkswaldlauf des MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt
description: The Volkswaldlauf of MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt takes place in Winsen-Borstel. The event offers distances ranging from short children’s races to a challenging 20.3 km course, making it ideal for families as well as runners looking for a longer distance. The start and finish are at the Am Habichtshorst sports facility on Heidlandsweg, which serves as the central meeting point. The race is part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup and promises a varied route through natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.5 km to 20.3 km
Start and finish at the Am Habichtshorst sports facility
Event held as part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup
additional: The event is aimed at families and runners of all ages. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The Am Habichtshorst sports facility is the central meeting point for runners. Distances: 0.5 km to 20.3 km, including children’s races; central meeting point at the Am Habichtshorst sports facility; October weather: approx. 14 °C, 6 °C low, 40 mm precipitation, cloudy.

name: Winterlauf-/Wanderserie TuS Jaderberg 1.Teil
description: Die Winterlauf- und Wanderserie des TuS Jaderberg ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die in der Region Jaderberg stattfindet. Sie bietet Läufern und Wanderern die Möglichkeit, in der kalten Jahreszeit aktiv zu bleiben und gemeinsam Sport zu treiben. Die Serie umfasst mehrere Läufe, die sowohl für Freizeit- als auch für ambitionierte Läufer geeignet sind. Die Veranstaltung ist fest in der Vereinsarbeit des TuS Jaderberg verankert und fördert die Gemeinschaft und den Breitensport.
course_highlights: Lauf- und Wanderstrecken in der naturnahen Umgebung von Jaderberg
Geeignet für alle Alters- und Leistungsklassen
Teil einer mehrteiligen Winterlaufserie
additional: Die Winterlaufserie sucht aktuell Nachfolger für die Organisation. Es gibt keine expliziten Angaben zu Startzeiten, Preisen oder Anmeldemöglichkeiten auf den verfügbaren Seiten.

name: 35. Ricklinger Volkslauf / Ricklinger Volkslauf
location: Meisenwinkel 9, Hannover-Ricklingen, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Ricklingen Volkslauf is a local race day in Hannover-Ricklingen, organized by TuS Ricklingen. It offers flat runs for adults over approximately 5.5 to 5.7 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking over the same distance. The main event is the 10 km Lothar-Mayer-Lauf. There is also a 400 m Bambini run for the youngest participants and a 1 km schoolchildren’s run, allowing families and club runners to take part together while being grouped by age category.
course_highlights: Flat courses in Hannover-Ricklingen
Runs for adults and children, plus walking and Nordic walking
Finish at Meisenwinkel 9 in Hannover-Ricklingen
additional: Running and walking events are organized by distance and age category. All events finish at the same location. The event takes place in Hannover-Ricklingen, with the start and finish at Meisenwinkel 9. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various running options, including walking and children’s races.

name: 44. Zerbster Rolandlauf
description: The 44th Zerbster Roland Run is a traditional fun run in Zerbst, Saxony-Anhalt, with the start and finish at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium. The event takes place on a Sunday in October and is organized by the athletics department of TSV Rot-Weiß Zerbst. Various distances are offered for all age groups, from short children’s races to 10 kilometers for adults. The course consists of a flat 5-kilometer loop on roads and mixed terrain, which also passes through the stadium. Winners receive special 3D medals, and certificates are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km loop on roads and mixed terrain
The course passes through the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Separate categories for children, youth, adults, and seniors. Typical October weather: around 14 °C, mostly cloudy, with about 40 mm of precipitation. The race also supports Anhalt Hospice Zerbst and is organized as a community fun run, with medals and certificates.

name: Gütersloher DJK Halbmarathon
description: Der Gütersloher DJK-Halbmarathon ist eine etablierte Laufveranstaltung in Gütersloh, die neben dem Halbmarathon auch 5- und 10-km-Straßenläufe anbietet. Die Strecken sind offiziell nach IAAF/AIMS vermessen und damit bestenlistentauglich. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Läufer aller Leistungsniveaus und bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit Ehrungen für die schnellsten Teilnehmer in verschiedenen Altersklassen. Die Siegerehrung findet zeitnah nach den Läufen im Zelt statt, und Urkunden können online heruntergeladen werden.
course_highlights: Offiziell vermessene Halbmarathon-Strecke nach IAAF/AIMS
5- und 10-km-Straßenläufe als zusätzliche Wettbewerbe
Bestechend familiäre Atmosphäre mit Ehrungen für die schnellsten Läufer
additional: Parkplätze stehen an der Hauptschule Nord, Ahornallee zur Verfügung. Die Siegerehrungen erfolgen schnellstmöglich nach den Läufen im Zelt. Urkunden können auf der Website des Zeitnehmers www.timeteam-jung.de heruntergeladen werden. Für Unfälle, Diebstähle und sonstige Schadensfälle übernimmt der Veranstalter keine Haftung.

name: VR Bank Westküsten Herbstlauf Schafstedt
description: The VR Bank Westküsten Autumn Run Schafstedt is an autumn running event in Schafstedt, Schleswig-Holstein, taking place for the 38th time in 2026. Distances include 3 km, 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 5 km walking route. The event welcomes adults and younger participants and fosters a family-friendly atmosphere with children’s and youth races. The routes pass through the autumn landscape in the fresh air and offer an alternative to city runs.
course_highlights: The 3 km route is flat
The 5 km run and 5 km walk include some hills
All races finish at the same finish line
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. Typical October weather in Schafstedt is around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event also includes walking options and is aimed at families and young people. October weather is generally mild, with temperatures around 6–14 °C, creating ideal conditions for an autumn run.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: PKO Sopot Half Marathon is an annual running event held in the seaside city of Sopot, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half marathon course runs through the city’s picturesque streets, offering exceptional views and the atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city. The finish line is at ERGO Arena, adding a distinctive character and sporting spirit to the event. It is also an opportunity for families to celebrate sport together, with numerous accompanying races for different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: A seaside course through the streets of Sopot
Finish line at ERGO Arena—a unique place to cross the finish
The atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city, attracting runners and spectators
additional: The event also includes accompanying races such as the Half Marathon Relay, the 5 km Run, and races for children and juniors. The race pack includes a medal and other merchandise. The finish at ERGO Arena provides a unique atmosphere and comfort for participants. The organizer also offers the “Run, Be Ready” training plan for those preparing for the race.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja jesienna 2026
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Nocna Ściema is a unique night road race in Koszalin, offering three distances: 7 km, a half marathon, and a marathon. The course runs through the city streets, with the start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium. The race has official PZLA certification, ensuring accurate course measurement and the possibility of setting records. The event has a one-of-a-kind atmosphere, with a laser start at 2:00 a.m. highlighting its unique nocturnal character. Participants can expect excellent organization, attractive prizes, and keepsakes.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course, confirming accurate measurement
A loop of approximately 7 km, completed multiple times depending on the distance
Start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium in Koszalin
additional: The race starts at 2:00 a.m. with a laser start. The race office for children and young people is located at the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall. The course runs through the streets of Koszalin, with views of exhibits at the aviation museum. After each distance, children receive gifts and prizes directly at the stadium. The course is undulating, and runners can rest at the stadium, which the loop passes through.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
description: The Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Dolnej Doliny Wisły is an annual running event held in Tczew County. The event features two races: a PZLA-certified marathon of 42.195 km and a half marathon of 21.097 km. The routes pass through the scenic Vistula Valley, over a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces, with traffic restricted during the race. The start and finish are located in Tczew, and the event attracts runners from various regions, offering professional organization and clearly marked routes.
course_highlights: A PZLA-certified 42.195 km marathon through Tczew and nearby towns
A 21.097 km half marathon on an asphalt-and-gravel route
The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals; traffic is restricted during the race
additional: The participant limit is 400 paid entrants. The marathon starts at 09:00 at the School Complex of Construction and Clothing in Tczew; the half marathon starts at 11:00 at the Primary School in Małe Walichnowy. The start line closes 15 minutes after the start. The marathon course is PZLA-certified; the half marathon course is not. The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals.

name: 63 Bieg Republiki Ostrowskiej
location: Ostrów Wielkopolski, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: II Jesienny Bieg Charytatywny Artbud Group – Biegniemy dla Rodzin Zastępczych
XIV Pętla Krosowa Grodziskiego Klubu Biegacza
Kullamannen by UTMB
description: Kullamannen by UTMB är ett äventyrslopp längs de steniga stränderna på Kullaberg och Bjärehalvön på Sveriges sydvästkust. Loppen sträcker sig från 22 km till 100 miles och bjuder på utmanande terräng genom klippiga berg, bokskogar och kuststigar. Detta är en tuff och naturskön trailupplevelse som lockar äventyrslystna löpare från hela världen. Loppen är en del av UTMB World Series och erbjuder en unik kombination av tekniska stigar och spektakulära vyer.
course_highlights: Tekniska singelspår på Kullabergsberget
Passage genom 15 naturreservat och två berg (Ultra 100 Miles)
Kustnära stigar och bokskogar längs Bjärehalvön
additional: Start och mål för Ultra 100 Miles och Sprint Ultra är i Höganäs med bib-uthämtning i Båstad. Dropbags tillhandahålls och kan hämtas vid specifika aid stations och efter målgång. Det finns möjlighet att överföra anmälan till kortare distans fram till tre veckor före loppet. Minimiålder varierar per lopp, och för minderåriga krävs föräldrasamtycke för North Shore 20K. Evenemanget inkluderar även ett omfattande schema med aktiviteter under veckan före loppen. Tävlingsutbudet omfattar bland annat 20K, 50K, 100K och 100 miles. För 100-milesloppet sker nummerlappsutdelningen på EXPO i Båstad.

name: Kullamannen 100 miles
description: Kullamannen 100 miles är ett extremt utmanande A+ 100-miles lopp som tar dig genom 15 natursköna naturreservat och två berg i Skåne. Starten går i Höganäs och banan inkluderar tekniska singelspår på Kullaberg, en av Sveriges mest populära naturreservat. Efter 66 kilometer kan löparna fylla på med varm soppa innan de fortsätter norrut mot Ängelholm och Torekov, med målgång i Båstad. Loppet är känt för sin höga DNF-rate på 40-60% och de tuffa väderförhållandena i november med skandinaviska kustvindar och mycket mörker.
course_highlights: Passerar 15 naturreservat och två berg
Tekniska singelspår på Kullaberg Mountain
Start i Höganäs och mål i Båstad med energipåfyllning efter 66 km
additional: Start sker i Höganäs med bussavgång från Båstad. Nummerlappar hämtas personligen i Båstad på Expo. Dropbags tillhandahålls och kan hämtas i Båstad Aid Station och efter målgång. Dropbags måste hämtas inom två timmar efter loppets slut. Ingen delegation vid nummerlappsutdelning. Loppet är en del av UTMB World Series. Nummerlappsutdelningen sker på EXPO i Båstad och kräver personlig hämtning med giltig legitimation och QR-kod. Deltagarna får en officiell UTMB World Series drop bag.

name: Walking Dead Ultra 100 Miles
description: Walking Dead Ultra 100 Miles är ett utmanande ultramaraton som går i Paradiset naturreservat i Huddinge. Loppet erbjuder en unik terrängupplevelse med natursköna vyer och tekniska stigar som testar både uthållighet och mental styrka. Det är en välrenommerad tävling för erfarna ultralöpare som söker en långdistansutmaning i en vacker miljö.
course_highlights: Löpning i Paradiset naturreservat med varierad terräng
Tekniska stigar och natursköna vyer
Utmanande långdistans på 100 miles
additional: Loppet erbjuder även distanserna 100 km och 65 km. Enligt befintlig loppinformation finns drop bags, toalett samt vatten, te, kaffe och buljong vid Torpet Paradiset.

name: Bislett 3000m 2027
description: Bislett 3000m arrangeres på Bislett Stadion i Oslo, en arena kjent for sin friidrettstradisjon og gode løpsforhold. Løpet er en del av Sportsklubben Vidars arrangementer, som tilbyr friidrettsaktiviteter for alle aldre og nivåer. Dette løpet gir en flott mulighet for både erfarne og nye løpere til å konkurrere på en klassisk bane i hjertet av Oslo. Arrangementet fremmer glede og fellesskap blant deltakerne.
course_highlights: Løpet går på den ikoniske Bislett Stadion
Flott bane med gode forhold for mellomdistanseløp
Sentral beliggenhet i Oslo med historisk friidrettsarena

name: Finalloppet Göteborg
description: Finalloppet är Västsveriges största terränglopp med anor från 1968 och arrangeras av Göteborgs Skidklubb. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser från 1,9 km upp till 19 km, alla med varierande terräng och utmanande inslag som avancerade trailavsnitt. Arenan är belägen vid Skatås Motionscentrum i Göteborg, där mål och service samlas. Loppet är välorganiserat med tydlig banmarkering och vätskestationer längs banorna, och det finns klasser för både kvinnor och män i olika åldersgrupper.
course_highlights: 19 km-banan innehåller ett cirka 2500 meter avancerat trailavsnitt
Banorna markeras med orangea pilar och kilometerangivelser i olika färger per distans
Vätskestationer finns på flera platser längs de längre banorna
additional: Anmälan sker via RaceID med betalning direkt vid anmälan. Startgrupper används för att sprida ut löparna efter angiven löptid. Försäkring Startklar kan tecknas vid anmälan. Parvelbanan (ca 250 m) anmäls på plats tävlingsdagen. Efterpatrull finns på alla banor. Läkare och sjukvårdare finns vid målområdet. Vätskestationer, sjukvård och efterpatrull finns längs banorna.

name: Jätten Bule-löpet
description: Jätten Bule-löpet är ett traditionsrikt löplopp som arrangeras av IFK Österbymo och bjuder på en naturskön och trolsk skogsmiljö runt Österbymo. Loppet erbjuder tre distanser: 10 km, 5 km och 2,4 km, där deltagarna springer på stigar och grusvägar med varierande terräng och vackra vyer. Start och mål är vid Bulevallen, och loppet är sanktionerat av Östergötlands Friidrottsförbund med tidtagning via chip. Det finns omklädningsrum, servering och nummerlappsutdelning på plats, vilket skapar en trivsam och välorganiserad tävlingsdag.
course_highlights: 10 km-banan slingrar sig genom trolsk skog på stigar och grusvägar med både upp- och nedförsbackar
5 km-banan är en miniatyr av 10 km-banan med en ny bansträckning från 2024 och är blåmarkerad
2,4 km-banan går på elljusspåret och är något tuffare
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas från kl 09.00 i IFK Österbymos klubbstuga vid startplatsen. Uppvärmning med Bulis sker innan knattestarten ca kl 10.00. Tidtagning sker med chip. Omklädningsrum finns i klubbstugan. Servering med fika och hamburgare finns vid startplatsen, betalning via Swish och kontanter. Start och mål vid Idrottsplatsen, Österbymo. 10 km och 5 km erbjuds både som löpning och gång.

name: Repovesi Trail 2026
description: The event offers three challenging distances: 10 km, 21 km and 42 km, which take you through stunning natural scenery among rugged cliffs and forest landscapes. The routes are clearly marked and offer varied terrain, providing a challenge for both experienced runners and new adventurers. The event centre is at the Lapinsalmi car park, a short distance from the start of the route.
course_highlights: The routes follow established trails in Repovesi National Park
Climbs, rugged cliffs and stunning forest views
The 21 km main route is run twice for the 42 km distance; the 10 km route takes a shortcut from the main route
additional: The event centre is at the Lapinsalmi car park, address Riippusillantie 55, 47900 Vuohijärvi. The event has a limit of 100 participants per distance, 300 in total. The finish closes at 18:00. Parking is available near the event centre. Participants must use their own cup at the drink stations. At the finish, Baba Foods smoothies, Maxim sports drinks, sweets, crisps, bananas and raisins are available. After the race, a buffet meal is served at Restaurant Prinssi, with continuous bus transfers to the car park. The routes are marked and have aid stations. The event is environmentally friendly and offers prizes to participants.

name: Pohjoisbaanan maili 2026
description: The event gives runners the chance to test their pace over one mile (1.609 km). The starting point is on the pedestrian and cycle path near Käpylä station, and the event is open to all running enthusiasts. Helsingin Juoksijat ry is the event organizer, and participation is free for members. Welcome to enjoy a fast-paced, community-oriented running event!
course_highlights: The distance is exactly one mile, or 1.609 km
Start on the pedestrian and cycle path near Käpylä station
The event takes place on Pohjoisbaanalla, in Käpylä, Helsinki
additional: The starting point is marked by a Helsingin Juoksijat flag. The event lasts about an hour, from 11:00 to 12:00. The event starts at 10:00, and no information is available about special features of the course or registration procedures. Helsingin Juoksijat also offers a varied range of running training and community events throughout the year.

name: Komia Ilkan Polku
location: Ilmajoella Kyrkösjärven läheisyydessä, Ilmajoki, South Ostrobothnia, Finland
description: KOMIA Ilkan Polku is a varied and challenging trail-running event held in Ilmajoki near Kyrkösjärvi. The event offers several distances, including a 39 km marathon, a 20 km half marathon, a 10 km sprint, and the children’s Halloween Run. The route follows a variety of trails and village roads, with approximately 300 metres of elevation gain. The event centre is at Luontokeskus Käpälikkö on the shore of Kyrkösjärvi, where runners can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and challenging sections. The event is also family-friendly and encourages participants to dress in a Halloween theme.
course_highlights: Varied trails along the Ilkan Polku nature trail
Approximately 300 metres of total elevation gain
The route also includes approximately 3 km of village roads and gravel roads
additional: The event has mass starts, bag storage, and bag transport from the start to the finish area. The café serves coffee, sweets, sausages, and drinks. First-aid points are located along the route and at the finish. Changing facilities, showers, and toilets are available in the changing rooms at Kyrkösjärvi beach. Littering in nature is prohibited. The children’s Halloween Run is free and encourages participants to dress up in costume. The event includes various categories, the route, timing, prizes, a café, soup, bag storage, toilets at Kyrkösjärvi beach, a recommendation to have insurance, first aid, and the opportunity to test running shoes.

name: Sandflugtsløbet 2026
distance_verbose: Halvmarathon, 15 km, 14 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 2 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Frit valg på alle distancer kun 229,- kr. + betalingsgebyr

description: Sandflugtsløbet er et motionsløb, der afholdes i Sandflugtsplantagen mellem Rørvig og Nykøbing Sjælland. Løbet byder på gode, flade grusstier og en hyggelig atmosfære med over 700 deltagere. Der er fine faciliteter med toiletter, stort telt til omklædning og ophold samt forplejning under og efter løbet, inklusive varm suppe. Alle deltagere får flotte medaljer, og der er også et børneløb på 2 km. Deltagerantallet er begrænset til 750, og der er forskellige starttider for de forskellige distancer.
course_highlights: Gode flade grusstier i Sandflugtsplantagen
Ruten går mellem Rørvig og Nykøbing Sjælland
Flotte medaljer til alle gennemførende
additional: Deltagerantal er max 750. Ved udsolgt er der ingen eftertilmelding på dagen. Der er fine toiletforhold, men ikke bademulighed. Der serveres varm suppe efter løbet. Mulighed for at donere medaljer til genbrug, hvor 25 kr. pr. medalje går til julemærkehjemmene. Der er ikke mulighed for bad. Løbet har et deltagerloft, og der er ingen eftertilmelding på dagen, hvis det er udsolgt.

name: 26. Dresden-Marathon / DRESDEN-MARATHON
description: The DRESDEN-MARATHON has been held regularly at the end of October since 1999 and offers a flat, fast course through the Saxon state capital, passing its famous sights. The route takes runners through the historic old town, including Brühl's Terrace, the Semper Opera House and other Baroque buildings, as well as the lively Neustadt district. More than 300 musicians and numerous bands create a special atmosphere along the course. The second half of the marathon runs through the Blasewitz district, with views of the castles on the Loschwitz Elbe slopes and the villas along Goetheallee, before heading back to the old town along the Elbe.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Dresden's historic old town and Neustadt district
Illuminated Waldschlösschen Tunnel and bridge, and the Großer Garten
Atmosphere created by more than 300 musicians and bands along the course
additional: There is a marathon expo, race packet pickup and a SPARKASSEN pacemaker service. After the race, medal engraving, a photo service, showers, changing rooms and toilets, as well as award ceremonies, are available. The evening before the race, an anniversary party will be held in the marquee behind Heinz-Steyer-Stadion (€25 admission; limited capacity).

name: Halloween-Run-Rotenburg
location: Flugplatz Rotenburg (Wümme), Rotenburg (Wümme), Lower Saxony, Germany
description: Der Halloween-Run-Rotenburg findet am 30. Oktober 2027 auf dem Flugplatz Rotenburg (Wümme) statt und bietet ein einzigartiges Lauferlebnis in schauriger Halloween-Atmosphäre mit Dunkelheit, Lichtern und Nebel. Die Strecke ist in Runden von 2,5 km aufgeteilt und wurde für 2027 so angepasst, dass sie auch bei schwierigen Lichtverhältnissen gut zu laufen ist. Es gibt verschiedene Wettbewerbe für alle Altersklassen, vom Kids Run bis zum 15-km-Evilthon. Nach dem Lauf erwartet die Teilnehmer ein spektakuläres Feuerwerk, das den Abend gebührend abschließt.
course_highlights: Rundenkurs auf dem Flugplatz Rotenburg mit 2,5 km pro Runde
Gruselige Halloween-Dekoration mit Lichtern und Nebel
Überarbeitete Strecke für bessere Laufbarkeit bei Dunkelheit
additional: Start- und Zielbereich auf dem Flugplatz Rotenburg Wümme zwischen THW und Tower. Startunterlagenausgabe am Veranstaltungstag ab 15:00 Uhr im Schulungsraum Transall (Hinter dem Restaurant HeyLü). Kostümwettbewerb mit Anmeldung möglich, Fotos für Abstimmung ab 17:00 Uhr am Startbereich. Nach dem Lauf spektakuläres Feuerwerk um 20:15 Uhr. Teilnehmer werden gebeten, Stirnlampen oder Laufbeleuchtung mitzubringen wegen Dunkelheit und Nebel. Versand der Startunterlagen gegen Gebühr von 7,50 € möglich, Anmeldung mit Versand bis 3. Oktober 2027. Geplant sind ein Kids Run über 1.000 m, 2,5 km, 5 km, 10 km und 15 km. Der 5- und 10-km-Lauf kann auch gewalkt werden. Ein Kostümwettbewerb und ein Feuerwerk zum Abschluss sind angekündigt.

name: 34. Mündener Altstadtlauf
description: Der 34. Mündener Altstadtlauf findet am 31. Oktober 2027 statt und bietet Läufern aller Altersgruppen attraktive Strecken in der historischen Altstadt von Hann. Münden. Die Veranstaltung umfasst eine 500-m-Bambini-Strecke, einen 1000-m-Schülerlauf sowie 5-km- und 10-km-Läufe für Hobby- und Wettkampfsportler. Die 5-km-Strecke beinhaltet eine Gruppenwertung, während die 10-km-Strecke eine Mannschaftswertung mit mindestens einer Frau pro Team bietet. Die Strecke wird vom Niedersächsischen Leichtathletikverband vermessen und gilt somit als bestzeitfähig. Das Organisationsteam legt großen Wert auf eine professionelle Durchführung und die Sicherheit der Läufer.
course_highlights: Historische Altstadt von Hann. Münden als Laufkulisse
Bestzeitfähige Strecke durch Vermessung des Leichtathletikverbands
Vielfältige Streckenlängen von 500 m bis 10 km mit Einzel- und Mannschaftswertungen
additional: Die Veranstaltung wird von einem engagierten Team organisiert, unterstützt von Feuerwehr, Polizei, Stadtverwaltung und lokalen Unternehmen. Es gibt eine Bambini-Strecke für die Jüngsten und Wertungen für Gruppen und Mannschaften. Rund 40 Helfer sichern die Strecke und sorgen für einen reibungslosen Ablauf.

name: 6. Halloween Run
description: Der Halloween-Run Bremen 2027 findet am 31. Oktober statt und bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern ein schauriges Lauferlebnis in Kostümen rund um den Werdersee. Mit fünf verschiedenen Streckenlängen von 1 km bis zum Marathon ist für jede Leistungsstufe etwas dabei. Die Strecken sind nach den Regeln des Deutschen Leichtathletik-Verbandes vermessen und bestenlistentauglich, was den Wettkampfcharakter unterstreicht. Neben dem Lauf gibt es einen Kostümwettbewerb und eine Siegerehrung mit anschließendem spektakulärem Feuerwerk als Highlight des Events.
course_highlights: 8,333 km langer Rundkurs am Werdersee, DLV-vermessen und bestenlistentauglich
Strecken von 1 km bis Marathon (42,195 km) mit gruseligen Extras
Start- und Zielbereich zwischen Finnbahn und Grillwiese nahe DLRG-Rettungswache
additional: Startunterlagenausgabe am 31. Oktober von 11:00 bis 14:30 Uhr in der Sporthalle am LidiceHaus. Kostümwettbewerb mit Foto-Abstimmung vor dem Start ab 12:45 Uhr. Staffelläufe möglich, Staffelstab ist die Startnummer mit RFID-Chip, Startnummernband muss selbst mitgebracht werden. Nach dem Lauf spektakuläres Feuerwerk ab 18:00 Uhr. Anmeldung bis 31. Oktober 2027 um 12:30 Uhr oder bis Teilnehmerlimit erreicht ist.

name: Bredstedt-Cross

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgelder liegen je nach Kategorie zwischen 2,50 Euro und 3,50 Euro

description: Der Bredstedt-Cross ist ein traditionsreicher Crosslauf, der am 30. Oktober 2027 in Bredstedt stattfindet. Veranstaltet vom Bredstedter TSV, bietet das Event Wettkämpfe für zahlreiche Altersklassen von Kindern bis Senioren. Die Läufe finden auf dem Gelände der Gemeinschaftsschule Bredstedt, in der Harald-Nommensen-Halle und im Außengelände statt und sind Teil des KLVNF Cross-Cup. Die Strecken bestehen aus kleinen und großen Runden mit einer Mindestlänge von 5 km. Für alle Teilnehmenden gibt es Urkunden und eine Siegerehrung im Außenbereich.
course_highlights: Wettkämpfe auf dem Gelände der Gemeinschaftsschule Bredstedt und im Außengelände
Teil des KLVNF Cross-Cup mit kurzen und langen Crossläufen
Streckenlänge mindestens 5 km mit kleinen und großen Runden
additional: Umkleideräume und Duschen in der Harald-Nommensen-Halle sind verfügbar. Ausreichend Parkplätze vor der Halle vorhanden. Ergebnisse und personenbezogene Daten werden erfasst und veröffentlicht. Es gibt eine Siegerehrung im Außenbereich unter Einhaltung von Abstand.

name: Kreismeisterschaft und 3. Halloween-Crosslauf im Örtzetal zu Munster
location: Sportpark Osterberg, Munster, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The County Cross-Country Championships and 3rd Örtzetal Halloween Cross-Country Run in Munster is a cross-country event held at Sportpark Osterberg in Munster. The event combines the county cross-country championships with the third Halloween cross-country run and is open to children, youth, open classes and masters. Distances range from 500 metres to 10 kilometres, creating a local, club-focused atmosphere rather than the feel of a large city race. The race takes place in the autumnal Örtzetal region and is a popular seasonal event organised by Eintracht Munster.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in the Örtzetal on varied terrain
Distances from 500 m to 10 km for different age and ability groups
Event at Sportpark Osterberg, Munster
additional: The event was postponed due to bad weather and incorporates the county championships into the Halloween cross-country run. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event is held in a cross-country format, has a local character, and is open to children, youth, adults and masters. It takes place on Halloween, with weather-dependent adjustments.

name: Nordhessische Crosslaufmeisterschaften
description: The North Hesse Cross-Country Championships are a regional club and regional cross-country championship held in various locations across North Hesse. The event is aimed primarily at club runners from the region competing for regional and district titles. Course distances range from short youth races of 1.2 km to longer senior races of 8 km. The races take place on cross-country terrain, not on closed roads, and are organized by various athletics districts and clubs.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain rather than a road race
Distances from 1.2 km to 8 km
Held at sports facilities in various locations across North Hesse
additional: The event is geared strongly toward club runners. Depending on the course, runners are advised to choose suitable shoes carefully, such as spikes. Results are published as web and PDF listings. Typical October weather is cool and mostly cloudy, with a daytime high of about 14°C and a low of 6°C. October weather: about 14°C, low of 6°C, 40 mm of precipitation, cloudy; races take place at sports facilities in the region, online registration is possible, and results are published as web and PDF listings.

name: Botaniczna Piątka – Bydgoszcz, edycja jesienna
location: Botanical Garden of the Kazimierz Wielki University, Bydgoszcz, Poland

name: Höstmilen
location: Sörsjön, Kolmårdsskogarna, Åby, Norrköping Municipality, Sverige
description: Höstmilen är ett terränglöpningslopp som går på stigarna mellan Sörsjön och Lillsjön utanför Åby, norr om Norrköping. Loppet erbjuder en utmanande bana i naturskön terräng och en trevlig upplevelse för alla deltagare. Du kan välja mellan en lång bana på 10,6 km, en kortare på 5,2 km samt banor för barn och ungdomar. De kortare banorna startar och slutar vid Lillsjön. Arrangör är OK Kolmården, en skid- och orienteringsklubb för alla nivåer och åldrar.
course_highlights: Terränglöpning på stigar mellan Sörsjön och Lillsjön
Naturskön terräng i Kolmårdsskogarna
Utmanande bana med både 10,6 km och 5,2 km distanser
additional: Anmälan stänger 29 oktober kl 23.00. Efter det kan man anmäla sig den 31 oktober kl 11-14 på XXL samt på startplatsen den 1 november. Det finns även barn- och ungdomsklasser. Tävlingsledare är Johan Malm. Parkering och transportinformation finns på hemsidan. Sjukdom med milda symtom innebär att man ska stanna hemma. Loppet har arrangerats sedan 1971.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a race focused on fast times, held at Ås school in Eidsvoll. The race takes place on a flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop, where participants can set out their own bottles and gels on their personal nutrition table. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. Race bibs are collected on a self-service basis at the school, and the venue has good facilities, including changing rooms, toilets and free parking. The race has a friendly atmosphere, where personal records are celebrated with the ringing of a bell near the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop
Participants’ own nutrition tables along the course
Good facilities at the venue, including changing rooms, toilets and free parking
additional: Race bibs are collected on a self-service basis about two hours before the start. The race uses a lap-time calculator to plan split times. At selected races, 9th grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times a day based on satellite data for the area around Ås school. Public transport by train and bus is available to the venue, with real-time departures provided. Race bibs can be collected on a self-service basis at the school from about two hours before the start. Registration is through RaceDays.

name: HA Ottestad løpsfestival 2027
description: HA Ottestad Running Festival is an annual event held at Ottestad Idrettspark, with the start and finish in the same place. The festival consists of three races: HOKA Ottestad Rundt (17 km), the Spenst Run (5 km), and the Sport1 Sprint for children, with distances of 400 metres, 1 km and 1.8 km. The route follows Ottestadstien, a scenic trail winding through the cultural landscape of woodland and farmland, with beautiful views over Lake Mjøsa. The event offers good facilities, including a café, food and refreshments, changing rooms and showers in the clubhouse.
course_highlights: The route follows Ottestadstien through a cultural landscape of woodland and farmland
Fantastic views over Lake Mjøsa
Start and finish at Ottestad Idrettspark, with good facilities
additional: HOKA Sprint is a separate 430-metre segment on the 17 km course, where participants can compete to be the fastest on Strava and win HOKA shoes. There is music, spectators and a dedicated drinks station at the sprint segment. A one-day licence is an additional cost for those without an annual licence. Athletes up to age 12 are covered by NIF's children's sports insurance. The 17 km and 5 km races can be run with or without timing. The start and finish are at Ottestad Idrettspark, which has a café, food and refreshments, and changing rooms with showers.

name: REINPAULI XXIV MAASTIKUJOOKS
location: Ebavere, Väike-Maarja Parish, Lääne-Viru County, Estonia

name: Birkhahnlauf
location: Schneeren, Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Birkhahnlauf in Schneeren is a traditional race that has been held annually on the last Sunday in October for over 50 years. The event offers distances for all age groups, from short children’s races starting at 500 meters to challenging 5 km and 10 km races for adults. The courses run through the pine forest on paved forest paths with a slightly sandy surface and no significant elevation profile, making the race a special experience amid nature. New this year is a 2.3 km course for the U12 age group and up. The friendly atmosphere and prompt award ceremonies with certificates and medals round off the event.
course_highlights: Courses through the pine forest on paved forest paths
Distances from 500 m to 10.2 km for all age groups
Kilometer markers on the 5.1 km and 10.2 km courses, which have no significant elevation profile
additional: Start times: children’s 500 m race at 10:30, 1,000 m at 10:45, 2.3 km at 11:10, and 5.1 km and 10.2 km at 11:40. Award ceremonies take place promptly after the respective races. Parking is available nearby and is signposted.

name: Halloween-Run-Bremen
description: The Halloween Run Bremen 2026 takes place on October 31 and offers runners a spooky race experience around Werdersee. With five different distances, from 1 km to the 42.195 km marathon, there is something for every ability level. The courses are measured in accordance with German Athletics Association rules and are eligible for record lists, underscoring the competitive nature of the event. Alongside the sporting event, participants can look forward to a spooky atmosphere with costumes, lights and fog, as well as an awards ceremony and a closing fireworks display.
course_highlights: 8.333 km loop course, measured by the German Athletics Association and eligible for record lists
Distances from 1 km (Spuklauf) to the marathon (Splatterthon), with a spooky atmosphere
Start and finish area at Werdersee, between the Finnbahn and the barbecue area
additional: The awards ceremony for the Spuklauf takes place immediately after the finish; awards for the other distances are presented later. A spectacular fireworks display at 18:00 rounds off the event. There are also relay competitions for the marathon (5-person relay). The race bib with RFID chip serves as the relay baton and must be brought by the team. Costumes are expressly encouraged but are not compulsory. Participants can register online. There are various distances and relay options; the event takes place at night and offers a spooky atmosphere.

name: 19. Bothfelder Waldlauf
description: Der Bothfelder Waldlauf ist ein vom Deutschen Leichtathletik-Verband genehmigter Volkslauf, der vom TuS Bothfeld 04 in Hannover veranstaltet wird. Die Läufe starten und enden auf dem Bezirkssportplatz Bothfeld und führen durch den schönen Bothfelder Wald auf einem Rundkurs über Waldwege und gut ausgebaute Forststraßen. Der Lauf ist Teil des Laufpasses der Region Hannover und bietet Umkleide- und Duschmöglichkeiten am Ziel. Für das leibliche Wohl ist mit günstigen Speisen und Getränken sowie kostenlosem warmen Tee für alle Teilnehmer gesorgt.
course_highlights: Rundkurs durch den Bothfelder Wald
Lauf auf Waldwegen und gut ausgebauten Forststraßen
Start und Ziel auf dem Bezirkssportplatz Bothfeld
additional: Spontane Nachmeldungen sind bis 60 Minuten vor dem jeweiligen Laufstart online möglich, sofern noch Startplätze frei sind, mit einer Nachmeldegebühr von 2 Euro zusätzlich zum Startgeld. Die Siegerehrungen der Kinderläufe finden etwa 60 Minuten nach den Läufen im Zielbereich statt, die der längeren Strecken unmittelbar nach Zieleinlauf. Ein Urkundenausdruck vor Ort ist für alle Läufer möglich. Der 5 km Walking startet zeitgleich mit dem 10 km Hauptlauf. Gute Erreichbarkeit mit Stadtbahn Linie 13 und Parkmöglichkeiten in der Nähe sind gegeben.

name: 28. Tangerpokallauf
description: Der 28. Tangerpokallauf in Demker ist die älteste Laufveranstaltung des SC Demker '95 und bildet den Saisonabschluss des Elbe-Ohre-Cups. Die Strecke führt durch die herbstliche Tangerniederung zwischen Demker und Weißewarte, vorbei am Deutschen Eck, unterquert die Bahnlinie Stendal-Magdeburg und verläuft durch das Waldgebiet des Süpplings. Angeboten werden Strecken von 1,2 km für Kinder und Jugendliche sowie 5,4 km und 12,0 km für ältere Jugendliche und Erwachsene. Das Terrain ist durchweg flach mit den Deichen als einzigen Erhebungen, die den Ort Demker seit dem Hochwasser 2013 schützen.
course_highlights: Flache Strecke durch die herbstliche Tangerniederung
Verlauf entlang des Tangers und vorbei am Deutschen Eck
Durchquerung des Waldgebiets Süpplings
additional: Die Strecke ist durchweg flach mit Deichen als einzige Erhebungen. Es gibt drei Streckenlängen: 1,2 km für Kinder und Jugendliche, 5,4 km und 12,0 km für ältere Jugendliche und Erwachsene. Die Strecke führt unter anderem unter der Bahnlinie Stendal-Magdeburg hindurch.

name: LG Alsternord Herbstwaldlauf 2026
description: The LG Alsternord Autumn Forest Run is a local autumn race through the forest in Norderstedt, north of Hamburg. Organized by LG Alsternord Hamburg e.V., the race starts at 11:00 a.m. at the Rantzauer Forst-Thingplatz. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes, including a cross-country option. The race takes place away from city streets in the Rantzauer Forst area and also offers walking and hiking events. With a modest field of usually 101 to 300 runners, the event has more of a club-run feel than that of a major race.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal Rantzauer Forst, away from city streets
5 km, 10 km and cross-country options
Modest field with a club-run atmosphere
additional: Results are published via race result; public start lists, photos, reports and historical rankings are available. In addition to the races, there are walking and hiking events, including a 5 km walk. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with rainy days. The event takes place in typical November weather, around 7°C and with rainy conditions. It is open to runners and walkers of all ages, with a modest participant count of between 101 and 300.

name: Tiergarten-Cross
description: The Tiergarten Cross in Schleswig is a local cross-country race. The event offers two main distances, 4.4 km and 8.8 km, which start one after the other so the fields are separated. The course is undulating and challenging, with constant changes of rhythm that make the race varied. Alongside the main races, there are also children’s and youth races, making the event family-friendly and varied.
course_highlights: Finishes in Tiergarten Schleswig, the course’s most distinctive point
Undulating course with constant small changes of rhythm
Separate start times for the 4.4 km and 8.8 km distances
additional: Typical November weather in Schleswig is cool, with daytime highs of around 7 °C, and rainy on most days. The event takes place in Tiergarten Schleswig, is weather-dependent (November is usually rainy), and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various race categories.

name: Ledlenser Nightrun Trondheim
description: Ledlenser Nightrun Trondheim is a night race that starts and finishes at Baklidammen. The course offers a varied route with gravel paths, forest trails and forest floor. The first two kilometres descend towards Theisendammen and the dam, followed by a steady climb of approximately 1.5 kilometres before descending towards the finish over the final kilometre. There are separate men’s and women’s categories in several age groups, and all participants receive a medal. Headlamps from Ledlenser are also available to borrow to light the way during the race.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Baklidammen
Varied terrain with gravel paths, forest trails and forest floor
The course includes a steady climb of approximately 1.5 km before descending to the finish
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Löplabbet Trondheim, Nordre Gate 11, from Thursday 28 October to Saturday 30 October, 10:00–18:00, and on race day from 17:00 at the start area. Self-service baggage storage is available in the start area; use the baggage tag attached to your race bib. Ledlenser offers a limited number of headlamps for testing and borrowing during the race on a first-come, first-served basis. There are separate men’s and women’s categories for ages under 25, 25–39, 40–54 and over 55. Prizes are awarded to the three fastest men and women overall, and all participants can enter the draw for spot prizes.

name: Landehof 4-Årstider Höstloppet 2026
description: Landehof 4-Årstider Höstloppet är en höstorienteringstävling som arrangeras av OK Landehof. Loppet bjuder på utmanande terräng med mörker, regn, rusk och hala rötter, vilket ger en äkta höstkänsla i skogen. Det är en traditionell tävling som lockar orienterare att testa sina färdigheter i svåra förhållanden. Deltagarna kan njuta av en spännande och naturnära upplevelse i Landehofsområdet under hösten.
course_highlights: Utmanande höstterräng med hala rötter
Löpning i mörker och ruskigt väder
Naturnära orientering i Landehofsområdet
additional: Startlista publiceras från fredag 30 oktober och uppdateras fram till sista anmälningsdag. Liveresultat och resultatlista finns tillgängliga. QR-koder finns för att enkelt dela inbjudan och anmälan med arbets- eller träningskompisar.

description: Frikarusellen is a traditional race series organised by IL Fri at Espeland sports ground in Arna. The course is 5 km long, officially measured for the first time in 2000 and again in 2018. It runs from north of the Londalskrysset junction to Gamle Haukeland station and back along the same route, finishing inside the sports ground. The series comprises several races throughout the season and is suitable for both young people and adults. Registration is available via EQ Timing, and race numbers are collected on race day.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course starting north of the Londalskrysset junction
Passes Gamle Haukeland station
Finishes inside Espeland sports ground
additional: Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. Race numbers are assigned when registering online and can be collected at Espelandshallen between 18:00 and 18:55. A licence fee applies in addition for participants over 13 without an annual licence. A fee of 50 kr applies if participants who have registered for all the races forget their race number. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no.

description: Frikarusellen is a traditional race series organized by IL Fri, starting and finishing at Espeland sports ground in Arna. The course is 5 km long, first officially measured in 2000 and remeasured in 2018. It runs from north of the Londalskrysset junction to Gamle Haukeland station and back along the same route. The series consists of several races throughout winter and spring and is suitable for both young people and adults. IL Fri offers a welcoming atmosphere and committed members, and the races are open to members and non-members alike.
course_highlights: 5 km officially measured course starting and finishing at Espeland sports ground
The route passes Gamle Haukeland station and returns along the same way
Races are held in Arna, Bergen, on several dates throughout the season
additional: Bib numbers can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A licence fee is added for participants over 13 without an annual licence. There is a 50 kr fee for forgetting your bib if you have registered for all the races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no.

name: MartinCrossen Trail Run
description: MartinCrossen Trail Run is a cross-country race starting and finishing at Voksenjordet in Oslo, inspired by the Martincrossen ski race and Martin Johnsrud Sundby. The race offers a unique course with challenging technical terrain, especially on the longest distance, which ends with a tough finish. The event takes place in the evening in November, and the darkness and use of headlamps on the 3 km and 8 km distances make for a special experience. The race is inclusive, with categories for children, young people, para-athletes, recreational runners and competitive runners. There will also be a show with pyrotechnics, flames, lights and music in the spirit of Martincrossen.
course_highlights: Trail running on challenging technical terrain
Start and finish at Voksenjordet
Evening race with headlamps required on the 3 km and 8 km distances
additional: The children’s race for ages 3–5 and the 500-metre para category are free and require no registration. Companions for para participants are free; contact mari@roail.no. Medals for all participants. A limited number of race bibs will be available for late registration, which opens on 2 November at 12:00.
