name: 55. Pirkan Hölkkä 5.10.2025
description:
A jewel of the running season, the icing on the cake: this long-distance running event, held mainly on trails, takes place every year on the first Sunday in October.

The 33-kilometre route from Valkeakoski to Tampere runs along a varied mix of fitness trails, forest roads and trails. Around five kilometres of the route are on asphalt. In addition to the running categories, you can take part in a walking category, which is not timed. The event is organised jointly by Tampereen Taivaltajat ry and Valkeakosken Retkeilijät ry.

Pirkan Hölkkä dates back to 1970. The route has largely remained as it is today. In recent years, the average number of participants has been around 1,000–1,500.
additional:
You can choose from the age categories Women’s Open, N40, N50, Men’s Open, M40, M50 and M60. The start is at the Sahara sports field in Valkeakoski (Tallikatu 11), where the starting gun will sound at 9:30 on Sunday morning. Late registration at the start is available from 8:00 to 9:00.

The event uses gun time, measured from the starting gun until you cross the finish line. At the start, you can choose a position near the start line according to your target time.

The first 3 km of the race are on streets. For the next 3 km, the route follows the fitness trail in the recreational area as far as Leppäjärventie. After that, the route to Rutajärvi (11 km from the start) consists of varied forest trails and a short section of gravel road. The 3.5 km stretch between Rutajärvi and Vähä-Kausjärvi is on forest roads. Of the 5 km between Vähä-Kausjärvi and Taivalpirtti, the first part is on forest roads, followed by forest trails; after crossing Savontie, the route returns to gravel roads.
From Taivalpirtti onward, the route alternates between gravel roads and forest trails until it reaches the recreational trail around Suolijärvi. The final 3 km follow a gravel-surfaced recreational trail between Hervanta and Koivistonkylä. This section still has a few climbs that will test Finnish grit.

The Pirkan Hölkkä route is marked with blue flagging tape, directional arrows and kilometre signs. The organisers have aimed to include as many forest trails as possible. There are six refreshment stations along the route.

The finish is in Nirva, Tampere, in the grounds of Tampere Adult Education Centre (Kurssikeskuksenkatu 11). Paid bus transport to the start is available from the finish area and Tampere city centre, both in the morning before the start and in the afternoon after you finish. You can include transport and the soup lunch sold at the finish area in your entry fee by selecting these add-ons in our online store.

name: Pirkan Kieppi 5.10.2025
description:
The jewel of the running season and the icing on the cake, Pirkan Hölkkä is a long-distance running event held mostly on trails. It takes place every year on the first Sunday in October. Together with TU38, we are organizing the much-requested shorter distance, the 14 km Pirkan Kieppi.

Pirkan Kieppi starts at the Pirkan Hölkkä finish area, in the courtyard of TAKK’s Nirva campus, at 11:30. On-site late registration is open from 10:00 to 11:00.
additional:
The route continues via Lahdesjärvi to Vuores, where it winds through the beautiful scenery of this neighbourhood. It then joins the traditional Pirkan Hölkkä route at the Vormisto aid station, from where runners continue to the finish together with the full-distance participants.

Pirkan Kieppi has two open categories, women (N) and men (M). Timing is based on gun time, from the starting gun to crossing the finish line. At the start, you can choose a spot near the start line according to your target time.

name: NUTS HEL
description: NUTS HEL is an urban trail running event in Helsinki's Central Park, with three different distances: 6 km, 14 km and 25 km. The event is suitable for both first-timers and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Eläintarha Sports Field, and the longest route takes runners along the trails of the Haltiala Forest Nature Reserve. On Friday evening, NUTS Kids & Juniors is also held for the family's youngest trail runners!

The 43 km race starts at 9:00 and consists of two loops. The 21 km starts at 11:00 and the 7 km at 10:30. The finish closes at 16:00. Slower runners may start the 43 km at 8:00, but must notify the race office.

description: Hercules Trail Run is a trail running event held in Mustijoki, Porvoo, on October 11, 2025. The event offers races on routes of different lengths, including 2 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km, so there is something for runners of all fitness levels. The trail rally is designed especially for younger participants, and adults can safely run alongside the children.

description: Nummela Backyard Ultra is an ultrarunning race held on Nummelanharju. The race ends when only one runner remains. The race is run on the orange daytime course, which is 6.7 km long, and the blue night loop, which consists of two 3.35 km laps.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run is a running event held since 1985 that attracts runners of different age groups. Held once a month, the event draws 100–200 participants, and its scenic route winds through the landscapes along the Loimijoki River. Runners can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km route, which runs near Forssa city centre through the park of the old cotton mill. The event awards the best runners, and the most active participants in particular receive an annual medal.

name: Kotojärven Ympärijuoksu
description: Kotojärven Ympärijuoksu is a traditional running event held at Mika Waltari School in Pornainen. The event gives participants the chance to challenge themselves in beautiful natural surroundings, and the route is designed to offer a suitable challenge. Last year, 73 people took part, and more than 100 runners are expected this year across the different categories, which include distances of 14.3 km, 6.8 km, and 2.2 km.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat kilpailevat Kotojärven Ympärijuoksussa.

name: Puuluoto Backyard
description: Puuluoto Backyard 2025 will take place on Saturday, 18 October 2025, from 9:00 to 21:00 on a peaceful forest trail on a crisp October day when the temperature is one or two degrees below zero. Are you ready to challenge yourself? Welcome to our backyard-style running event! The 6.7-kilometre loop is run once every hour, and you can take part in either the six-loop race (6 hours) or try to complete the full 12-loop distance (12 hours). We promise runners fun activities together, some easy kilometres and some a little more challenging, plus the trail-running community’s endless encouragement.

name: Hiidenkierros
distance_verbose: 13.2 km, 10.5 km, 10 km, 5.2 km, 5 km, 3000 metriä
description: The Hiidenkierros trail running event will take place next autumn on Saturday, 18 October. The event offers several distances, including 3–5 km routes suitable for families and schoolchildren, as well as the more challenging Kitulankierros (10.5 km). The Hiidenkierros loop route winds through the magnificent scenery of Hiidenportti National Park, with dramatic gorge valleys and beautiful lake views along the way. The route is challenging, but also offers places to take a break, making it an excellent destination for a day trip.

name: Solvalla Trail
description: Solvalla Trail is a trail running event where the SAUL Finnish Championships are being held for the first time. All age groups compete on the 10-kilometre course, with a choice of 10 or 20 kilometres; participants in the longer race complete the loop twice. The route winds through varied terrain, mostly along narrow trails, and features impressive rocky cliffs, stunning coastal scenery and beautiful forests. The highlight of the course is an almost 75-metre climb to the top of Swinghill.

name: Kaarinan Syysmaraton
description: Kaarina Autumn Marathon is a running event offering several distances for different age groups, including marathon, half marathon, and 10 km races, open to both men and women. The races take place on an approximately 10.5-kilometre loop through beautiful, flat terrain in Kaarina and Piikkiö. A children’s run is also held, with the youngest children running an approximately 150-metre loop and older children an approximately 500-metre loop. All participants receive a medal, and the children’s run is free with no advance registration required.

name: Viikin Viitonen
description: Viikin Viitonen is an event open to everyone, held several times a year. This year, the event will be run on July 1, bringing runners together in the atmosphere of a summer evening. The event has set a new record with 106 participants, and the current maximum number of participants is 150. Advance registration and the entry fee cost 10 euros (incl. 10% VAT).

name: Kankaanpää Maraton
description: Kankaanpää Marathon is a versatile running event offering races over various distances, including the marathon, half marathon, and shorter distances. The event takes place in Kankaanpää and is known for its beautiful scenery and well-maintained courses. Participants can enjoy running surrounded by nature, and the event attracts both recreational and competitive runners. To celebrate its 20th anniversary, the event returns to Niinisalo School, Kievarinkatu 3.

name: Pukinmaki Run 1/2 Maraton 10k 5k
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki. The officially measured distances are 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The route follows the borders of Pukinmäki and is a flat road course, with approximately 85% asphalt, 10% compacted crushed stone and 5% running track. The course is fast to run, with an elevation difference of just 4.9 metres.

description: Halloween Hike 2024 gives children the chance to enjoy Halloween without scary elements. The event takes place at Memphis Boo-tanic Garden and offers a safe alternative to traditional door-to-door trick-or-treating. Participants can enjoy craft activities, not-so-scary characters, and treats. Costumes are encouraged, and this year the garden has introduced timed entry, so it’s a good idea to buy tickets in advance.

name: Helsinki Halloween Run
description: Helsinki Halloween Run 2025 takes place on 25.10.2025 in Kalasatama, Helsinki! The event also includes a race for children, Kids Run Helsinki Halloween, with distances of approximately 450 m (for children under 7) and 900 m (for older children). Schedule: 16.00 Race office opens, 17.45 Kids Run 450 m, 18.00 Kids Run 900 m, and 18.30 start of the 5 km and 10 km races. Prizes will be awarded for the best costumes during the event, and a photo wall will be available for capturing the costumes.

name: Mustavuori Vertical
description: Mustavuori Vertical takes over the Mustavuori Ski Resort in Tampere on 28 October 2023! Participants climb the slope by walking, Nordic walking, jogging, bounding or even running. What makes the event special is that each ascent starts together at the bottom. The race is designed to be a challenging, communal experience, where the winner is the one who lasts the longest.

name: Lepokallion lenkki
description: Lepokallio Trail is a 5.8-kilometer hiking route in the varied forest landscapes of Hanhikoski, Ylistaro. It was renovated and is maintained by the Hanhikoski Rural and Home Economics Women's Association. There are two lean-to shelters along the route, Lepokallio Shelter and Pururata Shelter, both with a fire pit and firewood. The route is accessible year-round and offers an easy outing through varied terrain, including bright pine forests and atmospheric spruce forests.

name: Tuusula Trailrun
description: Tuusula Trailrun 2024 trail race will be held on Sunday, 27 October 2024 at 11:00 at the biathlon stadium of Tuusula Sports Centre. The route runs along the trails of Tuusula’s Korpikylä and Sammaloja, offering varied terrain and wide, runnable trails. Trail running shoes or studded shoes are the most suitable, but the route can also be run safely in regular running shoes. There are water stations on the course at the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km marks, and the route is marked with ribbons, signs and chalk.

description: At the Vantaa Endurance Series, you can challenge yourself in five different events. The series is suitable for fitness enthusiasts and endurance athletes of all levels, and offers a great opportunity to try completely new sports. The Vantaa Endurance Series consists of Vantaa Ski Race, Vantaa Off-trail Challenge orienteering, Vantaa Triathlon, Seutula Loop and Vantaa Marathon. The events are standalone competitions, but together they make up the Vantaa Endurance Series.

The route is officially measured, and the competition has 5 km and 10 km categories for men and women. The best Halloween costume will be awarded a prize!

name: Riston Hölkkä
description: Risto’s Run is held in Suomusjärvi, Salo, every year on the Sunday after All Saints’ Day. The event is named after Risto Nuuroks, a four-time World Championship medalist in orienteering who won silver in the individual event in 1978. Competitive and recreational categories are available for runners of all abilities, and the routes pass through rural landscapes, mostly on gravel roads. Risto’s Run will next be held on 2 November 2025, with the race headquarters at Sisumaja.

The event is a perfect opportunity for both beginners and experienced runners seeking a challenge and beautiful scenery. All participants receive a commemorative medal.

description: Tampere Marathon 2025 will be run on Sunday, August 31. You can choose to run the marathon, half marathon, quarter marathon (10.5 km), or take part in the marathon relay, run in teams of four. Children have their own Mini Marathon event at Tampere Stadium. The course has changed compared with previous years due to construction work in the city, and runs mainly on asphalt and partly on gravel paths.

description: The Fiskars Marathon in Raseborg 2026 is an exciting running event that gives participants the opportunity to experience magnificent scenery and a sense of community. The event attracts runners of all levels and is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness and enjoy running. The marathon is designed to offer unforgettable moments for both competitors and spectators.

The official time limit is six (6) hours for the full marathon and 5.5 hours for the half marathon and quarter marathon. The course is officially measured, and the start and finish area are at Keskuskoulu, Halmstadinkatu 2. Advance registration closes on Tuesday, September 30, 2025, at 24:00.

The event is held on Saturday, October 4 at 11:00, with 6 km and 10 km routes. The start and finish are at Hotel Keurusselkä, and a prize containing local products will be raffled among runners in both distances. The entry fee is €15, which includes use of the hotel spa after the run.

name: Pirkan Hölkkä & Kieppi
description: The autumn season’s fitness highlight, Pirkan Hölkkä, will be run on Sunday, 5 October 2025, for the 55th time. Pirkan Kieppi, a 14 km event, is held alongside Pirkan Hölkkä. It starts at 11:30 from the Pirkan Hölkkä finish area, in the yard of TAKK’s Nirva campus. The approximately 14 km Pirkan Kieppi through the beautiful autumn scenery of Vuores and Hervanta is suitable for anyone with a good basic level of fitness. There is no rush at the event, and participants can enjoy being outdoors and the refreshments provided at the aid stations.

description: Come celebrate the 60th anniversary run of the Pargas Run with us on Sunday, October 6, 2024. The race follows the traditional 10.35 km course, starting and finishing at Pajbacka Sports Field, which also has changing rooms and showers. To mark the occasion, all participants will receive a gold commemorative medal and a unique Pargas Run T-shirt. After the finish, coffee, juice, and layer cake will be served to all participants.

The route winds through beautiful scenery along gravel roads, giving runners the chance to enjoy nature and peaceful trails.

The event gives runners the chance to experience beautiful scenery and the calming effects of nature in the dark, on a reflective-marked course. The distance is approximately 13 km, and the event takes place on Friday, October 31, 2025, at 20:00.

name: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra
description: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra takes place on Saturday, November 16, 2024, at Folkhälsan Solvalla Sports Institute, starting at 9:00 a.m. The competition category follows the backyard-style format, with simultaneous starts; the final start is at 4:00 p.m. and the finish closes at 5:00 p.m. In the recreational category, you can run at your own pace for as many laps as you like. There is also a shortened course of approximately 5 km, offering the atmosphere of a mass start. This event is a great opportunity to try ultrarunning amid the beautiful scenery of Nuuksio. Refreshments include mulled berry juice, warm juice, gingerbread cookies, and other light snacks.

name: Teivocup I
description: Teivo Cup I was run on 26 November 2011 in sunny weather, with temperatures a few degrees above zero. The race had 80 runners, who competed on a route that was icy in places. There was a good turnout in the youth categories. In the girls’ 11-year-old category, Mila Manninen (KU-68) ran the fastest time, 4:10. In the boys’ 11-year-old category, Miska Manninen (KU-68) was the fastest in 4:13. In the men’s 5 km, Jarkko Järvenpää improved the previous course record by two seconds, running 14:54.

description: The distances at the Voimaa Metsästä event range from 6 to 21 kilometres, with a separate 2 km distance for children. Each distance follows its own marked, continuous trail route, and no part of the route is run more than once. The 2024 routes have undergone a thorough update, and the new event centre is located in the former premises of the UKK Institute. All routes are mostly off-road trails, with short sections on gravel roads.

name: Teivocup
description: Teivocup is a winter-season test-run race series held around Teivo Racecourse once a month from November to April. Each race is 5 km, with men’s and women’s categories. name: Guldfeber Aarhus — Golden Fever #1
description:
Gold Fever — Denmark’s first SplitRace tournament. A free running game in the streets of Aarhus: 12 segments (0.4–1.9 km) are mapped around the city, and 7 of them form a hidden “golden chain” — nobody knows which ones, or in what order. Find them. Run them. Chase the times.

No mass start and no entry fee: run whenever you want, as often as you want, throughout 17 October – 1 November. The app measures your times via GPS. You earn points for each golden segment based on how close you are to the fastest time — women are scored against the fastest woman, men against the fastest man. Extra points go to the first runners to unlock a golden segment — and the tournament’s biggest bonus goes to the first to complete the whole chain in the correct order.

This is the first edition — a pilot for a maximum of 30 runners. Your feedback will shape the game.

(EN: A free city-wide running game in Aarhus. 12 segments, 7 of them secretly form a golden chain — find them and beat the clock. No mass start: run anytime 17 Oct – 1 Nov. Free entry, GPS timing in the SplitRace app. First edition, 30 pilot spots.)
additional: No start line and no start groups — all segments are on public, lit routes around Aarhus, and you can run them whenever you want during the event window. Participation requires the free SplitRace app (iOS / Android) — download it via splitrace.app, join the “Guldfeber Aarhus” tournament, and all 12 segments will appear on your map. Limited to the first 30 runners. Open streets: follow normal traffic rules. Questions? Write to support@splitrace.app or Instagram https://www.instagram.com/split_race/

name: 41. Jõulumäe Metsajooks
description:
The Jõulumäe Forest Run takes place on the third Sunday of November, 15 November, bringing running enthusiasts from Pärnu County and beyond together for the 41st time in the scenic Jõulumäe dune pine forest. It is one of Jõulumäe’s oldest and most beloved races. Come celebrate this sporting tradition with us—it’s a day when the entire pine forest fills with happy participants, supporters cheering on the runners, and autumn colours.

The Forest Run is open to everyone who enjoys being active. In addition to the traditional 9 km main race, the programme includes shorter races for children (500 m, 1,000 m and 2,000 m). This year, jogging has been added alongside recreational walking. No times are recorded for these 5.6 km distances; participants can enjoy the activity for themselves.

Runners compete in 18 age categories. Early registration is open until 12.11.2026 at 23:59.

Recommendations:

To avoid unnecessary rushing on site, early registration is strongly recommended.
By registering early, you help ensure the event is better organised—we know to expect you and can plan accordingly. You’ll also have more time to get ready on site.
If registering on site, please arrive promptly and adhere to the registration schedule.

description:
The course starts from the Kopli Lines promenade. The route continues through Kopli Käsepark, then along the seashore.

The first half of the route follows the seashore, offering beautiful views of Kopli Bay.

The route also passes through the Paljassaare Conservation Area, a beautiful nature reserve known for birdwatching. We then continue through the Tallinn Water property, where you can see how water is treated, before returning to the promenade.

name: SPORTLAND KÕRVEMAA METSAJOOKS  27. SEPTEMBER 2026
description:
Why take part in the Kõrvemaa Forest Run?

- Probably the most beautiful trails, surrounded by unspoilt nature.
- 100% of the course is in a stunning nature reserve.
- Give your body and mind a boost.
- Bring the whole family: activities and childcare are organised for the little ones, too.
- A convenient, compact event centre close to Tallinn.
- Free soup, a smoothie and other surprises from our partners for everyone.
- Of course, there’ll also be a hot sauna and, for the bolder participants, a hot tub.
- You can also take part with your whole work team to boost team spirit and health.
- Together, we’re helping improve public health in Estonia.

The Sportland pop-up shop will be open all day, so you can top up your running gear if you’ve forgotten something at home or want the best functional gear for the course. Every finisher will receive a great medal, a GRAM drink and a Nicks bar. Winners will receive Sportland credit, a sapling and gifts from our partners. The season’s best in each age group and the season’s best team will also be recognised.

Want to enjoy a private sauna with your group? Rent the Iglusaun by the pond! Would you like to stay overnight in Kõrvemaa? Check availability at Kuuse Elamusmajad.
course_highlights: 100% of the course runs through a stunning nature reserve
Trail running in unspoilt nature, with a mix of climbs and descents
Routes suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike
additional:
Register online at iseteenindus.sportlandkorvemaa.ee or through the Sportos platform, where Stebby is also available as a payment method.

The event takes place on Sunday, 27.09.2026. On race day, you can register at the start venue from 10.00. Registration closes 30 minutes before the start.

Seniors (aged 60+) and young people (aged up to 17) receive a 50% discount on the main distances when registering in advance. The discount is applied automatically during registration based on year of birth. The minimum discounted price is 15 EUR; the discount will not reduce the price below this amount. The discount does not apply to youth races, which already have a special price of 15 EUR. Only one discount can be used at a time; the system always applies the larger discount.

A 10% discount applies when registering at least 5 people together. A 20% discount applies when registering at least 10 people together. If you are registering from the same company, club or group of friends, be sure to enter your team name, as we will award the best team to take part in the series at the end of the season.

name: Swedbanki Tallinna Maraton
description:
Swedbank Tallinn Marathon and Tallinn Autumn Run invite you to register!

Estonia’s largest running and movement festival, the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon, takes place from September 11 to 13. The programme of this event, which brings together thousands of active people, includes the classic marathon (42.195 km) and marathon relay, half marathon (21.1 km), Tallinn Autumn Run (10 km), Nike Youth Run (5 km), Welcome Run and Limpa Kids’ Runs.

The Tallinn Marathon’s event centre and start-finish area are located on the edge of Tallinn’s Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The course runs along streets and cycle and pedestrian paths, passing interesting places and offering a colourful overview of Estonia’s capital.

Over the years, more than 340,000 active people have taken part in the Tallinn Marathon across its various distances. The record for international participants at Estonia’s largest sporting event by number of participants was set in 2025, when runners came from as many as 93 countries.

Take this opportunity to be part of Estonia’s most spectacular movement event!

description: On January 12, 2025, we invite you to the traditional run commemorating Freedom Defenders’ Day on January 13. The race distances and route remain unchanged: the 8-kilometer race starts at 20:00 from the Giruliai TV Tower, and the 3-kilometer race starts at around 20:20 from the Summer Stage. The first 700 participants to finish will receive medals with an exclusive design, and teamsport.lt has prepared prizes for the fastest runners.

name: Gintarinė jūrmylė Krosas
description: The international running competition “Gintarinė jūrmylė 2024” will take place in Klaipėda on October 12, 2024. Participants can choose the 8 km distance, which starts at 13:10 from the Giruliai TV Tower. The route follows the bicycle path, and runners will turn toward Liepų Street by the Summer Concert Stage.

name: Gintarinė jūrmylė
description: “Gintarinė jūrmylė 2025” will take place in beautiful Smiltynė, with the start and finish at the Sports and Wellness Base. Entry is free for participants under 20 and LLAF members if they register by 11 p.m. on October 8. Registration on October 9 until 3 p.m. costs 5 euros. The race covers 3 nautical miles (5.55 km – one lap) for women and junior girls, and 6 nautical miles (11.11 km – two laps) for men and junior boys.

distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratonas, 30 km, Pusmaratonas, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: Trail Kursiu Nerija (#TKN) is an unforgettable running adventure with incredible views and plenty of sand! This race takes place on the Curonian Spit and offers a range of distances—from 1 km to 104 km—so everyone can find a challenge that suits them.

name: Graužikai - Kelmė Race
description: The “Graužikai–Kelmė” V. Rimkus Memorial Run took place on October 28, 2023, in Kelmė, marking the 50th anniversary of this traditional event. This year, more than 200 runners from across Lithuania and guests from Ukraine took part. Vitalij Kuznetsov was the fastest in the 8 km race. The fastest woman was Aurika Balsytė, who is from Kelmė District. There was also a 1.8 km race, in which Lukas Mikavičius performed best, and a 200 m race for young children.

description: LBT 16 - RUN AROUND LITHUANIA will take place on October 26, 2025, at 11:00 at the Lithuanian Museum of Ethnography in Rumšiškės. Registration and bib number collection will begin at 09:00.

name: Panevėžio maratonas
description: The Panevėžys Marathon 2024 will take place in Panevėžys, Lithuania, and registration will open on September 13, 2024. Anyone who has registered and had a health check may participate. Participants can choose from various distances: a 400 m walk, 2.8 km, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon, with different age requirements.

name: PINK RUN su Antėja
description: PINK RUN with Antėja is an annual pink ribbon charity run dedicated to the fight against breast cancer and the prevention of this disease. Join our event in the heart of Kaunas—Laisvės Avenue—and run for the women you love. Support the fight against breast cancer by taking part in runs of various distances for both professionals and amateurs. Pink Run with Antėja is more than a run; it is a message that we love them.

Rožinis kaspinas, susijęs su krūties vėžio sąmoningumu.
Rožinis fonas.
Rožinis fonas su mažais baltais taškais.

name: Bezirksmeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The District Cross-Country Championships in Velpke are a long-standing cross-country running competition organized by the NLV Braunschweig District. The event gives runners of various age groups, from children to Masters, the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The course crosses varied terrain and offers a challenging test for all participants. Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, and the event takes place on February 8, 2026.
course_highlights: Cross-country course through varied terrain
Competition for children, youth, adults, and Masters
Organized by the NLV Braunschweig District in Velpke
additional: Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, at 23:59. The organizer is the NLV Braunschweig District. The event category is 6.4.2 District Championships. Cross-country terrain; registration deadline is February 1, 2026; various course distances, including children’s and youth categories.

name: Deutsche Polizeimeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The German Police Cross-Country Championships are the police’s official cross-country running championships and focus on competition within the police force. The event takes place in Ravensbergerwald in Potsdam and features distances of 3.6 km and 9 km. The races are part of a wider German running series regulated by the German Athletics Association (DLV), with officially measured courses and professional timing. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The race offers a challenging cross-country experience in typical November weather, with cool temperatures and frequent rain.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in Ravensbergerwald
Officially measured courses of 3.6 km and 9 km
Part of the DLV-regulated police championships
additional: Typical November weather: around 7 °C, a low of 2 °C, an average of 45 mm of precipitation, and rainy days. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The event is not an open road race but is exclusively for police runners. It is not open to the general public and is organized within the police force. The challenging course includes uphill and downhill sections and sandy terrain.

name: Graal-Müritzer Schneckenlauf
description: The Graal-Müritz Schneckenlauf is a long-standing running event held annually at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium. Runners and walkers of all ages can choose from several distances, including a Bambini race, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and awards for the strongest classes and best teams. The Streuselschnecken pastries served after the finish are especially popular.
course_highlights: Red course: 2 km run
Blue course: 5 km and 10 km (2 x 5 km laps)
Start and finish at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium
additional: Start times: 10:00 a.m. Bambini race, 10:30 a.m. 2 km run, 11:00 a.m. 5 km and 10 km runs. Walkers start 5 minutes after the runners. Training for children takes place on Wednesdays from 4:30–6:00 p.m. in the sports hall at Ostseegrundschule. Traditional awards are given to the strongest class and best team. Streuselschnecken pastries are a popular post-race treat. The race takes place at the Forest Stadium. Advance registration is available, with categories for children and adults as well as team and class competitions.

name: Potsdamer Cross im Rahmen der 22. DPM
description: The 2nd Potsdam Cross, held as part of the 22nd German Police Championships (DPM), takes place on November 14, 2026, in Potsdam. The event is organized and hosted by OSC Potsdam Luftschiffhafen e.V., Athletics Department. It offers runners the opportunity to compete in a challenging cross-country race and take part in a long-standing competition series. Registration is open until November 9, 2026.
course_highlights: Participation in the German Cross Championships (DPM)
Off-stadium course in Potsdam
Event held as part of a national championship
additional: The entry deadline is November 9, 2026; the scenic venue offers a varied cross-country course.

name: 1. Volkslauf Seelze
description: The ADAC Marathon Hannover offers a varied running experience with distances from 4 to 42 km, including the marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 10 km run and handbike marathon. The course is one of the flattest in Germany, with just 19 m of elevation difference, making it ideal for fast times. The event combines an urban atmosphere, modern music and green stretches, taking runners through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied programme of events featuring an expo, Power Party and finisher celebration.
course_highlights: Flat course with just 19 m of elevation difference
Route through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks
A range of distances from 4 to 42 km, including relay and handbike events
additional: Race packs are distributed at the Marathon Expo over marathon weekend. The course is very flat and therefore ideal for fast times. Live tracking is available via the ADAC Marathon app. Massage facilities and showers are available. The programme includes the ROSSMANN Power Party, the expo and a finisher party at the brewery. Free public transport on the event day is included. Information about the course, registration, results and photos is available on the event website. The race is part of a broad Laufpass programme featuring a variety of events in the Hannover region.

name: Bremer Kuhcross QX
description: The Kuhcross is a challenging and varied cross-country race organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on demanding terrain and enjoy the ultimate cross-country experience. The event traditionally takes place in Bremen in November and attracts cross-country enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: Challenging and varied cross-country terrain
A traditional event in Bremen
Organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen
additional: The race is open to children, young people and active runners, with various categories and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Lila-Eule-Cross
description: The 37th Lila-Eule-Cross in Kappeln is a long-running cross-country race on the Schlei that is very popular with runners. At the most recent edition, 308 runners reached the finish, setting a participation record. The course is known for its autumn atmosphere and for being less muddy than in previous years, making the race especially appealing. The event is organised by the Schleswig-Holstein Athletics Association and offers a sporting challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country race on the Schlei
Autumn atmosphere and strong performances
Less muddy course than in previous years
additional: Cross-country race on a varied course along the Schlei, including children’s and youth races, with a focus on autumn weather and state championships.

name: Stadtparkstaffelmarathon
description:
All information about the 2024 Stadtpark Relay Marathon organized by the marathon department of FC St. Pauli von 1910 e.V.

Date: Sunday, 04 October 2026, 10:00 a.m. (finish cutoff: 3:00 p.m.)

Start / finish: “Jahnkampfbahn” (stadium), Stadtpark, Linnering 3, 22299 Hamburg

Course and format: Relay race, 5 participants per team—women’s, men’s, mixed (at least 2 women). Each team member runs two laps of 4.2 km each on paths in the western part of Stadtpark (around the planetarium). Course marshals will be present. A detailed course map can be viewed at the end of the page.

Registration: by email to staffelmarathon@marathon.fcstpauli.com

Registration deadline: 20.09.2026

Required information: First and last names of all relay team members, the relay team’s name, and whether the team is a women’s, men’s, or mixed team.

name: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości – Kocham Polskę!
location: Strzeszyn, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 20 zł za koszulkę techniczną, wpisowe na stronie nie jest wyraźnie podane
description: The Poznań Independence Run – I Love Poland! is a cross-country race held in picturesque locations in Poznań, particularly in Strzeszyn near Malibu Beach. The event is part of the activities of a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland since 2014, with an emphasis on attractive courses and the sporting character of the event. The race has a patriotic dimension and takes place on 11 November, combining sport with a celebration of Poland’s independence. Runners are invited to take part in a range of distances amid beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country course around Strzeszyn and Malibu Beach
Picturesque green areas of Poznań
A patriotic race held on 11 November
additional: The organiser is a group of running enthusiasts from Greater Poland, active since 2014 and specialising in cross-country races. The race takes place in the green areas of Strzeszyn, near Malibu Beach. The event has a patriotic character and is part of the Poznań Running Triad. Participant limit: 750; picturesque courses; cross-country races.

name: 9 Olsztyński Bieg Niepodległości
location: Centrum Rekreacyjno-Sportowe Ukiel, Olsztyn, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Olsztyn Independence Run is an annual patriotic sporting event held in Olsztyn, combining the joy of running with celebrations of Independence Day. The event is open to everyone, from experienced runners to families with children. The races take place at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre and include 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking, and children’s races of up to 400 metres. The atmosphere is lively despite the autumn weather, and places are limited, with online registration open until 6 November.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km routes run through the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre grounds and along nearby streets: Sielska, Schumana and Kapitańska
The event combines sporting competition with patriotic celebrations
Nordic walking and children’s races of up to 400 metres are also available
additional: The start and finish are located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre. The event takes place on 11 November, and registration is open online until 6 November. Participants can choose from the 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking, and children’s races of up to 400 m. Traffic disruptions should be expected along the race route. Traffic disruptions along the route; start at 9:00; registration until 6 November; event at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre and on Sielska, Schumana and Kapitańska streets.

name: Gdyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Gdynia Independence Run is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the 2026 Gdynia Grand Prix. The 10 km main race attracts runners of all ages, and there are also races for children and young people. The event combines sport and recreation, with participants able to expect professional organization and an atmosphere celebrating Poland’s independence. Photos and video footage are taken during the event for the organizers’ promotional purposes.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
Races for children and young people
Part of the 2026 Gdynia Grand Prix
additional: Photos and video footage will be taken during the event to promote events organized by GCS and the Municipality of the City of Gdynia. Registration until October 28, 2026; results, photo galleries, and information about event partners are available.

name: II Bieg Legionów Polskich
description: The 2nd Polish Legions Run commemorates the anniversary of Poland regaining its independence and offers two distances: 5 km and 10 km. The starts take place in scenic coastal locations: Władysławowo, Rozewie and Jastrzębia Góra. The organizer provides transport from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations and opens the race office on the day before and on race day. The course is available online, allowing participants to familiarize themselves with the route before the start.
course_highlights: The course passes through Władysławowo, Rozewie and Jastrzębia Góra
The 10 km race starts by the General Haller monument on Morska Street in Władysławowo
The 5 km race starts by the bust of Marshal Piłsudski on Garnizonowa Street in Rozewie
additional: Transport from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations is provided. The race office is open on 10 November 2025 from 14:30 to 15:30 at OSiR Władysławowo, and on 11 November 2025 from 10:20 to 10:50 in Jastrzębia Góra. The course is available online at https://www.traseo.pl/trasa/bieg-legionow-polskich. Registration runs from 22 September to 5 November 2025; the event takes place on routes with moderate elevation gain, starting in Władysławowo and Rozewie.

name: XXXVIII Goleniowska Mila Niepodległości o Puchar Burmistrza Gminy Goleniów
description: The 38th Goleniów Independence Mile is an annual one-mile race held to celebrate Independence Day in Goleniów. The event offers an opportunity to celebrate Poland’s independence together through sport, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The race takes place in Goleniów and is open to everyone, regardless of age or experience level.
course_highlights: A one-mile race
Held to celebrate Independence Day
Supports the local community and promotes physical activity
additional: The race takes place on 11 November 2026 in Goleniów and is part of the region’s Independence Day celebrations.

name: Grand Prix Powiatu Kościerskiego
description: The Kościan County Grand Prix is a series of five 5 km races, organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County under the patronage of the Kościan County Governor. Its aim is to promote physical activity, healthy competition, and community integration. Residents of the county who turn 16 in 2025 may participate. Each race requires a separate entry fee, and the overall standings are based on the total points earned across the races.
course_highlights: A series of five 5 km races
Organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County
Separate standings for women and men, with no age categories
additional: Participation in the Grand Prix is free; only the entry fee for each individual race, set locally, is payable. The races are scheduled from June to December 2025 in various locations across the county. Points from the individual races are added together, with prizes for the top 6 women and top 6 men, as well as additional special prizes from the organizers of the individual races. The series comprises five 5 km races held from June to December, with overall standings and prizes for the top finishers. The main 10 km race is scheduled for 15 November 2026 in Kościerzyna, with typical autumn weather and possible rain.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet na cały cykl w jednym mieście (4 imprezy) kosztuje 154,99 zł

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The races take place in beautiful woodland surroundings by Lake Szmaragdowe, with a course suitable for both beginners and advanced runners. Each race is an opportunity to test yourself on the same course, and results from individual races count toward the series standings. The organizers promote outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland beside Lake Szmaragdowe
A varied course profile with climbs and descents, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
The start and finish are located behind Zajazd Szmaragd, at ul. Kopalniana
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. The main race starts at 11:00. A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. Participants can collect their race number and timing chip at the race office on race day. A pass for the entire series entitles the holder to one free start in another city in the series, after notifying the organizers by email in advance. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Registration is available online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. The main race is open to participants aged 16 or older, or those who turn 16 in 2026; CITY TRAIL Junior is also held alongside the event.

name: III KÓRNICKI BIEG ZAMOYSKIEGO
location: Kórnickie Centrum Rekreacji i Sportu OAZA
organizer: Kórnickie Centrum Rekreacji i Sportu OAZA
description:
Edition celebrating the “Year of Kórnik Heritage”

Date: Sunday, 27 September 2026, at 10:00

Venue: Kórnickie Centrum Rekreacji i Sportu OAZA – Błonie.

The course follows the charming promenade along Lake Kórnickie, then speeds through the streets of Bnin before the final section leads into the quiet, picturesque Zwierzyniec Experimental Forest. This is a run with varied terrain: from paved routes to dirt trails surrounded by woodland.

Start/Finish: ul. Błonie, 62-035 Kórnik

10 km race

Entries will be accepted online only until 31 August 2026.

Participation in the “Bieg Zamoyskiego” is paid:
- Basic package – 80zł
- Extended package with a T-shirt – 130zł

Runner limit: 400
